FOREWORD
Ghana’s new Senior High School Curriculum aims to ensure that all learners achieve 
their potential by equipping them with 21st Century skills, knowledge, character 
qualities and shared Ghanaian values. This will prepare learners to live a responsible 
adult life, progress to further studies and enter the world of work. This is the first time 
that Ghana has developed a Senior High School Curriculum which focuses on national 
values, attempting to educate a generation of Ghanaian youth who are proud of our 
country and can contribute effectively to its development.
The Ministry of Education is proud to have overseen the production of these Learner 
Materials which can be used in class and for self-study and revision. These materials 
have been developed through a partnership between the Ghana Education Service, 
teacher unions (Ghana National Association of Teachers- GNAT, National Association 
of Graduate Teacher -NAGRAT and the Pre-Tertiary Teachers Association of Ghana- 
PRETAG) and National Subject Associations. These materials are informative and of 
high quality because they have been written by teachers for teachers with the expert 
backing of each subject association.
I believe that, if used appropriately, these materials will go a long way to transforming 
our Senior High Schools and developing Ghana so that we become a proud, prosperous 
and values-driven nation where our people are our greatest national asset.
Haruna Iddrisu MP
Minister for Education

NKƆMMƆDI
Asɛnsin Nhyehyɛe ne Toonu/Ɛnne
NNIANIM
Saa ɔfa yi kasa fa asɛnsin, asɛnsin nhyehyɛe ne toonu ho. Saa ɔfa yi mu adesua bɛkɔ 
awiei no, na woahu nsonsonoe a ɛda asɛnsin a ɛnne nnyigyei twa to ne asɛnsin a anom 
nnyigyei (kɔnsonant) twa to ntam wɔ Akuapem Twi kasa mu na afei nso, wutumi 
kyerɛ kwan a asɛnsin nhyehyɛe fa so boa ma yɛyɛ nsɛmfua foforo. Afei nso, wubesua 
biribi afa toonu ho na woatumi akyerɛ toonu ahorow a ɛyɛ fam, soro, adantam, sorokɔ, 
famba ne nea ɛkeka ho. Adesua a ɛwɔ ɔfa yi mu no bɛsan aboa wo ama woanya 
nimdeɛ wɔ kwan a yɛfa so gyina toonu ho nimdeɛ so yɛ nsɛmfua foforo wɔ Akuapem 
Twi kasa mu. Awiei no, ɔfa yi mu adesua no bɛkasa afa toonu dwumadi ahorow wɔ 
Akuapem Twi kasa mu a ɛnonom ne; nea ɛde nsonsonoe ba asɛmfua ntease mu, nea 
ɛde nsonsonoe ba kasa mmara mu ne nea ɛde nsonsonoe ba Akan kasa nkorabata 
ahorow mu no ho.
ADWEMPƆ AHOROW
• Asɛnsin yɛ asɛmfua fa bi a yɛte wɔ kasa mu.
• Anom (Kɔnsonant) nnyigyei yɛ anom nnyigyei a etumi gyina sɛ asɛnsin.
• Toonu yɛ ɛnne mu nsakrae a etumi de nsakrae ba asɛmfua ntease mu.
ASƐNSIN, N’AHOROW NE NE NHYEHYƐE
Asɛnsin Asekyerɛ
Asɛnsin yɛ mframakuw biako wɔ kasa mu a ɛtaa kura nnyigyei sɛ ne fa bi anaa asɛnsin 
no ankasa. Yɛbɛsan atumi akyerɛ asɛnsin ase sɛ, ɛyɛ mframakuw biako a yegyina so wɔ 
bere a yɛrekenkan asɛmfua anaa yɛrebɔ asɛmfua bi din. Nhwɛso, wobegyina mprenu 
wɔ bere a worekenkan anaasɛ worebɔ asɛmfua bi te sɛ, Kofi [ko:fi]. Eyi kyerɛ sɛ, 
asɛmfua Kofi wɔ asɛnsin abien (2) nanso sɛ yɛrekenkan asɛmfua tu a, yɛte mframakuw 
koro pɛ [tu] na eyi ma yehu sɛ, tu wɔ asɛnsin koro pɛ. Enti, wususuw sɛ, asɛnsin 
dodow ahe na ɛwɔ asɛmfua Bagabaga mu?
Sɛ yɛde ɛnne nnyigyei to nkyɛn a, anom nnyigyei bi te sɛ /m, n, w, r, l/ tumi gyina 
sɛ asɛnsin. Yenya saa anom nnyigyei asɛnsin yi wɔ bere a ɛnne nnyigyei biara nni saa 
anom nnyigyei yinom mu biara akyi. Nhwɛso, [pa:m], [na:m], [ka:m] [m:pa] ne nea 
ɛkeka ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ asɛnsin kura ɛnne nnyigyei biako a ebetumi aba sɛ anom nnyigyei 
di n’anim, n’akyi anaa twa ho hyia. Etumi ba sɛ, asɛmfua bi nya asɛnsin koro pɛ, na

sɛ ɛba no saa a, yɛfrɛ saa asɛmfua no sɛ, asɛnsin koro pɛ asɛmfua. Bio, etumi ba sɛ, 
asɛmfua bi nya asɛnsin abien, na sɛ ɛba no saa a, yɛfrɛ saa asɛmfua no sɛ, asɛnsin 
abien asɛmfua ɛnna edu bere bi nso a, asɛmfua bi tumi nya nsɛnsin bebree na sɛ ɛba 
no saa a, yɛfrɛ saa asɛmfua no sɛ, nsɛnsin bebree asɛmfua. Ne nyinaa ho nhwɛso bi na 
edidi so yi:
1. Asɛnsin koro pɛ asɛmfua: Ho [ho], fa [fa]
2. Asɛnsin abien asɛmfua: Tafo  [ta:fo], Osu [o:su]
3. Nsɛnsin bebree asɛmfua: Sakora [sa:ko:ra], Takoradi [ta:ko:ra:di], kakapɛ 
[ka:ka:pɛ]
Asɛnsin nhyehyɛe nimdeɛ ho hia efisɛ;
a. ɛboa adesuafo ma wotumi yɛ nsɛmfua foforo
b. ɛboa adesuafo no ma wotumi hu nsɛmfua a ɛwɔ ɔkasa bi mu
c. ɛsan nso boa adesuafo no ma wotumi te kasa bi mu nsɛmfua ase.
Nea edidi so yi yɛ Akuapem Twi nsɛmfua a wɔakyekyɛ mu kɔ nsɛnsin ahorow mu no 
ho nhwɛso: kɔ: m, e: tu: o, ɛ: tɔ
Nhwɛso a ɛwɔ soro hɔ no mu no, mframakuw biako biara a yɛte no gyina hɔ sɛ asɛnsin 
biako. Wɔakyekyɛ asɛmfua biara mu kɔ nsɛnsin ahorow a ɛwɔ mu mu.
Asɛnsin Ahorow
Ghana ha kasa ahorow no mu biara wɔ nsɛnsin ahorow nanso ne nyinaa mu no, 
nsɛnsin a edi akoten wom ne asɛnsin a ɛnne nnyigyei twa to ne asɛnsin a anom 
nnyigyei twa to.
Asɛnsin a emu abue
Asɛnsin a emu abue yɛ asɛnsin a ɛnne nnyigyei twa to. Nea edidi so yi yɛ Ghana ha 
kasa ahorow no mu bi nsɛnsin a emu bue no ho nhwɛso.
Ewe:  kpe, tɔ, va, dzo
Ga:  ka, : ka: ti: ɛ, ka: la: de
Mfantse:   su, ku: ko, pa
Twi:   ko: fi, bu: tu, bɔ: tɔ
Asɛnsin a anom nnyigyei twa to
Asɛnsin a emu to yɛ asɛnsin a anom nnyigyei twa to. Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhyɛ no nso sɛ, Ghana 
ha kasa ahorow no mu bebree na enni saa asɛnsin a anom nnyigyei na etwa to yi bi. 
Ghana ha kasa ahorow no mu kakra bi a wɔwɔ saa asɛnsin yi bi nonom ne Dagbani, 
Gurune, Likpankpaanl, Dagaree. Ɛho hwɛso no mu bi na edidi so yi: zab: li, dab: li
Gurune: nabt

Dwumadi 1.1 Asɛnsin asekyerɛ
1. Fa w’ankasa nsɛmfua kyerɛkyerɛ asɛnsin ase. Ka wo mmuae no kyerɛ adesuafo 
nkae no nyinaa.
2. Kyerɛkyerɛ nsɛnsin ahorow a ɛwɔ Akuapem Twi kasa mu no mu.
3. Kyerɛkyerɛ mfaso a ɛwɔ asɛnsin nhyehyɛe ho nimdeɛ so wɔ nsɛmfuayɛ mu. 
Ɛne wo mfɛfo nkyɛ wo mmuae no.
Asɛnsin nhyehyɛe
Ɔkasa biara wɔ ne nsɛnsin nhyehyɛe. Yegyina anom nnyigyei (A) ne ɛnne nnyigyei (Ɛ) 
so na ɛkyerɛkyerɛ asɛnsin nhyehyɛe mu. Asɛnsin fa a ɛho hia pa ara yɛ ɛnne nnyigyei. 
Kasa ahorow a ɛwɔ Ghana ha nyinaa mu nso no, toonu boa pa ara ma yehu asɛnsin bi 
nhyehyɛe. Yetumi de toonu ahyɛnsode toto ɛnne nnyigyei ne anom nnyigyei nyinaa 
so. Ɛnne nnyigyei ne anom nnyigyei dodow a ɛwɔ asɛmfua bi mu na ɛma yehu nsɛnsin 
dodow a ɛwɔ saa asɛmfua no mu. Nhwɛso, sɛ ɛnne nnyigyei a ɛwɔ asɛmfua bi mu yɛ 
abien (2) a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ, saa asɛmfua no wɔ nsɛnsin abien (2). Ghana kasa ahorow no bi 
ne wɔn nsɛnsin nhyehyɛe ho nhwɛso na edidi so yi:.
1. Ewe:  e (Ɛ), tɔ (AƐ),
2. Ga:  ni (Aɛ), a: te (Ɛ: AƐ), n: ka: ti: ɛ (A: AƐ: AƐ: Ɛ)
3. Twi:  a (Ɛ), tu (AƐ), a: ta (Ɛ: AƐ), n: ta (A:AƐ), e: tu: o (Ɛ: AƐ: Ɛ)
4. Mfante  a (Ɛ), kɔ (AƐ), a: pa (Ɛ: AƐ), m: pa (A: AƐ), a: pa: a (Ɛ: AƐ: Ɛ)
5. Dagbani  zab: li (AƐA:AƐ)
Dwumadi 1.2 Akuapem Twi asɛnsin nhyehyɛe
Yɛ mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu fa Akuapem Twi nsɛnsin nhyehyɛe no ho. Ɛne adesuafo nkae 
no nkyɛ wo mmuae no.
Dwumadi 1.3 Nsɛmfuayɛ a egyina asɛnsin so

2. Ɛne wo mfɛfo nkyɛ adwen mfa asɛnsin no mu biara nhyehyɛe ho.
Kuw biara nkyerɛw wɔn mmuae na wɔnka ho asɛm nkyerɛ adesuafo nkae no mfa 
mpɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu wɔ wɔn mmuae no ho.

TOONU (ƐNNE)
Ɔkasa ahorow nyinaa de ɛnne a ɛwɔ soro anaa nea ɛwɔ fam di dwuma wɔ ɔkasa mu 
de si asɛmfua bi ntease so dua anaa de da wɔn atenka adi. Toonu yɛ ɛnne a ɛwɔ soro 
anaa fam wɔ asɛnsin bi so a ɛde nsakrae ba asɛmfua bi ntease mu. Toonu kasa yɛ kasa 
a ne nsɛmfua ntease no gyina toonu so. Ghana ha kasa ahorow no nyinaa mu nsɛmfua 
ntease gyina toonu so. Ɛnne mu nsakrae a ɛkɔ so wɔ ɔkasamu mu no na yɛfrɛ no ɛnne 
soro-famkɔ.
Toonu (Ɛnne) ahorow
Ɔkasa biara wɔ toonu ahorow. Nea edidi so yi yɛ toonu a ɛwɔ Ghana ha kasa horow no 
bi mu ho nhwɛso: soro (S) toonu, Fam (F) toonu adantam (A) toonu, famkɔ (FK) toonu 
ne sorokɔ (SK) toonu. Ghana ha kasa ahorow no nyinaa mu biara wɔ toonu ahorow 
abien a ɛnonom ne soro ne fam. Ɔkasa foforo bi nso wɔ adantam toonu ka soro ne fam 
toonu no ho. Ɔkasa foforo bi nso wɔ hɔ a wɔwɔ sorokɔ ne famkɔ toonu ka soro, fam 
ne adantam toonu no ho. Nea edidi so yi yɛ toonu a ɛwɔ Ghana ha kasa ahorow no bi 
mu ho nhwɛso.

Yɛde ahyɛnsode a ɛwɔ adakaba yi mu no [`] na ɛkyerɛ fam toonu, yɛde nea ɛwɔ 
adakaba eyi [´] mu no kyerɛ soro toonu ɛnna yɛde nea ɛwɔ adakaba eyi [ ¯] mu no

Toonu (Ɛnne) Dwumadi
Toonu di akoten wɔ toonu kasa ahorow mu ɛnam ne dwuma a edi wɔ ɔkasa ntease 
mu no nti. Toonu di dwuma ahorow abiɛsa wɔ toonu abiɛsa (3) wɔ toonu ahorow mu. 
Eyinom ne nea ɛde nsonsonoe ba asɛmfua ntease mu, nea ɛde nsonsonoe ba ɔkasa 
mmara mu ne nea ɛde nsonsonoe ba Akan kasa nkorabata ahorow mu.
1. Nea ɛde nsonsonoe ba asɛmfua ntease mu:
Yɛde Toonu di dwuma wɔ nsɛmfua wɔn asopɛ no yɛ pɛ mu ma yehu ntease ahorow 
a ɛwɔ saa asɛmfua no mu. Hwɛ nhwɛso a edidi so yi. Hyɛ sɛnea toonu ahyɛnsode 
a ɛdeda akyerɛwde ahorow no so no sesa toonu no.
a. Akan: pá:pá ‘good’ ne pà:pá ‘father’, sùsùw ‘to measure’ ne. súsú ‘savings’
b. Ewe: sí ‘to flee’ ne sì ‘to cut’
c. Ga: bè ‘time’ ne bé ‘to quarrel’
2. Nea ɛde nsonsonoe ba ɔkasa mmara mu:
Yɛde Toonu di dwuma wɔ kasa mmara mu de kyerɛ nsonsonoe a ɛda adeyɛ kabea 
ahorow no ntam. Ɛho nhwɛso no bi na edidi so yi.
a. Daa/Seesei/Mprempren kabea: kòfí ʥìná ‘Kofi stands’ vs kòfí ʥìnà ‘Kofi stop!’
b. Daa/Seesei/Mprempren kabea ne Daakye kabea: kòfí bɛ̀ fá ‘Kofi takes’ ne kòfí 
bɛ́fá ‘Kofi will take’
c. Dabi ne ɔhyɛ kabea: ǹtá ‘don’t mend’ ne ńtá ‘should mend’
d. Ɔkasamufa titiriw ne ɔkasamufa kumaa: [mÍrÍkɔ] wɔ Akuapem Twi kasa‘I’m 
going’ ne [ mÌrÍkɔ nʊ́] ‘When I was going…’
3. Nea ɛde nsonsonoe ba Akan kasa nkorabata ahorow mu:
Ɛho nhwɛso no bi na edidi so yi:
a. i. [mʊ̀rʊ́kɔ̀] wɔ Fante kasa mu ne [mɪ́rɪ́kɔ́] wɔ Akuapem kasa mu ‘I’m going’
ii. [ ɔƙɔ́] wɔ Asante kasa mu ne [ɔƙɔ̀] wɔ Akuapem ‘S/he is gone’

1. Montena baanu baanu na montie nsɛmfua a mo kyerɛkyerɛfo no rebɛkenkan 
akyerɛ mo no na monyɛ nea edidi so no:
a. Kyerɛ toonu ko a ɛwɔ nsɛmfua no mu:

iv. Dangme: lε ‘firewood’ lε ‘canoe’, ba ‘come’, ba ‘leaf’
b. Kyerɛ asɛnsin a toonu ahyɛnsode no da so wɔ asɛmfua no mu.
2. Monka mo mmuae no nkyerɛ adesuafo nkae no nyinaa.

NKƆMMƆDI
ABASƐM HO NKƆMMƆDI NE AKENKAN
NNIANIM
Saa ɔfa yi kasa fa ɔkwan a yɛfa so hwehwɛ adwempɔ ahorow a ɛwɔ abasɛm anaa 
nkɔmmɔdi bi mu. Saa ɔfa yi bɛsan aka akenkan a emu dɔ ne akenkan ntrɛwmu ho 
asɛm tiawa bi akyerɛ wo. Mobɛpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm ɔkwan ahorow a yɛfa so hu ɔkyerɛwfo 
bi adwempɔw ne ɔkwan a yɛfa so de saa adwempɔw ahorow no to atiefo anim fann.
Twaka amapa da saa ɔfa yi ne adesua bi te sɛ Borɔfo kasa, Social Studies ne kasa 
ahorow no ntam.
ADWEMPƆW AHOROW
Asɛntitiriw a ɛwɔ abasɛm bi mu no na yɛfrɛ no adwempɔw. Eyi tumi yɛ nnyinaso kasamu 
a ɛsan nso wɔ ɔkasamu ahorow a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ mu. Akenkan tumi yɛ akenkan a emu dɔ 
anaa akenkan ntrɛwmu.
• Akenkan a emu dɔ yɛ akenkan a yɛto yɛn bo ase kenkan abasɛm bi yiye de hwehwɛ 
ɔkyerɛwfo adwen pɔtee a ɔde reto gua wɔ abasɛm no mu.
• Akenkan ntrɛwmu ne sɛ worekenkan nhoma bi a ɛso anaasɛ emu nsɛmfua no dɔɔso 
yiye na woafa so de anya nsɛmfua foforo aka nea wowɔ dedaw no ho na ama 
woatumi atu mpɔn wɔ akenkan ne ntease mu.
SƐNEA YESI HWEHWƐ ADWEMPƆW WƆ 
ABASƐM MU
Nnwennweneho asɛmmisa: Dwendwen nneɛma ahorow a woasua wɔ afe a edi kan 
mu no ho, dɛn ne adwempɔw? Fa w’adwenkyerɛ no toto kuw a wowɔ mu no de ho na 
afei kenkan nea edi so yi:
Adwempɔw: Eyi yɛ asɛntitiriw a ɛho hia pa ara a ɔkyerɛwfo da no adi wɔ kasapɛn bi 
mu wɔ abasɛm anaa nkɔmmɔdi bi mu. Adwempɔw no na ɛka abasɛm anaa nkɔmmɔdi 
no nyinaa botae. Wɔde kyerɛkyerɛ adwempɔw no mu yiye wɔ abasɛm anaa nkɔmmɔdi 
no mu. Sɛ wuhu ɔkasamu ahorow a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ nnyinaso kasamu no mu a, ɛboa ma 
wuhu adwempɔw no. Wubetumi afa akwan a edidi so yi so ahu adwempɔw a ɛwɔ 
abasɛm bi mu:
Kenkan atifi asɛm no ne nnianim no: Ɛho hia sɛ wubehu nea atifi asɛm no ne nnianim 
no ka fa asɛm pɔtee a abasɛm no rekasa fa ho no ho.

AKENKAN NE ADWEMPƆW HWEHWƐ
Year TwoƆFA 2
Hwehwɛ nnyinaso kasamu no: Mpɛn pii no ɛyɛ a na nnyinaso kasamu no di kasapɛn 
no kan. Ɛsɛ sɛ wohyɛ no nso sɛ, edu bere bi a, yetumi de nnyinaso kasamu no kɔhyɛ 
kasapɛn no mfinimfini anaa n’awiei.
Worehwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu kasamu ahorow: Sɛ wubehu ɔkasamu ahorow a 
ɛkyerɛkyerɛ adwempɔw no mu a, bisa wo ho nsɛm a edidi so yi: dɛn ne adwempɔw 
no, hefa na mehu adwempɔw, adɛn na eyi yɛ adwempɔw no, ɔkwan bɛn na mɛfa so 
ahu adwempɔw no?
Tɔfabɔ: Fa w’ankasa nsɛmfua bɔ abasɛm no tɔfa.
Ntotoho: Fa wo tɔfabɔ no toto nea wɔakyerɛw wɔ abasɛm a wokenkanee no awiei hɔ 
no ho.
Akenkan a emu dɔ
Akenkan a emu dɔ yɛ akenkan a yɛto yɛn bo ase kenkan abasɛm bi yiye de hwehwɛ 
ɔkyerɛwfo adwen pɔtee a ɔde reto gua wɔ abasɛm no mu. Eyi asekyerɛ ne sɛ, woreto wo 
bo ase akenkan abasɛm bi na woahyɛ emu nkyerɛkyerɛmu no nso. Ɛsɛ sɛ wohwehwɛ 
nsɛmfua titiriw a ɛwɔ abasɛm no mu. Etumi ba sɛ, wɔsensan nsɛmfua titiriw no 
ase, wɔkyerɛw nsɛmfua titiriw no kyeakyea no, wɔyɛ nsɛmfua titiriw no pikapika, 
wɔkyerɛw ti mu, ne nea ɛkeka ho wɔ abasɛm no mu. Nea ɛka ho bio ne sɛ, worekyerɛw 
nsɛmfua bi agu wo nhoma no mu, worehwehwɛ nsɛmfua bi asekyerɛ wɔ nsɛmfua 
nkyerɛase nhoma mu ne sɛ worekenkan abasɛm bi yiye pa ara ate ase yiye nyinaa ka 
akenkan a emu dɔ ho.
Dwumadi 2.1 Ɔhareso-akenkan ne Ɔhareso ade -hwehwɛ nkyerɛase
Musuaa biribi faa ɔhareso-akenkan ne ɔhareso-ade-hwehwɛ ho wɔ afe a edi 
kan no mu, monyina saa nimdeɛ no so na monkyerɛ emu biara ase, na afei 
nso, mompɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm akwan ahorow abiɛsa a yɛfa so yɛ ɔhareso-akenkan ne 
ɔhareso-ade-hwehwɛ. Fa nea woakyerɛw no toto nea wɔakyerɛw wɔ ase hɔ no ho.
AKENKAN A EMU DƆ SU
Akenkan a emu dɔ wɔ su bebree nanso saa adesua yi mu de, emu abien (2) pɛ a 
ɛnonom ne Ɔhareso-akenkan ne ɔhareso-ade-hwehwɛ na wubesua ho ade.
Ɔhareso-akenkan
Eyi yɛ akenkan a yɛde hwehwɛ asɛntitiriw a ɛwɔ abasɛm bi mu. Saa akenkan yi mu 
no, wonte abasɛm no ase efisɛ wokenkan abasɛm no nyinaa. Yɛde saa akenkan yi di 
dwuma wɔ nokwasɛm abasɛm akenkan mu.

AKENKAN NE ADWEMPƆW HWEHWƐ
Year TwoƆFA 2
Ɔhareso-ade-hwehwɛ
Eyi yi akenkan a yɛde yɛn ani fa akenkansɛm bi mu ntɛmso de hwehwɛ asɛmfua anaa 
nsɛmfua pɔtee bi. Yɛde saa akenkan yi hwehwɛ mmuae ma nsɛmmisa pɔtee bi.
Dwumadi 2.2 Adwempɔw hwehwɛ
1. Kenkan abasɛm a ɛwɔ ase hɔ no.
2. Kyerɛ adwempɔw a ɛwɔ abasɛm a ɛwɔ ase hɔ no mu.
3. Ka adwempɔw a wuhui no kyerɛ adesuafo nkae no na fa toto wɔn de ho.
NSIYƐ
Me mofra bere mu a na madi mfe anan na me maame kaa nkyene gui a na 
minnim biribiara nso fa me papa ne mpo baabi a ɔwɔ ho. Akwannya a na 
ɛwɔ hɔ ma me wɔ m’abrabɔ mu ara ne sɛ mene m’abusuafo a na mehuu wɔn 
mu binom mpo da kɔtena. Na abusuafo no mu biara nni hɔ a wayɛ krado 
sɛ ɔne me bɛtena ne fi na wahwɛ me. Nnɛ mekɔ oyi hɔ a, na ɔkyena mekɔ 
ɔfoforo hɔ: Mantena ofi biako mu anni afe biako mpo da anaa sukuu biako 
afe mpo da a eyi kɔɔ so bɛyɛ mfe dunan. Nea ɛka eyinom ho ne sɛ abusuafo 
no bi faa atenantwie a na medi wɔ abusuafo no so no so hyɛɛ me aniɛyaw yɛɛ 
me ayakayakade a nnɛ yi mpo, ɛda so yɛ me awerɛhow sɛ mɛka ho asɛm. Na 
mede m’afɛfo asukuufo no na ɛkyekyere me werɛ efisɛ sukuu mu nko ara na 
ɛyɛ beae a mekɔ a, metumi yi m’ani fi nsɛm a ɛkɔ so wɔ efie no so. Medii mfe 
du no, na wɔhyɛ me ma meyɛ adwumaden wɔ nnawɔtwe awiei ne akwamma 
mu de hwɛ me ho. Na mekɔyɛ berekyafo adwuma wɔ adansibea ahorow, na 
mede ɔkorow kɔ po so koyi mpataa san pae abo. Eyi kɔɔ so mfe du ma ɛnam 
so maa metumi de sika siee a ɛboaa me maa metumi de me ho kɔtoo ntoaso 
sukuu mu. Anigyesɛm ne sɛ, na mebɔ mmɔden yiye wɔ nhomasua mu na ɛnam 
so ma wɔyii me sɛ asukuufo no nyinaa kannifo wɔ bere a meduu gyinapɛn a 
etwa to no. Na meka wɔn a wɔbɔɔ wɔn ho mmɔden pa ara wɔ sɔhwɛ a etwa 
to no mu no ho.
Dwumadi 2.3 Adwempɔw Hwehwɛ
1.  Kuw biara nyɛ mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu wɔ abasɛm a ɛwɔ ase hɔ no mu na monhwehwɛ 
adwempɔw a ɛwɔ mu no.
2. Ka w’adwempɔw no kyerɛ adesuafo nkae no.
Osetie so mfaso
Abeawa: Me nua, woadwen hia a osetie ho hia ho pɛn?
Abarimaa: Yiw,mesusuw sɛ, osetie ne sɛ woredi mmara so na afei nso wode nnidi 
bɛma mpanyimfo.

Year TwoƆFA 2
Abeawa: Saa pɛpɛɛpɛ, Osetie boro sɛ woredi mmara so. Ɛyɛ gyidi, obuo ne nokwaredi. 
Sɛ woyɛ setie ma w’awofo a, woma wɔhu sɛ, wogye wɔn akwankyerɛ ne wɔn ateneatene 
di.
Abeawa; Eyi yɛ nokwasɛm na sɛ mpanyimfo nso yɛ mfomso ɛ?
Abarimaa: Asɛm pa ara na woabisa yi. Ɛnyɛ sɛ wobebu w’ani agu mpanyimfo mfomso 
so akɔ so de obu ama wɔn. Ɛsɛ sɛ yebisa nsɛm pɛ mu nkyerɛkyerɛmu wɔ bere a ɛsɛ mu.
Nanso, ne nyinaa mu no, setie boa ma yenya asomdwoe ne ahobammɔ.
Abarimaa: Mannwene ho saa da.
Abeawa: Hwɛ eyi nso ɛe-setie yɛ ayɔnkofa dodow no ara fapem amapa: ɔwofo-ɔba, 
ɔkyerɛkyerɛni-osuani, adwumawura-odwumayɛni. Ɛhyɛ gyidie mu kena na ɛma nkɔso 
nso ba.
Abarimaa: Nea woreka no yɛ nokware, Mɛbɔ mmɔden ayɛ setie wɔ m’ankasa m’abrabɔ 
mu.
Dwumadi 2.4 Nkɔmmɔdi
Montena baanu baanu na hyehyɛ nkɔmmɔdi bi te sɛ biako a ɛwɔ soro hɔ no fa 
ahoɔdennɛe, abɛɛfo mfididwuma so mfaso anaa ahonnidi so mfaso ho na monna 
no adi wɔ agoru kwan so nkyerɛ asuafo nkae no. Ma adesuafo nkae no nyɛ 
mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu mfa nea wɔsusuw sɛ ɛyɛ adwempɔw no mu.
Dwumadi 2.5 Akenkan a emu dɔ ho nimdeɛ
Kenkan abasɛm a ɛwɔ fam hɔ no na bua nsɛmmisa ahorow a ɛtoa so no.
1. Montena akuwakuw na monnyina ɔhareso- akenkan nimdeɛ so mfa nhwehwɛ 
na monkyerɛw adwempɔw abien biara mfi abasɛm no mu na akuw nkae no 
nkyɛ saa nimdeɛ no.
2. Gyina ɔhareso-ade-hwehwɛ so kyerɛ ade titiriw a ɔkyerɛwfo no susuw sɛ ɛho 
hia sɛ sukuupanyin no bɔ ho ban.
Sukuupanyin no gyina hɔ ma tumidi wɔ sukuu no mu. Ɔno na ɔkyerɛ nea ɛsɛ sɛ ɛkɔ 
so wɔ sukuu no mu fa adekyerɛ ne adesua ho a ɛnam nnipa, dwumadi ahorow ne 
nhyehyɛe ahorow bi te sɛ, ɔkwan pa a ɔkyerɛkyerɛni fa so kyerɛ ade, nkuranhyɛ 
ne adwumayɛ mu nnepa, adesuafo ahokeka ne nea ɛkeka ho ɛnna mpanyinni ho 
nimdeɛ ne akwan ahorow a ɔbɛfa so abɔ ahohyɛso ho ban no yɛ ade a ɛho hia pa 
ara ma sukuu no yiedi. Daniel Duke (1989) kyerɛ mu sɛ, suban pa yɛ botae a ɛho 
hia pa ara nanso, ɛno nko ara ntumi mma adesua mu mputu. Ɛsɛ sɛ sukuupanyin

Anotew: Eyi yɛ bere a obi tumi kenkan yiye na ɛsɛ fata na ɔde honam akwaa dwumadi

Abasɛm nhyehyɛe
Eyi nso kyerɛ sɛnea ɔkyerɛwfo hyehyɛ adwenemusɛm, nimdeɛ ne amannebɔ wɔ 
abasɛm mu. Wutumi de w’ani si adwenesu titiriw no so de yɛ nsusui fa biribi foforo 
a ɛbɛba ho wɔ bere a worehwɛ abasɛm no nhyehyɛe no. Eyi san boa ma wuhu sɛnea 
wode w’ani bedi akenkan no akyi de ahwɛ sɛnea wo ntease no rekɔ so fa wɔ bere a 
worekenkan abasɛm bi.
Wode w’ani redi akenkan no akyi
Eyi yɛ kwan a wofa so kenkan abasɛm bi sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wubenya emu ntease. Eyi kyerɛ 
sɛ, wubetumi akyerɛ mu sɛ, wote nea worekenkan no ase anaa wonte ase. Ɛtɔ bere 
bi mpo a, ɛho behia sɛ wobɛsan akenkan abasɛm no fa bi bio ama woanya mu ntease 
ansa na woatoa akenkan no so.
Mfatoho mu nimdeɛfa
Eyi yɛ kwan a akenkan mu no, ɔkenkanfo no gyina ne nimdeɛ bi a ɛnhyɛda nna adi 
pɔtee wɔ abasɛm no mu so yɛ nsusui. Eyi kyerɛ sɛ, wogyina amannebɔ ahorow a ɛwɔ 
abasɛm no mu so de kyerɛkyerɛ abasɛm no mu. Nsusui a woyɛ no taa gyina wo nimdeɛ 
a wowɔ no dedaw so.

Eyi yɛ bere a ɔkenkanfo no si gyinae wɔ abasɛm no akenkan akyi. Ɔkenkanfo no nya 
adwenesu ahorow bi wɔ bere a wapɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm nnepa a ɛwɔ abasɛm no mu sɛnea 
ɛbɛyɛ a obenya abasɛm no mu ntease ne bo a abasɛm no som fa�
Ahonnidi yɛ ade titiriw a ɛho hia pa ara wɔ nnipa apɔwmuden ne anuonyam mu. Eyi 
kasa fa nhyehyɛe pa a yɛbɛfa ahwɛ nnipa agyanan, nwira/bɔɔla ne nsufi so de abɔ yɛn 
ho ban afi nyarewa ho na ama yɛn ahonnidi atu mpɔn. Ahonnidi nhyehyɛe amapa bi te 
sɛ agyananbea, gota ahorow a nsufi ne ade fa mu ne beae a yɛto nneɛma fi ahorow gu yɛ

NNIANIM
Saa ɔfa yi mu, yɛbɛkasa afa nkabomde, nsɛmfuayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow ne mmataho 
dwumadi wɔ Akuapem Twi mu. Wo nimdeɛ a wowɔ wɔ mmataho ne nkabomde 
dwumadi ahorow ho no bɛboa wo ma woatumi ayɛ ɔkasamu ahorow a ewie mu di 
wɔ Akuapem twi mu. Yɛbɛsan aboa wo ma woapɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm nsɛmfuayɛ nhyehyɛe 
ahorow mu wɔ Akuapem Twi mu. Nsɛmfuayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wobɛpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm 
mu no bi ne nsɛmfua nkabom, boseabɔ/ɔfɛm, nsɛmfuasotwa ne mmataho.
ADWEMPƆW AHOROW
•  Mmataho yɛ ɔkasa nhyehyɛe fa bi a yɛde mɔɔfim si asɛmfua anim, Mfinimfini, 
akyi anaa anim ne akyi (Ntwaho). Mmataho wɔ nkyekyɛmu titiriw abiɛsa; nsianim, 
nsimu ne nsiakyi. Yɛde mmataho si asɛmfua anaa asɛnnua bi ho de nya asɛmfua 
nnanemu anaa nyafirim.
•  Yɛde nkabomde di dwuma wɔ kasa no mu de ka nsɛmfua, kasasin ne nimdeɛ bom 
de yɛ ɔkasamu ahorow a ntease wɔ mu.
• Yɛde mmataho di dwuma wɔ kasa no mu de yɛ nsɛmfua foforo.
• Nsɛmfuayɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow no boa ma yɛyɛ nsɛmfua foforo wɔ bere a yɛnam kasa 
mmara nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ kasa no mu dedaw so.
MMATAHO
 Mmataho asekyerɛ: Mmataho yɛ mɔɔfim a yɛde bata asɛmfua anaa asɛnnua bi ho de 
nya asɛmfua foforo anaa de sesa asɛmfua no kabea. Mmataho betumi nso asan akyerɛ 
ɔkasa nhyehyɛe fa bi a yɛde si asɛmfua anim anaa akyi de sesa ne ntease.
Mmataho a yɛtaa de di dwuma pa ara ne nsianim ne nsiakyi. Yɛde mmataho si asɛnnua 
anaa ɔkasasin bi ho ma ɛsesa ne ntease ma yenya asɛmfua nnanemu anaa nyafirim. 
Yebetumi asan aka sɛ, mmataho yɛ asɛmfua fa bi a yetumi de si nsɛmfua anaa asennua 
ho ma yenya ntease foforo anaasɛ ɛsesa n’asɛmfuakuw no.
Nsianim yɛ mmataho a yɛde si asennua bi anim.
Nsim nso yɛ mmataho a yɛde si asennua bi ntam.

Nsiakyi yɛ mmataho a yɛde si asennua bi akyi pɛɛ.
Nsianim ne nsiakyi (Ntwaho) nso yɛ mmataho a yɛde si asennua bi anim ne akyi wɔ 
bere koro no ara mu nam so de nya asɛmfua foforo.
Hyɛ no nso: Kasa ahorow kakraa bi na ɛwɔ wiase a ɛde nsim mmataho di dwuma. 
Yennim Ghana kasa bi a saa bere yi ɛde nsim di dwuma.
Mmataho ho nhwɛso wɔ Akuapem Twi mu na edidi so yi: a-, m-, n-,-fo, -nom, re- ne 
nea ɛkeka ho.
Eyinom nyinaa yɛ mmataho efisɛ, yebetumi de wɔn asi asɛmfua bi ho ama ne ntease 
no asesa. Nhwɛso: agya bɛdan agyanom. Wode nsiakyi nom si agya a ɛwɔ biakofo 
kabea mu no ho a, ɛdan dodow kabea ‘agyanom’.
 Dwumadi 3.1 Kyerɛkyerɛ mmataho ase
Dan w’ani kyerɛ wo yɔnko na kyerɛkyerɛ mmataho ho ase kyerɛ no. Bɔ mmɔden 
sɛ wonhwɛ nea yɛakyerɛw no wɔ soro hɔ no so.
Mmataho nkyekyɛmu ahorow: Mmataho nkyekyɛmu titiriw pa ara abien no ne 
nyafirimu mmataho ne nnanemu mmataho.
Nyafirimu mmataho: Eyi yɛ mmataho a yɛnam so nya nsɛmfua foforo ne ntease foforo. 
Nyafirim mmataho mu no, asennua no ne asɛmfua foforo no asɛmfuakuw betumi ayɛ 
adekoro anaa ɛbɛsesa. Eyi kyerɛ sɛ, nyafirim mmataho betumi asesa asɛmfuakuw 
no anaa ɛnsesa� Nyafirim mmataho no ma yenya nsɛmfua foforo fi asennua no mu. 
Nhwɛso : sa tumi bɛdan nsa ‘nsa’ wɔ bere a nsianim n- si asennua sa anim. Saa tebea 
yi mu no, asennua no asɛmfuakuw a na ɛyɛ adeyɛ no sesa bɛdan edin.
Nnanemu mmataho: Eyinom yɛ mmataho a ɛsesa asɛmfua no kabea nko ara na mmom, 
ɛnyɛ n’asɛmfuakuw. Nnanemu mmataho nsesa asɛmfua no ntease ne saa nti, yennya 
nsɛmfua foforo mfi mu. Nnanemu mmataho da kasa nhyehyɛe bi te sɛ akontabude, 
onipa bɔbea, kabea ahorow ne nea ɛkeka ho. Eyi kyerɛ sɛ, wode nnanemu mmataho 
si asɛmfua a ɛwɔ biakofo kabea mu ho a, ɛsesa no kɔ dodow kabea mu. Nhwɛso, wode 
nsianim m- si asennua barima ho a, ɛbɛdan mmarima. Ɛha yi, nsɛmfua barima  ne 
mmarima nyɛ nsɛmfua abien a nsonsonoe bi da wɔn asɛmfuakuw mu (wɔn nyinaa yɛ edin) 
anaa wɔn ntease no nsesa koraa.

Nkabomde ho mfaso
Nkabomde ho mfaso da nso wɔ kasa ahorow mu. Eyinom nyinaa akyi no, ɛho mfaso 
no mu bi na edidi so yi:
• Ɛkyerɛkyerɛ botae mu anaa ɛda nea enti bi adi.
• Ɛboa de kasamufa anaa asɛnsin bi ka ɔfoforo no ho.
• Yɛnam so tumi de asɛm bi a ɛnyɛ nokware ka asɛm dedaw bi a ɛno nso nyɛ nokware 
ho.
• Ɛboa da nsonsonoe a ɛda biribi ntam adi.
• Yɛnam so tumi de asɛm bi a ɛyɛ nokware ka asɛm dedaw bi a ɛno nso yɛ nokware 
ho.
• Yɛde yɛ ntotoe fa adwempɔw bi ne asɛm bi ho.
• Yɛnam so de da dwumadi bi ho nsunsuanso bi adi.
Wode nkabomde reyɛ ɔkasamu
Mmara kakra bi a ɛho hia pa ara da nkabomde dwumadi ho. Saa mmara yi dwumadi 
boa ma biribi a yɛrekyerɛw wie pɛyɛ.
• Nkabomde ka adwen, dwumadi ne nimdeɛ bom. Ne saa nti, ɛsɛ sɛ yɛde nkabomde 
a ɛfata di dwuma sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a yebedu yɛn botae no ho.
• Nkabomde boa ma yetumi kyerɛw nneɛma ahorow bi din mmiako mmiako.
• Berɛ a wode nkabomde redi dwuma no, hwɛ sɛ saa nkabomde no ne wo kasamu 
no nhyehyɛe kɔ pɛ.
NSƐMFUAYƐ NHYEHYƐE
Nsɛmfuayɛ ne sɛ yɛrefa akwan ahorow so anya nsɛmfua foforo abɛka nsɛmfua a ɛwɔ 
ɔkasa bi mu dedaw no ho. Akwan ahorow beree na kasakuw bi mu nnipa fa so nya 
nsɛmfua foforo ka nsɛmfua a wɔwɔ dedaw no ho. Saa akwan ahorow yi mu bi ne 
ntwaso-nkabom, nsɛmfua-nkabom, asɛmfuasotwa, ɔfɛm/boseabɔ, mmataho, nkakuho 
ne nnanemu. Emu bi na yɛapɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm mu wɔ ase ha yi..

so, Ɔkasa asekyerɛ a yɛto mu nkyene ne nea ɛkeka ho nso, yɛbɛka ho asɛm wɔ ɔfa yi 
mu. Wubenya ɔkasa asekyerɛ ahorow no nimdeɛ na ɛbɛsan aboa ama woatumi akyerɛ

ADWEMPƆW AHOROW
• Yɛkyerɛw krataa a yɛde kɔma adwuma mu panyin kɔma adwuma bi mu panin a ɔwɔ 
hɔ de kɔpɛ adwuma mu kwan anaa de kɔsrɛ anea bi fi ne hɔ.
• Atipɛnfo krataa yɛ krataa a yɛkyerɛw kɔma yɛn abusuafo, yɛn adamfo anaa yɛn 
manifo bi.
• Osusukyerɛw ne sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo bi keka nsɛmfua bi bom fa so da n’adwenkyerɛ bi adi 
wɔ akyerɛw kwan so.
• Kasakyerɛ ne sɛ wonam akyerɛw kwan so de adwenkyerɛ anaa amannebɔ bi ma 
nnipakuw bi.
• Kasa asekyerɛ ne sɛ worekyerɛ kasa bi ase akɔ kasa foforo bi mu wɔ akyerɛw kwan 
so.
OSUSUKYERƐW
Osusukyerɛw ne sɛ ɔkyererɛwfo bi ahyehyɛ nsɛm anaa adwempɔ ahorow bi wɔ akyerɛw 
kwan so. Osusukyerɛw ahorow anan a wɔagye atom fi mfenhyia ɔha a ɛto so dunkron 
(19th century) mu de besi nnɛ mmere yi nonom ne Sukyerɛ osusukyerɛw, Abasɛm 
osusukyerɛw, Akwankyerɛ osusukyerɛw ne Akyinnyegye osusukyerɛw. Wubetumi de 
osusukyerɛw ahorow yi su ahorow no abobom akyerɛw osusukyerɛw amapa.

Osusukyerɛw Ahorow
 Osusukyerɛw gu ahorow anan. Ɛnonom ne sukyerɛ osusukyerɛw, abasɛm osusukyerɛw, 
akwankyerɛ osusukyerɛw ne akyinnyegye osusukyerɛw.
Sukyerɛ Osusukyerɛw
Saa susukyerɛw yi hwehwɛ sɛ adesuafo betumi akyerɛ sɛnea ade bi, onipa, beae, 
osuahunu, akoma-mu-nsɛm, tebea, ne nea ɛkeka ho bi si te pɔtee. Ɛho nhwɛso no bi 
ne sɛ worekyerɛw biribi akyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea w’abusua anaa wo kurom si te ho. Hwɛ 
osusukyerɛw a ɛwɔ ase hɔ no:
M’abusua
M’abusuafo te efie ketewa bi mu wɔ me kurom. Efie no sua nanso ɛyɛ fɛ yiye. Yɛayɛ 
mfikyifuw kɛse wɔ ofi no akyi. Medɔ mfikyifuw no mu nanso sɛ me nuabaa no bɛyɛ adwuma 
wɔ mfikyifuw no mu de, okyi kɔkɔkɔkɔ. Ade a ɔpɛ pa ara ne nhoma akenkan. Ɔkenkan 
nhoma anɔpa, awia ne anwummere.
Mede atosode a minya fii mfikyifuu no mu nyinaa ma m’awofo. Wɔtaa noa aduan wɔ yɛn 
mukaase ketewa no mu. Midi atosode biara nanso me nuabea no de, ɛnyɛ atosode biara na 
odi. Mpɛn pii no, m’abusuafo no nyinaa ka wɔn ho bom di anɔpaduan ne anwummeduan. 
Yedi nkɔmmɔ. Yɛserew. Me nuabea no hohoro nkankyee no mu.
Edu anwummere a, me papa tie dwom, me maame yɛ adwuma wɔ ne kɔmputa so, mehwɛ 
kasamfoni ɛnna me nuabea no nso kenkan ne nhoma.
Ɛnkyɛ biara na yɛrekɔdeda. M’awofo nkɔda ntɛm koraa nanso me ne me nuabea no de, 
yɛkɔda ntɛm. Mpɛn pii no ɛyɛ a na m’ani kum a mepɛ sɛ meda no, na me nuabea no de ɔda 
so ara rekenkan ne nhoma.
Abasɛm susukyerɛw
Eyi yɛ abasɛm a ɛfa osuahunu bi ho a ɔkyerɛwfo bi de to gua. Wɔde abasɛm ho nneɛma 
ahorow hyehyɛ abasɛm susukyerɛw mu de twe adesuafo adwen ba dwumadi no so  . 
Nhwɛso, wokyerɛw biribi ka nea ɛkɔɔ so wɔ ɛda a edi kan a wokɔɔ sukuu a wowɔ mu 
seesei ara no ho anaa dwumadi bi a ɛkɔɔ so ho a, wo nsɛm a wobɛka no nyinaa ka 
bom yɛ abasɛm susukyerɛw. Saa s susukyerɛw yi mu no, woda w’ankasa suahunu bi a 
wonyaa wɔ wo sukuu no mu anaasɛ dwumadi a ɛkɔɔ so no mu adi.
Akwankyerɛ susukyerɛw
Saa susukyerɛw yi hwehwɛ sɛ adesuafo bɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu afa adwempɔw bi ho anya 
ɛho adansedide, de nsɛmfua foforo atrɛ saa adwempɔw no mu, na wɔagyina so de 
akyinnyegyesɛm bi a ɛfa saa adwempɔw no ho ato gua sɛnea ɛfata. Nhwɛso, susukyerɛw 
a ɛfa Ghana ahofadi ho mu no, ɔkyerɛwfɔ no kyerɛw abakɔsɛm a ɛyɛ nokwasɛm pɔtee 
a ɛfa da a Ghana nyaa ahofadi, nnipa pɔtee a wɔgye gyinaa mu ko maa Ghana nyaa 
ahofadi no, sɛnea amammu asi akɔ so wɔ ahofadinya no akyi ne nea ɛkeka ho ho.

Akyinnyegye susukyerɛw
Saa susukyerɛw yi hwehwɛ sɛ adesuafo bɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu amapa afa asɛntiriw bi 
ho na wɔakasa afoa saa asɛntiriw no so anaa atia. Nhwɛso, ‘mmea a wɔdi tumi brɛ 
wɔn ho ase kyɛn mmarima a wɔdi tumi.’ Saa atifi asɛm yi hwehwɛ sɛ osuani no bɛyɛ 
nhwehwɛmu anya nokwasɛm amapa na wagyina so de akyerɛkyerɛ nea nti a ogye 
asɛm yi tom anaasɛ onnye ntom mu fann. Eyi mu no, osuani anaa ɔkasafo no tumi 
kasa foa asɛntiriw no so anaasɛ ɔkasa tia asɛnti no.
Akyinnyegye susukyerɛw atifi asɛm ho nhwɛso:
1. Nnipa yi mu hena na ne ho hia pa ara: Tikyani anaa Dɔkotani?
2. Okuani ne Dɔkotani mu hena na ne ho hia pa ara wɔ ɔman yi mu?

Krataa a yɛkyerɛw kɔma adwuma mu panyin
Saa krataa yi yɛ krataa a yɛkyerɛw de kɔpɛ adwuma na ne kyerɛw no di akwankyerɛ 
ne nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi so. Saa krataa yi kyerɛw mu no, yɛde kasapa ne nidi kasa na edi 
dwuma.
Yɛde saa krataakyerɛw yi di dwuma wɔ bere a yɛne mpanyimfo ne atitiriw bi redi 
nkitaho.
Mpanyimfo a yɛreka wɔn ho asɛm wɔ saa krataakyerɛw yi mu no mu bi ne Sukuupanyin, 
Ɔsamufo, Adwuma Hwɛsofo, Ɔsɔfo, Ɔmansoafo, Ɔhene, Mansini/Kuropɔn Aban 
Krakyepanyin, ne wɔn a wɔkeka ho.
Krataa a yɛkyerɛw kɔma adwuma mu panyin su
Nea edidi so yi nom ne krataa a yɛkyerɛw kɔma adwuma mu panyin su:
1. Ɔkyerɛwfo adrɛɛse/akyikwan: Kyerɛw w’adrɛɛse/w’akyikwan wɔ krataa no soro 
nifa so. Momma yɛnhyɛ no nso sɛ, wubetumi akyerɛw w’adrɛɛse/w’akyikwan wɔ 
krataa no soro benkum so nso.
2. Da/Deeti; Eyi yɛ da a worekyerɛw krataa no. Eyi betumi ayɛ da bi a atwam na 
mmom ɛrentumi nyɛ da a ɛnnya mmae.
3. Ogyefo adrɛɛse/akyikwan: Kyerɛw ogyefo no diberɛ ne n’akyikwan wɔ wo nsa 
benkum so .
4. Nkyia a edi kan; Eyi yɛ nidi nkyia a yekyia ɔpanyin ko no. Nkyia a edi kan a ɛyɛ 
papa wɔ saa krataakyerɛw yi mu ne Me Wura/M’awuraa, Me Wura Smith, Me 
Wura Ɔsamufo.
5. Atifi asɛm: Fa akyerɛwde akɛse kyerɛw atifi asɛm a ɛkyerɛ nea enti a worekyerɛw 
krataa no na san ase kamakama. Saa atifi asɛm yi yɛ tɔfabɔ a efi asɛmmisa no mu.
6. Nnianim; Eyi yɛ ɔkasamu a edi kan koraa a ɛda botae pɔtee a akyerɛw no nyinaa 
gyina so adi.
7. Kasapɛn ahorow: Ɛsɛ sɛ kasapɛn biako da adwempɔw koro pɛ adi wɔ akyerɛw 
no mu. Sɛ wutumi da adwempɔw biara adi wɔ kasapɛn biako mu a, ɛma onipa a 
ɔbɛkenkan wo krataa no te wo nsɛm anaa nsɛmpɔw a wode reto gua no ase yiye 
pa ara.
8. Awiei kasapɛn: Krataa no awiei hɔ no, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo no tumi bɔ ne nsɛm 
ahorow no nyinaa tɔfa.
Sɛ worekyerɛw krataa akɔma adwuma mu panyin a, ɛho hia sɛ wobɛma wo kasa no 
mu ada hɔ fann na wobɛka wo nsɛm no ntiantia ama emu ntease no ada hɔ pefee. Eyi 
bɛma ɔpanyin a wode krataa no bɛma no no ate wo nsɛm no ase yiye na ɔno nso atumi 
ama wo mmuae papa. Hwɛ sɛ wode akyerɛw mu agyiraehyɛde a ɛwom no nyinaa dii 
dwuma pɛpɛɛpɛ ɛnna afei nso, hwɛ sɛ wontoo ɔkasa mmara biara wɔ w’akyerɛw no 
mu ansa na wode krataa no akɔ nea ɛrekɔ.

ATIPƐNFO KRATAA KYERƐW
Atipɛnfo krataakyerɛw yɛ krataa a yɛkyerɛw kɔma yɛn nnamfonom anaa yɛn abusuafo 
ka nea ɛrekɔ so wɔ yɛn abrabɔ mu ho nsɛm kyerɛ wɔn na afei nso yɛsan fa so kyia 
wɔn. Yɛkyerɛw atipɛnfo krataa kɔma onipa a ofi yɛn abusua mu, onipa bi a ɔbɛn yɛn 
anaa yɛn adamfo.
Ɔkwan a yɛfa so kyerɛ atipɛnfo krataa.
1. Kyerɛ ɔkyerɛwfo adrɛɛse/akyikwan no wɔ kratafa no soro nifa twea so.
2. Kyerɛ da/deeti no wɔ nsensane a ɛwɔ adrɛɛse/akyikwan no ase no so.
3. Kyerɛw nkyia a edi kan a mpɛn pii no, ɛyɛ mmrane/ɛfene bi a mode frɛ mo ho no, 
sɛ ebia, Obolo, Ogyam, Kelewa, Kalawu, Trapana, Omoski anaa wo din mu koro 
pɛ ne nea ɛkeka ho, no wɔ nsensane a ɛto no so wɔ wo nsa benkum so no so na fa 
nsanhɔ toa so.
4. Kyerɛw nnianimu tiawa bi a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ nea enti a worekyerɛw saa krataa no mu.
5. Kyerɛw kasapɛn ahorow a ɛyɛ krataa no ankasa (esinianim) no.
6. Kyerɛw awiei kasamu anaa kasapɛn no. Afei, kyerɛw nkyia a edi akyi no sɛ ebia, 
Ɛyɛ me, Ɛyɛ wo yɔnko berɛbo, Ɛyɛ w’adamfo, Ɛyɛ wo dɔfo, Ɛyɛ, ne nea ɛkeka ho 
na fa nsanhɔ toa so. Afei, bra nsensane a ɛtoa so no so na bɛkyerɛw wo din a ɛno 
nso, ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ mmrane/ɛfene anaasɛ wo din mu koro pɛ, sɛ ebia Kwame, Ogyam, 
Abele, Sikelewu, Abenaa, Safo, Mmeranteɛhene, Hyabo, Haa ne nea ɛkeka ho.

mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ wokyerɛw adrɛɛse no wɔ kratafa no soro nifa twea so. Ɛno na yɛde fi  
krataakyerɛw ase. Ɛho hia sɛ wokyerɛw w’adrɛɛse na sɛ wowɔ nɔmma soronko

3. Nkyia a ɛdi kan: Ɛsɛ sɛ nkyia a edi kan no yɛ mmrane/ɛfene anaa wo din koro 
pɛ sɛ ebia, Safo, Daakyehene, Daakyehemmea, Aberante, Tumiwura, Kwaku, 
Abenaa, ne nea ɛkeka ho.
4. Nnianim; Yehu ɛnne a ɔkyerɛwfo no de rekasa wɔ ne krataakyerɛw no mu wɔ 
nnianim kasapɛn yi mu. Wubetumi de onipa a krataa no rekɔ ne hɔ no apɔwmuden 
ho nsɛmmisa ahyɛ wo krataakyerɛw no ase. Wubetumi asan aka sɛ, wowɔ gyidie 
sɛ, wɔn nsa bɛka krataa no asomdwoe mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ wode nserehehe, serewa anaa 
anigyesɛm bi fi wo nsɛm no ase.
5. Krataa no ankasa (esinianim): Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛnne a ɛwɔ krataa no mu nsɛm no mu 
no nyinaa yɛ anigyesɛm. Mmom, nsɛmfua a ɔkyerɛwfo no de bedi dwuma wɔ 
n’akyerɛw no mu gyina nea ɔrekyerɛw krataa no akɔma no no so. Wubetumi 
de nsɛngoru anaa serewato adi dwuma wɔ bere a worekyerɛw krataa no akɔma 
w’adamfo bi. Sɛ worekyerɛw krataa no akɔma w’abusuani bi a ɔyɛ panyin kyɛn 
wo a, bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛte serewatosɛm no so kakra esiane sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ nidi kakra 
bi ba wo ne ne nkitahodi no mu.
6. Awiei: Bɔ wo nsɛm a woakyerɛw wɔ wo krataa no mu no nyinaa tɔfa wɔ kasapɛn 
biako mu wɔ ha. Ɛne onipa a worekyerɛw krataa no akɔma no no nni nkra wɔ 
anigye mu. Afei, mma wo werɛ mfi sɛ, wobɛka akyerɛ onipa a wo krataa no rekɔ 
ne hɔ no sɛ ɛyɛ a, ɔmmɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛma wo krataa no ho mmuae. Eyi ma onipa 
a krataa no rekɔ ne hɔ no hu sɛ, wopɛ sɛ mo nkɔmmɔdi no toa so.
7. Wubetumi de kasasin a edidi so yi mu bi awie wo tipɛnfo krataakyerɛw no:
a. Ɛyɛ a hwɛ wo ho so yiye
b. Ensi wo yiye
c. Onyame nka yɛn ho
d. Mekyia wo pii
e. Mekae wo bere biara
f. Ɛyɛ a yɛ ahwɛyie
g. Meda wo ase papaapa
Hyɛ no nso sɛ, atipɛnfo krataakyerɛw mu no, wutumi yi nkorodaa anaasɛ wutumi to 
serewa wom a ɛho nhia sɛ wobɛda obuo suban biara adi wɔ mu. Yɛkyerɛw saa krataa 
yi kɔma nnipa bi a yenim wɔn pa ara te sɛ yɛn nnamfonom ne yɛn abusuafo. Ɛnam eyi

sɛ wobedi atipɛnfo krataakyerɛw su ne ne nhyehyɛe no so pɛɛ.

ƆKASA ASEKYERƐ
Ɔkasa asekyerɛ ne sɛ worekyerɛ ɔkasa bi ase akɔ ɔkasa foforo bi mu wɔ akyerɛw 
kwan so. Ɔkasa a abasɛm a worekyerɛ ase no wom no na yɛfrɛ no Nkyerɛasefi kasa 
ɛnna ɔkasa a worekyerɛ abasɛm bi ase akɔ mu no nso yɛfrɛ no Nkyerɛasekɔ kasa. 
Nhwɛso: Sɛ abasɛm bi wɔ Akuapem Twi kasa mu na wokyerɛ ase kɔ Borɔfo kasa mu 
a, Akuapem Twi kasa no yɛ Nkyerɛasefi kasa ɛnna Borɔfo kasa no yɛ Nkyerɛasekɔ 
kasa. Bio, wokyerɛ abasɛm a ɛwɔ French kasa mu ase kɔ Akuapem Twi kasa mu a, 
French kasa no yɛ Nkyerɛasefi kasa ɛnna Akuapem Twi kasa no yɛ Nkyerɛasekɔ 
kasa.
Ɔkwan a yɛfa so kyerɛ kasa ase wɔ akyerɛw kwan so
Ɔkasa asekyerɛ wɔ akyerɛw-kwan-so kyerɛ hia akwanhorow a ɛbɛma adesuafo anya 
mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu, ntease ne kwan a yɛfa so de abasɛm bi fi kasa biako mu kɔ foforo 
mu ho nimdeɛ. Nea edidi so yi ne akwanhorow a yɛfa so kyerɛ kasa bi ase kɔ foforo 
mu wɔ akyerɛw kwan so:
1. Nya kasa asekyerɛ fapem; sua nsonsonoe a ɛda ɔkasa asekyerɛ wɔ akyerɛw kwan 
so ne anokasa asekyerɛ ntam, ne nnipakuw a abasɛm no fa wɔn ho amammere ne 
wɔn amanne so mfaso.
2. Nya akenkan ho nimdeɛ: Bɔ mmɔden hwɛ sɛ wubetumi akenkan ate Nkyerɛasefi  
kasa a wɔbɛkenkan no ase yiye.
3. Pɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm abasɛm mu: Sua abasɛm/kyerɛwsɛm ahorow, ɛnne a ɛwɔ abasɛm 
no mu, abasɛm no botae ne abasɛm no atiefo.
4. Fa w’adwen si akwan ahorow a wɔfa so kyerɛ kasa ase no so: Sua akwan ahorow 
te sɛ nea edidi so yi:
a. Asekyerɛtraa ne Asekyerɛ a enni mmara ketee so
b. Asekyerɛ a egyina amammere ne amanne so

c. Asekyerɛ a egyina ntease so

8. Monkenkan mo-ho-mo-ho dwumadi mu na momma ho mmuae: Monkenkan mo

Ɔkasa asekyerɛ ahorow
Ɔkasa asekyerɛ gu ahorow bebree na emu bi ne nea edidi so yi:
1. Asekyerɛ a egyina nsɛmfua ntease so; Eyi yɛ kasa asekyerɛ a ɛde nsɛmfua mmiako 
mmiako a ɛwɔ abasɛm no mu no ntease nko ara na ɛto gua na mmom, ennyina 
abasɛm no nyinaa mu ntease so.
2. Ɔkasa Asekyerɛ a enni mmara ketee so: Eyi yɛ ɔkasa asekyerɛ a ɛyɛ korogyee, na 
ɛka abasɛm no sɛnea nnipakuw a ɛfa wɔn ho no amammere ne wɔn amanne si te 
na afei nso ɛde abasɛm no mu ntease turodoo ne ɔkasafo no ɛnne to gua.
3. Ɔkasa asekyerɛ a egyina amammere ne amanne so: Eyi yɛ ɔkasa asekyerɛ a ɛgye 
nnipakuw biara amammere ne wɔn amanne mu nsonsonoe ahorow tom.
4. Ɔkasa asekyerɛ a edi nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi so: Saa ɔkasa asekyerɛ yi mu no, ɔkasa 
asekyerɛfo no hwɛ nhyehyɛe a nkyerɛasefi kasa no wom di so pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ 
nkyerɛasekɔ kasa no mu.
5. Anokasa asekyerɛ: Eyi yɛ ɔkasa asekyerɛ a wɔde ano ne ano na ɛyɛ. Wɔde saa 
ɔkasa asekyerɛ yi di dwuma wɔ nhyiamu ase, asɔredan mu ne asɛnni/kɔɔto.
6. Ɔkasa Asekyerɛ a yɛto mu nkyene: Saa ɔkasa asekyerɛ yi mu no, nkyerɛasefo no 
tumi de n’ankasa nsɛm tetɛ asɛm pɔtee a ɔrekyerɛ ase no ho ma mpo asɛm pɔtee 
no ntease, ɛnne ne ne botae nyinaa yera. Saa ɔkasa asekyerɛ yi mu no, nkyerɛasefo 
no tumi yi nsɛm no bi fi mu ɛnna otumi nso de ebi feafea ho to mu nkyene.
7. Ɔkasa Asekyerɛ a egyina ntease so: Saa ɔkasa asekyerɛ yi mu no, nkyerɛasefo no

asekyerɛ a animdeɛfo ato wɔn bo ase ayɛ ne kasa asekyerɛ a afidi na ayɛ toto ho 
na gyina nea wubehu no so yɛ nsakrae wɔ wo kasa asekyerɛ nimdeɛ mu.
9. Ankasa ho kasa asekyerɛ: W’ankasa kyerɛw abasɛm bi wɔ kasa bi mu na kyerɛ ase

wɔ ho mfa ntrɛw mo kasa asekyerɛ nimdeɛnya mu.

The Environment
In our modern world, there are many factors that place the wellbeing of the planet in 
jeopardy. While some people have the opinion that environmental problems are just 
a natural occurrence, others believe that human beings have a huge impact on the 
environment. Regardless of your viewpoint, take into consideration the following factors 
that place our environment as well as the planet Earth in danger.
Global warming or climate change is a major contributing factor to environmental 
damage. Because of global warming, we have seen an increase in melting ice caps, a 
rise in sea levels, and the formation of new weather patterns. These weather patterns 
have caused stronger storms, droughts, and flooding in places that they formerly did 
not occur.
Air pollution is primarily caused as a result of excessive and unregulated emissions of 
carbon dioxide into the air. Pollutants mostly emerge from the burning of fossil fuels 
in addition to chemicals, toxic substances, and improper waste disposal. Air pollutants 
are absorbed into the atmosphere, and they can cause smog, a combination of smoke 
and fog, in valleys as well as produce acidic precipitation in areas far away from the 
pollution source.
In many areas, people and local governments do not sustainably use their natural 
resources. Mining for natural gases, deforestation, and even improper use of water 
resources can have tremendous effects on the environment. While these strategies often 
attempt to boost local economies, their effects can lead to oil spills, interrupted animal 
habitats, and droughts.
Ultimately, the effects of the modern world on the environment can lead to many 
problems. Human beings need to consider the repercussions of their actions, trying 
to reduce, reuse, and recycle materials while establishing environmentally sustainable 
habits. If measures are not taken to protect the environment, we can potentially witness 
the extinction of more endangered species, worldwide pollution, and a completely 
uninhabitable planet

Mubenya nkyerɛmu ahorow yi mu bi: Abusuabɔ ho nsɛm a egyina hɔ ma

Mmusuakuw su
 Mmusuakuw su titiriw ahorow no mu bi ne:
1. Wɔbɔ/Wɔkyɛ mmusuabɔ: Eyi kyerɛ sɛ nnipakuw a wɔwɔ abusua mu no kyɛ 
amammere mu agyapade na wɔto ana kosi onipa biako so.
2. Abusuabɔ nkabom: Eyi kyerɛ sɛ wɔnam mogya, aware anaa nnyetom so na ɛbɔ 
abusua no.
3. Ahyɛnsode koro: Eyi kyerɛ sɛ wɔde biribi te sɛ edin koro, ahyɛnsode anaa atetesɛm 
na ɛhyɛ emu nnipa nso.
4. Asetenam ntoam: Mmusuakuw taa nya asetenam nkabom a ano yɛ den ɛma 
abusuafo ayɔnkofa mu na ɛma ankoroankoro a wɔbɛka ho nso nya ɔman no mu 
nkabom.
5. Nnidiso nhyehyɛe: Mmusuakuw wɔ annifo a wɔdi wɔn so te sɛ ahemfo ne 
mpanyimfo a wɔboa wɔn si gyinae.
6. Amammere ahyɛnsode: Mmusuakuw wɔ amanne koro na wɔnkyɛ amammere 
koro. Wɔwɔ nkyia ne nnyeso soronko.
7. Sikasɛm mu nkabom: Mmusuakuw wɔ agyapade bi te sɛ asase ne agyapade ahorow.
8. Nnadi ne Amanne : Mmusuakuw wɔ nnadi ne amanne yɛbom bi te sɛ nhyenmu 
amanne, awaregye, ayiyɛ ne amanne ahorow.
Mmusuakuw so mfaso
Mmusuakuw nhyehyɛe adi dwuma soronko wɔ amammere ne aman mu. Sɛnea 
yɛakyerɛkyerɛ mu wɔ fam ha yi;
1. Asetenam akuwakuw mu: Mmusuakuw di akoten wɔ asetenam akuwakuw mu. 
Ɛyɛ kuw nketewa a wɔn ano boa nyɛ den na wɔwɔ ahyɛnsode ne botae koro.

ba wɔn ntam.

boa yɛn ho yɛn ho.
4. Ahyɛnsode koro: Mmusuakuw ka wɔn mma kɔ kuw akɛse mu ma wɔnya abakɔsɛm,

Wɔn na wɔyɛ ahemfo a wɔhyɛ ɔmanhene ase. Wɔyɛ ahemfo a wɔhwɛ beae bi ɛyɛ

ara. Wɔn nso fa amammere ntetee mu ansa na wɔde wɔn asi ɔhene.
Ahemfo nketewa dwumadi
1. ɔhwɛ akyi bere a ɔmanhene nni hɔ.
2. Ɔhwɛ ɔman no banbɔ ne ne nhyehyɛe so.
3. Wɔdi nsɛm wɔ wɔn man mu.
4. Wɔhwɛ sɛ ɔman no benya asomdwoe.
5. Wɔn na wɔguare nkogua na afei wɔsrɛ nkɔso ma asase no.
7. Wɔhwɛ sɛ wɔremmɔ bra bɔne wɔ ɔman no mu.
8. Wɔwɔ nnipakuw ne nsase pɔtee a wɔbɔ ho ban.
9.Wɔhwɛ ma wɔdi nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu na wɔbɔ ho amanne kyerɛ 
ɔmanhene no.
Ahemfo nketewa no nkyekyɛmu na ɛwɔ fam ha yi:
Benkumhene
Wɔfrɛ benkumhene wɔ Ewe mu sɛ Miafi ɛnna Akanfo nso frɛ wɔn ‘Benkumhene’.
Benkumhene yɛ aɔhene a ɔhwɛ benkum fam na ɔno na ɔda nnipa aɔtena ɔmanhene 
benkum so wɔ aguabɔ ase, asɛnnibea ne ɔko brɛ mu.
Nifahene
Ewefo frɛ nifahene sɛ ‘Đusifia’ , ɛnna Akanfo nso frɛ no ‘Nifahene’. Wɔdi dɔm a wɔtena 
ɔmanhene no nifa wɔ beguam.
Ahemfo baanu yi di dwuma titiriw wɔ tete amammu wɔ aman mu na wɔdi dwuma a 
edidi so yi:
1. Wɔn ne ɔmanhene no na etu gyina anaa wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow.
2. Wɔn na wɔda Otumfo anaa Ɔmanhene benkum ne wɔn nifa so atenafo nyinaa ano
3. wɔn na wɔda nnipa a wɔtena ɔmanhene benkum ne nifa ano.
4. Wɔma ɔmanhene afotu ne akwankyerɛ. Wɔsiesie nsɛm na wɔhwɛ sɛ asomdwoe bɛba 
wɔn mantam mu.
5. Wɔdi akoten wɔ ahensi ne ahentu nhyehyɛe mu.
6. Wɔhwɛ nsase yɛ na afei nso wɔdi n’asase so mansosɛm ne nea ɛkeka ho.
Adontenhene
Akanfo frɛ no Adontenhene ɛnna Ewefo frɛ no “Aʋadada / Aʋafia”.

ntimu, ɛnne (vowel) nnyigyei ntimu ne nnyigyei a egyina hɔ ma asɛm no boa ma 
anwensɛm no yɛ atiefo no dɛ.
3. Nhyehyɛe: Anwensɛm no nhyehyɛe a ebi ne nkyekyɛmu, nhyehyɛe ne nsesanee 
atenten a yenya ntease a ɛboa yɛn.

7. Kasakoa: Ɛde nnyinahɔma, ntotohosɛm , sɛ-nipa ne anihanhan ma ntease no mu

8. Asɛntitiriw/Asɛnti: Ɛyɛ adwempɔw titiriw a ɔnwemfo no de reto gua anwensɛm 
no mu mu ɛda nnipa suahunu ne wɔn nkatede adi.
9. Toonu ne Tebea: Nsunsuanso a ɔkyerɛwfo no nya wɔ akenkanfo no so (toonu) ne 
atenka so nunsuanso a wonya wɔ a akenkanfo so (tebea).
10. Nsɛnkyerɛnnede/Agyiraehyɛdesɛm: Nsɛnkyerɛne a egyina hɔ ma adwempɔw

11. Nsɛmfuasu: Nsɛmfua a wɔde di dwuma ne wɔn nkyerɛase, a enya nsunsuanso wɔ 
toonu, tebea ne adwen mu mfoniyɛ.

1. Ɛma kasasua ho nimdeɛ: Anwensɛm boa adesuafo ma wɔnya nsɛmfua foforo, 
nnyinahɔma ne kasasu ahorow.
2. Adeyɛ ho nimdeɛ: Anwensɛm boa ma yetumi de yɛn ankasa nimdeɛ bɔ anaa nwene 
nsɛm bi de kyerɛkyerɛ yɛn adwempɔw ahorow mu
3. Ebue adwenem : Yɛpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm anwensɛm mu a, ɛboa yɛn ma yesua kwan a 
yɛbɛfa so adwen akɔ akyi, ɛma nkyerɛase ne pɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu mu suahunu.
4. Ɛma yenya tema: Anwensɛm boa da nnipa nkatede, osuahunu ne nhumu adi na 
ɛnam so ma yenya tema ne ntease.
5. Ɛde abakɔsɛm ne amammere to gua: Anwensɛm da nsɛm bi a asi wɔ yɛn abakɔsɛm, 
amammere ne asetena mu adi.
6. Ɛma akaakae ne kasa ho nimdeɛ: Yɛrekaakae na yɛaka anwensɛm no bue yɛn 
adwen mu, ma yɛn akokoduru ne beguam kasasua ho nimdeɛ.
7. Ɛboa kɔmpɔbu ne kasa: Anwensɛm bue kwan ma asuafo kyerɛ wɔn adwen, wɔn 
atenka ne wɔn suahu.
8. Anwensɛm ma adwen mu nyansa: Anwensɛm boa asuafo ma wɔnya ntease ne 
ahohyɛso na ɛma wɔnya adwen mu nyansa. Asuafo betumi de nea esi anwensɛm 
mu ne anwensɛm botae ayɛ adwuma.
9. Ɛboa ma yɛte kasasu ahorow ase: Anwensɛm kyerɛ asuafo no biribi fa kasasu 
ahorow bi te sɛ, mfoniyɛ, nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkasa ne kasakoa ahorow. Saa kasasu 
ahorow yi boa ma yɛn kasa mu yɛ dɛ.

FOREWORD
Ghana’s new Senior High School Curriculum aims to ensure that all learners achieve 
their potential by equipping them with 21st Century skills, knowledge, character 
qualities and shared Ghanaian values. This will prepare learners to live a responsible 
adult life, progress to further studies and enter the world of work. This is the first time 
that Ghana has developed a Senior High School Curriculum which focuses on national 
values, attempting to educate a generation of Ghanaian youth who are proud of our 
country and can contribute effectively to its development.
The Ministry of Education is proud to have overseen the production of these Learner 
Materials which can be used in class and for self-study and revision. These materials 
have been developed through a partnership between the Ghana Education Service, 
teacher unions (Ghana National Association of Teachers- GNAT, National Association 
of Graduate Teacher -NAGRAT and the Pre-Tertiary Teachers Association of Ghana- 
PRETAG) and National Subject Associations. These materials are informative and of 
high quality because they have been written by teachers for teachers with the expert 
backing of each subject association.
I believe that, if used appropriately, these materials will go a long way to transforming 
our Senior High Schools and developing Ghana so that we become a proud, prosperous 
and values-driven nation where our people are our greatest national asset.
Haruna Iddrisu MP
Minister for Education

ASƐNSINI NHYEHYƐEƐ NE TOONU
Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa  1
NKƆMMƆDIE
Asɛnsini Nhyehyɛeɛ ne Toonu
NNIANIMU
Saa ɔfa yi kasa fa asɛnsini, asɛnsini nhyehyɛeɛ ne toonu ho. Saa ɔfa yi mu adesua 
bɛkɔ awieeɛ no, na woahunu nsonsonoeɛ a ɛda asɛnsini a ɛnne nnyegyeeɛ twa ɛtoɔ 
ne asɛnsini a anom nnyegyeeɛ twa ɛtoɔ ntam wɔ Asante Twi kasa mu na afei nso, 
wotumi kyerɛ ɛkwan a asɛnsini nhyehyɛeɛ fa so boa ma yɛyɛ nsɛmfua foforɔ. Afei 
nso, wobɛsua biribi afa toonu ho na woatumi akyerɛ toonu ahodoɔ a ɛyɛ ɛfam, ɛsoro, 
adantam, sorokɔ, famba ne deɛ ɛkeka ho no mu. Adesua a ɛwɔ ɔfa yi mu no bɛsan aboa 
wo ama woanya nimdeɛ ɛwɔ ɛkwan a yɛfa so gyina toonu ho nimdeɛ so yɛ nsɛmfua 
foforɔ wɔ Asante Twi kasa mu. Awieeɛ no, ɔfa yi mu adesua no bɛkasa afa toonu 
dwumadie ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ Asante Twi kasa mu a ɛnonom ne; deɛ ɛde nsonsonoeɛ ba 
nsɛmfua nteaseɛ mu, deɛ ɛde nsonsonoeɛ ba ɔkasa mmara mu ɛne deɛ ɛde nsonsonoeɛ 
ba Akan kasa nkorabata ahodoɔ mu no ho.
ADWEMPƆ AHODOƆ
• Asɛnsini yɛ asɛmfua fa bi a yɛte wɔ ɔkasa mu.
• Anom nnyegyeeɛ asɛnsini yɛ anom nnyegyeeɛ a ɛtumi gyina sɛ asɛnsini.
• Toonu yɛ ɛnne mu nsakraeɛ a ɛtumi de nsakraeɛ ba asɛmfua bi nteaseɛ mu.
ASƐNSINI, N’AHODOƆ NE NE NHYEHYƐEƐ
Asɛnsini Asekyerɛ
Asɛnsini yɛ mframakuo baako wɔ ɔkasa mu a ɛtaa kura ɛnne nnyegyeeɛ sɛ ne fa bi 
anaa asɛnsini no ankasa. Yɛbɛsan atumi akyerɛ asɛnsini ase sɛ, ɛyɛ mframakuo baako 
a yɛgyina so wɔ berɛ a yɛrekenkan asɛmfua anaa yɛrebɔ asɛmfua bi din. Nhwɛsoɔ, 
wobɛgyina mprenu wɔ berɛ a worekenkan anaasɛ worebɔ asɛmfua bi te sɛ, Kofi [ko: 
fi]. Yei kyerɛ sɛ, asɛmfua Kofi wɔ asɛnsini mmienu (2) nanso sɛ yɛrekenkan asɛmfua 
tu a, yɛte mframakuo koro pɛ [tu] na yei ma yɛhunu sɛ, tu wɔ asɛnsini koro pɛ. Enti, 
wosusu sɛ, asɛnsini dodoɔ sɛn na ɛwɔ asɛmfua Bagabaga mu?
Sɛ yɛde ɛnne nnyegyeeɛ to nkyɛn a, anom nnyegyeeɛ bi te sɛ /m, n, w, r, l/ tumi gyina 
sɛ asɛnsini. Yɛnya saa anom nnyegyeeɛ asɛnsini yi wɔ berɛ a ɛnne nnyegyeeɛ biara nni 
saa anom nnyegyeeɛ yeinom mu biara akyi. Nhwɛsoɔ [pa:m], [na:m], [ka:m], [m:pa] 
ne deɛ ɛkeka ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ asɛnsini kura ɛnne nnyegyeeɛ baako a ɛbɛtumi aba sɛ anom 
nnyegyeeɛ di n’anim, n’akyi anaa twa ɛho hyia. Ɛtumi ba sɛ, asɛmfua bi nya asɛnsini

1. Asɛnsini koro pɛ asɛmfua: Ho [ho], fa [fa]
2. Asɛnsini mmienu asɛmfua: Tafo [ta:fo], Osu [o:su]
3. Nsɛnsini bebree asɛmfua : Sakora [sa:ko:ra], Takoradi [ta:ko:ra:di], kakapɛ

Asɛnsini nhyehyɛeɛ ho nimdeɛ ho hia ɛfiri sɛ;
• ɛboa adesuafoɔ ma wɔtumi yɛ nsɛmfua foforɔ.
• ɛboa adesuafoɔ ma wɔtumi hunu nsɛmfua a ɛwɔ ɔkasa bi mu.
• ɛboa adesuafoɔ ma wɔtumi te ɔkasa bi mu nsɛmfua ase.
Deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi yɛ Asante Twi nsɛmfua a wɔakyekyɛ mu kɔ nsɛnsini ahodoɔ mu no ho 
nhwɛsoɔ: kɔ: m, e: tu: o, ɛ: tɔ
Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛwɔ soro hɔ no mu no, mframakuo baako biara a yɛteɛ no gyina hɔ sɛ 
asɛnsini baako. Wɔakyekyɛ asɛmfua biara mu kɔ nsɛnsini ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ mu mu.
Asɛnsini Ahodoɔ
 Ghana ha kasa ahodoɔ no mu biara wɔ nsɛnsini ahodoɔ nanso ne nyinaa mu no, 
nsɛnsini a ɛdi akoten wom ne asɛnsini a emu abue ne asɛnsinia emu ato.
Asɛnsini a emu abue
Asɛnsini a emu abue yɛ asɛnsini a ɛnne nnyegyeeɛ twa toɔ. Deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi yɛ Ghana 
ha kasa ahodoɔ no mu bi nsɛnsini a emu bue no ho nhwɛsoɔ.
Ewe:  kpe, tɔ, va, dzo
Ga:  ka, ka: ti, ka: la: de
Mfantse:  su, ku: ko, pa
Twi:   ko: fi, bu: tu, bɔ: tɔ
Asɛnsini a emu to
Asɛnsini a emu to yɛ asɛnsini a anom nnyegyeeɛ twa toɔ. Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhyɛ no nso sɛ, 
Ghana ha kasa ahodoɔ no mu bebree na ɛnni saa asɛnsini a anom nnyegyeeɛ na ɛtwa 
toɔ yi bi. Ghana ha kasa ahodoɔ no mu kakra bi a wɔwɔ saa asɛnsini yi bi nonom ne 
Dagbani, Gurune, Likpankpaanl, Dagaare. Ɛho nhwɛsoɔ no bi na ɛdidi soɔ yi:
Dagbani: zab: li, dab: li
Gurune: nabt

Dwumadie 1.1 Asɛnsini asekyerɛ
1. Fa w’ankasa nsɛmfua kyerɛkyerɛ asɛnsini ase. Ka wo mmuaeɛ no kyerɛ 
adesuafoɔ nkaeɛ no nyinaa.
2. Kyerɛkyerɛ nsɛnsini ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ Asante Twi kasa mu no mu.
3. Kyerɛkyerɛ mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ asɛnsini nhyehyɛeɛ so wɔ nsɛmfuayɛ mu no. Ɛne 
w’afɛfoɔ nkyɛ wo mmuaeɛ no.
Asɛnsini nhyehyɛeɛ
Ɔkasa biara wɔ ne nsɛnsini nhyehyɛeɛ. Yɛgyina anom nnyegyeeɛ (A) ne ɛnne 
nnyegyeeɛ (Ɛ) so na ɛkyerɛkyerɛ asɛnsini nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Asɛnsini fa a ɛho hia pa ara 
yɛ ɛnne nnyegyeeɛ. Kasa ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ Ghana ha nyinaa mu nso no, toonu boa pa ara 
ma yɛhunu asɛnsini bi nhyehyɛeɛ. Yɛtumi de toonu ahyɛnsodeɛ toto ɛnne nnyegyeeɛ 
ne anom nnyegyeeɛ nyinaa so. Ɛnne nnyegyeeɛ ne anom nnyegyeeɛ dodoɔ a ɛwɔ 
asɛmfua bi mu na ɛma yɛhunu nsɛnsini dodoɔ a ɛwɔ saa asɛmfua no mu. Nhwɛsoɔ, 
sɛ ɛnne nnyegyeeɛ a ɛwɔ asɛmfua bi mu yɛ mmienu (2) a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ, saa asɛmfua no 
wɔ nsɛnsini mmienu (2). Ghana kasa ahodoɔ no bi ne wɔn nsɛnsini nhyehyɛeɛ ho 
nhwɛsoɔ na ɛdidi soɔ yi:
1. Ewe:  e (Ɛ), tɔ (AƐ),
2. Ga:  ni (AƐ), a: te (Ɛ: AƐ), n: ka: ti: ɛ (A: AƐ: AƐ: Ɛ)
3. Twi:  a (Ɛ), tu (AƐ), a: ta (Ɛ: AƐ), n: ta (A:AƐ), e: tu: o (Ɛ: AƐ: Ɛ)
4. Mfante  a (Ɛ), kɔ (AƐ), a: pa (Ɛ: AƐ), m: pa (A: AƐ), a: pa: a (Ɛ: AƐ: Ɛ)
5. Dagbani:  zab: li (AƐA: AƐ)
Dwumadie 1.2 Asante Twi asɛnsini nhyehyɛeɛ
Yɛ mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu fa Asante Twi nsɛnsini nhyehyɛeɛ no ho. Ɛne adesuafoɔ 
nkaeɛ no nkyɛ wo mmuaeɛ no.
Dwumadie 1.3 Nsɛmfuayɛ a ɛgyina asɛnsini soɔ
Ekuo biara nyi nsɛmfua nsia (6) mfiri abasɛm a ɛwɔ aseɛ hɔ no mu na monyɛ deɛ 
ɛdidi soɔ yi:
1. Ɛne w’afɛfoɔ nhwehwɛ nsɛnsini dodoɔ a ɛwɔ asɛmfua no mu biara mu.
2. Ɛne w’afɛdoɔ nkyɛ adwene mfa asɛnsini no mu biara nhyehyɛeɛ ho.
Ekuo biara ntwerɛ wɔn mmuaeɛ na wɔnka ho asɛm nkyerɛ adesuafoɔ nkaeɛ 
no mfa mpɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu wɔ wɔn mmuaeɛ no ho.

TOONU
Ɔkasa ahodoɔ nyinaa de ɛnne di dwuma wɔ kasa mu de si asɛmfua bi nteaseɛ so dua 
anaa de da wɔn atenka adi. Toonu yɛ ɛnne a ɛkɔ soro anaa fam wɔ asɛnsini bi so a ɛde 
nsakraeɛ ba asɛmfua bi nteaseɛ mu. Toonu kasa yɛ ɔkasa a ne nsɛmfua nteaseɛ no gyina 
toonu so. Ghana ha kasa ahodoɔ no nyinaa mu nsɛmfua nteaseɛ gyina toonu so. Ɛnne 
mu nsakraeɛ a ɛkɔ so wɔ ɔkasamu mu no na yɛfrɛ no ɛnne ɛsoro-famkɔ.
Toonu ahodoɔ
Ɔkasa biara wɔ toonu ahodoɔ. Deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi yɛ toonu a ɛwɔ Ghana ha kasa ahodoɔ 
no bi mu ho nhwɛsoɔ: soro (S) toonu, Fam (F) toonu, adantamu (A) toonu, famkɔ (FK) 
toonu, ne sorokɔ (SK) toonu. Ghana ha kasa ahodoɔ no nyinaa mu biara wɔ toonu 
ahodoɔ mmienu a ɛnonom ne soro ne fam. Ɔkasa afoforɔ bi nso wɔ adantamu toonu 
ka soro ne fam toonu no ho. Ɔkasa afoforɔ bi nso wɔ hɔ a wɔwɔ sorokɔ ne famkɔ toonu 
ka soro, fam ne adantamu toonu no ho. Deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi yɛ toonu a ɛwɔ Ghana ha kasa 
ahodoɔ no bi mu ho nhwɛsoɔ.

ASƐNSINI NHYEHYƐEƐ NE TOONU
Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa  1
1. Ɔkasa a ɛwɔ Toonu mmienu (2) (soro ne fam) ho nhwɛsoɔ: Akan, Nzema, Ga, 
Kasem, Ewe, ne deɛ ɛkeka ho.
2. Ɔkasa a ɛwɔ Toonu mmiɛnsa (3) (soro, fam ne adantamu) ho nhwɛsoɔ : Dangme, 
Dagbani, ne deɛ ɛkeka ho.
Yɛde ahyɛnsodeɛ a ɛwɔ adakaba yi mu no [`] na ɛkyerɛ fam toonu, yɛde deɛ ɛwɔ 
adakaba yei [´] mu no kyerɛ soro toonu ɛnna yɛde deɛ ɛwɔ adakaba yei [ ¯ ] mu no 
nso kyerɛ adantamu toonu. Nhwɛsoɔ, Akan asɛmfua dà (never) wɔ fam toonu da ɛnne 
nnyegyeeɛ no so ɛnna asɛmfua dá (to sleep) nso wɔ soro toonu da ɛnne nnyegyeeɛ 
no so. F ne S anaa S ne F a ɛtoatoa soɔ ma yɛnya sorokɔ (SK) toonu anaa famkɔ (FK) 
toonu nnidisoɔ nnidisoɔ.
Toonu Dwumadie
Toonu di akoten wɔ toonu kasa ahodoɔ mu ɛnam ne dwuma sononko a ɛdi wɔ ɔkasa 
no nteaseɛ mu no nti. Toonu di dwuma ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa (3) wɔ toonu kasa ahodoɔ 
mu. Yeinom ne deɛ ɛde nsonsonoeɛ ba asɛmfua nteaseɛ mu, deɛ ɛde nsonsonoeɛ ba 
ɔkasa mmara mu ɛne deɛ ɛde nsonsonoeɛ ba Akan kasa nkorabata ahodoɔ mu.
1. Deɛ ɛde nsonsonoeɛ ba asɛmfua nteaseɛ mu:
Yɛde Toonu di dwuma wɔ nsɛmfua a wɔn asopɛ yɛ pɛ mu ma yɛhunu nteaseɛ 
ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ saa asɛmfua no mu. Hwɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛdidi soɔ yi. Hyɛ sɛdeɛ toonu 
ahyɛnsodeɛ a ɛdeda atwerɛdeɛ ahodoɔ no soɔ no sesa toonu no.
a. Akan: pá:pá ‘good’ ne pà:pá ‘father’, sùsù ‘to measure’ ne súsú ‘savings’
b. Ewe: sí ‘to flee’ ne sì ‘to cut’
c. Ga: bè ‘time’ ne bé ‘to quarrel’
2. Deɛ ɛde nsonsonoeɛ ba ɔkasa mmara mu:
Yɛde Toonu di dwuma wɔ ɔkasa mmara mu de kyerɛ nsonsonoeɛ a ɛda adeyɛ 
kabea ahodoɔ no ntam. Ɛho nhwɛsoɔ no bi na ɛdidi soɔ yi.
a. Daa/Seesei/Mprempren kabea: kòfí ʥìná ‘Kofi stands’ ne kòfí ʥìnà ‘Kofi stop!’
b. Daa/Seesei/Mprempren kabea ne Daakye kabea: kòfí bɛ̀fá ‘Kofi takes’ ne kòfí 
bɛ́fá ‘Kofi will take’
c. Dabi ne ɔhyɛ kabea: ǹtá ‘don’t mend’ ne ńtá ‘should mend’
d. Ɔkasamufa titire ne ɔkasamufa kumaa: [mÍrÍkɔ̀] ‘I’m going’ vs [mÌrÍkɔ́ nʊ́] 
‘When I was going…’
3. Deɛ ɛde nsonsonoeɛ ba Akan kasa nkorabata ahodoɔ mu:
Yɛtumi de Toonu di dwuma de kyerɛ nsonsonoeɛ a ɛda Akan kasa nkorabata ntam.
Ɛho nhwɛsoɔ no bi na ɛdidi soɔ yi:
a. i. [mʊ̀rʊ́kɔ̀] wɔ Fante kasa mu ne [mɪ́rɪ́kɔ́] wɔ Asante Twi kasa mu ‘I’m going’
ii. [ɔ̀kɔ́] wɔ Asante kasa mu ne [ɔ́kɔ̀] wɔ Akuapem Twi kasa mu ‘S/he is gone’

Montena baanu baanu na montie nsɛmfua a mo kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ no rebɛkenkan

c. Dagbani: ba ‘ to ride’ , ba ‘to peg’
d. Dangme: lε ‘firewood’ lε ‘canoe’, ba ‘come’ , ba ‘leaf’

AKENKAN NE ADWEMPƆ NHWEHWƐEƐ
Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa  2
NKƆMMƆDIE
Abasɛm ho Nkɔmmɔdie ne Akenkan
NNIANIMU
Saa ɔfa yi kasa fa ɛkwan a yɛfa so hwehwɛ adwempɔ ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ abasɛm anaa 
nkɔmmɔdie bi mu. Saa ɔfa yi bɛsan aka akenkan a emu dɔ ne akenkan ntrɛmu ho asɛm 
tiawa bi akyerɛ wo. Mobɛpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm ɛkwan ahodoɔ a yɛfa so hunu ɔtwerɛfoɔ bi 
adwempɔ ne ɛkwan a yɛfa so de saa adwempɔ ahodoɔ no to atiefoɔ anim fann. Twaka 
amapa da saa ɔfa yi ne adesua ahodoɔ bi te sɛ Borɔfo kasa, Social Studies ne kasa 
ahodoɔ no ntam.
ADWEMPƆ AHODOƆ
Asɛntitire a ɛwɔ abasɛm bi mu no na yɛfrɛ no adwempɔ. Yei tumi yɛ nnyinasoɔ kasamu 
a ɛsan nso wɔ ɔkasamu ahodoɔ a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ mu. Akenkan tumi yɛ akenkan a emu 
dɔ anaa akenkan ntrɛmu.
• Akenkan a emu dɔ yɛ akenkan a yɛto yɛn bo ase kenkan abasɛm bi yie de hwehwɛ 
ɔtwerɛfoɔ adwen pɔtee a ɔde reto dwa wɔ abasɛm no mu.
• Akenkan ntrɛmu ne sɛ worekenkan nwoma bi a ɛso anaasɛ emu nsɛmfua no dɔɔso 
yie na woafa so de anya nsɛmfua foforɔ aka deɛ wowɔ dada no ho na ama woatumi 
atu mpɔn wɔ akenkan ne nteaseɛ mu.
SƐDEƐ YƐSI HWEHWƐ ADWEMPƆ WƆ 
ABASƐM MU
Nnwennweneho asɛmmisa: Dwendwene nneɛma ahodoɔ a wosuaa wɔ afe a ɛdi kan 
mu no ho, ɛdeɛn ne adwempɔ? Fa w’adwenkyerɛ no toto wo kuo no deɛ ho na afei 
kenkan deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi:
Adwempɔ: Yei yɛ asɛntire a ɛho hia pa ara a ɔtwerɛfoɔ da no adi wɔ kasapɛn bi mu 
wɔ abasɛm anaa nkɔmmɔdie bi mu. Adwempɔ no na ɛka abasɛm anaa nkɔmmɔdie 
no nyinaa botaeɛ. Wɔde ɔkasamu ahodoɔ kyerɛkyerɛ adwempɔ no mu yie wɔ abasɛm 
anaa nkɔmmɔdie no mu. Sɛ wohunu ɔkasamu ahodoɔ a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ nnyinasoɔ kasamu 
no mu a, ɛboa ma wohunu adwempɔ no. Wobɛtumi afa akwan a ɛdidi soɔ yi so ahunu 
adwempɔ a ɛwɔ abasɛm bi mu:
Kenkan atifiasɛm no ne nnianimu no: Ɛho hia sɛ wobɛhunu deɛ atifiasɛm no ne 
nnianimu no ka fa asɛm pɔtee a abasɛm no rekasa fa ho no ho.
Hwehwɛ nnyinasoɔ kasamu no: Mpɛn pii no, ɛyɛ a na nnyinasoɔ kasamu no di kasapɛn

no kan. Ɛsɛ sɛ wohyɛ no nso sɛ, ɛduru berɛ bi a, yɛtumi de nnyinasoɔ kasamu no kɔhyɛ 
kasapɛn no mfimfini anaa n’awieeɛ.
Worehwehwɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu kasamu: Sɛ wobɛhunu ɔkasamu ahodoɔ a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ 
adwempɔ no mu a, bisa wo ho nsɛm a ɛdidi soɔ yi: ɛdeɛn ne adwempɔ no, ɛhefa na

Tɔfabɔ: Fa w’ankasa nsɛmfua bɔ abasɛm no tɔfa.
Ntotoho: Fa wo tɔfabɔ no toto deɛ wɔatwerɛ wɔ abasɛm a wokenkaneeɛ no awieeɛ hɔ 
no ho.
Akenkan a emu dɔ
Akenkan a emu dɔ yɛ akenkan a yɛto yɛn bo ase kenkan abasɛm bi yie de hwehwɛ 
ɔtwerɛfoɔ adwen pɔtee a ɔde reto dwa wɔ abasɛm no mu. Yei asekyerɛ ne sɛ, woreto wo 
bo ase akenkan abasɛm bi na woahyɛ emu nkyerɛkyerɛmu no nso. Ɛsɛ sɛ wohwehwɛ 
nsɛmfua titire a ɛwɔ abasɛm no mu. Ɛtumi ba sɛ, wɔsensan nsɛmfua titire no ase, 
wɔtwerɛ nsɛmfua titire no kyeakyea no, wɔyɛ nsɛmfua titire no pikapika, wɔtwerɛ ti 
mu, ne deɛ ɛkeka ho wɔ abasɛm no mu. Deɛ ɛka ho bio ne sɛ, woretwerɛ nsɛmfua bi 
agu wo nwoma mu, worehwehwɛ nsɛmfua bi asekyerɛ wɔ nsɛmfua asekyerɛ nwoma 
mu ne sɛ worekenkan abasɛm bi yie pa ara ate aseɛ yie nyinaa ka akenkan a emu dɔ 
ho.
Dwumadie 2.1 Ɔhareso-akenkan ne Ɔhareso-adeɛ-hwehwɛ 
asekyerɛ
Mosuaa biribi faa ɔhareso-akenkan ne ɔhareso-adeɛ-hwehwɛ ho wɔ afe a ɛdi kan 
no mu, monnyina saa nimdeɛ no so na monkyerɛ emu biara ase, na afei nso, 
mompɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm akwan ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa a yɛfa so yɛ ɔhareso-akenkan ne 
ɔhareso-adeɛ-hwehwɛ. Fa deɛ woatwerɛ no toto deɛ wɔatwerɛ wɔ aseɛ hɔ no ho.
AKENKAN A EMU DƆ SU
Akenkan a emu dɔ wɔ su bebree nanso saa adesua yi mu deɛ, emu mmienu (2) pɛ a 
ɛnonom ne ɔhareso-akenkan ne ɔhareso-adeɛ-hwehwɛ na wobɛsua ho adeɛ.
Ɔhareso-akenkan
Yei yɛ akenkan a yɛde hwehwɛ asɛntitire a ɛwɔ abasɛm bi mu. Saa akenkan yi mu no, 
wonte abasɛm no ase yie ɛfiri sɛ wonkenkan abasɛm no nyinaa. Yɛde saa akenkan yi 
di dwuma wɔ nokwasɛm abasɛm akenkan mu.

AKENKAN NE ADWEMPƆ NHWEHWƐEƐ
Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa  2
Ɔhareso-adeɛ-hwehwɛ
Yei yɛ akenkan a yɛde yɛn ani fa akenkansɛm bi mu ntɛmso de hwehwɛ asɛmfua anaa 
nsɛmfua pɔtee bi. Yɛde saa akenkan yi hwehwɛ mmuaeɛ ma nsɛmmisa pɔtee bi.
Dwumadie 2.2 Adwempɔ Nhwehwɛeɛ
1. Kenkan abasɛm a ɛwɔ aseɛ hɔ no.
2. Kyerɛ adwempɔ a ɛwɔ abasɛm a ɛwɔ aseɛ hɔ no mu.
3. Ka adwempɔ a wohunuiɛ no kyerɛ adesuafoɔ nkaeɛ no na fa toto wɔn deɛ ho.
NSIYƐ
Me nkwadaa berɛ mu a na madi mfeɛ ɛnan na me maame kaa nkyene guiɛ a na 
mennim biribiara nso fa me papa ne mpo baabi a ɔwɔ ho. Akwannya a na ɛwɔ 
hɔ ma me wɔ m’abrabɔ mu ara ne sɛ mene m’abusuafoɔ a na menhunuu wɔn mu 
binom mpo da kɔtena. Na abusuafoɔ no mu biara nni hɔ a wayɛ krado sɛ ɔne 
me bɛtena ne efie na wahwɛ me. Ɛnnɛ mekɔ yei hɔ a, na ɔkyena mekɔ ɔfoforɔ 
hɔ; Mantena efie baako mu anni afe baako mpo da anaa sukuu baako afe mpo 
da a yei kɔɔ so saa bɛyɛ mfeɛ dunan. Deɛ ɛka yeinom ho ne sɛ, abusuafoɔ no bi 
faa atenantwie a na medi wɔ abusuafoɔ no soɔ no so hyɛɛ me aniɛyaa yɛɛ me 
ayakayakadeɛ a ɛnnɛ yi mpo, ɛda so yɛ me awerɛho sɛ mɛka ho asɛm. Na mede 
m’afɛfoɔ asukuufoɔ no na ɛkyekyere me werɛ ɛfiri sɛ sukuu mu nko ara na na ɛyɛ 
beaeɛ a mekɔ a, metumi yi m’ani firi nsɛm a ɛkɔ so wɔ efie no soɔ. Medii mfeɛ edu 
no, na wɔhyɛ me ma meyɛ adwumaden wɔ nnawɔtwe awieeɛ ne akwamma mu 
de hwɛ me ho. Na mekɔyɛ berekyafoɔ adwuma wɔ adansibea ahodoɔ, na mede 
kodoɔ kɔ ɛpo so kɔyi mpataa san pae aboɔ. Yei kɔɔ so mfeɛ du ma ɛnam so maa 
metumi de sika sieeɛ a ɛboaa me maa metumi de me ho kɔtoo ntoasoɔ sukuu mu. 
Anigyesɛm ne sɛ, na mebɔ mmɔden yie wɔ nwomasua mu na ɛnam so maa wɔyii 
me sɛ asukuufoɔ no nyinaa kannifoɔ wɔ berɛ a meduruu gyinapɛn a ɛtwa toɔ no. 
Na meka wɔn a wɔbɔɔ wɔn ho mmɔden pa ara wɔ sɔhwɛ a ɛtwa toɔ no mu no ho.
Dwumadie 2.3 Adwempɔ Nhwehwɛeɛ
1. Ekuo biara nyɛ mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu wɔ abasɛm a ɛwɔ aseɛ hɔ no mu na 
monhwehwɛ adwempɔ a ɛwɔ mu no.
2. Ka w’adwempɔ no kyerɛ adesuafoɔ nkaeɛ no.
Ɔsetie so mfasoɔ
Abaayewa: Me nua, woadwen hia a ɔsetie ho hia ho pɛn?
Abarimaa: Aane, mesusu sɛ, ɔsetie ne sɛ woredi mmara so na afei nso wode enidie 
bɛma mpanimfoɔ.

Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa  2
Abaayewa: Saa pɛpɛɛpɛ, Ɔsetie boro sɛ woredi mmara so. Ɛyɛ gyidie, obuo ne 
nokorɛdie. Sɛ woyɛ setie ma w’awofoɔ a, woma wɔhunu sɛ, wogye wɔn akwankyerɛ

Dwumadie 2.4 Nkɔmmɔdie
Montena baanu baanu na hyehyɛ nkɔmmɔdie bi te sɛ baako a ɛwɔ ɛsoro hɔ no 
fa ahoɔdennɛe, abɛɛfo mfididwuma so mfasoɔ anaa ahonnidie so mfasoɔ ho na 
monna no adi wɔ agorɔ kwan so nkyerɛ asuafoɔ nkaeɛ no. Ma adesuafoɔ nkaeɛ no 
nyɛ mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm mfa deɛ wɔsusu sɛ ɛyɛ adwempɔ no mu.
Dwumadie 2.5. Akenkan a emu dɔ ho nimdeɛ
Kenkan abasɛm a ɛwɔ fam hɔ no na bua nsɛmmisa ahodoɔ a ɛtoa soɔ no.
1. Montena akuakuo na monnyina ɔhareso akenkan nimdeɛ so mfa nhwehwɛ na 
montwerɛ adempɔ mmienu biara mfiri abasɛm no mu na akuo nkaeɛ no nkyɛ 
saa nimdeɛ no.
2. Gyina ɔhareso-adeɛ-hwehwɛ so kyerɛ adeɛ titire a ɔtwerɛfoɔ no susu sɛ ɛho hia 
sɛ sukuupanin no bɔ ho ban.
Sukuupanin no gyina hɔ ma tumidie wɔ sukuu no mu. Ɔno na ɔkyerɛ deɛ ɛsɛ sɛ ɛkɔ 
so wɔ sukuu no mu fa adekyerɛ ne adesua ho a ɛnam nnipa, dwumadie ahodoɔ ne 
nhyehyɛeɛ ahodoɔ bi te sɛ, ɛkwan pa ɔkyerɛkyerɛni fa so kyerɛ adeɛ, nkuranhyɛ 
ne adwumayɛ mu nnepa, adesuafoɔ ahokeka ne deɛ ɛkeka ho ɛnna mpaninnie 
ho nimdeɛ ne akwan ahodoɔ a ɔbɛfa so abɔ ahohyɛsoɔ ho ban no yɛ adeɛ a ɛho 
hia pa ara ma sukuu no yiedie. Daniel Duke (1989) kyerɛ mu sɛ, suban pa yɛ 
botaeɛ a ɛho hia pa ara nanso, ɛno nko ara ntumi mma adesua mu mputuo. Ɛsɛ sɛ 
sukuupanin no yɛ ahohyɛsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ahodoɔ a ɛbɛboa ama suban pa akɔ nkan 
na wama adesuafoɔ no nnepa a ɛhia wɔn wɔ sukuu no mu na wasi nnebɔne ahodoɔ 
ho kwan wɔ sukuu no mu.

ƆKASA DWUMADIE
Ɔkasa Nhyehyɛeɛ ne Mmara ɛda Asante Twi 
Twerɛbea ho
NNIANIMU
Saa ɔfa yi mu, yɛbɛkasa afa nkabomdeɛ, nsɛmfuayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ahodoɔ ne mmataho 
dwumadie wɔ Asante Twi mu. Wo nimdeɛ a wowɔ no wɔ mmataho ne nkabomdeɛ 
dwumadie ahodoɔ ho no bɛboa wo ma woatumi ayɛ ɔkasamu ahodoɔ a ewie mu die 
wɔ Asante twi mu. Yɛbɛsan aboa wo ma woapɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm nsɛmfuayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ 
ahodoɔ mu wɔ Asante Twi mu. Nsɛmfuayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ahodoɔ a wobɛpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm 
mu no bi ne nsɛmfua nkabom, boseabɔ/ɔfɛm, nsɛmfuasotwa ne mmataho.
ADWEMPƆ AHODOƆ
• Mmataho yɛ ɔkasa nhyehyɛeɛ fa bi a yɛde mɔɔfem si asɛmfua anim, mfinimfini, 
akyire anaa anim ne akyire (Ntwaho) . Mmataho wɔ nkyekyɛmu titire mmiɛnsa; 
nsianimu, nsimu ne nsiakyire. Yɛde mmataho si asɛmfua anaa asennua bi ho de nya 
asɛmfua nnanemu anaa nyafirim .
•  Yɛde nkabomdeɛ di dwuma wɔ ɔkasa no mu de ka nsɛmfua, kasasin ne nimdeɛ bom 
de yɛ ɔkasamu ahodoɔ a nteaseɛ wɔ mu.
• Yɛde mmataho di dwuma wɔ ɔkasa no mu de yɛ nsɛmfua foforɔ.
• Nsɛmfuayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ahodoɔ no boa ma yɛyɛ nsɛmfua foforɔ wɔ ɛberɛ a yɛnam 
ɔkasa mmara nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ ɔkasa no mu dada so.
MMATAHO
Mmataho asekyerɛ: Mmataho yɛ mɔɔfim a yɛde bata asɛmfua anaa asennua bi ho de 
nya asɛmfua foforɔ anaa de sesa asɛmfua no kabea. Mmataho bɛtumi nso asane akyerɛ 
ɔkasa nhyehyɛeɛ fa bi a yɛde si asɛmfua anim anaa akyire de sesa ne nteaseɛ.
Mmataho a yɛtaa de di dwuma pa ara ne nsianimu ne nsiakyire. Yɛde mmataho si 
asennua anaa ɔkasasin bi ho ma ɛsesa ne nteaseɛ ma yɛnya asɛmfua nnanemu anaa 
nyafirim. Yɛbɛtumi asan aka sɛ, mmataho yɛ asɛmfua fa bi a yɛtumi de si nsɛmfua 
anaa asennua ho ma yɛnya nteaseɛ foforɔ anaasɛ ɛsesa n’asɛmfuakuo no.
Nsianim yɛ mmataho a yɛde si asennua bi anim.
Nsim nso yɛ mmataho a yɛde si asennua bi ntam.
Nsiakyire yɛ mmataho a yɛde si asennua bi akyiri pɛɛ.

NKABOMDEƐ NE NSƐMFUAYƐ NHYEHYƐEƐ AHODOƆ
Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa  3
Nsianim ne nsiakyire (Ntwaho) nso yɛ mmataho a yɛde si asennua bi anim ne 
akyire wɔ ɛberɛ korɔ no ara mu nam so de nya asɛmfua foforɔ.
Hyɛ no nso: Ɔkasa ahodoɔ kakraa bi na ɛwɔ wiase a ɛde nsim mmataho di dwuma. 
Yɛnnim Ghana kasa bi a saa berɛ yi ɛde nsim di dwuma?
Mmataho ho nhwɛsoɔ wɔ Asante Twi mu na ɛdidi soɔ yi: a-, m-, n-,-foɔ, -nom, re- ne 
deɛ ɛkeka ho.
Yeinom nyinaa yɛ mmataho ɛfiri sɛ, yɛbɛtumi de wɔn asi asɛmfua bi ho ama ne nteaseɛ 
no asesa. Nhwɛsoɔ: agya bɛdane agyanom. Wode nsiakyire nom si agya a ɛwɔ baakofoɔ 
kabea mu no ho a, ɛdane dodoɔ kabea ‘agyanom’.
Dwumadie 3.1 Kyerɛkyerɛ mmataho ase
Dane w’ani kyerɛ wo yɔnko na kyerɛkyerɛ mmataho ho ase kyerɛ no. Bɔ mmɔden 
sɛ wonhwɛ deɛ yɛatwerɛ no wɔ ɛsoro hɔ no so.
Mmataho nkyekyɛmu ahodoɔ: Mmataho nkyekyɛmu titire pa ara mmienu no ne 
nyafirimu mmataho ne nnanemu mmataho.
Nyafirimu mmataho: Yei yɛ mmataho a yɛnam so nya nsɛmfua foforɔ ne nteaseɛ 
foforɔ. Nyafirim mmataho mu no, asennua no ne asɛmfua foforɔ no asɛmfuakuo bɛtumi 
ayɛ adekorɔ anaa ɛbɛsesa. Yei kyerɛ sɛ, nyafirim mmataho bɛtumi asesa asɛmfuakuo 
no anaa ɛnsesa. Nyafirim mmataho no ma yɛnya nsɛmfua foforɔ firi asennua no mu. 
Nhwɛsoɔ : sa tumi bɛdane nsa ‘nsa’ wɔ ɛberɛ a nsianim n- si asennua sa anim. Saa 
tebea yi mu no, asennua no asɛmfuakuo a na ɛyɛ adeyɔ no sesa bɛdane edin.
Nnanemu mmataho: Yeinom yɛ mmataho a ɛsesa asɛmfua no kabea nko ara na 
mmom, ɛnyɛ n’asɛmfuakuo. Nnanemu mmataho nsesa asɛmfua no nteaseɛ ne saa 
nti, yɛnnya nsɛmfua foforɔ mfiri mu. Nnanemu mmataho da ɔkasa nhyehyɛeɛ bi te 
sɛ akontabudeɛ, onipa bɔbea, kabea ahodoɔ ne deɛ ɛkeka ho. Yei kyerɛ sɛ, wode 
nnanemu mmataho si asɛmfua a ɛwɔ baakofoɔ kabea mu ho a, ɛsesa no kɔ dodoɔ 
kabea mu. Nhwɛsoɔ, wode nsianim m- si asennua barima ho a, ɛbɛdane mmarima. 
Ɛha yi, nsɛmfua barima ne mmarima nyɛ nsɛmfua mmienu a nsonsonoeɛ bi da wɔn 
asɛmfuakuo mu (wɔn nyinaa yɛ edin) anaa wɔn nteaseɛ no nsesa koraa.
Dwumadie 3.2 Kyerɛkyerɛ mmataho ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ Asante Twi mu.
1. Montena akuakuo na mompɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm mmataho ahodoɔ (monnyina 
nhwɛsoɔ a ɛwɔ ɛsoro hɔ no so) a ɛwɔ Asante Twi mu no nyinaa mu – ɛkwan 
bɛn na ɛfa so sesa asennua anaa nsɛmfua ahodoɔ no nteaseɛ?
2. Montena akuakuo na momfa nsɛmfua foforɔ a monam mmataho so yɛeɛ no mu 
enum nyɛ ɔkasamu ahodoɔ na mo ne adesuafoɔ nkaeɛ nkyɛ ho nimdeɛ.

Mmataho Dwumadie Ahodoɔ
Mmataho dwumadie no da nso wɔ ɔkasa ahodoɔ mu. Ne dwumadie no mu bi na ɛdidi 
soɔ yi:
a. Ɛboa ma yɛtumi yɛ nsɛmfua foforɔ firi asennua anaa asɛmfua dada bi mu. Nhwɛsoɔ: 
n + da = nna
b. Ɛtumi sesa asɛmfua bi asɛmfuakuo firi baako mu kɔ foforɔ mu. Nhwɛsoɔ: a + dɔ 
= adɔ.
c. Ɛtumi sesa adeyɛ bi kabea. Nhwɛsoɔ: re + kɔ = rekɔ.
d. Ɛtumi sesa asɛmfua bi kabea firi kabea baako mu kɔ foforɔ mu. Nhwɛsoɔ: agya + 
nom = agyanom.

n + kusie = nkusie.

g. Ɛtumi sesa edin nkyerɛkyerɛmu ma no dane adeyɔ

k. Ɛtumi sesa edin nkyerɛkyerɛmu ma no dane edin.

NKABOMDEƐ
Nkabomdeɛ asekyerɛ: Nkabomdeɛ yɛ asɛmfua/nsɛmfua a ɛka nsɛmfua, nsɛnsini anaa 
ɔkasamufa ahodoɔ bom. Nkabomdeɛ boa ma yɛtumi yɛ ɔkasamu kuntan, ɔkasamu 
mmɔho ne nhyehyɛeɛ ahodoɔ a ɛmma yɛntwerɛ ɔkasamu tiawa ahodoɔ bebree. Wɔn 
dwumadie titire pa ara ne sɛ, wɔbɛka ɔkasa afa ahodoɔ abobom. Nkabomdeɛ ho 
nhwɛsoɔ wɔ Asante Twi mu ne: nanso, nso, nti, ɛfiri sɛ, a, ne, anaa, anaasɛ, sɛ…..a, 
berɛ a ….. no, oo…oo, ne deɛ ɛkeka ho.Yɛtaa de saa nsɛmfua yi di dwuma wɔ yɛn 
daadaa nkutahodie mu. Deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi nyinaa yɛ nkabomdeɛ dwumadie wɔ ɔkasamu

Nkabomdeɛ ahodoɔ
Yɛwɔ nkabomdeɛ ahodoɔ bebree wɔ kasa ahodoɔ mu nanso, yɛbɛpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm emu 
mmiɛnsa pɛ mu. Ɛnonom ne:
1. Kasamufa titire nkabomdeɛ,
2. Ntotoho nkabomdeɛ, ne
3. Kasamufa kumaa nkabomdeɛ.
Kasamufa titire nkabomdeɛ : Kasamufa titire nkabomdeɛ yɛ nsɛmfua mmaako 
mmaako a ɛka ɔkasa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛsesɛ bi te sɛ edin ne edin anaa kasamufa ne kasamufa 
bobom. Kasamufa titire nkabomdeɛ ho nhwɛsoɔ no bi na ɛdidi soɔ yi:
na, ɛnna, eso, nanso, nti, mmom, a, anaasɛ, ma, ɛsiane sɛ, gye sɛ, sɛ…a, ɛberɛ a… no 
ne deɛ ɛkeka ho.
Kasamufa titire nkabomdeɛ dwumadie

sɛ, oo]

ii. Aburoo oo, nkateɛ oo

iv. Wopɛ kwadu anaa nkateɛ?
b.  Kasamufa titire nkabomdeɛ a ɛka nsɛmfua ne kasamufa ahodoɔ bobom yɛ [a].

Kasamufa kumaa nkabomdeɛ: Saa nkabodeɛ yi ka kasamufa kumaa (a ne nteaseɛ

Dwumadie 3.6. Nkabomdeɛ dwumadie wɔ ɔkasamu mu
Twerɛ nhwɛsoɔ mmiɛnsa mmiɛnsa ma nkabomdeɛ ahodoɔ no mu biara na fa 
nhwɛsoɔ no mu biara yɛ ɔkasamu. Yɛ krado sɛ wo ne wo mfɛfoɔ bɛkyɛ nimdeɛ afa 
wo kasamu no ho na woakyerɛ sɛnti a woyɛɛ no saa, sɛ ɛho bɛhia a.
Nkabomdeɛ ho mfasoɔ
Nkabomdeɛ ho mfasoɔ da nso wɔ kasa ahodoɔ mu. Yeinom nyinaa akyi no, ɛho mfasoɔ 
no mu bi na ɛdidi soɔ yi:
1. Ɛkyerɛkyerɛ botaeɛ mu anaa ɛda sɛnti bi adi.
2. Ɛboa de kasamufa anaa asɛnsini bi ka ɔfoforɔ no ho.
3. Yɛnam so tumi de asɛm bi a ɛnyɛ nokorɛ ka asɛm dada bi a ɛno nso nyɛ nokorɛ ho.
4. Ɛboa da nsonsonoeɛ a ɛda biribi ntam adi.
5. Yɛnam so tumi de asɛm bi a ɛyɛ nokorɛ ka asɛm dada bi a ɛno nso yɛ nokorɛ ho.

NSƐMFUAYƐ NHYEHYƐEƐ
Nsɛmfuayɛ ne sɛ yɛrefa akwan ahodoɔ so anya nsɛmfua foforɔ abɛka nsɛmfua a ɛwɔ 
ɔkasa bi mu dada no ho. Akwan ahodoɔ bebree na kasakuo bi mu nnipa fa so nya 
nsɛmfua foforɔ ka nsɛmfua a wɔwɔ dada no ho. Saa akwan ahodoɔ yi mu bi ne ntwasoɔ-
nkabom, nsɛmfua-nkabom, asɛmfuasotwa, ɔfɛm/boseabɔ, mmataho, nkakuho ne 
nnanemu. Emu bi na yɛapɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm mu wɔ aseɛ ha yi.

ƆKASA DWUMADIE

NNIANIMU
Saa ɔfa yi mu, wobɛsua Asante Twi kasa ho mmara bi te sɛ kasasin, ɔkasamufa ne 
atwerɛ mu agyinahyɛdeɛ ho. Wɔbɛda kasasin ne ɔkasamufa nhyehyɛeɛ ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ 
Asante Twi kasa mu no adi akyerɛ wo. Wobɛsua adeɛ afa atwerɛ mu agyinahyɛdeɛ 
nso ho. Saa Asante Twi kasa mmara ho nimdeɛ yi bɛma woatumi atwerɛ ɔkasamu, 
kasapɛn ne nwoma ahodoɔ amapa. Yei bɛsan aboa wo ama woatumi asua asan ate 
Borɔfo kasa nso ase yie.
ADWEMPƆ AHODOƆ
• Kasasin yɛ asɛmfua anaa nsɛmfuakuo bi a ɛka bom di dwuma korɔ wɔ ɔkasa mu. 
Kasasin ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ Asante Twi mu nonom ne edin kasasin, adeyɛ kasasin ne 
ɔkyerɛfoɔ kasasin.
•  Ɔkasamufa yɛ nsɛmfuakuo bi a ɛda adi wɔ ɔkasamu mu. Ɛwɔ ɔyɛfoɔ ne nkasaeɛ a 
ɛtumi gyina sɛ ɔkasamu anaasɛ ɔkasamu no fa bi.
• Atwerɛ mu no, yɛde ahyɛnsodeɛ ahodoɔ bi hyehyɛ mu ma nteaseɛ ba mu. Saa 
ahyɛnsodeɛ ahodoɔ nonom na yɛfrɛ wɔn Atwerɛ mu Agyinahyɛdeɛ no. Saa atwerɛ mu 
agyinahyɛdeɛ yi mu bi ne osiwieeɛ, osisan, nsanhɔ, osiprenu ne ogyansɛnkyerɛnneɛ.

OB5oKwxM so. Wohwɛ wie a, ɛne w’afɛfoɔ nkyɛ adwene mfa wo mmuaeɛ a wode 
bɛma asɛmmisa “Ɛdeɛn ne kasasin?” no. Fa deɛ wohunu faa kasasin ho no toto deɛ wo 
kuo no nso hunuiɛ no ho.
Kasasin yɛ asɛmfua anaa nsɛmfuakuo a ɛka bom di dwuma korɔ a nteaseɛ wom wɔ 
ɔkasa pɔtee bi mu. Sɛ nteaseɛ bɛba kasasin mu a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɛnya etire esiane sɛ etire no 
na ɛyɛ kasasin fa a ɛho hia pa ara. Etire no na yɛgyina so de hunu kasasin korɔ. Sɛ 
asɛmfua a ɛyɛ etire no yɛ edin a, yɛnya edin kasasin ɛnna sɛ asɛmfua a ɛyɛ etire no yɛ 
adeyɛ a, yɛnya adeyɛ kasasin. Kasasin ho nhwɛsoɔ no bi na ɛdidi soɔ yi:
Twi: toa ‘bottle; dua ‘tree’ nwoma no ‘the book’

Kasasin ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa nonom ne edin kasasin, adeyɛ kasasin ne ɔkyerɛfoɔ kasasin.

KASASIN/ƆKASAMUFA NHYEHYƐEƐ NE ATWERƐ MU AGYINAHYƐDEƐ
Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa  4
Edin Kasasin a ɛwɔ nkyerɛkyerɛmu
Nkyerɛkyerɛmu yɛ nsɛmfua anaa kasasin a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ edin ti no mu anaasɛ ɛka biribi 
fa edin ti no ho. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛdi edin ti anim no, yɛfrɛ no Anim Nkyerɛkyerɛmu 
ɛnna nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛdi edin ti no akyi no nso, yɛfrɛ no Akyire Nkyerɛkyerɛmu. 
Anim nkyerɛkyerɛmu ho nhwɛsoɔ na ɛdidi soɔ yi:
1. Me wɔfa atu kwan.
2. Yɛn nana aba.
3. Kofi papa yere no awo.
4. Ɔboase ankaa no asa.
5. Homase bankye yɛ dɛ.
Wohwɛ nhwɛsoɔ (1) no a, Me di edin ti wɔfa anim di dwuma sɛ anim nkyerɛkyerɛmu, 
wohwɛ nhwɛsoɔ (2) no a, yɛn di edin ti nana anim di dwuma sɛ anim nkyerɛkyerɛmu, 
wohwɛ nhwɛsoɔ (3) no a, Kofi papa di edin ti yere anim di dwuma sɛ anim 
nkyerɛkyerɛmu, wohwɛ nhwɛsoɔ (4) no a, Ɔboase di edin ti ankaa anim di dwuma sɛ 
anim nkyerɛkyerɛmu ɛnna sɛ wohwɛ nhwɛsoɔ (5) no nso a, Homase di edin ti bankye 
anim di dwuma sɛ anim nkyerɛkyerɛmu.
Afei, hwɛ Akyire Nkyerɛkyerɛmu nso ho nhwɛsoɔ bi:
Kae sɛ, Akyire Nkyerɛkyerɛmu yɛ asɛmfua anaa nsɛmfua a ɛdi edin ti akyi kyerɛkyerɛ 
anaasɛ ɛkasa fa ho wɔ edin kasasin mu.
Nhwɛsoɔ:
1. Dua tenten no akom.
2. Atadeɛ fɛfɛ no atete.
3. Nkwan kɔkɔɔ na ɔpɛ.
4. Akwadaa somakorɔ nya akyɛdeɛ.
5. Twene fitaa no ware.
Wohwɛ nhwɛsoɔ (1) no a, tenten di edin ti dua akyi di dwuma sɛ akyire 
nkyerɛkyerɛmu, wohwɛ nhwɛsoɔ (2) no a, fɛfɛ di edin ti atadeɛ akyi di dwuma sɛ 
akyire nkyerɛkyerɛmu, wohwɛ nhwɛsoɔ (3) no a, kɔkɔɔ di edin ti nkwan akyi di 
dwuma sɛ akyire nkyerɛkyerɛmu, wohwɛ nhwɛsoɔ (4) no a, somakorɔ di edin ti 
akwadaa akyi di dwuma sɛ akyire nkyerɛkyerɛmu ɛnna sɛ wohwɛ nhwɛsoɔ (5) no nso 
a, fitaa di edin ti twene akyi di dwuma sɛ akyire nkyerɛkyerɛmu.
Dwumadie 4.1 Twerɛ Edin Kasasin
Ekuo biara ntwerɛ edin kasasin ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa (3). Kasasin ahodoɔ a mobɛtwerɛ 
no, ɛyɛ a momma deɛ ɛdi kan no nyɛ asɛmfua koro pɛ a ɛno ara ne etire no, deɛ ɛtɔ 
so mmienu (2) no nyɛ edin kasasin a etire no wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛmu baako na momma

Adeyɛ Kasasin
Adeyɛ Kasasin yɛ kasasin a etire no yɛ adeyɛ. Adeyɛ kasasin tumi nya adeyɛ mmataho 
bata ne ho ma ne nyinaa di dwuma sɛ adeyɛ kasasin a ɛkyerɛ nneyɛɛ, dwumadie anaa 
tebea bi.
1. Adeyɛ kasasin a ɛyɛ adeyɛ titire baako pɛ no, yɛfrɛ no Adeyɛ Kasasin Tiawa.
Hwɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛdidi soɔ yi wɔ Ghana kasa ahodoɔ no bi mu:
Ewe:  va ‘come’, zu ‘become’, to ‘pound’
Twi:  di ‘eat’, nom ‘drink’, gyina ‘stand’
Dagbani: gbi ‘dig’, zani ‘stand’, she ‘roast’
Ga:  ŋma ‘write’, maje ‘send’, wie ‘talk’
Adeyɛ kasasin ho nhwɛsoɔ a ɛwɔ soro hɔ no mu biara nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ VP-VP
2. Adeyɛ Kasasin a ɛwɔ adeyɛ mmataho, adeyɛ titire ne adeyɛ boafoɔ. Adeyɛ mmataho 
boa ma yɛhunu kabea korɔ pɔtee a adeyɛ titire no wɔ mu (Asante Twi adeyɛ 
mmataho ho nhwɛsoɔ: a-, re-, rebɛ-, bɛ-, -eɛ, -iɛ) Adeyɛ Boafoɔ yɛ asɛmfua bi a 
ɛboa ma nteaseɛ ba adeyɛ bi mu anaasɛ ɛma adeyɛ bi mu nteaseɛ wie pɛ yɛ wɔ 
ɔkasamu mu (Nhwɛsoɔ: Nwomasua yɛ dɛ. Fosu yɛ aberanteɛ. Mmeranteɛ no yɛ 
nwomanimfoɔ. Wangara wɔ sika. Tamalefoɔ wɔ abadaeɛ. Kyei-Poku wɔ yere.)

mu. Ɔkyerɛfoɔ kasasin tumi kyerɛ yɛbea, ɛberɛ, dodoɔ, anoɔden, beaeɛ anaa ampayɛ/
akyinnyegyeɛ.

Kasasin Dwumadie
Wɔde kasasin di dwuma wɔ akwan a ɛdidi soɔ yi so:
1. Wɔde kasasin da adwempɔ bi adi.
2. Kasasin di akoten wɔ ɔkasa ne atwerɛ nkitahodie mu.
3. Kasasin boa ma nteaseɛ amapa ba baanu nkɔmmɔ, abasɛm, ahwɛgorɔ ne deɛ ɛkeka 
ho mu.

2. Monsensan asɛmfua a ɛyɛ kasasin a moahunu no ti no mu biara ase.
Ɛda A Mekɔɔ Mpoano
Nnawɔtwe a ɛtwaa mu no awieeɛ, me ne me nnamfonom yɛɛ yɛn adwen sɛ yɛbɛkɔ 
mpoano. Na ɛyɛ anɔpa a owie repue a na ama ewiem nsakraeɛ no ne efie agodie 
bɛkɔ pa ara. Anɔpa no ara na yɛsesaa yɛn nnuane ne yɛn anonneɛ guu yɛn baage 
mu, huri tenaa yɛn kaa mu ɛnna puwaa ɛnne mpoano hɔ. Mframa yurududu bi a 
na ɛrebɔ fa mpoano hɔ maa yɛn ani gyee yie wɔ yɛn mpoano nsrahwɛ no mu.
Yɛduruu hɔ no ara na yɛkɔpɛɛ ahomkabea bi wɔ abedua bi ase, de yɛn mpopaho 
sesɛɛ anwea hyeehyeɛ bi so ɛnna yɛtenaa so wɔ hɔ. Nkwadaa a na wɔredi asuo no 
mu agorɔ na nnipa binom nso de subonto nenam asuo no ani krididikrididi no maa 
yɛn ho peree yɛn sɛ yɛbɛkɔ akɔka wɔn ho ne wɔn nyinaa agye yɛn ani. Ɛberɛ kakra 
bi akyi no, yɛtoo yɛn ho too asuo no mu sei twau de anigyeɛ boroo nsuo no maa 
yɛn ho baee yɛn sei fɔmm.
Awiaberɛm no, yɛhyɛɛ da kɔtenaa ase dii nnuane a yɛde kɔeɛ no san nomee anonneɛ 
ahodoɔ ne nnuaba a yɛsoa guu yɛn baage mu kɔeɛ no nyinaa. Ɛpo asorɔkye a na 
ɛbɔ bɛpem abotan bi a na ɛwɔ yɛn nkyɛn baabi a na yɛteɛ no ho anika maa yɛn 
anigyeɛ mu dɔɔ sɛ eku. Yɛde yɛn berɛ a na aka yɛn wɔ mpoano hɔ no nyinaa de 
mpoano anwea no bi sisii adan nketenkete te sɛ akodeɛkorabeadan wɔ mpoano hɔ 
ɛnna yɛsan bɔɔ bɔɔlo wɔ mpoano hɔ.

Montena baanu baanu na monkenkan biribi mfa ɔkasamufa asekyerɛ ho. Monka mo 
mmuaeɛ no nkyerɛ adesuafoɔ nkaeɛ no: https://byjus.com/english/clauses/
Ɔkasamufa yɛ nsɛmfuakuo bi a ɛtɔ asom/nteaseɛ wom anaasɛ ɛntɔ asom/nteaseɛ nni 
mu wɔ ɔkasamu bi mu. Ɔkasamufa a ɛtɔ asom/nteaseɛ wom no, yɛfrɛ no ɔkasamufa 
titire ɛnna ɔkasamufa a ɛntɔ asom/nteaseɛ nni mu no nso, yɛfrɛ no ɔkasamufa kumaa.
Ɔkasamufa Ahodoɔ
Ɔkasamufa gu ahodoɔ mmienu (2). Ɛnonom ne; 1. Ɔkasamufa titire ne 2. Ɔkasamufa 
kumaa. Ɔkasamufa ahodoɔ mmienu (2) yi ho adesua na ɛwɔ fam hɔ no:
1. Ɔkasamufa Titire: Ɔkasamufa titire tumi gyina sɛ ɔkasamu tiawa esiane sɛ, nteaseɛ 
wom ɛnna afei nso ɛtumi nya ɔyɛfoɔ ne nkasaeɛ. Ɛwom sɛ, ɔkasamufa titire tumi 
gyina sɛ ɔkasamu tiawa deɛ nanso wɔnyɛ adekorɔ. Hwɛ nsonsonoeɛ a ɛda Ɔkasamu 
Tiawa ne Ɔkasamufa Titire ntam wɔ ɛpono a ɛwɔ aseɛ hɔ no so.
Nsonsonoeɛ a ɛda Ɔkasamu Tiawa ne Ɔkasamufa Titire ntam:

Ɔkasamu Tiawa/Ɔkasamufa Titire Dwumadie
Dwumadie 4.7 Ɔkasamu Tiawa/Ɔkasamufa Titire Dwumadie Ahodoɔ
Kɔ ntontanfidie no so kɔhwehwɛ Ɔkasamu Tiawa/Ɔkasamufa Titire dwumadie 
ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa (3). Ka deɛ wonyaeɛ no ho asɛm kyerɛ wo yɔnko na afei momfa 
ntoto deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi ho:
Ɔkasamu Tiawa/Ɔkasamufa Titire di dwuma ahodoɔ ɛnan (4). Ɛnonom ne 1. 
Asɛnka 2. Ɔhyɛ 3. Asɛmmisa ne 4. Nteamu.
1. Ɔkasamu Tiawa/Ɔkasamufa Titire tumi di dwuma sɛ Asɛnka. Yɛhunu 
saa dwumadie yi wɔ ɛberɛ a ɔkasafoɔ no de amannebɔ, adwenkyerɛ anaa 
nokwasɛm bi reto n’atiefoɔ anim. Yei mu no, ɔkasafoɔ no nhwehwɛ anaa mpɛ 
mmuaeɛ anaa asɛmmisa biara mfiri n’atiefoɔ no hɔ ɛnna afei nso ɔnhwehwɛ sɛ 
n’atiefoɔ no bɛyɛ biribi anaa adi dwuma biara. Ɛyɛ asɛm na ɔkasafoɔ no reka 
kyerɛ n’atiefoɔ no kɛkɛ. Monhwɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛdidi soɔ yi:
a. Kojo nom nsuo.
b. Yaa daa nnora.
c. Fosu kurom ne Homase.
d. Gyamfuaa nim aduane noa.
e. Mmarima pɛ ɛnam.
Sɛ wohwɛ nhwɛsoɔ i-v no a, ne nyinaa mu no, ɛyɛ asɛm bi na ɔkasafoɔ no ka 
kyerɛ akenkanfoɔ anaa atiefoɔ. Yei mu no, ɔkasafoɔ no nhwehwɛ biribiara 
mfiri n’atiefoɔ no hɔ na mmom, ɛyɛ asɛm na ɔreka kyerɛ wɔn kɛkɛ.
2. Ɔkasamu Tiawa/Ɔkasamufa Titire tumi di dwuma sɛ Ɔhyɛ. Yei mu no, ɔkasafoɔ 
no hwehwɛ sɛ n’atiefoɔ no bɛyɛ biribi a wɔnni ho anoyie biara. Ɔkasafoɔ 
no hyɛ atiefoɔ ma wɔdi dwuma bi anaa da nneyɛɛ bi adi a wɔnni kwan sɛ 
wɔtwentwɛn wɔ nan ase wɔ ho koraa. Monhwɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛdidi soɔ yi:
a. Montena ase!
b. Sɔre!
c. Sua Twi no yie!
d. Soa me!
e. Tie asɛmpa no!

ɔreka akyerɛ n’atiefoɔ no na mmom, ɔrehyɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ biribi anaasɛ wɔnni 
dwuma bi.
3. Ɔkasamu Tiawa/Ɔkasamufa Titire tumi di dwuma sɛ Asɛmmisa. Yei mu 
nso, ɔkasafoɔ no hwehwɛ anaa pɛ asɛm bi ho mmuaeɛ, mmoa anaa ɔhaw bi 
pomasiberɛ firi n’atiefoɔ no hɔ. Monhwɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛdidi soɔ yi:
a. Morehwehwɛ hwan?
b. Wobɛsua Twi anaa Borɔfo?
c. Ɔman bɛn mu na Kumase wɔ?
d. Wo papa atu kwan anaa?
e. Amankwaa ho te sɛn?

n’atiefoɔ no hɔ anaasɛ wɔka biribi kyerɛ no. Yei nyɛ asɛm bi kɛkɛ na ɔreka 
akyerɛ n’atiefoɔ no na mmom ɔpɛ sɛ nkitahodie bi kɔ so wɔ ɔne n’atiefoɔ no 
ntam.
4. Ɔkasamu Tiawa/Ɔkasamufa Titire tumi di dwuma sɛ Nteamu. Saa Ɔkasamu 
Tiawa/Ɔkasamufa Titire dwumadie yi da adi wɔ ɛberɛ a ɔkasafoɔ no ahunu 
anwanwadeɛ anaasɛ adeɛ a ɛyɛ hu bi. Sɛ ɛba no saa a, ɔkasafoɔ no tumi team 
de da dwiri a ne ho adwiri no anaa hye a ne yam ahye no adi. Yei nkyerɛ sɛ 
ɔreteam ahyɛ obi sɛ ɔnyɛ biribi na mmom, ɔde saa nteamu no da n’ahodwirie 
anaa n’ayamhyehyeɛ no adi. Monhwɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛdidi soɔ yi:
a. Akwadaa yi ho yɛ fɛ!
b. Adeɛ yi so!
c. Adeɛ a emu yɛ duru ni!
d. Akoa yi wɔ sika!
e. Agya ei!
Sɛ wohwɛ nhwɛsoɔ i-v no a, ne nyinaa mu no, ɔkasafoɔ no ma n’atiefoɔ no 
hunu sɛdeɛ adeɛ a wahunu no si yɛ no nwanwa fa anaa sɛdeɛ ne ho asi adwiri 
no. Biribiara nni yei mu a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔkasafoɔ no rehyɛ n’atiefoɔ no ama wɔayɛ 
biribi.
Fa Yei Sɔ Wo ho Hwɛ - Ma yɛnhwɛ baabi a woaduru
Wobɛtumi ama asɛmmisa nsɛmfua ho nhwɛsoɔ wɔ Asante Twi mu?
1. Mpɛn pii no, yɛde asɛmmisa agyinahyɛdeɛ (mmisaeɛ, ?) na ɛwie  Ɔkasamu 
Tiawa/Ɔkasamufa Titire a ɛdi dwuma sɛ Asɛmmisa.
Nhwɛsoɔ;
a.  Hwan sika nie?
b.  Ɛdeɛn na woresua no?
c.  Worehwehwɛ wo mpaboa no anaa?
d.  Ɛhefa na woteɛ?
e.  Morepɛ dodoɔ sɛn?
