KASASIN/ƆKASAMUFA NHYEHYƐEƐ NE ATWERƐ MU AGYINAHYƐDEƐ
Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa  4
Ɔkasamufa kumaa ahodoɔ ne ne dwumadie: Yɛbɛtumi agyina Ɔkasamufa kumaa 
dwuma a ɛdi wɔ ɔkasamu mu so aka sɛ, ɔkasamufa kumaa gu ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa 
(3). Ɛnonom ne edin kasamufa kumaa, edin nkyerɛkyerɛmu kasamufa kumaa ɛnna 
ɔkyerɛfoɔ kasamufa kumaa.
1. Edin nkyerɛkyerɛmu kasamufa kumaa: Edin nkyerɛkyerɛmu kasamufa kumaa 
kyerɛkyerɛ edin bi a ɛwɔ ɔkasamufa titire no mu mu. Mpɛn pii no, edin nkyerɛkyerɛmu 
kasamufa kumaa no de asɛmfua “a” na ɛfiti aseɛ. Edin nkyerɛkyerɛmu kasamufa 
kumaa ho nhwɛsoɔ no bi na yɛasensan aseɛ wɔ ɔkasamu a ɛwɔ fam hɔ no mu no:
a. Ampɔnsaa kenkanee nwoma a ne papa tɔ maa no no.
b. Ɔbaa no a ɔtɔɔ mpaboa nnora no kɔ.
Hyɛ no nso sɛ, nsɛmfua a yɛasensan aseɛ no na ɛyɛ edin nkyerɛkyerɛmu 
kasamufa kumaa no. Wohwɛ nhwɛsoɔ “a” no a, wobɛhunu sɛ, ‘a ne papa tɔ 
maa no’ kyerɛkyerɛ nwoma a ɛyɛ edin wɔ ɔkasamufa titire “Ampɔnsaa kenkanee 
nwoma no” mu no mu. Saa pɛpɛɛpɛ nso na nhwɛsoɔ ‘b’ mu no, ‘a ɔtɔɔ mpaboa 
nnora no’ kyerɛkyerɛ ɔbaa a ɛyɛ edin wɔ ɔkasamufa titire ‘Ɔbaa no kɔ’ mu no mu.
2. Edin kasamufa kumaa: Yei yɛ ɔkasamufa kumaa a ɛtumi yɛ nnwuma a edin di wɔ 
ɔkasamu mu no bi pɛpɛɛpɛ. Ɛtumi di dwuma sɛ ɔyɛfoɔ, ɔyɛtia anaa ɔgyefoɔ. Edin 
kasamufa ne edin nkyerɛkyerɛmu kasamufa kumaa di nsɛ nanso mpɛn pii no, ɛyɛ a na 
edin kasamufa no hyɛ beaeɛ a edin hyɛ wɔ ɔkasamu no mu hɔ nanso edin nkyerɛkyerɛmu 
kasasin no deɛ, ɛberɛ biara ɛkyerɛkyerɛ edin a ɛwɔ ɔkasamu no mu mu.
Edin kasamufa kumaa ho nhwɛsoɔ
1. Edin kasamufa kumaa a ɛdi dwuma sɛ ɔyɛfoɔ:
 “Ɔbaa a ɔtɔɔ ntoma nnora no kɔ.”
2. Edin kasamufa kumaa a ɛdi dwuma sɛ ɔyɛtia:
a.  Pepra kenkanee nwoma no.”
b. Mehyiaa ɔbɔfoɔ no a ɔkumm gyata no.
Ɔkasamu (i) a ɛwɔ soro hɔ no mu no, nsɛmfua ‘Ɔbaa a ɔtɔɔ ntoma nnora no’ a 
yɛasane aseɛ no yɛ edin kasamufa kumaa a ɛdi dwuma sɛ ɔyɛfoɔ ma adeyɛ ‘kɔ’ ɛnna 
nhwɛsoɔ a ɛwɔ 2 i ne ii mu no nso yɛ ɔkasamufa kumaa a ɛdi dwuma sɛ ɔyɛtia.
3. Ɔkyerɛfoɔ kasamufa kumaa: Ɔkyerɛfoɔ kasamufa di dwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛfoɔ wɔ 
ɔkasamu mu. Ɛtumi kyerɛkyerɛ adeyɛ, edin nkyerɛkyerɛmu anaasɛ ɔkyerɛfoɔ foforɔ 
mu wɔ ɔkasamu mu na ɛsan nso ka biribi fa ɛberɛ, beaeɛ ne yɛbea ne deɛ ɛkeka ho 
ho.
Ɔkyerɛfoɔ kasamufa ho nhwɛsoɔ:
a. Ɔkyena anɔpa, wobɛkɔ.
b. Maame no te dua no ase.
Ɔkyerɛfoɔ kasamufa kumaa na yɛasensan aseɛ wɔ ɔkasamu a ɛwɔ soro hɔ no mu 
no.

KASASIN/ƆKASAMUFA NHYEHYƐEƐ NE ATWERƐ MU AGYINAHYƐDEƐ
Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa  4
Dwumadie 4.8 Ɔkasamufa Asekyerɛ
Fa w’ankasa nsɛmfua kyerɛkyerɛ ɔkasamufa mu. Ka wo mmuaeɛ no kyerɛ w’afɛfoɔ.
Dwumadie 4.9 Ɔkasamufa Ahodoɔ
Ekuo biara mfa nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfata nkyerɛkyerɛ ɔkasamufa ahodoɔ mmienu (2) no 
mu. Ekuo biara nka wɔn mmuaeɛ no nkyerɛ adesuafoɔ a wɔwɔ sukuu dan no mu 
no nyinaa.
Dwumadie 4.10 Ɔkasamufa kumaa ahodoɔ
1. Montena baanu baanu na monkenkan abasɛm a ɛwɔ aseɛ hɔ no na montwerɛ 
ɔkasamufa kumaa ahodoɔ a ɛdidi soɔ yi mu biara ho nhwɛsoɔ mmienu (2) 
anaa deɛ ɛboro saa a ɛwɔ abasɛm no mu. i. Edin kasamufa kumaa. ii. Edin 
nkyerɛkyerɛmu kasamufa kumaa. iii. Ɔkyerɛfoɔ kasamufa kumaa.
2. Mo ne mo afɛfoɔ ntoatoa adwen mfa mo mmuaeɛ no ho na momfa mo mmuaeɛ 
no ntoto mo afɛfoɔ deɛ ho nhwɛ mmuaeɛ a ɛsesɛ ne deɛ nsonsonoeɛ wom na 
monsiesie mfomsoɔ biara a ɛbɛba mu no:
“Esiane sɛ megyaa m’awia aduane wɔ efie nti no, mekɔɔ aduanetɔnbea hɔ sɛ 
merekɔdidi. Mekɔhunuu m’adamfo bi a na ɔredi ɛmo wɔ hɔ. Esiane sɛ na ɛkɔm 
de me nti no, me nso metɔɔ ɛmo no bi. Medii ɛmo no wieeɛ no, meyɛɛ ntɛm kɔɔ 
nhyiamu bi a ɛdii dɔnhwereɛ mmienu (2) ase. Nhyiamu no kɔɔ awieeɛ no, mede 
ahosɛpɛ mepue firii hyiadan no mu ɛfiri sɛ, na biribiara aba awieeɛ”.
Dwumadie 4.11 Ɔkasamufa ho nhwɛsoɔ
Ekuo biara mma ɔkasamufa ahodoɔ a moasua no mu biara ho nhwɛsoɔ baako. 
Ekuo biara nka ne mmuaeɛ nkyerɛ adesuafoɔ nkaeɛ no.
ATWERƐ MU AGYINAHYƐDEƐ
Atwerɛ mu agyinahyɛdeɛ yɛ ahyɛnsodeɛ anaa nsɛnkyerɛne ahodoɔ a yɛde di dwuma 
wɔ atwerɛ mu de kyekyɛ ɔkasamu, ɔkasamufa ne ɔkasasin mu ma no da nteaseɛ bi adi.

Dwumadie 4.13 Atwerɛ mu agyinahyɛdeɛ Dwumadie
Ekuo biara mfa atwerɛ mu agyinahyɛdeɛ nni dwuma wɔ ɔkasamu a ɛdidi soɔ yi mu 
na monkyerɛ deɛ enti a mode saa atwerɛ mu agyinahyɛdeɛ no dii dwuma.
1. Meduruu ɛhyɛngyinabea hɔ no na ɛhyɛn no atu dada.
2. Me nnamfonom Oforiwaa Boatemaa Gyamfuaa ne Kuma bɛba abɛsra yɛn.

4. Ne din de Abenaa
5. M’awofoɔ efie wɔ kuro ketewa mu
Dwumadie 4.14 Fa atwerɛ mu agyinahyɛdeɛ di dwuma wɔ abasɛm 
mu
1. Ekuo biara mfa atwerɛ mu agyinahyɛdeɛ nni dwuma wɔ abasɛm yi mu mma 
nteaseɛ mmra mu.
2. Kyerɛ sɛnti a wode saa atwerɛ mu agyinahyɛdeɛ no dii dwuma.
Ewiem nsakraeɛ bɔne so nsunsuansoɔ a anya wɔ ewiase afanan soɔ no yɛ 
ɔhaw kɛseɛ pa ara ma amanpanimfoɔ ewiem a ayɛ hyɛ ne osutorɔ nhyehyɛeɛ 
a asesa no yɛ adeɛ ɛbɛma nnɔbaeɛ so ate pa ara wɔ amantam ahodoɔ a ɛkɔm 
wɔ mu dada no mu ewiem nsakraeɛ no bɛsan anya nsunsuansoɔ bɔne pa ara 
wɔ sikasɛm ne mmɔborɔfoɔ a wɔretee so wɔ abrabɔ mu dada no so basaa yei 
nti ɛho hia yie sɛ yɛbɛpɛ ewiem nsakraeɛ bɔne yi pomasiberɛ animanim yi ara

a ɛwowɔ mu.
4. Fa w’ankasa nsɛmfua kyerɛkyerɛ ɔkasamufa mu.
5. Twerɛ ɔkasamufa ahodoɔ mmienu (2) no na kyerɛkyerɛ emu biara mu tiawa.
a. Kenkan abasɛm a ɛwɔ aseɛ hɔ no na twerɛ ɔkasamufa kumaa a ɛwom no nyinaa.
b. Twerɛ ɔkyerɛfoɔ kasasin mmienu (2) biara a wohunu wɔ abasɛm no mu.
‘Merekɔ ɛdan no mu no, mehunuu mfoni fɛfɛ bi a mfoniyɔfoɔ a mepɛ n’asɛm pa ara 
bi na ɔyɔeɛ sɛ ɛfam ɛdan no ho. Esiane sɛ masua mfoni ho abakɔsɛm nti, mehunuiɛ 
ara pɛ na mehunuu ne nhyehyɛeɛ. Ɛwom sɛ na ahosuo ahodoɔ a ɔde adi adwini no 
nyi ne ho adi mmoro so deɛ, nanso ne nyinaa mu no, na mfoni no yɛ fɛ yie. Sɛdeɛ 
m’ani si gye mfoni ho no nti, ɛtwee me kɔgyinaa ho prɛko pɛ. Megyina ho rehwɛ 
no kyee no, mehunuu nsaano agyinaeɛ ketewa bi wɔ twea hɔ.
6. Twerɛ atwerɛ mu agyinahyɛdeɛ ahodoɔ enum (5).
7. Twerɛ w’ankasa ɔkasamu mmiɛnsa (3) na fa atwerɛ mu agyinahyɛdeɛ a 
woatwerɛ wɔ soro hɔ no mu mmiɛnsa (3) di dwuma wom sɛdeɛ ɛfata.
8. Kyerɛ atwerɛ mu nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ase.
9. Twerɛ Asante Twi nsɛmfua mmiɛnsa a yɛde atwerɛ mu nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ di dwuma 
wɔ mu na fa saa nsɛmfua no yɛ ɔkasamu .

Ano-Ne-Ano Kasa Asekyerɛ ne Ɔkasa Asekyerɛ a 
Yɛtwerɛ
NNIANIMU
Saa ɔfa yi bɛda adesua a ɛfa Susutwerɛ ne Ɔkasa asekyerɛ a Yɛtwerɛ adi akyerɛ wo. 
Susutwerɛ ɛfa no mu, wobɛsua susutwerɛ ahodoɔ ne ɛkwan a yɛfa so twerɛ susutwerɛ 
ahodoɔ no. Saa ɔfa yi mu, wobɛsua Krataa a yɛtwerɛ kɔma adwuma mu panin ne 
Atipɛnfoɔ krataatwerɛ nko ara ho adeɛ. Wobɛnya nimdeɛ a wobɛtumi de ahwehwɛ 
susutwerɛ ahodoɔ no na afei nso woatumi de saa nimdeɛ no atwerɛ w’ankasa susutwerɛ 
wɔ Asante Twi kasa mu. Ɔfa yi mu no, wobɛsan asua adeɛ afa ɛkwan a yɛfa so kyerɛ 
Borɔfo kasa ase kɔ Asante Twi kasa mu. Ɔkasa asekyerɛ ahodoɔ bi te sɛ Asekyerɛ a 
ɛgyina nsɛmfua nteaseɛ soɔ, Ɔkasa asekyerɛ a ɛgyina nteaseɛ soɔ, Ɔkasa asekyerɛ a 
yɛto mu nkyene ne deɛ ɛkeka ho nso, yɛbɛka ho asɛm wɔ ɔfa yi mu. Wobɛnya ɔkasa 
asekyerɛ ahodoɔ no nimdeɛ na ɛbɛsan aboa ama woatumi akyerɛ Borɔfo kasa ase akɔ 
Asante Twi kasa mu.
ADWEMPƆ AHODOƆ
• Yɛtwerɛ krataa a yɛde kɔma adwuma mu panin kɔma adwuma bi mu panin a ɔwɔ 
hɔ de kɔpɛ adwuma mu kwan anaa de kɔsrɛ adeɛ bi firi ne hɔ.
• Atipɛnfoɔ krataa yɛ krataa a yɛtwerɛ kɔma yɛn abusuani, yɛn adamfo anaa yɛn 
manifoɔ bi.
• Susutwerɛ ne sɛ ɔtwerɛfoɔ bi keka nsɛmfua bi bom fa so da n’adwenkyerɛ bi adi wɔ 
atwerɛ kwan so.
• Kasakyerɛ ne sɛ wonam atwerɛ kwan so de adwenkyerɛ anaa amannebɔ bi ma 
nnipakuo bi.
• Ɔkasa asekyerɛ ne sɛ worekyerɛ ɔkasa bi ase akɔ ɔkasa foforɔ bi mu wɔ atwerɛ kwan 
so.
SUSUTWERƐ
Susutwerɛ ne sɛ ɔtwerɛfoɔ bi ahyehyɛ nsɛm anaa adwempɔ ahodoɔ bi wɔ atwerɛ kwan 
so. Susutwerɛ ahodoɔ ɛnan a wɔagye atom firi mfenhyia ɔha a ɛtɔ so dunkron (19 th 
century) mu de bɛsi ɛnnɛ mmerɛ yi nonom ne Sukyerɛ susutwerɛ, Abasɛm susutwerɛ, 
Akwankyerɛ susutwerɛ ne Akyinnyegyeɛ susutwerɛ. Wobɛtumi de susutwerɛ ahodoɔ 
yi su ahodoɔ no abobom atwerɛ susutwerɛ amapa.

Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa  5
Susutwerɛ Ahodoɔ
Susutwerɛ gu ahodoɔ ɛnan. Ɛnonom ne sukyerɛ susutwerɛ, abasɛm susutwerɛ, 
akwankyerɛ susutwerɛ ne akyinnyegyeɛ susutwerɛ.
Sukyerɛ Susutwerɛ
Saa susutwerɛ yi hwehwɛ sɛ adesuafoɔ bɛtumi akyerɛ sɛdeɛ adeɛ bi, onipa, beaeɛ, 
osuahunu, akoma-mu-nsɛm, tebea, ne deɛ ɛkeka ho bi si teɛ pɔtee. Ɛho nhwɛsoɔ no 
bi ne sɛ woretwerɛ biribi akyerɛkyerɛ sɛdeɛ w’abusua anaa wo kurom si teɛ ho. Hwɛ 
susutwerɛ a ɛwɔ aseɛ hɔ no:
M’abusua
M’abusuafoɔ te efie ketewa bi mu wɔ me kurom. Efie no sua nanso ɛyɛ fɛ yie. Yɛayɛ 
mfikyifuo kɛseɛ wɔ efie no akyi. Medɔ mfikyifuo no mu nanso sɛ me nuabaa no bɛyɛ 
adwuma wɔ mfikyifuo no mu deɛ, ɔkyiri kɔkɔkɔkɔ.Adeɛ a ɔpɛ pa ara ne nwoma akenkan. 
Ɔkenkan nwoma anɔpa, awia ne anwummerɛ.
Mede atosodeɛ a menya firi mfikyifuo no mu nyinaa ma m’awofoɔ. Wɔtaa noa aduane wɔ 
yɛn gyaade ketewa no mu. Medi atosodeɛ biara nanso me nuabaa no deɛ, ɛnyɛ atosodeɛ 
biara na ɔdi. Mpɛn pii no, m’abusuafoɔ no nyinaa ka wɔn ho bom di anɔpaduane ne 
anwummeduane. Yɛdi nkɔmmɔ. Yɛsere. Me nuabaa no hohoro nkukuo no mu.
Ɛduru anwummerɛ a, me papa tie ɛdwom, me maame yɛ adwuma wɔ ne kɔmputa so, 
mehwɛ kasamfoni ɛnna me nuabaa no nso kenkan ne nwoma.
Ɛnkyɛre biara na yɛrekɔdeda. M’awofoɔ nkɔda ntɛm koraa nanso me ne me nuabaa no deɛ, 
yɛkɔda ntɛm. Mpɛn pii no ɛyɛ a na m’ani kum a mepɛ sɛ meda no, na me nuabaa no deɛ 
ɔda so ara rekenkan ne nwoma.
Abasɛm susutwerɛ
Yei yɛ abasɛm a ɛfa osuahunu bi ho a ɔtwerɛfoɔ bi de to dwa. Wɔde abasɛm ho nneɛma 
ahodoɔ hyehyɛ abasɛm susutwerɛ mu de twe adesuafoɔ adwene ba dwumadie no so  
. Nhwɛsoɔ, wotwerɛ biribi ka deɛ ɛkɔɔ so wɔ ɛda a ɛdi kan a wokɔɔ sukuu a wowɔ 
mu seesei ara no ho anaa dwumadie bi a ɛkɔɔ soɔ ho a, wo nsɛm a wobɛka no nyinaa 
ka bom yɛ abasɛm susutwerɛ. Saa susutwerɛ yi mu no, woda w’ankasa suahunu bi a 
wonyaa wɔ wo sukuu no mu anaasɛ dwumadie a ɛkɔɔ so no mu adi.
Akwankyerɛ susutwerɛ
Saa susutwerɛ yi hwehwɛ sɛ adesuafoɔ bɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu afa adwempɔ bi ho anya 
ɛho adansedideɛ, de nsɛmfua foforɔ atrɛ saa adwempɔ no mu, na wɔagyina so de 
akyinnyegyesɛm bi a ɛfa saa adwempɔ no ho ato dwa sɛdeɛ ɛfata. Nhwɛsoɔ, susutwerɛ 
a ɛfa Ghana ahofadie ho mu no, ɔtwerɛfoɔ no twerɛ abakɔsɛm a ɛyɛ nokwasɛm pɔtee 
a ɛfa ɛda Ghana nyaa ahofadie, nnipa pɔtee a wɔgye gyinaa mu ko maa Ghana nyaa 
ahofadie no, sɛdeɛ amammuo asi akɔ so wɔ ahofadienya no akyi ne deɛ ɛkeka ho ho.
Akyinnyegyeɛ susutwerɛ
Saa susutwerɛ yi hwehwɛ sɛ adesuafoɔ bɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu amapa afa asɛntire bi ho na 
wɔakasa afoa saa asɛntire no so anaa atia. Nhwɛsoɔ, ‘mmaa a wɔdi tumi brɛ wɔn ho ase

kyɛn mmarima a wɔdi tumi.’ Saa atifiasɛm yi hwehwɛ sɛ osuani no bɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu 
anya nokwasɛm amapa na wagyina so de akyerɛkyerɛ sɛnti a ɔgye asɛm yi tom anaasɛ 
ɔnnye ntom mu fann. Yei mu no, osuani anaa ɔkasafoɔ no tumi kasa foa asɛntire no 
so anaasɛ ɔkasa tia asɛntire no.
Akyinnyegyeɛ susutwerɛ atifiasɛm ho nhwɛsoɔ:
1. Nnipa yi mu hwan na ne ho hia pa ara: Tikyani anaa Dɔkotani?
2. Okuani ne Dɔkotani mu hwan na ne ho hia pa ara wɔ ɔman yi mu?
3. Sɛ wobɛtena sukuu mu hɔ akɔ sukuu ne sɛ wobɛtena efie akɔ sukuu mu deɛ ɛwɔ 
he na wopɛ? Kyerɛ sɛnti a wopɛ deɛ woayi no.
4. Deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi mu deɛ ɛwɔ he na wopɛ pa ara? Sukuu a mmaa anaa mmarima 
nko ara na ɛkɔ ne sukuu a mmaa ne mmarima nyinaa ka bom kɔ.
Susutwerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ
Susutwerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no wɔ afa mmiɛnsa (3). Ɛnonom ne nnianimu, esinianim ne 
awieeɛ.
Nnianimu
Mfitiasesɛm a yɛde kyere ɔkenkanfoɔ adwene kɔ susutwerɛ no so: fa asɛmmisa, 
akontabuo ho nsɛm anaa asɛnka bi a ɛkyere adwene fiti wo susutwerɛ no ase. Ka wo 
susutwerɛ no nnyinasosɛm bi a ɛhia sɛ akenkanfoɔ hunu.
Esinianim
Twerɛ wo nnyinasoɔ kasamu ahodoɔ no, akyinnyegyeɛ atifiasɛm a ɛfata na fa 
adansedideɛ a ɛsɛ kyerɛkyerɛ wo nsɛm no mu. Deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi ne nsɛm ahodoɔ a 
wobɛtumi atwerɛ wɔ akyinnyegyeɛ susutwerɛ esinianim hɔ:
1.Twerɛ ɔkasamu a ɛkyerɛ sɛ worefiri kasapɛn baako so akɔ foforɔ so.
2.Twerɛ nnyinasoɔ kasamu a ɛtɔ so mmienu no na fa adansedideɛ amapa kyerɛkyerɛ 
mu.
3.Twerɛ ɔkasamu a ɛkyerɛ sɛ worefiri saa kasapɛn no so akɔ foforɔ so.
4.Twerɛ ɔkasamu a akyinnyegyeɛ wom anaa ɛde akyinnyeɛ/kɔtwatwe bɛba.
5.Kyerɛkyerɛ wo nsɛm no mu fann na fa adansedideɛ a ɛfata taa akyire na gye tom sɛ 
nsakraeɛ bɛtumi aba wo nsɛm no mu.
6.Ka asɛm bi fa bɔ wo yɔnko no nsɛm no gu na gyina so fa wo nsɛm no kɔ awieeɛ.
Awieeɛ
Awieeɛ ha na ɔtwerɛfoɔ anaa ɔkasafoɔ no de ne nsɛm no nyinaa si. Ɛkwan a yɛfa so 
twerɛ Awieeɛ kasapɛn no nie:

Dwumadie 5.2 Ɔyɛkyerɛ Tiawa

Dwumadie 5.3 Susutwerɛ
1. “Adesuafoɔ a wɔtena sukuu mu sua adeɛ no taa bɔ wɔn ho mmɔden wɔ 
nwomasua mu kyɛn wɔn afɛfoɔ a wɔfiri efie kɔ sukuu san ba no.” Fa nsɛmfua 
ahasa aduonum (350) twerɛ akyinnyegyeɛ susutwerɛ foa asɛntire yi so anaa

adesuafoɔ no.
2. Ekuo biara ntoatoa adwene mfa asɛntire yi ho: Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛbara galamsey wɔ 
ɔman Ghana mu. Momma mo adwentoatoa no nnyina nnyinasosɛm a ɛdidi 
soɔ yi so: nsunsuansoɔ a ɛbɛba yɛn sikasɛm, yɛn asetena mu ne yɛn atenaeɛ 
soɔ. Afei, momfa kasapɛn ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa (3) so nna mo adwentoatoa no mu 
nsɛm adi nkyerɛ mo afɛfoɔ na wɔmmisabisa mo nsɛm mfa deɛ mokaeɛ no ho.

KASAKYERƐ NE ATEKERE TWERƐ
Kasakyerɛ ne Atekere Asekyerɛ
Kasakyerɛ twerɛ
Kasakyerɛ twerɛ yɛ ɛkwan a wɔfa so de atwerɛ mu agyinahyɛdeɛ ne ɔkasa da 
adwenemsɛm bi adi kyerɛ ɔkenkanfoɔ. Kasakyerɛ twerɛ ne abasɛm biara twerɛ yɛ 
adekorɔ.
Atekere
Ɛyɛ atwerɛ bi a wɔde fa nsɛntwerɛfoɔ so ma nnipa bebree nya bi kenkan. Nsɛntwerɛfoɔ 
a yɛreka wɔn ho asɛm wɔ atekere twerɛ mu no yɛ nsɛntwerɛ nnwuma bi te sɛ dawurobɔ 
nkrataa, ne deɛ ɛkeka ho.
Kasakyerɛ twerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ
Woahunu w’atiefoɔ, na woayi w’atifiasɛm, na woanya adansedideɛ ahodoɔ na 
woatwerɛ wo susutwerɛ no nhyehyɛeɛ awie no, afei na na ɛberɛ aso sɛ wotwerɛ wo 
kasakyerɛ no.
Kasakyerɛ afa ahodoɔ
Ɛsɛ sɛ wo kasakyerɛ no nya ɔfa ahodoɔ ɛnan yi wɔ mu.
1.  Nkyea a ɛdi kan
Deɛ ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ di kan ne sɛ wobɛkyea w’atiefoɔ na woada wo ho adi akyerɛ 
wɔn. Fa akwannuasa so ma atiefoɔ no nhunu so wo ne wɔn na ɛredi nkitaho 
no. Nhwɛsoɔ, Me nuanom mmeranteɛ ne mmabaawa, Me nuanom Ghanafoɔ, 
Awuranom animuonyamfoɔ, Otumfoɔ, ne deɛ ɛkeka ho.
2. Nnianimu
Bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛda asɛntire a kasakyerɛ no fa ho no adi akyerɛ w’atiefoɔ no. 
Nhwɛsoɔ, Maba mo nkyɛn awia yi rebɛma no ahunu mpɛmpɛnsoɔ a ɛko a yɛreko 
atia amumuyɛsɛm a ɛkɔ so wɔ yɛn mpɔtamu ha no aduru.
3. Kasakyerɛ no ankasa
Ɛsɛ sɛ wohunu asɛntire a kasakyerɛ no fa ho no nkorabata ahodoɔ a wobɛkasa afa

Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa  5
Moyɛ adantam sukuu mu adesuafoɔ yi, ɛbɛtumi aba sɛ, motaa de kasa ahodoɔ di 
dwuma wɔ mo daadaa asetena mu ɛfiri sɛ, mo ne mo abusuafoɔ ne mo nnamfonom 
di nkɔmmɔ na ɛno akyi no, moasan aba sukuu dan mu abɛsua adeɛ. Moagye ɛberɛ 
adwendwene hia a Asante Twi kasa ho hia wɔ mo adesua anammɔntuo yi mu pɛn?
Nhwehwɛmu kɔ so da no adi sɛ, adesuafoɔ a wɔte wɔn ankasa kasa yie no bɔ mmɔden 
wɔ nwomasua mu pa ara ɛnkanka adesua a ɛfa akenkan ne atwerɛ ho mu. Ɛfiri sɛ, 
kasa a woka no ma wonya fapem amapa wɔ ɔkasa ho nimdeɛ mu na ɛnam so ma ɛyɛ 
mmerɛ ma wo sɛ wobɛsua kasa foforɔ na woasan ate adesua mu nneɛma a ɛyɛ den ase 
ntɛm koraa.
Bio, sɛ yɛde wo kurom kasa kyerɛ wo adeɛ a, ɛma wote w’amammerɛ ne w’amanneɛ 
ase na afei nso ɛma wohunu wo nkyi. Ɔkasa hyɛ amammerɛ mu nti sɛ wode adesuafoɔ 
no kurom kasa kyerɛ wɔn adeɛ a, ɛma wɔhunu wɔn nkyi na ɛsan nso ma wɔn ani gye 
san hunu sɛ, wɔn amammerɛ ne wɔn amanneɛ yɛ sononko.
Deɛ ɛka ho bio ne sɛ, nhwehwɛmu asan ada no adi sɛ, adesuafoɔ a wɔtumi ka wɔn 
kurom kasa yie no nya adwenemteɛ, adwenemdɔ ho nimdeɛ ɛnna afei nso, ɛma wɔtumi 
dwene ntɛm pɛ ɔhaw bi ano pomasiberɛ ntɛmntɛmso. Esiane sɛ, adesuafoɔ no kurom 
kasa na ɛyɛ kasa a wɔde twaa wɔn funuma nti no, ɛmma ɛnyɛ den mma wɔn wɔ berɛ 
a wɔde saa kasa no redi dwuma na afei nso ɛmma amannebɔ biara a wɔbɛte no aseteɛ 
nyɛ tena mma wɔn koraa.
Deɛ ɛtwa toɔ ne sɛ, adesuafoɔ kurom kasa a wɔde kyerɛ wɔn adeɛ no ho hia pa ara ma 
wɔn wɔ wɔn adesua mu nkonimdie mu, ɛma wɔhunu wɔn amammerɛ ne wɔn amanneɛ 
na ɛsan nso ma wɔn adwene mu dɔ. Moyɛ adantamu asukuufoɔ yi, ɛho hia sɛ mobɛma 
mo ani aku mo kurom kasa ho wɔ berɛ a moresua kasa foforɔ ahodoɔ wɔ mo nwomasua 
anammɔntuo mu yi.
Dwumadie 5.8 Atekere/Kasakyerɛ twerɛ
 Ekuo biara mfa kasapɛn ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa (3) ntwerɛ atekere anaa kasakyerɛ mfa 
asɛntire yi ho: Mpontuo a aba me sukuu mu. Monhwɛ sɛ mode su ahodoɔ a yɛaka 
ho asɛm wɔ soro hɔ no nyinaa bi bɛba mu. Monyɛ krado sɛ mobɛka mo atekere/
kasakyerɛ no ho asɛm akyerɛ mo afɛfoɔ na mo nyinaa moatoatoa adwen afa ho.

KRATAA A YƐTWERƐ KƆMA ADWUMA MU 
PANIN NE NE SU
Fa Yei Sɔ Wo ho Hwɛ - Ma yɛnhwɛ baabi a woaduru
Ansa na yɛbɛhyɛ aseɛ asua krataatwerɛ ahodoɔ no ho adeɛ no, bɔ wo tirim twerɛ 
susutwerɛ ahodoɔ ɛnan (4) no ne wɔn su ahodoɔ no.
Krataa a yɛtwerɛ kɔma adwuma mu panin
Saa krataa yi yɛ krataa a yɛtwerɛ de kɔpɛ adwuma na ne twerɛ no di akwankyerɛ ne 
nhyehyɛeɛ pɔtee bi so. Saa krataa yi twerɛ mu no, yɛde kasapa ne enidie kasa na ɛdi 
dwuma.
Yɛde saa krataatwerɛ yi di dwuma wɔ berɛ a yɛne mpanimfoɔ ne atitire bi redi nkitaho.
Mpanimfoɔ a yɛreka wɔn ho asɛm wɔ saa krataatwerɛ yi mu no mu bi ne Sukuupanin, 
Ɔsamufoɔ, Adwuma Hwɛsofoɔ, Ɔsɔfoɔ, Ɔmansoafoɔ, Ɔhene, Mansini/Kuropɔn Aban 
Krakyepanin, ne wɔn a wɔkeka ho.
Krataa a yɛtwerɛ kɔma adwuma mu panin su
Deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi nom ne krataa a yɛtwerɛ kɔma adwuma mu panin su:
1. Ɔtwerɛfoɔ adrɛɛse/akyirikwan: Twerɛ w’adrɛɛse/w’akyirikwan wɔ krataa no 
soro nifa so. Momma yɛnhyɛ no nso sɛ, wobɛtumi atwerɛ w’adrɛɛse/w’akyirikwan 
wɔ krataa no soro benkum so nso.
2. Ɛda/Deeti; Yei yɛ ɛda a woretwerɛ krataa no. Yei bɛtumi ayɛ ɛda bi a atwam na 
mmom ɛrentumi nyɛ ɛda a ɛnnya mmaeɛ.
3. Ɔgyefoɔ adrɛɛse/akyirikwan: Twerɛ ɔgyefoɔ no diberɛ ne n’akyirikwan wɔ wo 
nsa benkum so .
4. Nkyea a ɛdi kan; Yei yɛ enidie nkyea a yɛkyea ɔpanin korɔ no. Nkyea a ɛdi kan a 
ɛyɛ papa wɔ saa krataatwerɛ yi mu ne Me Wura/M’awuraa, Me Wura Smith, Me 
Wura Ɔsamufoɔ.
5. Atifiasɛm: Fa atwerɛdeɛ akɛseɛ twerɛ atifiasɛm a ɛkyerɛ sɛnti a woretwerɛ krataa 
no na san aseɛ kamakama. Saa atifiasɛm yi yɛ tɔfabɔ a ɛfiri asɛmmisa no mu.
6. Nnianimu; Yei yɛ ɔkasamu a ɛdi kan koraa a ɛda botaeɛ pɔtee a atwerɛ no nyinaa 
gyina soɔ adi.
7. Kasapɛn ahodoɔ: Ɛsɛ sɛ kasapɛn baako da adwempɔ koro pɛ adi wɔ atwerɛ no mu. 
Sɛ wotumi da adwempɔ biara adi wɔ kasapɛn baako mu a, ɛma onipa a ɔbɛkenkan 
wo krataa no te wo nsɛm anaa nsɛmpɔ a wode reto dwa no ase yie pa ara.
8. Awieeɛ kasapɛn: Krataa no awieeɛ hɔ no, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔtwerɛfoɔ no tumi bɔ ne nsɛm 
ahodoɔ no nyinaa tɔfa.
Sɛ woretwerɛ krataa akɔma adwuma mu panin a, ɛho hia sɛ wobɛma wo kasa no mu 
ada hɔ fann na wobɛka wo nsɛm no ntiantia ama emu nteaseɛ no ada hɔ pefee. Yei 
bɛma ɔpanin a wode krataa no bɛma no no ate wo nsɛm no ase yie na ɔno nso atumi

ATIPƐNFOƆ KRATAATWERƐ
Atipɛnfoɔ krataatwerɛ yɛ krataa a yɛtwerɛ kɔma yɛn nnamfonom anaa yɛn abusuafoɔ 
ka deɛ ɛrekɔ so wɔ yɛn abrabɔ mu ho nsɛm kyerɛ wɔn na afei nso yɛsan fa so kyea 
wɔn. Yɛtwerɛ atipɛnfoɔ krataa kɔma onipa a ɔfiri yɛn abusua mu, onipa bi a ɔbɛn yɛn 
anaa yɛn adamfo.
Ɛkwan a yɛfa so twerɛ atipɛnfoɔ krataa.
1. Twerɛ ɔtwerɛfoɔ adrɛɛse/akyirikwan no wɔ kratafa no soro nifa twea so.
2. Twerɛ ɛda/deeti no wɔ nsensaneeɛ a ɛwɔ adrɛɛse/akyirikwan no aseɛ no so.
3. Twerɛ nkyea a ɛdi kan a mpɛn pii no, ɛyɛ mmrane/ɛfene bi a mode frɛ mo ho no, 
sɛ ebia, Obolo, Ogyam, Kelewa, Kalawu, Trapana, Omoski anaa wo din mu koro 
pɛ ne deɛ ɛkeka ho, no wɔ nsensaneeɛ a ɛtɔ no so wɔ wo nsa benkum soɔ no so na 
fa nsanhɔ toa so.
4. Twerɛ nnianimu tiawa bi a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ sɛnti a woretwerɛ saa krataa no mu.
5. Twerɛ kasapɛn ahodoɔ a ɛyɛ krataa no ankasa (esinianim) no.
6. Twerɛ awieeɛ kasamu anaa kasapɛn no. Afei, twerɛ nkyea a ɛdi akyire no sɛ ebia, 
Ɛyɛ me, Ɛyɛ wo yɔnko berɛboɔ, Ɛyɛ w’adamfo, Ɛyɛ wo dɔfo, Ɛyɛ, ne deɛ ɛkeka ho 
na fa nsanhɔ toa so. Afei, bra nsensaneeɛ a ɛtoa soɔ no so na bɛtwerɛ wo din a ɛno 
nso, ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ mmrane/ɛfene anaasɛ wo din mu koro pɛ, sɛ ebia Kwame, Ogyam, 
Abele, Sikelewu, Abenaa, Safo, Mmeranteɛhene, Hyabo, Haa ne deɛ ɛkeka ho.

Atipɛnfoɔ Krataatwerɛ Su
Deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi nom ne atipɛnfoɔ krataatwerɛ su:
1. Ɔtwerɛfoɔ Adrɛɛse: W’adrɛɛse na ɛsɛ sɛ wodi kan twerɛ wɔ krataatwerɛ biara 
mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ wotwerɛ adrɛɛse no wɔ kratafa no soro nifa twea so. Ɛno na yɛde fiti 
krataatwerɛ ase. Ɛho hia sɛ wotwerɛ w’adrɛɛse na sɛ wowɔ nɔmma sononko anaa 
koodu bi nso a, wotwerɛ ka ho.
2. Ɛda/Deeti: Ɛsɛ sɛ wotwerɛ deeti no wɔ adrɛɛse no ase. Deeti no bɛtumi ayɛ ɛda a 
woretwerɛ krataa no deeti ankasa anaasɛ ɛda a atwam bi deeti na mmom ɛnyɛ ɛda 
a ɛnnya mmaeɛ deeti.
3. Nkyea a ɛdi kan: Ɛsɛ sɛ nkyea a ɛdi kan no yɛ mmrane/ɛfene anaa wo din koro 
pɛ sɛ ebia, Safo, Daakyehene, Daakyehemmaa, Aberanteɛ, Tumiwura, Kwaku, 
Abenaa, ne deɛ ɛkeka ho.
4. Nnianimu; Yɛhunu ɛnne a ɔtwerɛfoɔ no de rekasa wɔ ne krataatwerɛ no mu wɔ 
nnianimu kasapɛn yi mu. Wobɛtumi de onipa a krataa no rekɔ ne hɔ no apɔmuden 
ho nsɛmmisa ahyɛ wo krataatwerɛ no ase. Wobɛtumi asan aka sɛ, wowɔ gyidie 
sɛ, wɔn nsa bɛka krataa no asomdwoeɛ mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ wode nserehehe, serewa anaa 
anigyesɛm bi fiti wo nsɛm no ase.
5. Krataa no ankasa (esinianim): Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛnne a ɛwɔ krataa no mu nsɛm no mu no 
nyinaa yɛ anigyesɛm. Mmom, nsɛmfua a ɔtwerɛfoɔ no de bɛdi dwuma wɔ n’atwerɛ 
no mu gyina deɛ ɔretwerɛ krataa no akɔma no no so. Wobɛtumi de nsɛngorɔ anaa 
serewatoɔ adi dwuma wɔ berɛ a woretwerɛ krataa no akɔma w’adamfo bi. Sɛ 
woretwerɛ krataa no akɔma w’abusuani bi a ɔyɛ panin kyɛn wo a, bɔ mmɔden 
sɛ wobɛte serewatosɛm no so kakra esiane sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ enidie kakra bi ba wo ne ne 
nkitahodie no mu.
6. Awieeɛ: Bɔ wo nsɛm a woatwerɛ wɔ wo krataa no mu no nyinaa tɔfa wɔ kasapɛn 
baako mu wɔ ha. Ɛne onipa a woretwerɛ krataa no akɔma no no nni nkra wɔ 
anigyeɛ mu. Afei, mma wo werɛ mfiri sɛ, wobɛka akyerɛ onipa a wo krataa no 
rekɔ ne hɔ no sɛ ɛyɛ a, ɔmmɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛma wo wo krataa no ho mmuaeɛ. Yei 
ma onipa a krataa no rekɔ ne hɔ no hunu sɛ, wopɛ sɛ mo nkɔmmɔdie no toa soɔ.
7. Wobɛtumi de kasasin a ɛdidi soɔ yi mu bi awie wo tipɛnfoɔ krataatwerɛ no:
a. Ɛyɛ a hwɛ wo ho so yie
b. Ɛnsi wo yie
c. Onyame nka yɛn ho
d. Mekyea wo pii
e. Mekae wo ɛberɛ biara
f. Ɛyɛ a yɛ ahwɛyie
g. Meda wo ase papaapa
Hyɛ no nso sɛ, atipɛnfoɔ krataatwerɛ mu no, wotumi yi nkorodaa anaasɛ wotumi to 
serewa wom a ɛho nhia sɛ wobɛda obuo suban biara adi wɔ mu. Yɛtwerɛ saa krataa yi 
kɔma nnipa bi a yɛnim wɔn pa ara te sɛ yɛn nnamfonom ne yɛn abusuafoɔ. Ɛnam yei

Dwumadie 5.12 Atipɛnfoɔ Krataatwerɛ
Ekuo biara mfa kasapɛn mmiɛnsa (3) ntwerɛ krataa nkɔma mo adamfo na monka 
afoofida bi a modiiɛ ho asɛm nkyerɛ no. Monka krataa a moatwerɛ no ho asɛm, ne

ƆKASA ASEKYERƐ
Ɔkasa asekyerɛ ne sɛ worekyerɛ ɔkasa bi ase akɔ ɔkasa foforɔ bi mu wɔ atwerɛ kwan 
so. Ɔkasa a abasɛm a worekyerɛ aseɛ no wom no na yɛfrɛ no Nkyerɛasefiri kasa ɛnna 
ɔkasa a worekyerɛ abasɛm bi ase akɔ mu no nso yɛfrɛ no Nkyerɛasekɔ kasa. Nhwɛsoɔ: 
Sɛ abasɛm bi wɔ Asante Twi kasa mu na wokyerɛ aseɛ kɔ Borɔfo kasa mu a, Asante 
Twi kasa no yɛ Nkyerɛasefiri kasa ɛnna Borɔfo kasa no yɛ Nkyerɛasekɔ kasa. Bio, 
wokyerɛ abasɛm a ɛwɔ French kasa mu ase kɔ Asante Twi kasa mu a, French kasa no 
yɛ Nkyerɛasefiri kasa ɛnna Asante Twi kasa no yɛ Nkyerɛasekɔ kasa.
Ɛkwan a yɛfa so kyerɛ ɔkasa ase wɔ atwerɛ 
kwan so
Ɔkasa asekyerɛ wɔ atwerɛ-kwan-so kyerɛ hia akwanhodoɔ a ɛbɛma adesuafoɔ anya 
mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu, nteaseɛ ne ɛkwan a yɛfa so de abasɛm bi firi kasa baako mu kɔ 
foforɔ mu ho nimdeɛ. Deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi ne akwanhodoɔ a yɛfa so kyerɛ ɔkasa bi ase kɔ 
foforɔ mu wɔ atwerɛ kwan so:
1. Nya ɔkasa asekyerɛ fapem; sua nsonsonoeɛ a ɛda ɔkasa asekyerɛ wɔ atwerɛ kwan 
so ne anokasa asekyerɛ ntam, ne nnipakuo a abasɛm no fa wɔn ho amammerɛ ne 
wɔn amanneɛ so mfasoɔ.
2. Nya akenkan ho nimdeɛ: Bɔ mmɔden hwɛ sɛ wobɛtumi akenkan ate Nkyerɛasefiri 
kasa a wɔbɛkenkan no ase yie.
3. Pɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm abasɛm mu: Sua abasɛm/twerɛsɛm ahodoɔ, ɛnne a ɛwɔ abasɛm 
no mu, abasɛm no botaeɛ ne abasɛm no atiefoɔ.

Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa  5
4. Fa w’adwene si akwan ahodoɔ a wɔfa so kyerɛ ɔkasa ase no so: Sua akwan ahodoɔ 
te sɛ deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi:
a.   Asekyerɛtraa ne Asekyerɛ a ɛnni mmara ketee so
b.  Asekyerɛ a ɛgyina amammerɛ ne amanneɛ so
c. Asekyerɛ a ɛgyina nteaseɛ so
d. Nsɛmfua a ɛne nsɛmfua foforɔ tumi nante bom
5. Fa ɔkasa asekyerɛ dwumadie sɔ wo ho hwɛ: Fa abasɛm a ɛnyɛ den hyɛ aseɛ na 
afei, fa deɛ emu yɛ den kakra na akyire yi no, woafa abasɛm a emu pi de asɔ wo 
ho ahwɛ.
6. Fa w’adwen si nkyerɛsefann ne ɔkasa asekyerɛ mu nokorɛdie so: Ma w’ani 
nkɔ nteaseɛ pɔtee a ɛwɔ abasɛm no mu so na yi asekyerɛtraa akwa.
7. Fa kɔmputa ne ɛho akadeɛ di dwuma: Fa kɔmputa so akadeɛ a yɛde kyerɛ ɔkasa 
ase, nwoma ahodoɔ a nsɛmfua asekyerɛ wom ne abɛɛfo ntontan so akadeɛ ahodoɔ 
di dwuma mma ɛmmoa wo mma wonte dwuma a woredie no ase yie. Yei mu no, 
ɛsɛ sɛ wohunu ɛkwan a wobɛfa so de saa akadeɛ no nyinaa adi dwuma na mmom, 
ɛnyɛ sɛ wobɛkɔ akɔhwehwɛ saa akadeɛ no kwa-ara-kwa.
8. Monkenkan mo-ho-mo-ho dwumadie mu na momma ho mmuaeɛ: Monkenkan 
mo yɔnko dwumadie mu na monka mfomsoɔ a mobɛhunu ho asɛm nkyerɛ wɔn a 
ɛyɛ wɔn dea no.
9. Yɛ dwumadie a emi pi: Fa abasɛm dwumadie a ɛfa nnwuma pɔtee bi te sɛ 
mmarasɛm, apɔmuden anaa nsaanodwuma ho na kyerɛ aseɛ kɔ Asante Twi mu na 
ɛmmoa wo mma wonkwadare wɔ ɔkasa asekyerɛ mu.
10. Monkɔ so nsua ɔkasa asekyerɛ: Monka mo ho mmom nyɛ ɔkasa asekyerɛ ho 
dwumadie mpɛn pii sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛboa mo ama moanya ɔkasa asekyerɛ ho 
nimdeɛ amapa.
Ɔkasa asekyerɛ ahodoɔ
Ɔkasa asekyerɛ gu ahodoɔ bebree na emu bi ne deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi:
1. Asekyerɛ a ɛgyina nsɛmfua nteaseɛ soɔ; Yei yɛ ɔkasa asekyerɛ a ɛde nsɛmfua 
mmaako mmaako a ɛwɔ abasɛm no mu no nteaseɛ nko ara na ɛto dwa na mmom, 
ɛnnyina abasɛm no nyinaa mu nteaseɛ so.
2. Ɔkasa Asekyerɛ a ɛnni mmara ketee so: Yei yɛ ɔkasa asekyerɛ a ɛyɛ korɔgyee, na 
ɛka abasɛm no sɛdeɛ nnipakuo a ɛfa wɔn ho no amammerɛ ne wɔn amanneɛ si teɛ 
na afei nso ɛde abasɛm no mu nteaseɛ turodoo ne ɔkasafoɔ no ɛnne to dwa.
3. Ɔkasa asekyerɛ a ɛgyina amammerɛ ne amanneɛ so: Yei yɛ ɔkasa asekyerɛ a ɛgye 
nnipakuo biara amammerɛ ne wɔn amanneɛ mu nsonsonoeɛ ahodoɔ tom.
4. Ɔkasa asekyerɛ a ɛdi nhyehyɛeɛ pɔtee bi so: Saa ɔkasa asekyerɛ yi mu no, ɔkasa 
asekyerɛfoɔ no hwɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a nkyerɛasefiri kasa no wom di so pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ 
nkyerɛasekɔ kasa no mu.
5. Anokasa asekyerɛ: Yei yɛ ɔkasa asekyerɛ a wɔde ano ne ano na ɛyɛ. Wɔde saa 
ɔkasa asekyerɛ yi di dwuma wɔ nhyiamu ase, asɔredan mu ne asɛnniiɛ/kɔɔto.

6. Ɔkasa Asekyerɛ a yɛto mu nkyene: Saa ɔkasa asekyerɛ yi mu no, nkyerɛasefoɔ 
no tumi de n’ankasa nsɛm tetɛ asɛm pɔtee a ɔrekyerɛ aseɛ no ho ma mpo asɛm 
pɔtee no nteaseɛ, ɛnne ne ne botaeɛ nyinaa yera. Saa ɔkasa asekyerɛ yi mu no, 
nkyerɛasefoɔ no tumi yi nsɛm no bi firi mu ɛnna ɔtumi nso de ebi feafea ho to mu 
nkyene.
7. Ɔkasa Asekyerɛ a ɛgyina nteaseɛ soɔ: Saa ɔkasa asekyerɛ yi mu no, nkyerɛasefoɔ 
no kenkan abasɛm no nyinaa te aseɛ yie na wakyerɛ aseɛ fann. Yei mu no, 
nkyerɛasefoɔ no hwɛ beaeɛ korɔ a abasɛm fa ho, abasɛm no botaeɛ, n’atiefoɔ, 
nneɛma a ɛyɛ sononko ne deɛ ɛsesɛ nyinaa ansa na ɔde ne asekyerɛ no ato dwa.
Ɔkasa asekyerɛ dwumadie
Fa ɔkasa asekyerɛ dwumadie ahodoɔ a ɛdidi soɔ yi sɔ wo ho hwɛ:
1. Ɔkasamu tiawa; Kyerɛ ɔkasamu tiawa bi ase kɔ Asante Twi kasa mu fann.
2. Kasakoa: Sua sɛdeɛ yɛsi kyerɛ kasakoa, tetesɛm ne adeyɛ ntoasoɔ ase.
3. Kasapɛn ntiantia: Kyerɛ kasapɛn ntiantia ase na hwɛ sɛ wode emu nteaseɛ pɔtee 
no bɛto dwa.
4. Abasɛm a ɛfa adwuma pɔtee bi ho: Kyerɛ abasɛm a ɛfa adwuma pɔtee bi te sɛ 
mmarasɛm, ayaresa ne nsaanodwuma ho ase na hwɛ sɛ wode nsɛmfua pɔtee a 
wɔde di dwuma wɔ saa nnwuma no mu bɛdi dwuma.
5. Abasɛm traa: Kyerɛ kasadwini mu nsɛm te sɛ anwonsɛm, abasɛm tiawa ne deɛ 
ɛkeka ho ase na hwɛ sɛ wobɛda ɛnne, nhyehyɛeɛ ne sononkonneɛ a ɛwom no 
nyinaa adi wɔ wo asekyerɛ no mu.
6. Kaseɛbɔ mu nsɛm: Kyerɛ kaseɛbɔ mu nsɛm ase na fa sua ɛkwan a wobɛfa so de 
nokwasɛm ne ɛnne a ɛwɔ nsɛm no mu ato dwa.
7. Nkɔmmɔdie: Kyerɛ baanunkɔmmɔ (s.e. nkɔmmɔdie ahodoɔ, ano-ne-ano-dwumadie) 
ase na fa sua ɛkwan a wobɛfa so de ɔkasafoɔ bi adwempɔ ne ɛnne a ɔde kasa no 
ato dwa.
8. Ntotoho kasa asekyerɛ: Fa wo nkyerɛasesɛm toto afoforɔ deɛ ho (s.e., fa ɔkasa 
asekyerɛ a animdefoɔ ato wɔn bo ase ayɛ ne ɔkasa asekyerɛ a afidie na ayɛ toto ho 
na gyina deɛ wobɛhunu no so yɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ wo kasa asekyerɛ nimdeɛ mu.
9. Ankasa ho kasa asekyerɛ: W’ankasa twerɛ abasɛm bi wɔ kasa bi mu na kyerɛ aseɛ 
kɔ ɔkasa foforɔ bi mu na fa sua kasa korɔgyee ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ wɔ ɔkasa asekyerɛ mu.
10. Atipɛnfoɔ nsamuyɛ: Ɛne wo yɔnko nsesa mo kasa asekyerɛ dwumadie na obiara 
nkenkan ne yɔnko deɛ mu na ɔnka mfomsoɔ a ɔbɛhunu wɔ mu na montoatoa 
adwen wɔ ho mfa ntrɛ mo kasa asekyerɛ nimdeɛnya mu.

The Environment
In our modern world, there are many factors that place the wellbeing of the planet 
in jeopardy. While some people have the opinion that environmental problems are 
just a natural occurrence, others believe that human beings have a huge impact 
on the environment. Regardless of your viewpoint, take into consideration the 
following factors that place our environment as well as the planet Earth in danger.
Global warming or climate change is a major contributing factor to environmental 
damage. Because of global warming, we have seen an increase in melting ice caps, 
a rise in sea levels, and the formation of new weather patterns. These weather 
patterns have caused stronger storms, droughts, and flooding in places that they 
formerly did not occur.
Air pollution is primarily caused as a result of excessive and unregulated emissions 
of carbon dioxide into the air. Pollutants mostly emerge from the burning of fossil 
fuels in addition to chemicals, toxic substances, and improper waste disposal. 
Air pollutants are absorbed into the atmosphere, and they can cause smog, a 
combination of smoke and fog, in valleys as well as produce acidic precipitation in 
areas far away from the pollution source.
In many areas, people and local governments do not sustainably use their natural 
resources. Mining for natural gases, deforestation, and even improper use of water 
resources can have tremendous effects on the environment. While these strategies 
often attempt to boost local economies, their effects can lead to oil spills, interrupted 
animal habitats, and droughts.
Ultimately, the effects of the modern world on the environment can lead to many 
problems. Human beings need to consider the repercussions of their actions, trying to 
reduce, reuse, and recycle materials while establishing environmentally sustainable 
habits. If measures are not taken to protect the environment, we can potentially 
witness the extinction of more endangered species, worldwide pollution, and a 
completely uninhabitable planet

AMAMMERƐ, AMANNEƐ NE AMAMMUO
Amammerɛ ne Amanneɛ
NNIANIMU
Saa ɔfa yi kasa fa awareɛ ne ɛkwan a yɛfa so gye awareɛ ho. Ɔfa yi kyerɛ Akanfoɔ 
awareɛ ase san kyerɛkyerɛ amanneɛ ahodoɔ a wɔyɛ wɔ ɛberɛ a wɔregye awareɛ mu. 
Awareɛ ahodoɔ ne ɛso mfasoɔ nso da adi wɔ ɔfa yi mu. Ɔfa bɛsan ada akwan ahodoɔ a 
wɔfa so gye awareɛ wɔ Akanman mu adi akyerɛ wo. Nimdeɛ a wobɛnya afiri saa ɔfa yi 
mu bɛboa ama woate awareɛ ase wɔ w’amammerɛ ne afoforɔ nso deɛ mu. Mobɛtoatoa 
adwen afa sɛdeɛ nnipakuo bi si gye awareɛ ne nsakraeɛ a aba mu, ne nsunsuansoɔ a 
nsakraeɛ no anya wɔ awaregyeɛ soɔ no ho. Nimdeɛ kakra a wobɛnya afa nnipakuo 
afoforɔ awareɛ ne wɔn awaregyeɛ ho no bɛboa ama moate mo-ho-mo-ho ase yie. 
Wobɛhunu mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ so sɛ yɛbɔ yɛn amammerɛ ne amanneɛ ho ban.
ADWEMPƆ
• Awareɛ yɛ nkabom a ɛda ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ntam.
• Awaregyeɛ yɛ amanneɛ a nnipakuo bi gyina wɔn gyidie, wɔn nnepa ne wɔn nhyehyɛeɛ 
ahodoɔ so yɛ de ka ɔbarima ne ɔbaa bi bom sɛ awarefoɔ.
• Awareɛ ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa na ɛwɔ Ghanaman mu ha. Yeinom ne Efie Awareɛ, Kɔɔto 
Awareɛ ne Nkramofoɔ Awareɛ.
• Nnipa ahofadie ne wɔn bɔbea pɛpɛyɛ, Nwomasua, Ɛsom mu nkyerɛkyerɛ, Mmarasɛm 
mu nsakraeɛ, Akwantuo ne deɛ ɛkeka ho anya nsunsuansoɔ wɔ awaregyeɛ so.
• Yɛbɛtumi afa Sankɔfa, Mpanin ne Nkyirimma nkitahodie so asi nsunsuansoɔ a 
nsakraeɛ a aba no anya wɔ yɛn awaregyeɛ soɔ no ano. Afei nso, ɛsɛ sɛ yɛtumi si 
ɔhyɛ a ɛfiri yɛn abusuafoɔ hɔ ba yɛn soɔ, yɛn sikasɛm ho adwendwen ne nsɛm a 
nnamfonom nso ka fa yɛn ho ho ateetee, abooboo, ɔhaw ne ho adwendwene a 
ɛbɛtumi anya nsunsuansoɔ bɔne wɔ w’awareɛ soɔ nyinaa ano.

Ɛdeɛn ne awareɛ?
Awareɛ ne sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa bi ka bom tena sɛ okunu ne ɔyere wɔ amammerɛ kwan 
so. Ɛyɛ nkabom a ɛda nnipa baanu (ɔbarima ne ɔbaa) ntam a yɛgye tom wɔ amammerɛ 
ne amanneɛ kwan so. Ɛma ɔbarima ne ɔbaa no hunu deɛ wɔn mu biara ahofadie ne 
wɔn asɛdeɛ ano kɔpem. Ɛyɛ kɔntraagye a ɛda ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ntam sɛ wɔbɛka wɔn ho 
abom atena sɛ okunu ne ɔyere wɔ amammerɛ kwan so. Ɛsɛ sɛ mmusuakuo mmienu no 
pene awareɛ no so ansa na atumi adi mu.

Awaregyeɛ
Awaregyeɛ yɛ edwa a wɔbɔ yɛ amanneɛ gye ɔbarima ne ɔbaa bi tom sɛ okunu ne 
ɔyere. Akanman mu no, ɛnyɛ nnipa baanu a wɔreware no nko ara na yɛhunu wɔn wɔ 
saa dwabɔ yi ase na mmom, ɔbarima abusuafoɔ ne ɔbaa no nso abusuafoɔ nyinaa ba 
adwabɔ yi ase bi. Nnipakuo biara nko ne sɛdeɛ wɔsi bɔ saa edwa yi ne amanneɛ a 
wɔyɛ wɔ hɔ.
Ɛpono 6.2
Nnipa a wɔwɔ mfoni no mu no yɛ abusuafoɔ bi a wɔde wɔn babaa rema awareɛ. Bio, 
ɔbarima a ɔrebɛyɛ okunu no na wabu nkotodwe wɔ ɔbaa a ɔrebɛyɛ ɔyere no anim no. 
Ɔbaa a ɔrebɛyɛ ɔyere no na wafa ne ho amammerɛ kwan soɔ no. Ɔbarima a ɔrebɛyɛ 
okunu no na ɔhyɛ atadeɛ fitaa a nkapo gu ne nsa ne ne kɔn mu no. Mpanimfoɔ no nso 
afa wɔn ho wɔ amammerɛ kwan so.

no mu tom wɔ abusua no mu sɛ adehyeɛ, ɛde ayɔnkofa ba, ɛka abusua ne abusua bom,

Wɔn nyinaa ani gye na ɛnam so ma wɔhunu wɔn-ho-wɔn-ho yie. Awareɛ a ɛkɔ so

de asomdwoeɛ ne nkabom ba saa nnipakuo no ntam na ɛma ɔmanmu no nyinaa 
nya saa asomdwoeɛ ne nkabom no so mfasoɔ.
6. Awareɛ ma mmusuakuo ne amansan gye awareɛ no mu nkwadaa tom. Awareɛ 
ma mma a wɔfiri mu ba no hunu sɛ wɔfra ɛdɔm mu na ɛsan nso ma wɔn kwan ma 
wɔdi adeɛ (akonnwa) wɔ wɔn abusua mu. Deɛ ɛtɔ so bio ne sɛ, ɛnam awareɛ so ma 
mma to ana hunu wɔn nkyi.
7. Ayɔnkofa: Awareɛ de ayɔnkofa ba nnipa ntam. Ɛma awarefoɔ no nya mmoa wɔ 
abateteɛ ne sikasɛm mu. Awareɛ ma kwan ma awarefoɔ no ne wɔn-ho-wɔn-ho da. 
Awarefoɔ no gye wɔn ani san di awerɛhoɔ bom.
8. Ɛma abusua ase tim:  Awareɛ ma ho kwan ma nkwadaa bɛka abusua no ho a 
ɛnam so ma abusua no kɔ so wɔ hɔ da biara a wɔn ase nhye da. Awareɛ ma nnipa 
foforɔ nam amammerɛ kwan so ba abusua mu a nnipa a wɔwɔ abusua no mu dada 
no gye wɔn tom sɛ wɔn abusuafoɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Akanfoɔ nnye nkwadaa a wɔn awofoɔ 
amfa awareɛ kwan so na ɛwoo wɔn no ntom sɛ abusua no mu adehyeɛ.
Dwumadie 6.2 Awareɛ ahodoɔ
Ekuo biara ntoatoa adwen mfa awareɛ ahodoɔ a moahunu wɔ mo kurom ho na 
monka mo mmuaeɛ no nkyerɛ ekuo foforɔ mu adesuafoɔ.

Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa  6
Awaregyeɛ no anim
Akanman mu no (Asante), ɛyɛ agya na ɔware ma ne babarima. Mmusuakuo mmienu 
a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔware wɔn ho no mu nnipa yɛ nhwehwɛmu amapa wɔ wɔn mu biara 
abusua mu ansa na sɛ awareɛ no bɛtumi aba so a, aba so. Wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu hunu sɛ, 
asomdwoeɛ wɔ efie a wɔrekɔwura mu no mu ansa na wɔama wɔn aware. Mpɛn pii no, 
wɔhwɛ sɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ saa mmusuakuo no mu ne titire efie pɔtee a wɔrekɔ mu no mu 
nnipa dɔ nnipa, te nnipa ase san de obuo ma nnipa nso. Akanfoɔ san yɛ nhwehwɛmu 
hunu sɛ, nnipa baanu a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔware no mfiri mogyakorɔ anaa mfiri abusua baako 
mu. Wɔsan hwehwɛ mmusuakuo no mu hunu sɛ, nsaneyareɛ biara nni nnipa no mu 
biara so sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔmfa nsane mma a wɔbɛwo wɔn no. Wɔhwɛ sɛ nyarewa bi te 
sɛ nsamanwa, kwata, etwirɛ ne deɛ ɛkeka ho biara nni mmusuakuo no mu biara mu. 
Akanfoɔ san hwehwɛ abusua a emu nnipa da subanpa adi. Wɔkyiri subammɔne bi te 
sɛ nsanom mmorosoɔ, korɔnobɔ, pɛpɛɛ ne akwadworɔ na mmom wɔpɛ subanpa bi te 
sɛ ayamyɛ, adwumaden, ahofama, nokorɛdie ne deɛ ɛkeka ho.
Awaregyeɛ no mu
Sɛ ɔbarima no ne ɔbaa no gye tom sɛ wɔbɛware a, wɔhyɛ ɛda a wɔbɛwareɛ no. Ɔbarima 
no nya boasetɔ yɛ ahoboa twɛn kɔsi sɛ ɛda no bɛso ama no aware ɔbaa no. Tete hɔ no, 
na Memeneda ne Ɛdwoada na Akanfoɔ gye awareɛ ɛfiri sɛ, yɛgye di sɛ, asomdwoeɛ wɔ 
saa nna yi mmienu mu. Nneɛma ahodoɔ a wɔde kyɛ wɔ awaregyeɛ ase no mu dodoɔ 
no ara taa yɛ sika ne anonneɛ. Nneɛma ahodoɔ a wɔgye wɔ awareɛ mu no bi na ɛdidi 
soɔ yi:
Nhunuanimu-nsa/kɔkɔɔkɔ/ɛpono-akyi-bɔ: Yei yɛ nsa a ɔbarima no abusuafoɔ de 
kɔma ɔbaa no papa ma wɔgyina so hyɛ ɛda a wɔde bɛyɛ ɔbaa no ho adeɛ. Mpɛn pii no, 
na saa nhuɛtaa yɛ Hyenaapo pantufa ne sika ketewa bi. Saa amanneɛ yi ma ɔbarima 
no kwan ma ɔtumi kɔsra ɔbaa no wɔ berɛ a obiara ntumi mmisa no hwee. Nokorɛm, 
ɛha yi na ɔbarima no kɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔware ɔbaa no.
Tiri-Nsa: Tete hɔ no, na ɛyɛ sika ne Hyenaapo. Saa nsa yi na ɛyɛ adansedideɛ a ɛkyerɛ 
sɛ, ɔbarima no aware ɔbaa no.
Tiri-adeɛ: Yei yɛ sika a ɔbarima no abusuafoɔ de bɔ ɔbaa no dwetire anaa de tua ɛka 
bi a ɛda ɔbaa no abusua no mu anaa de tɔ asase ma ɔbaa no anaa de yɛ agyapadeɛ bi 
wɔ ɔbaa no abusua mu.
Akontagye-sekan: Yei yɛ sika a ɔbarima no tua ma ɔbaa no nuammarimanom 
(nkontagyenom) sɛ wɔabɔ ɔbaa no ho ban akɔsi sɛ ɔreware na afei nso wɔbɛkɔ so abɔ 
ne ho ban wɔ n’awareɛ no akyi. Mpɛn pii no, ɛyɛ ɔbaa no nuabarima na ɔka sika dodoɔ 
a wɔbɛgye sɛ akontagye-sekan.
Danta: Yei yɛ mpatasika a ɔbarima no tua ma ɔbaa no papa wɔ kɛtɛ a ɔtɔ maa ne 
babaa no daa so wɔ ne nkwadaaberɛ mu no ho. Mpɛn pii no, ɛyɛ ɔbaa no papa na ɔka 
sika dodoɔ a ɔbɛgyeɛ.
Ase-kɛtɛ anaa tamboba: Yei yɛ sika a ɔbarima no tua ma ɔbaa no maame .
Awaregyeɛ no akyi
Wɔayɛ amanneɛ ahodoɔ nyinaa awie no na wɔde akyɛdeɛ ahodoɔ te sɛ anonneɛ ne 
sika ama awie no, wɔde afotusɛm amapa ma awarefoɔ no. Afanu no mu biara tu nnipa 
bi si hɔ sɛ afotufoɔ a awarefoɔ no bɛkɔ wɔn hɔ akɔgye awareɛ mu afotuo wɔ berɛ a 
wɔhia biribi saa.

Awareɛ ne sɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa bi kabom tena sɛ okunu ne ɔyere wɔ amammerɛ kwan 
so. Mpɛn pii no, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa na wɔware. Ghanaman mu ha no, ɛnyɛ ɔbarima ne 
ɔbaa no nko ara na wɔware na mmom, wɔn mmusuakuo a wɔfiri mu no mu nnipa 
ne wɔn nnamfonom nyinaa nso ka awareɛ no ho bi. Ɛnam yei nti, amammerɛ mu 
no, yɛhwehwɛ sɛ, nnipa a wɔwɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa no mmusuakuo mu no taa kɔsra 
awarefoɔ no na wɔkyekyɛ wɔn-ho-wɔn-ho adeɛ.
Awaregyeɛ
Awaregyeɛ yɛ edwa a wɔbɔ yɛ amanneɛ gye ɔbarima ne ɔbaa bi tom sɛ okunu ne 
ɔyere. Abusuakuo, ɔsom ahodoɔ ne nkuro ahodoɔ no mu biara wɔ ɛkwan a wɔfa so 
gye awareɛ ma ɛda wɔn gyidie ne wɔn amammerɛ adi.
Nnipakuo ahodoɔ bebree na wɔwɔ Ghanaman mu ha. Nnipakuo no mu biara nko ne ɛkwan 
a wɔfa fo gye awareɛ. Deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi kasa fa ɛkwan a nnipakuo no mu bi fa so gye awareɛ 
ho. Kuro biara nso mu nnipa wɔ wɔn ɛkwan a wɔfa so gye awareɛ.
Nkranfoɔ awaregyeɛ
Nkranman mu no, sɛ mmusuakuo mmienu bi pene so sɛ wɔde wɔn babarima ne ɔbabaa 
bɛma awareɛ a, wɔka sɛ saa nnipa (ɔbarima no ne ɔbaa no) aware. Nkranfoɔ gye 
abɛɛfo awaregyeɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛda adi wɔ Kristosom ne Nkramosom mu no tom. 
Ɔbarima a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔware anaa agya bi a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔware ma ne babarima di kan hwehwɛ 
ɔbaa a ɔpɛ no . Nkranfoɔ awareɛ ahodoɔ no mu bi na ɛdidi soɔ yi:
a. Musunɔtswaa (Asiwa): Sɛ ɔbaa bi nyinsɛn na sɛ ɔfiri abusua a wɔn nsam wɔ bi mu 
a, ɔbarima no abusuafoɔ soma ma wɔkɔ ɔbaa no abusuafoɔ hɔ kɔsrɛ akwadaa a 
wɔnya nwoo no no awareɛ sɛ ɔyɛ abaayewa anaasɛ abarimaa ketewa bi wɔ abusua 
no mu.
b. Henɔbaatsɛɛ (Ɔbaa no abusua awaresrɛ): Sɛ ɔbaa no abusuafoɔ hunu abarimaa bi 
a ɔfiri abusua a wɔwɔ subanpa mu a, ɔbaa no abusuafoɔ kɔsrɛ abusua a abarimaa 
no firi mu no sɛ, sɛ abarimaa no nyini a, wɔmma no mmɛware wɔn babaa no. Sɛ 
abarimaa no abusuafoɔ no pene so a, abarimaa no abusuafoɔ hwɛ abaayewa no 
kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛnyini na wɔawareɛ.

sɛ wɔbɛma wɔn babarima ne wɔn babaa aware. Ɛduru berɛ bi a, ɔbarima no 
nuammaanom anaa ne maame na ɛdi saa nkitaho yi ma babarima no.

Sɛdeɛ ɛsi teɛ wɔ Akanman mu no, Fantefoɔ mu nso, ɛyɛ agya na ɔware ma ne babarima. 
Sɛ agya bi hunu sɛ, ne babarima aduru ne mpanin mfeɛ so a, ɔtɔ etuo ma no de yɛ ha. 
Bio, ɔma no asase yɛ so afuo. Sɛ agya bi yɛ yeinom ma ne babarima a na ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔpɛ

5. Tsinsa/dase: Yei yɛ Hyenaapo ne sika. Yei na ɛyɛ adansedideɛ amapa wɔ awaregyeɛ 
no mu. Sɛ abarimaa no ne n’abusuafoɔ yɛ amanneɛ a ɛfa awareɛ no nyinaa na sɛ 
wɔgya tsinsa, wom a, awareɛ no nnya nnwiee pɛyɛ. Tsinsa no na ɛdi awareɛ no ho 
danseɛ ɛnam saa nti wɔde sie.
6. Tsir adze: Yei yɛ sika a wɔgye firi ɔbarima no hɔ de bɔ abaayewa no dwetire. 
Wɔgye di sɛ, awareɛ no bɛtumi agu berɛ biara na sɛ ɛkɔba no saa a, saa dwetire 
no na abaayewa no bɛdidi ho. Bio, tete hɔ no, na ɛka da mmusuakuo bi mu nti na 
wɔtumi de saa sika no tua ɛka a ɛda abusua no mu no. Na saa sika no yɛ sikapuduo.
7. Akontan-sekan: Yei yɛ sika a wɔtua ma abaayewa no nuammarima. Ɛyɛ nuammarima 
no ara na wɔka sika a wɔbɛgye. Adwempɔ a ɛtaa saa amanneɛ yi akyi ne sɛ, ɛyɛ 
abaayewa no nuammarima na wɔbɔ ne ho ban firi mmarima foforɔ ho. Ne saa nti, 
ɛsɛ sɛ abarimaa no tumi tɔ akodeɛ bi de ma ne nkontagyenom no na wɔatumi de 
abɔ wɔn nuabaa no ho ban yie ama no.
8. Asafo nsa: Kuromma no nso gye abarimaa no nsa sɛ wɔabɔ abaayewa no ho ban 
ama no anyini a ɔrebɛwareɛ. Saa nsa yi kyerɛ sɛ, abaayewa no aware nti kuromma 
nkaeɛ no mmoa mmɔ ne ho ban mfiri mmarima foforɔ ho.
Sɛ wɔyɛ saa amanneɛ yi nyinaa wie a, wɔbɔ amanneɛ sɛ, ɛfiri saa da no rekorɔ, 
abaayewa no hyɛ saa ɔbarima no nsa wɔ n’ahobammɔ ne biribiara mu. Wɔyi nsenom 
no mu bi si hɔ sɛ awarefoɔ no afotufoɔ ne wɔn aboafoɔ wɔ wɔn awareɛ akwantuo no 
mu. Wɔyi mpaeɛ anaasɛ wɔgu nsa de dwumadie no nyinaa ba awieeɛ.
Akyire yi no, okunu no ma ɔyere no sika kɔtotɔ nneɛma a ɔbɛhia wɔ awareɛ no ase 
na afei nso ɔde bi anoa aduane a ɛdi kan wɔ n’awareɛ no mu. Saa aduane yi na wɔfrɛ 
no ‘edziban kɛse’ anaasɛ ‘nkwansɛn kɛse’. Wɔde saa aduane yi kɔ okunu no papa efie. 
Wɔto nsa frɛ abusuafoɔ, nnamfonom ne adɔfoɔ nyinaa ma wɔbɛdi aduane no bi. Ɛduru 
anadwo a, ɔyere no kɔda nkunkyire. Ɔbaapanin bi na ɔdi abɔfoɔ bi anim de ɔyere no 
kɔ okunu no efie. Ɛhɔ na awareɛ no ankasa fiti aseɛ.
Dagombafoɔ Awaregyeɛ
Akwan ahodoɔ a Dagombafoɔ a wɔwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu no fa so gye awareɛ 
na ɛdidi soɔ yi:
Paɣa laɣibu: Yei yɛ mpenatwe a ɛkɔ so wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa a wɔpɛ sɛ, daakye, 
wɔware no ntam. Ɛduru saa mpɛmpɛnsoɔ yi na sɛ ɔbarima no se ɔbaa no awareɛ ho pɛ 
a, ɔbarima no tua sika bi ma ɔbaa no de hyɛ n’awaresɛm no mu kena. Sɛ ɔbaa no gye 
saa sika no deɛ a, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ wagye atom sɛ ɔbɛware ɔbarima no. Ɛduru ɛberɛ bi a, 
ɔbaa no tumi gye sika no nanso ɔsrɛ ɛberɛ firi ɔbarima no hɔ sɛ ɔrekɔdwene awaresɛm 
no ho na akyire yi no ɔbarima no akɔ bio akɔbisa no sɛ, ɔbɛpene so ama wɔn aware 
anaasɛ ɔrempene so. Ne tɔfabɔ ne sɛ, saa ɛberɛ yi yɛ mpenesoɔ ɛberɛ.
Tibili yoobu: Ɛha na ɔbarima no kɔbɔ kɔkɔɔkɔ na ɔfa so da ne ho adi kyerɛ ɔbaa no 
abusuafoɔ. Ɔbarima a ɔrekɔpɛ ɔbaa no aware no no pa ne tirimpɔ no ne n’ankasa ho 
ntoma kyerɛ ɔbaa no abusuafoɔ. Ɔsan da ne tirimpɔ no adi kyerɛ n’ankasa abusuafoɔ.
Paɣapulugu: Ɔbaa no awofoɔ bobɔ wɔn abusuafoɔ bi din ma ɔbarima no kɔkyeakyea 
wɔn san bɔ wɔn pɛ a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔware wɔn dehyeɛ no ho amanneɛ. Ɔbarima no tua sika 
kakra ma nnipa no mu biara a ɔkɔkyeaa no de hyɛ n’ananteseɛ no mu kena.

Paɣa suhibu: Afei, ɔbarima no hyɛda kɔ ɔbaa no awofoɔ hɔ kɔsrɛ ɔbaa no awareɛ firi

Paɣapini tibur: Ɛha yi no, ɔbaa no awofoɔ no pene so ma ɔbarima no. Saa ɛberɛ yi 
no, ɔbaa no awofoɔ ne n’abusuafoɔ no gye ɔbarima no tom san pene so sɛ wɔde wɔn 
dehyeɛ no bɛma no aware.
Paɣakpuɣibu: Ɔbarima no nnamfonom kɔbɔ ɔbaa no abommo de no kɔ ɔbarima no 
efie a wɔmmɔ ɔbaa no abusuafoɔ no amanneɛ mpo. Wɔde ɔbaa no kɔ ɔbarima no efie 
ma no kɔtena hɔ wɔ ɛberɛ ɔbaa no abusuafoɔ mpo nhunu ho hwee.
Ɛpono  6.3: Dagombani aberanteɛ a ɔrekɔsrɛ ɔbaa awareɛ.
Ɔbarima no abusuapanin ne abusua no mu mpanimfoɔ binom rekɔsrɛ ababaawa bi 
awareɛ.
Sandaani tumbu: Sɛ wɔde ɔbaa no kɔ ɔbarima no efie na adeɛ kye a, ɔbarima no kɔ 
ɔbaa no awofoɔ efie kɔpa wɔne wɔn abusuafoɔ kyɛw sɛ ɔde wɔn dehyeɛ no akɔtena ne 
efie. Ɔbarima no de bese pata ɔbaa no awofoɔ no sɛ wafa wɔn babaa no kɔ.
Saandi niŋbie: Afei, ɔbarima no hyɛda bɔ dwa dataa yɛ amanneɛ de da ɔbaa no adi 
kyerɛ n’abusuafoɔ san fa so de gye ɔbaa no ba ɔbarima no abusua mu.

AWAREƐ NE NSAKRAEƐ A ABA MU
Nsakraeɛ a aba no anya nsunsuansoɔ papa ne nsunsuansoɔ bɔne nyinaa bi wɔ awaregyeɛ 
so na yei ma ɛda adi pefee sɛ, amammerɛ nyini nnipa nso yɛtumi yɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ 
amammerɛ mu. Nneɛma a ɛde saa nsakraeɛ yi aba no mu bi ne deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi.
1. Nwomasua: Nwomasua abue nnipa binom ani ne titire mmaa ama seesei sɛ ɛba 
wɔn awaresɛm mu a, wɔtumi kyerɛ deɛ wɔpɛ ne deɛ wɔmpɛ. Mpɛn pii no, awarefoɔ 
no tumi si gyinaeɛ wɔ sɛdeɛ wɔpɛ sɛ wɔn awareɛ no si yɛ ho. Wɔtumi nso kyerɛ 
deɛ wɔpɛ ne dwumadie ahodoɔ a wɔpɛ sɛ ɛkɔ so wɔ wɔn awareɛ asetena no mu.
2. Nnipa ahofadie ne wɔn bɔbea pɛpɛyɛ: Nnipa ahofadie ne bɔbea pɛpɛyɛ ho nsɛm ne 
ɛho nkyerɛkyerɛ ama nsakraeɛ, bi te sɛ ɔbaa tumi fa agyapadeɛ ne ɔyere adedie, 
aba awareɛ mu.
3. Ɛsom mu nkyerɛkyerɛ: Kristosom ne Nkramosom de amammerɛ ne amanneɛ foforɔ 
aba awaregyeɛ mu a ɛduru berɛ bi a ɛne efie awaregyeɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ bɔ abira.
4. Sikasɛm mu mpontuo: Nnipa binom sikasɛm a akɔ yie ama wɔn nti no, ama wɔanya 
tumi wɔ wɔn hokafoɔ hwehwɛ so. Yei kyerɛ sɛ, wɔn ara nya tumi yi ɔbaa a wɔpɛ 
no ware no po mmaa a wɔmpɛ wɔn.
5. Akwantuo: Nnipa tu kwan kɔ nkuro akɛseɛ mu a, wɔkɔhunu amammerɛ ne amanneɛ 
ahodoɔ wɔ hɔ awaregyeɛ mu na ɛnam so ma wɔn nso pɛ sɛ wɔyɛ saa amanneɛ no 
bi wɔ wɔn efie awaregyeɛ mu.
6. Kɔmputa so nkitahodie: Kɔmputa so nkitahodie ama ɛkwan a nnipa fa so hyia 
wɔn-ho-wɔn-ho, di nkɔmmɔ, kyɛ adwen wɔ nsɛm bi ho ne subanpa ahodoɔ pii 
asesa.
7. Atutena ne Amanhodoɔ so abrabɔ: Akwanhodoɔ a nnipa binom tu kɔ nkuro akɛseɛ, 
nkuro ne amanhodoɔ soɔ no ama nnipa binom asua amammerɛ ne amanneɛ bi a 
ɛne wɔn deɛ bɔ abira.
8. Mmarasɛm mu nsakraeɛ: Nsakraeɛ a wɔayɛ wɔ ɔman mmarasɛm nhyehyɛeɛ mu 
a ɛgye efie awareɛ tom no nso anya nsunsuansoɔ wɔ amammerɛ ne amanneɛ so.

AMAMMERƐ, AMANNEƐ NE AMAMMUO
Akanfoɔ Amammuo
NNIANIMU
Saa ɔfa yi yɛ Abusua ne Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ a yɛkaa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ mo 
wɔ afe a ɛtwaa mu no mu no ntoasoɔ. Saa ɔfa yi bɛma wo ɛkwan ama woadɔ asukɔ 
wɔ Abusua ne Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ ho adesua ne kasakuo ahodoɔ no mu bi 
nso deɛ mu. Wobɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ Akanfoɔ mmusuakuo ahodoɔ no mu ahwehwɛ 
mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ Akanfoɔ mmusuakuo no soɔ na wode atoto mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ mmusuakuo 
nkaeɛ a ɛwɔ Ghanaman yi mu no deɛ ho. Nteaseɛ ne nimdeɛ a wobɛnya wɔ Abusua ne 
Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ ho no ho hia pa ara ɛfiri sɛ ɛbɛma w’adwene mu adɔ 
ama woahunu hia a ɛho hia anaa mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ so sɛ obiara sua Asante Twi ne deɛ 
ɛkeka ho bi te sɛ Religious Studies, Abakɔsɛm ne deɛ ɛkeka ho. Nimdeɛ a wobɛnya no 
bɛma w’ani agye w’abusua ne Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ ne nnipakuo ahodoɔ a 
wɔwɔ Ɔman Kronkron Ghana mu no nso deɛ ho.
ADWEMPƆ
Abusua yɛ ekuo a ne nhyehyɛeɛ no so kyɛn ekuo biara a ɛwɔ kuro bi mu. Ɛkame ayɛ 
sɛ abusua biara wɔ n’akraboa a ɛtumi yɛ adeɛ a nkwa wom anaa deɛ nkwa nni mu sɛ 
n’ahyɛnsodeɛ. Ɔmanhene na ɔda saa mmusuakuo ahodoɔ no nyinaa ano ɛnna ahemfo 
nkumaa no nso deda abusua bi a ɛwɔ nkuro ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ Ɔmanhene no mpasua soɔ 
ano. Asiahene na wɔhwɛ ma wɔsi obi ɔhene ɛnna wɔn korɔ no ara na wɔsan hwɛ ma 
wɔtu ɔhene bi adeɛ soɔ.
ABUSUA
Adesua Ahyɛaseɛ Dwumadie
Bua nsɛmmisa a ɛdidi soɔ yi na fa kaakae nneɛma bi a wosuaa wɔ ɔfa a ɛtwaa 
mu no mu no:
1. Awareɛ titire mmiɛnsa a ɛwɔ Ghanaman yi mu nonom ne deɛ ɛwɔ he?
2. Kyerɛ adeɛ baako a Akanfoɔ hwɛ ansa na wɔapene so ama nnipa baanu bi 
aware wɔn ho?
3. Adɛn nti na ɔbarima a ɔrewareɛ no tua akontagyesekan?
4. Kyerɛ nsakraeɛ ahodoɔ ɛnan (4) a anya nsunsuansoɔ wɔ Akanfoɔ awaregyeɛ 
soɔ.
Nnwennweneho Asɛmmisa: Ekuo biara nnyina nimdeɛ a monyaa faa abusua 
ho wɔ afe a ɛtwaa mu no so na monkyerɛ abusua ase. Monka mo mmuaeɛ no 
nkyerɛ mo afɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ ekuo foforɔ mu no.

ABUSUA NE AKANFOƆ AMAMMUO
Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa  7
Mobɛnya mmuaeɛ bi te sɛ: Abusua yɛ nnipakuo bi a emu nnipa no wɔ amammerɛ 
korɔ, agyapadeɛ korɔ, abakɔsɛm korɔ, kuro korɔ ɛnna wɔfiri ɛna (nanabaa) korɔ 
ase. Abusua tumi yɛ Agya abusuabɔ (abusua a yɛbɔ kɔ agya fam) ɛnna ɛbɛtumi 
nso ayɛ Ɛna abusuabɔ (abusua a yɛbɔ kɔ ɛna fam).
Abusua yɛ ekuo a ne nhyehyɛeɛ no so kyɛn ekuo biara a ɛwɔ kuro bi mu. 
Mmusuakuo no tumi gyina hɔ sɛ kasakuo baako a abusua nketewa bi hyehyɛ 
mu.
Amanhodoɔ a ɛwɔ Abibirem ha a mmusuakuo ahodoɔ wɔ mu no mu baako 
ne Ɔman Kronkron Ghana. Abakɔsɛm kyerɛ yɛn sɛ, mmusuakuo ahodoɔ wɔ 
amanhodoɔ a ɛwɔ ewiase afanan mu no nyinaa mu.
Abusua su
Nneɛma titire a ɛma abusua da nso no mu bi ne sɛ:
1. Wɔfiri ɛna korɔ: Abusuafoɔ no gye di sɛ wɔn nyinaa firi ɛna koro ase.
2. Abusuabɔ: Nnipa a wɔwɔ abusua no mu firi mogya korɔ na wɔnam awareɛ anaa 
nnyetom so na wɔbɛka abusua no ho .
3. Wɔwɔ ahyɛnsodeɛ korɔ: Nnipa a wɔfiri abusua korɔ mu wɔ din korɔ, agyinahyɛdeɛ 
ne amammerɛ korɔ.
4. Wɔtaa tena kuro korɔ mu: Abusuafoɔ taa ka wɔn ho bom tena kuro korɔ mu.
5. Abusua mu diberɛ nhyehyɛeɛ: Abusua biara wɔ akannifoɔ, mpanimfoɔ anaa 
ahemfo a wɔboa ma wɔsi gyinaeɛ wɔ abusua no mu nsɛm bi ho.
6. Abusua biara wɔ ahyɛnsodeɛ: Abusua biara mu nnipa no wɔ amammerɛ ne amanneɛ 
korɔ bi a ɛma wɔda nso firi afoforɔ ho. Wɔsan nso wɔ wɔn nkyea ne wɔn nnyesoɔ .
7. Wɔyɛ adwenkorɔ wɔ sikasɛm ntotoeɛ ho: Mmusuakuo no kyɛ akadeɛ ahodoɔ bi te 
sɛ asase ne nnyapadeɛ a ɛkeka ho no nyinaa pɛpɛɛpɛ ma wɔn mu biara de bɔ ne 
bra.
8. Adwabɔ ne amanneɛ ahodoɔ: Mmusuakuo no yɛ amanneɛ korɔ wɔ adwabɔ ahodoɔ 
bi te sɛ bragorɔ, awaregyeɛ, ayiyɔ ne afahyɛ ase.
Abusua so Mfasoɔ
Dwuma ahodoɔ a abusua di no bi nie:
1. Wɔtena akuakuo: Abusuafoɔ no kyekyɛ ɛdɔm a wɔwɔ abusua koro bi mu mu 
nketenkete sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn so die renyɛ dina na afei nso ɛbɛboa ama ɛberɛ biara 
no, wɔbɛhunu wɔn ho aka wɔn ho abom na wɔbɛyɛ adwene korɔ wɔ gyinaeɛsie bi 
ho.
2. Abusuabɔ: Abusuafoɔ pɛ nkabom, na yei ma wɔhunu sɛ wɔyɛ baako, di nokorɛ ma 
wɔn-ho-wɔn-ho, san boa wɔn-ho-wɔn-ho.
3. Wɔwɔ ahyɛnsodeɛ korɔ: Abusuafoɔ nam abakɔsɛm, amammerɛ ne amanneɛ ne 
wɔn agyapadeɛ so ma akuakuo nketewa no hunu ekuo kɛseɛ a wɔfra mu no kɔka 
wɔn ho.

4. Nkabom ne Mmoa: Abusuafoɔ tumi boa wɔn abusuafoɔ a wɔhia mmoa bi te sɛ 
kuayɔ anaa afuomdwuma, ahobammɔ anaa ntawantawa nsiesie.
5. Abusua siesie Ntawantawa: Na mmusuakuo no ara wɔ wɔn akwan ahodoɔ a wɔfa 
so di wɔn ho so, siesie ntawantawa ma asomdwoeɛ ne koroyɛ ba.
6. Abusua ma Amammerɛ ne Amanneɛ tim: Abusua boa ma nkyirimma sua amammerɛ 
ne amanneɛ, yɛn nnepa ne nneɛma a yɛn ani ku ho no nyinaa.
7. Amammuo Nhyehyɛeɛ: Nkuro no bi wɔ hɔ a na mmusuakuo no ara wɔ wɔn 
amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ a na wɔwɔ wɔn akannifoɔ a wɔhwɛ abusuafoɔ nkaeɛ no so.
8. Sikasɛm ho Nkitahodie: Na ɛyɛ mmusuakuo no ara na wɔhwɛ yɛ sikasɛm ho 
nhyehyɛeɛ, ɛho nkitahodie ne ho ntotoeɛ a ɛfa akadeɛ ahodoɔ, edwadie ne nnɔboa 
ho nyinaa.
9. Abusua boa asetena mu kankɔ: Na abusuafoɔ tumi boa wɔn-ho-wɔn-ho ma wɔtumi 
kɔ ɛkan anaa wɔn anim wɔ wɔn abrabɔ mu ma ɛnam so ma wɔnya animuonyam 
wɔ wɔn kurom.
10. Abusua ma nkabom ne koroyɛ: Abusua ma emu nnipa no hunu sɛ wɔyɛ nnipa 
baako nti wɔka wɔn ho bom boa wɔn-ho-wɔn-ho ma koroyɛ ba wɔn ntam.
11. Baakoyɛ: Abusuafoɔ no hunu sɛ wɔyɛ nnipa baako nti wɔboa wɔn-ho-wɔn-ho wɔ 
akwannuasa so.
Nsakraeɛ pii na aba abusua dwumadie ahodoɔ no mu na ama ɛso mfasoɔ no nso asesa 
wɔ mmusuakuo ahodoɔ ne abakɔsɛm mu nanso nsunsuansoɔ a ɛnya wɔ yɛn asetena 
mu nhyehyɛeɛ, yɛn nnipaban ne yɛn nkuro soɔ deɛ, ɛda so ara tim deɛ ɛtim.
Mmusuakuo Nkyekyɛmu
Nnipa a wɔwɔ Anlo/Aŋlɔ, Avenor, Ave, Tongu, Agave ne Mafi frɛ abusua sɛ hlɔ̃ nanso 
Ewedome a wɔyɛ Hofoɔ, Adaklufoɔ, Kpandofoɔ, Hohoefoɔ ne Pekifoɔ no nso frɛ abusua 
sɛ Ve ɛnna afoforɔ bi nso frɛ abusua sɛ sã.
Mmusuakuo bɛyɛ dunum (15) na ɛwɔ Anloman mu, dumiɛnsa (13) wɔ Avenor ɛnna 
nkron (9) nso wɔ Agave a wɔn mu biara wɔ n’akraboa. Mfantse ne Asante nso mu 
biara wɔ mmusuakuo ahodoɔ nwɔtwe.

Dwumadie 7.1 Abusua
Monnwennwene abusua ho. Monnwene ne nhyehyɛeɛ, ɛso mfasoɔ/dwuma a ɛdie,

Dwumadie 7.2 Abusua ntotoho
1. Twerɛ Akanfoɔ mmusuakuo ahodoɔ enum ne wɔn akraboa din na san twerɛ 
mmusuakuo a wɔnyɛ Akanfoɔ mmienu (2) anaa deɛ ɛboro saa ne wɔn akraboa 
ho nhwɛsoɔ.
2. Ka wo mmuaeɛ a ɛwɔ asɛmmisa (1) no ho asɛm kyerɛ adesuafoɔ nkaeɛ no na 
monnyina so nyɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ adekorɔ ne deɛ ɛnyɛ adekorɔ wɔ mmusuakuo a 
mobobɔɔ din no ho mu mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu.
Dwumadie 7.3 Abusua so mfasoɔ
Ekuo biara mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm dwuma a mmusuakuo a wɔwɔ Akanman mu no di wɔ 
wɔn daadaa asetena mu mu.
Dwumadie 7.4 Dwuma a abusua die
Montena baanu baanu na mompɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm nneɛma ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa (3) 
a w’abusua no kyiri (abusua akyiwadeɛ) mu na monkyerɛ nsunsuansoɔ a saa 
akyiwadeɛ nya wɔ mo so.
Dwumadie 7.5
Yɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ abɛɛfo ntontanfidie so fa mmusuakuo a yɛabobɔ wɔn din wɔ 
ɛpono a ɛwɔ soro hɔ no so no mu baako biara a wopɛ ho. Hwehwɛ mfoni a ɛkyerɛ 
abusua no mu nnipa a wɔafa/wɔasiesie wɔn ho,ne sini a abusua no mu nnipa 
wom a wɔrekyerɛkyerɛ wɔn amammerɛ ne wɔn suahunu ahodoɔ mu kyerɛ wɔn 
nkurɔfoɔ.
Dwumadie 7.6 Abusua dwumadie/Asɛdeɛ
Wɔde wo adi abusuapanin. Kyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa (3) a wobɛyɛ 
ama nkabom aba abusua no mu. Ka w’adwenkyerɛ no kyerɛ adesuafoɔ nkaeɛ no 
na monyɛ mu mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu.

AKANFOƆ AMAMMUO NHYEHYƐEƐ
Akanfoɔ Amammuo Nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ nnidisoɔ nnidisoɔ kwan wɔfa so hyehyɛ mpaninnie 
wɔ adwadie mu, amammuo ne nnwumakuo ahodoɔ mu.
Akanfoɔ Amammuo Nhyehyɛeɛ Su
Su a ɛda adi wɔ Akanfoɔ Amammuo Nhyehyɛeɛ ho no mu bi na ɛdidi soɔ yi:
1. Tumidie ho nhyehyɛeɛ: Tumi no firi soro na asiane aba fam wɔ ɛberɛ a ɔfa biara 
wɔ ne dwumadie ne n’asodie.
2. Agyinaeɛsie ho nhyɛhyɛeɛ: Mpanimfoɔ anaa akannifoɔ a wɔwɔ ɛsoro no na wɔsi 
gyinaeɛ titire no.
3. Dwumadie nkyekyɛmu: Wɔakyekyɛ nnwuma no mu akuakuo a emu biara wɔ ne 
dwumadie ahodoɔ sononko a ɔyɛ.
4. Dwumadie nkyekyɛmu: Wɔakyekyɛ nnwuma no mu akuakuo a emu biara wɔ ne 
dwumadie ahodoɔ sononko a ɔyɛ. Mpanimfoɔ anaa akannifoɔ a wɔwɔ ɛsoro no na 
wɔsi gyinaeɛ titire no.
5. Nnipa ahodoɔ a wɔhwɛ wɔn so: Mpanimfoɔ a wɔdeda akuakuo no ano no wɔ nnipa 
kakra a wɔhwɛ wɔn so anaa wɔhyɛ n’ase.
6. Nkitahodie ho nhyehyɛeɛ: Wɔwɔ ɛkwan sononko a wɔfa so di nkutahodie wɔ ekuo 
no mu.
7. Dwumadie ne asodie sononko: Ekuo biara wɔ ne dwumadie ne n’anisoadehunu.
8. Dwumadie ho tumidie nhyehyɛeɛ: Saa nnidisoɔ nnidisoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ akwan ahodoɔ 
yi boa ma dwumadie gyina pintinn, kɔ so frenkyem a akontabuo amapa tae akyire 
na mmom, ɛbɛtumi nso ama nneɛma bi te sɛ agyinaeɛsie aka akyire.
Akanfoɔ Amammuo Nhyehyɛeɛ Ɛpono
Mfitiaseɛ Dwumadie
1. Ekuo biara nhyehyɛ Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛdidi soɔ yi mfiri soro nkɔ 
fam;
Ahemfo nkumaa - mpanimfoɔ - amanhene  - asiahene
2. Nhyehyɛeɛ no bɛtumi ayɛ te sɛ yei: Amanhene→ ahemfo nkumaa→ asiahene→ 
mpanimfoɔ
3. Nhyehyɛeɛ a woayɛ no na yɛfrɛ no amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ no.
Amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ mfoni a ɛda adwumakuo bi mu dwumadie ahodoɔ no 
nhyehyɛeɛ adi. Ɛkyerɛ nnidisoɔ nnidisoɔ nkutahodie kwan a ɛda adwuma no mu 
mpanimfoɔ ne wɔn adwumayɛfoɔ no ntam.
Momma yɛnhwɛ Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ ɛpono ho nhwɛsoɔ a ɛwɔ aseɛ hɔ no

Figa 7.4: Akan amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ
Amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ soro hɔ no ma ɛda adi pefee sɛ, Otumfoɔ na ne diberɛ so 
pa ara wɔ Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ no mu ɛnna Ɔmanhene, Asiahene, Ahemfo 
nkumaa (a Akyeamehene ne Abusuapanin hyɛ wɔn ase), Asafohene, Ahemmaa, 
Akɔmfoɔ toatoa soɔ.
Ahemfo ahodoɔ a wɔwɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ ɛpono no soɔ no mu biara wɔ ne dwuma 
pɔtee a ɔdi. Ahemfo no ne wɔn dwuma a wɔdi no mu bi na ɛdidi soɔ yi.
Otumfoɔ
Otumfoɔ na ɔyɛ tumi nyinaa wura (tumiwura) wɔ Asanteman mu. Ɔno na ɔyɛ 
Asanteman kasamafoɔ wɔ aban mu sɛdeɛ ɛsi teɛ wɔ mmusuakuo ahodoɔ mu no.
Otumfoɔ dwumadie
1. Ɔno na ɔda ɔman mu no ne ahemfo nkaeɛ no nyinaa ano.
2. Ɔno na ɔhyɛ mmara san fa n’ahemfo nkaeɛ no nyinaa so hwɛ sɛ obiara redi mmara 
no so.
3. Ɔno na ɔtumi suae ɛko wɔ kuro anaa ɔman foforɔ bi so.
4. Ɔsiesie ne manmma ntam ntawantawa

ABUSUA NE AKANFOƆ AMAMMUO
Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa  7
Ɔmanhene
Ɔmanhene yɛ ɔkannifoɔ ma nnipakuo anaa mmusuakuo bi. Ɔno na ne tumi so pa ara 
wɔ Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ no mu. Nkuro bi so no, saa diberɛ yi gyina adedie a 
ɛfiri ɛna anaa agya fam so. Yɛtumi ka sɛ Ɔmanhene yɛ Abusuahene ɛfiri sɛ yɛyi no firi 
adehyebusua mu na ɛde no bɛdi akonnwa no. Wɔyɛ amanneɛ ahodoɔ ma Ɔmanhene 
ansa na wɔde no adi adeɛ. Abusua a wɔdi adeɛ kɔ ɛna fam no, ɔmanhene no tumi yɛ 
ɔbaa (ɔhemmaa).
Ɔmanhene dwumadie ahodoɔ
Ɔmanhene di dwuma ahodoɔ a ɛdidi soɔ yi;
1. Ɔmanhene na ɔda nnipakuo a wɔwɔ ne mpɔtam anaa ne mansini mu ano.
2. Ɔno na ɔhwɛ si gyinaeɛ ahodoɔ a ɛbɛma ne manfoɔ adi yie.
3. Ɔmanhene na ɔyɛ ntamgyinafoɔ ma ne manfoɔ ne nananom.
4. Ɔmanhene hwɛ ma ne manfoɔ di mmara so na ɔsan nso siesie ne manfoɔ ntam 
ntawantawa.
5. Ɔmanhene na ɔhwɛ asase ne nnyapadeɛ ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ ne mpasua soɔ no nyinaa soɔ.
6. Ɔmanhene na ɔhwɛ ma amammerɛ ne amanneɛ tu mpɔn wɔ ne mpasua soɔ.
7. Ɔmanhene hwɛ de mpontunnwuma ba ne mpasua so ma ne manfoɔ nya bi yɛ ma 
wɔn ho tɔ wɔn wɔ wɔn asetena mu.
8. Ɔmanhene hwehwɛ mpontunnwuma ahodoɔ a ne manfoɔ hia de ho asɛm kɔto aban 
krakyepanin a ɔwɔ ne mpasua soɔ no anim.
9. Ɔmanhene na ɔhwɛ yɛ ntotoeɛ amapa wɔ ne mpasua soɔ.
10. Ɔno na ɔhyɛ mmara ma ne mpasua sofoɔ san hwɛ ma wɔdi soɔ.
Ahemfo nkumaa
Ahemfo nkumaa yɛ ahemfo a wɔhyɛ ɔmanhene ase pɛɛ. Wɔdi wɔn hene anaa tumi wɔ 
nkuro nkumaa anaa nkuro mmaako mmaako so. Wɔnam awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ so na ɛdi 
saa diberɛ yi. Wɔn nso fa ahensie akwan ahodoɔ no nyinaa so te sɛ ɔmanhene ansa na 
wɔatumi abɛtena akonnwa so sɛ ɔhene.
Ahemfo nkumaa dwumadie ahodoɔ
1. Wɔyɛ amanhene ananmusifoɔ.
2. Wɔhwɛ ma wɔn manfoɔ nya ahobammɔ san di mmara so.
3. Wɔhwɛ siesie ntawantawa a ɛwɔ wɔn mpɔtam.
4. Wɔhwɛ ma asomdwoeɛ ba ɔman no mu.
5. Wɔhwɛ nkonnwafie so san yi mmusuo wɔ ɛberɛ ɛsɛ mu.
6. Wɔhwɛ si awudie ano wɔ wɔn mpɔtamu.
7. Wɔbɔ nsase a ɛwɔ wɔn mpɔtamu ho ban.

8. Wɔdi tumi wɔ mmeaeɛ pɔtee bi, mmusua ne akuhodoɔ mu.
9. Wɔboa ma wɔtumi de nhyehyɛeɛ ahodoɔ yɛ adwuma wɔ wɔn mpɔtamu na wɔde ɛho 
amanneɛ akɔbɔ ɔmanhene.
Wɔakyekyɛ Ahemfo Nkumaa no mu sɛdeɛ yɛaka wɔn ho asɛm wɔ aseɛ ha yi:
Benkumhene
Ewefoɔ frɛ Benkumhene sɛ Miafi ɛnna Akanfoɔ nso frɛ no Benkumhene. Benkumhene 
na ɔda nnipakuo a wɔtena Otumfoɔ anaasɛ Ɔmanhene nsa benkum so wɔ adwabɔ ase, 
asɛnniiɛ anaa ɛko berɛ mu no nyinaa ano.
Nifahene
Ewefoɔ frɛ Nifahene sɛ ‘Đusifia’ ɛnna Akanfoɔ nso frɛ no Nifahene. Nifahene na ɔda 
nnipakuo a wɔtena Otumfoɔ anaasɛ Ɔmanhene nsa nifa so wɔ adwabɔ ase, asɛnniiɛ 
anaa ɛko berɛ mu no nyinaa ano.
Ahemfo (Benkumhene ne Nifahene) baanu yi di dwuma sono wɔ Akanfoɔ amammuo 
mu wɔn mpɔtam. Dwuma ahodoɔ a ahemfo baanu yi die no mu bi na ɛdidi soɔ yi:
1. Benkumhene ne Nifahene boa Ɔmanhene wɔ ne gyinaeɛsie wɔ nsɛm bi ho san boa 
no ma ɔyɛ nnwuma ahodoɔ ho ntotoeɛ amapa wɔ wɔn mpasua so.
2. Wɔn na wɔda Otumfoɔ anaa Ɔmanhene benkum ne wɔn nifa so atenafoɔ nyinaa 
ano.
3. Benkumhene ne Nifahene na wɔtu Ɔmanhene fo san ma no akwankyerɛ.
4. Wɔsiesie nnipa a wɔwɔ wɔn mpasua soɔ no ntam ntawantawa san hwɛ ma asomdwoeɛ 
ne abotɔyam ba wɔn mpasua so.
5. Wɔdi akoten wɔ ahensie ne ahentuo mu.
6. Wɔyɛ asase ho ntotoeɛfoɔ ɛnna wɔsan nso siesie asase ho mansosɛm ne nsɛm ahodoɔ 
a ɛfa asase ho nyinaa.
Ɔsahene/Tufohene
Akanfoɔ frɛ wɔn Ɔsahene ɛnna Ewefoɔ nso frɛ wɔn sɛ “Aʋadada / Aʋafia”.
Ɔsahene dwumadie
1. Ɔsahene na ɔda asraadɔm a wɔwɔ wɔn mpasua soɔ no ano na ɔno na ɔdi asraadɔm 
no anim wɔ ɛko berɛ mu.
2. Ɔhwɛ ma ɔmanmma di mmara so san bɔ wɔn ho ban firi atamfo nsam.
3. Ɔtumi si Ɔmanhene anan wɔ dwumadie ahodoɔ mu.

Ahemmaa
Wɔhunu ahemmaa sɛ wɔyɛ honhom mu akannifoɔ ma mmaa a wɔwɔ wɔn mpɔtam 
ɛnna wɔsan nso kura ɔman abakɔsɛm. Wɔn dwumadie titire pa ara ne sɛ, wɔhwɛ 
mmaa a wɔwɔ wɔn kurom no so. Mmusuakuo a wɔdi ɛnadeɛ no, ɛyɛ Ahemmaa no na 
wɔyi obi ma ɔdi hene. Wɔtumi yi obi ma ɔno nso bɛyɛ ɔhemmaa hyɛ wɔn ase.
Ahemmaa dwumadie ahodoɔ
1. Wɔyɛ nnwuma ahodoɔ de boa ahemfo no wɔ Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ no mu.
2. Wɔhwɛ siesie ntawantawa a ɛda mmaa ntam.
3. Wɔbɔ mmaa yiedie ho ban.
4. Wɔbɔ wɔn kuro no abakɔsɛm ho ban.
5. Wɔhwɛ goro mmaayewa bra.
Ɔman Kɔmfoɔ
Ɔman Kɔmfoɔ na ɔda ahonhom a wɔwɔ ne mpasua soɔ no nyinaa ano. Ɔno na ɔhunu 
sunsum mu nsɛm bɔ Ɔmanhene ne ahemfo nkaeɛ no amanneɛ. Ɔno na ɔyɛ ɔyaresafoɔ 
na ɔsan nso yɛ ntamgyinafoɔ ma nnipa ne nananom nsamanfoɔ.
Ɔman Kɔmfoɔ dwumadie
1. Nkuro bi mu no, sɛ ɔhene tia ne nan akyi a, ɔno na ɔsi n’ananmu hwɛ akyire kɔsi 
sɛ ɔbɛsan aba.
2. Ɔman Kɔmfoɔ na ɔma ɔmanmma a wɔwɔ ne mpasua soɔ no sunsum mu akwankyerɛ.
3. Ɔman Kɔmfoɔ na ɔyɛ amanneɛ ahodoɔ a yɛde tu ɔhene bi adeɛ so anaa wɔ ɛberɛ a 
yɛde ɔhene bi redi adeɛ.
4. Ɔman Kɔmfoɔ kyerɛ daeɛ anaa anisoadehunu ase san ma kyerɛ ɔman no tiri mmusuo.
5. Ɔbɔ ɔman no amammerɛ ne amanneɛ ho ban.
6. Ɔgye obi a ahonhommɔne ne no di asie firi ahonhommɔne no nsam.
Asiahene: Asiahene yɛ nnipa anaa nnipakuo bi a wɔhwɛ yi obi wɔ adehyebusua mu 
ma no di ɔhene wɔ berɛ a wɔn mu biara ntumi nni ɔhene. Saa nnipakuo yi hyia fa 
adwene wɔ onipa a adedie aduru ne so no ho.
Asiahene dwumadie ahodoɔ
1. Wɔn na wɔyi onipa a adedie aduru ne so.
2. Wɔn na wɔhwɛ yɛ amanneɛ wɔ berɛ a ɔhene bi kɔ akuraa.
3. Wɔn na wɔhwɛ ma wɔtu ɔhene bi adeɛ so.
4. Wɔn na wɔda ɔhene foforɔ adi kyerɛ atenankonnwa ne ɔmanfoɔ.

6. Wɔhwɛ siesie ntawantawa.

8. Wɔdosodoso onipa bi hwɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ɔdehyeɛ kann na ahennie nso fata no.
Ɔkyeame
Ɔkyeame na ɔtɔ so mmienu wɔ adehyeɛ a wɔtumi tu ɔhene fo no mu. Yei nti ɔdi 
dwuma ahodoɔ pii wɔ ɔman no mu. Esiane sɛ nkuro ahodoɔ so amammerɛ ne wɔn 
amanneɛ nyɛ adekorɔ nti no, ɛma dwuma a Ɔkyeame tumi die no nso sesa wɔ nkuro 
ahodoɔ so. Ɔkyeame dwumadie ahodoɔ no mu bi na ɛdidi soɔ yi:
1. Ɔno na ɔde ɔhene ano asɛm to ɔmanfoɔ no anim.
2. Sɛ ɔhene di santene bi mu rekɔ adwabɔ bi ase a, Ɔkyeame na ɔdi ɔhene no anim pɛɛ.
3. Ɔkyeame na ɔyɛ ɔhene kasamafoɔ.
4. Ɔkyeame na ɔkura ɔhene poma (akyeampoma).
5. Ɔkyeame na ɔde ɔmanfoɔ ne nsrahwɛfoɔ anodisɛm to ɔhene anim na wasan agye 
ɔmanfoɔ asɛm no ho mmuaeɛ afiri ɔhene hɔ de abrɛ wɔn.
 Dwumadie 7.7 Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ ɛpono

Dwumadie 7.9 Ahemfo dwumadie
Nnipa binom ka sɛ, tete hɔ no na wɔnya ɔhaw, ntawantawa anaa mente-me-ho-ase

Montena baanu baanu na montwerɛ mo adwenkyerɛ mfa saa asɛntire yi ho. Monka

Dwumadie 7.10 Akanfoɔ amammuo

Monkenkan mo mmuaeɛ nkyerɛ mo afɛfoɔ na monyɛ mu mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu.
Dwumadie 7.11 Amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ mmienu no ntotoho
Ekuo biara nkasa mfa mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ Akanfoɔ amammuo nhyehyɛeɛ no soɔ ho na 
monsan nkyerɛ ɔhaw a ɛwɔ ho na afei momfa ntoto mfasoɔ ne ɔhaw a ɛwɔ ɛnnɛ

NNIANIMU
Saa ɔfa yi bɛkasa afa Akanfoɔ amammuo ne abɛɛfo asɛnnie nhyehyɛeɛ ho. 
Ɛbɛpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm asɛnnie nhyehyɛeɛ ahodoɔ mmienu no ne wɔn dwumadie mu. 
Wobɛyɛ ntotoeɛ afa asɛnnie nhyehyɛeɛ mmienu no ho sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a w’ankasa de wo 
nimdeɛ a wowɔ fa ho no bɛto dwa. Wo nimdeɛ ne wo nteaseɛ a wowɔ fa Akanfoɔ 
asɛnnie ne abɛɛfo asɛnnie nhyehyɛeɛ ho no bɛboa wo ama woatumi akyerɛ w’adwene 
wɔ Kabimamenkabi nhyehyɛeɛ ho ne ɛkwan a wobɛfa so ada w’ahofadie adi. Ɛbɛtumi 
asan aboa wo ama woatumi adwene akɔ akyiri na woasan ayɛ mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm a emu 
dɔ pa ara ama woatumi asi gyinaeɛ bi na ama woayɛ ɔmanbapa wɔ berɛ a woresua 
biribi afa w’ahofadie ne w’asodie ahodoɔ ho.
Bio, saa ɔfa yi bɛboa ama woanya nimdeɛ a ɛho hia pa ara na asan ama woanya 
anigyeɛ de atoa so asua mmara, amanyɔsɛm mu adesua ama woahunu deɛ ɛrekɔ so 
wɔ wo man ne amannɔne aman ahodoɔ so esiane sɛ, twaka bi da ɛne adesua ahodoɔ 
nkaeɛ bi te sɛ Amannyɔsɛm ne Abakɔsɛm ntam.

• Abɛɛfo asɛnnie nhyehyɛeɛ kyerɛkyerɛ ɔmanmmara baatan mu san de di dwuma. 
Abɛɛfo asɛnnie nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ Ghanaman mu no yɛ nnidisoɔ nnidisoɔ a Supreme 
kɔɔto na ɛyɛ emu kɛseɛ pa ara wɔ saa kwan no so.
• Akanfoɔ asɛnnie nhyehyɛeɛ no gyina amammerɛ mu mmara ahodoɔ so na ɛdi ne 
dwuma wɔ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ kwan so.

Abɛɛfo Asɛnnie Nhyehyɛeɛ
Abɛɛfo asɛnnie nhyehyɛeɛ no yɛ adwumakuo a wɔayi wɔn sɛ wɔnni nsɛm wɔ kɔɔto 
ahodoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu anaa ɛyɛ aban adwumakuo fa bi a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ amanmmara mu 
na ɛsan de di dwuma.
Abɛɛfo Asɛnnie Dwumadie
Abɛɛfo asɛnnie nhyehyɛeɛ di dwuma ahodoɔ a ɛdidi soɔ yi:
1. Ɛkyerɛkyerɛ ɔman no mmara ahodoɔ no mu na ɛsan de adi dwuma sɛdeɛ ɛfata.
2. Ɛhwɛ ma akontabuo amapa ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ da adi wɔ ɔman no mu
3. Ɛhwɛ bɔ afoforɔ ahofadie ho ban ne titire ne deɛ ɔman no amammara da no adi no.
4. Ɛhwɛ ma atɛntenenee da adi na ɛyi ntɛnkyea firi mmara sodie mu.
5. Ɛhwɛ siesie ntawantawa ahodoɔ: ɛsiesie ntawantawa/mansotwe a ɛwɔ nnipa ntam, 
nnwuma ahodoɔ mu ne aban nnwumakuo mu.
6. Ɛda ne ho adi sɛ ntamgyinafoɔ na ɛnam so de siesie nsɛm wɔ ɛberɛ a wɔnhyɛda nni 
asɛm no wɔ kɔɔto/asɛnnibea hɔ.
7. Ɛma obiara yɛ hwɛsofoɔ ma ne yɔnko: Ɛhwan aban no ne mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ tumi 
so sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a obiara bɛdi ne dwuma sɛdeɛ amammara no ma no tumi.
8. Ɛgyina ɔman no anan mu bu abɔnefoɔ atɛn.
9. Ɛtumi gyina hɔ ma wɔn a wɔrebɔ wɔn kwaadu no.
Abɛɛfo Atemmuo/kɔɔto asɛnnie ho nhyehyɛeɛ
Ghanaman atemmuo no wɔ nnidisoɔ nnidisoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ
1. Supirim kɔɔto ne kɔɔto no mu deɛ ɛso pa ara
2. Apii kɔɔto ne adantam kɔɔto a ɛdi supirim kɔɔto akyi
3. Haee kɔɔto ne asɛnnibea a ɛwɔ tumi sɛ ɛdi asɛm biara a wɔde bɛba hɔ
4. Sɛɛkit kɔɔto ne Mansini kɔɔto ne kɔɔto mu nketewa a ɛhwɛ abusua mmara ne nsɛm 
nketenkete so.
5. Nkwadaa kɔɔto anaa Trabunaa nso ka kɔɔto nketewa no ho a ɛdi mmɔfra a wɔnnii 
mfeɛ dunwɔtwe asɛm.
Kɔɔto/asɛnnibea Dwumadie
Kɔɔto kyerɛkyerɛ mmara mu na ɛsan hwɛ ma yɛdi mmara so sɛ ebia mmara nhyehyɛeɛ 
kunin a ɛbɔ yɛn ho ban, abɔnefosɛm ho mmara ne nnwumakuo ho mmara ahodoɔ 
ɛnna afei, ɛkyerɛ tumi a ɛtae mmara sodie akyiri.
Ghanaman mu ha, Chief Justice (CJ) na ɔda dwumadie a ɛwɔ Supirim kɔɔto ano na 
ɛno ne tumidie kɛseɛ pa ara ɛwɔ atemmuo anaa kɔɔto nhyehyɛeɛ dwumadie mu. 
Nnipakuo a aka a wɔdi dwuma wɔ kɔɔto no bi ne; adwɔɔgyefoɔ, magyiseratefoɔ ɛnna 
nnipa bi a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ fa atemmuo ho a wɔboa siesie nsɛm, kyerɛkyerɛ Ghana 
mmara ahodoɔ no mu na wɔsan nso kyerɛ mmara a ɛtae dwumadie bi akyi.

Abɛɛfo asɛnnie/kɔɔto ho nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ asɛnnie mu.
1. Otemmufoɔ baako pɛ tie nsɛm na wasi ho gyinaeɛ wɔ kɔɔto/asɛnnibea kɛseɛ, Apii 
kɔɔto ne Ɔman no mu kɔɔto Baatan (Supirim kɔɔto) mu.
2.  Atemmufoɔ mmiɛnsa de kɔsi enum agyinatukuo tumi tena asɛm so wɔ Apii kɔɔto 
ne Ɔman no mu kɔɔto/asɛnnibea Baatan no mu.
3. Nsɛm bi mu no, otemmufoɔ ne nhwehwɛmufoɔ (a ɔwɔ ho nimdeɛ pa ara anaa 
ɔnhyɛda nni ho nimdeɛ) tena asɛm bi so da nhunumu bi adi de boa asɛnnie no.
4. Magyiserate no tie nsɛm bua ho atɛn wɔ Magyiserate Kɔɔto/asɛnnibea.
5.  Asomdwoeɛ-temmufoɔ nso tie nsɛm nkumaa na wabua ho atɛn wɔ mansini 
asɛnnibea/kɔɔto.
Mfoni 8.1 : Mfoni no da abɛɛfo kɔɔto nhyehyɛeɛ ne emu adwomayɛfoɔ ahodoɔ adi.
Abɛɛfo Atemmuo/kɔɔto asɛnnie ho nhyehyɛeɛ 
nnidisoɔ
Asɛnnie nhyehyɛeɛ no nte boɔ korɔ so na mmom, ɛgyina kɔɔto/asɛnnibea korɔ, asɛm 
korɔ ne tebea korɔ no so. Ɛho nhyehyɛeɛ no na ɛdidi soɔ no:
1. Nnipa a wɔanya asɛm no de wɔn asɛm kɔto kɔtoo anim.
2. Kɔɔto no di kan ne wɔn hyia hwehwɛ asɛm no mu nam so de nneɛma gugu akwan 
mu.
3. Wɔde wɔn adansedeɛ to kɔtoo no anim na wɔabisabisa adansefoɔ no nsɛm bi.
4. Otemmufoɔ anaa agyinatukuo no de wɔn atemmuo no to dwa.
5.  Nnipa no mu biara tumi san de asɛm to kɔ kɔɔto/asɛnnibea kɛseɛ mu.
Hyɛ no nso: Asɛnnie no bi mu no, nnipa a wɔretwe manso no tumi serɛ yi asɛm no firi 
kɔɔto kɔdi no wɔ efie.

a ɛda asukuufoɔ mmienu ntam no:
Barima Kyei ne Ɔpɔn kɔ sukuu baako na wɔn nyinaa bɔ bɔɔlo ma wɔn sukuu

bi ne afisɛm, nsasesɛm, ntam so buo ne atorɔ anaa nnaadaa.

ASANTE TWI KASADWINI
Ano Kasadwini
NNIANIMU
Saa ɔfa yi mu, yɛbɛkyerɛ wo biribi afa agya rekɔ ne nyansapɔ ho a wɔn nyinaa hyɛ 
Akanfoɔ ano kasadwini ase. Yɛadi kan akyerɛ wo biribi afa nsaguo/apaeɛ ne nsuiɛ ho 
wɔ gyinapɛn baako (1) mu. Agya rekɔ ne nyansapɔ sua mu no, yɛbɛkyerɛ wo sɛdeɛ 
wobɛsi akyerɛ w’adwene afa agya rekɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ne n’ahodoɔ ntam. Saa ɔfa yi ho 
bɛhia ama wo pa ara ɛfiri sɛ, ɛnyɛ sɛ ɛyɛ Asante Twi nko ara nti na mmom, sɛ ɛne 
adesuadeɛ ahodoɔ bi te sɛ Borɔfo kasadwini bɛnya ayɔnkofa. Saa ɔfa yi bɛboa wo ama 
woanya nimdeɛ a ɛbɛma wo kasasua atu mpɔn ne sɛdeɛ wobɛsi asɔ ɔhaw bi ano afa. 
Agya rekɔ ne nyansapɔ yɛ anigyeɛ kwan a ɛboa ma wode w’adwene di dwuma, hunu 
sɛdeɛ wobɛsi ayɛ ade foforɔ bi na asan ama woatumi adwene akɔ akyiri.
ADWEMPƆ TITIRE
• Agya rekɔ yɛ asɛmmisa, asɛnka anaa asɛmfua ɛkyere adwene a ɛhia sɛ wodwene kɔ 
akyiri ansa na woanya anoyie no. Agya rekɔ taa kyere adwene, yi adwene si nkyɛn 
anaa ma adwene yɛ ntanta na ne mmuaeɛ nso yɛ nwanwa anaa anigyeɛ.
• Yɛtumi de agya rekɔ ne nyansapɔ gyegye yɛn ani, bue adwenem anaa sua adeɛ.
• Agya rekɔ tumi boa ma wo kasasua tu mpɔn, dwene kɔ akyiri, bue adwenem ma 
wotumi nya nimdeɛ ahodoɔ de yɛ nneɛma foforɔ.
AGYA REKƆ
Agya rekɔ yɛ nyansapɔ fa bi anaa adwenem dwumadie bi a ɛde ɔkasa, nsɛmfua ne 
nsɛngorɔ a emu dɔ na ɛde mmuaeɛ anaa anoyie bi sie. Ɛtae yɛ nsɛmmisa, asɛnka anaa 
kasasin bi a ɛhia adwene a emu dɔ ne nnwennweneho pa ara ansa na woatumi ate 
aseɛ. Agya rekorɔ ma anigyeɛ.
Agya rekɔ tae nya:
1. Nsɛmfua agodie: Nsɛngorɔ, nsɛm a ne nteaseɛ boro baako, nsɛmfua a yɛbɔ edin pɛ 
nanso wɔn nteaseɛ ne wɔn atwerɛ yɛ sononko, ɛnna nsɛmfua a wɔn atwerɛ yɛ pɛ 
nanso wɔn din bɔ ne wɔn nteaseɛ yɛ sononko.
2. Nnyinahɔma ne mfatoho ahodoɔ.
3. Nsɛngorɔ ahodoɔ.
4. nnwennweneho ntrasoɔ.
5. Mmuaeɛ a ɛyɛ anika.

Montena baanu baanu na momfa mo ankasa nsɛmfua nkyerɛ agya rekɔ ase na

Agya rekɔ ahodoɔ:
Yɛtumi gyina agya rekɔ tenten so kyɛ mu mmienu. Yeinom ne:

AGYA REKƆ NE NYANSAPƆ
Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa 9
Agya rekɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ho mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm.
Agya rekɔ ho mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm yɛ ɛkwan a yɛfa so baabae ɔkasa no, ne nhyehyɛeɛ 
mu de hwehwɛ ɛho asɛmmisa no mmuaeɛ. Deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi ne ɛkwan a yɛbɛfa so 
apɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm Agya rekɔ mu:
1. Kenkan no yie: Kenkan agya rekɔ brɛoo mpɛn pii sɛdeɛ wobɛte emu nsɛmfua ne 
kasasini ahodoɔ no ase.
2. Hwehwɛ nsɛmfua foforɔ: Hyɛ nsɛmfua, kasasin anaa nneɛma bi a yɛatim a ɛho hia 
no nso.
3. Hwehwɛ nteaseɛ hodoɔ: Agya rekɔ tae de nsɛnkwaa, nsɛngorɔ anaa nteaseɛ ahodoɔ 
di dwuma. Ma w’adwene nkɔ nsɛmfua asekyerɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu ahodoɔ no so.
4. Pɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm nhyehyɛeɛ mu: Ma w’ani nkɔ Agya rekɔ nhyehyɛeɛ no so, ne titire 
ne nnianimu, nkyerɛkyerɛmu, asɛmmisa ne nsɛngorɔ.
5. Hwehwɛ twaka a ɛwowom: Hwehwɛ twaka anaa ayɔnkofa a ɛdeda nsɛmfua, 
adwempɔ anaa nimdeɛ ahodoɔ ntam.
6. Ma w’adwene nkɔ nteaseɛ ahodoɔ so: Dwene nsɛm no ho yie na ma w’ani nkɔ 
nteaseɛ ahodoɔ so.
7. Yi w’adwene firi mmuaeɛ traa so: Agya rekɔ tumi de nsɛm bi a ɛyera adwene to 
dwa. Ne saa nti, bu w’ani gu mmuaeɛ traa ahodoɔ so.
8. Yɛ nsusuiɛ amapa: Yɛ nsusuiɛ ahodoɔ a emu dɔ pa ara fa agya rekɔ no ho.
9. Hwɛ wo mmuaeɛ no: Si gyinaeɛ wɔ wo mmuaeɛ no ho wɔ ɛberɛ a worekenkan agya 
rekɔ no mu bio de ahwɛ sɛ wo mmuaeɛ no tɔ asom.
10. Fa Agya rekɔ di dwuma na sua ɛho nimdeɛ: Mpɛn dodoɔ a worepɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm 
Agya rekɔ mu no, na worenya ne nhyehyɛeɛ ne deɛ ɛkeka ho ho nimdeɛ.
Bio, hyɛ deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi nso fa Agya rekɔ ho:
1. Fa aboterɛ ne nwetasoɔ honhom di dwuma.
2. Dwene kɔ akyiri pa ara tra agya rekɔ no so.
3. Fa nsɛnhini, nsianimu ne nsiakyire yɛ adwuma ma no mmoa wo.
4. Bue w’adwenem na yi nsusuiɛ hunu si nkyɛn.
Dwumadie 9.5 Agya rekɔ agodie
Montena baanu baanu, afei hyɛ aseɛ yɛ w’ankasa agya rekɔ ma wo yɔnko no. Sɛ 
wɔtumi yiyi agya rekɔ no ano a, ma wɔn nso nhyehyɛ wɔn agya rekɔ na no nso 
nyiyi ano. Deɛ ɔbɛdi nkonim no ne deɛ ɔbɛbisa na wayiyi agya rekɔ dodoɔ no ara 
ano.

AGYA REKƆ NE NYANSAPƆ
Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa 9
NYANSAPƆ
Ɛyɛ agorɔ a ɛde dwumadie bi to dwa a ɛhia adwene a emu dɔ ne nnwennweneho 
amapa ansa na woatumi ayi ano. Ɛyɛ ano ne ano agodie.
Yɛtae de Nyansapɔ gyegye yɛn ani, sua nimdeɛ ɛnna ɛsan nso bue yɛn adwene mu. 
Ɛma yɛtumi dwene kɔ akyiri, sua sɛdeɛ yɛbɛsi asɔ ɔhaw bi ano na ɛma yɛtumi kaekae 
nsɛm ɔhare so.
Nyansapɔ dwumadie ahodoɔ
Nyansapɔ tumi di dwuma bebree wɔ tebea ahodoɔ mu:
1. Ɛbue adwenem: Ɛboa ma yɛnya ɔhaw ano poma siberɛ, adwene a emu dɔ ne 
ankorɛankorɛ nnwennweneho nimdeɛ ne titire wɔ mmɔfra mu.
2. Anigyeɛ: Ɛboa ma nnipa ahodoɔ nyinaa anigyeɛ sononko wɔ asetena mu.
3. Nwomasua: Ɛboa ma yɛnya nimdeɛ, adwenemu-dɔ ne nteaseɛ amapa fa adesuadeɛ 
bi a wɔn aseteɛ mu yɛ den bi te sɛ nkontabuo, abɔdeɛmunyansapɛ ne kasasua.
4. Ayaresa: Ɛsiesie adwene mu, ɛma akoma tɔ yam wɔ akwannuasa so.
5. Nkabom: Ɛde nkabom sononko, nnɔboa ɛnna nkitahodie amapa ba wɔ ɛberɛ a 
yɛabom rehwehwɛ nyansapɔ bi anoyie.
6. Ɛbue adwene mu: Ɛboa ma yɛn adwene mu da hɔ fann na ɛnam so ma nneɛma nka 
akyi wɔ abrabɔ mu.
7. Nnwennweneho amapa: ɛboa ma yɛtumi dwene, yɛ nsusuiɛ pa ne deɛ ɛkeka ho.
8. Nkariiɛ ne mmɔakyire: Ɛboa ma yɛtumi yɛ nkariiɛ amapa fa agyinasie bi ho, da 
nimdeɛ a emu dɔ adi wɔ akwan ahodoɔ bebree so.
9. Anansesɛmtoɔ ne amanebɔ: Ɛboa ma yɛnya nimdeɛ fa ɛkwan a yɛbɛfa so de punetoɔ 
ne polɔɔto bɛdi dwuma wɔ kasadwini dwumadie ahodoɔ mu.
10. Nhwehwɛmuyɛ ne Abɔdeɛmunyansapɛ: Ɛboa ma yɛsua biribi fa ɛkwan a nnipa fa 
so da wɔn atenka, suban ne adwene mu nsusuiɛ ahodoɔ adi ɛnna sɛdeɛ wɔsi si nsɛm 
binom ho gyinaeɛ fa.
11. Ankorɛankoro nnyini: Ɛboa ma yɛnya akokoɔduro, nnwetaasoɔ, nkoden ne gyidie 
wɔ yɛn ankasa mu wɔ ɛberɛ a yɛrepɛ nyansapɔ bi ho.
12. Ɛkwati nnipa mu nyiyimu: Ɛboa ma nnipa a wɔwɔ tebea ahodoɔ mu nya kwan 
hyia di dwuma bom.
Nyansapɔ da mfasoɔ bebree adi na ɛma no som bo wɔ nnipa asetena/suahunu mu.
Dwumadie 9.6 Nyansapɔ nkyeraseɛ ho nimdeɛ
Montena baanu baanu na mompɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm nyansapɔ nkyeraseɛ no mu na 
momfa mo mmuaeɛ no nto dwa.

AGYA REKƆ NE NYANSAPƆ
Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa 9
Nyansapɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ
Nhyehyɛeɛ ahodoɔ no na ɛdidi soɔ no:
1. Botaeɛ: Ɛda botaeɛ titire bi adi sɛ ebia, ɛrepɛ ɔhaw bi ano aduro.
2. Mmara: Ɛhyehyɛ mmara ahodoɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ obiara di so.
3. Ahyɛaseɛ: tebea ahodoɔ a wɔnam so de hyɛ agorɔ no ase.
4. Akwansideɛ ahodoɔ: akwansideɛ a ɛbrɛ mpontuo ase.
5. Anoyie kwan: Anoyie kwan anaa gyinasie ahodoɔ a ɛde yɛn kɔpue botaeɛ no ho.
6. Asɛm no pomasiberɛ: Mmuaeɛ/anoyie amapa a ɛtwa toɔ.
Nyansapɔ ho nhwɛsoɔ
Nyansapɔ: Asɛm nwanwasoɔ a ɛwɔ Nwoma a ayera no ho.
Nyansapɔ no ankasa:
Aaaa
Nwoma bi a ɛho yɛ na ayera wɔ akurase bi nwomakorabea. Nwomakorabea hɔ 
hwɛsofoɔ no bisaa nwoma no ho firii mmɔfra nnan bi hɔ: Kukua, Nana, Clara, ne 
David. Wɔn mu biara de nánodisɛm to dwa:
1. Kukua: "Mamfa nwoma no. Mehunuu no wɔ Nana nkyɛn nnora."
2. Nana "Mamfa nwoma no. Mennim sɛdeɛ nwoma no si teɛ mpo."
3. Clara: "Mehunuu sɛ David afa nwoma no afiri ɛpono no so."
4. David: "Clara retwa atorɔ. Na mewɔ efie wɔ ɛberɛ a nwoma yeraeɛ."
Nwomakorabea so hwɛsofoɔ no nim pefee sɛ wɔn mu baako na ɔreka nokorɛ. Hwan 
na ɔfaa nwoma no?
Anoyie ho nhyehyɛeɛ
1. Kukua na ɔreka nokorɛ deɛ a, ɛnneɛ na nwoma no wɔ Nana hɔ. Ɛkɔba no saa a, na 
ɛkyerɛ sɛ, Clara ne David nyinaa retwa atorɔ na yei bɛma nnipa a ɛboro baako na 
wɔreka nokorɛ. Ne saa nti, Kukua retwa atorɔ.
2. Nana na ɔreka nokorɛ a, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ, ɔnnim sɛdeɛ nwoma no si teɛ. Yei bɛkyerɛ 
sɛ, Kukua, Clara ne David nyinaa retwa atorɔ na yei bɛma Clara anodisɛm no ayɛ 
atorɔ, na asan ne Nana asɛm a ɔkaeɛ sɛ, ɔnnim ho hwee no abɔ abira. Ne saa nti, 
Nana retwa nso retwa atorɔ.
3. Clara nso na ɔreka nokorɛ a, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ, ɔhunuu David sɛ ɔrefa nwoma no. Yei 
bɛkyerɛ sɛ, Kukua, Nana ne David nyinaa retwa atorɔ. Esiane sɛ, onipa baako 
anodisɛm na ɛbɛtumi ayɛ nokorɛ nti, saa nsusuiɛ no yɛ adwuma.
4. David na ɔreka nokorɛ deɛ a, na Clara retwa atorɔ ɛfiri sɛ, Clara anhunu sɛ David 
refa nwoma no. Yei kyerɛ sɛ, Kukua ne Nana nyinaa nso retwa atorɔ a ɛne nokorɛ 
ahodoɔ no bɛbɔ abira. Ne saa nti, David nso retwa atorɔ.
Esiane sɛ onipa baako na ɔreka nokorɛ nti, ɛsɛ sɛ Clara mmom na n’anodisɛm no yɛ 
nokorɛ. Ne saa nti, David na ɔfaa nwoma no.

ASANTE TWI KASADWINI
Atwerɛ Kasadwini
NNIANIMU
Saa ɔfa yi mu no, yɛbɛkyerɛ wo biribi afa Asante Twi kasadwini ho. Ne titire no, ɔfa yi 
pɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm anwonsɛm mu. Yɛbɛkyerɛ wo sɛdeɛ wobɛsi akyerɛkyerɛ manwonsɛm 
mu, anwonsɛm ahodoɔ, anwonsɛm su ne ne ɛso mfasoɔ. Wobɛsan asua ɛkwan a yɛfa 
so pɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm anwonsɛm mu. Wo nimdeɛ a wowɔ fa anwonsɛm ne ɛkwan a yɛfa 
so pɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm anwonsɛm mu no bɛboa wo ama nimdeɛ afa nsɛmfua ahodoɔ ne 
kasasua ho. Saa ɔfa yi bɛma woatwa adwene-mu-mfoni, adwene kɔ akyiri na w’ankasa 
atumi akyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma bi mu. Ɛbɛsan aboa wo ama woatumi ate nkatedeɛ ahodoɔ 
ase ama woaahyɛ wo ho so wɔ tebea biara mu na ɛbɛma woahunu nyansa pa ara. 
Ɔfa yi ne adesuadeɛ ahodoɔ bi te sɛ abakɔsɛm, Borɔfo kasadwini ɛnna nnwontoɔ wɔ 
twaka bi, and music. Ɔfa yi boa ma yɛ ne afoforɔ dwene bom na ɛsan da nsɛnnahɔ 
bi adi fa abakɔsɛm dwumadie, amammerɛ ne amanneɛ ne asetena mu nsɛm bi adi. 
Worewe anwonsɛm agu wo tirim na wode ato dwa no boa ma adwene no tu mpɔn, 
nya akokoɔduru san hunu badwam kasa mu nimdeɛ.
ADWEMPƆ TITIRE
• Anwonsɛm yɛ kasadwini fa bi a yɛtwerɛ no wɔ nsensanneɛ kwan so wɔ nkyekyɛmu 
ahodoɔ mu a ɛnam mfoniyɛ so de adwempɔ, osuahunu, atenka ne deɛ ɛkeka ho to 
dwa.
• Onipa a ɔka anwonsɛm no, yɛfrɛ no anwonsɛmkafoɔ. Anwonsɛmkafoɔ yi de kasasu 
ahodoɔ bi te sɛ nnyegyeeɛkorɔ, mita, adwenem-deɛ ne mfoniyɛ di dwuma nam so de 
nsɛm ahodoɔ ne atifiasɛm to dwa.
• Anwonsɛm kasa aseteɛ nyɛ mmrɛ te sɛ nsɛm nkaeɛ no a onipa biara ntumi nkyerɛ 
aseɛ.

Dwumadie 10.2 Anwonsɛm ahodoɔ ho adesua
Montena akuakuo mfa nhwehwɛ anwonsɛm ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa na monkyerɛkyerɛ 
mu nkyerɛ mo afɛfoɔ. Ma w’ankasa nhwɛsoɔ sɛ wobɛtumi a.
Anwonsɛm su
1. Adwenem mfoniyɛ: Ɛgyina nsɛmfua ahodoɔ so twa mfoni fa biribi ho kyerɛ wɔ 
akenkanfoɔ adwenem a ɛbɛnya nsunsuansoɔ wɔ wɔn atenka so.
2. Nnyegyeeɛ: Yei yɛ nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ, nnyegyeeɛ sononko, alitirehyin, asonanse ne 
nnyegyeeɛ-sɛ-aadwene a ɛboa ma anwonsɛm no tie yɛ anika.
3. Bɔbea ne nhyehyɛeɛ: Yei yɛ sɛdeɛ wɔsi hyehyɛ anwonsɛm no te sɛ nkyekyɛmu 
ahodoɔ ne nsensaneɛ no tenten a ɛwɔ nsunsuansoɔ wɔ anwonsɛm no nteaseɛ ne 
emu duru so.
4. Mita ne Ɛnne-mu-nsakraeɛ: Yei yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa ɛnne mu nsakraeɛ ho: sɛ 
ɛbɛkɔ soro anaa ɛbɛkɔ fam ɛsiane nsɛnsini a ɛwɔ nsensaneɛ bi mu a ɛma ngyegyeeɛ 
sononko bi.
5. Nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ: Yei nso yɛ nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ nsensaneɛ biara 
awieeɛ a ɛda dwom su ne nkaeɛ bi adi wɔ anwonsɛm no mu.
6. Nsensaneeɛ ne Nkyekyɛmu: Nsensaneɛ ne anwonsɛm biara nnyinasoɔ na 
nsensaneɛ ahodoɔ na ɛkeka bom bɛyɛ nkyekyɛmu a ɛwɔ nsunsuansoɔ fa sɛdeɛ ne 
ka no bɛsi akɔ ne ne nsɛntitire a ɛde to dwa no so.
7. Kasasu: Ɛde nnyinahɔma, asesɛsɛm, sɛ-nipa, ne anihanehane di dwuma nam so de 
nteaseɛ a emu dɔ pa ara to dwa na ɛma nkyerɛkyerɛ mu amapa bi kɔ so.
8. Asɛntitire: Yei yɛ adwempɔ pɔtee anaa asɛm pɔtee a a anwonsɛm bi de to dwa ne 
titire, deɛ ɛfa nnipa suahunu ne wɔn atenka ahodoɔ ho.
9. Tebea ne Atenka: Nneyɛeɛ a ɔkasafoɔ no da no adi fa biribi a ɔreka ho asɛm 
anaasɛ, ɔda no adi kyerɛ ɔkenkanfoɔ no (tebea) ɛnna nsunsuansoɔ a anwonsɛm no 
nya no wɔ akenkanfoɔ so (atenka).

10. Mfoniyɛ: Nneɛma a yɛtumi de gyina hɔ ma adwempɔ anaa nimdeɛ bi ma ɛda 
nteaseɛ sononko bi adi.
11. Nsɛmfua Dwumadie: Nsɛmfua ahodoɔ a kasadwumfoɔ no de di dwuma ne ne 
nteaseɛ ahodoɔ a ɛnya nsunsuansoɔ wɔ anwonsɛm no tebea, atenka ne mfoniyɛ 
no so.
Dwumadie 10.3 Adesuafoɔ no nyinaa ka anwonsɛm bi bom
Ma wo kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nka anwonsɛm fa bi na bɔ mmɔden sɛ, wobɛkenkan adi 
n’akyi sɛ wobɛtumi a.
Anwonsɛm so mfasoɔ
1. Ɛma kasasua ho nimdeɛ: Anwonsɛm boa ma ɔkenkanfoɔ no nya nsɛmfua foforɔ, 
nnyinahɔma, ne ɔkasa no ka ho nimdeɛ ahodoɔ.
2. Ɛboa adebɔ: Anwonsɛm boa ma yɛtumi de yɛn ankasa nimdeɛ bɔ anaa nwono 
nsɛm bi de kyerɛkyerɛ yɛn adwempɔ ahodoɔ mu.
3. Ɛma yɛdwene kɔ akyiri: Anwonsɛm mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm boa ma yɛn adwene mu bue, 
tumi kyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm mu san nya mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm ho nimdeɛ ahodoɔ.
4. Ɛma yɛnya tema: Anwonsɛm boa da nnipa nkatedeɛ, osuahunu ne nhunumu adi 
na ɛnam so ma yɛnya tema ne nteaseɛ wɔ yɛn asetena mu.
5. Ɛde abakɔsɛm ne amammerɛ to dwa: Anwonsɛm da nsɛm bi adi fa yɛn abakɔsɛm, 
amammerɛ ne asetena mu nsɛm adi.
6. Ɛboa akaakaeɛ ne kasa no ka ho nimdeɛ: Yɛrekaakae na yɛaka anwonsɛm bue yɛn 
adwene mu, ma yɛn akokoɔduro ne badwam kasasua ho nimdeɛ.
7. Ɛboa nkɔmpɔbuo: Anwonsɛm boa adesuafoɔ ma wɔda wɔn adwene, wɔn atenka 
ne wɔn suahunu adi.
8. Ɛboa ahohyɛsoɔ: Anwonsɛm boa adesuafoɔ ma wɔte nsɛm bi ase sane hyɛ wɔn 
nkatedeɛ so na yei ma wɔtumi hyɛ wɔn nnipadua so wɔ nneɛma bebree ho. 
Adesuafoɔ no bɛtumi de anwonsɛm no mu asɛntitire ne nsɛm ahodoɔ no adi 
dwuma.
9. Ɛboa ma yɛte kasasu ahodoɔ ase: Anwonsɛm kyerɛkyerɛ adesuafoɔ no biribi fa 
kasasu ahodoɔ bi te sɛ, mfoniyɛ, nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkasa ne deɛ ɛkeka ho ho. Saa 
kasasu ahodoɔ yi boa ma yɛn kasa mu yɛ dɛ anaa kama.
Dwumadie 10.4 Anwonsɛm so mfasoɔ
Wo ne wo nnamfonom mmienu (2) anaa deɛ ɛboro saa nyɛ ekuo na 
mompɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm anwonsɛm so mfasoɔ mu sɛ kasadwini fa bi. Fa adwempɔ 
ahodoɔ a yɛde ato dwa wɔ ɛsoro hɔ no ne w’ankasa wo nimdeɛ ahodoɔ ka ho.
