Anwonsɛm nhyehyɛeɛ
Anwonsɛm wɔ esu ahodoɔ yi nyina a ɛka bom yɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ
1. Nsensaneeɛ: Anwonsɛm biara wɔ nsensaneeɛ ahodoɔ a ɛde di dwuma wɔ mu.
2. Nsensaneeɛ no tenten: Nsensaneeɛ biara tenten anaa ne tiatia no gyina nsɛmfua 
anaa kasasin dodoɔ a ɛkura.
3. Nkyekyɛmu/Ɔfa: Nsensaneeɛ ahodoɔ na ɛkeka bom bɛyɛ ɛkuo baako ma yɛnya 
nkyekyɛmu/ɔfa.
4. Nnyegyeeɛ Ntimu: Ɛyɛ nnyegyeeɛ pɔtee bi a ɛtumi ti ne ho mu wɔ nsensaneeɛ 
binom awieeɛ.
5. Mita: Yei nso yɛ nsɛnsini a yɛtwem ne deɛ yɛntwem ho nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ anwonsɛm.
6. Fiiti: Yei yɛ mita ahodoɔ a ɛyɛ nsɛnsini ahodoɔ a yɛakeka abom.
7. Ɛngyamɛnte: Ɛyɛ ɛkwan a yɛfa so kyekyɛ ɔkasamu anaa kasasini mu wɔ nsensaneeɛ 
ahodoɔ mu wɔ ɛberɛ a yɛmfa atwerɛ mu agyinahyɛdeɛ biara nni dwuma.
8� Kaesura: Yei yɛ nsensaneeɛ mu ahomegyeɛ/agyinaeɛ ahodoɔ.
9.Atwerɛdeɛ kɛseɛ: Nsensaneeɛ ahodoɔ no mu biara de atwerɛdeɛ kɛseɛ na ɛhyɛaseɛ.
Yɛnam anwonsɛm nhyehyɛeɛ ahodoɔ no so di dwuma a ɛdidi soɔ yi;
• Ɛma anwonsɛn no nhyehyɛeɛ kɔ yɛ sɛ nnwom.
• Ɛboa ma anwonsɛm no mu nteaseɛ da hɔ fann.
• Ɛda atenka ne tebea a ɛwɔ anwonsɛm no mu adi.
• Ɛboa ma akenkanfoɔ no hunu sɛdeɛ anwonsɛm no akenkan bɛkɔ so afa.
• Ɛde adwene mu mfoni-twa bi ka anwonsɛm no dwumadie ho.
ANWONSƐM MPƐNSƐMPƐNSƐMU
Nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhyɛ no nso wɔ ɛberɛ a yɛrepɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm 
anwonsɛm mu
1.  Hwɛ twaka a ɛda atifiasɛm no ne anwonsɛm no mu nsɛm ntam.
2.  Hwɛ asɛm a anwonsɛm no de reto dwa anaa ɔtwerɛfoɔ no botaeɛ a ɔgyinaa so

3. Hwɛ sɛ ɔkasa a ɔde dii dwuma no aseteɛ yɛ den anaa mmrɛ na hwɛ sɛnti a ɔde saa

4. Hwɛ tebea a ɔtwerɛfoɔ no wom fa adeɛ ɔreka ho asɛm no ho ne ɛkwan a ɔrefa so

5. Pɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm atenka a anwonsɛm no de to dwa.

Dwumadie 10.5 Anwonsɛm su ne ne nhyehyɛeɛ akaakaeɛ.

1. Montena baanu baanu na monkaakae mo ho anwonsɛm su ahodoɔ no. Monnyina

Dwumadie 10.6 Anwonsɛm mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu
Kenkan anwonsɛm no ne ne mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm a ɛwɔ fam hɔ no. W’ankasa twerɛ 
wo nsɛm gu gu hɔ sɛdeɛ ɛbɛboa wo wɔ berɛ a wobɛpɛ sɛ, wobɛpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm

(Nkyekyɛmu mmienu a ɛdi kan na yɛde ato hɔ reyɛ mu mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm no)
 DADDY
You do not do, you do not do
Any more, black shoe
In which I have lived like a foot
For thirty years, poor and white,
Barely daring to breathe or Achoo.
Daddy, I have had to kill you.
You died before I had time _____
Marble-heavy, a bag full of God,
Ghastly statue with one gray toe
Big as a Frisco seal

Source: https://www.matrix.edu.au/beginners-guide-poetry/how-analyse-
rhyme/#analyse
Akwan ahodoɔ a yɛfa so yɛ mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm
Step 1: Kenkan anwonsɛm no nyinaa den
Worekenkan anwonsɛm Daddy den no yɛ osuahunu foforɔ koraa; emu nsɛm no ano yɛ 
den na ɛte akoma nso.
Ɛnhyɛda nni nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ a ɛtene . Nkyekyɛmu ahodoɔ no mu biara da nso firi 
afoforɔ ho, yei ma no yɛ den sɛ wobɛyɛ nsusuiɛ bi afa ho.
Wosan hunu no ntɛm so sɛ, Plath de nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ dii dwuma maa no boroo so, ne 
titire ne ‘oo’ nnyegyeeɛ no.
Yei ma anwonsɛm no kenkan yɛ ɔhyɛ na ɛma no ka akenkanfoɔ tirim kyɛ.
Step 2: Anwonsɛm no asekyerɛ
Yɛbɛkyerɛ anwonsɛm Daddy mu nkyekyɛmu mmienu pɛ ase wɔ saa nhwɛsoɔ yi mu. 
Nanso, ɛsɛ sɛ bere biara wokyerɛ anwonsɛm no nkyekyɛmu no nyinaa ase sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ 
a wobɛtumi ahunu ɛsu ahodoɔ a wɔde dii dwuma ne wɔn nsunsuansoɔ wɔ mu yie.
Nneɛma ahodoɔ a ɛda adi wɔ anwonsɛm no mu:
Yɛhunuu ‘oo’ nnyegyeeɛ no wɔ nkyekyɛmu mmienu no nyinaa mu wɔ anim, mfinimfini 
ne nsensanneɛ ahodoɔ akyi.
Nkyekyɛmu 1: Nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ no yɛ AAABA
Yɛhunu asɛmfua ‘foot’ sɛ ɛyɛ A ɛfiri sɛ, ɛnhyɛda nsɛ nnyegyeeɛ a ɛdi kan no
Nsensanneɛ nnum no mu nnan kura nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ.
Nkyekyɛmu 2: Nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ no yɛ ADEFG
Nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ‘A’ a ɛwɔ nkyekyɛmu baako (1) mu no tene kɔ nsensanneɛ 
a ɛdi kan wɔ nkyekyɛmu mmienu (2) no so.
Nsensaneeɛ no mu biara nni hɔ a wɔkura nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ. Yei kyerɛ sɛ, nnyegyeeɛ-
korɔ a ɛwɔ nsensaneeɛ no mu biara yɛ sononko wɔ saa nkyekyɛmu mmienu (2) no mu.
Step 3: Hwehwɛ nsunsuansoɔ a anwonsɛm no da no adi
Seesei a, woahunu Plath nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ nhyehyɛeɛ no, ma yɛnhwɛ nsunsuansoɔ a 
anwonsɛm no da no adi wɔ berɛ a yɛremmua nsɛmmisa a ɛdidi soɔ yi:
1. Nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ anwonsɛm no mu sesa anaa? Adɛn nti a?
Anwonsɛm no nkyekyɛmu no mu biara ne ne nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ nhyehyɛeɛ; nnyegyeeɛ-
korɔ a ɛwɔ anwonsɛm no mu nyɛ adekorɔ (nte bo-korɔ so).
129
ANWONSƐM
Gyinapɛn 2Ɔfa  10
Nkyekyɛmu no mu bi nsensanneɛ awieeɛ kura nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ɛnna ɛbi 
nso nhyɛda nni bi.
Nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ka anwonsɛm no nyinaa bom, ne saa nti, nkyekyɛmu a 
nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ nhyehyɛeɛ nnim no sɛe anwonsɛm no nhyehyɛeɛ na ɛmma wontumi 
nyɛ nsusuiɛ papa biara mfa ho. Yei ma anwonsɛm no kenkan ne ɛmu dwumadie 
nwie mudie.
2. Ne nhyehyɛeɛ no da fam anaa ɛmu yɛ den? Adɛn nti a?
Nsɛmfua a ɛde nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ no ba ne nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ no nhyehyɛeɛ no mu yɛ 
den.
Plath de nnyegyeeɛ ‘oo’ no dii dwuma maa no boroo so wɔ anwonsɛm no mu. Yei 
ma anwonsɛm no kenkan ne ne sua yɛ den, na ɛnya nsunsuansoɔ wɔ nsɛntitire a 
ɛwɔ anwonsɛm no mu so te sɛ: nhyɛsoɔ, abufuo ne owuo.
3. Tebea bɛn na anwonsɛm no da no adi?
Anwonsɛm no wɔ dwontoɔ su a ɛma no da adi sɛ mmofra anwonsɛm nhyehyɛeɛ. 
Ne saa nti, anka ɛsɛ sɛ ɛmu nsɛm no yɛ agodie na ɛda fam no nanso, anwonsɛm no 
mu nsɛm no yɛ awerɛhoɔ ne ɔhaw.
4. Ɛda nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ nhyehyɛeɛ bi adi?
Nsɛmfua a ɛde nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ ba (‘oo’ nnyegyeeɛ) no boa ma yɛnya nnyegyeeɛ-
korɔ, ɛwom sɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ no nyɛ adekorɔ wɔ wɔ anwonsɛm no mu. Nnyegyeeɛ 
no da adi prɛkopɛ; na ɛma anwonsɛm no dwontoɔ su no da fam na ɛkɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ. 
Bio, ‘oo’ nnyegyeeɛ a na ɛti ne ho mu no ma anwonsɛm no nnyegyeeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ 
da adi te sɛ keteke nnyegyeeɛ : “choo choo, choo choo” pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Step 4: Nteaseɛ bɛn na ɛda no adi?
Saa berɛ a yɛahwɛ anwonsɛm no nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ nhyehyɛeɛ nsunsuansoɔ no, ɛberɛ 
aso sɛ yɛhwɛ ne nteaseɛ nso!
1. Ɛkasa fa adeɛ pɔtee bi ho?
Dwene anwonsɛm no nsɛntitire bo ho.
Anwonsɛm Daddy yɛ ɔbaakofoɔ nkutahodie a Plath nam so daa n’atenka ne 
n’adwene fa ayɔnkofa bɔne a ɛda ɔne ne papa ntam.
Nsɛntitire a anwonsɛm no da no adi no mu bi nie:
Ahokyerɛ, abufuo, owuo, bɔbea ne tumi
Afei, ma yɛnkaakae yɛn adwene mfa deɛ yɛhunu faa nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ ho wɔ atrapɔeɛ 
a atwam no mu ho.
Plath de nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ (ne titire ne ‘oo’ nnyegyeeɛ) dii dwuma maa ɛboroo so na 
ɛnam so ma anwonsɛm no kenkan ne ne dwumadie yɛ yea.

 Anwonsɛm yi dwontoɔ su no te sɛ mmofra anwonsɛm pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ne saa nti, ma yɛmfa deɛ yɛhunuiɛ no ntoto Plath nsɛntitire no ho
 Nnyegyeeɛ ‘oo’ a ɔde dii dwuma maa no boroo so no kyerɛ tebea na Plath 
wom; ɛduru berɛ bi a na abufuo ne ɔtan a ɔwɔ ma ne papa ne ne kunu kɔ soro 
pa ara.
 Nsɛm a ɛyɛ hu na ɛka akoma ne anwonsɛm no nhyehyɛeɛ su a ɛsɛ mmofra 
anwonsɛm no ma yɛn nhunum bi fa Plath mmofra-berɛm ho a anka ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ 
anigyeɛ ne agodie nko ara, nanso na wanya adwene mu haw ɛsiane ne papa 
nneyɛeɛ ahodoɔ no nti.
2. Ɔtwerɛfoɔ no botaeɛ ne sɛn?
Nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ nhyehyɛeɛ no da Plath tebea ne n’adwene adi. Yei boa ma yɛhunu 
nsɛntitire ne adeɛ anwonsɛm no rekasa afa ho pɔtee na ɛma yɛ akwanya ma yɛn ho 
hyɛ Plath tebea a na ɔwom no mu bi.
Step 5: Bɔ deɛ wohunuiɛ no nyinaa tɔfa wɔ kasapɛn baako 
mu
Seesei, ɛberɛ aso sɛ woka deɛ wohunuiɛ no nyinaa bom wɔ kasapɛn baako mu
Plath da aniayea ne nhyɛsoɔ tumi a na ɔhyɛ aseɛ adi wɔ anwonsɛm Daddy mu. 
Nnyegyeeɛ ‘oo’ a ɔde dii dwuma boroo soɔ wɔ anwonsɛm no mu te sɛ, “You”, “Jew”, 
ne “Achoo”, no ma anwonsɛm no da ahomteɛ mfoniyɛ bi adi fa nnipa a wɔwɔ nhyɛsoɔ 
tumi bi ase no refa mu. Plath twii ne papa ne ne kunu anim wɔ anwonsɛm no mu ɛnna 
ɔsan kasa tiaa wɔn fa ateetee a na wɔde no refam no ho. Ne saa nti, nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ 
nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛnyɛ adekorɔ wɔ anwonsɛm no mu no da n’abufuo ne n’atenka a na ɔwom 
fa mmarima a wɔrehyɛ ne soɔ no ho. Anwonsɛm nkyekyɛmu no mu bi nsensanneɛ 
nnum no mu nnan na ɛwɔ nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ (nsɛmfua a ɛtwa nsensanneɛ ahodoɔ a 
ɛwɔ nkyekyɛmu baako (1) to: ‘do’, ‘shoe’, ‘foot’, ne ‘achoo’) wɔ berɛ a nkyekyɛmu a 
ɛtoa so no nso mu nsensanneɛ baako pɛ na ɛne nkyekyɛmu ɛdi kan kura nnyegyeeɛ-
korɔ (nsɛmfua a ɛtwa nsensanneɛ no biara to wɔ nkyekyɛmu mmienu (2) mu: ‘you’, 
‘time’, ‘god’, ‘toe’, ne ‘seal’). Ɛsiane sɛ ‘oo’ nnyegyeeɛ no gyina brane no, nkyekyɛmu 
a ɛkura nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ no twe adwene si tebea bi so na ɛyɛ ahomete nso, na ɛreda 
n’abufuhyeɛ adi. Ne saa nti, Plath ka n’atiefoɔ no anim fa nhyɛsoɔ ne ateetee ho ne 
nsunsuansoɔ a ɛde ba nnipa so.

2. Kyerɛkyerɛ anwonsɛm su a ɛdidi soɔ yi mu: adwempɔ, adwene mu mfoniyɛ, 
tebea/atenka ne nsɛmfua dwumadie.
3. Kyerɛ nsunsuansoɔ ahodoɔ a esu ahodoɔ no nya wɔ akenkanfoɔ no so.
4. Pɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm anwonsɛm so mfasoɔ wɔ yɛn daadaa asetena mu.
5. Gyina anwonsɛm nhyehyɛeɛ ahodoɔ no so twerɛ w’ankasa anwonsɛm na 
pɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm mu kakra.
6. Twerɛ anwonsɛm su ahodoɔ no.
7. Twerɛ akwan ahodoɔ wobɛfa so apɛnsɛmpɛnsɛm anwonsɛm mu ne sɛnti a woka 
no saa.
8. Twerɛ w’ankasa anwonsɛm na kyerɛ n’adwempɔ, nnyegyeeɛ-korɔ ne ne 
nsunsuansoɔ.
9. Kyerɛ anwonsɛm su ahodoɔ no so mfasoɔ wɔ anwonsɛm twerɛ mu.

GLOSSARY
Affix A grammatical form that is attached to a word at either the beginning.
Affixation The process of adding affixes to roots or stems to form new words.
Ballad A narrative poem meant to be sung, with simple meter and rhyme, 
often telling folklore or romantic stories.
Borrowing The process of acquiring new words from another language.
Clipping The process of shortening an existing word to form a new one.
Coda The final consonant of a syllable.
Comma A punctuation mark (,) indicating a pause or separating items in a list.
Compounding The process of putting two or more existing words together to form a 
new one.
Conjunction A word that joins two or more words, phrases, or clauses in a sentence.
Coordination 
conjunctions
Conjunctions that link equal parts of a sentence.
Correlative 
conjunctions
Paired conjunctions generally used at two points in a sentence.
Culture The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular group or society.
Customary Traditional practices passed down through generations.
Derivational 
affix
An affix that changes the class of a word it is attached to.
Dramatic 
Poetry
A poem written in verse to be spoken, involving dialogue among 
characters.
Elegy A reflective poem that laments loss, often exploring mourning and 
reflection.
Epic Poetry A lengthy narrative poem recounting heroic deeds or adventures.
Free Verse Poetry free from regular meter or rhyme scheme.
135
Goal A clearly defined objective or desired outcome.
Head word The central element in a phrase.
Human rights Principles concerned with equality and fairness, ensuring freedom and 
protection.
Indigenous Original occupants of a land or region.
Infix An affix placed between two parts of a word.
Inflectional 
affix
An affix that maintains the class of the word it is attached to.
Intonation Pitch changes that occur across a sentence.
Lexicon An inventory of sounds, words, etc. in a language.
Litigant A party involved in a lawsuit, either the accused or defendant.
Lyric Poetry A short poem expressing personal emotions or thoughts, often musical.
Meter and 
Rhythm
The pattern of stressed and unstressed syllables in a line.
Monogamy The practice of marrying one person at a time.
Obstacles Challenges or barriers that hinder progress.
Ode A lengthy poem that praises an event, individual, or idea.
Pitch The rate of vibration of vocal cords during speech.
Poem A verbal composition conveying experiences, ideas, or emotions.
Polygamy The practice of having multiple spouses at the same time.
Prefix An affix attached at the beginning of a root/stem.
Puzzle A game or problem requiring logical or strategic thinking to solve.
Relative adverb An adverb that heads an adjective clause.
Rhyme Scheme The ordered pattern of rhymes at the ends of lines.
Riddle A puzzle or brain teaser using clever language to conceal an answer.
Rules Constraints or guidelines that must be followed.
Slash A diagonal line used to show options, dates, or fractions.
Solution The final answer or outcome.
136
Solution Path A sequence of steps or decisions leading to the goal.
Sonnet A 14-line poem with a specific rhyme scheme and meter.
Source 
language
The language from which a text is translated.
Starting Point The initial situation or setup.
Subordinating 
conjunction
Conjunctions that link a dependent clause to an independent one.
Suffix An affix attached at the end of a root/stem.
Summary A condensed version of an original text.
Syllabic 
consonant
A consonant that functions as the nucleus of a syllable.
Syllabification The process of dividing a word into syllables.
Target language The language into which a text is translated.
Text A piece of written work.
Transitive verb A verb that uses a direct object to show who or what receives the action.

FOREWORD
Ghana’s new Senior High School Curriculum aims to ensure that all learners achieve 
their potential by equipping them with 21st Century skills, knowledge, character 
qualities and shared Ghanaian values. This will prepare learners to live a responsible 
adult life, progress to further studies and enter the world of work. This is the first time 
that Ghana has developed a Senior High School Curriculum which focuses on national 
values, attempting to educate a generation of Ghanaian youth who are proud of our 
country and can contribute effectively to its development.
The Ministry of Education is proud to have overseen the production of these Learner 
Materials which can be used in class and for self-study and revision. These materials 
have been developed through a partnership between the Ghana Education Service, 
teacher unions (Ghana National Association of Teachers- GNAT, National Association 
of Graduate Teacher -NAGRAT and the Pre-Tertiary Teachers Association of Ghana- 
PRETAG) and National Subject Associations. These materials are informative and of 
high quality because they have been written by teachers for teachers with the expert 
backing of each subject association.
I believe that, if used appropriately, these materials will go a long way to transforming 
our Senior High Schools and developing Ghana so that we become a proud, prosperous 
and values-driven nation where our people are our greatest national asset.
Haruna Iddrisu MP
Minister for Education

PAMPANA KULTAA YELTUURI
Pampana ŋa, yelpaala mine kpɛ la te saaŋkonnoŋ kultaa yeltuuri poɔ, a yeli ŋa taa la 
yelsonne ane faaloŋ ko a te kultaa yeltuuri. Yeli mine naŋ wa ne a yelpaala ama mine 
la ama na tu:
1. Sakuuri gaabo; Sakue yaare la zie zaa, a kyaana nobe niŋe, gaŋ a zaa pɔgebilii. 
Neɛ zaa teɛroŋ yuo la ka kaŋa zaa maŋ kaa iri o sikyiri poɔ serɛ bee pɔge. A kultaa 
deme la maŋ wuli saŋa bee lɛnɛɛ ba naŋ boɔra ba kultaa. Banaŋ maŋ wuli yeltuuri 
na ba naŋ boɔra a ba kultaa zie.
2. Meŋa soobo ane dɔɔ ne pɔge zaa sentaaloŋ; A be la zie zaa ka dɔɔ ne pɔge zaa seŋɛɛ 
taa. A Ghana begre ko la neɛ zaa sori ka o so o meŋa. A ŋaa vɛŋɛɛ la ka pɔge taa 
faŋa kaŋa kyaare naboma ane kyɛmboma zaa. Pɔgeba zagre la a te saaŋkonnoŋ 
yeltuuri mine naŋ taa dɔgroŋ ko ba a bare.
3. Ŋmenpuoripaala. Ŋmenpuoripaala teseŋ Kirista puoruu ane Yɛrre puoruu kpɛ la 
ta yeltuuri poɔ ne yelpaala. Gbɛɛ yage, te maŋ de la a puori paala yeltuuri laŋ a 
saaŋkonnoŋ yeltuuri poɔ.
4. Bondaannoo, Pampana, libie la yi, ka bondaãba derɛ bondaan-pɔgeba; azuiŋ, 
saaŋkonnoŋ kultaa yeltuuri (kyilli) la.
5. Ziyuo saŋa la; Zie yuoe la ka noba zeŋ tembɛrɛ poore. Nenboore tɛɛtɛɛ la laŋ kpeɛrɛ 
a tembɛrɛ poore; azuiŋ, booreyobo yeltuuri kpɛ la te saaŋkonnoŋ kultaa yeltuuri 
poɔ.
6. Kͻmpeetarre ne Taŋgarre saŋa la; Kͻmpeetarre ne taŋgarre naŋ yi zuiŋ, duoro 
terebo ne nyaabo ba la waa ŋa a saŋa na. Dɔɔlee ne pɔgelee maŋ tōɔ tu la a ama 
poɔ a dire dɛmɛ kyɛ ka ba dɔgreba naŋ ba baŋ ba yeli.
7. Sori tuubu, sori tuubu yie la ka neɛ maŋ tu sori gaa te zeŋ nemboora mine poɔ. A 
nemboora na kultaa yeltuuri na kpɛ la te deni poɔ.
8. Ghana merɛ; Merɛ mine be be la a ba sage yel-erre mine naŋ taa dɔgroŋ ko nensaala 
gyerema. A merɛ ama taa la ferebo kaŋa ko a te saaŋkonnoŋ kultaa yeltuuri mine.
Yipɔge yɔkpɛtaa; nemboora mine saaŋkonnoŋ yɔ kpɛ la a taaba poɔ. A zuiŋ kultaa 
yeltuuri parɛɛ la lantaa.
Pampana biiri zi-leɛ; pampana biiri ba la sage dasaŋa na yeltuuri, ka a lɛ taa dɔgroŋ 
ko saaŋkonnoŋ kultaa yeltuuri. Ba maŋ yeli ka zie leɛ la.

Toma 6.16 Pampana kultaa yeltuuri
Yε zeŋ gbulo ka gbuli zaa maŋ taa noba bayoͻbo a tͻgele dẽɛne kyaare kultaa 
yeltuuri. A karendie zaa di dεmε kyaare a noba bama toma a kultaa poͻ, teŋa 
nembεrε, pͻgeba, ane a kultaa deme. Yε di dεmε kyaare a saaŋkonnoŋ kultaa 
yeltuuri yelwonni mine kyε soŋ taa bͻ sobie na te naŋ na tu ka a yelwonni ama 
ŋmaa bare.
Sori na te naŋ na tu ka a yelpaala ama sigri a te 
saaŋkonnoŋ kultaa yeltuuri poɔ
A seŋ ka lamboore ane teɛroŋ zuluŋ kpɛ a poɔ ka te toɔ bɔ a yeli ŋa zu kpulluu.
Dabie mine te naŋ na tu la a ama naŋ tu:
1. Yipɔge duobu; Te leɛ nyɔge te saaŋkonnoŋ yelmaale ane te sagedeebo ka o are 
soŋ. Te tendaa zaa lamboore seŋ ka o wa. Ka te wuli teɛroŋ ko taa a na nyɔge a te 
yipɔge kpeɛŋaa.
2. Nembɛrɛ ane baapaalba lamboore; a seŋ ka nembɛrɛ ane baapaalba di dɛmɛ a wuli 
taa teɛroŋ kyaare a te yipɔge. A ŋa na soŋ la ka te bɔ yelnyɔgeraa kaŋa naŋ na 
gu a te saaŋkonnoŋ, gaŋ a zaa, saaŋkonnoŋ kultaa yeltuuri. A ŋa na vɛŋ la ka a 
baapaaba taa gyeremɛ ko a ba yipɔge kyɛ ka a pampana yel-erre meŋ nyɛ arezie.
3. Wulluu ane teɛtaa: ka neɛ zaa nyɛ wulluu kaŋa ane sommo na naŋ na soŋ ka a soba 
are o gbɛɛ zu. A soba ŋa na taa la gyerema ko a o yipɔge. Te kultaa yeltuuri poɔ, 
ka te bare sori ko yelpaala kyɛ naŋ nyɔge te saaŋkonnoŋ velaa.
4. Zenɛ kultaa leɛ la libiyɛlɛ. Nandaana koŋ la baŋ de pɔge, ka taŋgaraa zu kultaa 
enfuomo pãã sãã a zie zaa. A seŋ ka te kaa a yeli ŋa velaa.
Toma 6.17 a pampana kultaa yeltuuri yelsonne
Gbulo poͻ, yε wuli yelsonne ata a pampana kultaa yeltuuri poͻ. Wuli a yε nͻ-irri 
ko a gbulo na mine a karendie poͻ.
Toma 6.18 kultaa yeltuuri zu kaabo
A yε gbulo poͻ, di dεmε kyaare yele ata te naŋ na e a gu a te saaŋkonnoŋ kultaa 
yeltuuri ka a ta kpi. Wuli a yε nͻ-irri ko a yε taaba a gbulo na mine poͻ.

KYƐYUOBU
A foͻlaa ŋa wullo la yɛlɛ kyaare yipͻge bal yeltuuri ane saaŋkonnoŋ noba kaabo 
meɛroŋ fo naŋ zanne a yuon boŋyeni poͻ. A wɛlemɛ ŋa pare bammo na vɛle la fo niŋe 
ka fo toͻ gyɛle bal yeltuuri ane saaŋkonnoŋ noba zu kaabo meɛroŋ kyaare boore tɛɛtɛɛ 
naŋ be Ghana poͻ. Fo naŋ gyɛle la a bal bal yeltuuri ane a yelsonne naŋ kͻlage yipͻge 
zaa naŋ be a Ghana poͻ. De a peɛrenyɛre ama pɛre ne fo saaŋkonnoŋ/yipͻge yeltuuri. 
Yipͻge bal yeltuuri ane saaŋkonnoŋ noba zu kaabo parebammo waa la yelnimizeɛ 
bonso o naŋ soŋ la ka fo zanne yɛlɛ yaga kyɛ sage na zanne Ghana kͻkͻɛ mine ane 
zannoo bͻgere mine aseŋ ŋmempuori yɛlɛ zannoo ane saadayeli yeltaarre . A yɛŋ ŋa fo 
naŋ zanne na teɛ la taa ne sagediibu kyaare fo yipͻge bal bal yeltuuri ane saaŋkonnoŋ 
noba zu kaabo ane bal parɛɛ mine meŋ naŋ be a Ghana poͻ.
Yelbulo
Bal la boorͻ mine naŋ laŋ zeŋ paaloŋ kaŋa poͻ. Bal kpoŋ zie zaa taa bonvore ka o waa 
ba doma. A nakpoŋ la boorͻ naŋ be a paaloŋ poͻ weder ɛ kyɛ ka nabilii meŋ waa a 
tembilii wederebɛ. A nabinime la taa sori ka biŋ namine bee a yage namine.
BAL/YIILUŊ YƐLƐ
Leɛ kaa bone na fo naŋ zanne a foͻlaa naŋ pare kyɛ iri a soorebie ama naŋ tu nͻɛ
1. Kultaa parɛɛ ata abuobo la be Ghana poͻ?
2. Manne wuli yeli kaŋa naŋ na wuli ka noba sage la a saaŋkonnoŋ kultaa yeltuuri
3. Bonso ka dͻͻ maŋ de libiri ko pͻge o naŋ na de yͻͻdͻͻ a kultaa yeltuuri mine poͻ?
4. Wuli yelpaala anaare naŋ ferɛ pampana saaŋkonnoŋ kultaa yeltuuri.
Teɛroŋ soorebiri: A yɛ gbulo poͻ, de yɛŋ na fo naŋ zanne kyaare bal a yuoni boŋyeni 
poͻ wuli ne bal muni/tɛgɛ. De a fo nͻ-iraa wuli gbuli kaŋa naŋ be a karendie poͻ.
Fo na nyɛ la mannoo tɛɛtɛɛ: Bal e la dͻgeroŋ boͻlaa yelbiri na naŋ wulo noba laŋkpeɛbo 
bee yideme naŋ laŋ saakom-yeni ane saadayeli, segeraa yuori kyɛ tu dͻgeroŋ gbɛ-
yeni. O na baŋ waa la saa pare dͻgeroŋ( saa dͻgeroŋ gbɛre) bee ma pare( ma dͻgeroŋ 
gbɛre). Bal la boorͻ mine naŋ laŋ zeŋ paaloŋ kaŋa poͻ. Bal noba bee boorͻ zaa maŋ 
yele la kͻkͻkpɛlɛ boŋyeni . Yi-ŋmama la maŋ laŋ taa a waa bal.
Bal yeltuuri be la te nensaalesͻgelͻ laŋkpeɛbo poͻ aseŋ Ghana . Peɛroo wuli ka bal bal

Yuoni 2Wɛlemɛ 7
 Bal waaloŋ
 Bal waaloŋ mine la a ama.
1. Saaŋkoma boŋyeni; ba maŋ laŋ la saaŋkompare.
2. Sotaa; bal noba maŋ laŋ la dͻgeree a waa zẽẽ noba,kultaa poɔ bee de bie yi 
ziekaŋa wa guoluu poɔ.
3. Yitaaloŋ; Bal noba yeli mine maŋ yi la taa. Teseŋ; ba yoe, ba boma bee ba yipɔge 
yel-erre.
4. Laŋ zemmo; gbɛɛ yaga, ba maŋ zeŋ la paaloŋ yeni a guuro taa, a nyɔge taa ba 
yel-erre poɔ.
5. Ba kponnuŋ poɔ; Ba maŋ taa la tutaaloŋ kaŋa kyaare nembɛree diibu, teseŋ, 
balzuzeɛ, nembɛrɛ bee naa, ka o kaara ba zu.
6. Ba maŋ taa la lɛ ba naŋ boɔla ba balenoba; teseŋ yɔɔ, areba, saa, puree amk.
7. Libi-bͻ lamboore: Balnoba maŋ laŋ koͻla ane bontarre mine.
8. Tige ane yeltuuri: Bal noba maŋ laŋ la yelmaale mine. Aseŋ kponnuŋ poͻ kpeɛbo 
yeltuuri, kultaa, koe maaloo ane saaŋkonnoŋ tige maaloo.
Bal yelsonne/ tͻna
1.  A guuro taa ba laŋkpeɛbo poɔ. Ba maŋ zeŋ la gbulo a na tōɔ kaa ba menne. A gbulo 
ama kaŋa zaa maŋ taa la ba yelboɔre.
2. Yideme nyͻgetaa: Bal maŋ teɛ la yideme ka ba are kpeɛŋaa a taa noͻre yeni ba 
laŋkpeɛbo poͻ. Ba maŋ de la ba menne ko taa ba yel-erre zaa poɔ.
3. Yitaaloŋ; balnoba yel-erre maŋ yi la taa, yipͻge saaŋkoŋ toma zaa maŋ e la yeni. 
Ka ba yipɔge yel-erre zaa waa yeni.
4.  Sontaa, a balnoba maŋ sonna la taa ba yɛlɛ zaa poɔ, ba maŋ gu la taa, yeltuo ne 
yelnoɔ zaa poɔ. A sonna taa ba wɛreŋ, a kyɛ gu ba menne yi sãã taa eŋa.
5.  Zɔɔre faaroo; balnoba zaa taa la lɛ ba naŋ maŋ tu a faare zɔɔre a ba noba poɔ. Ba

7. Yipɔge guubu; a balnoba maŋ gu la a ba yipɔge ka o ta kpi. Ba maŋ e la ka a kpɛ

8. Noba zu kaabo parekparaa la. Noba zu kaabo piiluu la balnoba zukaabo. A balzuzeɛ

9. Ba libiyɛlɛ; balnoba maŋ taa la ba sobiri kaŋa baŋ tuuro boɔra ba naboma. A zuiŋ 
ba maŋ sonnɔ la taa ba toma poɔ. Teseŋ , yaako, koɔbo amk.
10. Nyɔge taa iri; a maŋ e la ferebo ka ba soŋ a teɛ taa iri/ baa ba tonnɔɛ poɔ. Balnoba

Toma 7.1 Bal yɛlɛ parebammo
Vɛŋ ka a biiri teɛre wuli bone naŋ la bal.Teɛre o meɛroŋ, tontonne, yiibu zie amk. 
De fo yelbulo wuli a karembiiri a karendie poͻ kyɛ teɛ ne fomeŋa yelpeɛrenyɛrre.
Toma 7.2 Bal pɛre taa
1. Sɛge bal anuu yoe ane ba donne naŋ be fo laŋkpeɛboŋ kyɛ wuli yeldemannewulli 
mine ata kyaare boorͻ mine ayi .
2. De fo nͻ-irri wuli fo karembitaa kyɛ ka yɛ di dɛmɛ kyaare yitaaloŋ ane tɛɛtɛɛloŋ.
Toma 7.3 Bal Tͻna /Sieree
Yɛ zeŋ gbulo a pore kyɛ di dɛmɛ kyaare ne bal tontonne bebiri zaa yel-erre poͻ a 
yɛ laŋkpeɛboŋ
Toma 7.4 Bal tontonne
Yɛ zeŋ ayiri a wuli yelba-erre mine ata naŋ be yɛ laŋkpeɛboŋ kyaare yɛ bal (kyiire) 
ane lɛ a naŋ ferɛ fo.
Toma 7.5
Kaa iri bal kaŋa fo meŋa a sazu tabol poͻ bal bal ane ba donne) a peɛre o yɛlɛ a. Bͻ 
enfuomo naŋ wulo a balnoba naŋ maŋ yɛre ba bal bonsuuri, sini naŋ manna ba 
yipͻge yɛlɛ korͻ noba.
Toma 7.6 Bal tontonne
Ba kaairi fo la ka waa bal weder ɛ. Manne wuli yɛlɛ ata fo naŋ na e a wane noͻre 
yeni a fo noba zie. Wuli fo teɛroŋ ko fo taaba ka yɛ di dɛmɛ.

SAAŊKONNOŊ NOBA ZU KAABO MEƐROŊ
Saaŋkonnoŋ noba zu kaabo meɛroŋ e la kponnuŋ sugilitaa wulo la lɛ noba naŋ maŋ 
suglitaa ba are ziiriŋ ane ba kaŋa zaa ferebo toma ba laŋkpeɛbo, daa diibu bɔne noba 
kaabo, ane a zibɛrɛ mine.
Saaŋkonnoŋ noba zukaabo meɛroŋ yelsoore
Saaŋkonnoŋ noba zukaabo meɛroŋ yelsoore la ama naŋ tu a puliŋ:
1. Suglitaa maŋ be be la a kyaane: Nemb ɛree diibu maŋ piili la kpoŋ a kyɛ sigre 
waana a bilii poɔ. Neɛ zaa arezie maŋ taa la o ferebo toma.
2. Yelnyɔgraa zaa maŋ yi la a nembɛrɛ bama zie. A sazu nembɛrɛ te ta a bilii la maŋ 
laŋ nyɔge yeli ziyeni.
3. Po bamenne eŋ gbulo; A nembɛrɛ kpaaroo ŋa maŋ ŋmaare la ba menne eŋ gbulo 
poɔ, ka gbuli zaa taa o kɔnoɔre.
4. Gbulo toͻ kaabo; a gbulo ama naŋ ŋmaare fẽẽ fẽẽ na, a zu kaabo maŋ seŋ la kaabo.
5. Duoro emmo; A gbulo ama zaa taa la duoro emmo sobie naŋ gaŋ.
6. Ferebo tonnɔɛ; gbuli zaa taa la o ferebo toma. neɛ zaa kaara la lombori zaa ne ba 
toma.
7. Nembɛree Suglitaa; Kponnuŋ zaa taa la dabiri fo naŋ piili kyɛ duoro a kpoŋ poɔ.
Saaŋkonnoŋ noba zu kaabo kponnuŋ diibu 
sugilitaa
Yɛŋ yuo toma
1. A yɛ gbulo poͻ yɛ leɛ maale a saaŋkonnoŋ noba zukaabo meɛroŋ ŋa ka o tutaaloŋ 
tori; a yi kpoŋ te ta bile.
nabilii - kpambeere - nakponni nabinibe
2. A tutaaloŋ la ŋa;
Nakponni→ nabilii→ nabinibe→kpambeere
3. A tulaaloŋ ŋa la ka ba boͻla kponnuŋ diibu sugilitaa
A suglitaa ŋa e la dabie naŋ wulo a nembɛree meɛroŋ. O wulo la nembɛrɛ ane ba 
potuuribo.
Yɛ e te kaa a saaŋkonnoŋ noba zu kaabo sugilitaa damannaa na naŋ tu a puliŋ:

Enfuoni 7.4: Saaŋkonnoŋ noba zu kaabo meεroŋ.
Ka fooŋ kaa a kponnuŋ diibu sugilitaa,o wuli ka a saaŋkonnoŋ noba zukaabo meɛroŋ 
maŋ piili ne la a paaloŋ zaa nakpoŋ, ka nabilii tu , ka pͻgenamine tu, tendemee meŋ 
be a baaraa. Nabilii, naagufo ane baalzuzeere la a parebaaraa.
A nembɛrɛ zaa naŋ be a sugiltaa poͻ taa la ba ferebo toma kyaare vuo na poͻ onaŋ be.
Sugilitaa nembɛrɛ mine ane ba ferebo tontonne mine la a tu a puliŋ kyɛ
Nakpoŋ
Namine zaa nakpoŋ taa la faŋa a namine zaa zu a paaloŋ poͻ. Boorͻ mine poͻ o taa 
la faŋa bͻnne ne a noba zu.
1. O naŋ la a paaloŋ zaa wederɛ
2. O naŋ la maŋ biŋ begɛ kyɛ e ka toŋ toma
3. O na la maŋ de zͻͻre weɛ
4. O maŋ faare la zͻͻre naŋ be o boba sogaŋ
Nakpoŋ maŋ la a boorɔ zaa wẽdeɛrɛ. A boorɔ noba la maŋ iri o ka o de ba wẽɛ. O naŋ 
la maŋ so a zie ne a noba zaa .Ba maŋ tu la saa pare bee ma pare a di naaloŋ. Boorͻ 
mine tuuro la saapare ka bamine meŋ tuuro mapare. Boorͻ mine poͻ nakpoŋ na baŋ 
waa la a bal naa bonso o maŋ yi la bal poͻ. Yeltuuri mine la ka ba maŋ de a soba tu 
ne kyɛ pãã e ka o zeŋ a nakogi/gane a waa a nakpoŋ. Boorͻ mine poͻ a nakpoŋ na 
baŋ e la pͻge (pͻgenaa)

Nakpoŋ ferebo toma
Ama naŋ tu waa la nakpoŋ ferebo mine
1. A boorɔ zaa wẽdeɛrɛ
2. Nyɔge yɛlɛ naŋ taa sommo ko o noba.
3. Tige diibu wẽderɛ
4. Ka zeŋlaafeɛ be be kyɛ faara zɔɔre meŋ
5. Kaara a boorɔ koɔla zu
6. Guuro la saaŋkompare yipɔge
7. Teŋa yuobu/maaloo
8. A are teŋa gbɛbɔgreŋ iri soorebiri noɔre ko a teŋa zaa.
9. Biŋ merɛ ka a guuro a noba.
Nabilii
Ba e namine naŋ tuuro a nabɛrɛ puori. A nabilii bama maŋ kaara tembilii zu. Ba meŋ 
tuuro la saapare bee mapare naaloŋ diibu gbɛre. A nabilii bama naaloŋ diibu sobie 
yitaa ne la a nabɛrɛ naaloŋ diibu yeltuuri.
Nabilii ferebo toma
1. Are a Nakpoŋ gbɛbogriŋ ka a Nakpoŋ ba kyebe.
2. A guuro a paaloŋ yi nenfaare nuuriŋ
3. A ŋmaara sɛrɛɛ kyɛ faara zɔɔre
4. Kaara a paaloŋ koɔla.
5. Kaa ka zeŋlaaŋfeɛ be o paaloŋ poɔ
6. Maala a paaloŋ ŋmemɛ ane tebɛ ka yelwonaa zaa wa a paaloŋ
Boorͻ mine poͻ, nabilii po-eŋ la a ama naŋ tu a puliŋ poͻ
Nugͻͻ zennemɛ namine
Ewe boorͻ maŋ boͻle la a nugͻͻ-zennɛ naa ka ‘Miafi’ kyɛ ka Santere boͻlͻ o ka 
‘Benkumhene’. A nugͻͻ -zennɛ namine la maŋ zeŋ a naa nugͻͻ seŋ kyɛ la waa a noba 
na naŋ maŋ zeŋ a nakpoŋ nugͻͻ seŋ lammo saŋa, sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo ane zͻͻre wagere 
wederɛ.
Nudoloŋ-zennemɛ namine
A nudoloŋ-zennemɛ namine la ka Ewe maŋ boͻle ka ‘Ðusifia’, ka Santere meŋ maŋ 
boͻle ka ‘Nifahene’. Ba na la maŋ de a noba naŋ maŋ zeŋ a nakpoŋ nudoloŋ weɛ 
lammo ziiri.
A namine parɛɛ ayi ama taa la ferebo toŋkpoŋ kyaare saaŋkonnoŋ noba zu kaabo te 
laŋkpeɛboŋ. A ba ferebo toma mine la tu a puliŋ kyɛ:

1. Ba naŋ maŋ soŋ a nakpoŋ ka o ŋmaa sɛrɛɛ ane o tontonne mine poͻ.
2. Ba na la a noba naŋ maŋ zeŋ a naa nugͻͻ ane nudoloŋ seŋ wederebɛ.
3. Ba naŋ maŋ dͻre a naa.
4. Ba maŋ faare la zͻͻre kyɛ soŋ ka emmaaroŋ be a paaloŋ poͻ.

Zͻͻre Wederɛ ( Tͻbɛrɛ)
Ba boͻlͻ ba la ‘Tofuhene’ Sante poͻ ane “Aʋadada / Aʋafia” Ewpoͻ.
Tͻbɛrɛ tontonne
1. Tͻbɛrɛ la maŋ de a teŋɛ weɛ zͻͻre saŋa
2. Ba maŋ gu la teŋɛ ka zeŋlaafeɛ be be
3. Ba na tõͻ are la nakpoŋ gbɛbogri zͻͻre faaroo saŋa
Pͻgenamine
Pɔgenamine maŋ la a pɔgeba seere yɛlɛ kaabo wederɛ a ba paaloŋ poɔ. Ba maŋ kaara 
la pɔgeba ane pɔgebilii baabo yɛlɛ a ba paaloŋ poɔ. A boorɔ banaŋ naŋ tuuro bɛlo,a 
pɔgenamine la maŋ tere a nͻ-baaraa kyaare neɛ na a nadirbe naŋ ba kaairi ka o na e 
a naa. Ba meŋ na baŋ kaa iri la bameŋa pɔgeba-nabilii ka ba sonnɔ ba.
Pɔgenamine ferebo toma
1. Ka o soŋ a namine ka ba kaara a noba zu
2. Ka o maŋ maala yεlε mine naŋ ferε pͻgeba ennε a o paaloŋ poͻ
3. Teɛ pɔgeba ka bamenne soobo do saa
4. Ka o gu kyε wuli a saakompare dͻgroŋ tutaaloŋ
5. Ba naŋ maŋ tu la saaŋkonnoŋ yeltuuri mine a na maale ka pͻgelee badͻgebo yɛlɛ 
kyɛ soŋ ka ba taa emmaaroŋ
Tendaana
Tendaana la a noba seere yɛlɛ maaloo wederɛ a paaloŋ.O maŋ sanna la noba baaloŋ. 
O naŋ la maŋ soŋ ka a kpenne ane a noba yɛlɛ kpɛ taa.
Tendaana tontonne
Tendaana ferebo toma
1. Ka a teŋɛ naa ba wa kyebe a tendaana la maŋ are a naa gbɛ-bogriŋ.
2. Ba naŋ la maŋ kaara a ba paaloŋ noba seere yɛlɛ.
3. Ba ferebo toma kaŋa la ka ba iri naa kyɛ la yage naa meŋ

Nabinime
Nabinne e la neɛ bee noba mine naŋ taa yuori ba paaloŋ poɔ. Ba maŋ e la noba naŋ 
so ba menne. kyɛ ba menne koŋ baŋ di naa. A noba bama la maŋ zeŋ a kaa iri a naa 
bee a nakpoŋ.
Nabinne ferebo toma
1.  Iri neɛ naŋ ta naa diibu
2. Peɛre neɛ naŋ boɔra naaloŋ a nyɛ ka o seŋɛɛ la.
3. Maale naa kuori
4. Ba naŋ maŋ yage naa.
5. De napaalaa wuli a teŋa nembɛrɛ
6. Banaŋ la maŋ dɔre a naa.
7. Ba faara la zɔɔre a teŋa poɔ.
8. Ba naŋ la maŋ kaa ka naaloŋ yi noba mine denoɔreŋ a kpɛ denɔyuo poɔ ka zɔɔre 
ta kpɛ.
Naa Gufo
Naa gufo la a naa potuuro ayi soba a namine poͻ. O taa la tonnͻɛ yaga o laŋkpeɛbo 
poͻ. A tonnͻɛ ama na baŋ waa la tɛɛtɛɛ a yi tenne ane saaŋkonnoŋ yel-erre naŋ ba 
yitaa zuiŋ
A nimize-tonnͻɛ mine la tu a puliŋ kyɛ.
1. Ba naŋ la maŋ de a naa noͻre yɛlɛ yeli ko a noba lammo zie
2. Ba naŋ la maŋ de naa weɛ ka ba kpɛ noba poͻ lammo zie.
3. Ba naŋ la maŋ de noͻre yɛlɛ yeli.
4. Ba naŋ la maŋ tuo a naa dagbale
5. Ba naŋ la maŋ leɛrɛ a naa noͻre yɛlɛ korͻ saama

Maale saaŋkonnoŋ noba zu kaabo kponnuŋ sugilitaa dabie fo laŋkpeɛbo poͻ. De a 
sugilitaa pɛre ne noba mine deni a karendieŋ.

Toma 7.8 saaŋkonnoŋ wederebɛ ferebo toma

b. Vɛŋ ka fo ne fo taaba di dɛmɛ kyaare a fo nͻ-iraa.
Tembile kaŋa yuori naŋ di Sigiri naŋ be GYerebaa naa paaloŋ a Ghana poͻ, 
(yͻͻmine bayi da be be la a zͻͻrͻ koͻlͻ zͻͻre. A yͻͻmine bama la Tanyɛ naŋ waa

Toma 7.9 Saaŋkonnoŋ wederebɛ tontonne
Noba mine maŋ ŋmɛ la nͻkpeɛne ka saaŋkonnoŋ sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo e la mͻlͻ a gaŋ

nͻkpeɛne.

KYƐYUOBU
A foͻlaa ŋa na wuli fo la yɛlɛ kyaare saaŋkonnoŋ sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo ane pampana sɛrɛɛ 
ŋmaabo sobie.O di la dɛmɛ kyaare a sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo sobie ama ayi ane a tontonne. Fo na 
wuli la a sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo sobie ayi ama tontonne yitaaloŋ ane tɛɛtɛɛloŋ. Fo yɛŋ bammo 
ane parebammo kyaare saaŋkonnoŋ sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo ane pampana sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo na teɛ 
fo la ka fo toͻ zanne yeli-kan-yeli sobie ane fomeŋa soobo yɛlɛ. O meŋ na soŋ fo la 
ka fo zanne teɛroŋ zuluŋ ane yɛlɛ gyɛlebo gͻͻloŋ kyaare sɛrɛɛ diibu kyɛ waa neɛ naŋ 
baŋ yeli zaa kyaare a teŋe, ayi lɛ fo naŋ zanne yɛlɛ kyaare fomeŋa soobo ne fo ferebo 
toma.
A la waana meŋ a foͻlaa ŋa na teɛ fo la yɛŋ kyɛ e ka fo boͻrͻ ka fo zanne yɛlɛ kyaare 
sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo.
Yelbulo
A sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo la maŋ wuli kyɛ vɛŋ ka a paaloŋ merɛ tona toma. A sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo 
tontonziiri taa la suglitaa, ka ‘Supreme’ kͻͻto be a sazu.
• A saaŋkonnoŋ sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo maŋ de la saaŋkonnoŋ tuubu mine bee yipͻge merɛ 
mine ŋmaa ne sɛrɛɛ.
• Noba naŋ maŋ zeŋ a pampana sɛrɛɛ ŋmaa zie a ŋmaa sɛrɛɛ e la gͻmenɛte tontonneba 
(kͻͻto zuleɛreba)
• A noba naŋ maŋ zeŋ a saaŋkonnoŋ sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo zie a ŋmaa sɛrɛɛ la namine, pͻge-
namine, tendaamba, teŋa nembɛrɛ.

Sɛrɛɛ diibu yɛlɛ
Sɛrɛɛ diibu yɛlɛ kyaare la kɔɔtere bee bͻnne bͻgere ŋa naŋ maŋ wele merɛ kyɛ e ka a 
toŋ toma a paaloŋ poͻ.
Sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo tontonne
A sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo tontonne mine a ama naŋ tu:
1. O naŋ maŋ wuli a paaloŋ merɛ pare kyɛ vɛŋ ka a merɛ tona toma.
2. O naŋ maŋ vɛŋ ka yelmeŋa be be ka noba tuuro a merɛ sori.
3. Gu noba meŋa soobo ne zeŋ-lããfeɛ a seŋ lɛ a merɛ naŋ wuli.
4. Gu ka sentaa a merɛ poͻ be be. Neɛ zaa ba gaŋ a paaloŋ merɛ.
5. A faara zͻͻre noba zie, tonnͻɛ ziiri ane gͻmenɛnte tontonziiriŋ
6. A maŋ toͻ soŋ iri yeli la yi kͻͻto a maale, a sɛgere taa, a vɛŋ ko taa a maale zeŋ.
7. A gu ka gͻmenɛnte ulibɛrɛ, teseŋ, merɛ maaleba, gͻmenɛnte meŋa, ane a 
sɛreŋmaareba to gaŋ taa a ba tonnͻɛ zie.
8. A are a gͻmenɛnte gbɛbogiriŋ a tage yelbɛ-errɛ toori.
9. A gu neɛ yelbe-erɛ naŋ ferɛ a merɛ poͻ.
Pampana sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo meɛroŋ
Sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo suglitaa meɛroŋ Ghana poͻ.
1. ‘Supreme’ kͻͻto la a kͻͻto kpoŋ a sugilitaa poͻ
2. ‘Appeal’ kͻͻto la tu a ‘Supreme’ zu.
3. ‘High’ kͻͻto la a kͻͻto yɛrɛɛ, o maŋ de la sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo yɛlɛ yi a ‘supreme’ ane 
‘appeal’ kͻͻtere poͻ
4. ‘Circuit’ kͻͻto ane ‘district’ kͻͻto la maŋ kaara yideme begɛ ane yelbilii zu
5. ‘Juvenile’ bee ‘tribunal’ la kͻͻto bilii mine naŋ maŋ kaara bibiiri naŋ ba ta yuomo 
pie ne anii (18) sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo zu.
Kͻͻto tontonne
Kͻͻto la maŋ wele yeli kyɛ e ka merɛ toŋ toma. Ghana poͻ, ‘Supreme’ kͻͻto, kͻͻto 
zuleɛrɛ neŋkpoŋ la maŋ zeŋ ŋmaa sɛrɛɛ. A kͻͻto zuleɛrɛ neŋkpoŋ la a sɛre ŋmaareba 
zaa neŋkpoŋ a paaloŋ poͻ. A nembɛrɛ mine la; sɛre ŋmaareba, kͻͻto ane bamine la 
maŋ soŋ wele la a merɛ a tu be maale a yɛlɛ ka o gaŋ yeni.
Pampana kͻͻto sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo meɛroŋ
1. Sɛreŋmaara boŋyeni la maŋ zeŋ ŋmaa sɛrɛɛ a kɔɔtere ama poɔ: ‘High’ Kɔɔto, 
‘Appeal’ Kɔɔto ane ‘Supreme’ Kɔɔto.
2. Sɛreŋmaareba bata bee banuu la maŋ zeŋ ŋmaa sɛrɛɛ a kɔɔtere ama poɔ: ‘Appeal’ 
kɔͻto ane ‘Supreme’ kɔɔto.

3. Wagere mine a Sɛreŋmaara ne noba naŋ sonna o la maŋ zeŋ a ŋmaa sɛrɛɛ.
4. ‘Magistrate’ la maŋ ŋmaa sɛrɛɛ ‘district’ kɔɔto poɔ.

Pampana sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo sobie
A sobie ama maŋ yi la kɔɔto na poɔ a yeli naŋ be, a yeli na pare naŋ la, ane bone naŋ 
wa ne a yeli. A ama naŋ tu la a meɛroŋ naŋ be a sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo poɔ:
1. A yeli deme na te sɛge la ba duoro.
2. A kɔɔto na zenne ba la a nyɔge a yeli bɔgere zaa lanta. Ba yelnyɛrre,ane dããseɛ 
deme ka ba na de lantaa a kyɛ.
3. A sɛredire pãã na ŋmaa la sɛrɛɛ.
4. Ona na naŋ ba sage taa la sori ka o gaa ‘Appeal kɔɔto’.
Note: Wagere kaŋa a noba naŋ taa a yɛlɛ a kͻͻto poͻ na baŋ iri la yɛlɛ gaa ne yiri te 
maale.

Toma 8.2 sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo yɛlɛ Ghana poͻ

Toma 8.3 Zͻͻre Faaroo Sobie
Dabuo ane Bayͻͻ waa la wetaaba kyɛ maŋ laŋ ŋmeɛrɛ bͻl a sakuuri poͻ.Ba sakuuri 
ane sakuuri yuo da ŋmɛ la bͻl kya kya. A ba sakuuri ane sakuuri kaŋa da ŋmɛ a bͻl 
baaraa ka ba nyɛ a onaŋ naŋ na di . Bayͻͻ da ba baŋ ne a kyɛ leɛ ŋmɛ a bͻl eŋ ba 
zie a leɛ di bameŋa. A ŋaa da vɛŋ la ka ba da ba di a bͻl kya kya. Dabuo suuri da 
iri la yaga ka o yeli ka Bay ͻͻ ba seŋ ne ka o e a bͻl-ŋmeɛreb ɛ zuzeɛ. Vi da kpɛ la 
Bayͻͻ ka o fale Dabuo gbɛre buyi ka ba deɛ piili ŋmeɛrɛ nͻkpeɛne. A yeli ŋa boͻrͻ 
la maaloo ka a zͻͻre ta gaa tͻͻre.
a. Manne wuli sobie na fo naŋ tu kyɛ faare a zͻͻre ane fo ananso.

Saaŋkonnoŋ sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo yɛlɛ
A saaŋkonnoŋ sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo taa la merɛ mine bee nɔbinni mine ba naŋ de tona ne 
toma sɛre ka yelsɛgebinni sɛrɛɛ ŋmaa te naŋ taa zine. A saaŋkonnoŋ sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo 
sobie poͻ noͻre la ka ba maŋ wolle ne a yɛlɛ. A sɛreŋmaareba maŋ la: namine, teŋa 
nembɛrɛ, balzuzeere, tendaamba ane nembɛrɛ naŋ taa gyerema a noba zie a teŋa poɔ.

Enfuoni 8.2: A enfuoni ŋa wulo la namine ane teŋɛ nembɛrɛ la saaŋkonnoŋ sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo poͻ
A zɔɔre ama maŋ taa la kpɛzie a yipɔge yel-erre poɔ. Te maŋ tu la te saaŋkonnoŋ 
yelmaale poɔ ane a te sagediibu poɔ kyɛ faare a zɔɔre. A sobie ama ba bala a paaloŋ 
merɛ naŋ gu te zaa zeŋ lããfeɛ. Zɔɔre na mine te naŋ maŋ tu saaŋkonnoŋ maale la, yiri 
poɔ yelbawontaa, koɔla yeli, kyiire sããmo yeli, ane neɛ naŋ bɛle o tɔ.
Saaŋkonnoŋ zɔɔre faaroo sobie mine ba naŋ tu a maale yelbawontaa saaŋkonnon poͻ;
1. Maaloo: Neɛ naŋ ba poͻ a z ͻͻre poͻ la maŋ daa yi omeŋɛ na soŋ maale a yɛlɛ a 
noba bayi kpakyaga ka a maa. A yelmaala ba maŋ tu begɛ naŋ sɛge biŋ kyɛ maale 
a yɛlɛ.
2. Sɛrɛɛ ŋmaabo: A zͻͻre faaroo sobiri ŋa maŋ ba maŋ de begɛ maale a yɛlɛ. Namine, 
balzuzeere teŋɛ nembɛrɛ ane sɛre-di nembɛrɛ mine la maŋ ŋmaa a sɛrɛɛ.
3. Vɛŋ ko taa: O boͻbo zaa la ka emmaaroŋ,noͻre yeni ane nͻmmo be a noba na naŋ 
taa a yelbawontaa. Yidaadͻbͻ bee balzuzeere ane a teŋɛ nembɛrɛ la maŋ kyaara 
maala a.
4. Sɔretaa: A kyɛ, ba maŋ de la dɛmɛ diibu kpɛ ne a yɛlɛ maaloo poͻ ana sͻre a noba 
na naŋ taa a yelbawontaa ka na bare a yɛlɛ ka a baare

a lɔba nɔ-iri. A ŋa maŋ wa ne la nɔyeni kaŋa a noba poɔ.

Lͻͻbo: Soͻre bata ne ba bibiiri bonyeni boŋyeni la tu sori, a gɛrɛ te ta mane. Mane-
gbori na naŋ be be na tõͻ de la noba bayi yoŋ a lͻnne wagere dayeni.Kyɛ ka soͻre

ŋmaa a mane ba zaa?
Iruu: Te de ka ba la Aa, Bb, Cc.(‘A’ , ‘B’ ane ‘C’ ) la a sͻmamine kyɛ ka ‘a’,’b’ ane ‘c’ 
meŋ waa ba biiri) Dɛndɛŋ,(a) ne (b) na de la a gbori lͻŋ te bare (a) kyɛ ka (b) leɛ wa 
de (c) te lͻŋ ne. ka (b) ne (c) te lͻŋ , ba na de la a gbori ko (a) ka o de wane ba manine 
zie. Ka onaŋ wa ta , o na are la o ma zie,’A’ la lɛ, kyɛ de a gbori ko ‘B’ ne ‘C’ ka ba lͻŋ 
gaa ba biiri zie. Ka banaŋ wa lͻŋ gaa ba biiri zie wa baare ‘B’ ne o bie ‘b’na leɛ de la 
a gbori la leɛ lͻŋ gaa ne zie na A ne o bie ‘a’ naŋ be na. ka banaŋ te ta ‘A’ ne ‘B’, ba 
mamine la lɛ, ba na bare la a ba biiri na kyɛ de a gbori lͻŋ gaa zie na ‘C’ ne o bie naŋ 
are na. Ka banaŋ te ta ba na de la a gbori ko ‘C’ bie na, ‘c’ la lɛ, ka o de gaa te de ‘a’ 
wa lͻŋ ne a la leɛ gaa te de ‘b’ meŋ wa lͻŋ ne. ba zaa la ŋmaa bee lͻŋ a mane.

GLOSSARY
Affix A grammatical form that is attached to a word at either the 
beginning.
Affixation The process of adding affixes to roots or stems to form new 
words.
Ballad A narrative poem meant to be sung, with simple meter and 
rhyme, often telling folklore or romantic stories.
Borrowing The process of acquiring new words from another language.
Clipping The process of shortening an existing word to form a new one.
Coda The final consonant of a syllable.
Comma A punctuation mark (,) indicating a pause or separating items 
in a list.
Compounding The process of putting two or more existing words together to 
form a new one.
Conjunction A word that joins two or more words, phrases, or clauses in a 
sentence.
Coordination 
conjunctions
Conjunctions that link equal parts of a sentence.
Correlative 
conjunctions
Paired conjunctions generally used at two points in a sentence.
Culture The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular group 
or society.
114
Customary Traditional practices passed down through generations.
Derivational affix An affix that changes the class of a word it is attached to.
Dramatic Poetry A poem written in verse to be spoken, involving dialogue 
among characters.
Elegy A reflective poem that laments loss, often exploring mourning 
and reflection.
Epic Poetry A lengthy narrative poem recounting heroic deeds or 
adventures.
Free Verse Poetry free from regular meter or rhyme scheme.
Goal A clearly defined objective or desired outcome.
Head word The central element in a phrase.
Human rights Principles concerned with equality and fairness, ensuring 
freedom and protection.
Indigenous Original occupants of a land or region.
Infix An affix placed between two parts of a word.
Inflectional affix An affix that maintains the class of the word it is attached to.
Intonation Pitch changes that occur across a sentence.
Lexicon An inventory of sounds, words, etc. in a language.
Litigant A party involved in a lawsuit, either the accused or defendant.
Lyric Poetry A short poem expressing personal emotions or thoughts, often 
musical.
Meter and Rhythm The pattern of stressed and unstressed syllables in a line.
Monogamy The practice of marrying one person at a time.
Obstacles Challenges or barriers that hinder progress.
Ode A lengthy poem that praises an event, individual, or idea.
Pitch The rate of vibration of vocal cords during speech.
Poem A verbal composition conveying experiences, ideas, or 
emotions.
Polygamy The practice of having multiple spouses at the same time.
Prefix An affix attached at the beginning of a root/stem.
Puzzle A game or problem requiring logical or strategic thinking to 
solve.
Relative adverb An adverb that heads an adjective clause.
Rhyme Scheme The ordered pattern of rhymes at the ends of lines.
Riddle A puzzle or brain teaser using clever language to conceal an 
answer.
115
Rules Constraints or guidelines that must be followed.
Slash A diagonal line used to show options, dates, or fractions.
Solution The final answer or outcome.
Solution Path A sequence of steps or decisions leading to the goal.
Sonnet A 14-line poem with a specific rhyme scheme and meter.
Source language The language from which a text is translated.
Starting Point The initial situation or setup.
Subordinating 
conjunction
Conjunctions that link a dependent clause to an independent 
one.
Suffix An affix attached at the end of a root/stem.
Summary A condensed version of an original text.
Syllabic consonant A consonant that functions as the nucleus of a syllable.
Syllabification The process of dividing a word into syllables.
Target language The language into which a text is translated.
Text A piece of written work.
Transitive verb A verb that uses a direct object to show who or what receives 
the action.

FOREWORD
Ghana’s new Senior High School Curriculum aims to ensure that all learners 
achieve their potential by equipping them with 21st Century skills, knowledge, 
character qualities and shared Ghanaian values. This will prepare learners to live a 
responsible adult life, progress to further studies and enter the world of work. This 
is the first time that Ghana has developed a Senior High School Curriculum which 
focuses on national values, attempting to educate a generation of Ghanaian youth 
who are proud of our country and can contribute effectively to its development.
The Ministry of Education is proud to have overseen the production of these 
Learner Materials which can be used in class and for self-study and revision. 
These materials have been developed through a partnership between the Ghana 
Education Service, teacher unions (Ghana National Association of Teachers- GNAT, 
National Association of Graduate Teacher -NAGRAT and the Pre-Tertiary Teachers 
Association of Ghana- PRETAG) and National Subject Associations. These materials 
are informative and of high quality because they have been written by teachers for 
teachers with the expert backing of each subject association.
I believe that, if used appropriately, these materials will go a long way to 
transforming our Senior High Schools and developing Ghana so that we become 
a proud, prosperous and values-driven nation where our people are our greatest 
national asset.
Haruna Iddrisu MP
Minister for Education

PILIGU
Yaɣili ŋɔ piini wuhiri bachjilli, bachijilli biɛhigu ni yee baŋsim. Yaɣili ŋɔ bɔhimbu 
nyaaŋa, a ni tooi ti waliginsim shɛli din be bachijil’ shɛli din ka nyaaŋa mini din 
mali nyaaŋa Dagbani puuni ka kahigi bachijilli biɛhigu ni ni sɔŋdi bachinima 
nambu puuni. A ni lahi bɔhim yee ka ni tooi pu yee balibu kamani din du, din lu, 
din lura, ni ŋan pahi. A ni mali baŋsim zaŋ jɛndi yee zaŋ nam Dagbani bachi pala. 
Bahigu, yaɣili maa ni kahigi yee tuma Dagbani puuni nti pahi bachinima, giraama 
ni balli yɛltɔɣa balibu tuma.
TƐH’ GAHINDA
• Bachijilli nyɛla bachi yaɣili di ni ni tooi boli shɛli.
• Bachijilli konsɔnanti nyɛla konsɔnanti shɛli din nahiŋgban ŋmani bachijilli.
• Yee nyɛla kukoli taɣiri shɛli din ni tooi tahi bachi gbunni taɣibu na.
BACHIJILLI, DI BLIBU NI BIƐHIGU
Bachijilli Buɣisibu
Bachijilli nyɛla yɛltɔɣa yaɣ’ shɛli din mali vaawuli, din ni tooi be bachi muni maa 
zaa puuni. Di ni tooi lahi nyɛ yaɣ’ shɛli ti vuhim ni lura bachi bolibu. Shɛhira, a 
vuhim ni lu yim a yi booni duni [du.ni]. Dinzuɣu, duni malila bachijila ayi. Amaa 
vuhim lubu ka tu [tu] bolibu puuni, dinzuɣu ti ni yɛli ni di malila bachijil’ yini. Di 
zuɣu, bachijila ala (vuhim lubu) ka a tɛhi ni di be Bagabaga [ba:ga:ba:ga] puuni?
Vaawulinima ŋan nyaaŋa, bachijila konsɔnantinima kamani /m, n, ŋ/ ni tooi nyɛ 
bachijila. Dimbɔŋɔ tooi niŋdimi di yi niŋ ka vaawuli bi doli konsɔnantinima maa. 
Shɛhira, [m]. Bachjilli ni tooi nyɛ vaawuli ko ka ka konsɔnanti bee ka di nyɛ 
konsɔnanti nyɛkpurugu ko. Bachi ni tooi nyɛ bachijil’ yini, bee bachijila ayi bee 
bachijil’ bɔbigu. Ŋa shɛhira shɛŋa n-do gbunni ŋɔ.
1. Bachijil’ yini bachi:  da [da], lu [lu]
2. Bachijila ayi bachinima: daŋa [da.ŋa], ŋubi [ŋu.bi], Adam [A.dam]
3. Bachijil’ bɔbigu bachinima: wulijo [wu.li.jo], firigima [fi.ri.gi.ma], Tamali 
[Ta.ma.li]

YUUNI LI SHƐM MINI KARIMBU
PILIGU
Yaɣili ŋɔ kahigirila yɛltɔɣikpana baŋbu lahabali, bee lahabali puuni. Yi ni pili 
bɔhim karimbu din ziligi mini karimbu din yɛligi. Yi ni kahigi baŋsim shɛŋa din 
kpa talahi zaŋ chaŋ sasabira bee ŋun yɛri yɛltɔɣa yɛltɔɣikpana ka bɔhim di ni yɛn 
niŋ shɛm n-zaŋ bɛ tɛha ŋɔ wuhi salo ban wumdi alizama dibu ni viɛnyɛla. Yaɣili ŋɔ 
lahi kpini baŋsim yaɣ’ shɛŋa kamani Silimiinsili mini Daadama Biɛhigu Bɔhimbu 
(Social Studies) ni zuliya shɛŋa yɛltɔɣa.
TƐH’ GAHINDA
Yɛlkpan’ shɛli din be lahabali puuni n-nyɛ di ni ʒiri yɛltɔɣikpan’ shɛli lahabali ni ʒira. 
Dimbɔŋɔ ni tooi be yɛltɔɣ’ shɛli din ʒiri yɛltɔɣikpani ka mali yɛltɔɣ’ shɛŋa ŋan kahigira. 
Karimbu ni tooi nyɛ din ziligi bee din yɛligi.
• Karimbu din ziligi nyɛla m-maai nii n-karindi binshɛli kam m-bɔri lahabali ka gbaai 
sasabira nia.
• Karimbu din yɛligi nyɛla n-karindi lahabli din galisi pam ni di pahi bachi gahinda 
mini viɛnyɛla karimbu ni n-kpaŋsi binshɛli kam gbaabu.
YƐLTƆƔIKPANA BAŊBU ALIZAMA NI
Tɛhibu bɔhigu: tɛhi labi karindu’ yini, bɔ n-nyɛ yɛlkpani? Zaŋmi a tɛha m-baɣisi 
bɔŋ maa zaa tɛha ka naan yi karim di ni nyɛ shɛli gbunni ŋɔ.
Yɛlkpani: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ yɛltɔɣ’ shɛli din kpa talahi satarili, lahabali, alizama dibu 
puuni. Dimbɔŋɔ yɛrila baŋsim yaɣili, lahabali bee alizama maa daliri. Yɛlkpana 
malila ŋan sɔŋdi kahigiri ŋa ka ŋa be lahabali bee alizama maa puuni. Ŋan sɔŋdi 
mini yɛlkpana ni kpini taba shɛm baŋbu sɔŋdi yɛlkpani maa baŋbu. Ŋan do gbunni 
ŋɔ nyɛla di ni tooi doli shɛli m-baŋ yɛlkpani lahabali puuni.
Karimmi yuli maa mini piligu: Di tu ni a bo yuli maa mini piligu maa ni yɛli shɛli 
zaŋ kpa baŋsim yaɣ’ shɛli di ni kahigiri lahabali maa puuni.
Bɔmi yɛltɔɣ’ shɛli din ʒiri yɛltɔɣikpani shee: Yɛltɔɣ’ shɛli din ʒiri yɛltɔɣikpani maa 
tooi bela satarili piligu. Di tu ni a lahi baŋ ni saha shɛli di ni tooi nya yɛltɔɣ’ shɛli 
din ʒiri yɛltɔɣikpani maa satarili maa sunsuuni bee di bahigu kuligu ni

Yɛltɔɣ’ shɛŋa ŋan sɔŋdi baŋbu: Din yɛn che ka a baŋ yɛltɔɣ’ shɛli din sɔŋdi maa, 
bɔhimi a maŋa bɔhisi ŋɔ: ŋuni, bɔ, bɔ saha, ya, bɔ zuɣu ni wula zaŋ chaŋ yɛlkpani 
maa polo.
Kolivaai: Zaŋmi a maŋmaŋa bachinima n-kolivaai lahabali maa.
Maɣisibu: Zaŋmi a kolivaai m-maɣisi lahabal’ shɛli a ni karim maa kolivaai.
Karimbu din ziligi
Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla m-maai nii n-karindi binshɛli kam ni a nya lahabali ni ʒiri baŋsim 
shɛli, biɛhigu ni yɛltɔɣa nahiŋgbana gbaari shɛli din zilima. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhirimi ni 
a karim la lahabali ni nimmoo ka sabi di kahigibu sɔŋ. A ni bo bachi gahinda shee 
Bachi gahinda ŋan be lahabali puuni gbuna ni booibooi mi, dalimmi, di ŋmɛbu yimi 
na gari di taba, labiboli, ŋan pahi. Din pahi, n-sabiri yɛligbahira sɔŋda, bachinima 
gbunni bɔbu gbunni buku ni ni n-karindi kulisi sunsuuni di ni nya binshɛli di ni 
karim maa gbaari zilinli pahila karimbu din ziligi puuni.
Tuma 2.1 Pari-karim mini Pari-vihi kahigibu
Yi daa bɔhim pari-karim mini pari-vihi yuun’ yini puuni, wuhimiya di zaɣ’ yini 
kam yi bɔŋ ni, ka naan yi kahigi soya atata shɛŋa di ni doli pari-karim mini 
pari-vihi puuni. Zaŋmi a tɛha m-maɣisi ŋan sabi do gbunni ŋɔ.
KARIMBU DIN ZILIGI NAHIŊGBANA
Karimbu din ziligi nahiŋgbana pam ka di ni tooi baŋ amaa, bɔhimbu ŋɔ puuni, yi 
ni bɔhim nahiŋgbana ayi shɛŋa ti ni booni pari-karim mini pari-vihi.
Pari-karim
Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla n-vihi bo yɛltɔɣikpan’ shɛli din be lahabali maa puuni. A ku gbaai 
binshɛli kam lahabli maa ni dama a bi karim lahabali maa zaa. Dimbɔŋɔ tumdi 
tuma viɛnyɛla lahabal’ shɛŋa ŋan nya yɛlmaŋli.
Pari-vihi
Dimbɔŋɔ m-mali a nina yuuni yomyom m-bɔri bachi shɛŋa shee lahabali ni. Di 
niŋdila dimbɔŋɔ m-bɔri bɔh’ shɛŋa labisibu.
Tuma 2.2 Yɛltɔɣikpani baŋbu
1. Karimmi lahabali din do gbunni ŋɔ.
2. Baŋmi yɛltɔɣikpani lahabal’ shɛli di ni ti gbunni ŋɔ.
3. Zaŋmi di ni baŋ yɛltɔɣikpan’ shɛli maa n-wuhi ka maɣisi a karimbi’ taba.

ANZANSI
N ni daa nye yuma anahi m bilim ni, n daa kɔŋ m ma ka da bi mi binshɛli zaŋ 
kpa m ba polo bee o biɛhigu shee. N ni daa mali yiko daa nyɛla m be n dɔɣiriba 
sani, bɛ shɛba n da ana ʒin mi ba naɣila n ni daa ti be bɛ sulinsi ni. N dɔɣiriba 
maa so daa bi bɔri ni o pii ma zuɣulɛm nti tiri m n yɛlibɔra ni gbɛbu shee. Di 
daa kuli miri yuun’ pianianahi ka n chanimi gindi lɔhiri n dɔɣiriba maa yinsi; n 
daa na ʒin be so yiŋa bee shikuru shɛli n-kuli paai yuuni. Din lahi pahi n chaŋ 
gili maa ni, n dɔɣiriba maa shɛba daa yuunila m biɛhigu maa zuɣu ka niŋdi 
ma fukumsi shɛŋa n ni ku tooi nya suhudoo n-yɛli. N daa yi bɔrila suhudoo n 
taba sani shikuru ni dama ni ko n-daa nyɛ luɣ’ shɛli din tiri ma suhudoo ka n 
tooi tamdi binshɛŋa ŋan niŋdi yiŋa m biɛhigu ni. N yuum’ pia ni, n daa n daa 
kpaŋla m maŋa n-tumdi tuma Asibiri ni Alahiri ni shikuru bahibu saha ni n 
sɔŋdi lihiri m maŋa. N daa yi tumdila lɛbira tuma ya mɛbu shɛhi, n daa zaŋdi 
ŋarim n-gbahiri zahim mɔɣa mini kulisi ni ka daa lahi tumdi kuɣa bɔɣibu 
tuma duri ni. Dimbɔŋɔ daa nyɛla din di yuum’ pia ka n daa sɔŋ liɣiri hali nti 
naai siinia haai. Din daa niŋ ma nyaɣisim daa nyɛmi, n daa na tooi kuli mali 
zaɣa zaŋ kpa m bɔhimbu polo ka daa leei shikurubihi zuɣulana n ni daa ti saɣi 
Haai Shikuru yibu. N daa naaya ni shɛhira gbaŋ shɛli din daa viɛli pam.
Tuma 2.3 Tɛh’ suma baŋbu
1.  Bɔŋbɔŋ puuni, kahigimiya alzama dibu lahabal’ shɛli din do gbunni ŋɔ ka 
wuhi yɛltɔɣikpana maa.
2. Zaŋmi yɛltɔɣikpana maa n-wuhi karimduu maa zaa.
Jilima tibu daanfaani
Bipuɣiŋga: Haai, a na min tɛhi din che ka jilima tibu mali anfaani pam?
Bidibiga: Iin, n tɛhiya ni di nyɛla n-doli zalisi mini n-tiri fukumsinima jilima.
Bipuɣiŋga: Yɛlmaŋly, Jilima tibu yaɣi n-kuli doli zalisi zuɣu. Di nyɛla dihitabili, 
jilima ni n-zaŋ maŋ ti. Tɛhimi saha shɛli a ni tiri a laamba jilima, a wuhiri ba mi 
ni a dihi bɛ fukumsi tabili
Bidibiga: Di mali yɛmbahiŋga. Amaa ka di yi niŋ ka fukumsinima ka yɛlmaŋli?
Bipuɣiŋga: Yɛlmaŋmali. N kuli tiri jilin’ shɛli a ni mi bi viɛla. Di tu ni ti bɔhiri ka 
bɔri neesim saha shɛli di yi tu. Amaa, jilima kuli chɛrimi ka biɛhigu chani viɛnyɛla 
ka che ka ti mali suhudoo.
Bidibiga: N na ʒin tɛhi li kpa lala polo.
Bipuɣiŋga: Zaŋmi tum tuma – jilima tibu nyɛla din nyɛ biɛhigu pam nyɛb’ shɛli 
din mali timsim: ba-bia, karimba-karimbia, tumalana-tuun’ tumd. Di kpaŋsiri 
dihitabili ka sɔŋdi zoobu.
Bidibiga: A mali yɛlmaŋli. N ni kpaŋ a maŋa n-niŋ zaɣa ni jilima tibu m maŋmaŋa 
biɛhigu ni.

Tuma 2.4 Alizama Dibu
 Niriba ayiyi, nammiya alizan’ shɛli din ŋmani alizan’ shɛli din do zuɣusaa 
ŋɔ ka di jɛndi laati, tabibi baŋsim daanfaani bee sabita daanfaani ka zaŋli 
nam sinii n-ti karinduu maa zaa. Che ka karinduu maa kahigi bɛ tɛha zaŋ kpa 
yɛltɔɣikpani ni nyɛ shɛli.
Tuma 2.5. Karimbu din ziligi baŋsim
Karimmi lahabal’ shɛli din do gbunni maa ka labisi bɔhisi ŋan doli li na.
1. A bɔŋ puuni zaŋmi pari-karim baŋsim n-baŋ ka sabi sɔŋ yɛlkpana ayi shɛŋa 
ŋan yi lahabali mma puuni na ka zaŋ ŋa wuhi bɔna din pahi maa.
2. Zaŋmi pari-vihi baŋsim m-baŋ sasabira maa ni tɛhi ni binshɛli kpa talahi ni 
karimbakpema maa mali zali.
Karimbakpema maa n-nyɛ ŋun mali shikuru maa fukumsi. Ŋuna n-nyɛ 
ŋun wuhiri shikuru so’ shɛŋa din yɛn mali biɛhigu zaŋ chaŋ wuhibu ni 
bɔhimbu, niriba ni mali shɛli bɔri maligu, niŋsim shɛŋa, ni yɛl’ shɛŋa tuma 
duri ni mala kamani karimbanima karimduu tuma kpaŋsibu mini zalisi din 
gbubi tuma, shikurubihi kpaŋmaŋa din pahi. Ka lahi mali baŋsim shɛli din 
din yɛn che ka tuun’ viɛla tumda din kpa talahi ni shikuru toontibo Daniel 
Duke (1989) wuhiya ni biɛh’ suŋ nia nyɛla din simdi, amaa di pa la din saɣi 
ni di sɔŋ n-kpansi toontibo baŋsim bɔbu shee. Karimbakpema maa tu ni o 
zaŋ so’ shɛŋa ŋan yɛn che ka shikuru zalisi tumdi tuma din yɛn kpaŋsi biɛh’ 
suŋ ka ti shikurubihi maa zaa shikuru biɛh’ shɛli din mali nintiɣibo ka lahi 
gbarigi biɛr’ yoya.
KARIMBU DIN YƐLIGI NAHIŊGBANA
Tɛhibu bɔhigu: Zaŋmi a karimbu din ziligi baŋsim n-kolivaai a ni tɛhi ni karimbu 
din yɛligi ni nyɛ binshɛli. Ka naan yi zaŋ li maɣisi di ni nyɛ shɛli gbunni ŋɔ.
Karimbu din yɛligi nyɛla a yi karim lahabal’ bɔbigu ni a wum nyaɣisim ni a 
karim ziligibu zuɣu nti pahi neesim zaŋ chaŋ yɛltɔɣa biɛh’ kɔŋkɔba ni n-nya bachi 
pala. Karimbu balibu ŋɔ yɛligiri a karimbu baŋsim, hala ni suhuyurilim nti pahi 
n-yɛligi a yɛltɔɣa yɛlibu baŋsim a ni karindi lahabal’ bɔbigu pam.
Karimbu din Yɛligi Nahiŋgbana
Karimbu din yɛligi nahiŋgbana n-do gbunni ŋɔ;
Karim viɛnyɛla: N zaŋ karimbu milinsi n-karim di ni tu ni di karim shɛm.
Lahabali biɛhigu
Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla sasabira ni pe o ɛha shɛm, baŋsim ni lahabal; shɛli din be lahabali 
puuni. A ni tooi zaŋ a zaɣa n-niŋ baŋsim gahinda ni ka buɣisi binshɛli din yɛn doli

na a yi gbaai lahabali biɛhigu. Dimbɔŋɔ gba sɔŋdi zahindi a gbaabu a yi karindi

Zahimbu
So’ shɛŋa di ni doli n- a maŋmaŋa karimbu soli n-karimgbaai. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhirimi 
ni a ni tooi baŋ ni a gbaai a ni karim binshɛli. A ni tooi zani ka labi karim bee 
n-vihi n-nya gbaabu ka naan yi tuɣi n-karim.
Milinsi
Saha shɛli ŋun karindi ni zaŋ lahabal’ shɛli din bi yini viɛnyɛla lahabali ni naai 
bee m-buɣisi. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni a ni kpahim binshɛli din be kulisi maa ni lahabal’ 
shɛli a ni mali n-wuhi lahabali maa ni nyɛ shɛli. Buɣisibu maa bee naari shɛŋa a 
ni mali maa dolila baŋsim shɛli a ni puun mala.
Zahimbu
Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla ŋun karindi yi namdi tɛha, n-wuhiri zaashee lahabali karimbu mini 
karim naai saha. Ŋun karindi namdi tɛha o yi niŋ vihigu zaŋ kpa lahabali dariza 
mini di daanfaani nyaaŋa din yɛn che ka di gbaai lahabali maa mini lahabali maa 
yɛlmaŋli.
Sabita nyɛla daadam daalafee mini jilima nyɛbili. Di laɣimla saɣiri ni ko’ daɣiri bee 
shinshɛbina viɛnyɛla gbubbu ni di gu dɔriti ka kpaŋsi sabita. Sabita du’ viɛla kamani 
baanjiriti, kulum soya ni saɣiri guŋgɔna nyɛla ŋan simdi salo daalaafee gubu ni. 
Sabita kalinsi ni tooi wuligi dɔriti kamani tiri ka nyɛra, binsaa ni kpaɣiʒiɛɣu n-kuri 
daadambiɛligu ban ka kalinli duniya ʒii zaa. Din lahi pahi, sabita bi gbarigirila daadam 
niŋgbuna ko, di mali bukaata ni biɛh’ suŋ.
Tuma 2.6 Karimbu din yɛligi nahiŋgbana

Ka naan yi, zaŋ a ni tɛhi ni lahabali ŋɔ ni tooi yɛligi. Wula ka sasabira maa di

Jilima Yaa
Jilima pa la binshɛli di ni ni tooi deei amaa di nyɛla binshɛli di ni bɔra. Di nyɛla 
biɛh’ suŋ nyɛbili, ti maŋmansi sunsuuni bee tuma shee. Yi yi ti shɛba jilima, ti 
wuhirimi ni bɛ tɛha, suhu ni biɛhigu ni tarisi mali dariza.
To zahimmi n-chaŋ kpe karimduu, luɣ’ shɛli nira kam ni puhiri o kpee ka bɛ suhuri 
ni nee ka tɛhigu kani Luɣ’ shɛli karimbanima mini karimbihi ni be kahigir’ shɛli din 
mali gbunni, n-wumdi viɛnyɛla n-tiri taba tɛha. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ jilima ni ŋmani shɛli.
Jilima pa la ti ni kuli niŋdi shɛba shɛm: di lahi nyɛla ti ni niŋdi ti maŋmansi shɛm. Ti 
maŋmansi jilima tibu wuhiri ni ti saɣi deei ti dariza, n-deeri ti biɛh’ shɛli din waligi 
ti ka che ti taba ka yooni ti niŋgbuŋ zuɣupuri daalaafee.
A yi kpɛri ka yiri haai shikuru, teemi ni jilima nyɛla yaɣa-yi soli. Timi a taba jilima, 
karimbanima ni ʒilɛli ka tɛhiri ni so ti a jilima labisi.

ZULIYA YƐLTƆƔA MINI ŊA TUMA 
Bachinima mini Ŋa Biɛhigu ni Sabbu zalisi Dagbani ni
PILIGU
Yaɣili ŋɔ ni, a bɔhim bachituɣira, bachipala nambu so’ shɛŋa, ni biɛlimpahira zaŋ 
tum tuma Dagbani ni. A yi nya baŋsim zaŋ kpa biɛlimpahira mini bachituɣira 
polo, di ni sɔŋ a ka a tooi nam yɛltɔɣa din mali gbunni Dagbani ni. Di ni sɔŋ 
n-wuhi a ka a zamzam bachipala nambu soya Dagbani ni. Bachipala nambu so’ 
shɛŋa a yi ni yɛn yuli n-nyɛ bachibɔbigu taba laɣimbu, bachinima yaɣa ŋmahibu, 
bachinima paŋbu, ni biɛlimpahira.
TƐHA GAHINDA
• Biɛlimpahirili nyɛla giraama biɛlin’ shɛli ti ni mali m-pahiri bachi zuɣu, di ni tooi nyɛ 
bachi maa tooni, sunsuuni bee di bahigu. Biɛlim pahira balibu nyɛla diba ata; tooni 
biɛlimpahira, nyaaŋa biɛlimpahira ni sunsuuni biɛlimpahira. Biɛlimpahira nyɛla din 
pahiri bachinima bee nyaɣa zuɣu n-namdi bachinima bee n-wuhiri bachinima tuma.
• Bachituɣira nyɛla din mali shɛli n-tuɣiri bachinima, yɛltɔɣiŋmasɔri ni tɛha ka di 
sɔŋdi n-namdi yɛltɔɣa din mali gbunni.
• Biɛlimpahira tuma zuliya ni nyɛla di sɔŋ n-nam bachipala.
• Bachinima nambu nyɛla so’ shɛŋa din che ka ti namdi bachipala ni girama neembɔra 
din pun m-be ti zuliya ni.
BIƐLIMPAHIRA
Biɛlimpahira ni nyɛ shɛli: Biɛlimpahira nyɛla mɔfim shɛŋa di ni zaŋ pahi jilikpeeni 
zuɣu n-nam bachi palli bee bachi biɛhigu. Di ni tooi lahi kahigi biɛlimpahira ka 
ŋa nyɛ giraama biɛlinli di ni zaŋdi pahiri bachi piligu bee bahigu ka di ni tooi 
taɣi di gbunni. Biɛlimpahira ŋan yoli pam n-nyɛ tooni biɛlipahira mini nyaaŋa 
biɛlimpahira. Biɛlimpahirili yi pahi bachi nyaɣili zuɣu, di gbunni taɣirimi n-lɛbi 
bachipalli bee gbunni palli. Biɛlimpahira yi pahi bachinima zuɣu, di tooi taɣiri di 
gbunni bee bachi maa pubu.’
Biɛlimpahirili nyɛla tooni biɛlimpahirili di yi do nyaɣili maa tooni.
Biɛlimpahirili nyɛla sunsuuni biɛlimpahirili di yi be nyaɣili maa sunsuuni.
Biɛlimpahirili nyɛla nyaaŋa biɛlimpahirili di yi ti kana bachi nyaaŋa.
Biɛlimpahira shɛhira Dagbani ni n-nyɛ –nima, -ra, -mi, -la, -ya, da-, n-.
Biɛlimpahira shɛhira Fanti/Kambɔnsili ni n-nyɛ a-, m-, n-, fo-, -nom, re-.

Ŋmaligi n-kpa a kpee n-kahigi biɛlimpahira ni nyɛ shɛli. Kpaŋmi a maŋa

Biɛlimpahira balibu: Biɛlimpahira balibu dibaayi shɛŋa ti 
ni mali Dagbani n-nyɛ ŋan bi taɣiri gbunni bee bachi pubu 
mini ŋan taɣiri gbunni bee bachi pubu na
Ŋan taɣiri gbunni bee bachi pubu: Ŋannima n-nyɛ biɛlimpahira shɛŋa ŋan 
namdi bachi pala bee gbunni palli. Ŋan taɣiri gbunni bee bachi pubu, bachi 
jilikpeeni maa pubu mini bachi palli shɛli di ni nam maa ni tooi nyɛ zaɣ’ yini bee 
kɔŋkɔba. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni biɛlimpahira ŋan taɣiri gbunni waliginsim na ni tooi 
din bi tahiri bee din tahiri bachi pubu taɣibu na. biɛlimpahira ŋan tahiri taɣibu 
bachinima gbunni bee pubu na nyɛla ŋan namdi bachi pala din waligi ka che 
ŋa jilikpeeni. Shɛhira:Dagbani bachi da din nyɛ Bachiniŋdili ŋɔ ni tooi leei dara 
(bachinamdili) ti yi zaŋ nyaaŋa biɛlimpahirili -ra m-pahi da maa zuɣu. Kpe ŋɔ ti 
Nyaya ka bachi maa nyabili din nyɛ bachiniŋdili ŋɔ pubu taɣi n-lɛbi bachinamdili.
Biɛlimpahira ŋan bi tataɣiri gbunni bee bachi pubu: Ŋannima nyɛla biɛlimpahira 
shɛŋa ŋan taɣiri bachi biɛhigu ko pa di gbunni bee di pubu. Ŋan bi tataɣiri 
gbunni bee bachi pubu bi taɣiri bachi gbunni dinzuɣu ŋannima bi namdi 
bachi pala. Ŋannima wuhirila kalinli, paɣitali bee dotali, niŋsim saha ni ŋan 
pahi. Di wuhirimi ni di yi zaŋ biɛlimpahira ŋan bi tataɣiri gbunni bee bachi pubu 
m-pahi baci shɛli din wuhiri nivuɣ’ yino di ni tooi taɣili li n-leei ninvuɣ’ bɔbigu. 
Shɛhira, n-zaŋ biɛlmpahirili -si m-pahi nooŋ-a zuɣu di ni titi noon-si. Bachinima 
ŋɔ pa la bachi kɔŋkɔba bee bachi pubu bal’ kɔŋkɔba.

bɔbili. Di tuuli tuma kuli nyɛla di zaŋdila yɛltɔɣa yaɣa tuɣiri taba. Bachibuɣisira

Tuma 3.6 Bachituɣira tuma yɛltɔɣa ni
Sabimi bachituɣira balibu shɛhira diba ata ka zaŋ ŋa n-nam yɛltɔɣa. Niŋmi 
shili n-zaŋ li n-wuhi a karinzɔŋ ni nima ka kahigi daliri din che ka a pii lala 
yɛltɔɣa maa.
Bachituɣira tuma daanfaani
Bachituɣira tuma balibu ni tooi wali bala ni, amaa di shɛŋa ni tooi nyɛ yim. Lala 
dina maa shɛŋa n-nyɛ:
• Di kahigiri daliri bee n-yihiri daliri polo
• Di sɔŋdi n-laɣindi yɛltɔɣiŋmahi bee yɛltɔɣiŋmasɔri mini ŋa taba.
• Di sɔŋdi n-tahiri waliginsim na.
N-zaŋ bachituɣira nam yɛltɔɣa
Bachituɣira mali zalisi biɛla zaŋ chaŋ ŋa zaŋ tum tuma polo. Zalisi ŋɔ zaŋ tum 
tuma ni tooi che ka sabbu chani viɛnyɛla.
• Bachituɣira kuli nyɛla ŋan gbundi tɛha ni niŋsim. Dinzuɣu, di ni tu ni 
bachituɣirili shɛli tum tuma ka di mali tumda ka di ti ti ti ni bɔri shɛli.
• Bachituɣira mali sɔŋsim pam zaŋ chaŋ binyɛra kalibu.
• Di yi mali bachituɣira tumdi tuma, che ka a yɛltɔɣa yaɣa zaa saɣi doli taba.
Bachinima Nambu Soya
Bachinima nambu nyɛla so’ shɛli di ni doli n-namdbi bachi pala bee yɛltɔɣiŋmaa 
din mali gbunni yini zuliya yɛltɔɣa puuni.
Bachinima nambu soya balibu zooya ka zuliya yɛltɔɣa tooi doli ŋa n-namdi 
bachi pala. Ŋannima n-nyɛ; bachinima taba laɣimbu, bachi bɔbigu taba laɣimbu, 
ŋmaabahi, paŋbu, bɛlimpahira, labiboli, tiligibu. Shɛŋa n-kahigi gbunni ŋɔ.

Yindi zuliya yɛltɔɣa ni. Yɛltɔɣiŋmasɔri ni tooi mali balibu kamani bachinamdili

zuɣu mini niŋsimdeera ka di laɣim taba n-nam yɛltɔɣili maa bee yɛltɔɣili maa yaɣ’ 
shɛli.
• Sabbu puuni, lahima bee ŋmahim’ shɛŋa di ni zaŋdi wuhiri gbunni n-nyɛ sabbu 
bibahira, ŋannima n-nyɛ zanibu bia, kolɔn pirigili, vuhim bia, kolɔn ni ŋmaabahi

O chaŋ tiŋa maa puuni.

Dahinshɛli ti ni daa be Teeku duli
Dakulo din gari la, m mini n zo daa gbaami ni ti di ti dabisili maa teeku duli. Di 
daa nyɛla asib’ polli din mali wuntaŋa ka biɛhigu maa viɛli n-ti luɣ’ yini diɛma. 
Dindali maa asibaashi, ti vala ti naŋgbansuuli mini binnyura m-pali ti baaji 
n-daa daai bahi teeku duli maa. Pɔhim maha din daa yiri teeku maa ni na daa 
che ka gɔrim maa chaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga.
Ti ni daa kuli paai, ti daa yulimi m-bo luɣ’ viɛlli shee kpukpalitia gbunni. Ti ni 
daa yarigi ti bɔduanima sɔŋ bih’ tulli maa zuɣu, ka ti ʒini tiŋa. Ti ni daa nya 
bihi ni diɛmdi kokpaŋa maa ka niriba zaŋ binyɛra tam teeku kogbana maa 
zuɣu diɛmdi maa daa chɛmi ka ti bɔri yom ni ti pahi diɛma maa ni. Saha biɛla 
nyaaŋa, ka ti daa lu ko’ mahili maa puuni, n-duɣiri gindi ni suhupiɛlli.
Zaŋ chaŋ wuntaŋa ni, ka ti gbaai ni ti vuhi biɛla ka di bindira mini binwala din 
be ti baajinima maa puuni. Kogbana din daa vuri baalim maa daa ŋmɛrila kɔɣa 
din miri ti na ka di kpɛri ti nyaɣisim. Ti daa zaŋ wuntaŋa maa ni zaa m-mɛrila 
bihigu ya teeku duli maa ka ŋmɛri teeku duli nuu bolli.

Lahibali Nambu, Nolini Lɛbigibu ni Sabbu Lɛbigibu
PILIGU
Yaɣili ŋɔ yɛn zaŋla karimbihi n-yuli binshɛli din nyɛ lahibali nambu mini lɛbigibu. 
Lahibali nambu yaɣili maa, yi ni vihi lahibali nambu balibu ni yi ni yɛn sabi 
lahibaya shɛm. Gbana sabbu yaɣa ayi shɛŋa yaɣili ŋɔ ni yɛn yuli n-nyɛ tumaduri 
gbana mini dɔɣim gbana. Yi ni deei baŋsim mini milinsi ka di sɔŋ ya ka yi tooi 
baŋ lahibaya balibu ka nam lahibaya n-doli yi zuliya shɛli yi ni bɔhinda. Yaɣili 
maa ni lan zam lahibali lɛbigibu n-yi Silimiinsili ni n-niŋ Ghana zuliya yɛltɔɣa ni. 
Lahibali lɛbigibu balibu, zaŋ tabili bachi ti kpa bachi lɛbigibu, gbunni lɛbigibu, ni 
din pahipahi, nyɛla di ni yɛn zam shɛli. Yi ni deei baŋsim mini milinsi ka di che ka 
yi tooi baŋ lahibali lɛbigibu balibu ka tooi lɛbigi lahibali shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ ti a n-yi ka 
kpɛhi Ghana zuliya yɛltɔɣa puuni.
TƐHA GAHINDA
• Tumaduu gbaŋ nyɛla gban’ shɛli din sabiri tiri kpamba.
• Dɔɣim gbana sabirimi tiri dɔɣiriba, zonima bee ninvuɣ’ so ŋun nyɛ a saawaralana.
• Lahibali nambu nyɛla sasabira maa pe lahibali shɛli o ni sabiri maa n-sɔŋ shɛm.
• Lahibali sabbu nyɛla tɛh’ shɛli bee lahibali shɛli din ti sabbu puuni.
• Lahibali lɛbigibu nyɛla lahibali gbunni zaŋ ti n-yi zuliya shɛli ni n-kpɛhi zuliya shɛli ni.
LAHIBALI NAMBU
Lahibali nambu nyɛla so’ shɛli sasabira ni doli m-pe sabbu sɔŋ shɛm. lahibali nambu 
balibu shɛŋa di ni daa lihi nya yuuni 19th century la n-nyɛ buɣisibu, lahibali labiti, 
kahigibu, ni naŋgbankpeeni. Sabbu din viɛli nyɛla din ni tooi mali lahibali nambu 
yɛlibɔra balibu zaa.
Lahibaya balibu
Lahibaya balibu diba Anahi m-beni. Dimbɔŋɔnima n-nyɛ buɣisibu, labiti, kahigibu, 
ni naŋgbankpeeni lahibaya.
Lahibali buɣisirili
Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla lahibali sabbu bal’ shɛli din bɔri ni karimbihi buɣisi binshɛli,

binyɛra yuya, daadama, luɣ’ shɛli, haŋkali shɛli, biɛhigu, churi ni din pahipahi. 
Shɛhira kamani, n-sabiri lahibali ni a buɣisi a daŋ bee a ya yɛn nyɛla lahibali 
buɣisirili. Shɛhira n-do gbunni ŋɔ:
N dɔɣim ban be yiŋa
N dɔɣim bela yil’ bila ni. Di pa kuntain amaa ka viɛla. Di malila gariche titali. N yuri 
tuma tumbu gariche maa ni amaa n tuzopaɣa je tuma tumbu gariche maa ni. O 
bɔrila karimbu o karindi asiba, wuntaŋa ni ni yuŋ.
N zaŋdila ʒɛvari maa zaa n-tiri m ba mini m ma. Bɛ yuri duɣibu ti duduɣusu bila 
maa ni. N diri ʒɛvari kam amaa n tuzopaɣa maa ŋun dirila biɛla kɔŋko.
N dɔɣim maa laɣindimi diri asiba naŋgbansuuli mini yuŋ bindirigu. Ti dii alizama. 
Ti lara. Di nyaaŋa ka n tuzopaɣa maa paɣi ŋmandaɣiri maa.
Yuŋ yi zibi m ba yuri ka o wumdila yila. M ma tumdila komputa zuɣu. N yuunila 
taliviisa. Ka n tuzopaɣa maa mi karinda.
Saha bihi sunsuuni ka ti kpe duu nti dɔni. N laamba bi daŋdi duu kpɛbu amaa m 
mini n tuzopaɣa maa daŋdila duu kpɛbu. N niŋla shili ni n kpe nti dɔni amaa n 
tuzopaɣa maa ŋun na bɔri ni o karindimi.
Lahibali din labiri tira
Lahibali balibu ŋɔ chaŋ nti jɛndila sasabira maa maŋmaŋa tɛha bee o ni nya shɛli 
ka o sabi li sɔŋ. Salima salimbu yɛlibɔra ka bɛ mali tumdi tuma ni di vooi karimbihi 
miri na. shɛhira, lahibali nambu zaŋ chaŋ a tuuli shikuru shɛli a ni be ŋɔ chandi 
dali bee chuɣ’ shɛli yɛn lɛbila lahibali buɣisirili. Lahibali ŋɔ nambu puuni, a yɛn 
yɛlila a maŋmaŋa ni nya binshɛŋa shikuru maa ni bee chuɣu maa ni.
Lahibali kahigirili
Lahibali nambu balibu ŋɔ bɔrila vihigu pam, lahibali din be dede, din ziligi, ni din 
na kuli nyɛ yɛltɔɣ’ pala ni a zaŋ tabi sɔŋ a lahibali maa taachi maa ka lan yuli nya 
haŋkali shɛŋa din gba pahi. Lahibali nambu yaɣili ŋɔ bɔri ni sasabiram aa vihi 
gili nya haŋkali kɔŋkɔba zaŋ chaŋ yɛlikpan’ shɛli polo ka tooi sabi lahibali din 
tam kalinli zuɣu. Di tirila lahibali din jɛndi lahibali maa yɛlizuɣu polo. Shɛhira 
kamani, lahibali zaŋ chaŋ Ghana maŋasulinsi polo, sasabira maa yɛn zaŋla taarihi 
din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli zaŋ chaŋ dabisi’ shɛli maŋasulinsi maa ni daa deei, ninvuɣ’ 
kpɛma ban daa be maŋasulinsi maa deebu tooni, maŋasulinsi maa deebu nyaaŋa 
gomnanti gbubbu, ni din pahipahi.
Naŋgbankpeeni Lahibali
Lahibali nambu balibu ŋɔ bɔri ni karimbia maa vihi yɛlli maa, n-zahim shɛhira, 
n-yɛligi haŋkali, ka zaŋ naŋgbankpeeni din beni maa n-ti ka di saɣisi ka ne. shɛhira 
kamani, ‘paɣiba ban gbubi tiŋgbani kpam’ kara tooi deeri niriba gari bɛ taba ban 
nyɛ dabba la’. Taachi ŋɔ tatabo bɔri ni karimbia pe ka yɛligi bɛ ni nya lala yɛlli 
maa shɛm ka di doli yɛlimaŋli. Bɛ yi yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔ, bɛ ni tooi saɣi n-ti bee 
n-zaɣisi taachi maa ni yɛli shɛm maa.

Lahibali ni pe n-dɔya shɛm
Lahibali malila yaɣa diba ata, dinnima n-nyɛ piligu,lahibali maŋmaŋa, ni naabu.
Piligu
Dimɔŋɔ nyɛla lahibali yoobu: Yaɣili ŋɔ ka a wuhiri lahibali maa yɛlizuɣu. A ni tooi 
pili li ni bɔhigu, lahibali deerili, bee yɛltɔɣili din voori ŋun karindi haŋkali. Yɛɣili 
ŋɔ puuni, a ni tooi yɛli lahibali maa ni yɛn jɛndi yɛl’ shɛŋa zaa ni di ni simdi ni 
ŋun karindi baŋ.
Satarili din ʒiri lahibali maa maŋmaŋa
Yaɣili yɛrila a sabbu maa ni nyɛ shɛm zaa n-kpe puuni, lahibali din labiri tira, 
naŋgbankpeeni, ni din pahipahi. Kpe ŋɔ a ni zaŋ yɛltɔɣili din ʒiri a yɛlizuɣu maa 
n-sɔŋ, naŋgbankpeeni taachi yɛlizuɣu din kpa talahi ka zaŋ shɛhira kahigi n-zani 
a naŋgbankpeeni, lahibali din labiri tira, kahigibu ni din pahipahi yɛlisim maa 
nyaaŋa. Din doli ŋɔ na ni tooi laɣim taba n-lɛbi naŋgbankpeeni lahibali maa 
maŋmaŋa
• Yɛltɔɣili din mali satarili din paya na yoori taba.
• Zaŋmi naŋgbankpeeni yɛlikpani din paya na n-ti ka kahigi li ni shɛhira..
• Yɛltɔɣili din mali satarili din paya na yaha yoori taba.
• Zaŋmi yɛlikpani din chihiri yɛltɔɣ’ shɛŋa naŋgbakpeeni maa ni n-sɔŋ.
• Kahigim ka ti shɛhira din wuhiri di yɛlimaŋtali ni chaŋ nti paai shɛm.
• Zaɣisim yɛltɔɣ’ shɛŋa din chihiri a zaashee maa n-zaŋ li naai a sabbu maa.
Naabu
Naabu maa shee ka sasabira maa kooni vaari haŋkali shɛŋa o ni sabi sɔŋ maa. Din 
doli ŋɔ na nyɛla so’ shɛŋa a ni tooi doli n-sabi a naabu.
• Koli vaai a yɛlikpana maa.
• Labi wuhi a zaashee ni nyɛ shɛli maa.
• Zaŋmi naabu yɛltɔɣili/lahibali n-ti.

dii ka woliginsim pam ka che teetɔɣisi lahibali sabbu.
Lahibali
Di nyɛla sabbu shɛli din sabi ni di ti salo pam lahibali sabiriba sɔŋsim puuni. 
Lahibali sabbu ŋuna, lahibalisabira zaŋdila lahibali n-talim n-ti lahibali wuligibu 
nima lahibalichuri gbana, magazinnima, jonalinima, ni din kam pahi.
Alizama sabbu biɛhigu
A yi pii bee m baŋ a ni yɛn sabiri n-tiri ninvuɣ’ shɛba naai, nyin piimi yɛlikpani, 
laɣisim yɛltɔɣa din yɛn sɔŋ n-kahigi n-neei li mini sodoligu, alizama sabbu saha 
paami maa.
Alizama tuɣa
Alizama maa tu ni di mali tuɣa ŋɔ.
1. Puhigu
Din kuli kpa talahi nyɛla a puhi a wumdiba ka zaŋ a maŋa n-wuhi. Niŋmi 
ba maraaba suŋ. shɛhira kamani, N tumtumditaba, M mabihi Gananima, 
Jilimanima ban beni, Nanima, ni din kam pahi.
2. Piligu
Piligu maa ni, zaŋmi lahibali maa nia n-wuhi a wumdiba. shɛhira kamani, 
N kamina wutaŋa ŋɔ ni ni n ti ti lahibali zaŋ chaŋ ti ni tuhi tuumbiɛri din 
muɣisi ti tingbani bee yaŋɔ shɛm.
3. Alizam maŋmaŋa
Kpe ŋɔ, di tu ni a mi a yɛlikpani maa yaɣa shɛŋa a ni yɛn tɔɣisi n-jɛndi zaa. 
Kpe ka a yɛn bo nineesim n-ti yɛlikpani maa.
4. Naabu
Naabu maa ni, kpaŋmi a maŋa n-niŋ niŋsim shɛli din yɛn che ka a wumdiba 
ku tam a yɛla. Shɛhira kamani, n-yɛli kpaŋmaŋa shɛli yi ni niŋ, ni yi ni tum 
shɛm n-ti yi tingbani ni yi kari kpaɣiʒiɛɣu din wuligiri yomyom ti fɔn’ tinsi 
la ni. Ti mali tahima ni sokam ni yina m-pahi kpaŋmaŋa ŋɔ zuɣu ka ti kari

Tuma duri/tuma bɔbu gbaŋ
Tuma duri/tuma gbaŋ nyɛla din sabi n-tiri tumaduri mini kpamba n-doli zalikpana 
mini soya. Di tooi doli salo zaa ni saɣi n-ti so’ shɛli ka zaŋdi yɛltɔɣa din tuhi

Tuma gbaŋ ni tooi buɣisi soya pam puuni di alizama dirimi n-tiri kpamba bee 
ban ʒe zaashɛhi. Kpamba maa shɛba n-nyɛ karimbakpɛma, lahibalisabiriba, tuma 
kpɛma, dolodolo karimbanima, nanima, gomnanti kpamba, asɛmbili kpamba ni

Tuma duu gbaŋ nahingbana
Nahingbana maa n-do gbunni ŋɔ.
1. Ŋun sabiri gbaŋ maa biɛhigu shee: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ gbaŋ maa yaɣ’ tuuli. Di 
sabirimi n sɔŋdi zuɣusaa nudirigu zuɣu. Di tu ni ti baŋ ni, biɛhigu shee maa ni 
tooi doni zuɣusaa nuzaa gba polo di mi yirila di fomaati ni doya shɛm.

LAHIBALI LƐBIGIBU
Lahibali lɛbigibu nyɛla ka lɛbigi zuliya shɛli yɛltɔɣa n-kpɛhi zuliya shɛli puuni. 
Zuliya shɛli puuni lahibali maa ni yiri ka bɛ yɛn lɛbigi li maa n-nyɛ lahibali ni yi 
zuliya shɛli ni na, ka zuliya puuni bɛ ni lɛbigiri lahibali maa kpɛhiri maa mi n-nyɛ 
zuliya shɛli nia maa ni kpaa.
Lahibali lɛbigibu daashili
Lahibali lɛbigibu malila sodolisi din pe ka di che ka nira zooi baŋsim puuni ni 
vihibu, baŋbu, ni ka tooi lɛbigi zuliya shɛli yɛltɔɣa n-kpɛhi zuliya shɛli puuni. Din 
doli ŋɔ na nyɛla sodolisi ka nira ni doli:
1. Piligu din bi ke puuni: Baŋmi wɔliginsim shɛli din be lahibali lɛbigibu mini 
nolini lɛbigibu sunsuuni, ni kaya ni taada biɛhigu ni kpa talahi shɛm.
2. Zoomi ni karimbu baŋsim: Kpaŋmi a maŋa n-ni tooi karim ka gbaai lahibali 
maa ni yiri zuliya shɛli puuni maa na.
3. Vihivihi lahibali maa: Baŋmi lahibali maa balibu, di kukoli daliri, ni di ni 
chani ninvuɣ’ shɛba sani.
4. Zaŋmi a zaɣa niŋ lahibali lɛbigibu baŋsim sodolisi ni: Yuli n-gbaai baŋsim soya 
kamani:
a. Bachi ti kpa bachi zaŋ maɣisi lɛbigibu din nyɛ zaɣ’ maŋli lahibali lɛbigibu
b. Kaya ni taada yaɣili din lu n-zahim
c. Yɛltɔɣiniɣima
d. Bachinima din gbunni ŋmani taba
5. Bɔhimmi lahibali lɛbigibu tuma: Pilimi ni sabbu din bi to ka du hali nti kpe 
sabbu din to puuni.
6. Zaŋmi a zaɣa niŋ di dede tali mini yɛlimaŋ’ tali ni: Zaŋmi gbunni bahi tooni ka 
che bachi ti kpa bachi lɛbigibu.
7. Zaŋmi tabibi baŋsim mini so’ shɛŋa din pahi: Zaŋmi tabibi soya din jɛndi 
lɛbigibu, dikishinaarinima, ni pɔhim zuɣu (online) soya ka di sɔŋ a ni bɔhimbu.
8. Taba labivihi mini kom tɔhibu: Labivihiya taba lahibali lɛbigibu ka tɔhi kom 
din tuhi soli zuɣu.
9. Tim tooni n-kpe sabbu din jɛndi baŋsim yaɣa polo: Chami tooni ni sabbu din 
jɛndi yaɣ’ gahinda (shɛhira; looyatali, dɔɣitɛtali, maʒina tuumbaŋsim polo) ka 
di che mali baŋsim yaɣili.
10. Tuɣi m-bɔhimma: Yuli m-bo soya n-tuɣi m-bɔhinda ka a lahibali lɛbigibu 
baŋsim ni yɛligira.
Lahibali lɛbigibu balibu
Lahibali lɛbigibu balibu pam m-beni. Amaa bɔhimbu yaɣili ŋɔ yɛn yulila balibu 
din doli ŋɔ na.
1. Bachi ti kpa bachi lɛbigibu: Nachi ti kpa bachi lɛbigibu zaɣa bela dedetali ni 
n-gari di kum doli taba viɛnyɛliŋga polo.
2. Lɛbigibu din tuhi: Lahibali lɛbigibu balibu ŋɔ nyɛla din nyɛ dede, yɛltɔɣiniɣima 
lɛbigibu din ʒiri gbunni mini kukoli din lu n-zahim zaa.

3. Kaya ni taada soya lɛbigibu: Lahibali lɛbigibu balibu ŋɔ ni, lahibali maa maani 
n-doli kaya ni taada kɔŋkɔba ka di lu n-zahim ka taɣili taba.
4. Lɛbigibu din du: Lɛbigibu balibu ŋɔ bɔri ni lɛbigibu maa dolila lahibali maa ni 
yiri zuliya shɛli puuni na maa biɛhigu ni be shɛm maa.
5. Nolini lɛbigibu: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla lɛbigibu din yiri nolini na, ka saha pam di tooi 
niŋdila laɣin’ zuɣuri ni, laɣinsi ni, bee kootu ni.
6. Lahibali lɛbigibu din tuhi ka mi bi doli zaligu: Lahibali lɛbigibu din galisi bee 
din zooi di nolini lɛgibu ni, din zilima n-gari zuliya shɛli puuni di ni lɛbigiri 
maa ni gbunni, kukoli, bee di ni bɔri shɛli. Lahibali lɛbigibu balibu ŋɔ ni tooi 
pahi bee n-yihi lahibali yaɣili din ka lahibali maa ni.
Lahibali lɛbigibu din ʒiri gbunni: Di nyɛla balibu shɛli din zaŋ di zaɣa niŋ 
lahibali gbunni zaŋ ti polo ni sabbu shɛli bɛ ni lɛbigiri ni ʒiri shɛli, ka di kuli 
pala din zaŋ di zaɣa niŋ bachi ti kpa bachi lɛbigibu, balibu ŋɔ zaŋla di zaɣa niŋ 
sabbu gbunni polo, di nia, gbunni din zilima, ni di tatabo.
Lahibali lɛbigibu bɔhimbu
Din doli ŋɔ na nyɛla lahibali lɛbigibu bɔhimbu tuma shɛli.
1. Yɛltɔɣ’ gaŋa: Lɛbigimi yɛltɣ’ gansi n-yi zuliya shɛli puuni n-kpɛhi zuliya shɛli 
ni, ka che ka a zaɣa be din tuhi mini girama polo.
2. Yɛltɔɣiniɣima: Bɔhimmi yɛltɔɣiniɣima, yɛltɔɣinyasɔɣ’ shɛŋa din yirina 
sahakam, mini bachiniŋda yɛltɔɣiŋmasɔri lɛbigibu.
3. Satar’ ŋmahi: Lɛbigimi satara din nyɛ zaɣ’ ŋmahi m-bɔhimbu lahiblai lɛbigibu 
din ʒiri gbunni.
4. Sabbu din yi Baŋsim yaɣ’ gahinda polo na: Lɛbigimi lahibali din yi baŋsim yaɣ’ 
gahinda polo na (shɛhira; looyatali, dɔɣitetali, maʒina polo, ni din pahi pahi) 
ka tooi bɔhim m-baŋ bachigahinda din yi lala yaɣa maa na.
5. Sabbu din litiricha: Lɛbigimi litiricha sabbu (shɛhira; yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi, kpɛrigu, 
ni salin’ ŋmahi) m-bɔhim kukoli, sabirinuu, ni wɔliginsim shɛŋa zaa din beni.
6. Lahibalichuri puuni lahibaya: Lɛbigimi lahibalichuri puuni lahibaya m-bɔhim 
lahibali din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ka di kukoli lu n-zahim zaŋ ti.
7. Alizama: Lɛbihimi alizama (shɛhira; vihigu din nyɛ alizama dibu) m-bɔhim 
ŋun yɛri maa nia mini kukoli ni nyɛ shɛli zaŋ ti.
8. Lahibali lɛbigibu zaŋ maɣisi taba: Zaŋmi a lahibali lɛbigibu maa m-maɣisi 
a taba dina (shɛhira; baŋdi’ kuɣila lɛbigibu, maʒina lɛbigibu) n-sahi neegi a 
baŋsim.
9. Maŋmaŋa lɛbigibu: Sabimi lahibali din yi zuliya shɛli ni na ka lɛbigi li n-niŋ 
zuliya shɛli ni m-bɔhim lɛbigibu din ne ka tuhi.
10. Taba tuma labivihi: Zaŋmi a tuma maa n-taɣi ti a kpee ka zaŋ kom tɔhibu din 
tuhi n-ti ka di che ka yi lɛbigibu baŋsim ti tooni.

The Environment
In our modern world, there are many factors that place the wellbeing of the planet 
in jeopardy. While some people have the opinion that environmental problems are 
just a natural occurrence, others believe that human beings have a huge impact on 
the environment. Regardless of your viewpoint, take into consideration the following 
factors that place our environment as well as the planet Earth in danger.
Global warming or climate change is a major contributing factor to environmental 
damage. Because of global warming, we have seen an increase in melting ice caps, a 
rise in sea levels, and the formation of new weather patterns. These weather patterns 
have caused stronger storms, droughts, and flooding in places that they formerly did 
not occur.
Air pollution is primarily caused as a result of excessive and unregulated emissions 
of carbon dioxide into the air. Pollutants mostly emerge from the burning of fossil 
fuels in addition to chemicals, toxic substances, and improper waste disposal. Air 
pollutants are absorbed into the atmosphere, and they can cause smog, a combination 
of smoke and fog, in valleys as well as produce acidic precipitation in areas far 
away from the pollution source.
In many areas, people and local governments do not sustainably use their natural 
resources. Mining for natural gases, deforestation, and even improper use of water 
resources can have tremendous effects on the environment. While these strategies 
often attempt to boost local economies, their effects can lead to oil spills, interrupted 
animal habitats, and droughts.
Ultimately, the effects of the modern world on the environment can lead to many 
problems. Human beings need to consider the repercussions of their actions, trying to 
reduce, reuse, and recycle materials while establishing environmentally sustainable 
habits. If measures are not taken to protect the environment, we can potentially 
witness the extinction of more endangered species, worldwide pollution, and a 
completely uninhabitable planet.

Yaɣili ŋɔ ti yɛn yulila paɣikpuɣibo ka di nyɛla taada yili ka lahi nyɛ ti kali tuma 
soli. Di jɛndila ti kaya ni taada paɣikpuɣibo ni paɣa kpuɣibu soya, paɣikpuɣibo

nyɛla ti ni yɛn yuli shɛli. Baŋsim shɛli yi ni yɛn bɔhim yaɣili ŋɔ ni ni sɔŋ ya ka yi 
baŋ paɣikpuɣibo soya Dagbani ni mini zuliya shɛŋa ni. Yi ni zamzam paɣikpuɣibo 
tuma soya zuliyanima ni ka yuli taɣiri pala ŋan kpe di puuni ʒɛmana ŋɔ. Yi ni 
bɔhim anfaani shɛli din be kali gubu ni, kali zaŋ n-wuhi niriba ni biɛh’ suŋ zaŋ 
n-wuhi daadama.
TƐHA GAHINDA
• Paɣikpuɣibo nyɛla doo mini paɣa saɣi ka bo taba
• Paɣikpuɣibo tuma nyɛla tuun’ shɛŋa di ni tumda n-doli Dagbamba dihitabili, dariza

ni paɣikpuɣibo ni musulinsi paɣikpuɣibo.

a. Kaya gu ka taɣi
Paɣikpuɣibo tuma nyɛla din tumdi n-doli kaya ni taada Yuma kaʒi. Hali di 
yi ku niŋ ka ka yɛli kpɛra kpenkpe di puuni gba, di piligu bee di janda na

b. Kaya zaŋ n-ti ban doli ti nyaaŋa
Paɣa kpuɣibu saha, soya kamani puhigu, paɣibɔri liɣiri yɔbu, laɣitarili ni 
din kam pahi nyɛla din niŋda. Lala niŋsim ŋɔ nyɛla di ni mali shɛli n-tiri ban 
doli ti nyaaŋa na.
c. Jilima mini Nintiɣibo
Paɣikpuɣibo nyɛla jilima mini nintiɣibo bini zaŋ n-ti ban bo taba maa mini 
bɛ yinsi nima. Niriba yuunila ban bo taba maa ka bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣishɛba ban 
niŋ shili ni bɛ deei talahi dooyili bee bɛ dundɔna ni, n-dɔɣi bihi ka wubisi 
ba. Dimbɔŋɔ yihiri ba salo ni ka lahi tiri ba jilima bɛ yanima ni.
d. Nangbanyini
Paɣikpuɣibo nyɛla alikauli n-ti dɔɣim diba ayi. Di laɣindila lala dɔɣim 
diba ayi maa mini bɛ zonima. Bɛ laɣindimi n-niŋdi suhupiɛlli ka baŋdi taba 
viɛnyɛla. Di yi ti niŋ ka bali konkɔbanima bo taba, di laɣindila lala bala maa 
taba ka tahiri suhudoo mini nangbanyini na bɛ sunsuuni n-ti tabili tiŋgbani 
maa zaa.
e. N-niŋ bihi a dahalali
Paɣikpuɣibo n-che ka bi’ shɛba bɛ ni dɔɣiri n-niŋdi daŋ puuni lɛbiri daŋ 
maa dahalali. Di tirila la bihi maa yiko ni bɛ di fali ka be daŋ maa puuni. 
Paɣikpuɣibo lahi nyɛla din tiri bihi soli ka bɛ ni tooi baŋ bɛ daŋ maa ni 
kpini taba shɛm.
f. Ʒiinitaba
Paɣikpuɣibo nyɛla so’ shɛli din simdi ka tiri nira o mini ban yɛn be ni taba 
bee o ʒiinitaba. Di lahi tiri doo mini o paɣa arizichi sɔŋsim mini di taba. Di 
lahi tiri nira soli ka o ni tooi laɣim ni o paɣa bee o yidana. Paɣa ni doo ŋɔ 
nyɛla ban laɣindi ni suhupiɛlli mini suhugarigu zaa.
