DIN KPƐRI TABA NI 
1. Ʒɛmana yɛla din pa kpe ti taada paɣikpuɣibo puuni Ghana ŋɔ nyɛla din galisi. 
Di shɛŋa nyɛla din viɛla amaa ka shɛŋa bi viɛla, ka di che ka yɛli pala kpe ti kaya 
ni n-yɛligi li viɛnyɛla. Di puuni shɛŋa n-nyɛ ŋan doli ŋɔ na. Shikuru baŋsim: 
Shikuru baŋsim pa tila niriba yaa, balle paɣiba, ka be ni tooi pii bɛ suhu ni bɔri 
shɛli di yi ti kana doo kulibu polo. Waawaayili, a ni tooi nya ka lala niriba ŋɔ 
piiri bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ daamiliya be shɛm ni saha shɛli bɛ ni bɔri ni di niŋ.
2. Ninsalanima yikonima mini dabba mini paɣiba nyɛ yim: Niriba ni pa yina 
n-kpaŋsiri daamanima yikonima ni nyɛli zaŋ n-ti ba mini di yuli ka gaŋbu ka 
dabba mini paɣiba sunsuuni la pa tahila taɣibu na ti paɣikpuɣibo ni. Kamani 
kaya shɛŋa puuni, di tiri paɣiba yiko ni bɛ di fali ka tooi zali aʒiya.’
3. Adiininima yaa: Dolodolo, Musulinsi nti pahi adiini shɛŋa ŋan pahi nyɛla ŋan 
zaŋ yɛli pala n-kpɛhina ti taadanima puuni, saha shɛŋa gba ka di nyɛla di mini 
ti taada maa yɛn laɣinla taba n-tum.
4. Daabilim toontibo: Daabilim toontibo mini soya gba pa tila niriba yaa ka bɛ 
piiri bɛ suhu ni yu ni bɛ mini shɛba bo taba ni bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ daamiliya lo 
shɛm.
5. Fɔntali: Niriba yi kuni fɔŋkara ni, di chɛrimi ka bɛ nyari taada mini dariza 
koŋkɔba din tahiri yɛli pala na ti Taada paɣikpuɣibo ni.
6. Tabiibi baŋsima : tabiibi baŋsim parisi yina m-pa che ka niriba ni nyari taba, 
n-diri alizama ka tiri lahibali pa taɣi, ka di zuɣu pa che ka paɣiba laɣibu gba 
taɣi.
7. Zalisi taɣibu: Tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni zalisi kamani zaligu din saɣi n-ti taada paɣa bɔbu gba 
nyɛla din kpe Ghana zalisi puuni lala maa gba tahi taɣibu na ti paɣikpuɣibo ni.

Daŋ Nahingbana
Daŋ Nahingban’ shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ:
1. Yaankur’ yino: Daŋ puuni niriba malila yaan’ kuri yino.
2. Doɣim: Daŋ puuni niriba kpinila taba ni dɔɣim, paɣikpuɣibo ni bihi tɔhigibu.
3. Din laɣindi ba: Daŋ puuni niriba malila tooi yuli din gahim n-ti daŋ maa, 
lahima ni bɛ taada.
4. Laɣim gbaai: Daŋ puuni niriba malila din laɣindi ba ka bɛ be ni taba.
5. Kpamli dubu: Daŋ puuni niriba malila toondaannima, kpamba bee nanima ban 
wuhiri di ni tu ni binyɛra niŋ shɛm.
6. Daŋ puuni niriba lahi malila puhisi ni di saɣibu ka laɣim n-nyɛ mabihi ni taba.
Daŋ Daanfaani
Daŋ nyɛla din tum anfaani pam n-ti zuliyanima. Di shɛŋa ŋan do gbunni ŋɔ:
1. Laɣingu zaŋ nti niriba: Daŋ nyɛla daantali kpeeni daadamanima biɛhigu puuni. 
Di nyɛla din pɔra, ka di gbubbu mali asama ka ban be di puuni mali biɛh’ yinsi 
ni nia yinsi.
2. Dɔɣim laɣimbu: Daŋ kpaŋsiri dɔɣim ka tahiri nangbanyini na niriba sunsuuni.
3. Mabiligu kpaŋsibu: Daŋ che ka niriba baŋdi bɛ ni be shɛli ka lahi sɔŋdi taba.
4. Taba Baŋbu: Daŋ zaŋdi niriba ka bɛ laɣindi ni bɛ taba ban mali taarihi yini, 
kali yini ni yɛl’ kuri yinsi.
5. Laɣintum mini Sɔŋsim: Daŋ kpaŋsiri laɣintum mini sɔŋsim nitiri di niriba bɛ yi 
ti bɔri sɔŋsim kamani pukparigu yɛla, gubu bee nangbankpeeni.
6. Maaligu niriba sunsuuni: Daŋ malila so’ shɛŋa di ni doli m-bɔri maaligu tiri 
niriba bɛ daŋ maa puuni.
7. Kali Gubu: Daŋ n-guri ka taɣiri kali, taata, ni darizanima ka mali li n-tiri 
ninvuɣ’ shɛba ban doli nyaaŋa na.
8. Daabilim tuma: Daŋ n-yuuni di niri bɔmma ni nyamma zuɣu kamani, daankaya, 
daabilim tuma ni taba laɣim n-sɔŋ.
9. Toontibo: Daŋ tiri soli din wuhiri niriba zoosim daŋ maa puuni, daŋ maa puuni 
niriba kpaŋmaŋa tiri ba soli ka bɛ tooi nyari kpamli daŋ maa puuni.
10. M-be biɛhigu ni: Daŋ tiri di niriba soli ka bɛ baŋ ni bɛ be biɛhigu din galisi 
n-gari bɛ ko biɛhigu ni, ka lahi bɔri kpaŋsibu n-tiri ba suhu saɣingu ni.
Daŋ nyɛla din yuui pam, ka di daanfaani dolila zuliya ni zuliya. Di mini di yuuya 
maa zaa yoli, di daanfaani zaŋ n-ti daadama mini bɛ tinsi na kuli nyɛla din galisi.

1. Sabimi daŋ diba anu yuya ni ŋa lahima a yaɣili polo ka sabi daŋ diba ata

Laɣimmiya niriba ayiyi n-zamzam binsɛli yi daŋ ni bɛ niŋda ka di yila yi daŋ

 Tuma 7.5

kali nɛma, ka bɔ sinii ka niriba maa kahigiri bɛ taada ka zaŋ li yɛli a taba maa.

Yuma Ayi YAƔILI 7
Ti yi yuli anfooni din do zuɣusaa ŋɔ, ti nyaya ka ŋun do nam soya biɛhigu maa 
zuɣusaa nyɛla nazuɣu maa, ka ban paya nyɛ o kparibɔɣiri, ka na’ shɛba ban pahi 
mi naanyi pahi. Nazuɣuri maa nyaaŋa ka kpambaliba mini daŋ kpamba doli.
Teema: Kpamli anfooni din do zuɣusaa ŋɔ din nyaaŋa, di ni tooi lahi niŋ ka kpamli shɛli 
lahi be nam soya puuni din doli ninvuɣ’ shɛba kali luɣ’ shɛŋa .
Ban zaa be kpamli dariga anfooni ŋɔ maa ni malila bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛli ka bɛ tumda 
n-doli bɛ dooshee kpamli dariga maa ni. Bɛ tuma maa shɛŋa n-do gbunni ŋɔ.
Nazuɣu maa
Nazuɣu n-nyɛ toondana zaŋ n-ti o niriba ka tiŋgban’ shɛli ni o niriba maa ni be. 
Zuliya shɛŋa ni, hali nazuɣu maa mali yaa ni o tooi che ka gɔmnanti mini o niriba 
maa niŋdi o ni bɔri shɛli.
Nazuɣu Tuma ni nyɛ shɛŋa
1. Nazuɣu maa n-nyɛ bɔbili maa bee zuliya toondana
2. ŋuna zaani ka mali zalisi tumdi tuma
3. ŋuna n-nyɛ bɛ sapashinnima toondana tɔbu saha
4. O maani o niriba sunsuuni zabili yi ti beni.
Yaɣa nazuɣuri
Yaɣa nazuɣuri maa n-nyɛ kpamba zaŋ ti bɛ zuliya bee yaɣa maa. Bɛ nama n-du 
n-gari nam kam lala yaɣili maa. Bɛ tooi dirila nama maa n-doli bayili bee mayili 
polo. Bɛ lahi tooi booni ba la nam zuliya dama bɛ piiri ba mi nam zuliya puuni. Pɔi 
ka bɛ naanyi ʒini gbandi maa zuɣu, bɛ yihirila nam chiha din zaa beni.
Yaɣa Nazuɣiri Tuma
 Yaɣa Nazuɣiri maa tuma shɛŋa n-doya ŋɔ;
i.  Bɔbili maa bee zuliya toondana
ii. Ŋun zaani o yanima zaani gbaari gbaari shɛŋa din mali anfaani n-ti o yanima
iii. Tumdi chuɣu puhibu tuma
iv. Ŋun mali zalisi tumdi tuma ka maani o niriba sunsuuni
v. Ŋuna n-yuuni tiŋgbani zuɣu/Tiŋgbandana
vi. Ŋun guri kaya
vii. Ŋun bɔri lɛbiginsim n-tiri o niriba
viii. Ŋun kariti sariya
ix. O maani gbana maa bin maanda
x. O zaani zalisi

Yuma Ayi YAƔILI 7
Tiŋkpan’ nanimaBana n-nyɛ na’ shɛba ban be nazuɣiri sulinsi ni. Tiŋkpaŋnanima 
maa nyɛla luɣ’ shɛŋa kpamba ka tooi be tiŋkpan’ shɛŋa ŋan be tinzuɣuri mini 
tiŋkpansi ni. Lala nama maa gba nyɛla bɛ ni diri na’ shɛŋa fali n-doli nam zuliya 
kamani nazuɣiri dina maa ni be shɛm maa. Bɛ yihirila chiha pɔi ka bɛ gba naanyi 
ʒini bɛ gbandi zuɣu.
Tiŋkpan’ nanima tuma ni nyɛ shɛli
1. O zaani nazuɣu zaani o yi kani
2. Sɔŋdi guri tuumbiɛri o sulinsi ni
3. O kariti sariya
4. Mali soli ni o gu o tiŋgbani
5. O kpandi o maŋa bɔri suhudoo o sulinsi ni
6. Ŋuna n-tumdi kaya tuma bɛ gbana zuɣu ka maani tiŋgbana di yi ti bɔri malig
Paɣananima
Paɣananima nyɛla ban nyɛ nanima zaŋ n-ti paɣiba mini dabba zaa sa bɛ tinsi ni. 
Bɛ tuma nyɛla din mali dariza pam zaŋ n-ti bɛ yanima. Luɣ’ shɛŋa fali ni diri n-doli 
mayili polo, paɣananima maa yɛltɔɣa n-nyɛ kpalinkpaa zaŋ chaŋ napalo gbaabu 
polo. Bɛ tooi leeri bɛ kpamba ka bɛ sɔŋdi ba bɛ nam tuma polo.
Paɣananima tuma
1. Bɛ tabiri n-sɔŋdi nanima bɛ tinsi ni.
2. Bana n-kariti sariya kam din kpini paɣiba mini paɣisara bɛ tinsi ni.
3. Bɛ zami n-ti paɣiba toontibo mini bɛ yikonima kpaŋsibu bɛ tinsi maa ni.
Tindana
Tindana maa n-nyɛ adiini toondana zaŋ n-ti bɛ tinsi. O nyɛla ŋun tibira, ka be 
niriba maa mini bɛ wuna sunsuuni.
Tindana tuma ni nyɛ shɛli:
1. Bɛ zaani nanima zaa ni di yi ti niŋ ka naa maa kani tiŋ shɛŋa ni.
2. Bɛ wuhiri suhisi n-tiri bɛ niriba bɛ tiŋgbana puuni.
3. Bɛ maani malisi laɣinsi ni kamani kparigu yɛbu shee ni di yi ti yɛn yihi so nam 
ni.
4. Bɛ baŋdi zahima gbunni ka yuuni n-nyari yɛla ka lahi bɔri gubu n-tiri tiŋgbani 
maa ka chɛri yɛlibiɛri.
5. Bɛ guri ka taɣiri bɛ kaya ni taada.
6. Bɛ tibiri niriba ka chɛri dɔribiɛri.

Yuma Ayi YAƔILI 7
Nagbahiriba
Nagbaara nyɛla ninvuɣ’ so bee ninvuɣ’ shɛba ŋun/ban mali soli ni bɛ zaŋ kali 
n-niŋ nabia niŋ ka ŋun/ban maŋmaŋa ka ban lɔ nam maa puuni. Niriba ŋɔ ʒiinimi 
n-gbaari ŋun tu ni o di nam bee n-lee toondana gbaabu.
Nagbahiriba Tuma ni nyɛ shɛli
1. Bana n-gbaari naa di yi ti niŋ ka ŋun diri maa kani.
2. Bana m-maani malisi naa yi ti kani.
3. Bana n-yihiri naa nam ni.
4. Ban mali na’ palli wuhiri kpamba mini niriba
5. Bana n-saɣisiri naa
6. Bɛ be naŋgbaŋkpeeni zaba maligu sunsuuni
7. Bana n-doli nam galisibu soya n-gilisiri nam tira.
Wulana
Wulana n-nyɛ kpambaliba zaa toondana naa tooni ka mali tuma pa nayili mini 
tŋa maa ni. Wulana tuma wolimi n-doli tiŋa ni tiŋa. Yɛli shɛŋa ŋan doya ŋɔ shɛŋa 
n-nyɛ wulana tuma.
1. Bana yɛri n-tiri naa salo ni, naa yi yɛli shɛli bana duhiri bɛ yeei ka salonima 
wumdi li.
2. Bana m-be naa tooni o yi yina zama ni.
3. Bana n-yɛri n-tiri naa maa.
4. Bana n-gbubi naa jaangbee.
5. Bana n-deeri saamba yɛltɔɣa n-tiri naa ka lahi deeri naa yɛltɔɣa n-tiri samba.
 Tuma 7.7 Nama soya biɛhigu kpamli anfooni
Nammi kpamli anfooni n-wuhi nanima nama ni du n-gari taba shɛm a ya. 
Zaŋmi a ni pe ŋa m-maɣisi ban bi yi a ya polo na ka be karinduu maa puuni.
Tuma 7.8 Nanima tuma
a. Yi niriba ayiyi, karimmiya lahabal’ jia din do gbunni ŋɔ maa ka sabi ŋan do 
gnunni ŋɔ tuma zaŋ kpa daŋ zaba maligu polo.

Shɛba ŋmɛri naŋgbaŋkpeeni ni tiŋkpansi nyari adalichi mini zaba maligu

Yi bɔŋdi ni, sabimi a tɛha zaŋ chaŋ naŋgbankpeen’ shɛli din do zuɣusaa maa ka

Tuma 7.10 Nam soya
“Nam soya nyɛla di ni bi lahi mali shɛli tumdi tuma”. Yi bɔŋdi ni, sabimiya

Tuma 7.11 Nam soya ayi maa zaŋ maɣisi taba
Yi bɔŋdi ni, ŋmɛmiya naŋgbaŋkpeeni n-jɛndi nam soya biɛhigu daanfaani ka 
ti muɣusugu shɛŋa a ni nya di yi zaŋ li maɣisi ʒɛmana ŋɔ nam soya bee a yi

PILIGU
Yaɣili ŋɔ yoorila nayili sariya karibu mini ʒɛmana ŋɔ sariya karibu soya n-tiri a. Di 
kahigirila soya ayi maa zaa biɛhigu ni ŋa tuma. Yi ni zaŋ soya ayi maa zaa tuma 
maɣisi taba n-nya yi maŋmaŋa yɛligbahira. Yi baŋsim ni yi gbaabu zaŋ kpa nayili 
sariya karibu mini ʒɛmana ŋɔ kootu sariya karibu soya ni sɔŋ ya ka yi tim nuu 
demokratiiya soya mini yiko zaŋ tum tuma polo. Di ni sɔŋ nyini ninvuɣ’ yini ka 
bɔhim nimmoo tɛha mini vihibu baŋsim zaŋ chaŋ gbaabu tɛha ka di che ka a leei 
tiŋbi’ so ŋun mali lahabali a yi bɔhindi a yikonima mini a tumanima.
Din pahi, yaɣili maa ni sɔŋ a ni baŋsim ka che ka a kɔre kpe n-chaŋ bɔhim zalikpana 
baŋsim ni, siyaasa baŋsim, ni tiŋduya biɛhigu di ni kpini bɔhimbu baŋsim kamani 
Nam soya mini Taarihi.
TƐH’ GAHNIDA
• Kootu sariya karibu soya maa kahigirimi ka mali zalikpan’ shɛŋa ŋan bi ne n-tumdi 
tuma tiŋgbani ni. Gana kootu sariya karibu soya malila toontali dariza durilim 
biɛhigu, ka Supirim kootu n-nyɛ Gana kootu shɛli din du gari kootunima zaa,
• Nayili sariya karibu soya malila zalkpan’ shɛŋa ŋan pun be tiŋa maa ni n-kariti 
sariya.
• Alikaaliyilinima ban be ʒɛmana ŋɔ kootu sariya karibu puuni nyɛla gomnanti ni pii 
tuuntumdiba shɛba (jaajinima) ka ʒiini yɛla zuɣu ka maani yɛla.
• Ban kariti sariya nayili sariya karibu soya ni nyɛla nanima bee kpamba ban ʒiini 
yɛla zuɣu ka maani yɛla.

Tɛha Bɔhigu

soya ata shɛŋa a laamba ni doli m-maani a mini a mabihi sunsuuni yiŋa. Zaŋmi a 
labisibu a taba ban be karindu’ yini puuni.
Kootu Sariya Karibu Soya
Kootu sariya karibu maa nyɛla so’ shɛli kootunima bee gomnanti yaɣ’ shɛŋa ŋan 
lɛbigira ka mali zalisi tumdi tuma tinsi ni.

Yuma Ayi YAƔILI 8
Alikaaliyilinima tuma
Kootonima sariya karibu soya tuma n-do gbunni ŋɔ:
1. Tiŋgbani zalisi gbunni lɛbigibu mini di zaŋ tum tuma di ni tu shɛm.
2. N-che ka niriba doli zalikpana ka kpaŋsiri adalichi n-ti tiŋgbani
3. N-guri tiŋbia yikonima mini maŋsulinsi kamani zalisi buku bee yiko zalisi ni 
saɣi ti shɛŋa bee yikonima zalisi.
4. N-kpaŋsi adalichi zaŋ tum tuma ka gaŋbu kani zalisi zaŋ tum tuma puuni
5. M-maani niriba, tuma duri ni gomnanti tuma duri sunsuuni zaba.
6. N-ti so’ shɛŋa kamani niriba sunsuuni zani bɔ maligu ka di pa kootu soli.
7. Di wuhiri gomnanti mini o tuundiba ni jintɔriba yaɣa yaa tatariga, din yɛn 
yuuni ka sokam yaa saɣisi zalisi buku ni wuhi ya’ shɛli tatariga.
8. N-zaani tiŋgbani zaani n-kpari ti bibiɛri.
9. N-zaani bɛ ni sam so zaani bibiɛlim yɛla ni.
Ʒɛmana ŋɔ kootu sariya karibu soya biɛhigu
Gana Alikaaliyilinima malila toontali dariza durilim biɛhigu n-do gbunni ŋɔ:
1. Supirim kootu n-nyɛ Gana kootu shɛli din du gari kootunima
2. Apiil kootu m-be sunsuuni
3. Haai kootunima n-nyɛ kariti binshɛɣu kam sariya luɣ’ shɛli
4. Kootu bihi ni kootu shɛŋa ŋan be tiŋzuɣuri ni n-nyɛ kootu bihi ŋan yuuni daŋ 
zalisi mini yɛl’ bihi zuɣu.
5. Bibihi ban Yuma bi paai yuum’ pishiayika kootu n-nyɛ kootu shɛŋa ŋan bi du 
shɛŋa ŋan kariti bibihi ŋɔ sariya.
Kootu tuma
Kootu n-lɛbigiri ka che ka zalikpana kamani sokam zalikpana, bibiɛhi zalikpana, 
ni tuuntumdiba zalikpana tumdi tuma ka nyɛ ban wuhiri zalisi ni saɣi ti zalikpana 
zaŋ tum tuma shɛm.
Gana ni, Supirim kootu kpema n-nyɛ tiŋgbani maa zaa alikaayilinima kpema. 
Tuuntundiba shɛba ban kpalim n-nyɛ; jaajinima, vihivihiriba ban sɔŋdi m-maani 
zaba ka lɛbigiri zalikpana ka wuhiri zalisi ni saɣi ti zalikpana zaŋ tum tuma shɛm.

The structure/composition of the contemporary 
judiciary system (court) in adjudicating cases
1. Jaaji yini n-ʒiini n-wumdi ka ŋmaari yɛltɔɣa Haai kootu, Apiil kootu ni Supirim 
kootu ni.
2. Supirim kootu ni mini Apiil kootu ni jaajinima ata zaŋ chaŋ jaajinima pianiata 
(Jaajinima kpem ni bɔri shɛli) n-wumdi ka ŋmaari yɛltɔɣa. Baŋmi ni ninvuɣ’ 
shɛba ban yɛn ʒini yɛltɔɣ zuɣu tooi nyɛla kalinli shɛli din ku tooi piri n-ti niriba 
ayi ka shɛli bi guui.
3. Saha shɛŋa ni, jaaji ʒinimi ni ŋun vihivihira (ŋun pa di baŋda bee ŋun nyɛ di 
baŋda) ka o wuhiri soli mini neesim.
4. Jaaji wumdi ka ŋmaari yɛltɔɣa tinsi Kootu ni.
5. Suhudoo jaaji n-wumdi ka ŋmaari yɛl’ bihi tinsi kootu ni.

6. Deemi tɛh’ bɔbigu: Tɛhimi nambu tɛha ka deeri tɛha bee baŋsim kɔŋkɔba.

mini buɣisibu.

Yoodara salima nyɛla diɛma bee muɣusugu shɛli din bɔri haŋkali, nambu bee tɛh’

Di yi niŋ ka Dammduu yɛri yɛlmaŋli, dinŋuna buku maa be Duliŋ sani. Amaa di 
wuhirimi ni Duligu mini Nɔŋa zaa ŋmarila ʒiri ka di che ka ban yɛri yɛlmaŋli yaɣi 
ninvuɣ’ yino. Dinzuɣu, Damduu ŋmarila ʒiri.
Di yi niŋ ka Duliŋ yɛri yɛlmaŋli, o bi mi buku maa ni ŋmani binshɛli. Dimbɔŋɔ ni 
wuhi ni Damduu, Duligu ni Nɔŋa ŋmarila ʒiri, ka di che ka Duligu ni yɛli shɛli nyɛ 
ʒiri, n-ŋmɛri Duliŋ yɛltɔɣa naŋgbaŋkpeeni ’. Dinzuɣu, Duliŋ ŋmarila ʒiri.
Di yi niŋ ka Duligu yɛri yɛlmaŋli, o nya Nɔŋa ni kpuɣi buku. Dimbɔŋɔ ni wuhi ni 
Damduu, Duliŋ ni Nɔŋa ŋmarila ʒiri. Din dee ni kuli nya ninvuɣ’ yino n-ni tooi yɛli 
yɛlmaŋli maa, dimbɔŋɔ ni tooi niŋ.
Di yi nyɛla Nɔŋa yɛrila yɛlmaŋli, Duligu ŋmarila ʒiri, ka di wuhiri ni Duligu bi 
nya Nɔŋa ni kpuɣi buku maa’. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ ni wuhi ni Damduu mini Duliŋ gba 
ŋmarila ʒiri, ka di tahiri naŋgbaŋkpeeni na ni yɛlmaŋli kalinli shɛli di ni saɣi ti. 
Dinzuɣu, Nɔŋa ŋmarila ʒiri.
Di ni kuli niŋ ka ka di nyɛla ninvuɣ’ yino n-yɛri yɛlmaŋli maa, Duligu n-tu ni o nyɛ

DAGBANI YƐLTƆƔA BAŊSIM (LITIRICHA)
Baŋsim Sabirili
PILIGU
Yaɣili ŋɔ puuni, a ni bɔhim Dagbani baŋsim sabirili yaɣ’ shɛŋa. Yaɣili ŋɔ 
kuli kahigirila yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi. A ni tuui bɔhim yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi buɣisibu, 
yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi balibu, yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi biɛlima ni yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi daanfaani. 
A bɔhimbu ni lahi jɛndi di ni vihiri ni lahi shɛm. A yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi milinsi mini 
di vihigu yɛn neela a nini zaŋ kpa bachigahinda mini yɛltɔɣa baŋsim polo. Yaɣili 
ŋɔ malila tɛha, tɛhani nambu, ni alizama dibu. Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi vihibu ni sɔŋ a 
ka a bɔhim tɛh’ zilinli tɛhibu, nolini yɛltɔɣa lɛbigibu ni vihibu baŋsim. Di ni lahi 
sɔŋ a ka a baŋ ka gbubi a halli, ka bɔhim suhuni biɛhigu baŋbu. Yaɣili ŋɔ kpinila 
bɔhimbu yaɣ’ shɛŋa kamani taarihi, Silimiinsili yɛltɔɣa baŋsim, ni yila. Yaɣili maa 
kpaŋsirila nambɔzɔbu ka neeri niŋsim shɛŋa ŋan be taarihi ni, kaya ni tada, ni 
ʒilɛli ni tuma. Hadda niŋbu ni yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi yɛlibu kpaŋsiri teebu, nintiɣili ni 
zama ni alizama dibu baŋsim.
TƐH’ GAHINDA
• Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi nyɛla litiricha yaɣ’ shɛli din mali kumsi mini yɛltɔɣiniɣiŋda n-tiri 
gbunni mini suhuni biɛhigu.
• Ŋun namdi yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi ka di booni sasabira. Sasabira malila litiricha biɛlima 
kamani kumsi lu n-zahim, mita, suhuni anfooni, ni suhuni anfooni nambu n-laɣindi 
namdi tɛh’ timsa ni yɛltɔɣikpana ni bachi biɛla.
• Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi yɛltɔɣa ku tooi di baŋ kamani alizama yɛltɔɣa ni baŋdi shɛm ŋɔ.
YƐLTƆƔITAƔIMALISI
Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi kahigbu
Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi nyɛla din namdi nolini n-wuhiri, biɛhigu, tɛha bee suhuni biɛhigu 
viɛnyɛla ni tɛha ni, Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisinima piirila yɛltɔɣ’ shɛŋa ŋan mali kumsi 
shɛŋa mini di ni ʒiri ya’ shɛli n-zaŋdi litiricha baŋsim kamani mita, zaŋbuɣisi ni 
kumsi lu n-zahim. Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi din nyɛ litiricha bal’ shɛli, nyɛla di ni sabi shɛli 
ni kulisi mini satara ka zaŋ nyaɣisim ni suhuni anfooni n-wuhiri tɛha.

Tuma 10.2 Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi balibu baŋbu
Yi niriba ayiyi, baŋmiya ka kahigi yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi balibu dibaata ka zaŋ wuhi 
karinduu zaa. Timi a maŋmaŋa shɛhira a yi ni tooi.
Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi biɛlima
1. Suhuni anfooni: N-namdi anfooni ŋun karindi suhu ni yɛltɔɣa buɣusira din 
viɛli n-ti kɔbituɣa.
2. Vuri: N-zaŋ lunzahim m-pahi, kumsi lu n-zahim, konsɔnanti vu’ yinsi kum pa 
taba, vaawuli vu’ yinsi kum pa taba, ni vugbunni, pahirila yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi 
wumbu nyaɣisim.
3. Biɛhigu: Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi doo nti pahi satara ni pe n-doya shɛm ni waɣilim ka 
di sɔŋdi gbunni ni di ni ʒiri binshɛli na.
4. Mita mini Kumsi Lunzahim: Bachijila ŋan mali yee mini ŋan ka yee zaŋ tum 
tuma kulisi puuni, ka di tiri kumsi bee lunzahim shɛli.
5. Lunzahim: M-pe vu’ yinsi ŋan mali lunzahim kulisi bahigu, ka di tiri yila mini 
teebu.
6. Kuligu mini satarili: Kulisi n-nyɛ yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi tampuɣa, ka satara mi nyɛ 
ŋan laɣim kulisi, din tahiri karim zanibu ta.
7. Yɛltɔɣiniɣindili: M-mali zaŋbuɣisi, zaŋ ŋmahim, zaŋzalizaani, ni niŋʒeei 
tumdi tuma n-tiri gbunni shɛli din ka polo ni, n-duhiri gbaabu.
8. Yɛltɔɣikpani: Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi ni kuli ʒiri tɛha shɛli bee di ni jɛndi binshɛli, 
din zaŋdi daadama biɛhigu mini suhuni biɛhigu n-tumdi tuma.
9. Yee mini Biɛhigu: Sasabira maa biɛhigu zaŋ chaŋ baŋsim yaɣili maa bee ŋun 
karinda (yee) ni ban wumdi suhu ni biɛhigu (biɛhigu).
10. Ŋmahinli: N-zaŋ ŋmahima n-zali tɛha bee baŋsim, ka di pahiri gbunni zilinli.
11. Bachi gahimbu: Bachinima gahimbu ni ŋa gbunni, ŋan sɔŋdi yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi 
yee, biɛhigu ni suhu ni anfooni nambu.

Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi daanfaani
1. Di kpaŋsiri yɛltɔɣa baŋsim: Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi yihiri ban bɔhindi bachinima, 
zaŋbuɣisi, ni litiricha biɛlima polo ni na.
2. Di sɔŋdi nambu: Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi kpaŋsiri tɛhibu, tɛh’ nam ni maŋa yɛltɔɣa.
3. Di che ka di bɔhindi nimmo tɛha: Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi vihibu sɔŋdi ban bɔhindi ka 
bɛ bɔhindi niommo tɛha, yɛltɔɣa lɛbigibu, ni vihigu baŋsim.
4. Nambɔzɔbo: Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi zaŋdi daadam suhuni biɛhigu, nira ni nya 
binshɛŋa biɛhigu, ni tɛha n-sɔŋdi nambɔzɔbo mini gbaabu.

5. Di tiri tarihi mini bɛ ni yuuni kali shɛm: Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi tiri tarihi binyɛra 
baŋsim, kaya ni tada, ni biɛhigu ni chani shɛm.
6. Di kpaŋsiri teebu mini yɛligu baŋsim: N-teeri ka yɛri yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi kpaŋsiri 
teebu, suhu ʒia ni zama ni yɛligu.
7. Di kpaŋsiri maŋa tɛha labi nyaaŋa mini yɛligu yɛlibu: Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi 
tiri karimbihi soli ka bɛ yihiri bɛ tɛha, suhu ni biɛhigu, ni bɛ ni pun nya 
binshɛli biɛhigu ni. Di kpaŋsiri maŋa tɛha labi nyaaŋa mini yɛligu yɛlibu: 
Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi tiri karimbihi soli ka bɛ yihiri bɛ tɛha, suhu ni biɛhigu, ni bɛ 
ni pun nya binshɛli biɛhigu ni.
8. Di kpaŋsiri baŋsim suhu ni: Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi sɔŋdi karimbihi gbaabu ka che 
ka bɛ mali suɣulo, ka kpaŋsiri baŋsim suhu ni. Karimbihi ni tooi mi yɛlkpana 
ni binshɛŋa ŋan niŋ yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi ni.
9. Di sɔŋdi litiricha biɛlima gbaabu: Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi wuhiri karimbihi litiricha 
biɛlima kamani suhu ni ŋmahinli, suhu ni anfooni nambu, ni yɛltɔɣiniɣima. 
Litiricha biɛlima ŋɔ pahiri yɛltɔɣa yɛlibu mini nolini baŋsim.
Tuma 10.4 Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi daanfaani
Kpamiya bɔŋbɔŋ ni yi zonima niriba ayi bee garibu n-kahigi yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi 
din nyɛ yɛltɔɣa baŋsim (litiricha) daanfaani. Zaŋmi tɛh’ shɛŋa ŋan do zuɣusaa 
ŋɔ mini a maŋmaŋa tɛha.
Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi biɛhigu
Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi malila nahiŋgaban’ shɛŋa ŋan do gbunni ŋɔ ŋan nyɛ di biɛhigu
1. Kulisi: Kuli’ yiniyini bachinima.
2. Kulisi Waɣilim: Bachijila kalinli bee fiiti.
3. Satarili: Kul’ bɔbigu ŋan laɣim n-leei bin’ yini.
4. Lunzahim: Kumsi yinsi di ni zaŋ tum tuma kulisi bahigu.
5. Miita: Bachijila ŋan mali yee ni ŋan ka yee.
6. Fiiti: Miitanima zaŋ laɣim taba ka ŋa nyɛ bachijila laɣimbu.
7. Yɛltɔɣa ŋme laɣim taba ni: Yɛltɔɣa bee yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi ŋan kpe kul’ shɛli din 
paya ni ka bibahira bi bahi.
8. Keesura: Zanibu din be kulisi sunsuuni.
9. Bachikɔb’ kara: N-zaŋ n-tum tuma kulisi bee yɛltɔɣa piligu.
Nianima ŋan be yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi biɛhigu zaŋ tum tuma ni n-do gbunni ŋɔ;
• N-nam lunzahim mini yila

8. Yulimi ŋun tiri lahibali maa ni di ni jɛndi so.

Yim-yim vihigu
Soli 1: Karimmi yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi ka di yirina
N-karindi M Ba ka di yirina nyɛla biɛh’ shɛli din waligi; di malila yaa ka di biɛhigu 
miri liɣibu .
Di lunzahim bi doli taba. Satarili kam waligimi ka che di ni doli shɛli, ka di che ka 
di buɣisi baŋ niŋ tom.
A lahi kpahim ka Plath zaŋ lunzahim tum tuma n-yaɣi, banle ‘m’ vuri ŋɔ.
Dimbɔŋɔ chɛmi ka o yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa yiɣisir suhu ka mali biɛrim.
Soli 2: Kahigimi yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa
Ti yɛn kahigila M Ba tuuli satara maa shɛhira ŋɔ ni. Amaa, di tu ni a kahigiri 
yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa zaa saha shɛlikam din yɛn che ka a zahim di biɛh’ shɛli di ni 
zaŋ tum tuma yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa ni viɛnyɛla.
Yɛl’ gbahira
‘m’ vuri nyɛla din yi na satara ayi maa zaa puuni (yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi puuni lunzahim), 
dina n-nyɛ; piligu, sunsuuni ni bahigu kulisi.
Satarili 1: AYNYM lunzahim
Bachi ‘niŋ’ nyɛla din lunzahim viɛnyɛla dama di bela yɛltɔɣ’ yini puuni.
Satarili 2: MKMDM
‘m’ lunzahim satrili ayi maa puuni kulisi pam puuni ka di zuɣu che ka ti ni tooi 
yɛli ni lala kulisi maa mali lunzahim, kulisi 1, 3 ni 5 puuni ka di yina.
Satarili yini maa puuni ‘y’ nyɛla din lunzahim kulisi 2 mini 4 puuni. Amaa bachi 
shɛŋa na kuli wuhiri lunzahim yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa tuuli satara ayi maa zaa 
puuni.

YɛLTƆɣiTaɣiMaLiSi
Yuma Ayi YAƔILI 10
Soli 3: Baŋmi din tahiri binshɛli na
Pumpɔŋɔ ti ni baŋ Plath ni zaŋ lunzahim n-tum tuma shɛm ŋɔ, chɛliya ka ti bɔ 
n-nya di ni tahiri bin’ shɛli na bɔhisi ŋan do gbunni ŋɔ ŋɔ labisibu ni:
1. Lunzahim maa taɣiri yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi zaa puuni? Bɔ zuɣu?
Satarili kam yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa puuni malila lunzahim kɔŋkɔba; di bi doli 
taba yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa zaa puuni.
Satar’ shɛŋa malila lunzahim di kulisi piligu ka shɛŋa mi kuli ka lunzahim zaa.
Lunzahim laɣindila yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa zaa dinzuɣu satar’ shɛŋa ŋan ka 
lunzahim ŋa puuni taɣiri yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi biɛhigu ka namdi binshɛli din ku 
tooi buɣisi baŋ. Dimbɔŋɔ ni tooi tahi nyenyɔnigu na dama di bi chani viɛnyɛla.
2. Di ŋmani buɣisugu bee din kuli nye shɛli? Bɔ zuɣu?
Bachi shɛŋa ŋan vuri lunzahim maa mini lunzahim maa biɛhibu ŋmanila 
lunzahim di bi tu ni di be ni. Plath zaŋla vuri ‘m’ n-tum tuma yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi 
puuni zaa. Dimbɔŋɔ tahirila ‘timsim’ mini pɔhim din fari vuhim din sɔŋdi 
yɛltɔɣikpani maa yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa puuni: yaa wuhibu, suhuyiɣisili, ni 
kum.
3. Biɛh’ dini ka di tiri?
Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa malila yila nahiŋgbana ŋan wuhiri bibihi lunzahim. 
Amaa, yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa ŋmanila di bi doni di di tu ni di nyɛla diɛma mini.
4. Di sɔŋdi namdi lunzahim?
Lunzahim bachinima maa (‘m’ vuri) namdila konsɔnanti lunzahim, di mini di 
bi zaŋ tum tuma n-doli taba zaa yoli. Dama di zaŋ la lunzahim n-tum tuma 
yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa zaa puuni. Di baŋdila vuri maa yim; din sɔŋdi tumdi 
kamani binshɛli din dalinli saha yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa puuni.
Soli 4: Di daanfaani nyɛ dini?
Pumpɔŋɔ ti ni baŋ lunzahim ni tiri binshɛli maa, saha paaya ni ti bɔ gbunni!
1. Di kpaŋsiri bɔhimbu yaɣ’ shɛli?
Tɛhimi yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa yɛltɔɣikpana zuɣu.
M Ba nyɛla yaɣ’ yini yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi alizama luɣ’ shɛli Plath ni kahigi o 
suhuni biɛhigu mini tɛha zaŋ jɛndi o mini o ba biɛh’ biɛɣu.
a. Yɛltɔɣikpan’ shɛŋa ŋan ni tooi be yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa ni puuni:
Kpeeŋgarigu, suhuyiɣisili, kum, paɣitali mini dotali ni yaa
Pumpɔŋɔ, chɛliya ka ti teei ti yɛligbahira zaŋ kpa lunzahim so’ shɛli di be 
zuɣusaa ŋɔ polo.
b. Plath zaŋla lunzahim n-tum tuma yaɣi (ni ‘m’ vuri) ka di che ka vuhim fabu 
mini timsim beni.
122
YɛLTƆɣiTaɣiMaLiSi
Yuma Ayi YAƔILI 10
c. Lunzahim bi doli, ka di zuɣu che ka di ku tooi buɣisi ka tiri biɛrim.
d. Yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa kumdimi ŋmani bibihi lunzahim yila.
Dinzuɣu, chɛliya ka ti zaŋ Plath yɛltɔɣikpana m-pahi ti yɛligbahira zuɣu:
e. N-zaŋ ‘m’ vuri n-tum tuma yaɣi wuhirila Plath suhuni biɛhigu; saha shɛli o 
tooi mali suhuyiɣisili mini jɛlinsi zaŋ chaŋ o ba mini o yidana polo.
f. Tɔhigu maa, bibihi lunzahim tiri ti neesim zaŋ chaŋ Plath bilim ni. Muɣisugu 
mali o zaŋ chaŋ o ba tuma polo ka di mini di ni di tiri suhupiɛlli mini diɛma 
teebu chihiri taba.
2. Bɔ ka sasabira maa bɔra?
Lunzahim maa tiri neesim zaŋ chaŋ Plath suhu ni biɛhigu mini o tɛha. Di 
sɔŋdila yɛltɔɣikpana maa mini bɔhimbu yaɣa ŋan be yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa 
puuni ka tiri ti soli ka ti nyari Plath suhu ni din beni.
Soli 5: Zaŋmi satar’ yini kolivaai yɛlgbahira maa
Pumpɔŋɔ, saha paaya ni ti zaŋ yɛligbahira maa zaa n-laɣim niŋ satarili ni
Plath yulila shinodali mini di nimbiɛri zaŋ chaŋ yaa wuhibu polo M Ba puuni. Di 
ni zaŋ ‘m’ lunzahim n-tum tuma yaɣi yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa puuni zaa, namdila 
timsim ka di pɔhim fari vuhim nyɛla dalinli n-wuhiri bɛ ni wuhiri so yaa vuhim 
fabu. Plath yɛli o ‘ba’ ni o yidana yɛltɔɣitaɣimalisi maa puuni ka galim ka feei ba 
ni bɛ ni wuhiri o ya’ shɛli maa. Din nyaaŋa, lunzahim shɛli din bi doli taba maa 
wuhirila o suhu yiɣisili ni o tɛha zaŋ chaŋ do’ shɛba ban wuhiri yaa polo. Satar’ 
shɛŋa mali hali ni kulisi anu ŋan mali lunzahim ka shɛŋa mi malila zaɣ’ yiniyini 
ko din mini kul’ shɛli din kana ka ti li maa mali lunzahim. Di ni kuli niŋ ka ‘m’ 
vuri wuhiri lunzahim ŋɔ, wuhirila o suhu ni biɛhigu. Dimbɔŋɔ din nyaaŋa Plath 
wuhirila ban wumdi yaa wuhibu ni di ni tahiri binshɛli na bɛ ni wuhiri so yaa 
zuɣu.

GLOSSARY
Affix A grammatical form attached to a word at the beginning or end.
Affixation The process of adding affixes to roots or stems to form new words.
Ballad A narrative poem meant to be sung, often with simple meter and 
rhyme, telling folklore or romantic stories.
Borrowing Acquiring new words from another language.
Clipping Shortening an existing word to form a new one.
Coda The final consonant of a syllable.
Comma A punctuation mark (,) indicating a pause or separating items in a list.
Compounding Putting two or more existing words together to form a new one.
127
Conjunction A word that joins words, phrases, or clauses in a sentence.
Coordinating 
Conjunctions
Link equal parts of a sentence.
Correlative 
Conjunctions
Paired conjunctions used at two points in a sentence.
Culture The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a group or society.
Customary Traditional practices passed down through generations.
Derivational Affix Changes the class of a word it is attached to.
Dramatic Poetry A poem written in verse to be spoken, involving character dialogue.
Elegy A reflective poem lamenting loss, often exploring mourning and 
reflection.
Epic Poetry A lengthy narrative poem recounting heroic deeds or adventures.
Free Verse Poetry free from regular meter or rhyme scheme.
Goal A clearly defined objective or desired outcome.
Head Word The central element in a phrase.
Human Rights Principles of equality and fairness, ensuring freedom and protection.
Indigenous Original occupants of a land or region.
Infix An affix placed between two parts of a word.
Inflectional Affix Maintains the class of the word it is attached to.
Intonation Pitch changes across a sentence.
Lexicon Inventory of sounds, words, and expressions in a language.
Litigant A party involved in a lawsuit.
Lyric Poetry A short poem expressing personal emotions or thoughts.
Meter and Rhythm Pattern of stressed and unstressed syllables in a line.
Monogamy Marrying one person at a time.
Obstacles Challenges or barriers to progress.
Ode A lengthy poem praising an event, person, or idea.
Pitch Rate of vocal cord vibration during speech.

Puzzle A problem or game requiring logical thinking to solve.

Rhyme Scheme Ordered pattern of rhymes at line ends.
Riddle A puzzle using clever language to conceal a hidden answer.

Ghana’s new Senior High School Curriculum aims to ensure that all learners achieve 
their potential by equipping them with 21st Century skills, knowledge, character 
qualities and shared Ghanaian values. This will prepare learners to live a responsible 
adult life, progress to further studies and enter the world of work. This is the first time 
that Ghana has developed a Senior High School Curriculum which focuses on national 
values, attempting to educate a generation of Ghanaian youth who are proud of our 
country and can contribute effectively to its development.
The Ministry of Education is proud to have overseen the production of these Learner 
Materials which can be used in class and for self-study and revision. These materials 
have been developed through a partnership between the Ghana Education Service, 
teacher unions (Ghana National Association of Teachers- GNAT, National Association 
of Graduate Teacher -NAGRAT and the Pre-Tertiary Teachers Association of Ghana- 
PRETAG) and National Subject Associations. These materials are informative and of 
high quality because they have been written by teachers for teachers with the expert 
backing of each subject association.
I believe that, if used appropriately, these materials will go a long way to transforming 
our Senior High Schools and developing Ghana so that we become a proud, prosperous 
and values-driven nation where our people are our greatest national asset.

INTRODUCTION
This section introduces the concepts of syllable, syllable structure and tone. After 
studying this section, you will be able to differentiate between open and closed 
syllables in their respective Ghanaian languages and discuss how syllable structure 
aids in word formation. You will also study the concept of tone and be able to classify 
types of tone such as low, high, mid, rising, falling, etc. You will be equipped with 
the knowledge and skills to be able to form new words of a Ghanaian based on tone. 
Finally, the section will discuss the functions of tone in a Ghanaian language including 
the lexical, grammatical, and dialectal functions.

INTRODUCTION
This section discusses the identification of main ideas in a text or conversation. You 
will be introduced to the concept of intensive and extensive reading. You will discuss 
essential techniques in understanding a writer’s or speaker’s main ideas and study 
how to communicate these ideas to an audience in a succinct way. This section also 
has links with other subjects such as English and Social Studies as well as other 
languages.
OTIHI
Oti pɔtɛɛ ngɛ demiyo ko mi ɔ ji nɔ he nɛ demiyo ɔ kɔɔ. Enɛ ɔ ma nyɛ je e he kpo ngɛ 
munyuza oti mi nɛ e ngɛ he kplali nɛ yeɔ buaa e kpo jemi kɛ e sisi numi. Ni kanemi ma 
nyɛ pee ni kanemi vii aloo ni kanemi kɛ mi kuɔmi.
• Ni kanemi vii: E ji ni kanemi fitsofitso kɛ hla sɛgbi pɔtɛɛ kɛ demiyo ngmalɔ ɔ yi mi 
tomi nɛ e kɛ ngma demiyo ɔ.
• Ni kanemi kɛ mi kuɔmi: Ni kanemi kɛ mi kuɔmi ji ni babauu kanemi kɛ hla 
munyunguhi nɛ o kane ni ɔ hlɛhlɛɛhlɛ.
MUNYUTSO YOMI NGƐ NI SƐƐMI KO MI
1. Yi mi susumi sane bimi: Ke o ngɔ o juɛmi kɛ ya kekle jeha a ni kasemi ɔ nɔ ɔ, 
mɛni ji munyutso oti nɛ o kase ɔ? Ngɔɔ juɛmi nɛ o na a kɛ to o kuu mi bi ɔmɛ a ni 
ɔmɛ a he konɛ o kane sisi tsɔɔmi nɛ nyɛɛ se nɛ ɔ.
2. Munyutso Oti: Munyutso oti ji nɔ pɔtɛɛ nɛ a tu he munyu ngɛ kuku aloo demiyo 
ko mi. A deɔ nihi babauu kɛ kɔɔ munyutso oti ɔ he. Ke o ma nyɛ yo nihi nɛ a de 
ngɛ e he ɔ, o ma nyɛ ma yo munyutso oti ɔ ma ngɛ demi ko mi. Ke o suɔ nɛ o yo 
munyutso oti ngɛ demi ko mi ɔ, pee nihi nɛ nyɛɛ se nɛ ɔmɛ:
a. Kane demiyo yi ɔ kɛ e nya blimi ɔ: Mɛni a de ngɛ demiyo ɔ he? E sa nɛ o hla nɔ 
nɛ demiyo yi ɔ kɛ nya blimi ɔ ngɛ dee ngɛ nɔ nɛ a ngɛ he sɛsɛe ɔ he.
b. Hla munyuza oti ɔ: E pɔɔ kuku ɔ sisi jemi. Munyuza oti ɔ pɔɔ e he kpo jemi ngɛ 
kuku ɔ sisije se be komɛ ɔ, e baa ngɛ kuku ɔ kpɛti aloo e nyagbe.
c. Munyuza he kplali ɔmɛ yomi: Loko o ma yo munyutso oti ɔ he kplali ɔmɛ ɔ, e sa 
nɛ o bi ke mɛnɔ, mɛni, jije, kɛ e ya nɔ kɛɛ, mɛni be aloo mɛni he je nɛ nɔ ko ya nɔ.

Juɛmi ngɛ he kplali a he: He kplali ji munyunguhi aloo pɛmihi nɛ a kɛ pataa/piɛɛɔ

ehe nɛ tsakeɔ sisi numi ɔ.
He kplali pɔtɛɛ nɛ ngɛ ji hɛ kpɛ he kplali kɛ se he kplali. Ke o ngɔ he kplalɔ kɛ

he kplali enyɔ kpla munyungu ko e se kɛ hɛ kpɛ tsuo ngɛ be kake mi kɛ na munyungu 
ehe.
Nɔhyɛ nɔ: a+kpa+sa=akpasa. Munyutso ɔ ji ‘kpa’. A kɛ ‘a’ kpla e se nɛ a kɛ ‘sa’ kpla 
e hɛ kpɛ.
Yɔse kaa: E sa nɛ wa yɔse kaa pi gbi fɛɛ gbi nɛ tsuɔ kikɛmɛ a he kplali nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a 
he ni. O le Gana gbi ko nɛ tsuɔ enɛ ɔmɛ tsuo a he ni lo?
He kplali nɔhyɛ ni komɛ ngɛ Dangme mi ji: -lɔ, -hi, -li, a-, -mɛ, -tsɛ, -nyɛ, e- kɛ ekpa 
komɛ.
Enɛ ɔmɛ peeɔ he kplali ejakaa ke a ngɔ mɛ kɛ piɛɛ/pataa munyungu ko he ɔ, e ma 
tsake munyungu ɔ sisi numi. Nɔhyɛ nɔ: tsɛ (father) ba peeɔ tsɛmɛ (fathers). Akɛnɛ a 
ngɔ (-mɛ) kɛ piɛɛ munyungu tsɛ nɛ ya peeɔ nɔ kake ɔ, tsake kɛ pee fuu ngɛ animosa 
glɛ nɔ (tsɛmɛ).
Ni tsumi 3�1 He kplali yomi
Plɛ kɛ kpee o nyɛmi ɔ nɛ o tsɔɔ nɔ nɛ ji he kplali a nya. Bɔɔ mɔde kaa o maa tsɔɔ 
nya be mi nɛ o hyɛ we womi ɔ mi.
He kpali oti enyɔ: He kplali oti enyɔ pɔtɛɛ nɛ ngɛ. Mɛ ji he kplali nɛ tsakeɔ munyungu 
ɔ sisi numi kɛ he kplali nɛ tsakee we munyungu ɔ sisi numi
He kplalɔ nɛ tsakeɔ munyungu ɔ sisi numi: Enɛ ɔ ji he kplalɔ nɛ tsakeɔ munyungu 
ɔ sisi numi. Ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, munyungu ɔ kɛ he kplalɔ ɔ ma nyɛ hɛɛ sisi numi ekpaakpa. 
Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa he kplalɔ nɛ tsakeɔ munyungu ɔ sisi numi kɛ munyungu ɔ ma nyɛ je 
munyungukuu kake mi aloo munyungukuu ekpaakpa mi. Wa naa munyungu ehe kɛ 
jeɔ munyungu nɛ a ngɔ he kplalɔ kɛ pata he ɔ mi. Nɔhyɛ nɔ: e + he maa pee ‘ehe’ ke o 
ngɔ hɛ kpɛ kplalɔ “e” kɛ piɛɛ munyungu “he” ɔ he. Ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, munyungu “he” nɛ peeɔ 
peemimunyu ɔ tsake kɛ pee “ehe” nɛ ya peeɔ kalelɔ ngɛ animosa glɛ nɔ.
He kplalɔ nɛ tsakee we munyungu ɔ sisi numi: Enɛ ɔ ji he kplalɔ nɛ tsakee we 
munyungu ɔ sisi numi ke a ngɔ kɛ pata munyungu ɔ he. Nɔ nɛ he kplalɔ nɛ ɔ tsuɔ ji e 
tsɔɔ hiɛhiɛɛ, eku aloo eyo, be he ni kɛ ekpa komɛ. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ kaa ke a ngɔ he kplalɔ kɛ 
piɛɛ munyungu nɛ ngɛ kake juɛmi ɔ, e ba peeɔ hiɛhiɛɛ. Nɔhyɛ nɔ: ke a ngɔ se kplalɔ 
“hi” kɛ pata munyungu ‘tso’ he ɔ, e ba peeɔ ‘tsohi’. ‘tso (kake), tsohi (fuu/hiɛhiɛɛ)’.

He kplali a he ni tsumi: He kplali a he ni tsumi ngɛ munomuno. Ekomɛ ji:

 he kplalɔ + munyungu. (e + kpa = ekpa)

Nɔhyɛ nɔ:
bɛɛ + e = bɛɛe.
d. A tsakeɔ munyungu ɔ kɛ jeɔ kake mi kɛ yaa hiɛhiɛɛ mi ngɛ animosa glɛ nɔ.
Nɔhyɛ nɔ:
womi + hi = womihi.

f. A tsakeɔ biɛ kɛ peeɔ kalelɔ.

MUNYUNGU EHE PEEMI BLƆ NƆ TOMIHI
Munyungu ehe peemi ji blɔ nɔ nɛ wa guɔ kɛ peeɔ munyungu ehehi kɛ guɔ animosa glɛ 
nɔ ngɛ gbi ko mi.
Blɔ slɔɔtohi a nɔ ngɛ nɛ a guɔ kɛ peeɔ munyungu ehehi. Ekomɛ ji munyungu tsami/
blami, munyungu he kpɔmi, munyungu bami/babɛɛ, he kplali a he ni tsumi, munyungu 
mi timi kɛ ekpa komɛ.

ni tsumi, nɔ he juɛmi peemi, yi mi tomi kɛ ekpa komɛ)
2. Mɛnɔ nɛ woɔ ni ɔmɛ a biɛ?
Munyungu tsami/blami: E ji blɔ nɔ nɛ a guɔ kɛ blaa munyungu enyɔ kɛ peeɔ 
munyungu kake. Munyungu ehe nɛ a naa a sisi numi ma nyɛ je muno ngɛ munyungu 
enyɔ nɛ a bla amɛ a he. Munyungu tsami/blami ma nyɛ pee munyungu enyɔ nɛ a bla 
mɛ kɛ je munyungukuu ekpahi a mi kɛ pee munyungu kake. A ma nyɛ bla biɛ+biɛ, 
biɛ+peemimunyu, biɛ+kalelɔ kɛ ekpa komɛ.

Munyukpɔfa he blɔ nɔ tomi
Munyukpɔfa yi ɔ ji munyungu oti ngɛ munyukpɔfa a mi. Ke munyukpɔfa yi ɔ be mi 
ɔ, juɛmi be munyukpɔfa a he bae. A blaa munyukpɔfa slɔɔtohi kɛ peeɔ munyuza mi.
Nɔhyɛ nɔ: E ho ma mi ya.
Ngɛ nɔhyɛ nɔ nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, biɛ munyukpɔfa a ji nɔ nɛ a diki mi ɔ nɛ. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ piɛ ɔ ji 
peemimunyu munyukpɔfa. Peemimunyu munyukpɔfa yi ɔ ji ho. Biɛ munyukpɔfa blɔ 
nɔ tomi ɔ ji biɛ (N) nɛ peemimunyu munyukpɔfa blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ ji peemimunyu (V) nɛ 
ngwɔhe nyɛɛ se.
Munyukpɔfahi a he ni tsumi
A tsuɔ munyukpɔfa he ni kɛ guɔ blɔ nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ
1. A kɛ jeɔ juɛmi kpo.
2. A yeɔ kɛ buaa munyu tumi kɛ e ngmami.
3. A kɛ jeɔ demihi nɛ sisi numi ngɛ a he ɔ kpo se sisi numi ɔ nya pi si.
4. A haa nɛ munyuza kpa ko mi tsɔɔ.
Ni tsumi 4�5 Munyukpɔfahi kɛ wo kuuhi a mi
1. Ngɛ nyɛ kuu ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, nyɛɛ kane demiyo nɛ nyɛɛ se nɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ yɔse 
munyukpɔfa slɔɔto etɛ nɛ kɔɔ ni nɛmɛ nɛ wa sɛsɛ he kɛ be ɔmɛ a he.
2. Nyɛɛ po munyukpɔfa yihi nɛ nyɛ yɔse ɔmɛ a sisi.

Ngɛ nyɛ kuu ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, nyɛ ha nɔhyɛ nɔ kakaaka ngɛ munyukpɔ slɔɔto nɛ nyɛ

INTRODUCTION
This section introduces the learner to the concepts of text composition and translation. 
In the composition section, you will explore types of composition and how to compose 
essays. The two types of essays this section will focus on are formal and informal 
essays. You will be equipped with the knowledge and skills to be able to identify the 
types of essay and compose essays in your respective Ghanaian languages of study. The 
section will also discuss translation of texts from a source language into a Ghanaian 
language. The various types of translation, including word-for-word, meaning-based, 
unduly free, etc. will be discussed. You will be equipped with the knowledge and 
skills to be able to identify types of translation and be able to translate given texts to 
and from a Ghanaian language of study.
OTIHI
• A ngmaa pijua sɛ womi kɛ haa nɔ yemihi.
• A ngmaa majua sɛ womi kɛ haa wekubi, huɛmɛ kɛ suɔli.
• Saneyo ngmami ji blɔ nɔ nɛ saneyo ngmalɔ toɔ saneyo ko ngmami he blɔ nɔ kɛ jeɔ 
yi mi tomi ko kpo.
• Sipitsi ngmami ji blɔ nɔ nɛ a woɔ sɛgbi kɛ haa tue buli kɛ guɔ gbi ɔ lomi saminya nɔ.
• Sisi jemi tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ a ma je munyu ko sisi kɛ je gbi kake mi kɛ ya gbi ekpa mi nɛ sisi 
numi ɔ be lae.
SANEYO
Saneyo ngmami ji blɔ nɔ nɛ saneyo ngmalɔ toɔ saneyo ko ngmami he blɔ nɔ kɛ jeɔ 
yi mi tomi ko kpo. Saneyo ngmami mi kɛtsɛ jemi blɔ nɔ tomi eywiɛ ɔmɛ nɛ a tu he 
munyu kɛ be ɔ ji kalemi, amaniɛbɔ, peemiblɔnɔ kɛ nya sami saneyohi. Saneyo kpakpa 
ngmami jeɔ blɔ nɔ tomi slɔɔtohi a nɔ nɛ a guɔ kɛ ngmaa mɛ ɔ mi.

Ye wekubi ngɛ we ɔ mi
Ye weku ɔ ngɛ we wayoo ko mi. We ɔ klee we se e ngɛ fɛu. Abɔɔ agbo ngɛ we ɔ mi. I suɔ ni 
tsumi ngɛ abɔ ɔ mi se ye nyɛwenyɛ ɔ lɛɛ e sume ni tsumi saasaa. E suɔ ni kanemi mohu. E 
kaneɔ ni mɔtu, piani kɛ gbɔkuɛ.
I woɔ ngmɔ si ni tsɔwi ya haa yayo kɛ papaa. A suɔ ni hoomi ngɛ wa kue nyafi ɔ mi. I yeɔ 
ngmɔ si ni tsɔwi fɛɛ ko se ye nyɛwenyɛ ɔ lɛɛ e sume mwɔmwi, kuadaa kɛ ga.
Ye weku ɔ blaa kɛ yeɔ mɔtu kɛ gbɔkuɛ ni be fɛɛ be. Wa sɛɛɔ ni. Wa muɔɔ. Ye nyɛwenyɛ ɔ 
saa plɛɛte kɛ tsesi ɔmɛ a mi.
Papaa buɔ la tue gbɔkuɛ. Yayo tsuɔ ni ngɛ kɔmputa a nɔ. I hyɛɔ TV. Ye nyɛwenyɛ ɔ kaneɔ 
nyazia womihi.
Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, wa ya hwɔɔ si. Wa fɔli ɔmɛ hwɔ we si ma se i kɛ ye nyɛwenyɛ ɔ lɛɛ wa hwɔɔ si ma. 
Amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i dla ye he nɛ ma hwɔ si se ye nyɛwenyɛ ɔ lɛɛ e ngɛ ni kanee loloolo.
Amaniɛbɔ saneyo
Enɛ ɔ ji saneyo nɛ tuɔ nɔ ko ni lemi he munyu. A guɔ nyazia siami blɔ nɔ tomi ɔmɛ a nɔ 
kɛ gblaa kaseli a juɛmi kɛ baa saneyo ɔ he. Nɔhyɛ nɔ ji saneyo nɛ kɔɔ o kekle ligbi ngɛ 
o sukuu ehe ɔ mi aloo nɔ ko nɛ ya nɔ be ko nɛ be peeɔ amaniɛbɔ saneyo. Ngɛ saneyo 
nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, o maa tsɔɔ nihi nɛ ya nɔ ɔmɛ.
Peemiblɔnɔ saneyo
Saneyo nɛ ɔ haa blɔ nɛ kaseli a gbɛ si ngɛ juɛmi ko he, a hla anɔkuale ɔ, a kpa anɔkuale 
ɔ mi konɛ a sa nya ngɛ munyutso ɔ he ngɛ blɔ nɛ da nɔ. Nɔhyɛ saneyo ji “Gana he 
yemi”. Saneyo ngmalɔ ɔ maa je blema anɔkuale nihi nɛ ya nɔ ɔ kpo. Ni komɛ kaa ligbi 
nɛ Gana na he yemi ɔ, nihi nɛ ye bua kɛ na he yemi ɔ kɛ ma nɔ yeli nɛ ba ngɛ lɔ ɔ se.
Nya sami saneyo
Enɛ ɔ peeɔ si gbɛmi pɔtɛɛ, anɔkuale, mi kuɔmi kɛ amlɔ mi munyuhi kɛ fi nya sami ɔ 
se. Nɔhyɛ saneyo ji “Yihi nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya ngua a baa he si pe nyumuhi nɛ hɛɛ jamɛ a 
blɔ nya nɔuu”. Saneyo kaa kikɛ ɔ, e hiaa nɛ kaselɔ ɔ e na nɔmimamihi kɛ fi nya sami 
ɔ se. A maa sa nya kɛ si aloo kɛ fi munyutso ɔ se.
Nya sami saneyo nɔhyɛ ni nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ nɛ.
1. Moo tsɔɔ nɔ nɛ he ngɛ se nami wawɛɛ pe e nyɛmi: Tsɔɔlɔ aloo Dɔkita.
2. Ngmɔ hulɔ kɛ dɔkita a, mɛnɔ he ngɛ se nami wawɛɛ ngɛ ma a mi?
3. Sukuu nɛ kaseli hwɔɔ sukuu ɔ kɛ sukuu nɛ kaseli jeɔ we mi kɛ baa sukuu ɔ, tenɔ 
nɛ hi nɛɛ? Moo tsɔɔ o da he ngɛ munyutso nɛ ɔ he konɛ o sa nya kɛ fi o da he ɔ se.
4. Tenɔ nɛ o suɔ nɛɛ? Sukuu nɛ nyumuhi kɛ yihi tsuo yaa sukuu ɔ aloo sukuu nɛ 
nyumuhi pɛ aloo yihi pɛ ngɛ sukuu ɔ. Tsɔɔ o da he ngɛ munyutso nɛ ɔ he konɛ o 
sa nya kɛ fi o da he ɔ se.

Saneyo ngmami he blɔ nɔ tomi
Saneyo ngmami ngɛ blɔ nɔ tomi etɛ: nya blimi, munyutso ɔ kɛ nya muɔmi.
Nya blimi
Hiɛ ɔ ji saneyo ɔ sisije. Hiɛ ɔ ji he nɛ o ma je munyutso ɔ kɛ yi mi tomi ɔ kpo ngɛ. Jee 
sisi kɛ bimi aloo demi nɛ ma tsɛ tue buli a juɛmi se kɛ ba munyutso ɔ nɔ. De nihi nɛ 
sa kaa tue buli ɔmɛ a le. Mo de demi komɛ nɛ ma wa kɛ je nya sami munyutso ɔ kpo.
Munyutso ɔ mi kukuhi
Hiɛ ɔ ji he nɛ o ma je o yi mi tomi ɔ kɛ ni kpahi kpo ngɛ. O ma je munyutso oti ɔ kpo 
konɛ o fuaa se kɛ demihi nɛ ma wa o nya tsɔɔmi ɔ.
Nihi nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ ji munyutso mi kukuhi kɛ ha nya sami saneyo ko
1. Je munyutso oti ɔ kpo ngɛ nya sami ɔ mi konɛ o ngɔ nihi kɛ fi se.
2. De nɔ ko nɛ maa hɛ mo kɛ sɛ kuku nɛ ma tsa nɔ ɔ mi.
3. Je munyutso ekpa kpo nɛ o ma nyɛ kɛ gbe o nyɛmi koli silɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ he guɛ.
4. Moo ngɔ nɔhyɛ nihi nɛ sa kɛ tsɔɔ o gbi jami ɔ nya kɛ tsɔɔ kaa nihi nɛ o ngɛ de ɔ ngɛ 
mi niinɛ ngɛ blɔ ko nɔ.
5. Moo gbe o nyɛmi koli silɔ ɔ demi ɔmɛ a he guɛ konɛ o ti nihi nɛ o de kɛ fi o da he 
ɔ se ɔ mi kɛ muɔ nya sami ɔ nya.
E nya muɔmi
Hiɛ ɔ ji he nɛ saneyo ngmalɔ ɔ muɔɔ yi mi tomi ɔ nya. Nihi nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ ji blɔhi a nɔ 
nɛ a guɔ kɛ muɔɔ saneyo nya.
1. Moo ti munyutso oti ɔ mi.
2. Moo tsɔɔ o da he ɔ ekohu.
3. Ha tue mi ngɔɔmi munyu kɛ muɔ nya sami ɔ nya.
Ni tsumi 5�1 Nya sami saneyohi
1. Ngɔɔ mo nitsɛ o munyunguhi kɛ tsɔɔ nya sami saneyo kɛ e he blɔ nɔ tomi ɔmɛ 
a nya.
2. Mo susu nɔ ko nɛ nyɛ sɛsɛ aloo nya sami ko nɛ ya nɔ ngɛ o wami si himi mi. 
Mɛni he nɛ nya sami ɔ kɔɔ? Mɛni ni oti komɛ nɛ sa hyɛmi. Nihi a sisi numi ba 
ngɛ nya sami ɔ se lo?

Kɛ tsa nɔ ɔ, si gbɛmi tsɔɔ kaa kaseli nɛ a tuɔ a je gbi ɔ saminya a, a juɛmi nya bliɔ, 
a kaiɔ nɔ saminya nɛ a susuɔ nɔ he mla kɛ hlaa tsaba ha nɔ peepee ko. Enɛ ɔ baa mi 
akɛnɛ kaseli ɔmɛ a je gbi ɔ ji nɔ nɛ ngɛ a juɛmi nɔ kɛ ha nihi a he susumi kɛ a he blɔ 
nya tomi.
Nyagbe ɔ, nɔ ko e je gbi tumi ɔ yeɔ bua kɛ haa sukuu ni kasemi blɔ nya tomi, kusumi 
lemi kɛ juɛmi nya wami. Kaa nihi nɛ a ngɛ ni kasee ngɛ Siniɔ Hai sukuu ɔ, e he hia kaa 
nyɛ bua maa jɔ nɛ nyɛ maa fua nyɛ je gbi kasemi ɔ wawɛɛ benɛ nyɛ ngɛ gbi kpahi hu 
kasee ɔ konɛ nyɛ juɛmi nya nɛ bli kɛ wo ni kasemi nihi a he.
Nimeli de ke, ‘Je gbi mi nɛ a nlaa ngɛ’.

Ni tsumi 5�8 Atikle/Sipitsi ngmami
Ngɛ kuuhi a mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngma sipitsi aloo atikle nɛ hɛɛ kuku etɛ ngɛ munyutso nɛ 
ɔ nɔ: “Nɔ yami ngɛ ye sukuu”. Nyɛɛ bɔ mɔde kaa nyɛ ma tsu blɔ nɔ nɛ a guɔ kɛ 
ngmaa atikle kɛ sipitsi ɔ he ni kaa bɔ nɛ wa sɛsɛ he ɔ. Nyɛ dla nyɛ he kaa nyɛ maa 
kane atikle aloo sipitsi ɔ nɛ nyɛ ngma a kɛ ha nyɛ tsu mi bi ɔmɛ konɛ nyɛɛ sɛsɛ he.
PIJUA SƐ WOMI NGMAMI KƐ E HE BLƆ NƆ 
TOMI ƆMƐ
Nɔ nitsɛ he kami – Waa hyɛ he nɛ o su
Loko wa ma tsa nɔ kɛ hyɛ saneyo slɔɔto ɔmɛ ɔ, nyɛ kai saneyo slɔɔto eywiɛ kɛ a he blɔ 
nɔ tomi ɔmɛ nɛ wa kase ɔmɛ.
Pijua sɛ womi
Pijua sɛ womi ji sɛ womi nɛ a ngmaa ngɛ nɔ ko klɛdɛɛ ko he nɛ e nyɛɛɔ blɔ nɔ tomi 
pɔtɛɛ komɛ a nɔ. A tsuɔ pijua sɛ womi he ni ngɛ gbi nɛ hɛɛ lilɛ mi kɔmi kɛ ha blɔ nya 
komɛ aloo nikɔtɔma komɛ.
A tsuɔ pijua sɛ womi he ni kɛ haa nɔ yeli aloo nikɔtɔma komɛ kaa sukuu nya dali, 
oposide womi he ni tsuli, ni tsumi nɔ hyɛli, osɔfo nɔkɔtɔmahi, ma nɔ yeli, matsɛmɛ, 
kpokpa nɔ hyɛli kɛ ekpa komɛ.
Nihi nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ ji blɔhi a nɔ nɛ a guɔ kɛ ngmaa pijua sɛ womi.
1. Lɛtɛ ngmalɔ ɔ adlɛɛsi: Enɛ ɔ ji nɔ kekle nɛ a naa ngɛ lɛtɛ ɔ mi. Lɛtɛ ngmalɔ adlɛɛsi 
ɔ hiɔ hiɔwe ngɛ hiɔ nine nɔ.
2. Be (deti): Enɛ ɔ ji ligbi nɛ o ngɛ lɛtɛ ɔ ngmae.
3. Nɔ nɛ ngɔ nɛ lɛtɛ ɔ yaa adlɛɛsi: Nɔ nɛ ngɔ nɛ lɛtɛ ɔ ya a e biɛ aloo e blɔ nya kɛ e 
adlɛɛsi hiɔ muɔ nine nɔ ngɛ hiɔwe.
4. Ngami: Ngami nɛ sa a ekomɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ (Hɛminyamitsɛ, Kpokpa nɔ hyɛlɔ, Ye tsɔɔlɔ, 
kɛ ekpa komɛ).
5. Yiti/Oti/Yi: Yiti aloo oti nɛ tsɔɔ nɔ he je nɛ o ngɛ lɛtɛ ɔ ngmae ngɛ ji nɔ nɛ maa 
ba hiɛ ɔ. A ngmaa lɛ kɛ ningma okadi nguahi. Enɛ ɔ peeɔ sɛgbi ɔ nɔ domi kpiti.
6. Nya blimi: A ngɔɔ demi komɛ nɛ e he hia kɛ bliɔ sɛ womi ɔ nya kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ he je nɛ 
o ngɛ sɛ womi ɔ ngmae ngɛ.
7. Kukuhi: Yi mi tomi fɛɛ ko nɛ o ma je kpo ɔ, e sa nɛ e hɛɛ lɛ nitsɛ e kuku. Kuku ɔ 
waa sɛ womi kanelɔ ɔ kɛ nuɔ nihi nɛ o ngɛ de ɔ sisi saminya.

8. Nya muɔmi: Ngɛ lɛtɛ ɔ nyagbe ɔ, e sa nɛ lɛtɛ ngmalɔ ɔ nɛ muɔ lɛtɛ ɔ nya kɛ nɔ mi 
mami
To he hɛ: Ngɛ pijua sɛ womi ngmami mi ɔ, e sa nɛ lɛtɛ ɔ mi nɛ tsɔ nɛ e hi e glɛ 
nɔ. Bɔɔ mɔde kaa o ma tsu gbitso nɛ he hia he ni konɛ o tsu blɔ nɔ tomi nɛ a kɛ 
ngmaa pijua sɛ womi ɔ he ni tutuutu. Bɔɔ mɔde kaa o maa hyɛ ni ngmami mi 
okadi ɔmɛ kɛ animosa he ni tsumi ɔ nɛ a hi glɛ nɔ.
Ni tsumi 5�9 Lɛtɛ/sɛ womi ngmami blɔ nɔ tomihi
Ngmaa blɔ nɔ nɛ a guɔ kɛ ngmaa pijua sɛ womi nɛ o de ha nyɛ tsu mi bi ɔmɛ.
Ni tsumi 5�10 Pijua sɛ womi ngmami
Ngɛ nyɛ kuu ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, nyɛɛ ngma sɛ womi ya ha nyɛ ma mi matsɛ ɔ nɛ nyɛ de lɛ 
nɔ yami ni etɛ komɛ nɛ sa kaa a gbe a peemi nya ngɛ ma a mi. Bɔɔ mɔde kaa nyɛ 
maa nyɛɛ pijua sɛ womi ngmami blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ nɔ konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ tsu mi bi ɔmɛ 
nɛ sɛsɛ he.
MAJUA SƐ WOMI NGMAMI KƐ E HE BLƆ 
NƆ TOMI ƆMƐ
Majua sɛ womihi
Majua sɛ womihi ji sɛ womihi nɛ a ngmaa kɛ haa huɛmɛ aloo wekuli aloo paka mi 
bi. E mi munyu ɔmɛ ngɛ kaa majua munyuhi. A nyɛɔ paleɔ sablaihi kɛ se biɛhi ngɛ e 
ngmami ɔ mi.
Majua sɛ womi he blɔ nɔ tomihi
Nihi nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔmɛ ji blɔhi a nɔ nɛ a guɔ kɛ ngmaa majua sɛ womihi.
1. Lɛtɛ ngmalɔ ɔ adlɛɛsi:  Lɛtɛ ngmalɔ adlɛɛsi ɔ ji nɔ kekle nɛ o maa ngma. O maa 
ngma enɛ ɔ ngɛ hiɔwe ngɛ hiɔ nine nɔ. E sa nɛ o ngma adlɛɛsi ɔ mluku konɛ ke e 
maa hi ɔ, o ngɔ GPS adlɛɛsi ɔ kɛ piɛɛ he.
2. Be (deti): Enɛ ɔ ji ligbi nɛ o ngɛ lɛtɛ ɔ ngmae. E baa ngɛ adlɛɛsi ɔ sisi.
3. Ngami: Ngami komɛ kaa Ye mami, Ye nyɛwetsɛ, Nyɛko Baake, Papakuao, Alistoto 
(Sablaihi) kɛ ekpa komɛ ji nɔ nɛ o ma nyɛ tsu a he ni.
4. Nya blimi: Gbitso he ni nɛ o ma tsu ɔ, e sa nɛ e pee nɔ ko nɛ lɛtɛ kanelɔ ɔ ma na 
he buajɔ. O ma nyɛ tsu munyungu komɛ a he ni ke o ngma lɛtɛ ɔ kɛ yaa ha o huɛ 
se o be jamɛ a munyungu ɔmɛ a he ni nyɛɛe ma tsu ke o ngma kɛ yaa ha o weku 
nɔkɔtɔma ko.

5. Munyutso: Gbi he ni nɛ o ma tsu ɔ nɛ hi gbugbuugbu nɛ bua jɔmi nɛ hi he. Nɔ nɛ 
ngɔ nɛ lɛtɛ ɔ ya a maa tsɔɔ gbitso he ni nɛ o ma tsu. Ke o ngma kɛ yaa ha o huɛ ɔ, o 
ma nyɛ tsu munyu tubɔ faa komɛ kaa palemi kɛ jua munyungu komɛ a he ni se ke 
o ngma kɛ yaa ha o fɔli aloo nɔkɔtɔma ko ɔ, o be jamɛ a munyu ɔmɛ a he ni nyɛe 
ma tsu. E sa nɛ bu nɛ hi munyungu ɔmɛ a he.
6. Nya muɔmi: Ngɛ hiɛ ɔ, o maa muɔ lɛtɛ ɔ nya kɛ yi mi tomi nɛ o kɛ ngɛ lɛtɛ ɔ 
ngmae. Mo de nɔ ko nɛ maa wo kanelɔ ɔ bua. Ekohu ɔ, de lɛtɛ kanelɔ ɔ nɛ lɛ hu e 
ngma kɛ mane mo. Enɛ ɔ ma wa kɛ ha ni sɛɛmi ɔ nɔ tsami.
7. Sisi nine womi: Blɔ pɔtɛɛ ko be nɛ a kɛ woɔ majua lɛtɛ sisi nine se mohu e je nɔ 
nɛ ngɔ nɛ lɛtɛ ɔ yaa. Bɔ nɛ a woɔ sisi nine ekomɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
a.  O suɔlɔ kpakpa
b.  O bɔɔdɔ
c. O bɛlɛ
d.  O siklitɛ
e.  O nyɛmi
f. O bi
g. O senɔ
8. Biɛ: Enɛ ɔmɛ a se ɔ, o maa ngma o biɛ.
To he hɛ: Ngɛ majua sɛ womi ngmami mi ɔ, gbitso he ni nɛ a tsuɔ ɔ ya peeɔ nɔ yi mi 
nɔ. A ji sɛ womihi nɛ a ngmaa kɛ haa nihi nɛ wa le mɛ kaa huɛmɛ, wekuli kɛ pakabi.
Ni tsumi 5�11 Majua sɛ womi ngmami blɔ nɔ tomihi
1. Mo kai nɛ o ngma pijua sɛ womi ngmami blɔ nɔ tomi ɔmɛ.
2. Mɛni be mi nɛ a ngmaa majua sɛ womi (kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ ekpa ngɛ pijua sɛ womi 
ngmami he ɔ)?
3. Ngmaa majua sɛ womi blɔ nɔ tomi ɔmɛ konɛ nyɛɛ kɛ nyɛ tsu mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ sɛsɛ 
he.
Majua sɛ womi nɔhyɛ nɔ: Huɛ sɛ womi ngmami.

Be sai ji nɛ ɔ nɛ wa kpi. Kɛ o sɛmista a ya nɔ kɛɛ? I susu nɛ ma mane mo imeli kɛ bɔ 
mo amaniɛ ngɛ bɔ nɛ ye sɛmista a ya nɔ ha ngɛ Ablotsi Yunivɛsiti ɔ. I ba hiɛ ɔ maa pee 
otsi ekpa ji nɛ ɔ nɛ i yo kaa hiɛ ɔ si himi ɔ bɔni ye he nɔ peemi bɔɔbɔɔbɔɔ. I bɔni gbi ɔ 
hu tumi bɔ nɛ sa.
I ba su hiɛ ɔ ngɛ Lemɔ oslami ɔ e kekle otsi ɔ mi. Fiɛ ɔ nya wɛ tsɔ. E ngɛ mi kaa wa ngɛ 
Kɔle oslami ɔ mi lɛɛ se pu ngɛ tsoe nɛ je ɔ mi dɔ la bɔ nɛ sa. Anɔkuale munyu ji kaa, i

Weku nɛ i ba to mɛ ɔ bua jɔ ye he saminya. I ngɛ ami nitsɛ ye tsu nɛ i hwɔɔ mi se wa 
yeɔ mɔtu ni, piani ni kɛ gbɔkuɛ ni kɛ blaa. Daa Hɔgba piani ɔ, wa yeɔ we mi ni ngɔngɔɛ. 
Ngɛ ‘Spain’ ɔ, piani ni yemi ji ni yemi ko nɛ a fiɛ we he kulaa. A pɔɔ nya mi ngɔɔmi ni 
nɛ wa tsɛɔ lɛ sanyabɛdɔ yemi ke a ye piani ni ta. Piɔ pɛ i gbe ye sanyabɔdɔ yemi ɔ nya.
Kɛ je Hɔɛgbi kɛ ya si Soha a, i yaa ni kasemi ngɛ lejɛ ɔ Yunivɛsiti ɔ kake. I kɛ nihi 
babauu nɛ tuɔ ‘Spanish’ gbi ɔ kpeɔ ngɛ lejɛ ɔ. A mi mi jɔ nɛ a taa bua si ha mi. Sisije ɔ, 
pɔ tɔ ye he kɛ a gbi ɔ sisi numi se amlɔ nɛ ɔ, i kɛ mɛ sɛɛɔ ni nɛ i nuɔ nihi nɛ a deɔ tsuo 
sisi. A ye odase kaa ye ‘Spanish’ tumi ɔ ya hɛ mi kɛ je benɛ a kɛ mi kpe ɔ. Piɔ lɛɛ, i nyɛɔ

Ye bua jɔ ye he kaa i ye sɛmista a ngɛ ‘Spain’. Wa ngɛ he jɔɔmi be babauu ngɛ wa hɛ kpɛ 
lɔ ɔ he ɔ, i kɛ ye huɛ ɔ ekomɛ maa hia blɔ kɛ ya ‘France’ nɛ wa ma ya ye ligbi eywiɛ. Blɔ

a pɔɔ tlee mi himi kɛ blɔ hiami. Ye bua jɔ he!
I he ye kaa ma nu o he ngɛ be kpiti mi. Kaa bɔ nɛ i de ɔ, bɔɔ mɔde kaa be fɛɛ be ɔ, o kɛ 
mi ma na ni sɛɛmi. Eko ɔ, o ma nyɛ ba slaa mi po! Kɛ o susu kɛɛ?

MUNYU SISI JEMI
Sisi jemi
Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ a ma je munyu ko sisi kɛ je gbi kake mi kɛ ya gbi kpa mi. Gbi mi nɛ 
munyu nɛ a ma je sisi ɔ ngɛ ɔ ji kekle gbi (source language) nɛ gbi mi nɛ a ma je 
munyu ɔ sisi kɛ ya a peeɔ gbi enyɔne (target language).
60
SANEYO KƐ SISI JEMI
Sɛ EnyɔMI GBAMI  5
Nihi nɛ waa ngɛ sisi jemi mi
Sisi jemi hiaa blɔ nɔ tomi nɛ ma wa nɔ ngɛ kɛtsɛ jemi, sisi numi kɛ munyu sisi jemi kɛ 
je gbi kake mi kɛ ya gbi kpa mi. Nihi nɛ nyɛɛ se ɔ ji kudɔmi nihi.
1. Sisi jemi nihi a nya tsɔɔmi: Tsɔɔ slɔɔto nɛ ngɛ sisi jemi kɛ nya tsɔɔmi a kpɛti kɛ 
se namihi nɛ ngɛ kusumi nɛ kɔɔ gbi ɔ he ɔ he.
2. Dla kɛ ha ni kanemi mi kɛtsɛ womihi: Bɔɔ mɔde kaa o ma nyɛ kane kekle gbi ɔ 
saminya nɛ o nu sisi hulɔ.
3. Munyu he kpami: Mo yo demiyo ɔ, gbitso, nɔ he je kɛ nihi nɛ a maa bu tue ɔ 
saminya.
4. O hɛ nɛ hi kɛtsɛhi nɛ a kɛ jeɔ demiyo sisi ɔ nɔ: Ekomɛ ji
a. Sisi jemi gu kɛ sisi jemi gbajaa
b. Gbi ɔ he kusumihi a lemi
c. Gbi mi zɔ woli a he ni tsumi
d. Munyuhi kɛ a sibi a he tomi
e. Henɔ munyu hlami
5. Sisi jemi he mi kami: Jee sisi kɛ munyu kpiti konɛ o tsa nɔ kɛ munyu nɛ nya ka 
bɔɔ.
6. Sisi jemi dadɛ: Je munyu ɔ sisi bɔ nɛ sa pe nɛ o ma je sisi kɛkɛ.
7. Tsu juɛmi klamahi a he ni: Tsu klamahi nɛ ma wa kɛ ha nɔ sisi jemi ɔ he ni.
8. Nɔ kɛ nɔ mi nylɔmi kɛ juɛmi kpo jemi: Nylɔ o nyɛmi kaseli ekpa amɛ a sisi jemi 
ɔ mi konɛ o je o juɛmi kpo ngɛ he.
9. Tsa nɔ kɛ munyu pɔtɛɛhi: Mo tsa nɔ kɛ munyu pɔtɛɛhi (nɔhyɛ ni; mlaa, hiɔ tsami, 
ga lele kɛ ekpa komɛ) kɛ kase a he ni konɛ o he nɛ be ngɛ mi.
10. Gɛjɛmi womi kɛ ha ni kasemi nɔ tsami: Tsa nɔ nɛ o ka o he mi ngɛ munyu sisi 
jemi ɔ mi. Lɔ ɔ ma ha o he maa be ngɛ munyu sisi jemi mi.
Sisi jemi slɔɔtohi
Sisi jemi slɔɔtohi nɛ ngɛ. Ekomɛ ji
1. Womi nɔ sisi jemi: Enɛ ɔ peeɔ munyungu nɔ dami kɛ ha sisi jemi se pi munyutso ɔ.
2. Sisi jemi faa/gbajaa: Enɛ ɔ ya peeɔ munyu mi zɔ woli a he ni tsumi kɛ je munyu 
sisi nɛ haa sisi numi ɔ kɛ gbimikɔmi ɔ jeɔ kpo paa.
3. Sisi jemi ngɛ kusumi glɛ nɔ: Je munyu ɔ sisi nɛ e kɛ gbi enyɔne ɔ kusumi glɛ nɔ 
nɛ sɔ.
4. Sisi tsɔɔmi tutuutu: Ngɛ sisi jemi ɔ mi ɔ, bɔɔ mɔde kaa munyutso nɛ ngɛ kekle 
gbi ɔ mi kɛ gbi enyɔne ɔ nɛ sɔ.
61
SANEYO KƐ SISI JEMI
Sɛ EnyɔMI GBAMI  5
5. Sisi tsɔɔmi: Enɛ ɔ ji gbi nya jemi ngɛ he nya buami he komɛ kaa kpe peemi, 
kojomi he, sɔlemi kɛ ekpa komɛ.
6. Sisi jemi kɛkɛ: Enɛ ɔ ji blɔ nɔ nɛ a jeɔ munyu ɔ sisi kɛkɛ. Yi mi tomi nɛ a kɛ ngma 
a laa. A nyɛɔ nɛ a woɔ ni ɔmɛ a he ngo aloo a jeɔ munyunguhi nɛ a he hia amɛ ngɛ 
mi. Enɛ ɔ haa nɛ sisi numi tutuutu ɔ tsakeɔ.
7. Yi mi tomi nɛ ko laa: Yi mi tomi nɛ a kɛ ngma munyutso ɔ nɛ ko laa ngɛ gbi nɛ 
o ngɛ sisi jee kɛ yaa mi ɔ mi. E hia nɛ o hyɛ munyutso ɔ, yi mi tomi ɔ, tue buli kɛ 
henɔ munyunguhi.
Sisi jemi he ni tsumi
Sisi jemi he ni tsumi ɔ ekomɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ
1. Munyuza kpokploo: Je munyuza kpokploo sisi kɛ je Aflane gbi mi kɛ ba Dangme 
mi. Moo hyɛ animosa glɛ nɔ be mi nɛ o ngɛ sisi jee ɔ. (Kai kaa Aflaane gbi ɔ maa 
pee kekle gbi nɛ Dangme ɔ maa pee gbi enyɔne).
2. Munyu mi zɔ woli: Moo ka o he mi ngɛ munyu mi zɔ woli, munyungu babɛɛhi kɛ 
munyukpɔfahi a sisi jemi mi.
3. Kuku kpitihi: Je kuku kpitihi a sisi nɛ sisi numi ɔ nɛ je kpo paa.
4. Sisi jemi ngɛ yi mi tomi pɔtɛɛ ko he: Je munyu ko sisi ngɛ yi mi tomi pɔtɛɛ ko 
he, (Nɔhyɛ ni; mlaa, hiɔ tsami, ga lele kɛ ekpa komɛ) kɛ kase munyungu kɛ demi 
ehehi.
5. Kpo nɔ sisi jemi: Je demi komɛ kaa asilɛ kɛ nyazia kpitikpitihi a sisi konɛ e ye bua 
mo nɛ o kase gbi he ni tsumi, kɛtsɛ jemi kɛ henɔ munyunguhi a sisi jemi.
6. Amaniɛbɔ sanehi: Je amaniɛbɔ sanehi a sisi tutuutu konɛ e ye bua mo kɛ kase 
demiyo sisi jemi kɛ gbi ɔ he ni tsumi.
7. Ni sɛɛmi: Je ni sɛɛmi sisi. (Nɔhyɛ ni; ni enyɔ a ni sɛɛmi, nɔ nya mi tami kɛ ekpa 
komɛ). Enɛ ɔ maa ye bua mo kɛ kase bɔ nɛ a jeɔ nɔ kpa nya mi munyu kɛ gbimikɔmi 
he ni nɛ e ma tsu ɔ sisi.
8. Sisi jemi kɛ a bi a he tomi: Ngɔɔ o sisi jemi ɔ kɛ to o nyɛmi nɔ he, (nɔhyɛ ni; sisi 
jemi tutuutu kɛ klama nɔ sisi jemi) konɛ e wa mo kɛ dla o nɔ ɔ.
9. Nɔ nitsɛ sisi jemi: Ngmaa demiyo ko ngɛ gbi kpa mi konɛ o je sisi kɛ ba Dangme 
mi. Enɛ ɔ maa ye bua mo kɛ kase nɔ sisi jemi saminya.
10. Nɔ kɛ nɔ mi nylɔmi: O kɛ o nyɛmi nɛ tsake nyɛ sisi jemi ɔmɛ konɛ nyɛ je nyɛ juɛmi

The Environment
In our modern world, there are many factors that place the wellbeing of the planet in 
jeopardy. While some people have the opinion that environmental problems are just 
a natural occurrence, others believe that human beings have a huge impact on the 
environment. Regardless of your viewpoint, take into consideration the following factors 
that place our environment as well as the planet Earth in danger.
Global warming or climate change is a major contributing factor to environmental 
damage. Because of global warming, we have seen an increase in melting ice caps, a 
rise in sea levels, and the formation of new weather patterns. These weather patterns 
have caused stronger storms, droughts, and flooding in places that they formerly did 
not occur.
Air pollution is primarily caused as a result of excessive and unregulated emissions of 
carbon dioxide into the air. Pollutants mostly emerge from the burning of fossil fuels 
in addition to chemicals, toxic substances, and improper waste disposal. Air pollutants 
are absorbed into the atmosphere, and they can cause smog, a combination of smoke 
and fog, in valleys as well as produce acidic precipitation in areas far away from the 
pollution source.
In many areas, people and local governments do not sustainably use their natural 
resources. Mining for natural gases, deforestation, and even improper use of water 
resources can have tremendous effects on the environment. While these strategies often 
attempt to boost local economies, their effects can lead to oil spills, interrupted animal 
habitats, and droughts.
Ultimately, the effects of the modern world on the environment can lead to many 
problems. Human beings need to consider the repercussions of their actions, trying 
to reduce, reuse, and recycle materials while establishing environmentally sustainable 
habits. If measures are not taken to protect the environment, we can potentially witness 
the extinction of more endangered species, worldwide pollution, and a completely 
uninhabitable planet.

A peeɔ kusumi kpɔmkpɔm ngɛ gba hami be ɔ mi. Ekomɛ ji
• Tɛlimi
• Agbo simi/He si jemi
• Nane he fɔmi
• Ngami
• Ngatsɛ tsumi haami kɛ nganyɛ se mi fɔmi
• Bajɔmɛ lemi
• Yo si bimi
• Yo hami kɛ e sɔlemi
• Nya tsumi haami
• Fiaa peemi
1. Tɛlimi: Kaa bɔ nɛ wa de momo ɔ, a tɛliɔ loko a peeɔ Dangme je kusumihi tsuo. 
Loko a ma ha gba a, a haa Tsaatsɛ Mawu kɛ e yo Zugba zu kɛ nimeli lemi nɛ a baa 
a dɛ mi gbaami loko a tsuɔ yo he ni.
2. Agbo simi/He si jemi: Ngɛ Dangme je ɔ, a yɛ nɔ we mi nɛ a si we agbo. Enɛ ɔ he je 
ɔ, nyumu wekuli nɛ ma yo he ni tsumi ɔ ma si agbo nɛ a ma he mɛ nɔ loko a maa 
sɛ a we ɔ mi. A haa sika kɛ sinapu kɛ siɔ agbo ngɛ he komɛ.
3. Nane he fɔmi: Dangmeli fɔɔ nubwɔ nane he loko a biɔ lɛ blɔ nɔ amaniɛ. Enɛ ɔ he 
je ɔ, a fɔɔ nyumu wekuli nɛ ma yo he ni tsumi ɔmɛ a nane he. A haa mɛ nyu nɛ a 
nu kekle nɛ lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a haa nane he fɔmi da.
4. Ngami: Kusumi nɛ a peeɔ ngɛ agbo simi se ji ngami. Nyumu wekuli ɔmɛ ma ha 
ngami da. Ke a nga ta a, a peeɔ amaniɛ kɛ jeɔ nɔ he je nɛ a kpe ɔ kpo.
5. Ngatsɛ tsumi haami kɛ nganyɛ se mi fɔmi: A ngmɛɔ blɔ nɛ a haa ngatsɛ tsumi nɛ 
a fɔɔ nganyɛ se mi. Ngɛ he komɛ ɔ, a haa ngatsɛ ɔ nyumu bo, tokota, ajowia kɛ e 
he sika kɛ haa lɛ fɔmi kɛ bi lɛmi tsumi. A haa nganyɛ ɔ hu bo kɛ doku kɛ e he sika. 
A tsɛɔ enɛ ɔ ke nganyɛ se mi fɔmi.
6. Bajɔmɛ lemi: Bajɔmɛ ji yo ɔ nyɛmi nyumuhi. A haa mɛ bajɔ sika kaa mɛ ji a nyɛmi 
yo ɔ he buli, titli ɔ, kɛ je nyumu kpahi a dɛ.
7. Yo si bimi: A ngmɛɔ blɔ nɛ a tsuɔ yo ɔ he ni jehanɛ ɔ. A haa sinapu, wisiki kɛ plɛɛte 
mi puemi. A haa yo he dlami ni kaa bo, duku, muɛ, subue, bɔdisi, juɛni kɛ tokota 
kɛ ni kpa komɛ. Nihi nɛ nɔ ko ngɛ a dɛ bɔɔ ɔ, a haa ni hoomi nihi, daka, biɛ, ginisi, 
fanta, lamlee kɛ da kpa komɛ. Be ngɛ nɛ a haa yo ɔ ni tsumi sika.

Fanteli piɛɛ Ohiɛli a he. Ngɛ a kusumi nya a, tsɛ nɛ ngɔɔ yo ha e bi. Ke tsɛ ɔ na kaa e 
bi ɔ su nyumu mi ɔ, o woɔ e dɛ mi tu nɛ e haa lɛ zugba nɛ e kɛ pee ngmɔ. Tsɛ ɔ haa 
niheyo ɔ ni nɛ ɔmɛ konɛ e bɔni ni tsumi nɛ e nyɛ nɛ e da si ngɛ e dɛhe. E haa lɛ e dɛhe 
tsu hulɔ. Enɛ ɔ se ɔ, a kɛ binyumu ɔ sɛsɛɔ e yo ngɔmi he. Ke lɛ nitsɛ e ngɛ pla ko momo 
ɔ, e deɔ e fɔli ɔmɛ nɛ ke pla nɛ ɔ ji yo nɛ a bua jɔ e he ɔ, kɛkɛ a bɔni e se pomi nɛ a kɛ 
yiheyo ɔ fɔli ya sɛɔ he ni. Biyo ɔ hu weku ya poɔ nyumu ɔ weku se. Ke weku enyɔ ɔ 
tsuo kplɛɛ nɔ ɔ, a haa gba a, nɛ ngɛ gba hami ɔ mi ɔ, a peeɔ kusumi nɛ ɔmɛ:
1.    Nhun enyim nsa: Enɛ ɔ ji da nɛ a haa yo ɔ weku kɛ biɔ blɔ kaa a maa suɔ nɛ a bi 
biyo ɔ si. A kɛ munyu nɛ ɔ fɔɔ biyo ɔ hɛ mi nɛ ke e kplɛɛ nɔ ke e maa gba a, a sɔleɔ 
da a nɛ a tɛliɔ nɛ a nuɔ kɛ maa nɔ mi. Hɔ ji be nɛ a pɔɔ ‘Nhun enyim nsa’ kusumi 
nɛ ɔ peemi ngɛ Fante ejakaa a hemi kɛ yemi ji kaa Hɔ ji Tsaatsɛ Mawu ligbi nɛ e 
ji tue mi jɔmi ligbi ha mɛ hulɔ. A tsɛɔ da nɛ ɔ ke ‘yoo’/‘nyew’/ akwanserɛ/kwanto 
nsa’ nɛ ji nɔ kplɛɛmi da.
2.    Pon ekyir/kɔkɔɔkɔ: Enɛ ɔ ji kusumi nɛ fiee se nɛ e ngɛ kaa agbo simi kusumi ngɛ 
Dangme je ɔ kɛ. A haa sinapu tɔ kake kɛ e he kaplɛ bɔɔ kɛ tsuɔ kusumi nɛ ɔ.
3.    Bɔwdo – Toa: Lɔ ɔ se ɔ, a peeɔ ‘Bɔwdo – toa’ kusumi nɛ ngɛ enɛ ɔ peemi mi ɔ, a 
haa bitsɛ ɔ sika nɛ a haa weku ɔ hu sika kɛ da ngɛ dengme nɛ a gbo ngɛ biyo ɔ 
lɛmi he. Anɛ kusumi nɛ ɔ kɛ Dangme yo he ni tsumi kusumi ɔ eko sɔ lo? Mo de.
4.    Tamboba: A haa binyɛ ɔ sika ngɛ e dengme nɛ e gbo kɛ ha nyɔ, kpa bi, fɔ tako 
he kɛ nɔ nɛ e na kɛ lɛ biyo kɛ ba su e yihe mi. E sa nɛ o to he hɛ kaa pi biyo ɔ nɛ 
a ngɛ juae ha nyumu ɔ se ayekoo kɛkɛ a ngɛ binyɛ kɛ bitsɛ ɔ hae ngɛ a ni tsumi 
kpakpa nɛ a tsu ngɛ a biyo ɔ lɛmi he.
5.   Tsinsa/dase: A haa sinapu kɛ sika nɛ enɛ ɔ ji yo ɔ he ni tsumi nihi tutuutu. Ke 
nyumu ɔ weku tloo je nɛ ɔ tsuo ya ha yo ɔ wekuli nɛ ‘Tsinsa/dase’ piɛɛ we he ɔ 
lɛɛ a tsu we yo ɔ he ni. A ngɔɔ da kɛ sika nɛ ɔ eko kɛ toɔ nɛ a kɛ bɔɔ wekuli tsuo 
amaniɛ. O ma nyɛ kɛ enɛ ɔ nɛ to Dangme je gba hami kusumi ɔ eko he lo? Moo 
tsɔɔ.
6.    Tsir adze: Enɛ ɔ ji sika nɛ nyumu ɔ weku haa kɛ to yo ɔ ni tsumi sisi. Susumi ngɛ 
sika nɛ ɔ hami he ji kaa, ke alini nɛ gba a ya puɛ ɔ, yo ɔ be e be puɛe gu se e ma 
na e dɛ mi sika nɛ e ma nyɛ kɛ tsu ni kɛ hyɛ e he nɔ. Ke pe e hɛɛ hiɔ hu ɔ, e kɛ se 
nami aloo vide nɛ e na ngɛ ni tsumi mi ɔ eko maa wo hiɔ ɔ. Sika nɛ ɔ nɛ a haa a 
kle bɔ nɛ sa. Dangme je plɛɛte mi puemi ɔ kɛ Fanteli a ‘tsir adze’ kusumi ɔ sɔ lo?
7.    Akontan-sekan: A haa bajɔmɛ sika nɛ a tsɛɔ ke ‘Akontan-sekan’ nɛ tsɔɔ kaa bajɔmɛ 
a dɛ mi tu. A he mi kɛ yemi ji kaa bajɔmɛ nɛ buɔ a nyɛmiyo ɔ he kɛ jeɔ nyumu 
kpahi a dɛ. A poɔ a nyɛmiyo ɔ he piɛ kɛ haa e huno ɔ. Bajɔ ɔmɛ nitsɛ nɛ tsɔɔ sika 
abɔ nɛ a ha mɛ.

Ke a pee kusumi nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo gbe nya a, a deɔ ma tsuo ke, kɛ je jamɛ a bɛ ɔ mi kɛ yaa

Dagombatsɛmɛ ngɛ Gana Omleyi je ɔ tsuɔ kusumi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ a yo hami be
Paɣa laiɣbu: Enɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa pla peemi. Ke nyumu ɔ na yo nɛ muɔ e hɛ kaa e maa ngɔ 
ɔ, e haa lɛ kaplɛ bɔɔ kɛ tsɔɔ e suɔmi kɛ ha yo ɔ. Ke yo ɔ sɔle kaplɛ ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa e kplɛɛ 
suɔmi nɛ a je tsɔɔ lɛ ɔ nɔ. Be ngɛ nɛ yo ɔ ma de nyumu ɔ nɛ e ha lɛ be bɔɔ nɛ e kɛ susu 
he. Pee se ɔ, nyumu ya ngɔɔ heto ɔ kaa yo ɔ kplɛɛ e suɔmi ɔ nɔ aloo e kplɛɛ we nɔ.
Tibili yoobu: Kusumi nɛ ɔ ji Dagombatsɛmɛ a agbo simi nɛ a guɔ nɔ kɛ jeɔ nyumu ɔ he 
si kɛ haa yo ɔ wekuli. Nyumu ɔ jeɔ e juɛmi ngɛ yo ɔ ngɔmi he kpo kɛ haa yo ɔ wekuli.
Paɣapulugu: Paɣapulugu kusumi ɔ ji kaa yo ɔ tsɛmɛ maa tsɔɔ a wekuli nɛ sa nɛ 
nyumu ɔ nɛ ya le mɛ. Ke nyumu ɔ ya wekuli nɛ ɔmɛ a ngɔ ɔ, e jeɔ e juɛmi ngɛ yo ɔ 
ngɔmi he ɔ kɛ haa mɛ nɛ be komɛ ɔ, e haa mɛ hu kaplɛ bɔɔbɔɔbɔɔ.
Paɣa suhibu: Paɣa suhibu kusumi ɔ ji kaa nyumu ɔ ya baa yo ɔ ngɛ e fɔli a dɛ. E kɛ 
tlomi kɛ kaplɛ bɔɔ ya haa mɛ.
Paɣapini tibur: Ke yo ɔ fɔli kplɛɛ kaa a kɛ a biyo ɔ ma ha gba a, a sɔleɔ ni ɔmɛ nɛ a 
ba ke mɛ ɔ kɛ maa nɔ mi.
Paɣakpuɣibu: Kusumi nɛ ɔ ji kaa, nyumu ɔ huɛmɛ ya kuɔ yo ɔ kɛ ya haa nyumu ɔ ngɛ 
e we mi nɛ yo ɔ fɔli li he nɔ ko.

Mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ je ɔ hɛ mi tsakemi ɔ wo ni kpakpahi kɛ ni yayahi tsuo kɛ wo kusumi 
gba hami ɔ mi nɛ lɛ nɔ ɔ ha nɛ kusumi ɔ peemi hɛ mi ngɛ tsakee. Mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ ni

1.  Sukuu tsɔsemi: Sukuu tsɔsemi bliɔ nihi a juɛmi nya kɛ suɔ tsitsaa nɛ e woɔ mɛ he 
wami, titli ɔ, yihi nɛ a da a nane nɔ nɛ a faa mɛ nitsɛmɛ a he ke a maa sɛ gba si 
himi mi. Nyumu ɔ kɛ yo ɔ tsuo nyɛɔ nɛ a tsɔɔ ligbi nɛ a kɛ maa pee kusumi ɔ, bɔ 
nɛ a maa pee lɛ ha kɛ he nɛ a maa suɔ nɛ a pee lɛ ngɛ nɛ nɔ kpa ko tsi we a nya.
2.  Adesahi a he blɔ kɛ blɔ nya kɛ yihi kɛ nyumuhi a sɔmi ngɛ mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ si himi mi: 
Gɔgɔ nɛ a ngɛ fiae ngɛ adesahi a he blɔ nɛ a ngɛ kɛ blɔ nya nɛ a ngɛ kɛ yihi kɛ 
nyumuhi a sɔmi ngɛ mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ si himi mi ɔ wo tsakemi kɛ ngɛ kusumi ɔ 
peemi mi bae. A ngɛ ni ɔmɛ a nɔ jee nɛ a kɛ ekpahi hu ngɛ he piɛɛe. Yihi a blɔ nya 
ngɛ weto ni yemi he kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ ba he si jehanɛ ɔ nɛ e ba sɛ kusumi mi sisiisi.
3.  Jami he kɔhi: Kliistofoli a jami, klamɔ jami kɛ jami kpahi a hemi kɛ yemi, a susumi 
kɛ a kɔhi ha nɛ kusumi ɔ ngɛ tsakee. A ngɔɔ hemi kɛ yemi ngɛ jami nɛ ɔmɛ a mi ɔ 
kɛ tsakaa kusumi peemi ni ɔmɛ. Be ngɛ nɛ a tsakeɔ kusumi ni ɔmɛ nɛ a deɔ ke a ji 
wɔ jami nihi aloo kolo nihi. Nihi ngɔɔ nguɛ ga kɛ kadiɔ a he ngɛ gba si himi mi nɛ 
enɛ ɔ be Dangme kusumi mi kulaa.
4.  Ni tsumi kɛ kaplɛ: Nihi a ni tsumi haa nɛ kaplɛ daa a dɛ nɛ lɛ nɔ ɔ he je ɔ, a ngɛ he 
blɔ kɛ he wami nɛ a ma nyɛ tsɔɔ nɔ nɛ a suɔ. Yo nɛ ngɛ ni tsumi kpakpa ko tsue ɔ 
be suɔe nɛ e tsɛ aloo e nyɛ ba ngɔ e nya kɛ wo nyumu nɛ e maa suɔ nɛ e kɛ hi si ɔ 
hlami mi.
5. Ma ngua mi yami: Be abɔ nɛ nihi ngɛ ma nguahi a mi yae ɔ, ja kɛ a kɛ nihi munomunohi 
ngɛ bɔe nɛ a ngɛ a kusumi kpahi kasee. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ ni kpahi a yo he ni tsumi 
kusumi ni peemihi ba ngɛ Dangme nɔ ɔ mi sɛe.
6. Oposide kɛ sosia midia: Oposide kɛ sosia midia nɛ ba pɔ he, titli ɔ wɔsapu, fesibuku 
tikitɔki ɔ, haa nihi he blɔ nɛ a bɔɔ ngɛ kpa nɔ. A kpeɔ nɛ a sɛɛɔ ni nɛ a peeɔ pla nɛ 
a nɛ a he tete po gblee. Enɛ ɔ ha nɛ nyumu kɛ yo se pomi ngɛ yee.
7.  Ma se kɛ Ablootsi yami: Nihi hiaa blɔ kɛ yaa ma se, ma nguahi a mi aloo Ablootsi. 
A kɛ ni kpahi nɛ a kusumi ɔ je muno kulaa ngɛ Dangme nɔ ɔ he ɔ ya kpeɔ. A kɛ a 
he ya woɔ kusumi nɛ ɔ ekomɛ a mi nɛ ni komɛ po ya ngɔɔ a huɛmɛ, a ni tsuli aloo 
ma setsɛmɛ kaa a fɔli kɛ a wekuli nɛ a ya tsuɔ yo he ni haa mɛ aloo a ya sɔleɔ gba 
ngɛ yo weku nane mi nɛ pohu, a ji weku ɔ mi saasaasaa.
8.  Mlaa hehi: Ma mlaahi kɛ ma blɔ nɔ tomihi ha nɛ tsakemi komɛ baa kusumi gba hami 
ɔ mi. Ekomɛ ji a ngɔ nine ngɔ wo gba womi sisi loko gba a nɛ pee gbugbuugbu.

hu ɔ, a woɔ tsakemi he nyagbahi kɛ baa.

INTRODUCTION
This section is a build-up on the traditional clan system and the traditional governance 
structures you were introduced to in year one. This section provides you with another 
opportunity to explore the traditional clan system and the traditional governance 
structures amongst the various language groups in Ghana. You will examine the 
traditional clan systems within other Ghanaian cultures, analyse their significance 
and compare them with that of your culture and compare it with those of other 
Ghanaian cultures. Your understanding and knowledge of traditional clan systems 
and governance structure is crucial because it broadens your scope of knowledge to 
be able to appreciate and understand Ghanaian language studies as well as the related 
subjects such as Religious Studies and History amongst others. The knowledge you 
gain will equip you to appreciate your traditional clan and traditional governance 
systems and those of other cultural groups in Ghana.

Wɛtso ji nimli adesahi a he nya buami ngɛ ma ko mi. Wɛtso peeɔ nihi nɛ je fɔmi kpa

nyatsɛ aloo wɛtso matsɛ. Wa ngɛ wɛtsohi ngɛ Aflika, Sukɔtland kɛ blema ma kusumi 
komɛ a mi. Wɛtsohi babauu ngɛ a kɔ nihi kɛ a kɔ lohwehi. Wɛtso nya dalɔ ɔ peeɔ

Wɛtso he so komɛ
Ni pɔtɛɛ komɛ nɛ a naa ngɛ wɛtso he ji kaa:
1� Nɛnɛkasoa: Wɛtso mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo je nɛnɛkasoa kake sisi.
2� Wɛtso kpa: Wɛtso mi bi ɔmɛ ngɛ tsa kpa kɛ gu muɔ mi fɔmi mi.
3� Biɛ hinemi: Wɛtso mi bi ɔmɛ hineɔ wɛtso biɛ kake.
4� Kake peemi si himi: Wɛtso mi bimɛ ngɛ kake peemi kɛ he numi kɛ ha a sibi nɛ a 
suɔ wɛtso ɔ kake peemi kɛ nɔ yami.
5� Nɔ kuɔmi blɔ nɔ tomi: Wɛtso fɛɛ wɛtso ngɛ nɔ kuɔmi he blɔ nɔ tomi. A ngɛ 
matsɛmɛ, nya dali, nimeli kɛ ni kpahi nɛ a maa munyuhi a nya si ha wɛtso ɔ nɛ a 
kudɔɔ wɛtso ɔ hulɔ.
6� Kusumi kake: Wɛtso mi bi ngɛ kusumihi, blɔ nɔ tomihi, kɔhi, ninyɛ nihi, palemi 
kɛ ngamihi kake kɛ ekpa komɛ. Nɔhyɛ nɔ ngɛ Dangme mi ji kaa, ke a ma bi hawi 
si ɔ, a deɔ ke, “Kua amɛ gbo lo?”
7� Ni tsumi: Blema a, wɛtso mi bi tsuɔ ni tsumi he nɔ kake: okuaa yemi, je juami, ga 
lele ni tsumi kɛ ekpa komɛ.
8� Gbijlɔ yemi: Wɛtsohi ngɛ jami, jeha yemi, sɛ peemi kɛ kusumi kpahi kake.
Wɛtso he se nami komɛ
Kɛ je blema a, wɛtso he blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ ye bua adesa si himi ngɛ blɔhi munomunohi a 
nɔ kaa enɛ ɔmɛ:
1� Ma he nya buami: Wɛtso si fɔfɔɛ ɔ to ma he nya buami blɔ nya kɛ wo kuu 
tsɔwitsɔwi a mi kaa weku, ka si, kɔpe, kpɔ mi, huza mi, kɛ ekpa komɛ nɛ enɛ ɔ haa 
ma nɔ yemi yi saasaa.
2� Wɛtso/weku kpa: A maa nɔ mi kaa wɛtso mi bi peeɔ nimli kake nɛ a hiɔ si kɛ haa 
a sibi. A yeɔ buaa a sibi nɛ a nuɔ nɔ he ngɔ haa a sibi.
3� Tsakpa kɛ mitso lemi: Wɛtso tsɔɔ nɔ mitso kɛ tsakpa nɛ ngɛ nɔ kɛ nɔ a kpɛti. Nɔ 
kake ngɛ e he nimli babauu nɛ hɛɛ kusumi kake, puɛhe kake, niye he kake kɛ ekpa 
komɛ.
4� Kake peemi kɛ he numi: Wɛtso haa nɛ nihi hiɔ si kaa ma kake nɛ a yeɔ buaa a 
sibi. A hiɔ si ngɛ jesi munyu ɔ nya ke, “Nɔ he nɔ saa nɔ”.
5� Munyu yemi: Wɛtsohi ngɛ blɔ nɔ tomi nɛ a kɛ yeɔ nihi a kpɛti munyu nɛ a kɛ dlaa 
nihi a kpɛti pɛ.

9� Nɔ yami kɛ nɔ kuɔmi: Wɛtsohi toɔ blɔ nɔ konɛ nihi nɛ a ya nɔ ngɛ a ni tsumi aloo

10� Nyɛmi peemi: Wɛtsohi haa nihi nuɔ he kaa a piɛɛ ni babauu a he nɛ enɛ ɔ haa nɛ 
a nɔ gbagba teɔ ngɛ si himi kɛ nɔ peemi mi.
Nɛ je ɔ hɛ mi ngɛ tsakee daa je jananɛɛ nɛ ɔ, ja kɛ wɛtsohi hu a nihi ngɛ tsakee. Wɛtso 
he se nami ɔ hu ngɛ munomuno ngɛ mahi kɛ a kusumihi a nya. Tsakemi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ 
bae se loloolo ɔ, wɛtso nyɛ nɛ e buaa nihi a nya kaa nimli aloo ma kake.
Wɛtso biɛ komɛ kɛ Dangme ninyɛ/nihiɔ ni komɛ
Ngɛ Gana a, wɛtsohi ngɛ a kɔ ni kɛ a nihiɔ/ninyɛ nihi. Dangme wɛtso ɔmɛ hu ngɛ nihiɔ/
ninyɛ nihi. E sa nɛ o kai kaa Dangme ngɛ wɛtso nguahi kpaanyɔ: Sɛ, Yilo Klo, Manya 
Klo, Osu, Adaa, Nugo, Kpomi kɛ Gbugblaa nɛ wɛtso fɛɛ wɛtso ngɛ biɛ munomunohi nɛ 
a woɔ. Wa maa hyɛ bɔɔ ko kɛkɛ. Etsɛ T.O Caesar tsɔɔ biɛ nɛ ɔ ekomɛ ngɛ e womi “E 
peeɔ mo Dangme no” ɔ mi.

a. Dangmeli yi ahua, jesi, ala, ovɔnɔ/kuɔwi kɛ sinɔ.
b. A gbi wo mi hlami nɛ a yi hulɔ.
c. A yi demi, siato kɛ ogbetee nɛ a gbi mɛ.
d. A yi nako nɛ a gbi lɛ hulɔ.
Lohwe nɛ ɔmɛ pee he fami kɛ he piɛ pomi, blɔ tsɔɔmi kɛ ni tsumi kpahi kɛ ha Dangme nimeli 
kɛ yimeli ɔmɛ nɛ lɔ ɔmɛ a he je nɛ a hiɔ kaa a gbe mɛ aloo a ye a lo ɔ nɛ. Ahua lɛɛ e nya 
nyu kplɔlee ɔ he je nɛ a yi nɛ jesi hu lɛɛ a susu kaa e tsuaa gbogboe nɛ e yeɔ.

WƐTSO BLƆ NƆ TOMI KƐ MA NƆ YEMI
Sɛ EnyɔMI GBAMI  7
Ni tsumi 7�1 Wɛtso
Nyɛ je nyɛ juɛmi kpo kɛ tsɔɔ nɔ nɛ wɛtso ji. Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ e blɔ nɔ tomi, e ni tsumi, e 
puɛ he, e he se nami, wɛtso komɛ a biɛhi kɛ a nihiɔ nihi. Ke nyɛ gbe nya a, nyɛ de 
nyɛ heto ɔmɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ tsu mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ mɛ hu a de a heto ɔmɛ.
Ni tsumi 7�2 Wɛtsohi kɛ a sibi a he tomi
1. Ngɛ mo nitsɛ o dɛhe ɔ, ngmaa wɛtso munomuno enuɔ ngɛ nyɛ je kɛ etɛɛtɛ ngɛ 
je enyɔ kpa mi nɛ o tsɔɔ a nihiɔ ni.
2. De o heto ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ tsu mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ mɛ hu a de a heto ɔmɛ. Hla aba jemi 
kɛ slɔɔtohi nɛ ngɛ nyɛ heto ɔmɛ a mi.
Ni tsumi 7�3 Wɛtso he se nami
Ngɛ nyɛ kuuhi a mi ɔ, nyɛɛ sɛsɛ wɛtso he se nami etɛɛtɛ nɛ ma bi naa ngɛ a daadaa 
si himi mi.
Ni tsumi 7�4 Wɛtso blɔ nɔ tomihi/ni tsumihi
Nyɛɛ nu nyɛ he enyɔɔnyɔ nɛ nyɛɛ sɛsɛ nihi etɛ nɛ nyɛ wɛtso ɔ ngmɛ he blɔ nɛ a pee 
nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ ni nɛ ɔmɛ yeɔ nyɛ awi aloo a yeɔ buaa nyɛ ha.
Ni tsumi 7�5
Ngɛ daka nɛ wa be he ɔ mi ɔ, ngɔɔ wɛtso kake nɛ o gbɛ si kɛ hla bɔ nɛ a dlaa a he 
ha. Gbɛɛ si kɛ hla vidio ko nɛ tsɔɔ ma bi nɛ ngɛ nɔ ko he sɛsɛe ngɛ ma nɔ aloo kpe 
he ko.
Ni tsumi 7�6 Wɛtso ni tsumi
A hla mo kaa wɛtso matsɛ. De nihi etɛ nɛ o maa pee nɛ e ngɔ kake peemi kɛ ba 
wɛtso ɔ mi. De o heto ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ tsu mi bi ɔmɛ.
98
WƐTSO BLƆ NƆ TOMI KƐ MA NƆ YEMI
Sɛ EnyɔMI GBAMI  7
KUSUMI MA NƆ YEMI HE BLƆ NƆ TOMI
Kusumi ma nɔ yemi he blɔ nɔ tomi ji blɔhi a nɔ nɛ blematsɛmɛ gu kɛ hyɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ 
kɛ ma amɛ a nɔ. Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ nɔ kuɔmi he blɔ nɔ tomi nɛ pɔɔ nɔ yami ngɛ ni tsumihi, ma 
nɔ yemihi kɛ he nya buami aloo kuu kpahi a mi.
Kusumi ma nɔ yemi he su komɛ
Wa pɔɔ nihi nɛ nyɛɛ se nɛ ɔmɛ nami ngɛ kusumi ma nɔ yemi blɔ nɔ tomi mi:
1. Nɔ kuɔmi blɔ nya: Nɔ kuɔmi he wami jeɔ yi nɔ kɛ kpleɔ si nɛ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ngɛ e blɔ nya 
ni tsumi kɛ e blɔ nya.
2. Munyu nya si mami: Nihi nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya ngua ngɛ blɔ nɔ tomi nya a, maa munyu 
otihi a nya si nɛ a peeɔ nihi pɔtɛɛ he juɛmi ngɛ ma a tsuo nane mi.
3. Blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ mi gbami slɔɔtohi: A gbaa wɛtso ɔ aloo ma a mi kpɔ mi kpɔ mi nɛ nɔ fɛɛ 
nɔ ngɛ e blɔ nya ni tsumi.
4. Kuu tsɔwi a nɔ hyɛmi: A hlaa nihi nɛ a hyɛɔ kuu nyafinyafihi a nɔ.
5. Sɛgbi hami: A ngɛ blɔ pɔtɛɛhi a nɔ nɛ a guɔ nɛ a kɛ sɛgbi haa ma.
6. Blɔ nya kɛ ni tsumi pɔtɛɛ: A ngɛ blɔ nya kɛ blɔ nya ni tsumi tutuutu nɛ a hyɛɔ blɔ.
7. Nɔ kuɔmi: A ngɛ nɔ kuɔmi nɔ kuɔmi kɛ jeɔ ni nguahi nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya nguahi a nɔ kɛ 
ya siɔ ni tsɔwi nɛ hɛɛ blɔ nya tsɔwi a nɔ.
Blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ ngɛ gbugbuugbu nɛ tsɔɔ se nami komɛ kaa he piɛ pomi, hwɔɔ se blɔ 
kpami kɛ nɔ he akɔtaa bumi se e ngɛ nyagba komɛ kaa siɔɔ peemi ngɛ munyuhi a nya 
si mami kɛ lalaalo womi ngɛ nihi a nya si mami mi.
Nɔ yemi nɔ kuɔmi blɔ nɔ tomi ji bɔ nɛ a toɔ nɔ kuɔmi blɔ nya ngɛ kuu ko mi. E tsɔɔ 
tsakpa nɛ ngɛ nikɔtɔmahi nɛ toɔ blɔ nɔ kɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ a sisi ɔmɛ a kpɛti.
Kusumi ma nɔ yemi nɔ kuɔmi blɔ nɔ tomi nɛ ngɛ sisi 
nɛ ɔ nɛ
Sisije ni tsumi
1. Ngɛ nyɛ kuuhi a mi ɔ, nyɛɛ to ma nɔ yeli nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ nɔ kuɔmi nya:
Matsɛ tsɔwi  Nimeli        Matsɛngua  Matsɛ woli
2. Ke nyɛ nya tomi ɔ ngɛ kaa nɔ nɛ nyɛɛ se nɛ ɔ, lɔ ɔ ji nɔ nɛ a deɔ ke ma nɔ yemi nɔ 
kuɔmi nɛ ngɛ Aflaane gbi mi ɔ, a deɔ ke oganoglami ɔ nɛ.
Matsɛngua - matsɛ tsɔwi - matsɛ woli - nimeli
Oganoglami ji kaa a ma tɛni nɔ kuɔmi blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ ngɛ womi hɛ nɔ aloo ngɛ klama 
hɛ nɔ nɛ e tsɔɔ nɔ kuɔmi kɛ je yiti kɛ ba sisi. E tsɔɔ blɔ nya kɛ bɔbɔɛ nɛ ngɛ nɔ yeli a 
kpɛti kɛ nɔ yeli ɔmɛ kɛ ma hu kpɛti.
99
WƐTSO BLƆ NƆ TOMI KƐ MA NƆ YEMI
Sɛ EnyɔMI GBAMI  7
Nyɛ ha nɛ waa hyɛ oganoglami nɛ tsɔɔ Dangme kusumi ma nɔ yemi nɔ kuɔmi blɔ nɔ 
tomi.
Foni 7.4: Kusumi ma nɔ yemi nɔ kuɔmi
Ke wa da oganoglami nɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, e tsɔɔ kaa nɔ nɛ nɔ kuɔ pe lɛ tsuo ngɛ kusumi ma 
nɔ yemi blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ mi ji jetsɛ. Jetsɛ se ɔ, wa ngɛ matsɛngua nɛ lɛ hu e se ɔ, wa 
ngɛ matsɛ woli. Matsɛ woli a se ɔ wa ngɛ wɛtso matsɛmɛ/matsɛ tsɔwi, asafoatsɛmɛ, 
manyɛmɛ kɛ jemɛli nɛ ngɛ mɛɛ a se ɔ, wa ngɛ otsiamɛhi, weku nyatsɛmɛ kɛ nimeli 
kpahi nɛ he maa hia ngɛ ma nɔ hyɛmi ɔ mi.
Yɔ se kaa: E sa nɛ o yo kaa wɛtso komɛ ngɛ maklalohi, sɛtsɛmɛ, jaasehi, dade matsɛmɛ, 
simpihi kɛ blɔ nya kpa hɛɛli ngɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ a mi. Nihi nɛ ngɛ oganoglami ɔ mi ɔ ngɛ a ni 
tsumi pɔtɛɛ nɛ a tsuɔ.
MATSƐ WOMI
Matsɛngua womi ɔ ngɛ glɛ etɛ nɔ:
•	 E hlami
•	 E womi aloo e tomi
•	 E kpo jemi
Matsɛ hlami
1. Ke matsɛngua ko kpa sɛ nɛ a maa to e nane mi ɔ, sɛtsɛ/jase kɛ matsɛ woli ɔmɛ hyɛɔ 
weku nɛ e su a nɔ kaa a ye tsɛ ɔ mi nɛ a hlaa nɔ nɛ sa ngɛ mi. A hyɛɔ kaa nɔ nɛ a 
maa hla a hɛ mi tɛ, e le kusumi, bu ngɛ e he nɛ kpa ko kulaa be e he.
100
WƐTSO BLƆ NƆ TOMI KƐ MA NƆ YEMI
Sɛ EnyɔMI GBAMI  7
2. Ke tsɛ woli ɔmɛ a nine su nɔ ɔ nɔ ɔ, a bɔɔ ma nimeli amaniɛ kɛ ha nɔ kplɛɛmi. Be 
ngɛ nɛ ke nihi enyɔ aloo etɛ nɛ a gbɔ a he nine ɔ, nimeli ɔmɛ hlaa a kpɛti nɔ kake.
Matsɛ womi aloo e tomi
1. Matsɛngua womi ɔ jeɔ sisi kɛ nɔ ɔ numi:  Ke a gbɔ nɔ ko he nine kaa a maa wo lɛ 
matsɛ ɔ, ni komɛ ngɛ nɛ a sume nɛ lɔ ɔ he je ɔ, a tuɔ fo kɛ je ɔ ma a mi. Nihi hu ngɛ 
nɛ a ji odehehi se pi ma a mi nɛ a ngɛ tutuutu se a ngɛ ni tsue ngɛ ma se. He fɛɛ 
he nɛ nɔ nɛ a gbɔ e he nine ɔ ngɛ ɔ, a tsɔɔ nihi nɛ a ya ngɔɔ lɛ kɛ baa. Ke lɛ nitsɛ e 
kplɛɛ nɔ ɔ, a kɛ lɛ baa dii se ke e kplɛɛ we nɔ ɔ, a nuɔ lɛ pani nya nya nɛ a kɛ lɛ baa.
2. Tɛlimi kɛ nangla/agbosu pomi pue nane nɔ: Ke a nu matsɛ ehe ɔ, a gbeɔ jijɔ ku nɛ 
ji agbosu aloo nangla nɛ a kɛ muɔ ɔ pueɔ nɔ ɔ nane nɔ. Ke a po agbosu muɔ nɛ ɔ 
pue nɔ ko nane nɔ se loloolo ɔ, e kua matsɛ ɔ yemi ɔ, be ngɛ nɛ e fuɔ da aloo e nuɔ 
godo.
3. Tsu mi womi: A woɔ nɔ nɛ a nu ɔ tsu mi. Ngɛ tsu ɔ mi ɔ, a tsukɔɔ e he, a tsɔɔ lɛ 
kusumi kɛ kusumi sisi, a tsɔɔ lɛ domi, kita kami, kɔhi kɛ si himi kpahi nɛ he maa 
hia matsɛ yemi ɔ. A yeɔ musu ngɛ e yi nɛ a tsukɔɔ e he kɛ je je mi yobuhi a he.
4. Sɛ hlami: A kɛ lɛ yaa sɛ tsu mi nɛ e ya hlaa matsɛ sɛ nɛ e maa hi nɔ. A fiɔ e hɛ mi 
nɛ e ko hyɛ nɔ loko e ngɔ sɛ nɛ e maa hi nɔ ɔ. E maa hine sɛ nɛ e maa ngɔ ɔ kaa e 
matsɛ biɛ.
5. Kita kami: E ma ka nimeli ɔmɛ kita kaa ke a tsɛ lɛ nyɔ mi jio, piani jio, gbɔkuɛ jio 
ɔ, ke a nɛ lɛ ɔ, e kɛ e yi ma je aloo e yi ma ha.
Matsɛ kpo jemi
Ke a ma je matsɛ ehe kpo ɔ, a bɔɔ gua nɛ ma tsuo nya ba kpeɔ.
1. Matsɛ kɛ matsɛ sɛ nɔ himi: A kɛ matsɛ ehe ɔ hiɔ e matsɛ sɛ nɔ. A woɔ e dɛ mi aflaa 
nɛ e kɛ ma ka kita.
2. Matsɛ ɔ kpo jemi kɛ tsɔɔ ma: A jeɔ matsɛ ɔ kpo kɛ tsɔɔ ma nɛ a tsɔɔ e matsɛ yemi biɛ 
kaa Nɛnɛ Asimasi Asimasi nɛ ji enyɔne aloo etɛne.
3. Kita kami: Wɛtso matsɛmɛ kɛ nimeli kaa lɛ kita kaa ke e tsɛ mɛ mɔtu, piani aloo 
nyɔ mi nɛ a bɛ, nɛ pi hiɔ nɛ tsi a nya a, a kɛ a yi ma je aloo a kɛ a yi ma ha.
4. Nyami: A fiɛɔ obonu kɛ do munomunohi nɛ a nyaa kaa a na matsɛ he.
5. Ma kɛ munyu tumi: Matsɛ he ɔ kɛ ma a tuɔ munyu. E woɔ mɛ si kaa e maa hyɛ nɛ 
ma a nɛ ya nɔ nɛ e baa nɔ fɛɛ nɔ yemi kɛ buami kɛ kake peemi.
To he hɛ: Moo to he hɛ kaa, akɛnɛ Dangme ngɛ wɛtso nguahi babauu he je ɔ, matsɛ 
womi kusumi ɔ hɛ mi ma tsake bɔɔ ngɛ wɛtso ɔmɛ a mi se e he blɔ nɔ to kaa e hlami, 
e womi kɛ e kpo jemi ɔ lɛɛ jeɔ e he kpo ngɛ wɛtso kusumi ɔmɛ tsuo a mi. He komɛ 
ma nyɛ ya nyatsɔɔ kaa bɔ nɛ wa sɛsɛ he ɔ nɛ ekomɛ hu maa pee kusumi komɛ kɛ sɛ 
ekomɛ a hlami. A ma nyɛ ma je ekomɛ ngɛ mi nɛ a kɛ ekpahi maa piɛɛ he.
101
WƐTSO BLƆ NƆ TOMI KƐ MA NƆ YEMI
Sɛ EnyɔMI GBAMI  7
Jetsɛ ni tsumi komɛ
Ke wa ke Jetsɛ ɔ, wa ngɛ je hyɛe kaa Adaa je aloo Klo je aloo Sɛ je aloo Nugo je aloo 
Dangme je kpahi nɛ piɛ ɔmɛ. Wa ngɛ Asante je, Ohuɛ je, Nzimaa je kɛ je kpa komɛ 
hulɔ.
Jetsɛ ɔ ni tsumi komɛ ji kaa:
1. E tsuɔ ni kaa e je ɔ tsuo nyatsɛ.
2. E woɔ mlaa nɛ a bɔɔ mɔde kaa e je bimɛ tsuo nɛ ye mlaa nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ.
3. Lɛ ji e je ɔ mi asafo aloo ta yami kuu ɔ nyatsɛ.
4. E dlaa matsɛ kpahi kɛ ma bi a kpɛti pɛ nɛ tue mi jɔmi nɛ hi e je ɔ.
Matsɛngua
Matsɛnguahi ji nihi nɛ hyɛɔ wɛtso ɔmɛ a nɔ nɛ a nɔ kuɔ pe nihi tsuo ngɛ wɛtso ko mi. 
A naa matsɛnga blɔ nya nɛ ɔ ngɛ odehe fɔmi nya. Tsɛ se ni yeli naa kɛ guɔ a tsɛmɛ 
aloo a nɛmɛ a nɔ nɛ nyɛ se ni yeli naa kɛ jeɔ a nyɛmɛ a se. Ke a hla matsɛngua ko ɔ, a 
peeɔ kusumi munomuno ha lɛ loko a woɔ lɛ matsɛngua a. He komɛ nɛ yeɔ nyɛ se ni ɔ, 
a nyɛɔ nɛ a woɔ yo matsɛ aloo matsɛngua.
Matsɛngua blɔ nya ni tsumi komɛ
1. Lɛ ji wɛtso ɔmɛ kɛ ma amɛ, kɔpe ɔmɛ kɛ huza amɛ tsuo a nyatsɛ.
2. E peeɔ nihi a he juɛmi nɛ a maa munyuhi a nya si kɛ ha ma a nɔ yami.
3. E hyɛɔ nɛ a ye jehahi, a pee sɛ kɛ ma kusumi ekpahi nɛ sa.
4. E hyɛɔ nɛ a ye ma mlaahi a nɔ nɛ e dlaa nihi kɛ wɛtso bimɛ a kpɛti munyu.
5. E hyɛɔ ma zugbahi a nɔ nɛ e poɔ ma zugba kɛ weto ni kpahi a he piɛ nɛ e baa a yi.
6. E poɔ ma kusumi he piɛ nɛ e baa a yi.
7. E ngɔɔ nɔ yami ni tsumi kɛ si himi kpakpa kɛ baa.
8. A yeɔ nihi a kpɛti sanehi nɛ e dlaa pɛ ngɛ wɛtso ɔ mi nɛ tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba.
9. E maa ma a he ni tsumi munyuhi a nya si ngɛ ma a nane mi.
10. E woɔ mlaahi nɛ nihi nɛ hi si ngɛ tue mi jɔmi mi.
Matsɛ tsɔwi/wɛtso matsɛmɛ
Wɛtso ɔmɛ ngɛ a kasi kasi nɛ a hyɛɔ wekuhi a nɔ. Nimli nɛ ɔmɛ peeɔ matsɛ tsɔwi ngɛ 
weku ɔmɛ a mi. A hyɛɔ huzahi kɛ kɔpehi a nɔ kaa nyatsɛmɛ. Dangme je matsɛ tsɔwi 
hu yeɔ blɔ nya nɛ ɔ kɛ guɔ a tsɛmɛ kɛ a nɛmɛ a mi nɛ a peeɔ kusumi pɔtɛɛ ngɔ haa mɛ 
loko a toɔ mɛ jamɛ a blɔ nya.
102
WƐTSO BLƆ NƆ TOMI KƐ MA NƆ YEMI
Sɛ EnyɔMI GBAMI  7
Matsɛ tsɔwi/wɛtso matsɛmɛ a ni tsumihi
1. Ke matsɛngua a be ɔ, mɛ nɛ a ngɛ.
2. A yeɔ buaa kɛ ku ju kɛ fɔ kɛ awi yemi nya ngɛ a kpɔ ɔmɛ a mi.
3. A peeɔ kojoli kɛ ha wɛtso ɔ.
4. A hyɛɔ nɛ tue mi jɔmi nɛ hi a kpɔ ɔmɛ kɛ huza amɛ a mi
5. A poɔ wɛtso zugba kɛ weto ni kpahi a he piɛ nɛ e baa a yi.
6. A hyɛɔ nɛ tue mi jɔmi nɛ hi ma a mi.
7. A hyɛɔ nɛ a pee ma kusumi: sɛ he dumi, ma he tsukɔmi, jeha yemi, jami kɛ ekpa 
komɛ.
8. Ke matsɛngua wo mlaahi ɔ, a hyɛɔ nɛ a sisi bi tsuo nɛ a ye nɔ.
Matsɛ tsɔwi nɛ ɔmɛ ngɛ a blɔ nya ni tsumi pɔtɛɛ nɛ a tsuɔ kɛ haa je nɛ a piɛɛ he ɔ. He 
komɛ ɔ, a tsuɔ ni kaa muɔ nɔ nyɛɛli aloo hiɔ nɔ nyɛɛli aloo hɛkpɛ nyɛɛli aloo se kpɛli 
ngɛ ta be mi. Ke ta hia a, a hwuɔ ngɛ muɔ nɔ, hiɔ nɔ, hɛkpɛ kɛ se tsuo nɛ he nyɛli hu 
tuaa mɛ ngɛ he nɛ ɔmɛ tsuo. Enɛ ɔ he nɛ a toɔ ta yali kɛ a nyatsɛmɛ ngɛ muɔ nɔ, hiɔ 
nɔ, hɛ kpɛ kɛ se tsuo ɔ nɛ.
Muɔ nɔ nyɛɛmi matsɛ
Ohiɛli tsɛɔ matsɛ nɛ ɔ ke benkumhene nɛ e kɛ e we bi nɛ nyɛɛ ta muɔ nɔ be mi nɛ tatsɛ 
nitsɛ nɛ ji Jetsɛ ɔ ngɛ kpɛti. Ke ma kpe aloo nimeli kpe ngɛ munyu ko he ɔ, muɔ nɔ 
matsɛ nɛ ɔ hiɔ Jetsɛ ɔ muɔ nɔ.
Hiɔ nɔ nyɛɛmi matsɛ
Ohiɛli tsɛɔ matsɛ nɛ ɔ ke Nifahene nɛ Ohuɛli tsɛɔ lɛ ke Dusifia. E kɛ e we bi nɛ nyɛɛ ta 
hiɔ nɔ be mi nɛ tatsɛ nitsɛ nɛ ji Jetsɛ ɔ ngɛ kpɛti. Ke ma kpe aloo nimeli kpe ngɛ munyu 
ko he ɔ, hiɔ nɔ matsɛ nɛ ɔ hiɔ Jetsɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ.
Muɔ nɔ kɛ hiɔ nɔ matsɛ nɛ ɔmɛ yeɔ buaa Jetsɛ ɔ ngɛ kusumi ma nɔ yemi ɔ mi nɛ a tsuɔ 
nihi nɛ nyɛɛ se nɛ ɔmɛ hulɔ.
1. A yeɔ buaa Jetsɛ ɔ kɛ maa munyuhi a nya si nɛ a yeɔ buaa lɛ kɛ maa juɛmi nya si 
ngɛ munyu ko he.
2. Mɛ ji muɔ nɔ kɛ hiɔ nɔ tabuli ɔmɛ a nyatsɛmɛ.
3. A woɔ Jetsɛ ɔ ga kɛ blɔ tsɔɔmi ngɛ e ma nɔ yemi ni tsumi ɔ mi.
4. A yeɔ nihi a kpɛti munyu nɛ tue mi jɔmi nɛ hi a huza amɛ a mi.
5. A yeɔ buaa kɛ woɔ matsɛmɛ kɛ nɔ yeli kpahi.
Hɛkpɛ sɛmi matsɛ
Ohiɛli tsɛɔ matsɛ nɛ ɔ ke Tufohene nɛ Ohuɛli tsɛɔ lɛ ke Aʋadada /aloo Aʋafia nɛ 
Dangmeli tsɛɔ matsɛ nɛ ɔ ke Asafonyatsɛ aloo Asafoatsɛ.
