Sɛ EnyɔMI GBAMI  7
E ni tsumi
1. E kɛ e we bi ji ta yali ɔmɛ tutuutu nɛ lɛ ji tatsɛmɛ nɛ nyɛɛɔ Jetsɛ ɔ hɛkpɛ ngɛ ta be 
mi ɔ a nyatsɛ.
2. E hyɛɔ nɛ a ye mlaa kɛ blɔ nɔ tomihi a nɔ.
3. E kɛ e webi buɔ ma a he kɛ jeɔ he nyɛli a dɛ.
4.  Ke Jetsɛ ɔ na we deka kɛ tsu ni tsumi ko aloo kɛ ya kpe ko ɔ, lɛ nɛ e ya daa e nane 
mi.
Manyɛmɛ
Manyɛmɛ ji yihi ngɛ wɛtso mi ɔ a nya dali ngɛ mumi kɛ he lo mi tsuo. Mɛ hu ji nihi 
nɛ hɛɛ nyasa kpɛɛ nɛ a tsɔɔ jokuɛwi je mi bami kpakpa. A baa wɛtso mi bi ɔmɛ a yi nɛ 
a bɔɔ mɔde nɛ a hiami nihi ko bɔ mɛ. Ngɛ wɛtsohi nɛ yeɔ nyɛ ni mi ɔ, manyɛ ji nɔ nɛ 
gbɔɔ matsɛ yelɔ he nine loko a wo ɔ lɛ. A woɔ manyɛmɛ tsɔwi ngɛ e sisi hulɔ.
Manyɛmɛ a ni tsumi
1. A yeɔ buaa matsɛmɛ ngɛ ma nɔ yemi ni tsumi ɔ mi, titlii ɔ, nihi nɛ kɔɔ yihi a he.
2. A yeɔ munyuhi nɛ kɔɔ yihi kɛ zangmawi a he.
3. A hlaa nɛ tsakemi nɛ ba nɛ a fa yihi a he nɛ a po a he piɛ.
4. A ngɛ kaa nile kpɛɛ nɛ a ngɔɔ tsɔsemi kpakpa kɛ haa yinɔ bimɛ tsuo.
5.  A hyɛɔ nɛ a pee yihi a si himi kusumihi kaa dipo sɛmi, ni womi, ablanya ngɔ yami, 
hɔ nɔ kpa fɔmi kɛ kusumihi nɛ maa ye bua yihi a nɔ yami kɛ a si himi kpakpa.
Matsɛ woli
Matsɛ woli ji nihi nɛ gbɔɔ ni kpahi a he nine nɛ a wo mɛ matsɛ se mɛ nitsɛmɛ lɛɛ a be 
jamɛ a blɔ nya kaa a yeɔ matsɛ. A kpeɔ kɛ sɛsɛɔ he loko a hlaa nɔ nɛ sa nɛ a wo lɛ matsɛ 
aloo manyɛ aloo maklaalo aloo jase aloo asafoatsɛ kɛ ma nikɔtɔma kpahi. Blɔhi a nɔ kɛ 
blɔ nɔ tomihi a mi nɛ a gbleeɔ kɛ hlaa nɔ yeli nɛ a woɔ mɛ ɔ je muno ngɛ mahimahi a 
mi nɛ ngɛ Dangme wɛtso ɔmɛ a mi pohu, slɔɔto bɔɔbɔɔbɔɔ ngɛ blɔ nɔ tomi ɔmɛ a mi.
Matsɛ woli a ni tsumihi
1. Mɛ nɛ a gbɔɔ matsɛ aloo manyɛ he nine loko a woɔ.
2. A poɔ nihi a se nɛ a kpaa nihi a mi loko a gbɔɔ nɔ he nine.
3. A peeɔ kusumi ke matsɛ kpa sɛ.
4. Mɛ nɛ a kpaa matsɛ nɛ a woɔ matsɛ.
5. Mɛ nɛ a jeɔ matsɛ ehe kpo kɛ haa ma nimeli kɛ ma.
6. A woɔ matsɛ ga.

7. A yeɔ nihi a kpɛti sane.
8. A hyɛɔ nɛ a to matsɛ nane mi ke blɔ ba kaa a na matsɛ ehe.
Otsiamɛ
Otsiamɛ ji nɔ nɛ daa ma nɔ nɛ e tuɔ matsɛ nya munyu. Ke matsɛ ɔ de nɔ ko ɔ, lɛ nɛ e 
tiɔ mi nɛ e gbaa kpɛ kɛ haa tue buli. E ni tsumi pɔtɛɛ komɛ nɛ nyɛɛ se nɛ ɔ nɛ.
1. E ngɔɔ matsɛ sɛgbi kɛ haa ma nɛ e tuɔ matsɛ ɔ nya munyu.
2. E ngɔɔ nihi a sɛgbi kɛ haa matsɛ ɔ.
3. E hɛɛɔ matsɛ tsɔmi tso.
4. Ke a wo za kɛ yaa ma nɔ ɔ, e nyɛɛɔ matsɛ ɔ hɛkpɛ.
5. Lɛ ji matsɛ tsɔlɔ nɛ kɛ sɛgbi aloo samami ya haa ni kpahi.
Ni tsumi 7�7 Wɛtso mi nɔ kuɔmi he blɔ nɔ tomi aloo oganoglami
Moo tɛni oganoglami aloo ma nɔ yemi blɔ nɔ tomi nɔ kuɔmi ngɛ nyɛ wɛtso ɔ mi. 
Ngɔɔ o oganoglami ɔ kɛ to ma kpa nɔ tsɛmɛ a nɔ he.
Ni tsumi 7�8 Ma nɔ yeli a ni tsumihi
1. Nyɛɛ nu nyɛ he enyɔɔnyɔ nɛ nyɛɛ kane demiyo nɛ nyɛɛ se nɛ ɔ konɛ nyɛ yo ma 
nɔ yeli nɛ nyɛɛ se nɛ ɔmɛ a ni tsumi ngɛ pɛ dlami aloo munyu yemi mi.
a. Matsɛngua
b. Matsɛ tsɔwi
c. Weku nyatsɛ
d. Ma nimeli
2. Kane o heto ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ tsu mi bimɛ.
Ayɛte kɛ e senɔ Ayɛnɔ na zugba he munyu ngɛ a ngmɔ si kɔpe ngɛ Satlamɔ Zɔɔ. 
Munyu ɔ kɛkɛ ji kaa, Ayɛnɔ ke e nyɛwetsɛ ɔ sɛ e zugba mi nɛ e po eko kɛ ha e bi nɛ 
e kɛ yaa ma tsu nɛ e bi we lɛ. Ayɛte tsɔɔ nya kaa a tsɛ Nɔmo Tɛɛ Anyɛmi Amɛɛdu 
nitsɛ kɛ jamɛ a zugba a ha lɛ loko e ho anɔsewe ya. Weku nyatsɛ, Nɔmo Kuami 
Kpabite tu a kpɛti munyu hluu se tue mi jɔmi ya bɛ. E ngɔ munyu ɔ ya muɔ Wɛtso 
matsɛwayo, Tɛɛ Kuɛsi Ajumani nɛ ji enuɔne ɔ nane nɛ e hyɛ nɛ a dla e bimɛ ɔmɛ 
a kpɛti. A ya munyu ɔ he be babauu se e yɛ nya. Enɛ ɔ he je ɔ, Nɛnɛ Ajumani ngɔ 
munyu ɔ ya ha Wɛtso matsɛngua, Nɛnɛ Okpɛnetɛ Okpɔtɛsa nɛ to nɔ etɛne ɔ nɛ e 
hyɛ munyu ɔ mi ha mɛ. Nɛnɛ Okpɔtɛsa ha nɛ a weku nimeli ɔmɛ ja a gbi kɛ tsɔɔ 
nɔ nɛ a le ngɛ zugba a he. Basabasa peemi bɔɔ ba lejɛ ɔ se Otsiamɛ Matewayo kɛ e 
nane ma si nɛ lejɛ ɔ tsuo jɔ dii. Nɛnɛ Okpɛnetɛ Okpɔtɛsa hla nihi kɛ piɛɛ Nɔmo Tɛɛ 
Anyɛmi Amɛɛdu we mi nimeli ɔmɛ a he konɛ a koli munyu ɔ mi fitsofitso nɛ a ba

Ni tsumi 7�9 Kusumi ma nɔ yeli a ni tsumi
Ni komɛ deɔ ke a yeɔ dami sane ngɛ blema kusumi ma nɔ yemi blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ mi 
pe bɔ nɛ a naa lɛ mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ ngɛ kɔɔtu. Nyɛɛ nu nyɛ he enyɔɔnyɔɔ nɛ nyɛɛ ja 
gbi kɛ tsɔɔ nyɛ da he ngɛ munyutso nɛ ɔ he. Ke nyɛ gbe nya a, nyɛ de nyɛ heto ɔ 
ngɔ ha nyɛ tsu mi bi ɔmɛ tsuo.
Ni tsumi 7�10 Kusumi ma nɔ yemi
Nihi deɔ ke, “Kusumi ma nɔ yemi blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ nya be”. Ngɛ nyɛ kuuhi a mi ɔ, 
nyɛɛ ngɔ tue mi ngɔɔmi munyuhi kɛ ja gbi kɛ fi nyɛ da he se ngɛ munyutso nɛ ɔ 
he. Ke nyɛ gbe nya a, nyɛ de nyɛ heto ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ tsu mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ mɛ hu a de a 
heto ɔmɛ.
Ni tsumi 7�11 Kusumi ma nɔ yemi blɔ nɔ tomi ngɛ ma kpahi a mi kɛ 
a bi a he tomi
Ngɛ kuuhi a mi ɔ, nyɛɛ sɛsɛ se namihi nɛ ngɛ kusumi ma nɔ yemi blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ he. 
Nyɛ yo hehi nɛ si gbeemi bɔɔbɔɔbɔɔ ngɛ nɛ nyɛ kɛ to mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ amlaalo ma 
nɔ yemi blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ he.

INTRODUCTION
This section introduces you to traditional and contemporary dispute resolution 
processes. It discusses the structures of both systems as well as their functions. You 
will compare and contrast the functions of the two systems in order to draw your own 
conclusions. Your knowledge and understanding of traditional dispute resolution and 
the contemporary judicial systems will empower you to participate in the democratic 
process and exercise your rights. It will also help you as an individual to develop 
critical thinking and analytical skills for decision making and to become informed 
citizens as you learn about your rights and responsibilities.
Additionally, the section will equip you with the basic knowledge and arouse your 
interest for further studies in law, political science, and international relations as it is 
linked to related subjects such as Government and History.
OTIHI
• Kojomi blɔ nɔ tomi tsɔɔ ma mlaa sisi nɛ e daa mlaa nɔ kɛ yeɔ munyu. Ngɛ Gana 
munyu yemi he blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ, wa ngɛ Suplimi Kɔɔtu, Apiili kɔɔtu, Hai kɔɔtu kɛ kɔɔtu 
tsɔwi. Kɔɔtu tsɔwi ɔmɛ ji Sɛkit kɔɔtu, Kpo aloo Distliti kɔɔtu kɛ Jokuɛwi a kɔɔtu nɛ 
ji aboflabɔnibi aloo jokuɛwi gbevuhi a kɔɔtu. Kɔɔtu fɛɛ kɔɔtu ngɛ munyuhi nɛ e yeɔ 
kaa we mi sanehi, ju kɛ fɔ, weku kɛ ni tsumi he munyuhi kɛ ekpa komɛ. Ngɛ Gana 
a, Suplimi kɔɔtu ji kɔɔtu nɛ nɔ kuɔ pe kɔɔtu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ Kojolɔ ngua pe kulaa nɛ ji 
“Chief Justice” ɔ nɛ hyɛɔ nɔ.
• Kusumi ma nɔ yemi daa kusumi blɔ nɔ tomihi a nɔ kɛ yeɔ munyu nɛ a kɛ yeɔ dami 
sane.
• Mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ kojomi sane yemi ngɛ kojomi ni tsumi ɔ blɔ nɔ tomi mi ɔ ngɛ kojoli 
nguahi, kojoli tsɔwi nɛ amlaalo nɛ ngɔ mɛ kɛ ni tsuli kpahi nɛ yeɔ buaa ngɛ munyu 
yemi he ɔ.
• Kusumi munyu yemi blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ ngɔɔ matsɛmɛ kɛ a he nimeli kɛ yeɔ munyu ɔ.

KOJOMI ALOO MUNYU YEMI BLƆ NƆ TOMI
Yi mi susumi sane bimi
Ngmaa mlaahi etɛ nɛ o fɔli wo nɛ a ye nɔ ngɛ we mi. Ngmaa blɔhi etɛ nɛ o fɔli guɔ nɔ 
kɛ dlaa pɛ ngɛ o kɛ o nyɛmimɛ a kpɛti. De o heto ɔ ngɔ ha nyɛ tsu mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ mɛ hu 
a de a heto ɔmɛ.
Kojomi Aloo Munyu Yemi Blɔ Nɔ Tomi
Kojomi aloo munyu yemi blɔ nɔ tomi ji kɔɔtuhi kɛ tlabunalihi aloo amlaalo blɔ nɔ 
tomi kɛ tsɔɔ mlaa sisi nɛ a da mlaa nɔ kɛ ye munyu ngɛ ma ko mi.
Kojoli a ni tsumi
Kojoli a ni tsumi komɛ ji nɛ ɔ nɛ:
1. A tsɔɔ mlaa sisi nɛ a daa mlaa a nɔ kɛ yeɔ dami sane.
2. A hlaa nɛ nɔ he akɔtaa bumi nɛ ba nɛ e ye bua kɛ ha munyu yemi nɛ hɛ mi hyɛmi 
be mi.
3. A poɔ nihi a blɔ nya kɛ he blɔ nɛ a ngɛ ɔ he piɛ ngɛ ma mlaa nya.
4. A bɔɔ mɔde nɛ a ye dami sane ngɛ mlaa nya nɛ hɛ mi hyɛmi be mi.
5. A dlaa nihi kɛ ni tsumihi kɛ ma kɛ amlaalo a kpɛti pɛ nɛ sisimi be mi.
6. A ngmɛɛ blɔ kɛ ha mi dami, gbi kplɛɛmi kɛ kojomi ngɛ sanehi a he.
7. A hyɛɔ nɛ amlaalo kɛ mla womi kpebi nɛ a ko ngɔ a blɔ nya kɛ a he wami kɛ pee 
nihi nɛ dɛ blɔ ngɛ mlaa nya.
8. A daa ma nane mi kɛ yeɔ juli kɛ ni gbogboe peeli a munyu.
9. A daa nihi nɛ a ngɛ a munyu yee ɔ se nɛ a ye dami sane ha mɛ.
Mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ kɔɔtu blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ si fɔfɔɛ
Mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ kɔɔtu blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ si fɔfɔɛ ɔ ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ e ngɛ sisi nɛ ɔ:
1. Suplimi kɔɔtu ji kɔɔtu ngua pe kulaa ngɛ Gana.
2. Apiili kɔɔtu nɛ a kɛ munyu yaa ke o bua jɔɛ bɔ nɛ sisi kɔɔtu aloo kɔɔtu wayo kɛ ye 
o sane ko ha.
3. Hai kɔɔtu nɛ yeɔ munyu saisaa nɛ kɔɔ nihi kakaaka aloo ni tsumihi aloo amlaalo 
aloo ni kpahi a he.
4. Sɛkit kɔɔtu, kpo aloo distliti kɔɔtu ngɛ wa ma amɛ a mi nɛ yeɔ sane tsɔwi kaa weku 
sanehi, ju sanehi, kunɔ kɛ pɛ sanehi kɛ sane kpa komɛ.

Kɔɔtuhi a ni tsumi
Kɔɔtuhi nɛ tsɔɔ mlaa sisi nɛ a daa mlaa nɔ kɛ yeɔ munyu. A yeɔ ju kɛ fɔ munyuhi nɛ 
Aflaanetsɛmɛ tsɛɔ ke kliminali (criminal) nɛ a yeɔ ni tsumihi a he munyu kɛ ni tsumi 
he mlaahi nɛ Aflaanetsɛmɛ tsɛɔ ke leba lɔɔ (labour law). A yeɔ sanehi nɛ pi ju sanehi 
nɛ Aflaanetsɛmɛ tsɛɔ ke sivil kesisi (civil cases) ɔ.
Ngɛ Gana a, Suplimi kɔɔtu ji kɔɔtu nɛ nɔ kuɔ pe kɔɔtu ɔmɛ tsuo nɛ Kojolɔ ngua pe 
kulaa nɛ ji “Chief Justice - CJ” ɔ nɛ hyɛɔ nɔ. Ngɛ kojomi ni tsumi ɔ blɔ nɔ tomi mi ɔ, 
wa ngɛ kojoli nguahi, kojoli tsɔwi kɛ ni tsuli kpahi nɛ yeɔ buaa ngɛ munyu yemi he ɔ.
Mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ munyu yemi kɛ kɔɔtu si fɔfɔɛ aloo e 
he blɔ nɔ tomi
1. Kojolɔ kake ma nyɛ ye munyu ngɛ Hai kɔɔtu, Apiili kɔɔtu kɛ Suplimi kɔɔtu.
2. Kojoli kɛ je etɛ kɛ ya su nyɔngma kɛ etɛ ma nyɛ ye munyu kake ngɛ Apiili kɔɔtu 
kɛ Suplimi kɔɔtu. A tsɔɔ kuu nɛ hyɛɔ sane nɛ a ma yemi ɔ nɔ. Aflaanetsɛmɛ deɔ ke 
panɛli (panel). E sa nɛ ke a gba nihi abɔ nɛ maa hi panɛli kake mi enyɔ ɔ, kake nɛ 
dɛ nɔ konɛ ke a ma munyu ko nya si ɔ, a ko na da he fiee.
3. Be ngɛ nɛ ni kpahi piɛɛɔ kojolɔ ɔ he nɛ a yeɔ bua lɛ kɛ yeɔ munyu ɔ.
4. Majistleti nɛ yeɔ munyu tsɔwi ngɛ Majistleti kɔɔtu.
5. Kojoli tsɔwi yeɔ munyu ngɛ Kpo aloo Distliti kɔɔtu ɔmɛ nɛ a tsɛɔ mɛ ke tue mi jɔmi 
dami sane yeli aloo tue mi jɔmi kojoli.
Foni 8.1: Foni nɛ ɔ tsɔɔ mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ kɔɔtu sane yemi he. Kojoli, lɔyahi, munyutsɛ ɔmɛ, tue buli kɛ ni 
kpahi ngɛ kɔɔtu tsu ɔ mi.

Blɔ nɔ nɛ a guɔ kɛ yeɔ munyu ngɛ kɔɔtu
Kɔɔtu fɛɛ kɔɔtu ngɛ blɔhi a nɔ nɛ e guɔ kɛ yeɔ munyu, se blɔ nɔ tomihi nɛ nyɛɛ se nɛ 
ɔmɛ a he hia.
1. Munyutsɛ ɔmɛ ngɔɔ a sane kɛ ya fɔɔ kɔɔtu ɔ hɛ mi kɛ guɔ kɔɔtu ni tsulɔ nɛ a to ɔ

2. A bɔɔ nɔ nɛ a kɛ munyu ɔ fɔ e nɔ ɔ amaniɛ aloo a ngɔɔ samami ya haa lɛ.
3. Munyutsɛ ɔ kɛ nɔ nɛ a kɛ munyu ɔ fɔ e nɔ ɔ kpeɔ nɛ a hyɛɔ munyu ɔ yemi he blɔ nɔ 
tomi kɛ odasefoli ngɛ munyu he.
4. A ngɔɔ munyu ɔ he nɔ mi mami kɛ baa nɛ a tsɛɔ odase yeli nɛ a biɔ a nya mi.
5. Kojolɔ ɔ buaa munyu ɔ he nɛ e kɛ tue gblami nɛ sa haa nɔ nɛ ye fɔ ɔ.
6. Ke nɔ ko bua jɔɛ bɔ nɛ a bua munyu ɔ he ɔ, e kɛ munyu ɔ ma nyɛ ya nɔ kuɔmi he 
nɛ ji kaa e ma nyɛ pee apiili.
To he hɛ kaa, be komɛ ɔ, munyutsɛ ɔmɛ ma nyɛ ha nɛ a je munyu ɔ kɛ ya we mi nɛ 
a ya tu.
 Ni tsumi 8�1 Kojomi he blɔ nɔ tomi
Ngɛ nyɛ kuu ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, nyɛ hla hehi enyɔ nɛ a yeɔ munyu ngɛ kɛ munyu slɔɔtohi

a. Kale mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ kojomi blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ.
b. Sɛsɛ nihi nɛ tsuɔ ni ngɛ kɔɔtu aloo a tsuɔ kojomi ni tsumi ɔ he se nami ngɛ kɔɔtu

c. Moo tsɔɔ blɔhi a nɔ nɛ a guɔ kɛ yeɔ munyu ngɛ mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ kɔɔtu munyu

Ni tsumi 8�3 Munyu yemi he blɔ nɔ tomihi
Ngɛ nyɛ kuuhi a mi ɔ, nyɛɛ pee fiɛmi kɛ je blɔhi etɛ nɛ a guɔ nɔ kɛ yeɔ munyu kpo.

Ajo kɛ Kosi yaa sukuu ngɛ Asɛsɛswa Sisije Sukuu ɔ. Mɛ tsuo a ngɛ a sukuu nane bɔɔlu 
fiami kuu ɔ mi nɛ a bɔɔ a he mɔde wawɛɛ nitsɛ. Ngɛ bɔɔlu ko nɛ a kɛ sukuu kpa nɛ je 
ma se fia lingmi nɛ ɔ mi ɔ, Kosi li e he be nɛ e wo lɛ nitsɛ e he goolu. Kosi goolu nɛ ɔ 
ha nɛ ma se bɔɔlu fiami kuu ɔ ye kunimi ngɛ Asɛsɛwa sukuu bɔɔlu fiami kuu nɛ nɔ fɛɛ 
nɔ le mɛ ɔ nɔ. Nɔ nɛ ɔ dɔ Ajo be nɔ nɛ e je pɛ wo Kosi kaa lɛ nɛ e pee nɛ hɛ mi si puemi 
nɛ ɔ ba a sukuu ɔ nɔ. Ajo ya nɔ nɛ e fiaa Kosi glazi tsesi hluu bɔ e ma nyɛ. Nɛ Kosi nu 
Ajo lilɛ fiami ɔ he ɔ, lɛ hu e fiaa lɛ lilɛ bɔ nɛ e ma nyɛ. Kunɔ sɛ mɛ ni enyɔ ɔmɛ a kpɛti. 
Ajo gba Kosi nya nɔ ma plamplam nɛ Kosi lungu etɛ kplɔ. Kosi hu bɔ kɔ kɛ si Ajo gugwɔ 
nɔ nɔtonɔto nɛ e gugwɔ ɔ hia fɔ si. Kosi ngɔ e nya lo ɔmɛ kɛ ha e nya mi nɛ fa a nɔ se 
Ajo nɛ nɔ ko nɛ e kɛ maa tsi e gugwɔ nɛ hia a nɔ. Nimeli ke, “A fani nya mi nɛ fa ngɛ 
gugwɔ nɛ hia he” niinɛ.
Ni tsumi 8�4 Kojomi aloo munyu yemi he blɔ nɔ tomihi
a. Ngɛ nyɛ kuu ɔmɛ a mi ɔ, nyɛɛ tsɔɔ mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ kojomi he blɔ nɔ tomi ko nɛ 
nyɛ maa suɔ nɛ mlaa womi kpe ɔ nɛ wo mlaa kɛ tsake mi nɛ nyɛɛ tsɔɔ bɔ nɛ 
nyɛ suɔ nɛ tsakemi ɔ nɛ ya lɛ ha.
b. Nyɛɛ tsɔɔ nɔ he je nɛ jamɛ a tsakemi ɔmɛ a he hia ngɛ, nɛ nyɛɛ kane nyɛ heto 
ɔmɛ ngɔ ha nyɛ tsu mi bi ɔmɛ nɛ mɛ hu a de nyɛ a heto ɔmɛ.
KUSUMI KƐ MWƆNƐMWƆNƐ Ɔ MUNYU 
YEMI HE BLƆ NƆ TOMIHI
Kusumi munyu yemi
Kusumi munyu yemi ji blɔ nɔ tomi kɛ ha munyu yemi ngɛ ma ko mi, titli ɔ, munyuhi 
nɛ kɔɔ ma kusumihi, ma kɔhi, ma ni peepee kɛ ma nɔ yami he. Blɔ nɔ tomi nɛ ɔmɛ 
ngɛ momoomo loko mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ mlaahi kɛ amlaalo kojomi blɔ nɔ tomi ɔmɛ ba. 
A ngmɛ mlaahi nɛ a daa nɔ kɛ yeɔ kusumi munyu ɔ se a tsɔɔ bimɛ kɛ yi nɔ bimɛ nɛ 
a leɔ mlaa kɛ blɔ nɔ tomi nɛ ɔmɛ sisiisi. Kusumi kojomi blɔ nɔ tomi nɛ ɔ kɛ si himi 
kpakpa, nyɛmi suɔmi, kake peemi kɛ tue mi jɔmi baa. Munyu komɛ nɛ a pɔɔ yemi ji 
pɛ, zugba sane, we mi munyuhi, kita nɔ gbleemi, nyangɔ, patapaa, atua tsɔmi, kunɔ, 
nɔ he pleemi kɛ munyu kpa komɛ. Matsɛmɛ, weku nyatsɛmɛ kɛ nimeli nɛ daa si nɛ a 
yeɔ munyu nɛ ɔmɛ.

Kusumi munyu yemi blɔ nɔ tomi ji nimeli a blɔ nɔ tomihi nɛ a guɔ nɔ kɛ yeɔ nihi a 
kpɛti munyu nɛ a kɛ dla pɛ kɛ nihi a sisi nuimi loko mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ kojomi blɔ nɔ tomi

Blɔ komɛ a nɔ nɛ a guɔ kɛ yeɔ munyu
1. Mi dami: Enɛ ɔ ji kaa nɔ ko nɛ munyu ɔ kɔ we e he saasaa ma nyɛ da mi kɛ dla nihi 
nɛ munyu ɔ kɔɔ a he ɔ kpɛti. A dɛ mlaa nɔ veveeve kɛ dla munyu kaa kikɛ nɛ ɔ.
2. Kojomi: Enɛ ɔ daa kusumi blɔ nɔ tomi kɛ kɔhi a nɔ kɛ yeɔ munyu nɛ a ngɔɔ dami 
kɛ fɔɔ e blɔ he.
3. Kpɛti tsami/Dlami: Enɛ ɔ hyɛɔ nɛ a dla pɛbili ɔmɛ a kpɛti nɛ tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba.
4. Gbi kplɛɛmi: Nimeli yeɔ buaa nɛ munyutsɛ ɔmɛ baa gbi kplɛɛmi kake kaa a dla 
munyu ɔ aloo a ngmɛɛ he nɛ tue mi jɔmi nɛ ba. Nimeli deɔ ke a kɛ a nane ma 
munyu ɔ nɔ.
Kusumi munyu yemi blɔ nɔ tomi kɛ mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ munyu 
yemi blɔ nɔ tomi kɛ a bi a he tomi

mwɔnɛmwɔnɛ ɔ munyu yemi blɔ nɔ tomi he kpɛti.

INTRODUCTION
In this section, you will be exposed to the concepts of riddles and puzzles as part of 
oral literature of the Ghanaian language. You have already been exposed to concepts 
like libation and dirges in year one. In the study of riddles and puzzles, you will 
be introduced to analysing the structure and types of riddles and then move on to 
explore the structure of puzzles. This section is essential for you not only in the 
context of Ghanaian language studies but also establishes links with related subjects 
such as Literature in English. This section will also equip you with the requisite skills 
to improve your language and enhance your problem-solving abilities. Riddles and 
puzzles are exciting ways to exercise the brain, boost creativity, and develop critical 
thinking skills. The examples given are not exhaustive.
OTIHI
• Ajohi/Amanɔsaahi ji bimi, demi munyukpɔ nɛ hiaa yi mi susumi saminya kɛ ha 
heto. Ajo ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ alobalohi ngɛ ɔ nɛ a kaa nɔ juɛmi nɛ e hɛɛɔ heto nɛ nya muɔ 
womi ngɛ he.
• A kɛ ajo kɛ alobalo jeɔ hɛja, kanyaa nɔ juɛmi nɛ a kɛ kaseɔ ni.
• Ajo yeɔ buaa nɔ nɛ e tsuɔ gbi ɔ he ni saminya: gbi ɔ lomi kɛ nɔ he susumi.
AJOHI/AMANƆSAA
Ajohi/Amanɔsaahi ngɛ kaa bɔ nɛ alobalohi ngɛ ɔ nɛ a kaa nɔ juɛmi kɛ guɔ gbi, 
munyunguhi kɛ nɔ lakami nɔ konɛ a kɛ je laami hetohi kpo. Ajo peeɔ bimi, demi aloo 
munyukpɔ nɛ hlaa yi mi susumi kɛ nɔ he susumi kɛ mi kuɔmi. A ma nyɛ pee nya muɔ 
womi nihi hulɔ.
Ajo/Amanɔsaa he su komɛ
1. E tsuɔ munyunguhefiɛmi he ni: Munyunguhefiɛmi, sisi numi enyɔ, munyunguhi nɛ 
hɛɛ pɛmi kake ngmami bɔ ekpaakpa kɛ sisi numi ekpaakpa, munyunguhi nɛ hɛɛ 
ngmami bɔ kake kɛ sisi numi ekpaakpa.
2. E tsuɔ lɛngmengmle kɛ nɔ kɛ nɔ he tomi he ni.
3. E hiaa nɔ mi tsakemi kɛ nɔ mi plɛmi.
4. E hiaa kpo nɔ he susumi.
5. E hiaa heto nɛ juɛmi sui he.

Alobalohi ji bimihi nɛ hia yi mi susumi kɛ nɔ he susumi kɛ hla heto kɛ nyagba. A pɔɔ

juɛmi nya wami. E yeɔ buaa kɛ haa yi mi susumi vii, nɔ kaimi kɛ nɔ he susumi pɔtɛɛ.

4. Pɛmingunɔmami kɛ hanɔpɛmi: E ji pɛmingu tsɛmi kpiti kɛ e mi gblami/sami ngɛ za 
ko mi.
5. Pɛmikplɛɛmi: E ji pɛmihi a mi timi ngɛ zahi a nyagbe ngɛ asilɛ ko mi.
6. Za kɛ kuku: Za amɛ peeɔ nihi nɛ asilɛ ɔ daa si ngɛ nɔ nɛ kuku ji za abɔ nɛ daa si kaa 
nɔ kake kɛ tsɔɔ nya sɔmi aloo mumi womi ngɛ asilɛ ɔ kanemi/demi mi.
7. Munyu mi zɔ woli kɛ munyuhezawoli: A tsuɔ enɛ ɔmɛ a he ni kɛ jeɔ munyungu ɔmɛ a 
sisi numi slɔɔto ɔmɛ kpo aloo a kɛ jeɔ juɛmi ekpahi nɛ a kɛ munyungu ɔmɛ kɔ we ɔ 
kpo. Munyu mi zɔ woli kaa amlɔɔmo, okadi kɛ senya munyu nɛ ma ha sisi tsɔɔmi 
slɔɔtohi maa hi asilɛ ɔ he. Ja nɔuu a tsuɔ munyuhezawoli kaa lɛngmengmlee, 
kaalɛ/ejelɛ, apeelɛnɔ, he ni kɛ tsɔɔ tsakpa nɛ ngɛ okadi komɛ nɛ a tsu he ni kɛ be ɔ 
a kpɛti. A ngɛ munyuhezawoli komɛ hu kaa kaaekonu, nyakpatawomi, senyakɔmi/
kolisimi, mitimi kɛ ekpa komɛ nɛ a tsuɔ a he ni.
8. Munyutso: Juɛmi aloo yi mi tomi ko nɛ ngɛ kpo jee ngɛ asilɛ ɔ mi. Munyutso aloo 
yi mi tomi oti komɛ ngɛ asilɛ mi ma nyɛ pee nɔ nɛ nɔ ko le momo kɛ he numihi.
9.  Gbitso kɛ he numi: Asilɛte ɔ je mi bami kɛ si asilɛ ɔ kanelɔ kɛ he numi nɛ asilɛ tue 
buli ɔmɛ je kpo kɛ kɔ sɛgbi ɔ he.
10. Okadigbi: A tsuɔ okadigbihi a he ni kɛ maa yi mi tomi aloo nɔ peemi ko nane mi nɛ 
haa sisi numi baa asilɛ ɔ he.
11. Munyunguhlami: Enɛ ɔ tsɔɔ munyungu ɔmɛ hlami kɛ a sisi numihi. A yoɔ enɛ ɔ kɛ 
guɔ gbi nɔ womi aloo e si bami, mumi mi nɛ asilɛte ɔ ngɛ kɛ munyuhezawoli a he 
ni tsumi mi.

Asilɛ he se namihi
1. E waa gbi ɔ tumi: Asilɛ yeɔ buaa kaseli nɛ a naa munyungu ehehi, lɛngmengmlee kɛ 
munyu mi zɔ woli.
2. Nɔ ehe peemi: Asilɛ waa kɛ haa nɔ he susumi, yi mi susumi kɛ munyu tumi.
3. Nɔ he susumi tsɔsemi: Asilɛ he fiɔmi ɔ yeɔ buaa kaseli kɛ naa tsɔsemi ngɛ yi mi 
susumi, nɔ sisi tsɔɔmi kɛ bɔ nɛ a yɔseɔ nihi ha a he.
4. He numi tsɔsemi: Asilɛ jeɔ adesa he numi, nihi nɛ nɔ ko le momo, nɔ kpa he numi kɛ 
nihi a sisi numihi kpo.

5. Kusumi ni peemi kɛ kɔhi: E yeɔ buaa kɛ tsɔɔ kusumi ni peemi kɛ kɔhi kɛ ma blɔ nɔ 
tomihi.
6. Tsɔseɔ nɔ kaimi kɛ nɔ demi suhi: Asilɛ ɔ kaimi kɛ e demi ɔ waa kɛ haa nɔ kaimi, hɛ kɛ 
nɔ fɔmi kɛ ma hɛ mi munyu tumi suhi.
7. Gɛjɛmi kɛ ha nɔ nitsɛ kɛ munyu tumi: Asilɛ ngmɛɔ blɔ nɛ kaseli jeɔ a juɛmi mi nihi, he 
numihi kɛ nihi nɛ a le momo ɔ kpo.
8. Juɛmi mi tsɔsemi: Asilɛ waa kaseli kɛ nuɔ nihi a sisi kɛ bɔ nɛ a ma kudɔ nɔ ko he 
numi ha kɛ juɛmi nɔ tsɔsemi. Kaseli ma nyɛ yo munyutso ɔ aloo yi mi tomi oti ɔ 
ngɛ asilɛ ɔ mi.
9. Munyuhezawoli a sisi numi: Asilɛ tsɔɔ kaseli munyuhezawoli kaa kadihi kɛ munyu 
mi zɔ woli. Munyuhezawoli nɛ ɔmɛ waa ngɛ gbi ɔ tumi mi.
Ni tsumi 10�4 Asilɛ he se namihi
Nyɛɛ nuu nyɛ he nɛ nyɛɛ sɛsɛ asilɛ se namihi kaa masu ɔ he. Nyɛɛ ngɔ nihi nɛ wa 
sɛsɛ he ɔmɛ kɛ nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ juɛmi ngɔ piɛɛ he.
Asilɛ he blɔ nɔ tomi
Asilɛ hɛɛ blɔ nɔ tomi nɛ ɔmɛ:
1. Zahi: Za amɛ hɛɛ munyunguhi.
2. Za nya kami: Pɛmingu abɔ ngɛ za ko mi.
3. Kukuhi: Enɛ ɔ ji za abɔ nɛ daa si kaa nɔ kake.
4. Pɛmikplɛɛmi: E ji pɛmihi a mi timi ngɛ zahi a nyagbe ngɛ asilɛ ko mi.
5. Pɛmingunɔmami: E ji pɛmingu nɔ mi mami ngɛ pɛminguhi a nɔ.
6. Pɛmingumitimi: E ji pɛmingu mi timi nyafii nɛ ya peeɔ pɛminguhi nɛ a bla mɛ.
7. Zanɔhwɔmi: E ji blɔ nɔ nɛ haa munyu ko tsaa nɔ kɛ sɛɔ za kpa mi nɛ e wo we ni 
ngmami mi okadi kɛ to kekle za a nya.
8. Tsui aloo mumi womi: E ji blɔ nɔ nɛ asilɛ kanelɔ guɔ kɛ woɔ mumi ngɛ asilɛ ko 
kanemi mi ngɛ za amɛ a nyagbe ngɛ asilɛ ko mi.
9. Ningma okadi ngua:  Mo tsu ningma okadi ngua he ni ngɛ za amɛ a sisije aloo 
munyuzahi a sisije.
A daa ni nɛ ɔmɛ a nɔ kɛ tsuɔ asilɛ blɔ nɔ tomi ɔmɛ a he ni.
a. Hanɔpɛmi kɛ pɛmihi a he ni.
b. Sisi numi kɛ mitimi he ni.

ASILƐ HE FIƆMI
Nihi nɛ sa hyɛmi aloo yomi ke a ngɛ asilɛ he fiɔe
1. Moo hyɛ oti/yi ɔ kɛ tsakpa nɛ ngɛ e kɛ asilɛ ɔ kpɛti.
2. Mo yɔse sɛgbi nɛ ngɛ asilɛ ɔ mi aloo nɔ nɛ asilɛte ɔ ngɛ hlae ma de.
3. Hyɛ kaa munyunguhi nɛ asilɛte ɔ tsu he ni ɔ, a mi he wa aloo a mi he wɛ konɛ o 
susu nɔ he je nɛ e tsu jamɛ a munyungu ɔmɛ a he ni.
4. Moo tu gbitso aloo he numi nɛ asilɛte ɔ na kɛ je asilɛ ɔ kpo kɛ bɔ nɛ e tsu a he ni 
ngɛ asilɛ ɔ mi ha a he munyu.
5. Sɛsɛ he numi nɛ asilɛte ɔ na kɛ ngma asilɛ ɔ.
6. Moo tu munyuhezawoli nɛ asilɛte ɔ tsu he ni ngɛ asilɛ ɔ mi ɔ he munyu. Moo sɛsɛ 
bɔ nɛ munyuhezawoli ɔmɛ ye bua asilɛ ɔ ha.
7. Moo tu asilɛ ɔ lomi bɔ ɔ he munyu.
8. Moo hyɛ nɔ nɛ ngɛ asilɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ nɔ nɛ e ngɛ ngmae kɛ yaa ha a.
Ni tsumi 10�5 Asilɛ he blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ mi hyɛmi ekohu
Asilɛ blɔ nɔ tomi sisi numi ɔ he hia ke o ngɛ hlae ma fiɔ asilɛ ɔ he.
1. Nyɛɛ nuu nyɛ he enyɔɔnyɔ nɛ nyɛɛ hyɛ asilɛ he blɔ nɔ tomi ɔ mi ekohu. Nyɛɛ 
hyɛ asilɛ nɔhyɛ nɔ nɛ nyɛ kase ngɛ ni tsumi 10.3 ɔ mi.

GLOSSARY
Affix A grammatical form that is attached to a word at either the 
beginning.
Affixation The process of adding affixes to roots or stems to form new 
words.
Ballad A narrative poem meant to be sung, with simple meter and 
rhyme, often telling folklore or romantic stories.
Borrowing The process of acquiring new words from another language.
Clipping The process of shortening an existing word to form a new one.
Coda The final consonant of a syllable.
Comma A punctuation mark (,) indicating a pause or separating items 
in a list.
Compounding The process of putting two or more existing words together to 
form a new one.
Conjunction A word that joins two or more words, phrases, or clauses in a 
sentence.
Coordination 
conjunctions
Conjunctions that link equal parts of a sentence.
Correlative 
conjunctions
Paired conjunctions generally used at two points in a sentence.
Culture The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular group 
or society.
Customary Traditional practices passed down through generations.
Derivational affix An affix that changes the class of a word it is attached to.
Dramatic Poetry A poem written in verse to be spoken, involving dialogue 
among characters.
Elegy A reflective poem that laments loss, often exploring mourning 
and reflection.
Epic Poetry A lengthy narrative poem recounting heroic deeds or 
adventures.
Free Verse Poetry free from regular meter or rhyme scheme.
Goal A clearly defined objective or desired outcome.
Head word The central element in a phrase.
Human rights Principles concerned with equality and fairness, ensuring 
freedom and protection.
Indigenous Original occupants of a land or region.
Infix An affix placed between two parts of a word.
144
Inflectional affix An affix that maintains the class of the word it is attached to.
Intonation Pitch changes that occur across a sentence.
Lexicon An inventory of sounds, words, etc. in a language.
Litigant A party involved in a lawsuit, either the accused or defendant.
Lyric Poetry A short poem expressing personal emotions or thoughts, often 
musical.
Meter and Rhythm The pattern of stressed and unstressed syllables in a line.
Monogamy The practice of marrying one person at a time.
Obstacles Challenges or barriers that hinder progress.
Ode A lengthy poem that praises an event, individual, or idea.
Pitch The rate of vibration of vocal cords during speech.
Poem A verbal composition conveying experiences, ideas, or 
emotions.
Polygamy The practice of having multiple spouses at the same time.
Prefix An affix attached at the beginning of a root/stem.
Puzzle A game or problem requiring logical or strategic thinking to 
solve.
Relative adverb An adverb that heads an adjective clause.
Rhyme Scheme The ordered pattern of rhymes at the ends of lines.
Riddle A puzzle or brain teaser using clever language to conceal an 
answer.
Rules Constraints or guidelines that must be followed.
Slash A diagonal line used to show options, dates, or fractions.
Solution The final answer or outcome.
Solution Path A sequence of steps or decisions leading to the goal.
Sonnet A 14-line poem with a specific rhyme scheme and meter.
Source language The language from which a text is translated.
Starting Point The initial situation or setup.
Subordinating 
conjunction
Conjunctions that link a dependent clause to an independent 
one.
Suffix An affix attached at the end of a root/stem.
Summary A condensed version of an original text.
Syllabic consonant A consonant that functions as the nucleus of a syllable.
Syllabification The process of dividing a word into syllables.
145
Target language The language into which a text is translated.
Text A piece of written work.
Transitive verb A verb that uses a direct object to show who or what receives 
the action.

Ghana’s new Senior High School Curriculum aims to ensure that all learners 
achieve their potential by equipping them with 21st Century skills, knowledge, 
character qualities and shared Ghanaian values. This will prepare learners to live a 
responsible adult life, progress to further studies and enter the world of work. This 
is the first time that Ghana has developed a Senior High School Curriculum which 
focuses on national values, attempting to educate a generation of Ghanaian youth 
who are proud of our country and can contribute effectively to its development.
The Ministry of Education is proud to have overseen the production of these 
Learner Materials which can be used in class and for self-study and revision. 
These materials have been developed through a partnership between the Ghana 
Education Service, teacher unions (Ghana National Association of Teachers- GNAT, 
National Association of Graduate Teacher -NAGRAT and the Pre-Tertiary Teachers 
Association of Ghana- PRETAG) and National Subject Associations. These materials 
are informative and of high quality because they have been written by teachers for 
teachers with the expert backing of each subject association.
I believe that, if used appropriately, these materials will go a long way to 
transforming our Senior High Schools and developing Ghana so that we become 
a proud, prosperous and values-driven nation where our people are our greatest 
national asset.
Haruna Iddrisu MP

DZEƉOƉO
NUKƆKƆ ƑE TUTUƉO KPLE GBEƉƆƉƆ
NUƲUƲU
Akpa sia ƒo nu tso nu si nukɔkɔ nye, nukɔkɔ ƒe tutuɖo kple gbeɖɔɖɔ ŋu. Ne èwu 
nusɔsrɔ̃ sia nu la, àte ŋu ade vovototo nukɔkɔ nɔnuvo kple nukɔkɔ manɔnuvo dome 
le Eʋegbe me eye àte ŋu adzro ale si nunyanya tso nukɔkɔwo ŋu kpena ɖe mía ŋu le 
nyawo tutu ɖo me la me. Àgasrɔ̃ nu tso gbeɖɔɖɔ hã ŋu le akpa sia. Nusɔsrɔ̃ sia akpe 
ɖe ŋuwò be nàde dzesi gbeɖɔɖɔ dzimetɔ (gbekɔkɔ), gbeɖɔɖɔ anyimetɔ (gbebɔbɔ), 
titinagbeɖɔɖɔ (evedomesitɔ), gbekɔkɔ-bɔbɔ, gbebɔbɔ-kɔkɔ kple bubuawo. Nusɔsrɔ̃ 
la akpe ɖe ŋuwò be nàte ŋu atu nya yeyewo ɖo to gbeɖɔɖɔ nyuitɔ zazã me. Mlɔeba 
la, akpa sia adzro gbeɖɔɖɔ ƒe wɔƒewo me abe vovototodede nyawo ƒe gɔmesese, 
nyahawo kple gbetagbewo dome ene.
NYATI VEVIWO
• Nukɔkɔ nye nya ƒe akpa si woate ŋu ayɔ le nukeke ɖeka me.
• Xaxagbeɖiɖi aɖewo tea ŋu nɔa wo ɖokuiwo si nyea nukɔkɔ.
• Gbeɖɔɖɔ nye ale si míaƒe gbe ƒe dziyiyi kple ɖiɖi hea tɔtrɔ dea nyawo ƒe gɔmesese 
me la.
NUKƆKƆ, EƑE HAWO KPLE TUTUƉO
NU SI NUKƆKƆ NYE
Nukɔkɔ nye nya ɖeka alo nya ƒe akpa si me ablɔɖegbeɖiɖi le la si míeyɔna zi ɖeka 
le nukeke ɖeka me la. Enye afi si míetɔna ɖo vie nenye be míele nya alo nya ƒe akpa 
aɖe yɔm la. Le kpɔɖeŋu me, ne èle ŋkɔ Kofi [ko.fi] yɔm la, àke nu atu zi eve hafi ayɔe. 
Le esia ta la, míagblɔ be nukɔkɔ evee le ŋkɔ Kofi me ke nukɔkɔ ɖeka koe le nya tu 
[tu] me. Nusrɔ̃la, nukɔkɔ nenie le nya agbelimɔ me?
Kpe ɖe ablɔɖegbeɖiɖiwo ŋu la, xaxagbeɖiɖi aɖewo abe [m, n, ŋ] ene tea ŋu nyea 
nukɔkɔ. Wonɔa wo ɖokuiwo si wɔa nukɔkɔ. Nu sia dzɔna nenye be ablɔɖegbeɖiɖi 
aɖeke mekplɔ xaxagbeɖiɖi siawo ɖo o. Le kpɔɖeŋu me [ŋ.kɔ], [n.dɔ], [a.m.pe], 
[ko.m], [kpa.m], [ko.ŋ] kple [n.di]. Ele be ablɔɖegbeɖiɖi ɖeka nanɔ nukɔkɔ me eye 
xaxagbeɖiɖi ate ŋu akpe ɖe eŋu loo alo makpe ɖe eŋu o. Nyawo tea ŋu nɔa nukɔkɔ 
vovovowo me abe nukɔkɔ ɖeka, eve alo wu nenema ene.

Kpɔ kpɔɖeŋu siwo gbɔna la ɖa
1. Nukɔkɔ ɖeka: Ho [ho], fa [fa]
2. Nukɔkɔ eve: taflo [ta.flo], kese [ke.se]
3. Nukɔkɔ geɖe: tsileƒe [tsi.le.ƒe], mawunyagblɔla [ma.wu.nya.gblɔ.la]
Nunyanya tso nukɔkɔ ƒe tutuɖo ŋu le vevie elabena
a. ekpena ɖe nusrɔ̃lawo ŋu be wotea ŋu tua nya yeyewo ɖo nyuie.
b. enana be wotea ŋu dea dzesi nya siwo le gbegbɔgblɔ aɖe me la.
c. ekpena ɖe nusrɔ̃lawo ŋu le nyawo gɔme sese me.
Nukɔkɔ ƒe kpɔɖeŋu aɖewoe nye: a.kpe, tɔ, a.tɔ.tɔ.tɔ, a.me, ŋ.ke.ke, ke.ŋ. Le kpɔɖeŋu 
siwo va yi me la, gbeɖiɖi siwo gbɔ woda tɔtɔdzesiwo ɖo la nye nukɔkɔwo.
Nukɔkɔ ƒe hawo
Nukɔkɔwo to vovo tso gbegbɔgblɔ ɖeka gbɔ yi bubu gbɔ. Ke h ã la, le Ghana 
gbegbɔgblɔwo me la, nukɔkɔ siwo li la woe nye nukɔkɔ nɔnuno kple nukɔkɔ 
manɔnuvo.

me la, nukɔkɔ nɔnuno kple manɔnuvowo li.
Nukɔkɔ nɔnuvo
Nukɔkɔ nɔnuvo nye nukɔkɔ si wu enu kple ablɔɖegbeɖiɖi. Nukɔkɔ nɔnuvotɔwo ƒe 
kpɔɖeŋu aɖewoe nye esiwo gbɔna:
Eʋegbe: a:kpe, tɔ, va, dzo, a.gbe.li
Gɛ̃gbe: ka, n.ka: ti.ɛ, n.ka.la.de
Fantigbe:  n.su, n.ku.ko, a.pa
Blugbe:  ko.fi, e.tu.o, ɛ.tɔ
Le kpɔɖeŋu siwo va yi me la, míede dzesii be ablɔɖegbeɖiɖiwoe wu nyawo nu. Le 
esia ta la, míagblɔ be nukɔkɔ nɔnuvo nye nukɔkɔ si wu enu kple ablɔɖegbeɖiɖi.
Nukɔkɔ manɔnuvo
Nukɔkɔ manɔnuvo nye nukɔkɔ si wua enu kple xaxagbeɖiɖi. Abe ale si wòle Eʋegbe 
me ene la, ele vevie be nànya be nukɔkɔ ƒe ha sia mele Ghanagbe geɖe me o. Ghanagbe 
ʋɛ siwo me nukɔkɔ manɔnuvotɔwo le la dometɔ aɖewoe nye Dagbanigbe, Gurunegbe, 
Likpankpaanlgbe, Dagaaregbe kple bubuawo. Nukɔkɔ manɔnuvo ƒe kpɔɖeŋu aɖewoe 
nye:
Dagbanigbe: zab.li, dab.li
Gurune: nabt

3. Miɖe nukɔkɔ ƒe tutuɖo ƒe vevinyenye le nyatutuɖo me la me. Migblɔ miaƒe

Nukɔkɔ ƒe tutuɖo
Nukɔkɔ ƒe tutuɖo to vovo tso gbegbɔgblɔ ɖeka gbɔ yi bubu gbɔ. Míate ŋu aɖɔ 
nukɔkɔ ƒe tutuɖo ku ɖe xaxagbeɖiɖi (X), ablɔɖegbeɖiɖi (A) kple gbeɖɔɖɔ (G) ŋu. 
Ablɔɖegbeɖiɖiwo nye nukɔkɔ ƒe akpa vevitɔ. Woawoe nye nukɔkɔ la ƒe dzi. Le 
Ghana gbegbɔgblɔ geɖewo me la, gbeɖɔɖɔ le vevie le dzesidede nukɔkɔ la me. Kpe 
ɖe ablɔɖegbeɖiɖiwo ŋu la, xaxagbeɖiɖi aɖewo tea ŋu xɔa gbeɖɔɖɔ hetua nukɔkɔ 
ɖo. Nukɔkɔ ƒe tutuɖo si ƒomevi nukɔkɔ aɖe nye la kuna ɖe xaxagbeɖiɖi kple 
ablɔɖegbeɖiɖi ƒe xexlẽme si le nukɔkɔa me la ŋu. Le kpɔɖeŋu me, ne ablɔɖegbeɖiɖi 
eve le nya aɖe me la, ekema nukɔkɔ evee le nya la me. Nukɔkɔ ƒe tutuɖo vovovowo 
le Eʋegbe me. Na míalé ŋku ɖe wo ŋu ɖekaɖeka.

Le gbegbɔgblɔ geɖewo me la, woz ãa gbeɖɔɖɔ tsɔna ɖea gɔ mesese kple seselelãme 
tɔxɛ fiana. Gbeɖɔɖɔ nye ale si míaƒe gbe nɔa dzi yim ganɔa ɖiɖim le nuƒo me. 
Gbegbɔgblɔ aɖewo li siwo me gbeɖɔɖɔ dea vovototo nyawo ƒe gɔmesese me le. 
Eʋegbe kple Ghana degbe bubuwo k ãta nye gbegb ɔgblɔ siwo me gbeɖɔɖɔ hea 
vovototo dea nyawo dome le la.
Gbeɖɔɖɔ ƒe hawo
Gbeɖɔɖɔ to vovo tso gbegbɔgblɔ ɖeka gbɔ yi bubu gbɔ. Gbeɖɔɖɔ siwo gbɔna lae 
nye gbeɖɔɖɔ ƒe kpɔɖeŋu siwo le Ghana gbegbɔgblɔwo me: gbekɔkɔ, gbebɔbɔ, 
evedomesi gbeɖɔɖɔ, gbekɔkɔ-gbebɔbɔ kple gbebɔbɔ-kɔkɔ. Gbeɖɔɖɔ ƒe ha eve siwo 
nye gbekɔkɔ kple gbebɔbɔ la le Ghana gbegbɔgblɔwo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe me. Tsɔ kpe 
gbeɖɔɖɔ eve siawo ŋu la, gbeɖɔɖɔ evedomesitɔ le Ghana gbegbɔgblɔ aɖewo me. 
Gbekɔkɔ-bɔbɔ kple gbebɔbɔ-kɔkɔ hã le Ghana gbegbɔgblɔ aɖewo hã me. Gbeɖɔɖɔ ƒe 
kpɔɖeŋu siwo gbɔna la le Ghana gbegbɔgblɔ aɖewo me:
1. Gbegbɔgblɔ siwo me gbeɖɔɖɔ eve koŋ le (gbekɔkɔ kple gbebɔbɔ): Blugbe, 
Nzemagbe, Gɛ̃gbe, Kasemgbe, Eʋegbe kple bubuawo.
2. Gbegbɔgblɔ siwo me gbeɖɔɖɔ et ɔ̃ koŋ le (gbekɔkɔ, gbebɔbɔ kple gbeɖɔɖɔ 
evedomesitɔ): Adagbe, Dagbanigbe kple buabuawo.
Wodea dzesi gbeɖɔɖɔ siawo kple dzesi siwo gbɔna la: gbekɔkɔ [´], gbebɔbɔ [`]

DZEƉOƉO
DZEƉOƉO TSO NYATI AƉE ŊU KPLE NUXEXLẼ
NUƲUƲU
Akpa sia ku ɖe dzesidede nyati vevi siwo le nuŋlɔɖi kple dzeɖoɖo me la ŋu. Le 
akpa sia la, àsrɔ̃ nu tso nuxexlẽ tsitotsito kple nuxexlẽ gbadzaa ŋu. Nusɔsrɔ̃ la adzro 
aɖaŋu vevi siwo hiã le dzesidede nyati vevi siwo le nuŋl ɔɖi alo nuƒo aɖe me la me. 
Akpe ɖe ŋuwò nàsrɔ̃ ale si nàgblɔ nyati siwo le nuŋlɔɖi alo nuƒo aɖ e me la na ame 
bubuwo hã nyuie. Kadodo le nu siwo nàsrɔ̃  le akpa sia kple nusɔsr ɔ̃ bubuwo abe 
Iŋlisigbe kple nusɔsrɔ̃ tso hadomegbenɔnɔ ŋu ene la dome.
NYATI VEVIWO
Nyati vevi si le nuŋlɔɖi aɖe me la nye nu si ŋu nuŋlɔɖi la ku ɖo la. Nyati vevi la tea ŋu 
nɔa nyatinyagbe me eye alɔdonyagbewo ɖea nyati la me. Nuxexlẽ tea ŋu nyea nuxexlẽ 
tsitotsito kple nuxexlẽ gbadzaa.
• Nuxexlẽ tsitotsito nye nuxexlẽ si me nuxlẽla la ƒlɔa ŋku ɖe nuŋlɔɖi la me nyuie le 
be wòase nu si ŋu nuŋl ɔɖi la ku ɖo la me eye wòase ta ɖodzinu si le nuŋlɔla la si 
la me.
• Nuxexlẽ gbadzaa nye nu geɖewo xexlẽ kple susu be woasrɔ̃ nya yeyewo, axlẽ nu 
kple aɖebibi eye woanya nu tso nu geɖe ŋu.
DZESIDEDE NYATI VEVIWO LE DZEƉOƉO 
ME
Ŋugblededebiabia: Bu nu si miesrɔ̃ le ƒe gbãtɔ me tso nyati vevi ŋu la ŋu. Nu kae 
nye nyati vevi? Tsɔ  nu si ŋu nèke ɖo la sɔ kple wò hatsotsomet ɔwo tɔ. Emegbe la, 
xlẽ numeɖeɖe si gbɔna la.
Nyati Vevi
Nyati vevi lae nye nu si ŋu boɖeɖe, nuŋlɔɖi alo nuƒo si woŋlɔ da ɖi la ku ɖo 
la. Nyati vevi la ƒoa nu tso nu si ŋu nuŋlɔɖi alo dzeɖoɖo aɖe ku ɖo. Zi geɖe la, 
nyagbe siwo ɖea nyati vevi la me la kplɔnɛ ɖo. Ne àte ŋu ade dzesi kadodo si le 
alɔdonyagbewo dome la, àte ŋu ake ɖe nyati vevi si ŋu wòle nu ƒom le la ŋu. Be nàte 
ŋu ade dzesi nyati vevi le nuŋlɔɖi aɖe me la, wɔ nu siwo gbɔna la:
• Xlẽ tanya kple nuʋuʋu la – Ele be nàdi nu si tanya la kple nuʋuʋu la gblɔ tso nu 
si me wodzro le nuŋlɔɖi la me la ŋu.
• Di nyatinyagbe la – Zi geɖe la, nyatinyagbe la nɔa boɖeɖea ƒe gɔmedzeƒe.

• De dzesi nu siwo wogblɔ tso nyati la ŋu – Bia nya siawo ɖ okuiwò tso nyati la 
ŋu: ame ka, nu ka, ɣe ka ɣi, nu ka ta kple aleke ku ɖe nyati vevi la ŋu.
• Nyatotoɖeme: To nuŋlɔɖi la ɖe eme le wò gɔmesese nu.
• Nyatotoɖeme la sɔsɔ kple taƒonya la: Tsɔ wò nyatotoɖeme la sɔ kple nuŋlɔla la ƒe

Nuxexlẽ Tsitotsito
Enye nuxexlẽ ƒe ha si l ɔ taɖodzinu eve ɖe eme. Taɖodzinu siawoe nye nuŋlɔɖi 
la gɔme sese kple gbesɔsr ɔ̃ to ŋkuléle ɖe nu siwo le nuŋlɔɖia me la ŋu me. Elɔ 
ŋkuƒɔƒlɔ ɖe nuŋlɔɖi aɖe me tsitotsito ɖ e eme. Le nuxexlẽ sia me la, nuxlẽlawo tsoa 
ŋku ɖi na nya vevi aɖe siwo te woanya te fli ɖo, mu ɖe ɖusime, de amae, gbugbɔ 
ŋlɔ kple bubuawo. Nuxlẽlawo dzea agbagba léa nu veviwo dana ɖi, dia nyawo le 
nyagɔmeɖegbalẽ me eye woxlẽa nuŋl ɔɖi la tsitotsito be woase nu si xlẽm wole la 
gɔme nyuie le nuxexlẽ ƒe ha sia me.
Nuwɔna 2�1 Nuxexlẽ dzradzradzra kple nuŋlɔɖimetoto hena 
nyatakaka tɔxɛ aɖe didi
Miesrɔ̃ nu tso nuxexlẽ dzradzradzra kple nuŋlɔɖimetoto hena nyatakaka tɔxɛ 
aɖe didi ŋu le ƒe gbãtɔ me. Midzro nu siwo wonye la me le miaƒe hatsotsowo

kple nuŋlɔɖimetoto hena nyatakaka tɔxɛ aɖe didi la me. Mitsɔ nu siwo ŋu 
mieke ɖo la sɔ kple nu siwo gbɔna la.

EME

Nuxexlẽ Dzradzradzra
Nuxexlẽ ƒe akpa sia ku ɖe nuxexlẽ dzradzradzra hena dzesidede nu si ŋu nuŋl ɔɖi la 
ku ɖo gbadzaa alo nyati vevi siwo le nuŋlɔɖi la me la ŋu. Le nuxexlẽ sia me la, 
míesea nuŋlɔɖi la katã gɔme o elabena míexlẽa nuŋlɔɖi la katã o. Míewɔa nuxexlẽ 
sia ƒomevi ŋu dɔ vevietɔ le nuŋlɔɖi si nye nyateƒenya aɖe la xexlẽ me.

Nuwɔna 2�2 Dzesidede nyati vevi le nuŋlɔɖi me

2. De dzesi nyati vevi si le nuŋlɔɖi si gbɔna la me.
3. Migblɔ nyati vevi siwo ŋu mieke ɖo la na klase la eye miatsɔ wo asɔ kple

KUTRIKUKU
Esi mexɔ ƒe ene ko la, danye trɔ megbe eye nyemenya naneke tso fofonye ŋu o. 
Naneke meli mawɔ tsɔ wu be manɔ ƒonyemetɔwo gbɔ o. Ƒonyemetɔ siwo gbɔ wodam 
ɖo la dometɔ geɖewo menye ame siwo menya tsã la o. Wo dometɔ aɖeke mele klalo 
be yeaxɔm manɔ ye gbɔ koŋ yeakpɔ dzinye o. Ne mele ƒonyemetɔ aɖe gbɔ ɣeyiɣi 
ʋɛ aɖe ko la, ekplɔam yia ƒonyemetɔ bubu gbɔ; nyemenɔ aƒe ɖeka me tẽe wòde ƒe 
ɖeka kpɔ o. Nenema ke nyemenɔ suku ɖeka hã wòde ƒe ɖeka kpɔ o. Kpe ɖe tsatsa 
tso aƒe ɖeka me yi aƒe bubu me ŋu la, ƒonyemetɔ aɖewo tsɔ mɔnukpɔkpɔ la fia fum 
vevie ŋutɔ le mɔ siwo ŋu nyemedina be magaƒo nu le o la nu. Mekpɔa dzidzeme 
tso xɔ̃nyewo gbɔ le suku elabena teƒe siae medzea agbagba le be maŋlɔ nu siwo me 
tom mele le aƒe me la be le. Esi mexɔ ƒe ewo la, wozi dzinye be manɔ dɔ wɔm le 
Memliɖagbe kple Kɔsiɖagbewo atsɔ anɔ ɖokuinye dzi kpɔm. Meɖia apa le xɔtutu, 
tɔsisi kple kpegbagbã ƒe dɔwo wɔwɔ me. Mewɔ apaɖidɔ sia ƒe ewo sɔŋ. Medze egɔme 
hafi kpɔ ga dze sekendrisukudede gɔme eye megawɔ dɔ sia ʋuu va se ɖe esi mewu 
sekendrisuku nu. Nukutɔe la, togbɔ be menɔ dɔ siawo wɔm hã la, metea ŋu toa mo 
ɖe nusɔsrɔ̃ ŋu eye wotiam abe nusrɔ̃lawo ƒe tatɔ ene le esime menɔ ƒe mamlɛa me 
le sekendrisuku. Esi medo le sekendrisuku la, mekpɔ dzidzedze nyuitɔ kekeake le 
dodokpɔ mamlɛa me.
Nuwɔna 2�3 Dzesidede susu veviwo le dzeɖoɖo me

NU SIWO NUXEXLẼ GBADZAA LƆ ƉE EME
Ŋugblededebiabia: Ku ɖe nu si nènya tso nuxexlẽ tsitotsito ŋuti la, gblɔ nu si nèbu 
be nuxexlẽ gbadzaa nye la kpuie ko. Emegbe la, ts ɔ wò nume ɖeɖe la sɔ kple esi

Nuxexlẽ Gbadzaa
Enye nuxexlẽ si me míe xlẽa nu gbadzaa le hena modzaka ɖeɖe, nuwo gɔme sese 
gbadzaa, gbe vovovowo ƒe tutuɖo kple nya yeyewo sɔsr ɔ̃. Nuxexlẽ ƒe ha sia doa 
míaƒe nuxlẽɖaŋuwo ɖe ŋgɔ. Enana be míel ɔ̃a nuxexlẽ. Nuxexlẽ gbadzaa nana be 
miexlẽa nu geɖewo eye wòdoa míaƒe gbesɔsrɔ̃ ɖe ŋgɔ.
Nu siwo nuxexlẽ gbadzaa lɔ ɖe eme
Nu siwo nuxexlẽ gbadzaa lɔ ɖe eme lae nye esiwo gbɔna:

Amebubu menye nu si wozina ɖe ame dzi o, ke boŋ enye nu si wodzena na. Enye

asixɔxɔ woƒe susuwo, seselelãmewo kple nu siwo doa dzidzɔ na wo la ŋu.
Nenye be ège ɖe sukuxɔ aɖe me eye nusrɔ̃lawo kple nufialawo ɖe lɔlɔ̃ kple amebubu

ŋu, sidzedze ame ɖokui kple beléle na mía ɖokuiwo hena lãmesẽmenɔnɔ kple susu ƒe 
tenunɔnɔ.
Esi nèle sekendrisuku dem la, ɖo ŋku edzi be amebubu yia edzi le go eve me; ne èdi be

NYATI VEVIWO
• Nyaŋunyakpe nye nyakpe si wokpena ɖe nyake ŋu le eƒe gɔmedzeƒe alo nuwuƒe 
tsɔna tua nya yeye alo nya ma ƒe nɔnɔme bubu ɖo la. Nyaŋunyakpe ƒe ha etɔ̃e 
li. Woawoe nye nyaŋunyakpe ŋgɔdotɔ, nyaŋunyakpe titinatɔ kple nyaŋunyakpe 
megbedotɔ. Míekpea nyaŋunyakpewo ɖe nya alo agununyakpewo ŋu tsɔna tua nya 
yeye si si gɔmesese alo wɔƒe bubu le la ɖo.
• Nyablanyawo nye nya siwo tea nyawo, nyakɔsɔkɔsɔwo alo nyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔwo ƒoa ƒu 
hetua nyagbe siwo si gɔmesese le la ɖo.
• Míezãa nyaŋunyakpewo tsɔ tua nya yeyewo ɖo.
• Nyatutuɖomɔnu nye mɔ si dzi míetona tua nya yeyewo ɖo le gbegbɔgblɔ aɖe me la 
to nya vovovo siwo le gbea me la zazã me.
NYAŊUNYAKPEWO
Nu si nyaŋunyakpewo nye: Nyaŋunyakpe nye nyakpe si wokpena ɖe nyake ŋu 
tsɔna tua nya yeye alo nya ma ƒe nɔnɔme bubu ɖo la. Míagate ŋu aɖe nyaŋunyakpewo 
me be wonye nya siwo wokpena ɖe nya ŋu le eƒe gɔmedzeƒe alo nuwuƒe si hea 
tɔtrɔ dea nya la ƒe gɔmesese me la.
Nyaŋunyakpe siwo le Eʋegbe me la woe nye nyaŋunyakpe ŋgɔdotɔwo kple 
nyaŋunyakpe megbedotɔwo. Ne wotsɔ nyaŋunyakpe kpe ɖe nyake alo nyakɔsɔkɔsɔ 
aɖe ŋu la, eƒe gɔmesese trɔna to nya yeyewo alo nya ma ƒe nɔnɔme bubuwo tutu 
ɖo me. Míagate ŋu agblɔ be nyaŋunyakpewo nye nyakui siwo wokpena ɖe nya 
bubuwo ŋu be woatu nya yeye siwo si gɔmesese bubu le alo atrɔ nyaha si me nya 
la le la ɖo.
Nyaŋunyakpe ŋgɔdotɔ nɔa nyake/agununyakpe la ƒe gɔmedzeƒe heléna ɖe eŋu.
Nyaŋunyakpe megbedotɔ nɔa nyake/agununyakpe la ƒe nuwuƒe heléna ɖe eŋu.

Nuwɔna 3�1 Dzesidede nyaŋunyakpewo
Trɔ ɖe wò nusrɔ̃hati aɖe ŋu eye nàɖe nu si nyaŋunyakpewo nye la me nɛ. Dze

Nyaŋunyakpe ƒe hawo
Nyaŋunyakpe ƒe ha gã eve siwo le Eʋegbe me lae nye nyaŋunyakpe nyayeyewɔtɔ 
kple nyaŋunyakpe wɔƒefiatɔ.
Nyaŋunyakpe nyayeyewɔtɔ
Nyaŋunyakpe siawo nye esiwo tua nya yeye siwo si gɔmesese bubu nɔna la ɖo. 
Nenye be wotsɔ nyaŋunyakpe nyayeyewɔtɔ kpe ɖe nyake aɖe ŋu la, etea ŋu nana 
be nyaha la trɔna tso nyaha si me wòle la yina ɖe nyaha bubu me. Ɣe aɖewo ɣi 
la, nyaha si me nyake la le la metrɔna o. Esia fia be nyaŋunyakpe nyayeyewɔtɔwo 
tea ŋu trɔa nyaha si me nya la le la alo metrɔa nyaha si me nya la le la o. Wozãa 
nyaŋunyakpe nyayeyewɔtɔwo tsɔna tua nya yeyewo ɖo. Le kpɔɖeŋu me, nenye 
be míekpe nyaŋunyakpe nyayeyewɔtɔ -la ɖe nyagblɔɖi ŋu la, ezu nyagblɔɖila� 
Togbɔ be nyagblɔɖila zu nya yeye hã la, nyaha si me nyagblɔɖi le si nye ŋkɔnya 
la metrɔ o. Le go bubu me la, ne míetsɔ nyaŋunyakpe -e kpe ɖe kpui si nye 
ŋkɔnyaɖɔnya ŋu la, etrɔ zu kpuie si nye dɔwɔnyaɖɔnya. Le go sia me la, nyaha si 
me kpui le la mesɔ kple nyaha si me kpuie le la o.
Nyaŋunyakpe wɔƒefiatɔ
Nyaŋunyakpe siawo tea ŋu trɔa nyake la ƒe nɔnɔme gake wometrɔa nyaha si me 
nyake la le la o. Nyaŋunyakpe wɔƒefiatɔwo metrɔa nyawo ƒe gɔmesese bliboe o. Le 
esia ta la, womewɔa nya yeyewo o. Nyaŋunyakpe wɔƒefiatɔ ɖea wɔƒe aɖewo fiana 
le gbeŋutise nu le nuwɔnɔnɔme kple gbɔsɔsɔɖeɖe fia me. Le gbegbɔgblɔ aɖewo me 
la, nyakpe siawo tea ŋu ɖea ŋutsu alo nyɔnunyenye, nuwɔɣi, kple bubuawo fiana. 
Efia be ne míekpe nyaŋunyakpe wɔƒefiatɔ ɖe ŋkɔnya ŋu la, eɖea gbɔsɔsɔ fiana. Le 
kpɔɖeŋu me: nenye be míekpe -wo ɖe ɖevi ŋu la, ezua ɖeviwo si fia be ɖeviawo 
sɔ gbɔ.

b. Adzotɔ kpɔ Kofi gake mebia nya aɖekee o.
c. Àɖu nu loo alo ale tsi gbã?
3. Nyablanya kuɖeŋutɔwo: Nyablanya siawo tea nyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ ɖokuisinɔtɔ

ne, hafi, togbɔ be, eya ta, elabena, esime. Lé ŋku ɖe nyagbe siwo gbɔna la ŋu:

Nuwɔna 3�6 Nyablanyawo zazã le nyagbewo me
Ŋlɔ nyablanya ƒe ha eveawo ƒe kpɔɖeŋuwo eye nàzã wo le nyagbewo me 
wotɔxɛwotɔxɛe. Xlẽ wò nyagbeawo na klase la eye nàɖe wo me.
Nyablanyawo ƒe Vevinyenye
Nyablanyawo zazã tea ŋu toa vovo tso gbegbɔgblɔ ɖeka gbɔ yi ɖe gbegbɔgblɔ bubu 
gbɔ. Ke hã la, nyablanyawo zazã yi ale:
1. Wohea susu alo taɖodzinu si ta wowɔ nane ɖo la ɖe go.
2. Wonana be míekpea nyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ alo nyakɔsɔkɔsɔ ɖe bubu si do ka kplii la 
ŋu.
3. Wozãa wo tsɔna hea kadodo dea susu siwo ɖe nugbegbe fia la dome.
4. Wonana be míeɖea susu siwo tsi tsitre ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu la fiana.
5. Wonana be míetea ŋu kpea susu si meɖe nugbegbe fia o la ɖe susu bubu ŋuti.
6. Wozãa wo tsɔna ɖea nuwɔna alo nudzɔdzɔ aɖe ƒe metsonu fiana.
Nyablanyawo zazã le nyagbewo tutu ɖo me
Se vevi aɖewo ku ɖe nyablanyawo zazã le nyagbewo tutu ɖo me ŋu. Se siawo ŋu dɔ 
wɔwɔ ate ŋu awɔe be míaƒe Eʋegbeŋɔŋlɔ nanɔ ɖoɖo nyuitɔ nu.
a. Nyablanyawo hea kadodo dea susuwo kple nuwɔ nawo me. Eya ta ehiã be 
míazã nyablanya si dze la be wòawɔ dɔ abe ale si dze ene.
b. Nyablanyawo le vevie le nu siwo tu wo nɔewo ɖe nu la yɔyɔ ɖekaɖeka me.
c. Ne èle nyablanyawo zãm la, kp ɔ egbɔ  be nyagbe la ƒe akpawo katã s ɔ ɖe 
gbeŋutise ƒe ɖoɖo nu.
NYATUTUƉOMƆNUWO
Nyatutuɖomɔnu nye mɔ si dzi wotona tua nya yeyewo ɖo le gbegbɔgblɔ aɖe me la.
Nyatutuɖomɔnu vovovowo li siwo dzi wotona tua nya yeyewo ɖo le Eʋegbe me. 
Esiawo lɔ nyateƒoƒu, gbugbɔyɔ, nyakpedenyaŋu, nyaɣeɣe kple bubuawo ɖe eme.

(kpɔɖeŋu: nya siwo ku ɖe mɔɖaŋuŋutinunya, susu yeyewo, kple nutovɛwo

Nyateƒoƒu: Nyateƒoƒu nye nyatutuɖomɔnu si me wotsɔa nyakpe nɔɖokuisi eve alo

míate ŋu akpe nyaŋunyakpe ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi ɖo la. Nu vevi ɖeka si ɖea dzesi le 
Eʋegbe ƒe nyateƒoƒuwo ŋu lae nye be wo dometɔ geɖewo nyea ŋkɔnyawo. Azɔ la, 
míalé ŋku ɖe nyateƒoƒu ƒe kpɔɖeŋu aɖewo ŋu.
Ŋkɔnya kple ŋkɔnya ƒe ƒuƒoƒo: wɔ  + akplẽ = wɔkplẽ, bli + kotoku = blikotoku, 
agbeli + tsro = agbelitsro.
Ŋkɔnya kple teƒefianya ƒe ƒuƒoƒo: to + me = tome, dɔ + me = dɔme, afɔ + dzi 
= afɔdzi.
Nuwɔna 3�8 Dzesidede nya vovovo siwo tu nya aɖe ɖo
Di nya vovovo siwo tu nya siawo ɖo la eye nàyɔ wo na klase la.
1. agbelimɔkotoku
2. neɖega
3. sukuwu
4. kokloziɖula
5. neƒimidzalẽ
6. wɔkplẽ
7. lãgbalẽkotoku
8. sukuviwo
9. gabati
10. gakukuwo
Gbugbɔyɔ
Enye nyatutuɖomɔnu si me wogbugbɔa nyake blibo alo nya la ƒe akpa aɖe tuna 
ɖo le hena nya yeye wɔwɔ. Nenye be wogbugbɔ nya blibo la yɔ la, woɖea ŋkɔ nɛ 
be gbugbɔyɔ blibotɔ. Ke ne wogbugbɔ nyaa ƒe akpa aɖe ko yɔ la, ekema woyɔnɛ 
be gbugbɔyɔ afãtɔ. Le Eʋegbe me la, nyake lae vana evelia. Esia fia be gbugbɔyɔ  
la vana gbã hafi nyake la kplɔnɛ ɖo. Zi geɖe la, gbugbɔyɔ trɔa nyake la ƒe gɔmesese 
kple nyaha si me wòle la. Míalé ŋku ɖe kpɔɖeŋu aɖewo ŋu.
Gbugbɔyɔ blibotɔ: va+ va = vava, ɖu + ɖu = ɖuɖu, ƒo+ƒo = ƒoƒo;
ɖu+ nu = nuɖuɖu, lé + dɔ = dɔléle, ga+kpɔ = gakpɔkpɔ;
Gbugbɔyɔ afãtɔ: trɔ+ trɔ = tɔtrɔ, ƒle + ƒle = ƒeƒle, dzra+dzra = dzadzra

Enye nyatutuɖomɔnu si me gbegbɔgblɔ aɖe dolawo ɣea nya aɖe tso gbegbɔgblɔ 
bubu me le hewɔa asitɔtrɔ le eŋu wòsɔna ɖe woƒe gbegblɔsewo nu. Woyɔa nya si 
woɣe la be nya ɣeɣi. Ne womeɣe nya siawo o la, nya siwo wodina ɖoa wo teƒe 
la mesɔna ɖe nu si gblɔm wole la nu tututu ɣe aɖewo ɣi o. Kpɔɖeŋu aɖewoe nye

4. Ekpena ɖe ame ŋu le gbesɔsrɔ̃ me.
5. Enana be wokena ɖe nyawo ƒe dzɔtsoƒe alo agunu ŋu.

Zã nɔnɔmetata si gbɔna la nàtsɔ aɖo biabia sia ŋu: Aleke míetua nya yeyewo

NUƲUƲU
Le akpa sia la, àsrɔ̃ nu tso gbeŋutisewo ƒe akpa aɖewo abe nyakɔsɔkɔsɔ,

hawo kple woƒe tutuɖo kpakple nyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔwo ƒe tutuɖo le Eʋegbe me ŋu. 
Míadzro nyaŋutidzesiwo hã me. Wò nunya ku ɖe gbeŋutise ƒe akpa siawo ŋu awɔe 
be nàtu nyagbe siwo si gɔmesese le la ɖo. Nusɔsrɔ̃ la akpe ɖe ŋuwò be nàte ŋu ase 
nusɔsrɔ̃ bubu siwo do ka kple Eʋegbe abe Iŋlisigbe ene la gɔme nyuie.

• Nyakɔsɔkɔsɔ nye nya alo nyawo ƒe ƒuƒoƒo si si wɔƒe le le nyagbe me la. Nyakɔsɔkɔsɔ 
ƒe ha vovovowo abe ŋkɔnyakɔsɔkɔsɔ, dɔwɔnyakɔsɔkɔsɔ kple dɔwɔnyaɖɔnyakɔsɔkɔsɔ 
ene le Eʋegbe me.
•  Nyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ nye nyawo ƒe ƒuƒoƒo si tua nyagbe ɖo la. Elɔ nuwɔƒe kple dɔwɔƒe 
ɖe eme eye wòwɔa dɔ abe nyagbe alo nyagbe ƒe akpa aɖe ene.
• Le nuŋɔŋlɔ me la, dzesi siwo míezãna tsɔna dea gɔmesese míaƒe nuŋɔŋlɔwo me 
lae nye nyaŋutidzesiwo. Woƒe kpɔɖeŋu aɖewoe nye tɔtɔdzesi, ɣletivitoasike, 
gbɔviedzesi, nyalemegbedzesi kple nyabudzesi.

Nyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ ɖokuisimanɔtɔ ƒe ha etɔ̃e li ku ɖe woƒe wɔƒewo ŋu. Woawoe nye 
ŋkɔnyaɖɔnyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ, ŋkɔnyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ kple dɔwɔnyaɖɔnyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ.
1. Ŋkɔnyaɖɔnyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ: Enye nyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ si ɖɔa ŋkɔnya alo kɔa 
eŋu. Edzea egɔme kple ‘si’ hewɔa dɔ abe ŋkɔnyaɖɔnya ene le nyagbea me. 
Ŋkɔnyaɖɔnyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔwo le nyagbe siwo gbɔna la me:
a. Menya ŋutsu si va afi sia.
b. Nyɔnu si dzraa ami la va afi sia.
c. Tsɔ agbalẽ si nèfi la nam.
Dzesidenya: Nyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ siwo te fli le la nye ŋkɔnyaɖɔnyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ.
2. Ŋkɔnyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ nye nyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ si wɔa dɔ abe ŋkɔnya ene le 
nyagbe me la. Le kpɔɖeŋu me, ewɔa dɔ abe nuwɔla, fidola ene le nyagbe 
me. Ŋkɔnyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ kple ŋkɔnyaɖɔnyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ de sɔsɔ ge gake 
le esime ŋkɔnyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ tea ŋu nɔa ŋkɔnya teƒe le nyagbe me la, 
ŋkɔnyaɖɔnyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ ɖɔa ŋkɔnya si le nyagbea me la. Ŋkɔnyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ 
ƒe kpɔɖeŋu aɖewoe nye esiwo gbɔna:
Ŋkɔnyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ si wɔ dɔ abe nuwɔla ene ƒe kpɔɖeŋu:
a. Sukuvi si wɔ dɔ nyuie wu le dodokpɔ me la xɔ nunana.
b. Nufiala si gbɔ nyemelɔ̃a nu le o la meva suku egbe o.
Ŋkɔnyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ si wɔ dɔ abe fidoƒe ene ƒe kpɔɖeŋu:
c. Míekpɔ afɔkpa sue si bu la.
d. Danye ɖa nuɖuɖu si doa dzidzɔ nam vevie la.
Ŋkɔnyanyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ siwo le nyagbe (a-b) la nye ŋkɔnyanyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ si 
le dɔ wɔm abe nuwɔla ene la ƒe kpɔɖeŋu eye esi te wote fli ɖo le kpɔɖeŋu (b-c) 
me la, nye nyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ si wɔ dɔ abe fidola ene.
3. Dɔwɔnyaɖɔnyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ: Enye nyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ si wɔa dɔ abe dɔwɔnyaɖɔnya 
ene. Le go bubu me la, eɖɔa dɔwɔnya alo kɔa eŋu le nyagbe me heƒoa nu tso 
ɣeyiɣi, teƒe kple nɔnɔme si me wowɔ nane le la ŋu. Nyagbe siwo gbɔna la ɖe 
dɔwɔnyaɖɔnyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ fia.
a. Eɖo ŋku edzi le ɣeyiɣi si me wòdzo le dɔwɔƒe la.
b. Ne míeɖu nu vɔ la, madzo.
Nyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ siwo te fli le va yi la katã nye nyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ ɖokuisimanɔtɔwo.

Ɖe nu si nyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ nye la me le wò gɔmesese nu eye nàgblɔ wò ŋuɖoɖo 
la na klase la.

“Esi meŋlɔ nye ŋdɔnuɖuɖu la be ta la, meyi ɖe nuɖuɖudzraƒe la, afi si medo go

Degbewo ƒe Vevinyenye le Nusɔsrɔ̃ me
Abe nusrɔ̃la siwo le sekendrisuku ene la, ne miele nu ƒom kple miaƒe ƒometɔwo alo 
mia xɔlɔ̃wo la, miedoa gbe bubu eye ne miele nu srɔ̃m le sukuxɔ me la, miegadoa 
gbe bubu. Ɖe miebu ta me tso mia degbe ƒe vevinyenyewo le sukudede me ŋu kpɔa?
Nugɔmekuku ɖee fia be nusrɔ̃la siwo tea ŋu doa wo degbewo nyuie la wɔa dɔ nyuie 
wu, vevietɔ le nusɔsrɔ̃ siwo ku ɖe nuxexlẽ kple nuŋɔŋlɔ ŋu la me. Ele alea elabena 
mía degbewo nyea gɔmeɖokpe na gbesɔsrɔ̃ ƒe aɖaŋu siwo wɔnɛ be míetea ŋu srɔ̃a 
gbegbɔgblɔ bubuwo eye míesea nusɔsrɔ̃ vovovowo gɔme.
Kpe ɖe eŋu la, mía degbe nyanya wɔnɛ be míesea míaƒe dekɔnuwo kple domenyinuwo 
ƒe wɔnawo gɔme eye míedea dzesi ame si ƒomeviwo míenye la. Gbegbɔgblɔ nye 
dekɔnu ƒe akpa vevi aɖe. Nusrɔ̃la siwo tea ŋu doa wo degbewo la nyaa nu tso woƒe 
dekɔnu ŋu eye wodea dzesi woƒe dzɔtsoƒewo.
Gawu la, nugɔmekuku gaɖee fia be nusrɔ̃la siwo doa wo degbe memie la ƒe susu tea 
ŋu ɖana. Wotea ŋu léa nu ɖe ta me, bua ta me deto tso ale si woaɖe kuxiwo ɖa la 
ŋu. Ele alea elabena zi geɖe la, degbewo lia ke ɖe nusrɔ̃lawo ƒe susu me si wɔnɛ be 
woƒoa nu nyuie eye woɖea susu nyuie.
Le nuwuwu la, degbewo zazã le vevie hena dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ le agbalẽsrɔ̃nyawo 
me, sidzedze ame si ƒomeviwo míenye kple susu ƒe tenunɔnɔ. Abe nusrɔ̃la siwo le 
sekendrisuku ene la, ele vevie be mia degbewo dodo nanye dada na mi le esime 
miegale gbegbɔgblɔ srɔ̃m eye miele hehe xɔm hena dɔ siwo miava wɔ la wɔwɔ.

Dɔwɔƒelɛtaŋɔŋlɔ ƒe aƒɔɖoƒe
1. Dze egɔme kple agoododo na ame si nèle agbalẽ la ŋlɔm na la. Kpɔɖeŋu: “Sukutatɔ 
bubutɔ,”, “Dɔmegã bubutɔ,”, “Nufiala bubutɔ,”, “Sewɔtakpekpemenɔla bubutɔ,”.
2. Zã gbe siwo aɖe bubu fia la.
3.  Zɔ ɖe ɖoɖo tɔxɛ aɖe dzi; ŋlɔ  agbalẽŋl ɔla ƒe adrɛsi, nyati la ƒe totoɖeme, 
ɣletiŋkeke, agbalẽxɔla ƒe adrɛsi.
4.  Zã gbe si ɖe amebubu fia, gbeŋutisewo kple nyaŋutidzesiwo nyuie.
5. Ŋlɔ wò lɛta la ƒe xexlẽmedzeside tɔxɛ ɖe agbalẽa dzi ne ehiã.
6. Wu lɛta la nu kple “Nye” eye nàŋlɔ wò ŋkɔdzesi kple ŋkɔwòwo katã.
Dɔwɔƒelɛta ƒe dzesidenuwo
Dɔwɔƒelɛta ƒe dzesidenuwoe nye esiwo gbɔna
1. Agbalẽŋlɔla ƒe adrɛsi: Nu siae nye nu gbãtɔ le lɛta la ŋɔŋlɔ me. Ŋlɔ wò adrɛsi 
ɖe agbalẽ la ƒe ɖusikpa dzi le dziƒo. De dzesii be ku ɖe nɔnɔme si me nèdi be lɛta 
la nenɔ ŋu la, àte ŋu aŋlɔ adrɛsi la ɖe agbalẽ la ƒe miakpa dzi le dziƒo.
2.  Ɣletiŋkeke: Esiae nye ŋkeke si nèŋlɔ agbalẽ la.
3. Agbalẽxɔla ƒe adrɛsi: Ŋlɔ agbalẽxɔla ƒe ɖoƒe kple adrɛsi ɖe fli si le wò adrɛsi la 
te le miame.
4. Agoodoƒe: Zã agoododo si dze la (Sukutatɔ bubutɔ, Mɔmefia bubutɔ, Nutodzikpɔla 
bubutɔ, Nuto Sue Dziɖutakpehamenɔla bubutɔ)
5. Nyati la ƒe totoɖeme: To nyati si ŋu nèle nu ƒom le la ɖe eme. Dze agbagba be 
nu si ŋu nèle nu ƒom le la ɖe dzesi le totoɖeme la me.
6. Nuʋuʋu: Ʋu lɛta la nu. Nuʋuʋu la nenɔ kpokploe eye neɖ e susu si ta nèle l ɛta 
la ŋlɔm ɖo la ɖe go.
7. Lɛta la ŋutɔ ŋɔŋlɔ: Nyati ɖe sia ɖe nenɔ nyabo ɖ eka me. Nenye be nyatiwo le 
nyabowo me la, enana be agbalẽxɔla la sea nu siwo nègblɔ la gɔme nyuie.
8. Taƒoƒo: Le lɛta ƒe taƒoƒo la, gbugbɔ nyati siwo ŋu nèƒo nu le la to ɖe eme.
9. Kaklãɖuɖu: Ŋlɔ “Nye” eye nàŋlɔ wò ŋkɔdzesi kple ŋkɔwòwo katã ɖe ete.
Dzesidenya: Le dɔwɔƒelɛtaŋɔŋlɔ me la, ele vevie be nu sia nu me nakɔ eye wòanɔ 
ɖoɖo nu. Kpɔ egbɔ be nya siwo yezã la ɖe bubu fia eye wòz ɔ ɖe ɖoɖo si dze la nu 
le nua ŋɔŋlɔ me kple susu be woate ŋu awɔ dɔ tso wò lɛta la ŋu. Kpɔ egbɔ be yezã 
nyaŋudzesiwo nyuie eye yewɔ ɖe gbeŋlɔsewo dzi nyuie hafi aɖo lɛta la ɖa alo 
atsɔe de asi.

dzodzro kple klase la.
XƆLƆ̃LƐTA
Xɔlɔ̃lɛta nye lɛta siwo míeŋlɔna na mía xɔlɔ̃wo alo míaƒe ƒometɔwo be míagblɔ nu 
siwo le edzi yim le míaƒe agbe me la na wo. Le xɔlɔ̃lɛtaŋɔŋlɔ me la, míedoa gbe na 
ame siwo míele lɛta la ŋlɔm na la. Zi geɖe la, míeŋlɔa xɔlɔ̃lɛta na míaƒe ƒometɔwo 
alo mía xɔlɔ̃wo. Xɔlɔ̃lɛta ƒe dzesidenu aɖewoe nye esiwo gbɔna:
Xɔlɔ̃lɛta ƒe dzesidenuwo
1. Agbalẽŋlɔla ƒe adrɛsi: Ŋlɔ wò adrɛsi la gbã. Ŋlɔ adrɛsi la ɖe agbalẽa ƒe ɖusikpa 
dzi le dziƒo. Esiae nye lɛta la ƒe gɔmedzedze. Ele be nàŋlɔ wò adrɛsi la katã.
2. Ɣletiŋkeke: Ele be nàŋlɔ gbe si gbe nèle lɛta la ŋlɔm la ƒe ɣletiŋkeke la ɖe adrɛsi 
la te.
3. Agoodoƒe: Do agoo na ame si nèle agbalẽ la ŋlɔm na la. Le kpɔɖeŋu me, “Adzo 
lɔlɔ̃a,” “Kɔku lɔlɔ̃a,”.
4. Nuʋuʋu: Gblɔ susu si ta nèle l ɛta la ŋlɔm ɖo la le nyabo gbãt ɔ me. Àte ŋu abia 
xɔ̃wò la ƒe f ɔfɔ ta ase. Àte ŋu agbl ɔ be yeka ɖe edzi be exɔ  wò lɛta la eye wòle 
lãmesẽ me. Ele be wò lɛta la ƒe fli gbãtɔ navivi eye wòalé aɖe.
5. Lɛta la ŋutɔ ŋɔŋlɔ: Ele be gbezazã le l ɛta bliboa ŋɔŋlɔ me nanɔ ko abe ale si 
míeƒoa nu na mía xɔlɔ̃wo ene. Ke hã la, ku ɖe ame si nèle lɛta la ŋlɔm na ŋu la, 
àte ŋu azã nya siwo dze la. Ne xɔ̃wò nèle lɛta la ŋlɔm na la, zã gbe abe ale si nèƒoa 
nu kple xɔ̃wò la ko ene. Ke nenye be ƒometɔ aɖe si tsi wu wòe nèle lɛta la ŋlɔm na 
la, ele be amebubu nadze le wò nuƒo la me.
6. Taƒoƒo: To susu si ta nèle l ɛta la ŋlɔm ɖo la ɖe eme le nyabo mamlɛtɔ me. Ƒo 
lɛta la ta. Do gbe na ame bubu siwo nèganya la to xɔ̃wò la dzi. Kpe ɖe eŋu la, bia 
tso xɔ̃wò la gbɔ be wòaɖo lɛta la ŋu na wò. Esia ɖenɛ fiana be èdi be lɛtaŋɔŋlɔ na 
ame nɔewo la nagayi edzi.

Nuŋlɔɖigɔmeɖeɖe nye gɔmesese si le nuŋlɔɖi aɖe me la gɔme ɖeɖe ɖe gbe bubu

ɖem wole la tututu nanɔ gɔmeɖeɖe si wowɔ la si. Wowɔa gbegbɔgblɔ eve teti ŋu 
dɔ le nuŋlɔɖigɔmeɖeɖe me; gbe si me nuŋlɔɖi la le kple gbe si me wole nuŋlɔɖi la 
gɔme ɖem ɖo la.

me

6. Gɔmeɖeɖe deditɔ didi na nyawo kple nya siwo wogblɔ la ko: Ɖe gɔmesese 
si le nuŋlɔɖi la me la ɖe gbe evelia me. Di gɔmeɖeɖe na nyawo abe ale si wozã 
wo ene. Mègado nya ɖe nya dzi o.
7. Mɔɖaŋuŋutinunyawo zazã: Zã mɔɖaŋuŋutinunya siwo wozãna le gbegɔmeɖeɖe 
me la, nyagɔmeɖ egbalẽ, gbegɔmeɖemɔnu vovovo siwo le intanɛ ti dzi la zazã 
hena nusɔsrɔ̃ – Ele be nàzã nu siawo ɖe ɖoɖo nyuitɔ nu. Menye gɔmeɖeɖe ɖe sia 
ɖe si nàkpɔ le teƒe siawoe nye deditɔ o; ale si wozã nya la le nuŋlɔɖi la me la le 
vevie ŋutɔ.
8. Gbegɔmeɖeɖe la me toto na ame nɔewo kple nutsotsonana: Mito dɔ me na 
mia nɔewo eye miana nutsotso tso wo ŋu.
9. Nuŋlɔɖi tɔxɛwo gɔme ɖeɖe: Yi edzi kple nuŋlɔɖi siwo ku ɖe nu tɔxɛ aɖ ewo 
abe seŋutinyawo, lãmesẽnyawo kple mɔɖaŋutinunyawo ŋu la gɔme ɖeɖe.
10. Nuŋlɔɖi vovovowo gɔme ɖeɖe: Di mɔnukpɔkpɔ si ana be nànɔ 
nuŋlɔɖigɔmeɖeɖe wɔm edziedzi kple susu be nàte ŋu akpɔ tsitsiɖedzi le 
nuŋlɔɖigɔmeɖeɖe me.
Gbegɔmeɖeɖe ƒe Hawo
Gbegɔmeɖeɖe ƒe ha vovovowo li. Wo dometɔ aɖewoe nye.
1. Nyaɖenyanu ƒe gbegɔmeɖeɖe: Enye gbegɔmeɖeɖe si me woɖea nyawo gɔme 
ɖe gɔmesese si le nyawo si ɖekaɖeka la nu. Zi geɖe la, gɔmesese nyuitɔ menɔa 
gbegɔmeɖeɖe sia ƒomevi si o.
2. Gbegɔmeɖeɖe Nyuitɔ: Gbegɔmeɖeɖe si si gɔmesese nyuitɔ  le eye eƒe nyawo 
kple seselelãme sɔna ɖe gbea dolawo ƒe nyawo nu.
3. Gbegɔmeɖeɖe si sɔna ɖe dekɔnu nu: Enye gbegɔmeɖeɖe si me wotrɔa asi le 
nyawo ŋu le aɖaŋutɔ e be wòas ɔ ɖe gbegbɔgblɔ si me wole nuŋlɔɖi aɖe gɔme 
ɖem ɖo la ƒe dekɔnu nu.

wokpɔa egbɔ le be dɔwɔƒewo ƒe ɖoɖo si le nuŋlɔɖi aɖe si gɔme ɖem wole si la

ƒe gɔmesese, seselelãme alo ta ɖodzinu toa vovo tso nuŋlɔɖi si gɔme ɖem wole 
la gbɔ. Wotea ŋu kpea nya ɖe nuŋlɔɖi si gɔme ɖem wole la ŋu alo ɖea nya le 
nuŋlɔɖi si gɔme ɖem wole la me le gbegɔmeɖeɖe sia ƒomevi me.
7. Gbegɔmeɖeɖe akuakua: Gbegɔmeɖeɖe sia ƒomevi ɖea gɔmesese adodoe alo

ƒe taɖodzinu, nuxlẽlawo, nyawo ƒe gɔmeɖeɖe siwo sɔ ɖe wo nɔewo nu, dekɔnu 
ƒe ɖoɖowo kple gbegɔmeɖeɖe ƒe aɖaŋu bubuwo ŋu le gbegɔmeɖeɖe sia ƒomevi 
me.
Gbegɔmeɖeɖe
1. Nyagbe kpokploewo: Ɖe nyagbe kpokploewo me tso gbe ɖeka me yi bubu me. 
Miaƒe susu nenɔ nyawo ƒe dede kple gbeŋutise ŋu.
2. Adaganawo kple lododo: Miɖe adaganawo, lododowo kple nyamenyawo 
gɔme.
3. Nyabo siwo medidi o: Mite nyabo siwo medidi o la gɔme ɖeɖe kpɔ to ŋkuléle 
ɖe gɔmesese kple nuŋlɔɖi la ƒe tutuɖo ŋu me.
4. Nuŋlɔɖi siwo ku ɖe dɔ tɔxɛ aɖewo ŋu: Ɖe nuŋlɔɖi siwo ku ɖe dɔ tɔxɛ aɖewo 
ŋu la me (kpɔɖeŋu: esiwo ku ɖe seŋutinunya, lãmesẽnyawo kple dɔ tɔxɛ bubuwo 
ŋu)
5. Nyadu ŋlɔɖiwo: Srɔ̃ ale si woɖ ea seselelãme, atsiã kple g ɔmesese si le nyadu 
ŋlɔɖiwo me la gɔme ɖeɖe me (kpɔɖeŋu: hakpanya, ŋutinya kpuiwo).
6. Nyadzɔdzɔwo: Srɔ̃ nu siwo dzɔ vavã kple seselelãme si le nuŋlɔɖiwo me la gɔme 
ɖeɖe to nyadzɔdzɔ siwo wode nyadzɔdzɔgbalẽ me la gɔme ɖeɖe me.
7. Dzeɖoɖo: Srɔ̃ nuƒola ƒe susu kple seselelãme si le dzeɖoɖo aɖe me la gɔme ɖeɖe 
to dzeɖoɖowo gɔme ɖeɖe me (kpɔɖeŋu: dzeɖoɖo, gbebiabia amewo).
8. Nuŋlɔɖigɔmeɖeɖesɔsɔ kple ame bubuwo tɔ: Tsɔ nuŋlɔɖigɔmeɖeɖe siwo nèwɔ 
la sɔ kple ame bubuwo tɔ (kpɔɖeŋu: gbegɔmeɖela adodoewo tɔ, gbegɔmeɖeɖe 
si wowɔ kple mɔɖaŋuwo la) be aɖaŋu siwo le asiwò la natsi ɖe edzi.
9. Ame ŋutɔ ƒe nuŋlɔɖi gɔme ɖeɖe: Ŋlɔ  nu tso nane ŋu eye nà ɖe egɔme ɖe gbe 
bubu me. Esia wɔwɔ ana nàsrɔ̃ ale si woɖea nuŋlɔɖi gɔme wòkɔna eye gɔmesese 
si le gbe gbãtɔ me la nɔa evelia me.

The Environment
In our modern world, there are many factors that place the well-being of the planet 
in jeopardy. While some people have the opinion that environmental problems are 
just a natural occurrence, others believe that human beings have a huge impact on 
the environment. Regardless of your viewpoint, take into consideration the following 
factors that place our environment as well as the planet Earth in danger.
Global warming or climate change is a major contributing factor to environmental 
damage. Because of global warming, we have seen an increase in melting ice caps, a 
rise in sea levels, and the formation of new weather patterns. These weather patterns 
have caused stronger storms, droughts, and flooding in places where they formerly 
did not occur.
Air pollution is primarily caused as a result of excessive and unregulated emissions 
of carbon dioxide into the air. Pollutants mostly emerge from the burning of fossil 
fuels, in addition to chemicals, toxic substances, and improper waste disposal. Air 
pollutants are absorbed into the atmosphere, and they can cause smog, a combination 
of smoke and fog, in valleys as well as produce acidic precipitation in areas far 
away from the pollution source.
In many areas, people and local governments do not sustainably use their natural 
resources. Mining for natural gases, deforestation, and even improper use of water 
resources can have tremendous effects on the environment. While these strategies 
often attempt to boost local economies, their effects can lead to oil spills, interrupted 
animal habitats, and droughts.
Ultimately, the effects of the modern world on the environment can lead to many 
problems. Human beings need to consider the repercussions of their actions, trying to

NUƲUƲU
Akpa sia dzro sr ɔ̃ɖeɖe me abe nuɖoanyi kple dekɔnuwɔna ene. Eku ɖe nu si 
dekɔnusrɔ̃ɖeɖe kple srɔ̃ɖekɔnuwo nye, srɔ̃ɖeɖe ƒe hawo kple srɔ̃ɖeɖe ƒe vevinyenye

si nàsrɔ̃ le akpa sia ŋu la ana be  nàse srɔ̃ɖeɖe le miaƒe dekɔnu nu kple sr ɔ̃ɖeɖe le

nu kple egbeŋkuʋuʋu ƒe wɔna siwo le dɔ wɔm ɖe srɔ̃ɖeɖe dzi la me. Wò nunya tso 
miaƒe dekɔnusrɔ̃ɖeɖe kple dekɔnu bubuwo ƒe srɔ̃ɖeɖe ŋu akpe ɖe ŋuwò be nàse wo 
gɔme nyuie. Àse dek ɔnuléle ɖe te, dekɔnufiafia kple degbenɔnɔ nyuiwo dodo ɖe 
ŋgɔ ƒe vevinyenye me nyuie.

akpatogoe le kɔnu si woyɔna be ‘Fotoyeli’ la me. Kɔnu si kplɔa esia ɖo lae nye 
tabianuwo nana si woyɔna be ‘Gbalaniihamɔ’. Kɔnu mamlɛa si wowɔna lae nye 
‘Yookpeemɔ’. Esia nye sr ɔ̃ ŋutɔ ɖeɖe. Woyɔa nyɔnu si to kɔnu sia me la be ‘Boi 
Ekpaa Yoo’ (avɔ kpofa ade nyɔnu).
Srɔ̃ɖekɔnu le Fantitɔwo dome
Le Fantiawo dome la, vifofoe ɖea sr ɔ̃ na via ŋutsu. Ne vifofo kpɔ be ye vi la tsi 
aɖe srɔ̃ la, eƒlea tu nɛ be wòatsɔ anɔ ade dam. Kpe ɖe esia ŋu la, enaa anyigbae be 
wòatsɔ ade agble. Woɖea xɔ nu na ɖekakpui la. Ne vifofo wɔ esia na via ŋutsu la 
vɔ la, efia be edi be yeana be ye vi la nanɔ eɖokui si eye wòdze aɖe srɔ̃. Wonɔa anyi 
kple ɖekakpui la ɖoa dze kplii ku ɖe srɔ̃ɖeɖe ŋu. Nenye be ɖetugbi aɖe le ta me na 
ɖekakpui la ŋutɔ xoxo la, wodoa egɔme hebiana tso edzilawo si be yewoaɖee na 
yewo vi la. Ɣe aɖewo ɣi la, vifofo dia nyɔnu na via hebia edzilawo be woaɖe mɔ 
yeaɖee na ye vi la.
Nenye be nyɔnuƒomea se nya sia la, wodzea nugɔmekuku tso ŋutsuƒomea ŋu. Ne 
nyɔnuƒomea wu nugɔmekukua nu vɔ la, woɖoa du ɖe ŋutsuƒomea be woava ɖe 
yewo vi la. Le sr ɔ̃ɖeɖea me la, ŋutsuƒomea naa ga alo nanewo ɖe nyɔnu la ta. 
Wotsɔa ga kple nu bubu siwo gbɔna tsɔ biaa ɖetugbi la ta.
1. “Nhun enyim nsa”: Enye aha si ŋutsuƒomea nana nyɔnuƒomea tsɔna nana 
woanyana be yewoadi be yewoaɖe wo vi nyɔnu la. Hafi nyɔnuƒomea naxɔ 
aha sia la, wobiaa gbe ɖetugbi la nenye be yewoaxɔ aha loo alo yewomaxɔe o 
mahã. Nenye be elɔ̃ be woaxɔe la, wononɛ si ɖenɛ fiana be yewolɔ̃ ɖe srɔ̃ɖeɖe 
la dzi. Tsã la, wowɔa kɔnu sia le Memliɖagbe. Woxɔe se be Memliɖagbe nye 
Mawu ƒe ŋkeke eye wònye ŋutifafaŋkeke aɖe. Wogayɔa aha sia be “yoo/nyew/
akwanserɛ/kwanto nsa no”.
2. “Pon ekyir/kɔkɔɔkɔ”: Kɔnu evelia si wowɔna lae nye kɔkɔkɔ (ʋɔƒoƒo). Tsã la, 
wozãa sinapu atukpa ɖeka kple ga home sue aɖe abe ʋɔƒoga ene.
3. “Bɔwdo-toa”: Esia nye ga si wonaa nyɔnu la fofo ɖe fu siwo katã wòkpe ɖe via 
ta la. Tsã la, wotsɔa ga kple sinapu na nyɔnudzilawo be woatsɔ ado dzidzɔ ɖe

ŋutsu bubuwo ƒe zɔzɔme ŋu.
Ne wowɔ kɔnu siawo katã vɔ la, woɖea gbeƒã be tso gbe ma gbe dzi la, nyɔnu la le

woava aɖu nu la. Le zã me la, wokplɔa nyɔnu la yia srɔ̃a ƒe aƒe me. Esia fia be woƒe

Srɔ̃ɖeɖe le Dagombatɔwo dome
Nu siwo gbɔna la nye ɖoƒe siwo le srɔ̃ɖeɖe me le Dagombatɔwo dome le Ghana.
Paɣa laɣibu: Esia nye ahiãw ɔwɔ si yia edzi le ŋutsu kple nyɔnu dome. Le ɖoƒe 
sia la, ne ŋutsu la ɖee fia be yedi be yeaɖe nyɔnua la, enaa ga aɖe nyɔnu la abe 
dzeside ene. Ne nyɔnu la xɔ ga si wonɛ la, efia be elɔ̃ ɖe edzi be yeaɖe ŋutsu la. Ɣe 
aɖewo ɣi la, nyɔnu la tea ŋu xɔa ga la eye wòbiana be woana ɣeyiɣi aɖe ye yeatsɔ 
abu ta me le srɔ̃ɖenya la ŋu. Emegbe la, ŋutsu la trɔna yina ɖakpɔna ɖa be nyɔnu 
la lɔ̃ ɖe srɔ̃ɖenya la dzi mahã. Kpuie ko la, ɖoƒe siae wodaa asi ɖe srɔ̃ɖeɖe la dzi le.
Tibili yoobu: Ɖoƒe siae nye ʋɔƒoƒo kple ŋutsu sr ɔ̃ɖela la ɖeɖe fia nyɔnu la ƒe 
ƒometɔwo. Ŋutsu sr ɔ̃ɖela la ɖea eɖokui fiana hegblɔa sr ɔ̃ɖenya la na nyɔnu la 
dzilawo.

Dekɔnudziɖuɖu
NUƲUƲU
Wotu akpa sia ɖe hlɔ̃ kple dekɔnudziɖuɖu siwo ŋu nu le le ƒe gbãtɔ me la dzi. Akpa 
sia gale mɔnukpɔkpɔ bubu nam wò be nàgadzro hlɔ̃ kple dekɔnudziɖuɖu siwo le 
gbegblɔha vovovo siwo le Ghana la me. Àlé ŋku ɖe hlɔ̃ siwo le Ghana la kple woƒe 
vevinyenyewo ŋu eye nàtsɔ wo asɔ kple esiwo le gbegblɔha bubuwo dome la. Wò 
nunya kple gɔmesese ku ɖe hlɔ̃ kple dekɔnudziɖuɖu ŋu le vevie ŋutɔ elabena adzi wò 
nunya ɖe edzi kple susu be nàte ŋu aɖu tu na Eʋegbe kple nusɔsrɔ̃ bubu siwo do ka 
kplii abe Subɔsubɔŋutinusɔsrɔ̃, Blemanyawo ŋuti Nusɔsrɔ̃ kple bubuawo ene. Nunya si 
asu asiwò la akpe ɖe ŋuwò be nàse mia de hlɔ̃wo kple dekɔnudziɖuɖu kpakple esiwo 
le gbegblɔha bubu siwo le Ghana la dome me nyuie.
NYATI VEVIWO
Hlɔ̃ nye ame siwo dome ʋukadodo le la.  Enye ƒome vovovo siwo katã nye tɔgbui ɖeka 
ƒe dzidzimevi siwo ŋu tɔgbuiŋkɔ ɖeka le la. Dzesidenuwo le hlɔ̃ ɖe sia ɖe si. Dzesidenu 
siawo tea ŋu nyea nane alo nu gbagbe aɖe si dea dzesi hlɔ̃ aɖe me tɔwo la. Ame siwo nɔa 
hlɔ̃metɔwo nu lae nye hlɔ̃tatɔwo.

Hlɔ̃ nye ame siwo dome ʋukadodo aɖe le eye wonye tɔgbui ɖeka ƒe viwo la. Enye 
ƒome vovovo siwo tɔa tɔgbuiŋkɔ ɖeka eye tatɔ ɖeka nɔa wo si la. Nɔnɔme, taɖodzinu 
alo didi ɖeka nɔa wo si. Ame si hlɔ̃metɔwo tiana be wòanɔ yewo nu lae nye hlɔ̃tatɔ. 
Nɔnɔme si nɔa ame aɖe si hafi wotsɔnɛ ɖoa hlɔ̃tatɔ la to vovo tso nuto ɖeka gbɔ yi 
bubu gbɔ. Le nuto aɖewo me la, ƒometatɔwoe tiaa hl ɔ̃tatɔ la, ke le nuto bubuwo 
me la, amewo nyia ɖoƒe sia ƒe dome. Hlɔ̃wo le Afrika dukɔ aɖewo abe Ghana ene 
la me. Le blemanyatotowo nu la, hlɔ̃wo le teƒe vovovowo le xexea me godoo.
Hlɔ̃ ƒe dzesidenuwo
Hlɔ̃ ƒe dzesidenu vevitɔ aɖewoe nye:
1. Tɔgbui ɖeka ƒe dzidzimeviwo : Hlɔ ɖeka me tɔwo nyea tɔgbui ɖeka ƒe 
dzidzimeviwo.
2. Ʋukadodo: Ʋukadodo nɔa hlɔ̃ ɖeka me tɔwo dome.
3. Dzeside tɔxɛ: Dzeside tɔxɛwo abe ŋkɔwo, nutsitsriwo, dzesiwo kple kɔnyinyiwo 
ene le hlɔ̃ ɖeka me tɔwo si.
4. Hamenuwɔna: Hadomenɔnɔ ƒe kadodo sesẽ aɖewo le hlɔ̃ ɖeka me tɔwo dome 
eye wowɔa ɖeka.
5. Nunɔlawo ƒe kɔkɔnunɔnɔ: Nunɔlawo le hlɔ̃ ɖe sia ɖe si. Wole kɔkɔ vovovowo 
nu eye wowɔa ɖoɖo na hlɔ̃metɔwo.
6. Dekɔnu ɖeka me tɔwo nyenye ƒe dzeside : Degbenɔnɔ kple dekɔnuwɔna 
tɔxɛwo le hlɔ̃wo si. Kɔnu tɔxɛwo le wo si.
7. Ɖekawɔwɔ le gakpɔmɔnunyawo me: Hlɔ̃metɔwo kpɔa gome le anyigba kple 
nunɔamesi bubuwo me.
8. Kɔnuwɔwɔ: Hlɔ̃metɔwo kpɔa gome le kɔnu ɖeka ƒomeviwo abe tsitsimekɔnuwo, 
srɔ̃ɖekɔnuwo, kukɔnuwo kple kɔnu bubuwo ene wɔwɔ me.
Hlɔ̃ ƒe Vevinyenye
Hlɔ̃ ƒe wɔƒe le vevie le dekɔnu kple ameha vovovowo dome tso blema ke abe ale si 
wodzro eme le afi sia ene.
1. Hamenuwɔwɔ: Hl ɔ̃ nye mɔnu si ƒoa ƒu amewo ɖe hatsotso aɖe me. Emaa 
amewo ɖe hatsotso vivivi siwo dome kadodo le la me.
2. Ʋukadodo: Ʋukadodo le hlɔ̃metɔwo dome si dzia ɖekawɔwɔ, nuteƒewɔwɔ kple 
alɔdodo hlɔ̃metɔwo ƒe wɔnawo ɖe edzi.
3. Dzeside kple kadodo: Dzeside ɖeka nɔa hlɔ̃metɔwo ŋu si wɔnɛ be kadodo nɔa 
ame siwo dzɔ tso dzidzime ɖeka me eye woƒe dekɔnu kple domenyinuwo nye 
ɖeka la dome.
4. Ɖekawɔwɔ kple alɔdodo: Hlɔ̃wo nana be hlɔ̃metɔwo wɔa ɖeka eye wodoa alɔ 
wo nɔewo le hiahiãwo abe agbledede, ame nɔewo ta ʋiʋli alo masɔmasɔɖeɖe ɖa 
ene ƒe ɣeyiɣiwo me.

nutsitsriwo ŋu kple ale si wowɔa dɔ ɖe mia dzi la me.
Nuwɔna 7�5 Nugɔmekuku tso hlɔ̃wo ŋu
Wɔ nugɔmekuku tso hlɔ̃wo kple woƒe nutsitsri siwo dze le tata si va yi dzi la 
dometɔ si nàtia la ŋu. Di hlɔ̃ la me tɔwo ƒe nudodowo ƒe nɔnɔmetatawo, viɖio 
siwo ku ɖe hlɔ̃ la me tɔwo ƒe numeɖeɖe tso woƒe kɔnuwo ŋu kple nuƒoƒo na 
hlɔ̃metɔwo tso woƒe nuteƒekpɔkpɔwo ŋu.
Nuwɔnawo 7�6 Hlɔ̃ ƒe Wɔƒewo
Wotia wò be nànye hlɔ̃tatɔ. Ɖe nu etɔ̃ aɖe siwo nàwɔ be ɖekawɔwɔ nanɔ 
hlɔ̃metɔwo dome la me. Ɖe wò susu gblɔ na wò nusrɔ̃hatiwo hena klase la ƒe 
numedzodzro.
DEKƆNUDZIƉUƉU ƑE NƆNƆME
Dekɔnudziɖuɖu ƒe nɔnɔme nye ɖoɖo si nu tatɔwo ƒe dɔdeasiwo kple ɖoɖowɔwɔ ƒe 
ŋusẽ le tso ɖoƒe kɔkɔtɔ dzi va se ɖe suetɔ dzi si wozãna le duwo, dɔwɔnawo, dziɖuɖu 
kple dɔwɔƒe bubuwo me la.
Dekɔnudziɖuɖu ƒe Nɔnɔme
Nu siwo gbɔna la nye dekɔnudziɖuɖu ƒe nɔnɔmewo dometɔ aɖewo:
1. Gbeɖeɖe ƒe zɔzɔme: Gbeɖeɖe tsoa ɖoƒe kɔkɔtɔ dzi yia ɖoƒe suetɔ dzi eye 
dɔdeasi tɔxɛ le ɖoƒe ɖe sia ɖe si.
2. Dɔmegãwo ƒe ɖoɖowɔwɔ: Dɔmegãwo wɔa ɖoɖo veviwo.
3. Dɔwɔƒe ƒe akpa vovovowo : Womaa dɔwɔƒe la ɖe akpa vovovowo me eye 
dɔdeasi alo wɔƒe tɔxɛ le akpa ɖe sia ɖe si wòwɔna.
89

Ƒe eveliaAKPA 7LIA
4. Ŋusẽkpɔkpɔ ɖe dɔwɔlawo dzi: Dɔwɔla siwo mesɔ gbɔ o la nɔa dɔ megã ƒe 
kpɔkplɔ te
5. Nyatakaka: Nyatakaka toa teƒe siwo dze la ɖoa dɔwɔlawo gbɔ.
6. Wɔƒewo kple dɔdeasiwo: Woŋlɔa dɔdeasiwo kple nu siwo wɔwɔ wokpɔ mɔ na 
tso ame aɖe gbɔ la wo me kɔna nyuie.
7. Nuwo ƒe kɔkɔnunɔnɔ: Dɔdzikpɔkpɔ ƒe ɖoƒe vovovowo li tso dɔmegãwo ƒe ɖoƒe 
kɔkɔtɔwo dzi va se ɖe ɖoƒe suetɔwo dzi.
Dekɔnudziɖuɖu ƒe Nɔnɔme ƒe Tata
Nuʋuʋu ƒe wɔna
1. Minɔ hatsotsowo me eye miagbugbɔ dekɔnudziɖuɖu ƒe ɖoƒe siwo gbɔna la aɖo 
ɖe ɖoɖo nu tso ŋusẽ si le wo si la ƒe kɔkɔtɔ dzi va se ɖe suetɔ dzi abe ale si wole 
le miaƒe nutowo me ene.
tofiawo - dumegãwo - fiagãwo - dufiawo - fiatɔwo
2. Ɖoƒeawo ɖoɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu ate ŋu anɔ abe esi gbɔna la ƒe nɔnɔme ene:
fiagãwo→ dufiawo →tofiawo→ fiatɔwo→ dumegãwo
3. Woate ŋu ayɔ ɖoƒe siwo nègbugbɔ ɖo ɖe ɖoɖo nu la be dekɔnudziɖuɖu ƒe ɖoƒewo 
ƒe kɔkɔnunɔnɔ ƒe nɔnɔme.
Dekɔnudziɖuɖu ƒe nɔnɔme ƒe tata nye tata si ɖea nɔnɔme si le dɔwɔƒe aɖe ƒe 
ɖoƒewo si la fiana. Eɖea kɔkɔnunɔnɔ ƒe kadodo siwo le dɔ megãwo kple wo teviwo 
dome la fiana.
Fifia la, mina míalé ŋku dekɔnudziɖuɖu ƒe nɔnɔme ƒe tata ƒe kpɔɖeŋu si gbɔna la ŋu:
Tata 7�4: Dekɔnudziɖuɖu ƒe kɔkɔnunɔnɔ ƒe tata

Abe ale si wòdze le dekɔnudziɖuɖu ƒe kɔkɔnunɔnɔ ƒe tata la dzi ene la, fiag ãe nye 
kɔkɔtɔ kekeake eye dufiawo, tofiawo, fiatɔwo, hl ɔ̃tatɔwo kple ƒometatɔwo kplɔe 
ɖo.
Dekɔnudziɖula siwo kat ã le dekɔnudziɖuɖu ƒe kɔkɔnunɔnɔ ƒe tata dzi la ƒe 
wɔƒewo kple dɔdeasiwo li wowɔna ku ɖe ɖoƒe siwo wole le kɔkɔnunɔnɔ me la ŋu. 
Dekɔnudziɖulawo kple woƒe dɔdeasiwo dometɔ aɖewoe nye esiwo gbɔna.
Fiagãwo
Fiagãwo nye fia alo ame siwo ɖu du vovovo siwo ƒo ƒu wɔ nuto ɖeka la dzi la. 
Wonye tatɔ kɔkɔtɔ kekeakewo na du vovovowo ƒe fiawo. Zi geɖ e la, fiagãwo nyia 
fiaɖuɖu la ƒe dome le tɔgome alo nɔgome ku ɖe dome si ƒomevi wonyina le nutoa 
me la ŋu. Wotiaa fiagãwo tso hlɔ̃ si me tɔwo ɖua fia la dome. Zi geɖe la, wokplɔ a 
fiagãwo toa kɔnu vevi aɖewo me hafi ɖoa wo zi dzi. Le nuto siwo me woɖua nɔnu 
le la, fiagã la ate ŋu anye nyɔnu (nyɔnufia).
Fiagã ƒe Wɔƒewo
Fiagã ƒe wɔƒewoe nye esiwo gbɔna:
1. Enye kplɔla na nuto blibo la.
2. Ewɔa ɖoɖo vevi siwo aɖe vi na nutoa la.
3. Enɔa ŋgɔ le dezãɖuɖu kple kɔnuwo wɔwɔ me.
4. Ekpɔa egbɔ be wowɔ ɖe sewo dzi.
5. Ekpɔ ŋusẽ ɖe zitenyigbawo dzi.
6. Ekpɔa dekɔnuwɔnawo ƒe dedinɔnɔ ta.
7. Ehea ŋgɔyiyi vana na eteviwo.
8. Edrɔ̃a nya eye wòw ɔa ɖoɖo ɖe dunyawo kple gakpɔmɔnunyawo ŋu le nutoa 
me.
9. Ewɔa kɔnu siwo ku ɖe fiazikpui la ŋu la.
10. Edea se tso wɔna aɖewo ŋu.
Dufiawo/Tofiawo
Wonye fia siwo le fia bubuwo te la. Dufiawo le fiagãwo te eye tofiawo le dufiawo te. 
Dufiawo kple tofiawo ɖua fia ɖe duwo kple kɔƒewo dzi.
Dufiawo/Tofiawo ƒe Wɔƒewo
1. Dufia wɔa dɔ ɖe fiagã teƒe nenye be exaxa.
2. Ekpɔa egbɔ be yetsi hlɔ̃dodo kple nu gbegblẽ wɔwɔ bubuwo nu le yeƒe fiaɖuƒe la.
91
HLƆ̃WO KPLE DEKƆNUDZIƉUƉU
Ƒe eveliaAKPA 7LIA
3. Edrɔ̃a nya na amewo.
4. Ekpɔa zitenyigbawo ƒe dedinɔnɔ ta.
5. Ekpɔa egbɔ be tomefafa le yeƒe fiaɖuƒe la.
6. Ewɔa kɔnu siwo ku ɖe fiazikpui la ŋu eye wònɔa ŋgɔ le guɖeɖe le anyigba la ŋu 
ƒe kɔnuwo wɔwɔ me, ne ehiã.
7. Ŋusẽ blibo le wo si be woakpɔ anyigba/zitenyigba siwo le woƒe dzikpɔkpɔ te la 
ƒe dedinɔnɔ ta.
8. Woɖua ameha tɔxɛ aɖewo dzi.
9. Wokpea asi ɖe ɖoɖowo me dɔ wɔwɔ ŋu eye wonaa nutsotso fiagãwo.
Tofiawo le hatsotso vovovowo me abe ale si woƒo nu tso wo ŋu le afi sia ene
Miafiawo
Miafiawo nye fia na aʋalɔgo siwo le miame la (miameʋalɔgowo) eye wonye 
tatɔwo na ameha siwo nɔa fiagã la ƒe miame le ƒuƒoƒewo abe dutoƒotakpekpewɔƒewo, 
dekɔnuʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒewo kple aʋawɔɣiwo la ene.
Ɖusifiawo
Ɖusifiawo nye fia na aʋalɔgo siwo le ɖusime la (ɖusimeʋalɔgowo) eye wonye tatɔwo 
na ameha siwo nɔ a fiagã la ƒe ɖusime le ƒuƒoƒewo abe dutoƒotakpekpewɔƒewo, 
dekɔnuʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒewo kple aʋawɔɣiwo la ene.
Fia eveawo wɔa wɔƒe veviwo le dekɔnudziɖuɖu me le míaƒe duwo me eye wowɔa 
dɔdeasi siwo gbɔna la:
1. Wokpena ɖe fiagãwo ŋu le ɖoɖowɔwɔ kple dudziɖuɖu ƒe dɔdeasi bubuwo wɔwɔ 
me.
2. Woawoe nye tatɔwo na ameha siwo nɔa mia kple ɖusime na fiagã la.
3. Woɖoa aɖaŋu na fiagã la eye wofiaa afɔɖoƒe hãe.
4. Woɖea dzre kpe masɔmasɔwo ɖa le amewo dome eye wokpɔa egbɔ  be ŋutifafa 
le dua me eye wòle tenu.
5. Wowɔa wɔƒe veviwo le fiaɖoɖo kple fiaɖeɖe le zi dzi ƒe kɔnuwo wɔwɔ me.
6. Wozãa anyigbawo ɖe ɖoɖo nu eye wodrɔ̃a anyigbanyawo heɖea masɔmasɔwo ɖa.
Aʋadada
Enye aʋalɔgoawo ƒe tatɔ. Eyae nɔa ŋgɔ le aʋagbe dzi eye wòɖea gbe na aʋalɔgoawo.
92

Ƒe eveliaAKPA 7LIA
Aʋadadawo ƒe Dɔdeasiwo
1. Woawoe nye aʋalɔgoawo ƒe gbeɖelawo eye wonɔa ŋgɔ le nutoa ta ʋiʋli me le 
aʋaŋɔliwo alo ɣeyiɣi siwo me ʋunyaʋunya aɖe do mo.
2. Wokpɔa egbɔ be dumeviwo wɔ ɖe se kple ɖoɖowo dzi, kpɔa nutoa ƒe dedinɔnɔ 
ta tso futɔwo si me eye wokpɔa egbɔ be dumeviwo le dedie.
3. Wotea ŋu nɔa fiagãwo teƒe le nya vevi aɖewo dɔdrɔ̃, nugbidodo alo masɔmasɔwo 
ɖeɖe ɖa me.
Nyɔnufiawo
Nyɔnufiawo nye tatɔ siwo kpɔa nyɔnuwo ƒe gbɔgbɔmenyawo dzi le wo deduwo 
me eye woléa woƒe dekɔnuŋutinunya si tso dzidzime yi dzidzime la ɖe te. Wowɔa 
wɔƒe veviwo le beléle na nyɔnuwo kple nyɔnuviwo me eye wokpɔa woƒe dedinɔnɔ 
hã ta le woƒe duwo me. Le gbegblɔha siwo ɖua nɔnu gome la, nyɔnufiawoe daa asi 
ɖe ame si fiaƒome la tia na fiaɖuɖu la dzi. Wotea ŋu tiaa nyɔnufia bubu siwo le wo 
te la be wowɔa dɔ kpli wo.
Nyɔnufiawo ƒe wɔƒewo
1. Wokpea asi ɖe fiawo ŋu le dekɔnudziɖuɖu ƒe dɔdeasiwo wɔwɔ me.
2. Wodrɔ̃a nya siwo katã ku ɖe nyɔnuwo kple ɖetugbiwo ŋu le woƒe nutowo me la.
3. Wonye ame siwo hea tɔtrɔ vɛ le nyɔnuwo ƒe gomekpɔkpɔwo ƒe nyawo dodo ɖe 
ŋgɔ kple nutoa ƒe ŋgɔyinyawo me la.
4. Wofiaa dekɔnuwo kple blemanya siwo ku ɖe nyɔnuwo kple ɖetugbiwo ŋu la 
wo.
5. Wowɔa kɔnu siwo ku ɖe fufɔfɔ kple vidzidzi ŋu la na ɖetugbiwo.
6. Wokpɔa egbɔ be ŋutifafa le dua me eye nuwo dze edzi na dumeviwo.
Trɔ̃nua
Trɔ̃nua nye tatɔ na mía deduwo le gbɔgbɔmenyawo me. Eyae daa gbe le amewo ŋu 
eye wònye kadodo si nɔa dumeviwo kple gbɔgbɔwo dome.
Trɔ̃nua ƒe Dɔdeasiwo
1. Wowɔa dɔ abe fiawo ene le du siwo me fiawo mele o la.
2. Wofiaa afɔɖoƒe amewo tso gbɔgbɔmenyawo ŋu le nutoa me.
3. Wowɔa kɔnuwo le azãɖuƒewo, dutoƒotakpekpewo, ƒuƒoƒewo kpe ɖe fiaɖoɖo alo 
fiaɖeɖe le zi dzi ƒe kɔnuwo ŋu.
4. Woɖea drɔ̃ewo kple ŋutegawo gɔme eye wodia gbɔgbɔmeŋuɖoɖo na esiwo ate 
ŋu ahe dzɔgbevɔ̃ewo vɛ la.
93

5. Woléa woƒe nutowo ƒe dekɔnuwo, kɔnuwo kple degbenɔnɔ ɖe te.
6. Wokpɔa amewo ƒe gbɔgbɔmenyawo gbɔ.
Fiatɔwo
Wonye ame siwo kpɔa fiaɖoɖo dzi eye wowɔa wɔƒe geɖewo le fiaɖoɖo me. Fiatɔwo 
meɖua fia o. Wodoa go hedea ŋugble tso ame si woaɖo fiae la ŋu.
Fiatɔwo ƒe wɔƒewo
1. Wotiaa ame si aɖu fia la.
2. Wowɔa kukɔnuwo na fia si yi kɔƒe la.
3. Wotea ŋu ɖea afɔkpa le afɔ na fia alo ɖea fia le fia la dzi.
4. Woɖea ame si wotia be wòaɖu fia la fiaa dumegãwo kple dumeviwo.
5. Woɖoa aɖaŋu na fia la.
6. Wodrɔ̃a nya le dumeviwo dome.
7. Wonɔa ŋgɔ na fiaɖoɖo na dua.
8. Woléa ŋku ɖe ame siwo woaɖo fiae la ŋu nyuie akpɔ ɖ a be wodze mahã hafi  
ɖoa wo.
Tsiami
Tsiami nye ame si ƒe ŋusẽ kpl ɔ fia tɔ ɖo le dekɔnudziɖuɖ u me eye wòw ɔa wɔƒe 
geɖewo le dua me. Tsiami ƒe wɔƒewo tea ŋu toa vovo tso teƒe yi teƒe ku ɖe amehawo 
ƒe dekɔnu kple degbenɔnɔ ŋu. Tsiamiwo ƒe wɔƒe vevi aɖewoe nye esiwo gbɔna.
1. Woawoe nye fia ƒe nyanuɖelawo; efia be woawo dzi fia tona ƒoa nu na eteviwo.
2. Wonɔa ŋgɔ na fia la ne wozɔ yina ɖe dutoƒotakpekpewo, azãɖuƒewo kple ƒuƒoƒe 
bubuwo.
3. Woƒoa nu ɖe fia nu.
4. Wotsɔa fiatikplɔ ɖe asi na fia la.
5. Wogblɔa amedzrowo ƒe gbedeasi na fia la eye wogblɔa fia la ƒe gbedeasi na 
amedzrowo.
Nuwɔna 7�7 Dekɔnudziɖuɖu ƒe nɔnɔme ƒe tata
Ɖe dekɔnudziɖuɖu ƒe nɔnɔme kple kadodo si le dekɔnudziɖulawo dome le mia 
de la fia le numeɖeɖe ƒe tata si le kɔkɔ nu la dzi. Tsɔ miaƒe dekɔnudziɖuɖu ƒe 
nɔnɔme ƒe tata la sɔ kple wò nusrɔ̃hati siwo tso du bubuwo me la tɔ.

Nuwɔna 7�8 Dekɔnudziɖulawo ƒe wɔƒewo
1. Minɔ eveve miaxlẽ nuŋlɔɖi kpui si gbɔna la, eye miade dzesi dekɔnudziɖula 
siwo gbɔna la ƒe wɔƒewo le nyadɔdrɔ̃ me.
a. fiagã
b. tofiawo
c. hlɔ̃tatɔwo
d. dumegãwo
2. Migblɔ miaƒe ŋuɖoɖo la na klase la be woadzro eme.
Le fiaɖuƒe sue aɖe si le Aŋlɔnyigba dzi le Amugã Nutoa me le Ghana dukɔa me 
la, masɔmasɔ aɖe ge ɖe agbledela aɖe si ŋkɔe nye Kofitsɛ kple tɔɖiyɔvia ƒe vi 
si nye Agbeko la dome. Kofitsɛ tsɔ nya ɖe Agbeko ŋu be ege ɖe ƒomenyigba si 
wotsɔ na ye be yenetu xɔ ɖe edzi la me. Agbeko hã be ye fofo si trɔ megbe lae tsɔ 
anyigba la na ye. Kofitsɛ kple Agbeko ƒe hlɔ̃tatɔ do go wo be yease nya la gɔme 
nyuie, gake mekpɔ ta na nya la o. Eya ta woƒe fiagã la yɔ ƒometakpekpe kple 
susu be woaɖe masɔmasɔ sia ɖa le ƒomea me. Emegbe la, wobia tso hlɔ̃tatɔ kple 
eƒe ametsitsiawo si be woawɔ nugɔmekuku tso ame si tɔ anyigba si le ʋiʋlia dom 
la nye la ŋu. Tofiawo kple woƒe dumegãwo di amewo ɖe nya la ŋu be yewoadrɔ̃ 
hena masɔmasɔ la ɖeɖe ɖa.
Nuwɔna 7�9 Dekɔnudziɖulawo ƒe wɔƒewo
Ame aɖewo gblɔna be ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ kple masɔmasɔwo ɖeɖe ɖa le duwo me nɔ 
bɔbɔe le dekɔnudziɖulawo ƒe kpɔkplɔ te le blema wu ale si wole le egbeŋkekewo 
me le egbeŋkuʋuʋu ƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒewo.
Minɔ eveve eye miaɖe miaƒe susuwo agblɔ tso nyati sia ŋu ahagblɔ miaƒe 
ŋuɖoɖo la na klase la hena emedzodzro.
Nuwɔna 7�10 Dekɔnudziɖuɖu
“Dekɔnudziɖuɖu nye dukpɔkplɔmɔnu si megahiã fifia o.” Minɔ miaƒe hatsotsowo 
me eye miatso nyahenyadu ade nyati sia dzi alo atsi tsitre ɖe eŋu. Migblɔ miaƒe 
ŋuɖoɖo la na klase la hena emedzodzro.
Nuwɔna 7�11 Dziɖuɖumɔnu eve sɔsɔ ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu
Minɔ hatsotsowo me miahe nya le vovototo si le dekɔnudziɖuɖu ƒe vevinyenye 
kple egbeŋkuʋuʋu ƒe dziɖuɖu ƒe vevinyenyewo dome la ŋu. Le kpɔɖeŋu me, 
le ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ƒe nyawo gome abe ale si miedzro eme le nuwɔna 7.9lia me ene.

NUMEDZROBIABIAWO 7�1

2. Ŋlɔ hlɔ̃ siwo le miaƒe nuto me la dometɔ atɔ̃ ƒe ŋkɔwo kple woƒe nutsitsriwo

NUMEDZROBIABIAWO 7�2

NUƲUƲU
Akpa sia ƒo nu tso dekɔnuʋɔnudɔdr ɔ̃ kple egbeŋkuʋuʋu ƒe ʋɔnudɔdr ɔ̃ ƒe mɔnuwo 
ŋu. Edzro ɖoɖo siwo nu ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe eveawo drɔ̃a nya ɖo kple woƒe dɔdeasiwo me. 
Le nusɔsrɔ̃a me la, àts ɔ ɖoɖo siwo nu ʋɔnudr ɔ̃ƒe eveawo dr ɔ̃a nya ɖo la asɔ kple 
wo nɔewo, ade dzesi sɔsɔminasɔe kple vovototo siwo le wo dome la kple susu be 
nàte ŋu atso nya me le ɖokuiwò si. Wò nunya kple gɔmesese tso dekɔnuʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ 
kple ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ le egbeŋkuʋuʋu ƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒewo ŋu ado ŋusẽ wò be nàkpɔ gome le 
dukɔmeviwo ƒe susuɖeɖe gblɔ tso dukplɔnyawo ŋu kple wò gomekpɔkpɔ le wo me 
me. Agakpe ɖe ŋuwò abe ame ɖeka ene be nàtu wò ta me deto bubu kple ŋkuléle ɖe 
nu ŋu tsitotsito ƒe aɖaŋuwo ɖe edzi hena ɖoɖo nyuitɔwo wɔwɔ eye nàzu dukɔmevi 
si nya nu tso nu geɖewo ŋu la le esime nèle nu srɔ̃m tso wò gomekpɔkpɔwo kple 
dɔdeasiwo abe dukɔmevi ene la ŋu.
Kpe ɖe eŋu la, akpa sia agado ŋusẽ wò be nusɔsrɔ̃ tso se, dunyaheheŋutinunya, 
kple kadodomenɔnɔ kple gbetadukɔmetɔwo ŋu ƒe didi nanyɔ le mewò elabena edo 
ka kple nusɔsrɔ̃wo abe Dukpɔkplɔŋutinunya kple Blemanudzɔdzɔwo ŋuti nunya ene.

• Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒewo ɖea dukɔa ƒe se siwo woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ me la me eye wozãa wo le woƒe 
dɔwo wɔwɔ me. Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe siwo le Ghana la le ɖoɖo tɔxɛ aɖe nu tso kɔkɔtɔ dzi va se 
ɖe suetɔ dzi. Le ɖoɖo sia nu la, Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒegã lae nye kɔkɔtɔ kekeake.
• Wozãa dekɔnu ƒe se kple ɖoɖo tsɔna drɔ̃a nya le dekɔnuʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me.
• Ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo drɔ̃a nya le egbeŋkuʋuʋu ƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃ ƒewo eye wofiaa afɔɖoƒe le nu 
siwo woawɔ la ŋu.
• Fiawo kple dumegãwo drɔ̃a nya le dekɔnuʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me eye wokpɔa ʋɔnudrɔ̃nyawo 
dzi.

Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ɖoɖowo nye ɖoɖo siwo dzi ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒewo alo dziɖuɖu ƒe akpa aɖe zɔna ɖo

Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒewo ƒe dɔdeasiwo
Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒewo ƒe dɔ siwo wowɔna la woe nye esiwo gbɔna:
1. Woɖea dukɔa ƒe sewo me eye wozãa wo ɖe ɖoɖo nu.
2. Wokpɔa egbɔ be amewo na akɔnta tso woƒe wɔnawo ŋu eye wodoa afia dzɔdzɔe 
tsotso kple nu nyui wɔwɔ ɖe ŋgɔ le dukɔa me.
3. Wokpɔa amewo ƒe gomekpɔkpɔwo kple ablɔɖemenɔnɔ ƒe wɔna siwo dzi 
dukplɔse alo gomekpɔkpɔ ƒe se aɖe ɖo kpee la ta.
4. Wokpɔa egbɔ be amewo wɔ nu ɖe ɖoɖo nyuitɔ nu ameŋkumemakpɔmakpɔtɔe 
le sewo ŋu dɔ wɔwɔ me (afia dzɔdzɔe tsotso).
5. Woɖea masɔmasɔwo kple dzrewo ɖa le ame ɖekaɖekawo, dɔwɔƒewo, kple 
dziɖuɖudɔwɔƒewo dome.
6. Wonaa nyahelawo dome dzadzra ɖo, nugbidodo kple ame nɔewo gɔme sese 
ƒe mɔnukpɔkpɔwo be woaɖe masɔmasɔwo ɖa ʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ ɖe ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒewo ƒe se 
kple ɖoɖowo nu manɔmee.
7. Woɖenɛ fiana be seɖoƒe le dukplɔla kple eƒe akametiwo (dudɔlawo) kpakple 
sewɔtakpekpemenɔlawo ƒe ŋusẽ si, eya ta ele be woawɔ nu ɖe ŋusẽ si dukplɔsea 
na wo la nu.
8. Wonɔa dukɔa teƒe drɔ̃a nya na hlɔ̃dolawo alo sedzidalawo.
9. Wonɔa ame siwo ŋu wotsɔ nya aɖe ɖo la teƒe le hlɔ̃donyawo dɔdrɔ̃ me.
Ɖoɖo si nu Egbeŋkuʋuʋu ƒe Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒewo le
Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe siwo le Ghana la le ɖoɖo tɔxɛ aɖe nu tso kɔkɔtɔ dzi va se ɖe suetɔ dzi. 
Woawoe nye esiwo gbɔna:
1. Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒegã lae nye kɔkɔtɔ kekeake.
2. Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe si wogbugbɔa nya drɔ̃na le la nye ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe si wogbugbɔa ŋku léna 
ɖe nya si wodrɔ̃ xoxo alo va yi la ŋu le la.
3. Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe gãtɔwo nye ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe siwo wodrɔ̃a nya ɖe sia ɖe ƒomevi le la.
4. Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe siwo le nuto suewo me la nye ʋɔnudr ɔ̃ƒe sue siwo drɔ̃a ƒomenyawo

5. Ɖeviwo ƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒewo nye ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe sue siwo woɖo be woadr ɔ̃ nya siwo ku 
ɖe ɖevi siwo mexɔ ƒe 18 haɖeke o la ŋu le la.

Le Ghana la, ʋɔnudrɔ̃lagã si nye ʋɔnudrɔ̃lawo katã ƒe tatɔ lae kpɔa ʋɔnudrɔ̃nyawo 
dzi. Ʋɔnudr ɔ̃dɔwɔla siwo wɔa dɔ le ʋɔnudr ɔ̃ƒewo lae nye: ʋɔnudr ɔ̃lawo,

ŋu le ʋɔnudɔdr ɔ̃, sewo me ɖeɖe kple sewo ŋu dɔ wɔwɔ ƒe senunɔnɔ le Ghana ƒe 
sewo nu la me.
Ɖoɖo siwo nu wodrɔ̃a nya ɖo le egbeŋkuʋuʋu ƒe

Nya Drɔ̃na le la kple Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe Gãtɔ Kekeake si le dukɔa me la.
2.  Ʋɔnudrɔ̃la etɔ̃ yi atɔ̃ drɔ̃a nya hetsoa afia le Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe si Wogbugbɔa nya Drɔ̃na 
le la kple Ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe Gãtɔ Kekeake si le dukɔa me la.

Ɖoɖo siwo dzi wozɔna le dekɔnuʋɔnudɔdrɔ̃ me la woe nye:

sia me la woe nye fiawo, hlɔ̃tatɔwo, dumegãwo kple ame siwo nya nu tso nyadɔdrɔ̃ 
ŋu la.
3. Nugbidodo: Ʋɔnudrɔ̃mɔnu sia ƒe taɖodzinu koŋue nye ŋutifafa, ɖekawɔwɔ 
kple hamenuwɔwɔ gbugbɔɖote le nyahelawo dome to woƒe ƒometatɔwo alo 
hlɔ̃tatɔwo kple dumegãwo dzi.

nye la ŋu va yi xoxo le ƒe gbãtɔ me. Le nusɔsrɔ̃ tso adzowo kple alobalowo ŋu me la, 
àsrɔ̃ nu tso ale si woléa ŋku ɖe adzowo ƒe tutuɖo kple woƒe hawo ŋu eye emegbe la, 
míadzro alobalowo ƒe tutuɖo hã me. Akpa sia le vevie na wò, menye le Eʋegbesɔsrɔ̃

wò ŋutete hena kuxiwo ɖeɖe ɖa ƒe aɖaŋuwo ɖo. Adzowo kple alobalowo nye mɔnu 
siwo míetona tua míaƒe susuwo kple aɖaŋuwo ɖo, eye woganana be míebua ta me
