ALOBALOWO
Alobalo nye nya kpakpa si me nuwɔnawo kple nuwɔlawo le la. Enye ŋutinya blibo 
si wogblɔna eye le eƒe nuwuwu la, wodea kɔsasae be eselawo natu abe ale si wòle 
le adzo gome ene. Zi geɖe la, alobalowo ɖea modzaka na ame, fiaa nu ame eye 
wotua ame ƒe susu ɖo. Wodoa ta me deto bubu, kuxiwo ɖeɖe ɖa ƒe aɖaŋuwo, 
ŋkuɖoɖonudzi kple ŋugbledede deto ƒe wɔnawo ɖe ŋgɔ.
Alobalo ƒe Wɔƒewo
Alobalo ƒe wɔƒewo le vovovo le ɣeyiɣi vovovowo me.
1. Susututu ɖo: Etua kuxiwo ɖeɖe ɖa, ta me deto bubu kple susu si le ɖoɖo nu la 
ɖeɖe ƒe aɖaŋuwo ɖo le amewo me, vevietɔ ɖeviwo.
2. Modzakaɖeɖe: Eɖea modzaka na ame eye wòdoa dzidzɔ na ame ame sia ame.
3. Agbalẽsɔsrɔ̃dodo ɖe ŋgɔ: Edoa agbal ẽsɔsrɔ̃ ɖe ŋgɔ, tua míaƒe susuwo ɖ o, 
eye wònana míesea nu vovovowo gɔme le Akɔnta, Dzɔdzɔmeŋutinunya kple 
Gbegbɔgblɔwo sɔsrɔ̃ me.
4. Susu ƒe tenunɔnɔ: Etua míaƒe susuwo ɖo, naa gbɔdzɔ e mí eye wònana míaƒe 
susuwo nɔa tenu.
5. Hamenuwɔwɔ: Alobalototo doa kadodomenɔnɔ kple ame nɔewo le 
hadomegbenɔnɔ, hamenuwɔwɔ kple nuƒoƒo me ɖe ŋgɔ.
6. Nuléɖetame: Edoa míaƒe susu ƒe tenunɔnɔ, susu ƒe kuku ɖe nuwɔnawo ŋu, 
susu ƒe ablaɖeɖe ɖe ŋgɔ eye wònana be míeŋlɔa nu be kabakaba o.

9. Ŋutinyagbɔgblɔ: Enana be míegblɔ a ŋutinya wòléa vi, zɔna ɖe ɖoɖ o nu eye 
wòléa ame ɖe zi dzi.
10. Nugɔmekuku kple Dzɔdzɔmeŋutinunya: Edoa nusɔsrɔ̃ tso amegbetɔ ƒe susu, 
agbenɔnɔ, kple ɖoɖowɔwɔ ŋu ɖe ŋgɔ.
11. Tsitsiɖedzi: Enana be dzideƒo ɖoa mía si, eye wòƒãa kutrikuku kple sidzedze ame 
ɖokui ƒe gbɔgbɔ ɖe mía me.
12. Habɔbɔ: Enaa mɔnukpɔkpɔ ame vovovo siwo ŋu ŋutete vovovowo le la be 
woawɔ nu le ha me.

Kpɔɖeŋu 1: Alobalo - Nukugbalẽ si bu la
Alobalo la
Agbalẽ aɖe si mebɔ o la bu le kɔƒe sue aɖe ƒe agbalẽxlẽƒe. Agbalẽxlẽƒedzikpɔla la bia 
gbe ame ene aɖ e siwo ŋu wòbu nazã ɖo la: Kumɔdzi, Nanewɔtɔ , Klẽnam, Seɖina. 
Wo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe gblɔ nya aɖe.
1. Kumɔdzi: “Nyemetsɔ agbalẽ la o. Mekpɔe le Nanewɔtɔ si etsɔ.”
2. Nanewɔtɔ: “Nyemetsɔ agbalẽ la o. Nyemenya ale si wòle hã o.”
3. Klẽnam: “Mekpɔ Seɖina wòtsɔ agbalẽ la le agbalẽdaɖoƒe la.”
4. Seɖina: “Klẽnam le alakpa dam. Menɔ aƒe me hafi agbalẽ la bu.”
Agbalẽxlẽƒedzikpɔla la nya be wo dometɔ ɖeka koe tsɔ agbalẽa. Ame kae tsɔ agbalẽ 
la?
Gɔmeɖeɖedidi na alobalo la
a. Ne Kumɔdzi le nyateƒe tom la, ekema agbalẽ la le Nanewɔtɔ si. Gake esia fia be 
Klẽnam kple Seɖina le alakpa dam si fia be ame siwo le nyateƒe tom la wu 
ɖeka. Esia ɖee fia be Kumɔdzi le alakpa dam.
b. Ne Nanewɔtɔ le nyateƒe tom la, ekema menya ale asi agbalẽ la le o. Esia fia be 
Kumɔdzi, Klẽnam kple Seɖina le alakpa dam, si fia be Klẽnam le alakpa dam, 
si tsi tsitre ɖe Nanewɔtɔ ƒe nya ŋu be yemenya ale si agbalẽ la le o. Esia ɖee 
fia be Nanewɔtɔ le alakpa dam.
c. Ne Klẽnam le nyateƒe tom la, ekema ekp ɔ Seɖina wòtsɔ agbalẽ la. Esia fia be 
Kumɔdzi, Nanewɔtɔ kple Seɖ ina le alakpa dam. Esi wònye ame ɖeka koe le 
nyateƒe tom ta la, nya sia ate ŋu anɔ eme.
d. Ne Seɖina le nyateƒe tom la, Klẽnam le alakpa dam si fia be Klẽnam mekp ɔ 
Seɖina wòtsɔ agbalẽ la o. Gake esia fia be Kumɔdzi kple Nanewɔtɔ hã le alakpa 
dam si wɔe be nya siwo wogblɔ la dometɔ aɖewo tsi tsitre ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu. 
Efia be Seɖina le alakpa dam.

NUƲUƲU
Le akpa sia la, àsrɔ̃ nu tso Eʋegbe ƒe nyadu ŋlɔɖiwo ƒe akpa aɖ ewo ŋu. Akpa sia ƒo 
nu tso hakpanyawo ŋu. Àsrɔ̃ nu tso hakpanyawo, woƒe hawo, nu siwo hakpanya lɔ 
ɖe eme kple hakpanya ƒe vevinyenye ŋu. Àgasrɔ̃ nu tso ale si wodzroa hakpanyawo 
me la ŋu. Wò nunya tso hakpanyawo kple hakpanyawo me dzodzro ŋu awɔe be nànya 
nya geɖewo eye wòatu wò gbezazã ƒe aɖaŋuwo ɖo. Akpa sia gaɖe nu me tso ale si 
hakpanyawo nana be míebua ta me, ɖea aɖaŋu eye míeƒoa nu kple aɖe bibi la ŋu. 
Hakpanyawo me dzodzro nana be nusr ɔ̃lawo bua ta me wòdea to, w ɔa gɔmesese 
nyuitɔ ŋu dɔ eye wònana be míeléa ŋku ɖe nu ŋu tsitotsitotsito. Hakpanyawo nana 
be nusrɔ̃lawo sea wo ɖokuiwo gɔme le ememe ke eye wòƒãa ɖokuidziɖuɖu ƒe gbɔgbɔ 
ɖe wo me. Akpa sia do ka kple nusɔsrɔ̃ bubuwo abe Blemanudzɔdzɔwo ŋuti Nusɔsrɔ̃, 
Iŋlisigbe ƒe Nyaduwo ŋuti Nusɔsrɔ̃ kple Hadzidziwo ene. Akpa sia gaɖe nunya kple 
gɔmesese si ku ɖe blemanudzɔdzɔwo, dekɔnuwo kple hadomegbenɔnyawo ŋu la 
fia. Hakpanyawo léle ɖe ta me kple wo gbɔgblɔ tua míaƒe susuwo ɖ o, naa dzideƒo 
mí eye wògatua nuƒoƒo le amewo dome ƒe aɖaŋuwo ɖo.
NYATI VEVIWO
• Hakpanya nye nyadu ƒe ha si me wozãa gbeɖaŋuwo le tsɔna ɖea gɔmesese kple 
seselelãme blibo ɖe go le la. Woŋlɔa hakpanyawo wodzea ga dzi kple susu be woate 
ŋu adzi wo.
• Woyɔa ame si ŋlɔ hakpanya la be hakpala/hakpanyaŋlɔla. Hakpala/hakpanyaŋlɔla 
zãa gbeɖaŋuwo abe gbeɖiɖiwo ƒe sɔsɔ, nyawo ƒe gadzidzedze, dzesiwo kple 
susumenukpɔkpɔ ene ƒe aɖaŋu tsɔna toa susu vovovowo kple nyatiwo ɖe eme le nya 
ʋɛ aɖewo ko me.
• Gɔmesese si le nya aɖe si le hakpanya me la mesɔna kple ale si wozãa nya la le 
gbeŋutise ƒe tutuɖo nu o.

Nu si hakpanya nye
Hakpanya nye nyadu ƒe ha si woŋlɔna ɖ e fli kple kpukpuiwo me si me wozãa gbe 
kple dzesiwo a ɖaŋutɔe le tsɔna ɖea susuwo, nuteƒekpɔkpɔ wo, seselelãmewo kple 
susumenutata ɖe go le la. Woŋlɔa hakpanyawo wodzea ga dzi kple susu be woate ŋu 
adzi wo. Zi geɖe la, wodea axa na nyawo le hakpanyawo me. Esia fia be womegblɔa 
nya siwo wodina be yewoagblɔ la kã o; wogblɔa nyawo to nyamenyawo zazã me.

Nu siwo hakpanya lɔ ɖe eme
1. Nyati: Enye susu vevitɔ alo gbedeasi si le nyadu aɖe si la. Hakpanya ƒe nyatiwo 
lɔ lɔlɔ̃, dzɔdzɔme, tugbedzedze, ku, gbɔgbɔmenyawo, kple nu makumaku ƒe 
nyawo ɖe eme. Nyati la gɔme sese kpena ɖe nuxlẽlawo ŋu be wodea dzesi 
gbedeasi si le hakpanya la si la alo taɖodzinu si ta hakpanyaŋlɔla la ŋlɔ 
hakpanya la ɖo la.
2. Gbezazã: Gbezazã nye gbegbɔgblɔ, gbeɖiɖi kple nyagbe ƒe tutuɖo si ƒomevi wozã 
le hakpanya aɖe ŋɔŋlɔ me la. Hakpanyaŋlɔla ƒe seselelãme kple ale si hakpanya 
wɔa dɔ ɖe hakpanyaxlẽla dzi la nye gbezazã ƒe akpa aɖe. Be nàse seselelãme si 
le hakpanyaŋlɔla la si ku ɖe nyati la ŋu gɔme la, ele be nuxlẽlawo nalé ŋku ɖe 
nya, gbeɖaŋu kple gbeɖiɖi siwo hakpanyaŋlɔla la zã la ŋu. Seselelãme si ava na 
nuxlẽla la ku ɖe ale si hakpanya la wɔ dɔ ɖe nuxlẽlawo dzi la ŋu.
3. Nuŋlɔla ƒe Seselelãme: Seselelãme si le hakpanyaŋlɔla si ku ɖe nyati la ŋu.
4. Nuxlẽla ƒe Seselelãme: Seselelãme si vana na hakpanyaxlẽla la le hakpanya la 
xexlẽ vɔ megbe. Seselelãme sia menɔa anyi ɣeyiɣi didi o.
5. Gbeɖaŋuwo: Wonye nya siwo wozãna aɖaŋutɔe siwo ƒe gɔmesese tea ŋu toa 
vovo alo nya siwo wogazãna le mɔ bubu nu siwo ƒe gɔmesese toa vovo tso nya 
ɖekaɖeka siwo tu wo ɖo wotɔxɛwotɔxɛe la ƒe gɔmesese gbɔ la. Gbeɖaŋuwo 
abe fuflugbadodo, dzesiwo kple nya siwo tsi tsitre ɖe wo nɔewo ŋu ene la zazã 
tea ŋu wɔnɛ be gɔmesese vovovowo nɔa hakpanya la si. Nenema ke wozãa 
gbeɖaŋuwo abe nusɔnu, nyasɔnya kple gbetɔdonu ene tsɔna hea kadodo dea 
susumenukpɔkpɔ vovovo siwo meɖe dzesi gaglã o la dome. Gbeɖaŋuwo abe 
nuƒoƒo na ame aɖe si mele teƒea o, dzededenya/fudodonya, gbe tsitsi zazã, 
ŋgogbãnyawo zazã aduadu, gbugbɔgblɔ, nyagbe alo nyakɔsɔkɔsɔ si ge ɖe fli 
bubu dzi kple bubuawo ene hã li.
6. Gbeɖiɖiwo zazã : Wozãa gbeɖiɖiwo abe xaxagbeɖiɖi ɖeka tuɖenuwo, 
ablɔɖegbeɖiɖi ɖeka tuɖenuwo kple gbeɖiɖinyawo be woate ŋu adzi hakpanya 
la.
7. Gbeŋlɔtsiã: Enye ale si woŋlɔ hakpanya la, vevietɔ ɖoɖo si nu woɖoa nyaawo 
ɖo hena hakpanya la gɔme sese. Hakpanyaŋlɔlawo trɔa asi le nyawo ɖoɖo ɖe 
gbeŋutise ƒe ɖoɖo nu ŋu hena gbetete ɖe nya tɔxɛ aɖewo dzi. Susu si ta wotrɔa 
asi le hakpanya ƒe tutuɖo kple gbezazã ŋu ɖo lae nye be wòawɔ dɔ tɔxɛ ɖe 
hakpanya la dzi abe asitɔtrɔ le seselelãmewo ŋu ene.
8. Nuƒola: Ame si le nu ƒom le hakpanya la me la. Etea ŋu nyea hakpanyaŋlɔla 
la alo ame si le nu ƒom le hakpanya la me la. Zi geɖe la, wozãa ame gbãtɔ 
ƒe nyagblɔmɔnu le hakpanyaŋɔŋlɔ me tsɔna ƒoa nu tso ame etɔ̃lia ŋu. Ɣe 
aɖewo ɣi la, hakpanyaŋlɔlawo zãa ame evelia ƒe nyagblɔmɔnu tsɔna ƒoa nu na 
hakpanyaxlẽlawo kã.

amewo dome ƒe aɖaŋu ɖe ŋgɔ.

7. Ŋugbledede le ame ɖokui me kple susuɖeɖe gblɔ dodo ɖe ŋgɔ: Hakpanyawo 
nana be nusrɔ̃lawo ɖea woƒe susuwo, seselelãmewo, kple nuteƒekpɔkpɔwo gblɔna.
8. Ameɖokuidziɖuɖu ƒe gbɔgbɔ ƒaƒã ɖe ame me: Hakpanyawo nana be nusrɔ̃lawo 
sea wo ɖokuiwo gɔ me le ememe ke eye woƒãa ɖokuidziɖuɖu ƒe gbɔgbɔ ɖe 
nusrɔ̃lawo me. Hakpanyawo ƒe nyatiwo wɔa dɔ ɖe nusrɔ̃lawo dzi eye wosea nu 
siwo ŋu hakpanyawo ƒo nu tsoe la gɔme.
9. Gbeɖaŋuwo gɔme sese: Hakpanyawo fiaa nu nusr ɔ̃lawo tso gbeɖaŋuwo abe 
dzesiwo, susumenutata, kple gbeɖaŋu bubuawo ene ŋu. Gbeɖaŋu siawo ɖoa 
atsyɔ̃ na woƒe nuƒo eye wonana be woƒoa nu kple aɖe bibi
Nuwɔna 10�4 Hakpanya ƒe vevinyenye
Minɔ eveve alo wu nenema eye miadzro hakpanya ƒe vevinyenye me.
Hakpanya ƒe Tutuɖo
Hakpanya ƒe tutuɖo lɔ dzesidenu siwo gbɔna la ɖe eme:
1. Fliwo: Fli siwo me nyawo le la
2. Fli ƒe didime: Didime si le fli ɖe sia ɖe siwo me nyawo le la si
3. Kpukpuiwo: Fli siwo tu kpukpui aɖe ɖo la
4. Gbeɖiɖi ɖ eka zazã : Ale si wogbugbɔ gbeɖiɖi ɖeka aɖe yɔ le nyawo me le 
fliawo ƒe nuwuƒe
5. Gbetete ɖe nukɔkɔwo dzi: Ale si wote gbe ɖe nukɔkɔwo dzi alo womete gbe 
ɖe wo dzi o
6. Nyagbe ɖeka aɖe dzi yiyi le fli bubu dzi: Nyagbe alo nyagbekɔsɔkɔsɔ aɖe tea 
ŋu dzea egɔme le fli ɖeka dzi hewua enu ɖe fli bubu dzi nyaŋutidzesi aɖeke 
manɔmee.
7. Ŋɔŋlɔdzesi gãtɔwo zazã: Ale si wozã ŋɔŋlɔdzesi gãtɔwo le fliwo alo nyagbewo 
ƒe gɔmedzeƒe.
Hakpanyawo ƒe tutuɖo ƒe taɖodzinuwo lɔ nu siwo gbɔna la ɖe eme:
a. Enana be wodzia hakpanya/ha la wòdzea ga dzi.
b. Enana be wosea hakpanya la kple nya siwo dzi wote gbe ɖo la gɔme.
c. Eɖea hakpanyaŋlɔla la ƒe seselelãme fiana.
d. Efiaa afɔɖoƒe nuxlẽlawo be woaxlẽ hakpanya la nyuie.
e. Enana be míekpɔa nu siwo ŋu hakpanya la ƒo nu tsoe la kple 
susumenukpɔŋkuwo.

HAKPANYAWO ME DZODZRO
Nu siwo ŋu woléa ŋu ɖo le hakpanyawo me dzodzro me
1. Lé ŋku kadodo si le hakpanya ƒe tanya la kple hakpanya la dome me la ŋu.
2. De dzesi gbedeasi vevi si le hakpanya la si alo taɖodzinu si ta hakpanyaŋlɔla la 
ŋlɔ hakpanya la ɖo la.
3. Lé ŋku ɖe gbezazã ŋu kpɔ ɖa be egɔmesese le bɔbɔe alo sesẽ mahã eye nàde dzesi 
susu si ta wozã gbea alo gbeŋlɔtsiã ma nenema ɖo.
4. Ƒo nu tso hakpanyaŋlɔla la ƒe seselelãme ku ɖe nyati si ŋu wòle nu ƒom tsoe la ŋu.
5. Dzro seselelãme si le hakpanya la si na exlẽla la me.
6. Ɖe gbeɖaŋuawo ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ɖe hakpanya la dzi me.
7. Ƒo nu tso hakpanya la ƒe tutuɖo ŋu.
8. Lé ŋku ɖe ame si le nu ƒom le hakpanya la me kple ame si ŋu hakpanya la ku 
ɖo la ŋu.
Nuwɔna 10�5 Hakpanyawo ƒe tutuɖo kple nu siwo wòlɔ ɖe eme la 
me dzodzro
Hakpanyawo ƒe tutuɖo kple nu siwo wòlɔ ɖe eme la le vevie le hakpanyawo 
me dzodzro me.
1. Minɔ eveve miadzro nu siwo hakpanya lɔ ɖe eme la me. Mizã hakpanya si 
miegblɔ le nuwɔna 10.3 me la.
2. Midzro hakpanya si miegblɔ le nuwɔna 10.3 me la ƒe tutuɖo me. Nya ka 
miate ŋu agblɔ tso hakpanya la ƒe gadzidzedze ŋu? Kpukpui neni mee 
hakpanya la le? Fli nenie le kpukpui ɖe sia ɖe me? Ɖe fliawo ƒe didime sɔa?
Nuwɔna 10�6 Hakpanyawo me dzodzro
Xlẽ hakpanya si gbɔna la kple ale si wodzro emee la. Lé hakpanya la me dzodzro 
ƒe nyati veviwo da ɖi le wò gɔmesese nu be woafia afɔɖoƒe wò nenye be èdi be 
yeadzro hakpanya aɖe me.

Ɖoƒe 2lia: Hakpanya si ƒomevi wònye
Le ɖoƒe sia la, ele be nàde dzesi hakpanya si ƒomevi ha la nye la to ŋkuléle ɖe nya 
siwo le hakpanya la me la ŋu me. Le hakpanya sia me la, hakpala la ƒo nu tso 
Akpalu ƒe tenu ƒe ku ŋu. Efa konyi tso ale si eƒe tenuvi ɖeka hɔ̃ɔ la kue la ŋu. Esia 
fia be hakpanya la nye konyifaha.
Ɖoƒe 3lia: Hakpanya ƒe Tutuɖo
Esia nye hakpanya la ƒe nɔnɔme. Ekuna ɖe kpukpui ƒe xexlẽme siwo le hakpanya la 
me la, fli siwo le kpukpui ɖe sia ɖe me la, fliawo ƒe didime, nyagbewo ƒe nɔnɔme 
kple bubuawo ŋu. Kpukpui ɖeka koe le hakpanya sia si eye fli wuieve le kpukpui 
la me. Fliawo dometɔ aɖewo didi eye ɖewo medidi o.
Ɖoƒe 4lia: Hakpanya la ƒe nyati
Nyati nye susu vevitɔ alo gbedeasi si le hakpanya la me la. Wodea dzesi nyati le 
hakpanya me to ŋkuléle ɖe nu siwo ŋu hakpanya la ƒo nu tsoe la ŋu me. Nyati si 
le hakpanya sia si lae nye, “Ku doa lo” alo “Ku menyaa hiã na ame o.” Le hakpanya 
la me la, hakpala la gbl ɔ nya aɖe siwo ɖo kpe nyati si ŋu hakpanya la ƒo nu le la 
dzi. Kpɔɖeŋu:
 “Kua mebe yeawu nye ŋutɔ o.
Aŋgba si ke tre ɖiɖi la, eyae gatrea gege.
Nya kae wɔ kuvia nam ale?”

FOREWORD
Ghana’s new Senior High School Curriculum aims to ensure that all learners 
achieve their potential by equipping them with 21st Century skills, knowledge, 
character qualities and shared Ghanaian values. This will prepare learners to live a 
responsible adult life, progress to further studies and enter the world of work. This 
is the first time that Ghana has developed a Senior High School Curriculum which 
focuses on national values, attempting to educate a generation of Ghanaian youth 
who are proud of our country and can contribute effectively to its development.
The Ministry of Education is proud to have overseen the production of these 
Learner Materials which can be used in class and for self-study and revision. 
These materials have been developed through a partnership between the Ghana 
Education Service, teacher unions (Ghana National Association of Teachers- GNAT, 
National Association of Graduate Teacher -NAGRAT and the Pre-Tertiary Teachers 
Association of Ghana- PRETAG) and National Subject Associations. These materials 
are informative and of high quality because they have been written by teachers for 
teachers with the expert backing of each subject association.
I believe that, if used appropriately, these materials will go a long way to 
transforming our Senior High Schools and developing Ghana so that we become 
a proud, prosperous and values-driven nation where our people are our greatest 
national asset.
Haruna Iddrisu MP
Minister for Education

BLAWA JEBƆ KƐ GBEE
HIƐGBELEMƆ
Mlijaa nɛɛ gbeleɔ blawa he nilee, jebɔ kɛ gbee ni yɔɔ blawai amli hiɛ etsɔɔ. Nikasemɔ 
nɛɛ naagbee lɛ obaanyɛ otsɔɔ srɔtoi ni yɔɔ blawa ni gbeɔ naa kɛ vaoli, kɛ blawa ni 
gbɛɔ naa kɛ kɔnsonanti yɛ Ga wiemɔ lɛ mli, koni ogba bɔ ni blawa jebɔ yeɔ buaa 
wiemɔkulibii atsɛrɛmɔ yɛ Ga wiemɔ lɛ mli. Obaakase nii yɛ gbee ni kamɔ blawai anɔ 
hu he, koni okwɛ henɔi ni yɔɔ blawai amli, gbee ni ba shi, nɔ ni ka teŋ, nɔ ni yɛ ŋwɛi, 
nɔ ni miiwo ehe nɔ kɛ nɔ ni miiba shi hu he nii. Obaana nilee kɛ hesalɛ ni akɛtsɛrɛɔ 
wiemɔkulibii hei kɛ gbee ni kamɔ blawai kɛ wiemɔkulibii anɔ. Naagbee lɛ, mlijaa nɛɛ 
baakwɛ gbee nitsumɔ yɛ Ga wiemɔkulibii, wiemɔwekui kɛ wiemɔ lɛ diɛŋtsɛ mli.
SUSUMƆ OTII
• Blawa ji wiemɔkuli mlijaa ko ni abaanyɛ atsɛ ni shishinumɔ fioo ko kɛ yɛ mli.
• Kɔnsonanti blawa ji kɔnsonanti ni nyɛɔ damɔɔ shi ekome akɛ blawa.
• Gbee ni ka nɔ tsɔɔ gbeetsakemɔ ni baa yɛ wiemɔkuli ko mli ni tsakeɔ shishinumɔ yɛ 
wiemɔkuli lɛ mli (homophones /homonyms).
BLAWA HENƆ KƐ JEBƆ
BLAWA SUSUMƆKƐTSƆƆMƆ
Blawa ji wiemɔkuli mlijaa ko loo wiemɔkuli muu ni hiɛ kɔnsonanti kɛ vaoli, loo 
kɔnsonanti aloo vaoli. Yɛ gbɛ kroko nɔ lɛ, eji mlijaramɔi ni wɔnuɔ kɛji wɔmiitsɛ 
wiemɔkuli ko. Nɔkwɛmɔ nɔ, eko lɛ obaawa loo obaamu shii enyɔ loo nɔ kɛji ootsɛ 
wiemɔkuli ko, Kofi [ko: fi]. Hewɔ lɛ Kofi hiɛ blawai enyɔ. Shi yɛ tu tsɛmɔ mli lɛ ebaa 
lɛ shi kome too [tu], hewɔ lɛ ehiɛ blawa kome pɛ. Hewɔ lɛ “bodobodo” baahiɛ blawai 
enyiɛ [bo:do:bo:do]?
Jɛ vaolii asɛɛ lɛ, kɔnsonanti blawa tamɔ /m, n, ŋ/ nyɛɔ damɔɔ shi akɛ vaoli. Enɛ nyɛɔ 
tsuɔ nii kɛji vaoli ko enyiɛɛɛ kɔnsonantii nɛɛ asɛɛ. Nɔkwɛmɔ nɔ, [pa: m]. Blawa hiɛɔ 
vaoli gbɛɛmɔ kome, ni enyɛɔ efeɔ vaoli kome ni damɔ shi loo kɔnsonanti gbɛɛmɔ kome 
kɛ vaoli gbɛɛmɔ kome. Wiemɔkuli kome nyɛɔ feɔ blawa kome ni no atsɛɔ lɛ blawa 
kome wiemɔ lɛ, aloo blawai enyɔ wiemɔ loo blawai pii awiemɔ. Nɔkwɛmɔ nibii komɛi 
nɛ.

• Eyeɔ ebuaa kaselɔi kɛyɔseɔ blawakulibii ni yɔɔ wiemɔkuli ko mli.

pɛpɛɛpɛ awo amɛblawai lɛ amli.
Blawa henɔi
Ghana wiemɔi srɔtoi lɛ yɛ amɛblawa henɔi srɔtoi. Fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, blawa henɔi ni anaa titri 
ji blawa ni gbeɔ naa kɛ vaoli (vaoli naagbee) kɛ blawa ni gbeɔ naa kɛ kɔnsonanti 
(kɔnsonanti naagbee).

Nitsumɔ 1.1 Blawa susumɔkɛtsɔɔmɔ
1. Yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ owiemɔi amli lɛ, tsɔɔmɔ nɔ ni ji blawa. Okɛ klasi lɛ asusu ohetoo 
lɛ he.
2. Gbalamɔ blawa henɔi ni yɔɔ owiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ otsɔɔ.
3. Gbalamɔ sɛɛnamɔi ni yɔɔ blawa jebɔi kɛ wiemɔtsɛrɛmɔ mli otsɔɔ. Okɛ onaanyo 
agba he sane.
Blawa jebɔ
Srɔtoi yɛ blawa jebɔi amli yɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi lɛ mli. Abaanyɛ akɛ kɔnsonantii kɛ vaolii 
asusu blawa jebɔi atsɔɔ. Vaolii ji hiamɔ nibii ni yɔɔ blawai amli. Yɛ Ghana wiemɔi lɛ 
amli lɛ, gbee hu he miihia jogbaŋŋ ni akɛyoɔ blawa jebɔi. Kɛfata vaoli ahe lɛ, blawa 
kɔnsonanti hu hiɛ gbee ni ka amɛnɔ. Vaolii kɛ kɔnsonantii afalɛ yɛ wiemɔkuli ko mli 
ni tsɔɔ blawa jebɔi abɔ ni yɔɔ mli. Nɔkwɛmɔ nɔ, kɛji wiemɔ ko hiɛ vaoli enyɔ lɛ, etsɔɔ 
akɛ kɛji ehiɛɛɛ kwraa lɛ jeee blawai enyɔ ni enaŋ. Nɔkwɛmɔ nibii yɛ Ghana wiemɔi lɛ 
ekomɛi amli kɛ bɔ ni blawa jebɔi yɔɔ lɛ nɛ:
Ga: ni (KV), te ( KV), ŋ: ka: ti: ɛ (K: KV: KV: V) klaŋ: kla: ŋ (KKV: K). KKV baa kɛji 
liquid ko yɛ wiemɔ ni atsɛrɛ lɛ mli. Kɛji l kɛ r nyiɛ kɔnsonanti ko sɛɛ tuntu. Nɔkwɛmɔ 
nibii: Klaŋ, kla: ŋ (KKV: K)
Nitsumɔ 1.2 Blawa jebɔ yɛ Ga wiemɔ lɛ mli
Nyɛsusua blawa jebɔi yɛ Ga wiemɔ lɛ mli ahe. Okɛ klasi lɛ agba ohetoo lɛ he sane.
Nitsumɔ 1.3 Daamɔ blawai anɔ kɛtsɛrɛ wiemɔ hei
Yɛ kui amli lɛ, nyɛhalaa wiemɔkulibii ekpaa kɛjɛa sane ni yɔɔ shishi lɛ mli, koni 
ofee nibii ni baa nɛɛ:
1. Kɛ onaanyo asusu wiemɔi ni nyɛkɔlɔ lɛ he kɛtao blawai abɔ ni yɔɔ wiemɔkulibii 
lɛ eko fɛɛ eko mli.
2. Okɛ onaanyo lɛ asusu blawa jebɔi ni yɔɔ wiemɔkulibii ni nyɛfee lɛ ahe.
Ku lɛ agba nɔ ni amɛfee lɛ amɛtsɔɔ klasi lɛ, koni klasi lɛ asusu he ni amɛma nɔ mi.
Nanemɛi kpakpai ji aga kɛ tsatsu. Fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, soro amɛ fɛɛ amɛshihilɛ kɛ jeŋba. Hulutsoo 
be mli lɛ, tsatsu miaa ehiɛ kɛtsuɔ nii kɛtaoɔ niyenii etoɔ. Aga lɛ, shwɛmɔ kɛkɛ eshwɛɔ yɛ

ni ebua naa yɛ hulutsoo bei amli lɛ, be mli ni hɔmɔ miiye aga ni fɛi miigbe lɛ yɛ eshia lɛ.

GBEE HE NILEE
Adesai awiemɔi fɛɛ kɛ gbee tsuɔ nii kɛmaa nɔ ko nɔ mi yɛ wiemɔ mli. Amɛkɛtsɔɔ 
miishɛɛ loo awerɛho loo kɛhaa shishinumɔ yɛ wiemɔ ko mli. Gbee ji wiemɔ nɔwomɔ 
loo shibaa yɛ blawai loo wiemɔkulibii anɔ ni kɛ tsakemɔi baa shishinumɔi amli kɛtsɔɔ 
henumɔi komɛi kɛji mɔ ko miiwie. Wiemɔi ni gbee kamɔ nɔ ji wiemɔi ni shishinumɔ 
damɔɔ gbee ni akɛwieɔ lɛ nɔ. Ghana wiemɔi lɛ fɛɛ lɛ gbee kamɔ nɔ. Ni gbee lɛ ŋwɛiyaa 
kɛ shibaa yɛ sanemuu lɛ fɛɛ nɔ lɛ ji nɔ ni wɔtsɛɔ lɛ gbeetsakemɔ lɛ.
Gbee henɔi
Wiemɔi srɔtoi hiɛ gbee henɔi srɔtoi. Nɔkwɛmɔ nibii ni baa nɛɛ ji henɔi komɛi ni yɔɔ 
Ghana wiemɔi lɛ amli: gbee ni yɔɔ ŋwɛi, gbee ni ba shi, gbee ni ka teŋ, gbee ni miiba 
shi kɛ gbee ni miiya ŋwɛi. Ghana wiemɔi lɛ eko fɛɛ eko hiɛɔ kɛhooo kwraa lɛ gbee 
henɔi enyɔ nɛɛ: nomɛi ji gbee ni 'yaa ŋwɛi kɛ nɔ ni 'baa shi'. Kɛfata henɔi enyɔ nɛɛ ahe 
lɛ, ekomɛi hiɛɔ nɔ ni 'ka teŋ'. Ni ekrokomɛi hu hiɛ gbee ni 'miikwɔ kɛmiiya ŋwɛi' kɛ 'nɔ 
ni miiba shi'. Nibii ni baa nɛɛ ji nɔkwɛmɔ nibii ni yɔɔ Ghana wiemɔi lɛ ekomɛi amli.
1. Wiemɔi ni kɛ gbee henɔi enyɔ lɛ tsuɔ nii (nɔ ni yɛ ŋwɛi kɛ nɔ ni ba shi): Akan, 
Nzema, Ga, Kasem, Ewe, knkn.
2. Wiemɔi ni kɛ gbee henɔi etɛ tsuɔ nii (nɔ ni yɛ ŋwɛi, nɔ ni ba shi kɛ nɔ ni ka teŋ): 
Dangme, Dagbani, knkn.

Gbee mli nitsumɔi
Gbee he hiaa yɛ wiemɔi ni kɛ gbee tsuɔ nii lɛ amli, yɛ amɛnitsumɔi pɔtɛɛ komɛi ni 
haa shishinumɔi lɛ ahe. Gbee tsuɔ nibii srɔtoi etɛ yɛ wiemɔi ni kɛ gbee tsuɔ nii lɛ 
amli. Enɛmɛi ji wiemɔkulibii ni yɔɔ wiemɔ ko mli, wiemɔ mli mlai kɛ srɔtoi ni yɔɔ 
wiemɔkulibii tsɛmɔi amli.
1. Wiemɔkulibii atsɛmɔ (Lexical function of tone):
Akɛ gbee tsɔɔ srɔtoi ni yɔɔ wiemɔi ni hiɛ henɔ kome amli ni anaa shishinumɔi 
srɔtoi ni yɔɔ wiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ jogbaŋŋ. Kwɛmɔ nɔkwɛmɔ nibii ni yɔɔ shishi lɛ, 
yɔsemɔ kadimɔi ni niŋmaa okadii lɛ ayiteŋ lɛ, tsakeɔ gbei nikamɔ nɔ lɛ.
a. Ga: kpá:kpá ‘good’ kɛ pà:pá ‘father’,
b. Ga: bè ‘time’ kɛ bé ‘to quarrel’
2. Gbee nitsumɔ kɛ wiemɔ mli mlai:
Akɛ gbee tsɔɔ wiemɔkuli ko yeli he yɛ sanemuu mli, feemɔwiemɔ bei, otii pɔtɛɛ 
komɛi k.n.kn Nɔkwɛmɔ nibii komɛi nɛ: Daabe kɛ famɔ: kòfí wá ‘Kofi wa edamɔ shi’ 
kɛ kòfí wà ‘Kofi wa’
a. Daabe kɛ baababe: kòfí kɔɔ, ‘Kofi takes’ vs Kòfí baakɔ ‘Kofi will take’
b. Dabi kɛ famɔ: Kaalá (Don't sing) vs kɛyalà (to hook)
c. Sanemuu oti kɛ kpasalɔ sanefa: [miiyá] ‘I’m going’ kɛ [Beni miyàa lɛ] ‘When 
I was going…’
3. ‘Gbee’ nitsumɔ yɛ wiemɔ ko mli: Adamɔɔ gbee nɔ kɛtsɔɔ srɔtoi ni yɔɔ wiemɔ henɔi 
komɛi amli. Nɔkwɛmɔ nibii komɛi baa nɛɛ.
a. i. [Minù] I heard vs [Enú] to spin’
ii. [fè] More than vs [Fée] Did
iii. Fέ vs fὲ; Ayὲ vs Eyὲ; fù vs fú
Nitsumɔ 1.5 Tsɔɔmɔ nɔ ni ji gbee
1. Yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ owiemɔi amli lɛ tsɔɔmɔ nɔ ni ji gbee. Okɛ klasi lɛ asusu ohetoo lɛ he.
2. Okɛ nɔkwɛmɔ nibii ni sa agbala gbee henɔi srɔtoi lɛ amli otsɔɔ yɛ Ga mli.
3. Yɛ kui amli lɛ, nyɛtsɔa gbee nitsumɔi. Nyɛkɛ klasi lɛ agbaa nyɛhetoo lɛ he sane.
Nitsumɔ 1.6 Gbee yɔsemɔ
Yɛ mɛi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ akui amli lɛ, bo wiemɔkulibii komɛi ni aha toi yɛ Ga wiemɔ 
lɛ mli koni ofee nibii ni baa nɛɛ:
Taomɔ gbee henɔi ni yɔɔ wiemɔ ni aha lɛ mli.
1. Ga: tsa ‘to join’, tsa ‘to dig’, gbo ‘September’, gbo ‘to die’
a. Taomɔ blawa ni tere wiemɔ ni aha lɛ gbee okadi lɛ.
Okɛ klasi lɛ asusu ohetoo lɛ he.

HIƐGBELEMƆ
Mlijaa nɛɛ wieɔ sanemuu otii ni yɔɔ niŋmaa loo sanegbaa ko mli taomɔ he. Abaagbele 
nikanemɔ vii kɛ gbaajaa (intensive and extensive) mli nilee naa atsɔɔ bo. Obaagba 
hesalɛi ni he hiaa kɛnuɔ saneŋmalɔi loo wielɔi asanemuji otii ashishi koni okwɛ gbɛi 
anɔ ni obaatsɔ kɛtsɔse mɛi krokomɛi kɛtsɔ sanemuji, kukuji ni shishinumɔ yɔɔ mli nɔ. 
Mlijaa nɛɛ kɛ nikasemɔi krokomɛi tamɔ Blɔfo wiemɔ kɛ ‘Social Studies’ kɛ wiemɔi 
krokomɛi hu naa sharamɔ.
SUSUMƆ OTII
Susumɔ oti ni yɔɔ sane ko mli ji yitso ni hiɛ sane lɛ. Enɛ feɔ sane oti ni yɔɔ kuku ko mli 
ni hiɛ wiemɔ oti walɔi. Nikanemɔ lɛ nyɛɔ feɔ nikanemɔ vii loo gbajaa.
• Nikanemɔ vii ji nikanemɔ kɛ hiɛshiŋmɛɛ kɛtaoɔ otii, adafitswaa kɛ yiŋtoo ni ŋmalɔ 
lɛ hiɛ kɛha kanelɔi.
• Nikanemɔ gbajaa ji nikanemɔ babaoo kɛle wiemɔkulibii babaoo, ni ona naatselɛ kɛ 
niashishinumɔ ni mlikwɔ
SUSUMƆ OTII YƆSEMƆ YƐ SANEGBAA MLI
Jwɛŋmɔ mli sanebimɔi: Jwɛŋmɔ klɛŋklɛŋ afi lɛ nitsumɔi lɛ ahe, mɛni ji susumɔ oti? 
Nyɛku lɛ kɛ nyɛsusumɔi lɛ atoa he koni nyɛkanea nɔ ni yɔɔ shishi lɛ.
Susumɔ oti: Enɛ ji oti ni he hiaa fe fɛɛ yɛ kuku lɛ mli, sane ko ni aŋma, yɛ sanegbaa ko 
loo niŋmaa ko mli. Enɛ tsɔɔ nɔ hewɔ ni nakai yitso, niŋmaa loo sanegbaa lɛ ba. Wiemɔ 
oti walɔi yɛ sane lɛ mli ni yeɔ buaa susumɔ oti lɛ. Sharamɔi ni yɔɔ sane lɛ mli yɔsemɔ 
haa anaa susumɔ oti lɛ. Abaanyɛ ana susumɔ ni yɔɔ sane lɛ mli kɛbaatsɔ gbɛi nɛɛ anɔ:
Kanemɔ yitso lɛ kɛ hiɛgbelemɔ lɛ: Ehe miihia akɛ ona nɔ ni yitso lɛ kɛ hiɛgbelemɔ lɛ 
kɛɔ yɛ nɔ ni asusuɔ lɛ he yɛ sane lɛ mli.
Taomɔ sanemuu oti lɛ: Titri lɛ anaa sanemuu oti lɛ yɛ kukuji lɛ ashishijee niŋmaa lɛ 
mli. Kadimɔ hu akɛ bei komɛi lɛ anaa sanemuu oti lɛ yɛ teŋ loo yɛ naagbee liamɔ ni 
yɔɔ kuku lɛ mli lɛ.
Sanemuu oti walɔi lɛ taomɔ: Koni onyɛ oyɔse sanemuu oti walɔi lɛ bi ohe saji nɛɛ: 
namɔ, mɛni, mɛɛ be, nɛgbɛ, mɛɛba kɛ te sane oti lɛ ba lɛ tɛŋŋ.

Gbekɛ nuu: Hɛɛ, misusuɔ akɛ ekɔɔ mla nɔyeli kɛ bulɛ ni akɛhaa hiɛnyiɛlɔi ahe.

Gbekɛ nuu: Jwɛŋmɔ yɛ nɔ ni owieɔ lɛ mli. Shi kɛji nɔ ni hiɛnyiɛlɔi wieɔ lɛ ejaaa hu?

Gbekɛ nuu: Mijwɛŋko he nakai kwraa.

Gbekɛ nuu: Anɔkwale ni. Mamia mihiɛ kɛfee toiboo yɛ miwalashihilɛ mli.

Kanemɔ sane ni yɔɔ shishi lɛ koni oha sanebimɔi ni nyiɛ sɛɛ lɛ ahetoo.

nilee ni he hiaa kɛkura bulɛ kɛ nifeemɔi ni baaye abua sukuu lɛ nɔyaa kɛ

Wiemɔkulibii kɛ amɛjebɔ: kɛ Ga wiemɔ lɛ ŋmaa mli mlai
HIƐGBELEMƆ
Yɛ mlijaa nɛɛ mli lɛ, abaagbele tsalɔi, wiemɔkulibii asɔɔ gbɛjianɔtoo komɛi kɛ bɔ ni 
akɛ afisii tsuɔ nii yɛ Ga wiemɔ lɛ mli ahaa. Onilee yɛ bɔ ni akɛ afisii kɛ tsalɔi tsuɔ nii lɛ 
baaye abua bo kɛsɔ sanemuji ni shishinumɔ ahi mli faŋŋ yɛ Ga wiemɔ lɛ mli. Abaakudɔ 
bo kɛkase wiemɔkulibii asɔɔ gbɛjianɔtoo ni yɔɔ Ga wiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ. Wiemɔkulibii asɔɔ 
gbɛjianɔtoo ni abaawie he lɛ ekomɛi ji wiemɔ nta, afolɔ nɔ, ama kɛ afisii ni akɛtsaa 
wiemɔkulibii anɔ.
SUSUMƆ OTII
• Afisi ji mɔɔfim henɔ ni akɛtsaa wiemɔkulibii ni shishinumɔ yɛ mli. Enyɛɔ ebaa yɛ 
wiemɔ shishijee, eteŋ loo enaagbee. Ayɛ afisi henɔi etɛ yɛ Ga mli. Nomɛi ji hiɛ afisi, 
teŋ/awoteŋ afisi, kɛ sɛɛ afisi. Akɛ afisi tsaa wiemɔ shishifa he kɛnaa wiemɔkulibii 
henɔi srɔtoi.
• Akɛ tsalɔi tsuɔ nii yɛ wiemɔkulibii amli kɛtsaa wiemɔkulibii, wiemɔkuku kɛ susumɔi 
kɛsɔɔ sanemuji ni shishinumɔ yɛ faŋŋ.
• Afisi ni akɛtsuɔ nii yɛ wiemɔkulibii amli lɛ waa kɛsɔɔ wiemɔi hei
• Wiemɔsɔɔ ji gbɛjianɔtoo ni ŋmɛɔ wɔ gbɛ ni wɔkɛ wiemɔi ni yɛ Ga wiemɔwekui lɛ 
amli momo sɔɔ wiemɔ hei
AFISII
Afisi he nilee: Afisi ji mɔɔfim ni akɛtsaa wiemɔ shishifa kɛfeɔ wiemɔkulibii hee. 
Abaanyɛ agbala afisi mli akɛ eji wiemɔkuli ni tsuɔ nɔ ko pɔtɛɛ ni akɛtsaa wiemɔkulibii 
ashishijee teŋ/awoteŋ loo naagbee kɛfeɔ wiemɔ hee, ni ehaa shishinumɔ hee.
Afisii ni ale titri ji hiɛ kɛ sɛɛ afisi. Kɛji akɛ afisi fata wiemɔ shishifa loo sanekuku he 
lɛ, eshishinumɔ lɛ tsakeɔ kɛnaa wiemɔ hee. Abaanyɛ akɛɛ akɛ afisi ji wiemɔkuli henɔ 
ni abaanyɛ akɛtsa wiemɔkulibii krokomɛi kɛna shishinumɔ hee loo kɛtsake wiemɔkuli 
lɛ kɛna.wiemɔ hee.
Afisi komɛi baa dani wiemɔ shishifa lɛ baa, ni nomɛi ji Hiɛtsalɔ afisi.

Naagbee afisi lɛ baa yɛ shishifa wiemɔ lɛ sɛɛ hewɔ lɛ atsɛɔ lɛ sɛɛtsalɔ afisi
Awoteŋ ji afisi henɔ ko. Anaa nɛkɛ afisi nɛɛ kɛji akɛ hiɛ afisi kɛ sɛɛ afisi fɛɛ tsu nii shi

Nitsumɔ 3.1 Nɔ ni ji afisi
Tsɔ ohiɛ oha onaanyo lɛ koni ogbala afisi mli otsɔɔ lɛ. Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ obaafee enɛ 
ni okwɛɛɛ nɔ ni aŋma lɛ nɔ.
Afisi Henɔi: Afisi henɔi enyɔ ni ayɔɔ yɛ wiemɔi amli lɛ ji Afisi ni tsakeɔ wiemɔ 
weku kɛ afisi ni tsakeee wiemɔ weku loo nɔnyɛɛ afisi
Afisi ni tsakeɔ wiemɔ lɛ weku: Enɛ ji afisii ni sɔɔ wiemɔkulibii hee ni hiɛ shishinumɔ 
hee. Yɛ afisi ni tsakeɔ wiemɔ weku mli lɛ, eeenyɛ eba lɛ akɛ wiemɔ weku mli ni 
wiemɔ shishifa lɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ baatsake. No ji akɛ, afisi henɔ nɛɛ tsakeɔ wiemɔ 
shishifa lɛ, wiemɔ weku ni eyɔɔ mli lɛ kɛyaa wiemɔ weku kroko mli. Afisi henɔ 
nɛɛ kɛ wiemɔ shishifa lɛ sɔɔ wiemɔi hee. Tamɔ; abaanyɛ ana wiemɔkuli tsɔɔmɔ 
‘teaching’ kɛji akɛ sɛɛ afisi –mɔ tsa wiemɔ shishifa tsɔɔ ‘teach’ nɔ. Yɛ nɛkɛ gbɛ 
nɔ lɛ, wiemɔ weku ni wiemɔ shishifa lɛ yɔɔ mli ni ji feemɔwiemɔ lɛ etsake kɛtee 
gbɛiwiemɔ mli.
Afisi ni tsakeee wiemɔ weku/Nɔnyɛɛ afisi: Enɛ ji afisi ni tsakeɔ wiemɔkuli lɛ kpojee 
pɛ shi etsakeee wiemɔweku ni eyɔɔ mli lɛ. Nɔnyɛɛ sɛɛ afisii tsakeee wiemɔkulibii 
lɛ ashishinumɔ ni asaŋ, esɔɔɔ wiemɔ hee. Nɔnyɛɛ afisi tsuɔ nɔ ko pɔtɛɛ tamɔ, yibɔ, 
be, kɛ nii kɛ nii. No ji akɛ, kɛji akɛ nɔynɛɛ afisi fata wiemɔkulibii ni yɛ ekome mli 
lɛ, etsakeɔ lɛ kɛfeɔ pii. Tamɔ; te baafee tɛŋŋ. Biɛ lɛ, jeee wiemɔi srɔtoi ji te kɛ tɛŋŋ 
loo amɛyɛ shishinumɔ srɔto ko.

TSALƆI
Tsalɔi: Tsalɔi ji wiemɔkulibii ni tsaa wiemɔkulibii krokomɛi, sanefafai loo sanekukuji. 
Tsalɔi haa afeɔ sanemuji haŋtsiŋŋ bɔ ni afee ni akafee sanemuji ganei babaoo. 
Amɛnitsumɔ ji akɛ amɛbaatsa wiemɔkulibii ni yɔɔ wiemɔ ko mli. Tsalɔi komɛi ji; ni, 
koni, ejaakɛ, tsɛbelɛ. Nomɛi ji tsalɔi ni wɔkɛtsuɔ nii yɛ wɔdaadaa sanegbaa mli. Nɔ ni 
baa nɛɛ ji nɔkwɛmɔnii ni tsɔɔ bɔ ni akɛ tsalɔi tsuɔ nii yɛ sanemuji amli.
Ekaseɔ nii hewɔ lɛ ele nii.

Nitsumɔ 3.5 Tsalɔi amligbalamɔ
Ha nikasemɔ yɛ klasi lɛ akudɔ bo ni ogbala nɔ ni ji tsalɔi amli yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ

Tsalɔ Henɔi
Ayɛ tsalɔi henɔi srɔtoi yɛ wiemɔi krokomɛi amli
1. Tsalɔi ni tsaa wiemɔi, sanekuku kɛ sanefafai enyɔ ni hiɛ tsiimɔ kome ji (coordinating 
conjunctions)
2. Tsalɔi enyɔ ni tsaa sanekukuji, sanefafai kɛ wiemɔkulibii ji (correlative conjunctions)
3. Tsalɔ ni tsaa sanemuji enyɔ ni ekome kpasaa ehefatalɔ lɛ ji (subordinating 
conjunctions)
Tsalɔ ni tsaa nibii enyɔ, ni hiɛ tsiimɔ kome (coordinating conjunctions) ŋmɛɔ gbɛ 
ni akɛ wiemɔkulibii, sanekukuji kɛ sanefafai ni hiɛ wiemɔweku kome tsaa. Nɔkwɛmɔ

Nifeemɔ 3.6 Tsalɔi kɛ sanemujifeemɔ
Ŋmalamɔ tsalɔi srɔtoi etɛ koni okɛ eko fɛɛ eko afee sanemuji. Bɔɔmɔdɛŋ koni okɛ 
oklasi lɛ asusu osanemuji lɛ ahe.
Tsalɔi hesɛɛnamɔi
Nɔhewɔ ni akɛ tsalɔi tsuɔ nii lɛ ekomɛi nɛ:
• Amɛgbalaa yiŋtoo yɛ sane ko mli.
• Amɛwaa ni akɛ sanekuku loo sanefa fataa sanemuu he.
• Amɛwaa kɛtsaa yiŋtoo gbohii enyɔ.
• Amɛwaa kɛtsaa yiŋtoo kpakpai enyɔ.
Sanemuji feemɔ kɛ tsalɔi
Mlai fioo ni he hiaa ni sɛɛnamɔi yɔɔ he he miihia yɛ tsalɔi kɛnitsumɔ mli. Mlai nɛɛ 
kɛnitsumɔ baaye abua wɔniŋmaa lɛ jogbaŋŋ. Tsalɔi yɛ kɛha susumɔi, nifeemɔi kɛ 
jwɛŋmɔi atsaramɔ.
• Tsalɔi waa akɛ yiŋtoo, nifeemɔi kɛ susumɔi tsaa.
• Tsalɔi waa kɛji aatsɛtsɛi nibii.
• Kɛji okɛ tsalɔi miitsu nii lɛ, kwɛmɔ akɛ sanemuji lɛ kɛ amɛhe nyiɛ ŋɛlɛ kome nɔ.
WIEMƆKULIBII ASƆƆ GBƐJIANƆTOO
Wiemɔkulibii asɔɔ gbɛjianɔtoo ji ŋaagbɛ ni akɛsɔɔ wiemɔkulibii hee yɛ wiemɔ pɔtɛɛ 
ko mli.
Ayɛ wiemɔkulibii asɔɔ gbɛjianɔtoo henɔi babaoo. Wiemɔ ko baanyɛ etsɔ gbɛjianɔtoo 
kome loo enyɔ ko mli ni ekɛna wiemɔkulibii hee. Gbɛjianɔtoi nɛɛ ekomɛi ji, Afoatsa, 
wiemɔnta, afolɔ nɔ, ama, afisi ni akɛtsaa wiemɔ shishifa, nɔtoonɔtoo. Abaawie 
wiemɔkulibii asɔɔ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ ekomɛi ahe.

a. Te otsɛɔ nibii komɛi ni yɛ ehee yɛ okutso lɛ mli tɛŋŋ (tamɔ tɛkinɔlɔji, susumɔi 
k.n.k.n)?

Wiemɔnta: Eji wiemɔkulibii srɔtoi enyɔ kɛ sɛɛ ni hiɛ shishinumɔi srɔtoi ni akɛtsa 
kɛfee wiemɔkuli. Wiemɔkulibii hee lɛ aaanyɛ ajɛ wiemɔ weku kroko mli. Abaanyɛ 
ana gbɛiwiemɔ kɛ gbɛiwiemɔ wiemɔnta, gbɛiwiemɔ kɛ feemɔwiemɔ wiemɔnta kɛ 
ekrokomɛi. Wiemɔnta nɔkwɛmɔnii komɛi ji; la + mlu = lamlu, saa + tso = 
saatso, sikli + tɛ = siklitɛ.
Nitsumɔ 3.8 Wiemɔnta mli wiemɔkulibii lɛ amlitsɔɔmɔ
Tsɔɔmɔ ankro ankro wiemɔkulibii ni yɔɔ wiemɔntai ni baa nɛɛ amli.

Wiemɔ sɔɔ gbɛjianɔtoo henɔ ko ni afolɔɔ wiemɔkulibii lɛ ekomɛi anɔ kɛfeɔ 
wiemɔkulibii hee. Abaanyɛ afo wiemɔkuli lɛ shishijee, teŋ loo naagbee blawa loo 
gbɛɛmɔ lɛ.
Tamɔ afoɔ gbɛi Akwele nɔ kɛfeɔ AK, Papa fio kɛfeɔ Paafio, Mami onukpa kɛfeɔ 
Maŋkpa, Tsɛ onukpa feɔ Tsɛŋkpa.
Ama
Wiemɔi komɛi maa wiemɔkulibii kɛjɛɔ wiemɔi krokomɛi amli. Anaa ama wiemɔi 
lɛ akɛ wiemɔi ni ama kɛba wiemɔ pɔtɛɛ ko mli. Gbɛjianɔtoo loo ŋaagbɛ ni akɛmaa 
wiemɔkulibii kɛjɛ wiemɔ ko mli kɛbaa wiemɔ kroko ko mli ji nɔ ni atsɛɔ akɛ 
wiemɔkulibii amaa. Wiemɔi babaoo ema wiemɔkulibii srɔtoi kɛjɛ wiemɔi krokomɛi 
amli. Ghana wiemɔi lɛ ekomɛi tete ema wiemɔkulibii kɛjɛ Ghana wiemɔ kui 
krokomɛi loo yɛ maŋsɛɛ wiemɔi lɛ amli.
Ama wiemɔi komɛi
Faneshiŋ (foundation), tɛlivishɛŋ (television), sɛmɛnti (cement), kɔmpiuta, knkn.
Ama Ga wiemɔkulibii nɛɛ fɛɛ kɛjɛ Blɔfo wiemɔ lɛ mli.

HIƐGBELEMƆ
Yɛ mlijaa nɛɛ mli lɛ, obaakase nii yɛ niŋmaa mli mlai tamɔ wiemɔkuku, wiemɔfa kɛ

mli. Abaagba sanemli gbalamɔ okadii hu ahe sane kɛ bɔ ni akɛbaatsu nii hu he sane. 
Nilee ni yɔɔ wiemɔ mli mlai ahe yeɔ buaa kɛfeɔ sanemuji ni shishinumɔ yɔɔ mli kɛ 
saji tamɔ sane nta kɛ haŋtsiŋŋ fɛɛ. Enɛ yeɔ buaa bo kɛnuɔ nikasemɔ tamɔ blɔfo wiemɔ

SUSUMƆ OTII
• Sanekuku nyɛɔ efeɔ wiemɔkuli kome loo wiemɔ ku ko ni tsuɔ enii akɛ wiemɔ henɔ 
kome yɛ wiemɔ ko mli. Wiemɔkuku ko nyɛɔ hiɛɔ wiemɔi ni jɛ henɔ oti kome mli taakɛ 
gbɛiwiemɔ sanekuku, feemɔwiemɔ sanekuku, kadilɔ/sutsɔɔlɔ sanekuku, gbɛhegbɛi 
sanekuku kɛ mligbalalɔ sanekuku.
•  Sanefa ji wiemɔkulibii ni abua amɛnaa ni nyɛɔ feɔ sanemuu. Anaa feelɔ kɛ nifeemɔ 
ni akɛfeɔ sanemuu loo sanefa lɛ mli fa ko.
• Yɛ niŋmaa mli lɛ, okadii ni yeɔ buaa ni shishinumɔ tsuɔ nii jogbaŋŋ lɛ ji niŋmaa 
mlitserɛmɔ okadii, ni ekomɛi ji omashi (.), omashi alɔgɔ(;), omashi omashi (:), kɛ 
nɔtsɛ okadi (‘).

Sanekuku henɔi
Sanekukuji henɔi enumɔ lɛ ji gbɛiwiemɔ sanekuku, feemɔwiemɔ sanekuku, kadilɔ/
sutsɔɔlɔ sanekuku, mligbalalɔ sanekuku kɛ gbɛhegbɛi sanekuku. Anaa gbɛhegbɛi 
sanekuku yɛ Ghana wiemɔi fioo ko pɛ amli. Please note that an adjective phrase 
is different from adjectival phrase. Kadimɔ loo mligbalamɔ sanekuku (Adjectival 
or adverbial phrases) ji gbɛi ni akɛhaa wiemɔkulibii/sanekuku ni amɛjɛɛɛ kadilɔi 
loo mligbalalɔi awekui lɛ amli shi moŋ amɛtsuɔ nakai wiemɔweku lɛ nitsumɔ (lɛ 
amɛsusuɔ gbɛiwiemɔ loo feemɔwiemɔ lɛ amɛtsɔɔ).

efeɔ wiemɔkuli kome pɛ. Nɔkwɛmɔ nibii komɛi baa adeka ni yɔɔ shishi lɛ mli lɛ:
Adeka 4.1: Gbɛiwiemɔ jebɔ kɛ shikamɔ.

HIƐGBELEMƆ
Mlijaa nɛɛ gbeleɔ nilee ni yɔɔ saneŋmaa kɛ saneshishitsɔɔmɔ hiɛ ehaa kaselɔi lɛ. 
Yɛ saneŋmaa mlijaa lɛ mli lɛ, obaana saneŋmaa srɔtoi kɛ bɔ ni aŋmaa lɛ ahaa. 
Saneŋmaa henɔi enyɔ ni yitso nɛɛ baakwɛ lɛ ji agwaseiaŋ saneŋmaa kɛ nanemɛi 
asaneŋmaa. Abaaha bo nilee kɛ hesalɛ ni akɛyɔseɔ henɔi lɛ koni oŋma yɛ owiemɔ 
ni okaseɔ lɛ mli. Mlijaa nɛɛ baasaa ekwɛ saneshishitsɔɔmɔ kɛjɛ wiemɔ ko mli kɛya 
wiemɔ kroko mli. Wɔbaasaa wɔgba sane yɛ saneshishitsɔɔmɔ henɔi lɛ, wiemɔkulibii, 
kɛ saneshishitsɔɔmɔ ni shishinumɔ yɔɔ mli he. Abaaha bo nilee kɛ hesalɛ ni baaye 
abua bo kɛtsɔɔ sane ni aha shishi kɛba Ga wiemɔ lɛ mli ni esaa etsɔɔ shishi kɛjɛ Ga 
wiemɔ lɛ mli kɛya blɔfo wiemɔ lɛ mli.
SUSUMƆ OTII
• Akɛ agwaseiaŋ sane yahaa hesalɔ ko ni hiɛ gbɛnaa.
• Akɛ naanyo majemɔ wolo yahaa wekunyo, naanyo loo shieŋnyɛ/tsɛ.
• Saneŋmaa ji bɔ ni niŋmalɔ ko toɔ esusumɔi anaa yɛ niŋmaa mli ni ekɛwoɔ woji anɔ.
• Naawiemɔ saneŋmaa ji ni okɛ osusumɔi baashwie wolo nɔ koni okane oha toibolɔi.
• Saneshishitsɔɔmɔ ji ni obaatsɔɔ sane shishi kɛjɛ wiemɔ ko mli kɛya ekroko mli ni 
shishinumɔ lɛ elaajeee.
SANEŊMAA
Saneŋmaa ji bɔ ni niŋmalɔ ko baato eyiŋtoi anaa yɛ niŋmaa mli eha. Saneŋmaa 
henɔi ejwɛ ni ahe awo mli lɛ ji susumɔkɛtsɔɔmɔ saneŋmaa, gbaa saneŋmaa, 
kadaagbamɔ kɛ nɔkofeemɔ saneŋmaa. Niŋmaa kpakpa hiɛɔ saneŋmaa henɔi srɔtoi.
Saneŋmaa henɔi
Ayɛ saneŋmaa henɔi ejwɛ. Nomɛi ji susumɔkɛtsɔɔmɔ, gbaa saneŋmaa, nɔkofeemɔ 
kɛ kadaagbamɔ saneŋmaa.

Miweku lɛ yɛ shia
Miweku lɛ yɛ shia bibioo ko mli. Shia fioo shi eyɛ fɛo. Abɔɔ agbo yɛ shia lɛ mli. Misumɔɔ 
akɛ matsu nii yɛ abɔɔ lɛ mli, shi minyɛmi yoo lɛ sumɔɔɔ abɔɔ lɛ mli nitsumɔ. Esumɔɔ 
nikanemɔ moŋ fe abɔɔ lɛ mli nitsumɔ lɛ. Ekaneɔ nii leebi, shwane, gbɛkɛ kɛ jenamɔ fɛɛ.
Mikɛ aduawai lɛ haa mami kɛ papa. Amɛsumɔɔ nihoomɔ yɛ wɔkpata bibioo lɛ mli. 
Miyeɔ aduawa fɛɛ aduawa, shi minyɛmi yoo lɛ sumɔɔ fioo ko kɛkɛ.
Miweku lɛ fɛɛ yeɔ shwane kɛ gbɛkɛ niyenii kome. Wɔgbaa sane ni wɔŋmɔɔ. Ni minyɛmi 
yoo lɛ shaa plɛtei lɛ amli.
Jenamɔ mli lɛ, mipapa sumɔɔ ni ebo lala toi. Mami tsuɔ nii yɛ kɔmpiuta lɛ nɔ. Misumɔɔ 
tɛlivishɛŋ kwɛmɔ. Ni minyɛmi yoo lɛ kaneɔ nii.
Be fioo sɛɛ lɛ wɔyawɔɔ. Mifɔlɔi tsɛɔ dani amɛyawɔɔ shi mikɛ minyɛmi yoo lɛ yawɔɔ 
mra.. Mifee klalo akɛ mawɔ shi minyɛmi yoo lɛ miitao akɛ etsa enikanemɔ lɛ nɔ.
Gbaasane ŋmaa
Saneŋmaa henɔ nɛɛ kɔɔ niŋmalɔ lɛ nibii amli ni etsɔmɔ yɛ ewalashihilɛ mli he. 
Kaselɔi tsɔɔ adesatamɔ sui anɔ kɛŋmaa sane nɛɛ.
Nɔkwɛmɔ nɔ: Miklɛŋklɛŋ gbi yɛ misukuu lɛ loo nɔ ko ni etee nɔ ni oye he odase 
nyɛɔ feɔ gbaa sane. Yɛ niŋmaa nɛɛ mli lɛ otsɔɔ nɔ ni mli otsɔmɔ ni okɛ mɛi jaa.
Nɔkofeemɔ saneŋmaa
Saneŋmaa henɔ nɛɛ biɔ ni otao nibii amli koni ona adafitswaa ni he hiaa jogbaŋŋ 
lɛ kɛpia oniŋmaa lɛ koni okwɛ mɛi krokomɛi asusumɔi hu. Saneŋmaa nɛɛ biɔ ni 
niŋmalɔ lɛ akwɛ susulɔi krokomɛi hu ayiŋtoi yɛ yitsei komɛi ahe ni amɛkɛtsu nii. 
Ehaa adafitswaa yɛ yitso lɛ he. Nɔkwɛmɔ nɔ: Saneŋmaa yɛ Ghana henɔyeli lɛ he: 
yɛ enɛ mli lɛ ŋmalɔ lɛ baagba Ghana blema sane, ebaatsɔɔ be ni akɛna henɔyeli lɛ, 
mɛi ni damɔ shi no bei lɛ amli, kɛ heyeli sɛɛ maŋkuramɔ gbɛjianɔtoi, knkn.
Kadaagbamɔ saneŋmaa
Saneŋmaa henɔ nɛɛ kpaa gbɛ akɛ kaselɔ lɛ agbɛlɛ shi kɛtao adafitswaa yɛ yitso ni 
aha lɛ he, koni ehala mli, ejie ekomɛi yɛ mli ni ekɛ ekrokomɛi afata he koni esane 
lɛ hiɛ aka shi faŋŋ kɛgba ekadaa lɛ. Nɔkwɛmɔ nɔ, ‘Yei ni hiɛɔ gbɛnaa yɛ amralo mli 
baa amɛhe shi fe amɛtipɛŋfoi hii lɛ.’ Yɛ enɛ feemɔ mli lɛ aakpa gbɛ akɛ kadaagbalɔ 
lɛ baabua otii ni ehiɛ lɛ anaa koni eto amɛ bɔ ni etaoɔ lɛ. Nɛkɛ lɛ, enyɛɔ ewieɔ ehaa 
loo ewieɔ eshiɔ yitso lɛ.
Nɔkwɛmɔ nibii krokomɛi baa yɛ kadaagbamɔ saneŋmaa yitsei ahe
1. Namɔ he yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ jogbaŋŋ? Datrɛfonyo aloo tsɔɔlɔ.
2. Okwaafonyo kɛ iŋjinia, namɔ he yɔɔ sɛɛnamɔ fe enaanyo?
3. Tsɔɔmɔ nɔ ni osumɔɔ, sukuu ni awɔɔ jɛmɛ kɛ nɔ ni awɔɔɔ jɛmɛ koni otsɔɔ nɔ 
hewɔ ni okɔ nɔ ni osumɔɔ lɛ.
4. Te enɛmɛi ateŋ nɔ ni osumɔɔ, hii kɛ yei asukuu kɛ hii pɛ aloo yei pɛ asukuu?

Saneŋmaa jebɔ ni ehiɛ
Saneŋmaa hiɛ mlijaramɔi etɛ, nomɛi ji hiɛgbelemɔ, sanetso kɛ naamuu
Hiɛgbelemɔ
Hiɛgbelemɔ: Enɛ ni gbeleɔ yitso lɛ hiɛ ni ekpaa he mama. Onyɛɔ okɛ sanebimɔ, 
yibɔi loo wiemɔmuu ko ni mɔɔ jwɛŋmɔ jeɔ shishi. Yɛ enɛfeemɔ mli lɛ, obaanyɛ 
okpa yitso lɛ he mama kɛ adafitswaa ko ni sa akɛ kanelɔi ale.
Sanetso lɛ
Biɛ ji he ni ofɔteɔ otii lɛ fɛɛ oshwieɔ shi yɛ, mlihalamɔ sanegbaa, kadaagbamɔ, 
k.n.k.n. Biɛ ji he ni okɛ sanemuu oti lɛ fɔɔ jaraŋ yɛ, kadaagbamɔ yitso lɛ tsɔɔmɔ ni 
ogbalaa mli otsɔɔ kanelɔi lɛ kɛ nibii ni mamɔɔ nɔ mii. Nɔ ni baa nɛɛ tsɔɔ nibii ni 
yɔɔ kadaagbamɔ sanetso lɛ mli. Sanemuji ni tsaraa mlijaramɔi lɛ. Wo yitso kroko 
nɔ yɛ kadaagbamɔ lɛ he koni ogbala mli ni okɛ okadii ni baaye abua kadaagbamɔ 
lɛ afata he.
•  Okɛ sanemuu kroko ni kɛ bo baaya kuku kroko nɔ lɛ atsa nɔ.
• Okɛ sanemuu oti ni wieɔ shiɔ yitso lɛ atsa nɔ.
• Gbalamɔ mli koni oha nibii ni tsɔɔ akɛ nɔ ni owieɔ lɛ anukwale, ni eyɛ mli.
• Kaahe owo mli akɛ nɔ ni awieɔ he lɛ anukwale ni okɛbɛŋkɛ naamuu lɛ.
Naamuu
Naamuu lɛ ji he ni niŋmalɔ lɛ buaa esusumɔi lɛ anaa yɛ kɛmuɔ naa. Nɔ ni nyiɛ sɛɛ 
nɛɛ ji gbɛi anɔ ni atsɔɔ kɛmuɔ naa.
• Doomɔ susumɔ otii lɛ anɔ.
• Maa oshidaamɔ lɛ nɔ mi.
• Okɛ naamuu sanemuu lɛ ama shi.
Nitsumɔ 5.1 Kadaagbamɔ saneŋmaa
Yɛ bo diɛŋtsɛ owiemɔi amli lɛ, tsɔɔmɔ nɔ ni kadaagbamɔ saneŋmaa ji koni otsɔɔ 
otii ni ehiɛ. Jwɛŋmɔ susumɔi kɛ hwanejee wiemɔi ni onu da yɛ yitso lɛ he yɛ owala 
beiaŋ fɛɛ. Mɛni he kadaagbamɔ nɛɛ kɔɔ? Mɛɛ otii ji nɔ ni obaahe owo mli? Ani 
shishinumɔ nyɛ ba pɛpɛɛpɛ?
Nitsumɔ 5.2 Feemɔ ni akwɛ
Yɛ mɛi enyɔnyɔɔnyɔ akui amli lɛ, nyɛgbaa kadaa yɛ yitso ko he ni mɔ kome miiwie 
eha yitso lɛ ni mɔ kroko lɛ hu miiwie eeshi yitso lɛ. “Be fitemɔ yɛ weku kɛ nanemɛi 
ahe he miihia fe be ni akɛkaseɔ nii”

NAAWIEMƆ KƐ “ARTICLE” SANEŊMAA
Mligbalamɔ ni yɔɔ naawiemɔ ŋmaa kɛ article teŋ
Naawiemɔ ŋmaa
Naawiemɔ saneŋmaa ji gbɛjianɔtoo ni akɛ yiŋtoi kɛ susumɔi haa toibolɔi kɛ kanelɔi. 
Srɔtoi kpakpa ko bɛ naawiemɔi saneŋmaa kɛ gbaa saji ateŋ.
Article
Enɛ ji niŋmaa ko ni akɛhaa mɛi babaoo koni amɛna nɔ ni yaa nɔ kɛtsɔ adafitswaa 
woji amli. Adafitswaa woji lɛ ji hei ni aŋmalaa adafitswaa woji nɛɛ yɛ lɛ ni blɔfo 
tsɛɔ lɛ “Press Houses” lɛ. Ni amɛŋmalaa magazines, journals, adafitswaa woji tamɔ 
Daily Graphic, Ghanaian Times, Daily Guide kɛ ekrokomɛi pii.
Jebɔ ni naawiemɔ ŋmaa hiɛɔ
Toibolɔi ahalamɔ, yitsokɔmɔ, nibii ni ahe hiaa sɛɛdii kɛ jebɔ ni yitso nɛɛ hiɛ, kɛji 
ona nibii nɛɛ fɛɛ lɛ, bɛ bei eshɛ ni obaaŋma naawiemɔ lɛ.

Mlijaramɔi ni naawiemɔi hiɛ
Naawiemɔi hiɛ mlijaramɔi ejwɛ nɛɛ.
1. Ŋamɔ
Klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ ji ŋamɔ. Obaaŋa otoibolɔi loo kanelɔi lɛ kɛkɛ lɛ ojie ohe shi otsɔɔ 
amɛ. Kpeemɔ amɛ kɛba nifeemɔ lɛ shishi. Nɔkwɛmɔ nɔ, Nanemɛi, Nyɛmimɛi 
Ghana bii, Hiɛnaanɔbii, Niimɛi kɛ naamɛi, kɛ nii kɛ nii.
2. Hiɛgbelemɔ
Yɛ hiɛgbelemɔ lɛ mli lɛ, ojieɔ ohe kpo otsɔɔ, ni okɛ sane ni ohiɛ oti lɛ ŋmɛɔ 
jaraŋ. Nɔkwɛmɔ nɔ: Miitsi kɛbɛŋkɛ nyɛ shwane nɛɛ koni maha nyɛle he ni wɔkɛ 
gbɛjianɔtoo ni baasa nibii fɔɔji ni yaa nɔ yɛ akutso lɛ mli lɛ eshɛ.
3. Naawiemɔ lɛ sanetso
Yɛ biɛ lɛ, esa akɛ ole nɔ fɛɛ nɔ ni yɔɔ yitso he ni obaawie lɛ fitsofitso. Biɛ ji he 
ni obaaŋma/obaatsɔɔ nɔ fɛɛ nɔ mli fitsofitso yɛ yitso ni ohiɛ lɛ he lɛ yɛ.
4. Naamuu
Yɛ naamuu lɛ mli lɛ, bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ koni oshi otoibolɔi lɛ oti ko, ni amɛsusu he. 
Nɔkwɛmɔ nɔ: Mibɔ mɔdɛŋ mikɛ heni nibii eshɛ lɛ efɔ jaraŋ kɛ maŋnyo fɛɛ 
maŋnyo gbɛnaa nitsumɔ ni sa akɛ efee kɛye abua helai gbohii tamɔ atridii ni 
gbɛɔ shwaa nɛɛ anaatsii yɛ wɔkutsei nɛɛ amli. Eji wɔhemɔkɛyeli akɛ maŋbii fɛɛ 
kɛ amɛhebaawo nifeemɔ nɛɛ mli kɛye amɛbua hela ni gbɛɔ shwaa nɛɛ shishifaa 
yɛ wɔkutso lɛ mli.

Sɛɛnamɔi ni yɔɔ nyɛ awo wiemɔ kɛ nikasemɔ he
Akɛ Hai Sukuu nikaselɔ lɛ, bei pii baa ni sa akɛ otsake wiemɔ ni owieɔ yɛ okɛ mɛi 
asharamɔi amli, kɛjɛ okɛ wekumɛi kɛ nanemɛi asharamɔi amli kɛyashi sukuu nikasemɔi 
amli yɛ klasi lɛ. Fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, ani osusu he da, sɛɛnamɔi ni yɔɔ nyɛ awo wiemɔ he yɛ 
onikasemɔ mli?
Shigbɛlɛmɔ etsɔɔ krɛdɛɛ akɛ kaselɔi ni nuɔ, ni amɛwieɔ nyɛ awo wiemɔ kɛkaseɔ nii lɛ 
bɔɔ amɛhe mɔdɛŋ yɛ nikasemɔ mli fe mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, titri lɛ yɛ nikanemɔ kɛ niŋmaa 
mli. Ebaa lɛ nakai ejaakɛ nyɛ awo wiemɔ lɛ haa kaselɔ lɛ nikasemɔ mli shishifa kpakpa 
kɛha wiemɔ mli hesalɛ ni ehaa nikasemɔ yɛ wiemɔi amli feɔ mlɛo ni onuɔ nilee ni yɔɔ 
haŋtsiŋ shishi mra.
Kɛfata he lɛ, mɔ ko nyɛ awo wiemɔ kɛ nikasemɔ haa enuɔ kusumi nikasemɔi lɛ ashishi 
jogbaŋŋ. Wiemɔ ji kusumi, ni kɛji onyɛɔ owieɔ ku lɛ wiemɔ lɛ, ehaa kaselɔi lɛ nuɔ 
shikwɛɛ kusumi yɛ wiemɔ lɛ mli lɛ shishi jogbaŋŋ ni ehaa amɛnuɔ shikwɛɛbii lɛ ashishi 
ni amɛnyaa nifeemɔi lɛ ahe.
Kɛfata he ekoŋŋ lɛ, shigbɛlɛmɔ etsɔɔ akɛ kaselɔi ni yɔɔ naatselɛ yɛ nyɛ awo wiemɔ lɛ 
mli ajwɛŋmɔ mli egbele ni amɛnaa hesalɛ fe mɛi krokomɛi lɛ, ni amɛkaiɔ nii, amɛkuraa 
haomɔi ni amɛsusuɔ nibii ahe jogbaŋŋ. Ejaakɛ nyɛ awo wiemɔ ji nɔ ni yɔɔ ejwɛŋmɔ lɛ 
mli ni ehe shi yɛ mli hu ni no ji nɔ ni ekɛwieɔ yɛ esharamɔi titrii lɛ amli.
Naagbee lɛ, nyɛ awo wiemɔ he hiaa jogbaŋŋ yɛ kaselɔ lɛ nikasemɔ mli, ehaa anaa ku 
mli ni ejɛ kɛ ejwɛŋmɔ mligbelemɔ. Akɛ Hai Sukuu nikaselɔ lɛ, ehe miihia akɛ omɔ nyɛ 
awo wiemɔ mli koni okɛtsɔse ohe, kɛji ookase wiemɔi krokomɛi tete po koni okɛye obua 
onikasemɔ lɛ.
Nitsumɔ 5.8 “Article”/ Naawiemɔ ŋmaa
 Yɛ kui amli lɛ, nyɛŋmalaa article loo naawiemɔi ni hiɛ kukuji etɛ yɛ yitso ni baa 
nɛɛ he: nɔyaa yɛ misukuu lɛ mli. Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ okɛ gbɛjianɔtoi ni yɔɔ “article”/
naawiemɔ ŋmaa mli lɛ fɛɛ aŋma nii lɛ. Feemɔ klalo akɛ okɛ onitsumɔ baaha klasi 
lɛ koni amɛsusu he.

srɔtoi anɔ ni kpaa gbɛ akɛ aaŋma ayaha onukpa ko loo hesalɔ ko ni hiɛ maŋ

Agwaseiaŋ woloŋmaa jebɔi kɛ gbɛjianɔtoo
Nibii ni baa nɛɛ ji jebɔi kɛ gbɛjianɔtoi ni yɔɔ agwaseiaŋ woloŋmaa he.
1. Woloŋmalɔ lɛ adrɛsi: Enɛ ji klɛŋklɛŋ nɔ loo shishijee. Okɛ odrɛsi woɔ wolo lɛ 
ŋwɛigbɛ ninejurɔ. Kadimɔ akɛ ebaajɛ jebɔ ni okɛtsuɔ nii lɛ, obaanyɛ oŋma yɛ 
ŋwɛi abɛkugbɛ
2. Be: Gbi ni okɛŋmaa wolo lɛ.
3. Mɔ ni oŋmaa oyaha lɛ adrɛsi: Mɔ ni oŋmaa oyaha lɛ gbɛnaa/adrɛsi yɛ abɛku 
gbɛ yɛ wolo lɛ nɔ.
4. Ŋamɔ: Ŋamɔ ni sa (Director, Onukpa, Gbɛtsɔɔlɔ, Awulaa Owulaŋa, Maŋsɔɔlɔ 
knkn)
5. Yitso: Oti hewɔ ni oŋmaa wolo lɛ yɛ okadi wuji amli. Adoɔ nɔ kɛjɛɔ nɔ hewɔ 
ni oŋmaa wolo lɛ mli.
6. Hiɛgbelemɔ: Sanemuu ni miitsɔɔ nɔ hewɔ ni oŋmaa wolo lɛ
7. Mlijaramɔi: Oti fɛɛ oti ni obaawie he lɛ biɔ ni ena mlijaa kome. Enɛ yeɔ buaa 
mɔ ni oŋmaa oyaha lɛ ni enuɔ nɔ hewɔ ni oŋmaa wolo lɛ shishi jogbaŋŋ.
8. Naamuu: Naamuu lɛ atsɔɔ nɔ hewɔ ni ŋmalɔ lɛ ŋmaa ewolo lɛ loo eti sane oti 
hewɔ ni eŋmaa wolo lɛ mli kɛmu naa.
Kɛji ooŋma agwaseiaŋ wolo lɛ, ha ni oniŋmaa lɛ afee faŋŋ, kuku ni enyiɛ eŋɛlɛ nɔ. 
Bɔɔ mɔdɛŋ akɛ gbee ni okɛŋmaa wolo lɛ afee heshibaa gbee, jeee mlifu loo gbee ni 
etee ŋwɛi, koni onyiɛ gbɛjianɔtoo ni ja nɔ koni ana akɛ ohiɛ edɔ yɛ nɔ ni otaoɔ lɛ

SANEMLITSƆƆMƆ
Sanemlitsɔɔmɔ ji gbɛjianɔtoo ni akɛtsakeɔ wiemɔ shishi kɛjɛɔ wiemɔ ko mli kɛyaa 
wiemɔ kroko mli. Wiemɔ mli ni sane lɛ yɔɔ lɛ ji he ni sane lɛ jɛ, ni wiemɔ mli ni 
atsɔɔ shishi kɛyaa lɛ ji wiemɔ mli ni akɛyaa.
Otii anɔ ni akwɛɔ kɛtsɔɔ sane shishi
Saneshishitsɔɔmɔ biɔ ni atsɔ gbɛjianɔtoi pɔtɛɛ komɛi anɔ, hesalɛ ni akɛpɛɔ sane 
mli, koni anu sane lɛ shishi dani atsɔɔ shishi kɛjɛ wiemɔ ko mli kɛya ekroko mli. 
Nɔ ni baa nɛɛ ji gbɛjianɔtoi ni kulaa nitsumɔ lɛ:
1. Hiɛgbelemɔ nifeemɔi: Anu srɔtoi ni yɔɔ saneshishitsɔɔmɔ kɛ wiemɔ mligbalamɔ 
mli, kɛ kusum naa hesɛɛnamɔi.
2. Ana nikanemɔ mli hesalɛ: Ana akɛ obaanyɛ okane wiemɔ mli ni sane lɛ yɔɔ lɛ 
ni onu shishi fitsofitso.
3. Apɛi sane lɛ mli: Ayɔse sane henɔ ni ji, gbee ni akɛŋma sane lɛ, kɛ mɛi ahewɔ 
ni aŋma.
4. Akwɛ saneshishitsɔɔmɔ gbɛjianɔtoi lɛ anɔ: Akwɛ saneshishitsɔɔmɔ hesalɛi tamɔ:
i. Wiemɔkulibii ashishitsɔɔmɔ kɛ ni onu sane shishi ni otsɔɔ shishi
ii. Ni akwɛ kusum mli ni atsɔɔ shishi kɛyaa lɛ henɔ
iii. Fɔŋwiemɔi kɛnitsumɔ
iv. Wiemɔ lɛ shishinumɔ yɛ sane mli
5. Kaa saneshishitsɔɔmɔ okwɛ: Jee enɛ shishi kɛjɛ sane ni shishinumɔ yɔɔ mlɛo 
kɛya nɔ ni shishinumɔ mli kwɔ loo haŋtsiŋŋ.
6.  Maa shishinumɔ kpɛŋŋ nɔ mi koni oye anɔkwale: Ha shishinumɔ atsu nii koni 
ona shishinumɔ ni yɔɔ sanemuji lɛ amli ni ofee lɛ nakai.
7. Okɛ tsɔji kɛ hesalɛi krokomɛi atsu nii: Okɛ saneshishitsɔɔmɔ gbɛjianɔtoi, hesalɛi 
kɛ tsɔji kɛ wiemɔkulibii ahe woji atsu nii, Kaashi intanɛti nɔ yelikɛbuamɔi hu,
8. Nanemɛi akwɛ onitsumɔ lɛ mli: Nanemɛi akwɛ onitsumɔ lɛ mli ni amɛwo ŋaa 
kpakpai.
9. Tsa nɔ kɛya saji srɔtoi ni mliwala: Tsa nɔ kɛya saji pɔtɛɛ komɛi amli tamɔ mla 
saji, datrɛfoi asaji kɛ dadei kɛ tsɔji ahe nifeemɔi amli saji koni otao emli hesalɛi.
10. Yaa nɔ ni otsu mli nii: Taomɔ hegbɛi kɛya nɔ ni otsu mli nii koni ona 
saneshishitsɔɔmɔ mli hesalɛ. .

Saneshishitsɔɔmɔ henɔi
Ayɛ saneshishitsɔɔmɔ henɔi srɔtoi. Fɛɛ sɛɛ lɛ, nikasemɔ nɛɛ baakwɛ henɔi ni baa 
nɛɛ.
1. Wiemɔ kɛ wiemɔ shishitsɔɔmɔ: Wiemɔ kɛ wiemɔ shishitsɔɔmɔ kpɛŋŋ ni jeee yɛ 
sane mli shishinumɔ.
2. Saneshishitsɔɔmɔ faŋŋ: Henɔ nɛɛ tsɔɔ sane shishi ni eje kpo faŋŋ taakɛ eyɔɔ yɛ 
he ni ejɛ lɛ, fɔŋwiemɔi feɔ shishinumɔ faŋŋ kɛ gbee ni yɔɔ sane lɛ mli lɛ jeɔ kpo 
jogbaŋŋ ni kɛ shishinumɔ baa.
3. Akwɛɔ kusum mli ni sane lɛ jɛ kɛ kusum mli ni atsɔɔ shishi kɛyaa lɛ, ni akwɛɔ 
srɔtoi kɛ hegbɔyeli ni akɛtsuɔ nii.
4. Shishitsɔɔmɔ ni tamɔ sane lɛ yɛ ejɛɛhe lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ: Saneshishitsɔɔmɔ ni 
shishinumɔ lɛ tamɔ bɔ ni eyɔɔ yɛ he ni ejɛ lɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
5. Mligbalamɔ: Enɛ lɛ saneshishitsɔɔmɔ ni jɛɔ naa, ni aŋmako. Afɔɔ kɛnitsumɔ yɛ 
kpei amli loo kɔɔtu.
6. Saneshishitsɔɔmɔ ni feɔ nɔ: Saneshishitsɔɔmɔ ni shishinumɔ lɛ feɔ nɔ kɛji 
akɛmiito sane lɛ he kɛmiijɛ ejɛɛhe lɛ. Nɛkɛ shishitsɔɔmɔ nɛɛ kɛ eko gbeɔ yi loo 
jieɔ eko kɛjɛɔ sane lɛ mli.
7. Shishinumɔ saneshishitsɔɔmɔ: Enɛ ji saneshishitsɔɔmɔ ni kwɛɔ sane lɛ 
shishinumɔ fɛɛ ni yɔɔ sane lɛ mli kɛmiijɛ ejɛɛhe lɛ kɛ nɔ hewɔ ni atsɔɔ shishi lɛ, 
ni jeee wiemɔ kɛ wiemɔ shishitsɔɔmɔ, gbɛjianɔtoo nɛɛ kwɛɔ sanetso lɛ, yiŋtoo, 
kusum naa nifeemɔi ni sa kɛ ehenɔi nibii ni sa.
Saneshishitsɔɔmɔ kaakɛkwɛmɔ
Saneshishitsɔɔmɔ nitsumɔi komɛi baa nɛɛ:
1. Sanemuu flo: Tsɔɔmɔ sanemuu flo nɛɛ shishi kɛba owiemɔ lɛ mli, kwɛmɔ 
anɔkwayeli kɛ wiemɔ mli mlai.
2. Fɔŋwiemɔi: Kaa fɔŋwiemɔi ashishitsɔɔmɔ, plasheele, kɛ feemɔwiemɔ sanekukuji.
3. Sane mlijaramɔ kukuji: Tsɔɔmɔ sane kukuji ashishi kɛya owiemɔ lɛ mli.
4 Yitso-sane pɔtɛɛ ko: Tsɔɔmɔ sane ni kɔɔ mla he, helatsamɔ nifeemɔi, tsɔnei kɛ 
hesalɛ nifeemɔi ahe, wiemɔ otii komɛi kɛ wiemɔ otii.
4. Naawiemɔi: Tsɔɔmɔ naawiemɔ saji komɛi ashishi (e.g. lalawiemɔi, shwɛmɔi, 
kɛ adesai kukuji) koni oka gbee, samai, kɛ kusum nifeemɔi komɛi kɛ mliwoo
5. Adafitswaa saji: Kaa adafitswaa saji komɛi ashishitsɔɔmɔ kɛ akwɛɛmɔhiɛgbee. 
anɔkwale saji okwɛ
6. Sanegbaa: Kaa saneshishitsɔɔmɔ (e.g. sanegbaa , daaŋtaa) koni okwɛ wielɔ lɛ 
yiŋtoo kɛ gbee ni ekɛwieɔ lɛ.
7. Saneshishitsɔɔmɔ kɛ hetoo: Okɛ osaneshishitsɔɔmɔ lɛ ato mɔ kroko nɔ lɛ he 
(e.g. mɛi ni he esa yɛ saneshishitsɔɔmɔ mli anitsumɔ kɛ ekrokomɛi tamɔ nɔ ni 
tsɔne ye bua kɛtsɔɔ shishi kɛye abua ohesalɛnamɔ.
8. Shishitsɔɔmɔ nitsumɔ ni oha ohe: Ha ohe nitsumɔ bo diɛŋtsɛ.
9. Nanemɛi akwɛ mli amɛha bo: Okɛ onaanyo atsake nitsumɔ ni nyɛtsu lɛ. Kwɛmɔ 
enɔ lɛ mli koni lɛ hu ekwɛ onɔ lɛ mli ni ewie onɔ lɛ he, koni bo hu owie enɔ lɛ 
he kɛye abua nyɛnɔyaa.

The Environment
In our modern world, there are many factors that place the wellbeing of the planet in 
jeopardy. While some people have the opinion that environmental problems are just 
a natural occurrence, others believe that human beings have a huge impact on the 
environment. Regardless of your viewpoint, take into consideration the following factors 
that place our environment as well as the planet Earth in danger.
Global warming or climate change is a major contributing factor to environmental 
damage. Because of global warming, we have seen an increase in melting ice caps, a 
rise in sea levels, and the formation of new weather patterns. These weather patterns 
have caused stronger storms, droughts, and flooding in places that they formerly did 
not occur.
Air pollution is primarily caused as a result of excessive and unregulated emissions of 
carbon dioxide into the air. Pollutants mostly emerge from the burning of fossil fuels 
in addition to chemicals, toxic substances, and improper waste disposal. Air pollutants 
are absorbed into the atmosphere, and they can cause smog, a combination of smoke 
and fog, in valleys as well as produce acidic precipitation in areas far away from the 
pollution source.
In many areas, people and local governments do not sustainably use their natural 
resources. Mining for natural gases, deforestation, and even improper use of water 
resources can have tremendous effects on the environment. While these strategies often 
attempt to boost local economies, their effects can lead to oil spills, interrupted animal 
habitats, and droughts.
Ultimately, the effects of the modern world on the environment can lead to many 
problems. Human beings need to consider the repercussions of their actions, trying 
to reduce, reuse, and recycle materials while establishing environmentally sustainable 
habits. If measures are not taken to protect the environment, we can potentially witness 
the extinction of more endangered species, worldwide pollution, and a completely 
uninhabitable planet.

HIƐGBELEMƆ
Mlijaa nɛɛ naa gbalamlibotemɔ akɛ blema nifeemɔ gbɛjianɔtoo ni atswa ama shi 
akɛ kusumnaa hegbɛi ni. Oti ni ehiɛ ji ekwɛɔ kusumnaa gbalamlibotemɔ nilee 
lɛ hegbɛi ni yɔɔ he, gbalamlibotemɔ henɔi, sɛɛnamɔi ni yɔɔ gbalamlibotemɔ mli 
hegbɛi lɛ ahe. Gbɛjianɔtoi ni yɔɔ gbala nifeemɔi ahe yɛ kusumnaa hu baaje kpo yɛ 
yitso nɛɛ shishi. Nilee ni yɔɔ mlijaa nɛɛ mli lɛ baaye abua koni onu gbalashihilɛ 
shishi jogbaŋŋ yɛ okusum lɛ kɛ kusumi krokomɛi lɛ amli. Obaasusu gbalamlibotemɔ 
gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ he ni obaakwɛ kusumi krokomɛi lɛ hu, ni okɛbaato ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ 
nɔ ni afeɔ ni esaa kusumnaa nifeemɔi ahe lɛ fɛɛ. Bɔ ni ato nibii agbɛnɔi kɛ nɔ ni 
afeɔ ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ yɛ gbalashihilɛ mli lɛ, kɛ nɔ ni yaa nɔ yɛ kusumi krokomɛi amli 
lɛ baaye abua mɛi krokomɛi akusumi lɛ ashishinumɔ. Obaanu nɔ hewɔ ni abaa 
kusumi lɛ ayi, ni akɛhaa yinɔbii ni baa lɛ hu anu shishi kɛ subaŋi ayibaamɔi lɛ fɛɛ.
Susumɔ otii
• Gbala ji tsakpaa ni feɔ nuu kɛ yoo ko ekome.
• Gbala nifeemɔi ji nifeemɔi ni adamɔɔ hemɔkɛyeli nɔ afeɔ, nibii ni sa akɛ afee kɛ 
gbɛjianɔtoi ni yɔɔ kusumi komɛi ahe yɛ akutsei komɛi amli.
• Gbalashihilɛ henɔi srɔtoi etɛ ni yɔɔ, nomɛi ji kusumnaa gbalamlibotemɔ, mlanaa 
gbalamlibotemɔ kɛ moslembii agbalamlibotemɔ.
• Gbalamlibotemɔ gbɛjianɔtoi etsake kwraa ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ. Nibii ni gbaa enɛ naa ji 
gbɔmɛi kɛ hii kɛ yei ahegbɔyeli gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ, tsɔsemɔ loo nikasemɔ ni etee hiɛ, 
shika shidaamɔ yɛ hii kɛ yei fɛɛ agbɛfaŋ, jamɔ gbɛjianɔtoi kɛ yiŋwoo, mlahiɛtsakemɔ, 
kɛ shihilɛhei ashimɔ kɛ maji wuji amliyaa kɛ ekrokomɛi.
• Abaanyɛ aku nɔni ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ jeŋtsakemɔ kɛba gbalamlibotemɔ gbɛjianɔtoi amli 
lɛ anaa kɛbaatsɔ sɛɛkuu kɛya kusumnaa gbɛjianɔtoi lɛ kɛnitsumɔ ekoŋŋ, yinɔi ni baa 
lɛ kɛ wiemɔkɛtsɔɔmɔ kɛ naji anɔ daamɔ .

Mfoniri lɛ miitsɔɔ wekumɛiabii ni baa abaye oblayoo ko gbalanifeemɔ lɛ he odase. 
Yɛ mfoniri lɛ mli lɛ, yoo wu lɛ kua shi yɛ eŋa ni baa lɛ hiɛ. Ŋa hee ni baa lɛ esaa 
ehe kɛ mama. Ŋa hee ni baa lɛ saa ehe yɛ kusumnaa. Yoo wu lɛ esaa ehe kɛ atade

Gbalamlibotemɔ kusum
Gbalamlibotemɔ nifeemɔi ahe miihia ni sɛɛnamɔ yɛ he yɛ Ghana akutsei lɛ amli. 
Nibii komɛi ni he hiaa yɛ gbalashihilɛ mlibotemɔ kɛ hegbɛi lɛ ekomɛi ji kusumi 
ayibaamɔ, kusumi kɛ yinɔbii lɛ hamɔ, subaŋ kpakpa jiemɔkɛtsɔɔmɔ, shwiewoo 
yɛ weku lɛ mli, wekunyo tsɔmɔ kɛ yelikɛbuamɔ, ekomefeemɔ he afabaŋfoo, 
yelikɛbuamɔ, knkn. Gbalamlibotemɔ ji kusum gbɛjianɔtoo ni afeɔ ahaa nuu kɛ yoo 
ni boteɔ gbalashihilɛ mli kɛfeɔ amɛ ekome akɛ nuu kɛ eŋa. Yɛ Ghana akutso lɛ mli lɛ, 
kusum nɛɛ kɔɔɔ nuu kɛ yoo ni boteɔ gbalashihilɛ mli lɛ pɛ ahe, shi moŋ kɛ amɛwekumɛi 
lɛ fɛɛ
Kusumi ayibaamɔ
Gbalashihilɛ mlibotemɔ, kɛ yoo he nifeemɔi lɛ titri damɔ kusumi lɛ anɔ. Tsakemɔi 
komɛi ni baa lɛ jɛɔ yinɔbii ni baa lɛ kɛ amɛtsakemɔi ni amɛkɛbaa, kɛji okɛto bei 
ni ehohoi lɛ ahe lɛ, shi kɛji okwɛ nibii ni aheɔ lɛ etsakeee, nakai nɔŋŋ ni, shi nibii 
ajara lɛ pɛ ji titri ni tsakeɔ yɛ nibii ajarawalɛ no beiaŋ lɛ ahewɔ. Enɛ tsɔɔ bɔ ni abaa 
kusum lɛ yi.
Gbalashihilɛ mli kusumi ni afeɔ damɔɔ, titri lɛ, akutso lɛ kɛ ekusum nifeemɔi 
agbɛjianɔtoo ni yaa nɔ yɛ afii ni eho lɛ amli. Tsakemɔi srɔtoi eba gbalamlibotemɔ 
gbɛjianɔtoo nɛɛ mli moŋ nɛ lɛ, nibii ni aheɔ lɛ nomɛi nɔŋŋ ni aheɔ, fe akɛ shika ni 
kaa nɔ lɛ yikulɛ ji nɔ ni tsakeɔ. Enɛ jɛɔ he ni shika yikulɛ eshɛ yɛ bei ni afee kusum 
lɛ mli. Yɛ gbɛ nɛɛ nɔ lɛ eebaa kusum lɛ yi.
Kusumi lɛ kɛhamɔ: Nifeemɔi tamɔ wekui lɛ aninamɔ kɛ sanegbaa lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ 
ni, ayeŋforo yinii lɛ hamɔ lɛ, nibii ni aheɔ lɛ, nakai nɔŋŋ ni, nibii lɛ ajara lɛ pɛ 
ji nɔ ni tsakeɔ, nɔkplɛmɔ, kusumi kɛhamɔ. Nifeemɔi tamɔ shramɔi ni yaa nɔ yɛ 
wekumɛi ateŋ lɛ nakai nɔŋŋ ji nɔ ni yaa nɔ, gbalanihamɔ ni ayemflo wu lɛ haa, 
kɛ nɔkplɛmɔ ni nuu lɛ haa fɛɛ shi nifeemɔi lɛ anɔ lolo. Afeɔ enɛmɛi fɛɛ kɛtsɔɔ akɛ 
aatsu gbalahamɔ kusumi lɛ fɛɛ taakɛ afeɔ kɛjɛ blema lɛ ni akɛhaa yinɔi ni baa lɛ 
fɛɛ yɛ amɛbeia.
Bulɛ kɛ woo: Gbalahemɔ nifeemɔi lɛ kɛ anumnyam bahaa nuu kɛ yoo ni boteɔ 
gbala lɛ mli lɛ kɛ amɛwekumɛi fɛɛ. Mɛi naa nuu kɛ yoo ni boteɔ gbala lɛ mli lɛ 
akɛ amɛbaatsu amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔi yɛ gbalashihilɛ lɛ mli. Enɛ haa ayɔseɔ amɛ yɛ 
akutso lɛ mli hu akɛ amɛtsuɔ amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔi yɛ maŋ ni amɛyɔɔ nɔ lɛ mli. Enɛ 
haa ayoɔ amɛ ni akɛ bulɛ haa amɛ yɛ akutso lɛ mli.
Subaŋ kpakpa shihilɛ kpojiemɔ: Eŋmɛɔ gbɛ ni amɛkɛ amɛhe naa bɔlɛ akɛ wu kɛ ŋa. 
Enɛ biɔ ni wu kɛ ŋa kɛ amɛhe ana bɔlɛ shi jeee mɔ ko kɛkɛ amɛkɛfeɔ nakai. Titri lɛ 
enɛ he gbɛkpamɔ yaa ehaa yoo lɛ fe nuu lɛ. Kusumnaa lɛ atsɔɔ enɛ nɔ kɛkwɛɔ akɛ 
amɛshihilɛ lɛ he tse ni ajwamaŋbɔɔ bɛ gbala lɛ mli.

shi.
Kusumnaa gbalashihilɛ: Ale no hu akɛ shikwɛɛbii agbalashihilɛ, ni no tsɔɔ mɛi

kome, wu kɛ ŋa yɛ jaku ko gbɛjianɔtoo kɛ mlai anaa. Srɔtoi babaoo yɛ kusumi 
ni atsuɔ lɛ amli ni fɛɛ jɛɔ kui kɛ jakui srɔtoi lɛ akusumi srɔtoi lɛ. Yɛ kusumnaa

dani aŋmɛɔ gbɛ. Akpaa wekui enyɔ lɛ asɛɛ da kɛkwɛɔ akɛ aleee nɔ subaŋi komɛi ni 
ehiii yɛ jɛmɛ lo, ni kɛji ana eko lɛ gbalashihilɛ lɛ baŋ nɔ.

ekɛkwɛ ebi lɛ kɛbashi be ni afeɔ ehe nii nɛɛ eko. Shika lɛ ji nɔ ko fioo ko kɛkɛ 
kɛtsɔɔ shidaa yɛ nɔ ni efee lɛ he.
3. Gbalanii (Tsinsa/dase ‘dowry’): Enɛ nɔ adamɔɔ ni akɛɔ akɛ yoo lɛ ebote gbala 
mli, ni eji shika kɛ Shinapu. Akɛ gbalanii (shika) nɛɛ toɔ akɛni no ji nɔ ni tsɔɔ 
akɛ yoo lɛ ebote gbala mli, ni egbalanii lɛ nɛ. Kɛji aha nɔ fɛɛ nɔ yɛ gbala lɛ he 
ni eshwɛ gbalanii nɛɛ, ni ahako lɛ, gbala lɛ yeko emuu.
4. Yinii (Tsir adze ‘bride price’): Yinii nɛɛ ji shika ni nuu lɛ weku kɛhaa yoo lɛ akɛ 
shikatso ni ekɛbaatsu nii. Aheɔ ayeɔ akɛ gbala nyɛɔ eguɔ trukaa, koni kɛji eba 
lɛ nakai lɛ hɔmɔ akaye yoo lɛ. Kɛfata he lɛ, wekui komɛi nyɛɔ boteɔ hefimɔ loo 
nyɔmɔ mli. Kɛji eba lɛ nakai lɛ, weku lɛ kɛ shika nɛɛ woɔ nyɔmɔ lɛ eko loo fɛɛ. 
Eji shika ni da.
5. Shabi daa (Akontan-sekan ‘bride’s brother’s price/fee’): Eji shika ni akɛhaa yoo 
lɛ nyɛmi nuu. Yoo lɛ nyɛmi lɛ ji mɔ ni tsɔɔ nɔ ni ebaahe. Jwɛŋmɔ ni yɔɔ enɛ sɛɛ 
ji akɛ, nyɛmi nuu nɛɛ ji mɔ ni buɔ enyɛmi yoo lɛ he kɛjɛɔ hii krokomɛi adɛŋ, 
hewɔ lɛ esa akɛ ena hebuu nii ni baanyɛ aye abua lɛ kɛtsu enitsumɔ nɛɛ, hewɔ 
lɛ nuu lɛ ji mɔni sa ni ehe nɛkɛ nibii nɛɛ.
6. Asafo daa (Asafo nsa ‘warriors’ price/fee'): Yoo wu lɛ haa asafobii ni yɔɔ akutso 
ni yoo lɛ yɔɔ mli lɛ hu daa kɛdaa amɛ shi akɛ amɛbu yoo lɛ he kɛshi ekɛlɛ ebahi 
shi nɛɛ. Daa nɛɛ hu tsɔɔ akɛ asafobii lɛ ena akɛ yoo lɛ ena wu ni abaabu ehe 
kɛjɛ hii krokomɛi ahe aha yoo wu lɛ.

Ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ gbalamlibotemɔ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ esa kusumnaa gbɛjianɔtoi lɛ fɛɛ ahe 
yɛ kui srɔtoi lɛ amli yɛ Ghana. Esa kusumi lɛ ahe yɛ gbɛ gbonyo kɛ gbɛ kpakpai fɛɛ 
anɔ. Gbɛi anɔ ni esa gbalamlibotemɔ kusumi lɛ ahe yɛ lɛ ekomɛi nɛ:
Sukuuyaa: Sukuuyaa ni efa yɛ yei agbɛfaŋ titri esa gbalamlibotemɔ gbɛjianɔtoo 
he jogbaŋŋ. Sukuuyaa ewo yei ahewalɛ ni eha amɛhalaa nifeemɔi ni baaye abua 
amɛgbalamlibotemɔ gbɛjianɔtoi lɛ. Amɛkɔɔ jwɛŋmɔi yɛ nɔ ni amɛtaoɔ ni afee aha 
amɛ he yɛ amɛgbalanifeemɔi lɛ amli ni amɛ amɛtsɔɔ bɔ ni sa akɛ shihilɛ lɛ aya lɛ 
aha amɛ kɛ nɔ ni afee aha amɛ.
Adesai ahegbɛi kɛ yei ni kɛ hii miishi kɔŋ: Nilee ni efa kɛ nɔ ni efe nɔ bɔ ni akɛtsuɔ 
nii ahaa lɛ kɛ tsakemɔi eba kusumnaa gbalamlibotemɔ nifeemɔi amli. Enɛ eha bulɛ 
ni akɛhaa yei etee ŋwɛi ni amɛna hegbɛi yɛ kusumnaa gbɛhei ni tsutsu lɛ ebɛ lɛ 
nakai. Amɛyeɔ gboshi nii kɛ gbɛhei ni yei ehiɛɛɛ yɛ kusumi komɛi amli.
1. Jamɔi amli hewalɛwoo: Jamɔ nifeemɔi kɛ Kristo kɛ Islam jamɔ ni efa lɛ ewo 
mɛi pii ahewalɛ kɛte shi amɛshi kusumnaa gbalamli nifeemɔi komɛi. Jamɔi eha 
agba gbɛi hee aha kusumnaa nifeemɔi ni akɛmiifutu kusumnaa nifeemɔi.
2. Shika he ŋaatsɔɔ kɛ shikanamɔ: Shika hewalɛnamɔ kɛtsɔ ŋaatsɔɔ gbɛi anɔ kɛ 
hegbɛi ni mɛi ena hewɔlɛ, mɛi ena shika hewalɛ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ amɛyeɔ amɛhe 
nɔ, hewɔ lɛ amɛ ni amɛtsɔɔ mɛi ni amɛkɛbaahi shi kɛ bɔ ni amɛbaaba amɛjeŋ 
amɛha.

mɛi ahiŋmɛi egbele yɛ nibii srɔtoi kɛ nifeemɔi amli. Enɛ eha kusumi srɔtoi lɛ 
efutu ni nibii etsake.
4. Soshia midia kɛ tsɔji amli nilee: Nɔyaa ni etee hiɛ kɛ nilee hewɔ lɛ mɛi kɛ mɛi 
naa sharamɔ yɛ he fɛɛ he be fɛɛ be (nyɔŋteŋ yɛ soshia midia) Enɛ eha tsakemɔi 
eba mɔ kɛ mɔ sharamɔ mli. Sharamɔ etsake, ŋaawoo efa kɛ gbalashihilɛ mli 
nifeemɔi hu etsake.
5. Gbɛfaa kɛyaa majiasɛɛ: Mɛi ni faa gbɛ kɛjɛɔ maji amli kɛyaa maji amli, kɛjɛɔ 
maŋtiaseŋ kɛyaa maŋtiaseŋ, kɛ jaku maji amli kɛyaa jaku maji krokomɛi amli. 
Enɛ eha wɔkɔlɔ subaŋi kɛ jeŋbai ni kɛ wɔkusumii lɛ eyaa tamɔ gbalashihilɛ mli

6. Mlai ahiɛtsakemɔ: Mlatsakemɔi kɛ mlai ahiɛtsakemɔ tamɔ mlanaa 
gbalamlibotemɔ mla ni ahe awo mli lɛ, kusumnaa gbalamlibotemɔ ni etee 
Ghana mlawoji amli lɛ etsake gbalamlibotemɔ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ
7. Kusumi ahe nilee kɛ jeŋjeŋ nifeemɔi: Jeŋjeŋnilee kɛ kusumi feemɔi ahe susumɔi 
kɛ nilee yeɔ buaa kɛhalaa nilee amli ni akɛtsuɔ nii, ni no kɛ tsakemɔi babaoo 
eba wɔkusumi lɛ amli ni kusumnaa gbalamlibotemɔ fata he lɛ. Eye ebua nibii 
pii yɛ gbɛi kpakpai kɛ gbohii fɛɛ mli.

Kusumnaa maŋkuramɔ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ ji nɔyeli nɔkwɔlɛi ni yɔɔ kusumnaa 
maŋkuramɔ gbɛjianɔtoo ko mli koni ana mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yelihe kɛ hewalɛ yɛ akutso, 
nitsumɔ, amralofoi agbɛjianɔtoo loo kui krokomɛi amli.
Kusumnaa Maŋkuramɔ ji maŋkuramɔ ko ni shikwɛɛbii kɛ jeŋ kusum kɛ jeŋ nilee ni 
akɛkuraa. Shikwɛɛbii lɛ hiɛ maŋkuramɔ gbɛjianɔtoo kpakpai ni ato yɛ wɔkutsei lɛ amli 
ni akɛkuraa maji lɛ. Ehiɛ nɔyeli naatoo ni tsɔɔ lumɔ fɛɛ lumɔ kɛ mɔ ni shishi ni eyɔɔ. 
Srɔtoi baa yɛ nɔyeli gbɛjianɔtoi nɛɛ amli yɛ wiemɔi srɔtoi lɛ amli shi akutsei lɛ titri hiɛ 
gbɛjianɔtoo kome.
Sui ni kusumnaa maŋkuramɔ hiɛ
Nibii ni baa nɛɛ tsɔɔ sui komɛi ni Kusumnaa Maŋkuramɔ hiɛ:
1. Sui loo gbɛjianɔtoi lɛ tsɔɔ nɔyeli nɔkwɔlɛi lɛ kɛ hewalɛ ni mɔ fɛɛ mɔ ko hiɛ yɛ 
maŋkuramɔ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ mli. Enɛ tsɔɔ akɛ hewalɛi lɛ jɛɔ ŋwɛi kɛbaa shishi ni 
mɔ fɛɛ mɔ yɛ nitsumɔ pɔtɛɛ ko ni etsuɔ.

2. Maŋkuramɔ ni damɔ he ko pɔtɛɛ: Enɛ ji gbɛjianɔtoo ni ŋmɛɔ onukpai ni yɔɔ 
yiteŋ lɛ gbɛ koni amɛwo mlai loo awoɔ mlai lɛ yɛ jaku mli onukpai lɛ aŋɛlɛ nɔ.
3. Gbɛjianɔtoo ni ajara mli: Enɛ tsɔɔ bɔ ni ajara maŋkuramɔ gbɛjinɔtoo lɛ mli aha, 
kpokpa wulu, kpokpa bibii, maji, akutso kɛ ekrokomɛi.
4. Ajara mli awo gbeji amli: Maŋkuramɔ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ hiɛ gbeji ni hiɛ amɛhe. 
Gbeji lɛ fɛɛ eko hiɛ ehe kɛ nitsumɔ ni etsuɔ yɛ maŋkuramɔ lɛ mli. Ajara hewalɛi 
lɛ amli awo gbeji bibii tamɔ wekutɔkpaa kɛ wekutsakpaa amli kɛha maŋkuramɔ 
lɛ, eko fɛɛ eko kɛ enitsumɔ pɔtɛɛ ni etsuɔ.
5. Kulalɔi lɛ kwɛɔ mɛi fioo ko kɛkɛ anɔ.
6. Gbɛi anɔ ni atsɔɔ akɛmaŋbii lɛ sharaa: Ayɛ gbɛjianɔtoi ni afee ni atsɔɔ nɔ akɛ 
maŋbii lɛ sharaa kɛhaa loo kɛtaoɔ adafitswaa
7. Gbɛnaa nifeemɔi kɛ nitsumɔi: Enɛ tsɔɔ mɔ fɛɛ mɔ gbɛnaa nitsumɔi ni sa akɛ etsu 
yɛ ku lɛ mli, sharamɔ kpakpa, yiŋkɔmɔ loo yiŋtoofeemɔ kɛ gbɛkpamɔi yɛ ku lɛ 
mli.
8. Gbɛnaahiɛlɔi ashikamɔ: Gbɛnaahiɛlɔi srɔtoi lɛ akuramɔ, kɛjɛ kulalɔnukpai anɔ 
kɛyashi nitsulɔi ni kpaako dani amɛbote nitsumɔi lɛ amli. Akɛ nɔkwɔlɛ tsuɔ nii 
yɛ gbɛnai nɛɛ ahiɛmɔ mli ni akwɛɔ mɛi ni ato amɛ gbɛnaa, mɛi ni yeɔ anɔkwa yɛ 
akɔntaabuu mli, mɛi ni tsuɔ ni oya, ni akwɛɔ nijiaŋwujee nifeemɔi hu ni baanyɛ 
aba mɛi agbɛi anɔ hu kɛ bɔ ni amɛbaafee kɛje mli kɛ nibii amligbɔjɔmɔ bɔ ni sa.
Kusumnaa maŋkuramɔ nɔyelitso
Shishijee Nitsumɔi
1. Yɛ kui amli lɛ nyɛsaa nyɛtoa gbɛjianɔi nɛɛ ekoŋŋ kɛjɛa onukpa ni fe fɛɛ nɔ 
kɛyashi gbɛnaahiɛlɔ bibioo ni fe fɛɛ nɔ yɛ okutso lɛ mli;
Maji anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi - maŋtsɛ he onukpai - maŋtsɛmɛi onukpai - 
Maŋtsɛwolɔi
2. Naatoo lɛ aaanyɛ aba lɛ nɛkɛ;
Maŋtsɛmɛi nukpai→ maji anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi→ maŋtsɛwolɔi→Maŋtsɛ he onukpai
3. Abaanyɛ atsɛ naatoo ni nyɛfee nɛɛ akɛ nɔyelitso
Nɔyelitso ji gbɛnaahiɛlɔi anɔkwɔlɔmɔ tɛŋmɔ tso yɛ ku ko mli. Etsɔɔ gbɛnaahiɛlɔ 
ko nɔkwɔlɛ kɛ mɛi ni yɔɔ eshishi.

Tɛŋmɔ 7.4: Kusumnaa maŋkuramɔ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ shikamɔ
Taakɛ wɔnaa yɛ nɔyelitso lɛ mli lɛ, etsɔɔ faŋŋ akɛ maŋtsɛ wulu ji hewalɛtsɛ nukpa 
ni yɔɔ naatoo lɛ mli, mɔ ni nyiɛ esɛɛ ji maŋtsɛnukpa, jɛ esɛɛ lɛ kpokpa bibii anɔ 
maŋtsɛmɛi, maji anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi hu nyiɛ sɛɛ. Jɛ lumɛi nɛɛ asɛɛ lɛ ayɛ lumɛi krokomɛi 
ni yeɔ buaa maŋtsɛmɛi ejwɛ ni yɔɔ nɔyelitso ni wɔna momo lɛ mli lɛ. Yɛ maji anɔ 
maŋtsɛmɛi lɛ ashishi lɛ wɔnaa otsaamifoi lɛ kɛ wekutɔkpaa mli onukpai lɛ.
Gbɛnaahiɛlɔi ni yɔɔ nɔyelitso lɛ mli lɛ fɛɛ yɛ amɛnitsumɔi pɔtɛɛ ni amɛtsuɔ. 
Gbɛnaahiɛlɔi lɛ ekomɛi nɛ kɛ amɛgbɛnaa nitsumɔi.
Maŋtsɛ wulu lɛ
Maŋtsɛ wulu lɛ ji mɔ ni yɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ ejaku lɛ nɔ ni mɔ ko bɛ esɛɛ dɔŋŋ. Yɛ jakui 
komɛi amli lɛ Maŋtsɛ wulu lɛ yɛ hewalɛ yɛ amralofoi kɛ maŋbii lɛ anɔ.
Maŋtsɛwulu lɛ nitsumɔi
1. Maŋtsɛwulu lɛ tsuɔ enii akɛ maŋsɔɔlɔ nukpa
2. Ewoɔ mla ni ekwɛɔ akɛ mla lɛ miitsu nii.
3. Lɛ ji asraafoi ahiɛnyiɛlɔ kɛ tatsɛnukpa kɛji ta ko je.
4. Ekulaa saji ni baa emaŋbii lɛ ateŋ
Maŋtsɛ nukpai
Maŋtsɛnukpai lɛ ji wiemɔkui lɛ ahiɛnyiɛlɔi. Amɛji kusumnaa maŋkuralɔi lɛ ayitso 
ni yɔɔ maŋkuralɔi lɛ ateŋ yɛ kpokpa agbo ko mli. Gamɛi asateŋ lɛ tsɛsɛɛ ajɛɔ ni 
ayeɔ sɛi lɛ, aatsɔɔ akɛ kɛjeee nuu bi ji bo lɛ oyeee maŋtsɛ bɛja nuu ko bɛ maŋtsɛyeli 
weku lɛ mli dɔŋŋ. Anaa maŋtsɛnukpa akɛ wekutɔkpaa maŋtsɛ ejaakɛ odehei awekui

amli ajɛɔ ni awoɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ. Atsuɔ kusumi pɔtɛɛ komɛi kɛwoɔ maŋtsɛ nɛɛ. Yɛ hei 
ni ayeɔ nyɛsɛɛ nii yɛ lɛ yoo hu nyɛɔ yeɔ maŋtsɛ.
Maŋtsɛnukpa lɛ gbɛnaa nitsumɔi
Maŋtsɛnukpa lɛ tsuɔ nibii ni baa nɛɛ;
 1. Hiɛnyiɛlɔ kɛha kpokpa wulu ni hiɛ akutsei kɛ akrowai babaoo
 2. Esusuɔ ni ewoɔ mla ni yeɔ buaa ekpokpa lɛ.
 3. Amɛsɔmɔɔ mumɔŋbii ni ji blematsɛmɛi lɛ kɛ heloo mli bii ni ji hiɛkaalɔi lɛ.
 4. Amɛkwɛɔ ni aye mla nɔ ni amɛyeɔ saji.
 5. Amɛji shikpɔŋ lɛ kɛ japadei krokomɛi ni yɔɔ lɛ atsɛmɛi yɛ akutso lɛ mli.
 6. Amɛbaa ni amɛkwɛɔ maŋbii akusumi lɛ anɔyaa.
 7. Amɛkɛ nɔyaa nitsumɔi bahaa maŋbii lɛ.
 8. Amɛyeɔ saji ni amɛkwɛɔ saji ni teɔ shi yɛ maŋkuramɔ kɛ shika nifeemɔi ahe yɛ 
amɛkutsei lɛ amli.
9. Amɛkwɛɔ kuramɔ gbɛjianɔtoi ni yɔɔ maji kɛ kpokpai lɛ anɔ fɛɛ.
10. Ewoɔ mla ni ekwɛɔ akɛ aye mla lɛ nɔ.
Maji kɛ kpokpai anɔ Maŋtsɛmɛi
Mɛi nɛɛ mɛi ji maŋtsɛmɛi ni yɔɔ maŋtsɛnukpa lɛ shishi. Kpokpaa bibii anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi. 
Amɛ ni amɛkulaa kpokpaa bibii lɛ amɛhaa maŋtsɛnukpa lɛ. Amɛsɛɛ dani anaa maji 
kɛ akrowai amli maŋtsɛmɛi. Mɛi ni yeɔ maŋtsɛ yɛ maji nɛɛ amli naa gbɛhe nɛɛ 
kɛtsɔɔ tsɛsɛɛ niyeli mli ni amɛ hu atsuɔ kusumi pɔtɛɛ ahaa amɛ taakɛ maŋtsɛnukpa 
lɛ nɔŋŋ dani amɛyeɔ gbɛhe nɛɛ.
Maji kɛ kpokpai anɔ maŋtsɛmɛi anitsumɔ
1. Amɛyeɔ maŋtsɛnukpa lɛ najiaŋ kɛtsuɔ enitsumɔi lɛ amɛhaa lɛ.
2. Amɛkwɛɔ shweshweeshwenamɔ yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ amli.
3. Amɛkojoɔ ni amɛsaa saji ni baa yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ amli.
4. Amɛkwɛɔ toiŋjɔlɛnamɔ yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ amli.
5. Amɛtsuɔ kusumi ni baa yɛ maŋ lɛ kɛ sɛi lɛ he.
6. Amɛyeɔ amɛbuaa kɛkuɔ nibii gbohii anaa yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ amli.
7. Amɛhiɛ hewalɛ ni akɛfoɔ amɛshikpɔji lɛ ahe afabaŋ.
8. Amɛkuraa akutsei kɛ kpokpai ni amɛyɔɔ mli lɛ.

9. Amɛkwɛɔ ni akɛ mlai ni awo lɛ tsuɔ nii ni amɛwoɔ maŋtsɛnukpa lɛ toi nɔ yɛ bɔ

Maŋnyɛ
Ayɛ maŋnyɛmɛi yɛ maji lɛ fɛɛ anɔ. Maŋnyɛmɛi lɛ tsuɔ amɛnii akɛ mumɔ mli yitsei kɛha 
yei ni yɔɔ maji lɛ amli lɛ, ni amɛkɛ blema saji ni kɔɔ yinɔbii ahe lɛ toɔ. Amɛbɔɔ mɔdɛŋ 
kɛtsuɔ nii kɛbaa yei kɛ gbekɛbii ashihilɛ yi, yɛ amɛmaji lɛ amli. Yɛ jakui ni yeɔ nyɛsɛɛ 
nii lɛ amli lɛ, eji maŋnyɛmɛi lɛ agbɛnaa akɛ amɛ amɛjieɔ mɔ ni sa ni awo lɛ maŋtsɛ. 
Maŋnyɛ lɛ ni hiɛ hewalɛ ni akɛtsɔɔ mɔ ni sa akɛ awo kɛji abladei awekui lɛ efamɔ mɛi 
fɛɛ ni sa kɛjɛ amɛwekui lɛ amli amɛha sɛi lɛ he onukpai lɛ. Amɛyɛ hegbɛ ni amɛ diɛŋtsɛ 
amɛfamɔɔ maŋnyɛmɛi bibii ni baasɔmɔ amɛ.
Maŋnyɛmɛi agbɛnaa nitsumɔi lɛ ekomɛi ji:
1. Aye abua gbɛnaa nitsumɔi ni maŋtsɛmɛi tsuɔ yɛ maŋkuramɔ gbɛjianɔtoo mli lɛ.
2. Akwɛ ni eye saji ni gbaa yei anaa yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ amli.
3. Amɛ ni amɛfaa yei ahegbɛi ahe.
4. Amɛbaa yinɔi lɛ ahe saji ayi koni amɛkɛtsɔse yinɔi ni baa yɛ amɛkutsei lɛ amli lɛ.
Wulɔmɔ
Ayɛ wulɔmɛi yɛ maji lɛ fɛɛ amli. Amɛ ji mumɔŋ hiɛnyiɛlɔ yɛ akutsei lɛ amli. Etsuɔ 
enii akɛ helatsalɔ ni edamɔɔ mli ehaa heloo mli bii yɛ mumɔŋ gbɛfaŋ.
Wulɔmɔ nitsumɔ:
1. Wulɔmɛi tsuɔ amɛnii akɛ mumɔŋ tatsɛmɛi ni amɛnyiɛɔ tabilɔi ahiɛ kɛyaa ta kɛji 
nakai be shɛ.
2. Amɛkwɛɔ ni aye mla nɔ koni toiŋjɔlɛ aba akutso lɛ mli ni ejie maŋbii kɛjɛ 
maŋsɛɛbii amlifu mli.
3. Amɛnyɛɔ amɛyeɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ najiaŋ yɛ kpee komɛi amli.
4. Amɛyeɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ najiaŋ kɛji ebɛ yɛ kusumnaa nifeemɔi komɛi amli yɛ akutsei 
lɛ amli.
5. Amɛyeɔ amɛbuaa maŋbii yɛ mumɔŋ nibii ahe yɛ akutso lɛ mli.
6. Amɛtsuɔ hetsuumɔ nifeemɔi amɛhaa mɛi ni aato amɛ maŋtsɛmɛi kɛ mɛi ni 
aakpa amɛ fɛɛ.
7. Amɛtsɔɔ lamɔi kɛ ninamɔi ashishi ni amɛhaa mumɔŋ gbɛtsɔɔmɔi yɛ shade gbohii 
ahe.
8. Amɛbaa maŋbii akusumi lɛ ayi ni amɛkɛhaa yinɔi ni baa lɛ.
9. Amɛtsaa mɛi ni mumɔi fɔji yeɔ amɛtsui lɛ.
10. Amɛtswaa shi yɛ kpee mli dani ajeɔ shishi kɛ agbɛnɛ hu dani abaakpa kpee lɛ.

Maŋtsɛwolɔi
Maŋtsɛwolɔ loo wolɔi ji mɛi ni bɛŋkɛ ni amɛyɔɔ hewalɛ yɛ odehe ko ni sa maŋtsɛ ko

Maŋtsɛwolɔi anitsumɔi nɛ

3. Amɛdamɔɔ shi kɛkpaa maŋtsɛ kɛji gbɛ ba maŋtsɛ lɛ he.

5. Amɛkɛ maŋtsɛ gbɛnaa nitsumɔi lɛ woɔ edɛŋ ni etsuɔ.
6. Amɛhaa maŋtsɛ lɛ eniyeli he koni hɔmɔ akaye lɛ
7. Amɛwoɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ ŋaa.
Maŋtsɛ Otsiami
Maŋtsɛ otsiami ji mɛi enyɔ nɔ kɛjɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ nɔ ni etsuɔ nibii pii yɛ maŋ lɛ mli. 
Egbɛnaa nitsumɔi lɛ tsakeɔ ni no damɔɔ akutso lɛ kusum gbɛjianɔtoi anɔ. Nibii ni 
baa nɛɛ tsɔɔ otsiami lɛ gbɛnaa nitsumɔi ni he hiaa lɛ.
1. Amɛtsuɔ amɛnii akɛ maŋtsɛ lɛ naawielɔ, no ji amɛwie maŋtsɛ lɛ naawiemɔi 
amɛhaa maŋbii lɛ.
2. Amɛnyiɛɔ maŋtsɛ lɛ hiɛ kɛyaa bɔgwa mli.
3. Amɛwieɔ amɛhaa maŋtsɛ lɛ.
4. Amɛhiɛɔ otsiamitso amɛhaa maŋtsɛ lɛ.
5. Amɛkɛ gbɔi awiemɔi haa maŋtsɛ lɛ ni amɛkɛ maŋtsɛ nɔ hu yaa gbɔi lɛ.

ekoŋŋ kɛkwɛ akɛ eja kɛha sanebimɔ lɛ lo.
10. Feemɔ kɛtsara nɔ ni okase: Shii abɔ ni opɛɔ ajenu sanebimɔi amli lɛ, no haa 
onaa hesalɛ yɛ jebɔ kɛ sanebimɔi lɛ ayoomɔ mli.
Kɛfata he lɛ, ha ohiɛ aka nibii nɛɛ anɔ:
1. Ŋmɛɛ otsui shi ni oya nɔ kɛfee
2. Jwɛŋmɔ gbajaa
3. Kɛ wiemɔ shishifaa, hiɛ kɛ sɛɛ afisii lɛ awa kɛ saji ni hiɛ shishinumɔ nta lɛ 
ashishinumɔ
4. Gbelemɔ ojwɛŋmɔ mli ni okaka ohiɛ oha hetoo.
Nifeemɔ 9.5 Ajenu shwɛmɔ lɛ
Yɛ nyɛkui anyɔnyɔɔnyɔ amli lɛ, nyɛteaŋ mɔ kome agba ajenu ko ni mɔ kroko hu 
aha hetoo. Kɛji mɔ ni haa ajenu lɛ hetoo ni ja lɛ, lɛ hu egba ajenu lɛ eko bɔ ni afee 
ni mɔ ni gba ajenu klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ hu aha hetoo.
ALABAALOO
Alabaaloo
Alabaaloo ji saji loo nibii ni shishinumɔ kaaa shi, ni ebiɔ jwɛŋmɔ, susumɔ ni mli 
kwɔ kɛ ŋaa kɛha hetoo. Amɛjeɔ kpo yɛ mɔ naa.
Alabaaloo Henɔi
Alabaaloo tsuɔ nii srɔtoi yɛ gbɛi srɔtoi anɔ:

1. Jwɛŋmɔ mli kwɔlɛ: Ehaa anaa hesalɛ yɛ saji ahetoohamɔ kɛ niahesusumɔ gbajaa 
yɛ adesai amli, titri gbekɛbii.
2. Hiɛtserɛjiemɔ: Ekɛ naaŋmɔlɔwoo, hejɔɔmɔ kɛ miishɛɛ baa mɛi fɛɛ anɔ.
3. Tsɔsemɔ: Ewaa kɛ nikasemɔ, kaimɔ, ni ewaa kɛ saji haŋtsiŋŋ ashishinumɔ tamɔ 
akɔntabuu, jeŋshikpamɔ saji kɛ wiemɔi.
4. Tsabaa: Ewaa kɛ jwɛŋmɔŋ hiɛtsakemɔ, egbɔɔ tɔlɛ nɔ ni eyeɔ ebuaa wɔjwɛŋmɔ.
5. Agbonaa tsakpaa: Eyeɔ ebuaa yɛ mɛi atsakpaanamɔ mli, ku mli nitsumɔ kɛ 
sanegbaa kɛtsɔ ekomefeemɔ nɔ.
6. Jwɛŋmɔ tsɔsemɔ: Ehaa wɔhiɛ kaa nɔ ko nɔ, wɔsusuɔ nii ahe oya ni etsiɛɔ susumɔ 
blɛoo kɛ mɛi ni kɔɔɔ nii asɛɛ oya lɛ ahiɛ.
7. Nibii Hee ahesusumɔ: Ehaa akɛ jwɛŋmɔ hee baa ni ehaa hegbɛ ni ajieɔ henumɔ 
kɛ susumɔ srɔto ko kpo.
8. Kaa: Eji nɔ ko ni atsɔɔ nɔ kɛkaa mɔ ko jwɛŋmɔ mlikwɔlɛ, nilee kɛ hesalɛ yɛ 
nifeemɔ ko mli.
9. Adesa kɛ gbaasane: Ehaa mɛi nitsumɔi ni amɛtsuɔ, susumɔ kɛ yiŋtoofeemɔ 
yɛ ŋaaŋsaji ahe (Enhance engagement, suspense, and plot development in 
literature and media.)
10.Shigbɛlɛmɔ kɛ Jeŋshikpamɔ: Ewaa kɛha adesa he jwɛŋmɔ, subaŋ kɛ susumɔ 
gbɛjianɔtoo he nikasemɔ.
11.Gbɔmɔtsoŋ dalɛ: Ehaa mɔ ko kaa lɛ diɛŋtsɛ ehe ekwɛɔ, hiɛmiamɔ ni ehaa onaa 
hemɔkɛyeli yɛ bo diɛŋstɛ omli kɛtaoɔ alabaaloo naagbai lɛ ahetoo.
12.Ehaa wɔkɛ wɔhe woɔ nii amli: Ehaa hegbɛ kɛha mɛi ni jɛ hei srɔtoi kɛ amɛhe 
sharaa.
Sɛɛnamɔi babaoo yɛ alabaaloo he, ni no haa ehe baa sɛɛnamɔ yɛ adesa walashihilɛ 
mli.

Nyɛsusua alabaaloo he yɛ nyɛkui lɛ amli.

Hetoo gbɛjianɔtoo kɛ hetoonamɔ

2. Klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ, gbɛfalɔ lɛ kɛ wuɔ lɛ baafo faa lɛ ni eshi jata kɛ abele lɛ. Esɛɛkuu mli

Naagbee lɛ ebaaku esɛɛ kɛbawo wuɔ lɛ kɛyafata amɛhe kɛkɛ lɛ amɛtsa amɛgbɛfaa lɛ

Yɛ nyɛkui anyɔnyɔɔnyɔ amli lɛ, nyɛteaŋ mɔ kome agba alabaaloo ko ni mɔ kroko

bɔ ni afee ni mɔ ni gba alabaaloo klɛŋklɛŋ lɛ hu aha hetoo.

HIƐGBELEMƆ
Yɛ afa nɛɛ mli lɛ, wobaabote Ga Nilee Saji lɛ gbene kome mli. Nɔ krɛdɛɛ ni 
wɔbaasusu he lɛ ji lalawiemɔ: lalawiemɔ henɔi, lalawiemɔ mli otui, lalawiemɔ 
he sɛɛnamɔi. Wɔbaakase bɔ ni anyaa lalawiemɔ he. Lalawiemɔ he nilee kɛ ehe 
nyamɔ baaha wɔle wiemɔkulibii halamɔ kɛ bɔ ni akɛ amɛ tsuɔ nii yɛ wiemɔ mli. 
Fa nɛɛ baatee wɔjwɛŋmɔ mli mfonirishamɔ kɛ naatsele shi. Lalawiemɔ henyamɔ lɛ 
baaye abua ojwɛŋmɔ mli gbelemɔ, sane shishinumɔ kɛ naatselɛ. Kɛfatahe lɛ ebaaye 
ebua ohenuumɔ yɛ nifeemɔ kɛ saji amli. Asaŋ ehaa okaiɔ blema saji kɛ nikasemɔi 
krokomɛi tamɔ lalafoo kɛ lalawiemɔi lɛ diɛŋtsɛ hu. Ehaa wɔnaa shihɛlemɔ yɛ blema 
saji kɛ nifeemɔi komɛi ahe, tamɔ kusumi nifeemɔi kɛ mɛi atsomlomɔi yɛ amɛshihilɛ 
mli. Kɛji mɔ ko kase lalawiemɔ ni enyɛɔ ekɛtsuɔ nii lɛ, egbeleɔ ejwɛŋmɔ mli, ekaiɔ 
saji ni eleɔ mɛi ahiɛdaamɔ kɛ wiemɔ.
WIEMƆ OTII
• Lalawiemɔ ji nilee mli ŋaa gbɛi ni atsɔɔ nɔ kɛnuɔ saji ashishi, anuɔ wiemɔ mli agugui 
kɛ otui,fɔŋwiemɔ kɛ ekrokomɛi ni yɔɔ sane lɛ mli lɛ shishi.
• Atsɛɔ mɔ ni foɔ lalawiemɔ lɛ akɛ lalafolɔ. Lalafolɔ lɛ ŋɔɔ nilee mli gbɛi tamɔ shitiimɔ, 
shitiimɔ kɛlɛmɔ (meter), lala lɛ mli wiemɔi kɛjieɔ nilee srɔtoi ni mli kwɔlɔ kpo.
• Lalawiemɔ mli sane lɛ shishinumɔ kaaa gbɛhe tamɔ bɔ ni anuɔ saji krokomɛi ashishi 
faŋŋ lɛ.
LALAWIEMƆ HE NILEE
Lalawiemɔ shishitsɔɔmɔ
Lalawiemɔ ji yiŋsusumɔ sane ko ni tsɔɔ mɔ ko nilee loo henumɔ ni ena yɛ yitso ko 
he. Sui komɛi ni yɔɔ lalawiemɔ he ji atseɔ he ni ahalaa wiemɔi ni hiɛ gbɛmɔi krɛdɛɛ 
komɛi, ni teɔ henumɔi komɛi ashi. Eŋɔɔ shitiimɔi akɛlɛmɔ, noni, kɛ gbɛmɔ henɔi.
Aŋmaa lalawiemɔi yɛ liamɔi amli ni akɛwoɔ kukuji amli. Lalafolɔ lɛ tsɔɔ ŋaagbɛi 
anɔ kɛfolɔɔ lalawiemɔi lɛ yɛ liamɔi amli bɔ ni kanelɔ lɛ baajwɛŋ shrao kɛnu shishi.

Lalawiemɔ jebɔ
Lalawiemɔ hiɛ jebɔi ni baa nɛɛ.
1. Liamɔ: Wiemɔkulibii yɛ ŋlɛ kome nɔ.
2. Liamɔi abɔ: Blawia abɔ yɛ liamɔ kome nɔ.
3. Kukuji: Wiemɔkulibii kɛ blawai abɔ yɛ mlijaa mli.
4. Shitiimɔ: Gbɛɛmɔi loo gbee henɔ kome yɛ liamɔi anaagbe.
5. Shitiimɔkɛlɛ: gbee loo blawai agbɛɛmɔ mlikpamɔ.
6. Kɛlɛ: Shitiimɔkɛlɛ ni hiɛ blawai srɔtoi.
7. Enjambment: Sanemuu kɛ sanekuku nɔtsaramɔ ni niŋmaa mli okadi bɛ mli.
8. Caesura: Sɛŋlajɔmii yɛ nikanemɔ mli.
9. Niŋmaa mli okadi wulu: Niŋmaa okadi wuji ni akɛtsu nii yɛ wiemɔ loo sanemuu 
shishijee.
Lalawiemɔ kɛ jebɔi ni baa nɛɛ tsuɔ nii;
• Atsɔɔ shitiimɔ kɛ lala mli kɛŋmaa
• Ewaa shishinumɔ kɛ nɔmimaa
• Ekwɛɔ gbee ni akɛtsu nii lɛ

Syllable Structure and Tone
INTRODUCTION 
This section introduces the concepts of syllable, syllable structure and tone. 
After studying this section, you will be able to differentiate between open 
and closed syllables in their respective Ghanaian languages and discuss how 
syllable structure aids in word formation. You will also study the concept of 
tone and be able to classify types of tone, such as low, high, mid, rising, falling, 
etc. You will be equipped with the knowledge and skills to form new words 
of a Ghanaian based on tone. Finally, the section will discuss the functions of 
tone in a Ghanaian language, including the lexical, grammatical, and dialectal 
functions. 
KEY IDEAS 
• A syllable is a pronounceable part of a word. 
• Asyllabic consonant is a consonant that behaves as a syllable. 
• Tone refers to the change in voice that can change the meaning of a 
word.
THE SYLLABLE, ITS TYPES AND 
STRUCTURE
Description of a Syllable
A syllable refers to a segment/unit of speech that consists of a vowel, which may 
form a part or the whole of a word. In other words, it is a unit of pauses that 
we realise when pronouncing a word. For example, you will pause twice when 
pronouncing the name Kofi [ko: fi]. Therefore, Kofi contains two syllables. But 
there will be only one pause when pronouncing tu [tu], hence we say it has 
one syllable. So, how many syllables (pauses) do you think are in the word 
Bagabaga [ba:ga:ba:ga]? 
Aside from vowels, syllabic consonants such as /m, n, w, r, l/ qualify as 
syllables. This usually happens when vowels are not immediately following 
3
SECTION 1 SYLLABLE STRUCTURE AND TONE
these consonants. For example, [pa:m] in Akan, [na:m] in Dagbani, [kpa:m] 
in Ewe, etc. A syllable must contain a single vowel sound and may or may 
not have consonants before, after or sounding the vowel sound. A word may 
contain only one syllable, which is known as a monosyllabic word, or two 
syllables, termed a disyllabic word, or multiple syllables, which is known as a 
polysyllabic word. The following are some examples.
1. Monosyllabic word: Ho [ho], fa [fa]
2. Disyllabic words: Tafo [ta:fo], Osu [o:su] 
3. Polysyllabic words: Sakora [sa:ko:ra], Takoradi [ta:ko:ra:di]
Knowledge of the syllable structure of a language is important because;
a. it helps learners to form new words correctly 
b. it helps the learners to identify the lexicon of languages
c. it also helps the learners in processing the meaning of words in a language. 
The following are examples of how Ghanaian language words have been divided 
into their respective syllables.
Ewe:   e: na, a: kpe, tɔ, a: ji, a: tɔ: tɔ: tɔ
Ga:   n: ka: ti: e, n: ka: la: de
Mfantse:  n: su, n: ku: kɔ, m: pa
Twi:   kɔ: m, e: tu: o, e: to
In the examples above, each unit of pronunciation qualifies as a syllable. Each 
word has been divided into its respective syllables. 
Types of syllables
Different Ghanaian languages have different types of syllables. However, among 
the Ghanaian languages, open and closed syllables are the most common types. 
Open syllables
An open syllable is a syllable that ends in a vowel. The following are examples 
of how Ghanaian language words have been divided into their open syllables. 
Ewe:  a: kpe, tɔ, va, dzo
Ga:  ka, n: ka: ti: ɛ, n: ka: la: de
Mfantse:  n: su, n: ku: ko, a: pa
Twi:   ko: fi, e: tu: o, ɛ: tɔ
Closed syllables
A closed syllable is a syllable that ends in a consonant. It is important to note 
that most Ghanaian languages do not have closed syllables, but they have

Syllable Structure
The structure of syllables differs from language to language. The syllable 
structure can be described in terms of the consonants (C) and vowels (V). The 
vowels are the most important part of the syllable. For all Ghanaian languages, 
tone is also a major factor in identifying syllable structure. In addition to the 
vowel, the syllabic consonant also bears tone. The number of vowels and 
consonants that a word has determines its syllable structure. For example, if a 
word contains two vowels, then it has at least two syllables. Some examples of 
Ghanaian languages words and their syllable structures are: 
1. Ewe: e (V), tɔ (CV), 
2. Ga: ni (CV), a: te (V: CV), n: ka: ti: ɛ (C: CV: CV: V)
3. Twi: a (V), tu (CV), a: ta (V: CV), n: ta (C:CV), e: tu: o (V: CV: V) 
4. Mfante: a (V), kɔ (CV), a: pa (V: CV), m: pa (C: CV), a: pa: a (V: CV: 
V)
5. Dagbani: zab: li (CVC: CV)

THE CONCEPT OF TONE
All human languages use pitch for emphasis and/or to express emotions or 
meaning. Tone is the raising or lowering of the pitch of voice across a syllable 
or a word that results in a change in meaning. A tonal language is a language 
where the meaning of words depends on tone. All Ghanaian languages are 
tonal. Pitch changes across a whole sentence are what we call intonation. 
6
SECTION 1 SYLLABLE STRUCTURE AND TONE
Types of Tone
Different languages have different types of tone. The following are examples 
of some types of tone among Ghanaian languages: high (H) tone, low (L) tone, 
mid (M) tone, falling (F) tone, and rising (R) tone. All Ghanaian languages have 
at least two types, namely high and low. In addition to these two types, others 
have mid-tones. There are others, too, that have additional rising and falling 
tones. The following are examples of tone in some Ghanaian languages.
1. Two-tone languages (high and low): Akan, Nzema, Ga, Kasem, Ewe, etc.
2. Three-tone languages (high, low and mid): Dangme, Dagbani, etc. 
The tones are marked with [`] for low tone, [´] for high tones, and [ ¯] for mid 
tones. For example, the Akan word dà never has a low tone marked on the 
vowel, whereas the word dá ‘to sleep’ has a high tone marked on the vowel. A 
sequence of L and H or H and L produces a rising (R) tone or a falling (F) tone, 
respectively. 
Functions of Tone
Tone is very important in tonal languages due to the distinctive role it plays in 
meaning. There are three main functions of tone among tonal languages. These 
are lexical, grammatical and dialectal. 
1. Lexical function of tone:  Tone is used to distinguish different meanings 
from words that have the same spelling or otherwise would be homonyms 
in a language. See the examples below. Note how the markings above the 
letters change the tone.
a. Akan: pá:pá ‘good’ vs pà:pá ‘father’, sùsù ‘to measure’ vs. súsú ‘savings’
b. Ewe: sí ‘to flee’ vs sì ‘to cut’
c. Ga: bè ‘time’ vs bé ‘to quarrel’
2. Grammatical function of tone: Tone is used to mark contrast in grammatical 
features such as case, tense, aspect, etc. The following are some examples. 
a. Everyday/habitual vs command aspect: kòfí ʥìná ‘Kofi stands’ vs kòfí 
ʥìnà ‘Kofi stop!’
b. Everyday/habitual vs future tense: kòfí bɛ̀ fá ‘Kofi takes’ vs kòfí bɛ́fá 
‘Kofi will take’
c. Negation vs command aspect: ǹtá ‘don’t mend’ vs ńtá ‘should mend’
d. Main vs subordinate clause: [mʊ̀rʊ́kɔ̀] ‘I’m going’ vs [mʊ̀rʊ́kɔ́ nʊ́] 
‘When I was going…’
7

3. Dialectal function of tone:  Tone can also be used to indicate distinctions 
between dialects of the same language. The following are examples.
a. [mʊ̀rʊ́kɔ̀] in Fante vs [mɪ́rɪ́kɔ́] in Asante ‘I’m going’ 
b. [ɔ̀kɔ́] in Asante vs [ɔ́kɔ̀] in Akuapem ‘S/he is gone’
