kasibɛbirabarso to loŋ.
Baru be kawol be kasibɛbirabarso
Kasibɛbirabarso monɛ baa sibɛ a sa baasa damta nɛ abɔayasaso be achɛtosɔ. Baru be 
kawol be abɔayasaso be achɛtosɔ ela kaboŋ monɛ ba lara abɔaya fanɛ baru be nwol to.
Kebɔayaseso be kapɔr
Fo kaŋ tiseto fobe benupo/bekrampo n luwe, n lara kumu, n chala achɛtosɔ n luwe, n 
tol kumu na, kebɔaysaso be kasibɛ be saŋɛ fo.
Kebɔayaseso be mba mba
Kebɔayasaso na daga ku ka kɔ mba ana nna;
i. Kechurɔ
Sososo ela kechurɔ benupo na n shin delge fobe kumu so. Wɔrɔ bumo ansaŋ nɛ 
keba nɛ kagbenefuli. Fanɛ ma tere/nekpa lɛla, ma bunyaŋwura nɛ adamta.
ii. Kasotofuti
Ashi kasotofuti to, delge fobe kesheŋtirso na so n sa fobe benupo na. Fanɛ, n yili 
menyebe anishito kapa ere nɛ n sa menye kananɛ anyee kuŋ ashuŋ lubi be jirbɛ 
ashi anyebe nde to.
iii. Kebɔayasaso be apuntoso
Mfa, adaga fo ka nyi kusɔ kama nɛ fee sha kemalga na ta n laŋɛ fobe kumu na be 
kabaso be asheŋ. Mfa nɛ fee sa abɔaya monɛ a bee buwi fobe kesheŋtirso na to 
nɛnɛ.
iv. Lalaluwe
Lalaluwe na to, adaga fo ka tiŋ luweto nɛ benupo na e baa fɛ kusɔ monɛ ku wɔrɔ 
na be asheŋ nna. Fanɛ, “n lara efuli ekpa monɛ adaga nɛ fo gbagba be kushuŋ ta 
n laŋɛ fiiba be kulɔ be kekuŋ be kabaso. Ku la anyebe tama nna fanɛ ekama beeŋ 
chɛto nɛ anye e ju fiiba be kulɔ ashi anyebe nde to”.

Kushuŋ 5.6 Kebɔayasaso be kapɔrto be kepin to
Kunyɔnyɔto, menye e bii kebɔayasaso be kapɔr monɛ ku wɔ kaseto ere n shin pin 
adabi/kapɔr na to fanɛ: kechurɔ, kasotofuti, apuntosɔ nɛ lalaluwe. Chigeto fobe

Ma beŋinipo nɛ beteri lɛla,
Anshuma mabe beŋinipo nɛ benekpa/beteri. Kabre ela “Durnyaŋ kikɛ be Alemfia be 
Kachɛ”, nɛ ma Amaabaŋɛ Akuro bee sha nɛ m malga n sa menye ta n laŋɛ karɛchɛ 
kikɛ be eyurto be kesaŋɛto be tunɔ be asheŋ. Ku daga baasa ka du wurɛwurɛbi nna a 
kɔ alemfia. Anyebe naniere be kebawɔtɔ monɛ anye wɔ kumo to na fanɛ a china kaboŋ 
koŋwule a chɛr, nɛ kumobe loŋ la tɔrɔ n sa anyebe alemfia. Eyurto be kesaŋɛto maŋ la 
ku baa shuŋ kushuŋ gboŋ nna a nya alemfia. Anye beeŋ tiŋ nya le be yulwe nɛ anye kaŋ 
ta kayursaŋɛ be adabi a wɔtɔ karɛchɛ kama be ashuŋ/kawɔrɔ to. Buko bee kaŋɛ fanɛ 
kefara na e du kpakpa, amoso n teri, fara kabre n sa maŋ naŋ yige.

Baru be kawol be kekeniso
Ngbanyato be kabii be kechɛto
Fanɛ bebiipo kpra, fo tiŋ n wu fanɛ kabii be kabaso, fee kaa chɛrga ngbar a malga 
fobe kebawɔtrɔ to, ashi fobe kanaŋ nɛ beteri kutɔ be kamalga n ta n yɔ kasɔbii to ashi 
ebiikpa. Ama, fo daŋ tiŋ baaŋ n china m fɛ kechɛto monɛ fo gbagba be ngbar kɔ ashi 
fobe sukuru be kabaso aa?
Kemigeto damta bee ŋini fanɛ bebiipo monɛ bu kɔ bumo gbagba be ngbar be kenyi 
bee wɔrɔ asɔ ga ebiikpa, fɔŋfɔŋ kasɔbii kraŋso nɛ asibɛso be kapliɛ. Nkpalmanɛso, esa 
gbagba be ngbar e na ŋini ngbar pɔtɛ be kabii, a shin nɛ anyee bii n naa nu ngbar pɔtɛ 
a pe nɛnɛ.

N naŋ ta n tiiso, fo baa ta fo gbagba be ngbar a shuŋ ku bee chɛto nna nɛ fee pin fobe 
adaŋkaresheŋ nɛ adrasheŋ. Ngbar nɛ daŋkare baa mar abar nna, nɛ fo baa tiŋ a malga 
fo gbagba be ngbar bee chɛ bebiipo to nna nɛ baa pin bumobe elarkpa nɛ bumobe 
adaŋkare tenini be asheŋ.
N naŋ ta n tiiso, kemigeto bee ŋini fanɛ bebiipo monɛ bu kɔ bumo gbagba be ngbar be 
kenyi kɔ lakal ga a laŋɛ kenyiŋi asheŋ manaŋ, a tiŋ a nya kesheŋ be tɔrɔ be yulwe n shin 
naa fɛ mfɛra a yɔ kufɔ. Nkpalmanɛso, mobe ngbar gbagba na la kusɔ nɛ ku wɔ mobe 
lakal to nna a sa nɛ e bee tiŋ a malga nɛnɛ n naa nu abɔaya to nɛnɛ.
Lalaluwe, ku ta fo gbagba be ngbar a shuŋ nko a malga bee chɛto nɛ sukuru be kabla be 
kejigi, adaŋkaresheŋ be kepin nɛ kefɛ mfɛra n yɔ kufɔ. Menye bebiipo kpra, daga menye 
ka pɛto n shin koli menyebe ngbar gbagba nna, hali nɛ menyee bii ngbar pɔtɛ gba ashi 
menyebe kabla be kabaso.
Kushuŋ 5.8 Kebɔayasaso/baru be kawol be kasibɛ
 Ntuŋso to, menye e sibɛ nto asa be kebɔayasaso/baru be kawol nɛ kumu ere: 
Nkilgi/nchɛrga ashi ma sukuru to. Wɔrɔ aniya n sibɛ ekpaana monɛ a wɔ esoso ere 
kikɛ. Blase n chigeto fobe atuwebi na n sa fo braana.
KAWOL KPRA BE ADABI/KAPƆR
Kechɔ fo kumu n keni – Anye e keni kakpa nɛ fo bii m fo
Pɔɛ nɛ anye e chɛso m bii kasibɛbirabarso be ntuŋso, laŋɛ fobe lakal n yɔ n shin 
sibɛ kasibɛbirabarso be ntuŋ ana nɛ amobe adabi/kapɔr na.
Kawol kpra
Kawol kpra la kasibɛbirabarso monɛ ku bee bɛ bunyaŋ be ekpaso nna a yɔ benimukpra 
kutɔ. Ku bee ta bunyaŋ be ebol be mmalgaba nna a shuŋ.
Kawol kpra bee tiŋ a shuŋ benimukpra nko bumo nɛ bu chɔ anye kenimu be kelijima 
to. Benimu na be akeniso ko ela sukuru be enimu, baru be nwol be enimu(editor), 
eshuŋkpa be enimu (managing director) nɛ adamta.
Kawol kpra be adabi
Kawol kpra be adabi nde.
1. Esibɛpo be adrɛsi: Kede ela kasibɛbirabarso na be sososo. Ta fobe adrɛsi na n deŋi 
esoso – jisaso be kukɔlɔbi na to. Menye e baa nyi fanɛ ekpa wɔtɔ nɛ fee naŋ tiŋ sibɛ 
kumo banaso be kukɔlɔbi na to ashi ekpa monɛ fo bɛso a sibɛ na so.
2. Kachɛ: Kede ela kachɛ monɛ fee sibɛ kawol na.

3. Esɔpo be adrɛsi: Esɔpo na be ketere/ashuŋkpa nɛ adrɛsi ashi banaso esoso gberɛ.
4. Kechurɔ; Kechurɔ mo nɛ keniŋi (ma enimu, ma bunyaŋwura nɛ adamta)
5. Kumu: Kumu monɛ ku bee ŋini kusɔ mo so nɛ fee sibɛ kawol na bee la alɔntorworgboŋ 
nna. Ku bee la mbishi na be keduwɔso nna.
6. Kasotofuti; Kamalgafol shimbi monɛ ku bee futi kusoe ta n laŋɛ kusɔ monɛ ku bra 
kawol na be kasibɛ be kabaso.
7. Nto: Kesheŋtirso kama daga ku ka la kato nna. Ku ta nto n shuŋ bee shinnɛ esɔpo 
na bee pin kebɔaya na to nɛnɛ nna.
8. Keluweto/lalaluwe: Kawol na be lalaluwe, esibɛpo na e lɔŋɛ mpalto mobe abɔaya 
kpra nna to.
Ashi kawol kpra be kesibɛ to, ku daga fo ka malga gberɛ nɛ bunyaŋ be ebol nna. Wɔrɔ 
aniya a ta bunyaŋ be mmalgaba, be ebol nɛ kumobe kapɔr na a shuŋ, loŋ nɛ baaŋ ta 
fobe kebɔaya na nɛ kenishipre. Wɔrɔ aniya n keni fanɛ fobe akurso nɛ ngbar be mbra 
na niŋi nɛnɛ pɔɛ n ta kumo n chise.
Kushuŋ 5.9 Kawol be adabi
Sibɛ kawol kpra be adabi n shin chigeto fobe atuwebi na n sa fo braana.
Kushuŋ 5.10 Nwol kpra be kasibɛ
Ntuŋso to, menye e sibɛ nto asa be kewol kpra n sa menyebe kadeto be ewura a 
kaŋɛ mo nkilgi be ashuŋ asa monɛ adaga keluwe ashi menyebe kade na to. Wɔrɔ 
aniya n sibɛ kawol kpra be kapɔr be adabi na kikɛ n shin blase n chigeto fobe 
atuwebi na n sa fo braana.
KAWOL JEWULEBI
Kawol jewulebi la esa gbagba be kawol monɛ e bee sibɛ a sa mo beteri/benekpa nko 
kanaŋ nna a kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ ku bee yɔ so bumobe kebawɔtɔ to n naa churɔ bumo. 
Kawol jewulebi la kawol monɛ baa sibɛ a sa kanaŋebi, bechinashapo nko beteri/
benakpa nna. Kumobe kasibɛ be ekpaana e bɛso na.
Kawol jewulebi be kapɔr
Kawol jewulebi be kapɔr be ekpaana nde:
1. Esibɛpo be adrɛsi: Adrɛsi ela sososo be kusɔ monɛ feeŋ sibɛ. Ku daga nɛ fo 
sibɛ kumo n deŋi esoso – jisaso be kukɔlɔbi na to nna. Ku daga nɛ fo sibɛ kumo 
kelelemuto nna nɛ fo kɔ ndulwi be kebi, ta n tiiso.

2. Kachɛ: Ta kachɛ monɛ fee sibɛ kawol na n nase adrɛsi na be kaseto.
3.  Kechurɔ: Keniopibi be kechurɔ fanɛ nnio lɛla, nteri Dari, nɛ adamta
4. Kasotofuti: Sososo be ebol na bee fara mfa nna a bishi esɔpo na be alemfia. Feeŋ 
naŋ tiŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ fee tama fanɛ e beeŋ nya kawol na nɛ kagbenewushi. Sososo be 
kamalgafol na daga ku ka bee wushi kagbene n naa fuli kagbene to.
5. Kawol be apuntoso: Sososo be ebol na daga ku kaa bee fuli kagbene nna. Ama 
ashi esa monɛ fee sibɛ a sa nna, feeŋ tiŋ chɛrga fobe mmalgaba/mmalgafolshiŋ na 
be ebol na. Fo teri be ebol daga ku ka kɔr nɛ fo ka bee sibɛ a sa enimu ashi fobe 
kanaŋ to.
6. Lalaluwe: Mfa, duwɔso kusɔ kama nɛ fo malga na lalaluwe be kato na to. Sa 
ekrampo na kagbenewushi be kebɔaya. Saŋ teŋso kekaŋɛ ekrampo na fanɛ e lɔŋɛ 
n sibɛ fo e kaŋ kraŋ n luwe. Ku bee ŋini fanɛ kelijima na bee chuwɔso nna na.
7. Keterechaŋso: Kede maŋ la ekpa koŋwule be kebɛso nna, feeŋ tiŋ wɔrɔ kumo 
kanaŋkama ashi esa monɛ fee sibɛ kumo asa nna. Ade ela mmalgafolshiŋ monɛ a 
bee tiŋ a shuŋ:
i. Nɛ kasha damta
ii. Fo teri/nekpa lɛla
iii. Nɛ kagbene wushi
iv. China nɛnɛ
v. Nɛ kechurɔ damta
Kawol jewulebi bee ta ngbar monɛ a la asɔ monɛ mo nɛ mo teri/nekpa nyi nna a shuŋ. 
Wɔrɔ aniya a ta ebol dagaso a shuŋ n shin naŋ bɛ kumobe kapɔr so.

1. Laŋɛ m palto kawol kpra to a buwito kumobe kapɔr na n nase.
2. Saŋɛ monɛ ku daga nɛ fo sibɛ kawol jewulebi?
3. Ta kawol jewulebi be adabi n wɔrɔ kamalga ashi ebiikpa.

Kushuŋ 5.12 Kawol jewulebi be kasibɛ
Ntuŋso to, menye e sibɛ nto asa be kewol jewulebi n sa menye teri/nekpa a kaŋɛ 
mo fobe sukuru be ewushi be asheŋ. Wɔrɔ aniya n sibɛ kawol jewulebi be kapɔr be

KEBƆAYA BE NKILGI
Kebɔaya be nkilgi ela fo ka ta kebɔaya ashi kumobe elerkpa a yɔ ngbar ko to nɛ 
kumobe kefiito maŋ chɛrga. Ngbar monɛ ku shi na ela elerkpa nɛ ngbar monɛ fo kilgi 
kumo a yɔ na la ngbar pɔtɛ/ko.
Ekpa monɛ feeŋ bɛso nkilgi kebɔaya
Kebɔaya be nkilgi be keŋini bee sha nɛ bebiipo e nya kenyi nna ta n laŋɛ asheŋ be 
kemigeto, nɛ kepinto n shin tiŋ kilgi kebɔaya ngbar ko to n yɔ ngbar pɔtɛana to. Ekpa 
monɛ feeŋ bɛso nkilgi kebɔaya nde:
1. Kebuwi ekpa: Pin kebɔaya be nkilgi nɛ kebuwi kebɔaya be kefiito be mbarga nɛ 
adaŋkare be kechɛto ashi nkilgi/kebɔaya na to.
2. Nya kakraŋ be agoni: Wɔrɔ aniya n tiŋ n kraŋ n numpe kebɔaya na be elerkpa to 
nɛnɛ.
60

3. Kebɔaya be ketiseto: Pin abɔaya be ntuŋso, ebol, kusɔ nɛ ku ba nɛ benupo/
bekraŋpo mo be kebɔaya nɛ ku la.
4. Wɔtɔ lakal nɛ kebɔaya be nkilgi be atrɔmbi. Wɔrɔ ade be ako:
i. Kefiito be nkilgi nko keta mmalgaba koko a kilgito
ii. Adaŋkare be kebɛso
iii. Animumalga/mmalgatrɔmbi
iv. Mmalgaba/awor be kushu n kukweso
5. Nkilgi be kekoya: Fara nɛ abɔaya jewulebi n shin dii a yɔ akpakpaso to.
6. Yiliso kebɛ abarso nɛnɛ: Kpaŋ kebaa kilgi kebɔaya be kefiito achɔ mmalgaba koko.
7. Ta durnyaŋ be nchɛrga/kenishibuwi be ashuŋsɔ n shuŋ: Ta kebɔaya be nkilgi be 
kechɛtosɔ, mmalgaba be kawol nɛ afuuto be achɛtosɔ n shuŋ nɛ a chɛ kabii to.
8. Kelaŋɛ n keni nɛ atuwebi be kelaŋɛ n sa: Laŋɛ n kraŋ n shin sa fo braana atuwebi 
daga so.
9. Wɔrɔ aniya a bii abɔaya kpakpaso/tenini ko: Baa bii amu koko tenini fanɛ (mbra, 
adur/alemfiasheŋ nko kaba kama so)
10. Pre kenishi a wɔrɔ a keni: Baa bii kebɔaya kama nɛ fo nya be kekilgi nɛ ku chɛto 
nɛ fobe nkilgi be agoni a daŋɛ so.
Kebɔaya be nkilgi be ntuŋso
Kebɔaya be nkilgi be ntuŋso shi ga, amobe ako nde:
1. Mmalgaba koko be nkilgi; Mmalgaba koko be nkilgi nɛ ku bee keni amobe keniŋi 
m bulɔ kenishi achɔ amobe kemalga nɛnɛ.
2. Nkilgi buwitoso: Nkilgi monɛ kebɔaya na be kefiito nɛ ebol bee lar efuli nɛnɛ.
3. Adaŋkare be kebɛso be nkilgi: Kede to, abɔaya kilgiso na bee chɛrga gberɛ nna n 
kukwe ngbar na be adaŋkare be mbarga to.
4. Kapɔr be nkilgi: Kekilgi a bɛ elerkpa be kebɔaya be kapɔr so.
5. Kebuwi kebɔaya be kefiito: Kede la kɔnɔto be nkilgi nna nɛ bu kɔ a shuŋ nshɛr nko 
mbra be ebu to.
6. Nkilgi monɛ ku maa bulɔ ekpa: Nkilgi monɛ ku bee kuu kebɔaya na be kaba a lɛ 
nko a kuu a daŋɛ so.
7. Kebɔaya be kefiito be nkilgi: Nkilgi monɛ ku bee ta benupo be lakal a shuŋ a lara 
kebɔaya na be kefiito nɛnɛ.
Nkilgi be kewɔrɔ n keni
Nkilgi be kewɔrɔ n keni be ashuŋ ko nde:
1. Kamalgafol jewulebi: Kilgi mmalgafol jewulebi ashi ngbar ko to a yɔ a ko to nɛ a 
baa niŋi ekpa n naa bɛ ngbar be mbra so.
2. Animumalga/mmalgatrɔmbi: Bii animumalga/mmalgatrɔmbi, mmalgabafɔ nɛ

mmalgafolshiŋ be nkilgi.
3. Nto shinshimbi: Nto shinshimbi nɛ a ba kɔ kefiito be nkilgi.
4. Abɔaya kpakpaso/tenini ko: Baa kilgi amu koko tenini fanɛ (mbra, adur/
alemfiasheŋ nko kaba kama so) n tiŋ m bii mmalgaba pupɔr.
5. Ngbar be apɔrsobi be abɔaya: Kilgi ngbar be apɔrsobi be abɔaya fanɛ (atande, 
epelsibɛ, ashɛrkpaŋ shimbi) a bii ebolbenchɛrga nɛ kananɛ keshɛrkpaŋ bee nite nɛ

The Environment
In our modern world, there are many factors that place the wellbeing of the planet in 
jeopardy. While some people have the opinion that environmental problems are just 
a natural occurrence, others believe that human beings have a huge impact on the 
environment. Regardless of your viewpoint, take into consideration the following factors 
that place our environment as well as the planet Earth in danger.
Global warming or climate change is a major contributing factor to environmental 
damage. Because of global warming, we have seen an increase in melting ice caps, a 
rise in sea levels, and the formation of new weather patterns. These weather patterns

have caused stronger storms, droughts, and flooding in places that they formerly did 
not occur.
Air pollution is primarily caused as a result of excessive and unregulated emissions of 
carbon dioxide into the air. Pollutants mostly emerge from the burning of fossil fuels 
in addition to chemicals, toxic substances, and improper waste disposal. Air pollutants 
are absorbed into the atmosphere, and they can cause smog, a combination of smoke 
and fog, in valleys as well as produce acidic precipitation in areas far away from the 
pollution source.
In many areas, people and local governments do not sustainably use their natural 
resources. Mining for natural gases, deforestation, and even improper use of water 
resources can have tremendous effects on the environment. While these strategies often 
attempt to boost local economies, their effects can lead to oil spills, interrupted animal 
habitats, and droughts.
Ultimately, the effects of the modern world on the environment can lead to many 
problems. Human beings need to consider the repercussions of their actions, trying 
to reduce, reuse, and recycle materials while establishing environmentally sustainable 
habits. If measures are not taken to protect the environment, we can potentially witness 
the extinction of more endangered species, worldwide pollution, and a completely 
uninhabitable planet.

KAKIL NƐ ASHEŊ PUPƆR KO
Asɔ pupɔr ko bee bra nchɛrga daŋkare be kakil to. Le be nchɛrga pupɔr la asɔ monɛ a kɔ 
kechɛto nɛ tɔrɔ kikɛ nna, a delge anyebe daŋkare kpra nɛ kachina to be kebawɔtɔ so. 
Amobe akeniso ko e wɔ kaseto ere.
1. Sukuru be kasɔbii: Sukuru to be kabii be kebuwito leŋ baasa to nna fɔŋfɔŋ beche, 
nɛ baa lara kananɛ baaŋ kil nɛ kananɛ kebawɔtɔ beeŋ ba du n sa bumo. Saŋɛ 
damta, esa na e naa ŋini asheŋwɔrɔso monɛ adaga mobe kakil to.
2. Bomin be asɔ daga so nɛ keche nɛ kenyɛn be kesasa be asheŋ: Kelento monɛ ku wɔtɔ 
n sa esa be kusɔ nɛ ku daga e ka kɔ nɛ keche nɛ kenyɛn be kesasa shin nna nɛ 
mbarga ba daŋkare be kakil be kabaso fanɛ eche ka bee ji kapitɛ adaŋkare ko to.
3. Kabɔrɛshuŋ be nchɛrga:  Asɔrisheŋ, kekramoaya nɛ abɔrɛshuŋ pɔtɛ bra ekpa nɛ 
mbra pɔtɛana, saŋɛ ko a ta daŋkare ko a wie anyebe kakil to. Ku bee shin nna nɛ 
esa bee ta eche mobe daŋkare be ekpa so n naaŋ laŋɛ n ta mo kabɔrɛshuŋ na malɛ 
be daŋkare be kabaso.
4. Asɔ be ketiŋ wɔrɔ (kedamaya): Asɔ be ku baa tiŋ a wɔrɔ sa baasa ekpa nɛ kananɛ 
baa wɔrɔ bumobe nkil nna.
5. Kadegboŋ to be kebawɔtɔ: Baasa be ku baa yɔ ndegboŋ to shin nɛ bu bii baasa pɔtɛ 
be adaŋkare n wɔtɔ naniere be daŋkare be kakil to.
6. Durnyaŋ be nkilgi: Durnyaŋ be nkilgi chɛrga mbra be kakil nɛ kakil be kawɔrɔ nna 
nɛ kananɛ baasa bee shɛr, a malga nɛ kananɛ ba bir kelijima
7. Mbra be nchɛrga:  Mbra be nchɛrga fanɛ a ta daŋkare be kakil be asheŋ a wɔtɔ 
kegbeŋfu kikɛ be mbra to gba bee bra loŋ.
8. Adaŋkare nɛ durnyaŋ be nchɛrga: Adaŋkare nɛ alakal be kekasar abar gba bee 
bra loŋ.

Baasa anu n ta n yɔ baasa ashe be katuŋ to, menye e pel kakil be kawɔrɔ be epel 
ashi ebiikpa. Bebiipo na kikɛ e ji benimu, beche nɛ benyɛn be ashuŋ ashi kakil be 
kawɔrɔ na to. Menye e naŋ malga kadigal monɛ a wɔ daŋkare be kakil to n shin

Kananɛ anyeeŋ wɔrɔ n duwɔ naniere be nchɛrga lubi 
monɛ a wɔ anyebe daŋkare be kakil wɔrɔ na so
Kananɛ anyeeŋ wɔrɔ n duwɔ naniere be nchɛrga lubi monɛ a wɔ anyebe daŋkare be 
kakil wɔrɔ to nɛ anye e baa bunyaŋ anyebe ataada. Ekpaana ko nde:
a. Daŋkare be kenyiŋito: Adaŋkare be ekpaana kama nɛ a bee bra nnaŋ abarso na 
kikɛ daga ku baa palto. Kadeebi kikɛ daga keleŋto nɛ bu sɔ n shin naa wɔrɔ kakil 
daŋkare be ekpaso
b. Abar be bunyaŋ: Abar be kebunyaŋ beeŋ sa kenu n sa abar nɛ loŋ bee leŋ baasa to 
nɛ baa bunyaŋ bumobe adaŋkare.
c. Kanaŋ be kelijima: Benimu nɛ mbifolbi daga be ka bee shɛr a malga lakal so ta n 
laŋɛ daŋkare be kakil be asheŋ nɛ ku bra bumobe mfɛra bumobe adaŋkaresheŋ 
be kawɔrɔ so. Loŋ be kelijima nko daŋkare be kechɛr abar be kawɔrɔ monɛ baaŋ 
chige lakal to na beeŋ chɛto nɛ bu bunyaŋ bumobe adaŋkare n naŋ tiŋ nya naniere 
be tɔrɔ ere be yulwe.
d. Sukuru be kabla nɛ eleŋ: Sukuru be kabla daga kebuwito n leŋ baasa to nɛ bu sha 
n shin naŋ bunyaŋ bumobe adaŋkaresheŋ. Daŋkare be kakil daga a ka wɔ naniere 
be asheŋwɔrɔ so to ama n kaa kuŋ kumobe kela nɛ tunɔ
e. Durnyaŋ to be kebawɔtɔ be ayabi kama nɛ a bee tɔrɔ kakil be asheŋ fanɛ amanshɛrbi 
nɛ afuuto be asheŋ be mmalga kikɛ daga kemigeto. Adaga anye ka tiŋ kuŋ kakil be 
atɔrɔ lubi kama nɛ a wɔ kakil to.

KASOTOFUTI
Kaba ere bee futi fo asoe ta n laŋɛ kabuna be daŋkare nɛ daŋkare be kejunkpar be 
asheŋ monɛ fo bii ebu koŋwule to na nna. Kaba ere naa sa fo ekpa nna nɛ fo naŋ palto 
kabuna be daŋkare nɛ daŋkare be kejunkpar be asheŋ ashi Ghana be ngbarana to. 
Feeŋ migeto kabuna be daŋkare be asheŋ ashi Ghana be adaŋkare to, n tiise amobe 
tunɔ to n shin ta amo n karga feya so. Fo kepin kabuna be daŋkare nɛ daŋkare be 
kejunkpar be asheŋ to daga nkpalmanɛso, ku beeŋ daŋɛ fo so kenyi nɛ fobe kenishi a 
bulɔ Ghana be ngbar nɛ kasɔbii pɔtɛ fanɛ ademansheŋ nɛ kabɔrɛshuŋ be kasɔbii kikɛ. 
Kenyi monɛ feeŋ nya na beeŋ shin nɛ fobe kenishi a bulɔ fobe kabuna be daŋkare nɛ 
daŋkare be kejunkpar be asheŋ nɛ ngbar pɔtɛana kikɛ.
ALAKAL TENINI
Kabuna la kanaŋ gboŋ nna ashi ngbar to. Kabuna kama kɔ asɔ nko asɔfuteso monɛ 
baa tere ataŋɛbuna nna a yili fanɛ adaŋkaresɔ. Ewuragboŋ ela ngbar nko efuli kikɛ be 
ejunkparpo nɛ bewura malɛ la nde be bejunkparpo. Begboŋipo ela baasa monɛ baa 
buu nko agboŋi bewura.

Feeŋ nyɛ atuwebi monɛ a duli ade: Kabuna la baasa nɛ bu kɔ kenanafofo 
koŋwule, enimu koŋwule nɛ ketere/nduli/adaŋkaresɔ koŋwule nna. Ku beeŋ tiŋ 
n shi etuto nko enio be kabaso. Kabuna la kanaŋ gboŋ nna ashi ngbar/yiri to. 
Mbuna damta e naa kii ngbar be kaba (dialect) nɛ nnaŋ damta wɔ kabuna to.
Mbuna wɔ Africa be adaŋkare be nde fanɛ Ghana nna. Adrasheŋ bee ŋini fanɛ 
mbuna wɔ durnyaŋ be adaŋkare be mboŋ pɔtɛana gba nna..
Mbuna be adabi/kapɔr
Mbuna be adabi/kapɔr tenini be ako ela:
1. Kenanafofo koŋwule: Kabuna be baasa shi kenanafofo koŋwule to nna.
2. Nklaŋ koŋwule: Kabuna be baasa ler nklaŋ nɛ kakil to na nko kenyɛnpe to.
3. Nduli/adaŋkaresɔ koŋwule: Kabuna be baasa bee ji ketere koŋwule, adaŋkaresɔ 
nko daŋkare koŋwule nna.
4. Kɔnɔkoŋwule: Kabuna be baasa bee ka kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule nɛ lakal koŋwule nna.
5. Kebɛso kebɛso be kapɔr: Kabuna beeŋ tiŋ a kɔ bejunkparpo, benimu nko bewura 
monɛ baa junkpar lakal be kepɛ nko kesheŋ be kekre to.
6. Adaŋkare koŋwule: Kabuna be baasa kɔ daŋkaresheŋ koŋwule nna n shin naa kuŋ 
bumobe adaŋkare na. Bu naa kɔ adelebi koŋwule nko kechurɔ nɛ keshuliso lɛla 
nna.
7. Kayawuji be nnɔ koŋwule: Kabuna bee chigeto asɔ fanɛ kasawule nɛ adamta nna.
8. Kabuna nko daŋkare be kawɔrɔ: Kabuna kɔ adaŋkaresheŋ be kawɔrɔ fanɛ kakil, 
keliwɔrɔ nɛ daŋkare be nchɛgboŋ koŋwule nna.
Kabuna be kechɛto/tunɔ
Mbuna be asheŋ kɔ atunɔ damta n sa nde damta, amobe ako ela;
1. Kachinato be katuŋ: Kabuna bee buwi ekpa nna nɛ nnaŋ bee china ntuŋso a pin 
bumobe asheŋ shaso.
2. Kanaŋ be koŋwule: Kabuna bee bra kanaŋ abarso, n naa leŋ kɔnɔkoŋwule to.
3. Keniopibi: Kabuna be bra baasa abarso, kushuli n sa abar nɛ abar be kechɛto.
4. Nduli koŋwule: Kabuna be baasa kɔ nduli koŋwule nna, a ta bumo a kii nnaŋ gboŋ 
monɛ a shi adrasheŋ, ataada nɛ adaŋkare koŋwule to.
5. Kɔnɔkoŋwule nɛ abar be kechɛto: Kabuna bee chɛto nɛ kayurwushi/kɔnɔkoŋwule 
saŋɛ monɛ kechɛto daga fanɛ kadɔɔ be ademu nko nnɔgberge.
6. Kɔnɔgberge be yulwe: Kabuna kɔ ekpa mo so nɛ baa bɛso nna a yulwe nnɔgberge 
nɛ kagbenewushi bee wɔ kachina to.
7. Adaŋkare be kekuŋ: Kabuna bee chɛto nna a kuŋ kabuna be ataada/adaŋkaresɔ nɛ 
adrasheŋ a ta a ŋini kamantoebi.

KAPƆR
Daŋkare be Kejunkpar (Kewuraji) be Kapɔr, Kede bee ŋini kebɛso kebɛso be 
kejunkpar monɛ anye kɔ ashi ashuŋ to, gomina to nɛ mboŋ pɔtɛana.
Daŋkare be Kejunkpar (Kewuraji) be Kapɔr be adabi
Daŋkare be Kejunkpar be kapɔr be adabi ko nde:
1. Ebol be kesa be ekpa tenini: Ebol bee shi esoso nna a gbelgeto a ba kaseto, nɛ kaba 
kama kɔ kumobe kushuŋ nɛ asheŋwɔrɔso.
2. Mfrinto be kesheŋkre: Esoso be benimu nko bejunkparpo e naa kre ademu kpakpaso.
3. Kebɛso kebɛso: Kejunkpar be mba damta, ashi esoso be benimu kutɔ a yɔ beshumpo 
monɛ bu kraa luri to kutɔ.

kama monɛ a kɔ amobe ashuŋ.
5. Kekeni mue so: Bekenipo bee keni baasa gberɛbi so nna.
6. Kelijima kpra be ekpaana: Kelijima kpra bee bɛ ekpa naseso so nna nɛ baasa bee 
bɛso a bir kelijima ashi nde nko baasa be ntuŋ to.
7. Ashuŋ nɛ kesheŋwɔrɔ naseso: Ekama be ashuŋ buwito nna, kebir abarso a shuŋ

Ashi shabɔrɛ monɛ ku wɔ esoso ere to, feeŋ wu fanɛ kewurbuu be daŋkare to bee fara 
nɛ efuli be ewuragoŋ, ewura nɛ bewurbi/bewurche nna nɛ mbɔŋwura nɛ kasaawura 
male wɔ egbaŋ koŋwule to. Bewurbi na be kaseto ela dɔgti nɛ kabuna be benimu.
Keni: Ade be bushi, daŋkare be bejunkparpo ko beeŋ tiŋ a wɔtɔ ashi baasa ko be adaŋkare 
to.
Ekama na ashi shabɔrɛ na to kikɛ kɔ bumobe ashuŋ nɛ kechɛto nna. Bumo nɛ bumobe 
ashuŋ/kechɛto na be ako e wɔ kaseto ere.
Efuli be ewura
Efuli be ewura ela ewura monɛ e la efuli na kikɛ be ejunkparpo. Ashi ngbar ko to, efuli 
be ewura na kɔ eleŋ nɛ e bee ji gominati/abani nɛ mobe baasa kikɛ so. Ngbanya be 
efuli be ewura ela Yagboŋwura.
Efuli be ewura be Ashuŋ
1. Mo ela ngbar/efuli na kikɛ be enimu nko kumu.
2. Mo e naa nase kanase/mbra n naa yiliso nɛ a bee shuŋ.
3. Mo e naa junkpar benaapo nko mbɔŋwuraana ashi kenaa be saŋɛ.
4. He resolves disputes amongst his people Mo e naa bra yulwe mobe baasa be 
nnɔgberge to.
Ewuragboŋ
Ewurgboŋ ela ewura monɛ e bee keni kade nɛ kumobe nde monɛ a wɔ kumobe kefiɛto 
kikɛ so. Mo e la daŋkare be enimu monɛ baa lara ashi bewurajipo be kabuna fanɛ 
etuto nko enio be kabaso ashi mobe kade to be daŋkare to. Baa wɔrɔ adaŋkaresheŋ 
nna pɔɛ a buu mo kewura na. Ashi enio pe be daŋkare to ewurgboŋ beeŋ tiŋ a la eche. 
Ama loŋ maaŋ tiŋ wɔrɔ Ngbanyato nkpalmanɛso, Ngbanya bee ji etuto be kabaso nna.
Ewurgboŋ be Ashuŋ
Ewurgboŋ bee shuŋ ashuŋ ere nna;
1. Mo ela ngbar nɛ kegbomfu na kikɛ be enimu.
2. Mo e naa kre nko a pɛ kusɔnɛ ku beeŋ chɛ kegbomfu na to be nkre/jina.
3. Mo ela baasa na nɛ bebuni na be mfrinto wura.
4. Mo e naa bra kayurwushi n naa yulwe mobe baasa be nnɔgberge.
5. Mo e naa keni kegbomfu na be kasawule nɛ kapitɛ pɔtɛ kikɛ so.
6. Mo e naa kuŋ n saa leŋ baasa na be adaŋkaresheŋ to.
7. Mo e naa bra kade be nkilgi a sa mobe baasa.
8. Mo e naa junkpar nshɛrana be kawɔrɔ.

9. Mo ela daŋkare be efuli na kikɛ be demujipo nimuso.
10. Mo e naa nase kanase/mbra a yiliso fanɛ kapuni maŋ wɔtɔ mobe kade nɛ kegbomfu

Bewura/Bewurbi
Bede la bewura monɛ bu bɛ ewurgboŋ so nna. Bewurbi bee la kade be benimu nna a 
wɔ ndegboŋ nko ndewurbi to. Bumobe buko be nde maŋ naa wɔtɔ gba ama bu kraa 
buu loŋ be nde na be bewura. Bumoale gba bee bɛ ewurgboŋ be ekpa na so nna n shin 
naa wɔrɔ daŋkaresheŋ pɔɛ a kii bewura.
Bewura/Bewurbi be ashuŋ
1. Mo e naa yili ewurgboŋ be ayato a shuŋ saŋɛ nɛ ewurgboŋ na maŋ wɔtɔ.
2. Bumo e naa chɛto nɛ kayurwushi nɛ kenu n sa abar bee wɔ bumobe nde to.
3. Mo ela kade na kikɛ be demujipo nimuso
4. Mo e naa chɛto nɛ kayurwushi bee wɔ mobe efuli so.
5. Mo e naa wɔrɔ mobe nwol na be adaŋkaresheŋ n naa junkpar nɛ kenanasawule be 
kalɔŋɛ saŋɛ nɛ ku daga.
6. Mo e naa chɛto a kuŋ mobe kaboŋ nɛ e bee keniso nɛ asheŋlubi.
7. Mo e naa kuŋ bumobe kenana sawule.
8. Mo e na keni kowuchu, kabuna nko kade be kaba ko so.
9. Bumo e naa ta nkre monɛ bu pɛ a sa ewurgboŋ.

Banaso be bewura
Banaso be bewura nɛ Mbɔtɔɔ bee tere Miafi nɛ Nkraŋ bee tere bumo Benkumhene’. 
Bumo nɛ baa tere “banaso be abaa be ewura” bu la banaso be benimu monɛ baa china 
ewurgboŋ be banaso ashi daŋkare be kesheŋwɔrɔ nɛ kenaa to.
Jisaso be bewura
Jisaso be bewura nɛ Mbɔtɔɔ bee tere Đusifia’ nɛ Nkraŋ bee tere bumo ‘Nifahene’. 
Bumo ela katuŋ monɛ baa china ewurgboŋ be jisaso ashi daŋkare be kesheŋwɔrɔ to.
Bewura ntuŋ nyɔ na kikɛ bee chɛto nɛ daŋkare be kejunkpar nna a wɔrɔ ashuŋ koŋwule 
ashi bumobe nde to:
1. Bumo e naa chɛ ewurgboŋ na to a kre/pɛ kusɔnɛ ku beeŋ chɛ efuli na to nɛ kejunkpar 
be ashuŋ ko.
2. Bumo ela ewurgboŋ na be bana nɛ jisa so be mboŋ be bewura.

3. Bumo e naa niŋi n naa sa ewurgboŋ na lakal monɛ ku daga.
4. Baa chɛto a yulwe mobe baasa be nnɔgberge nɛ kayurwushi bee wɔ efuli na so.
5. Bumo e naa chɛto a buu n naa gboŋi bewura.
6. Bumo e na keni kenanasawule so n naa yulwe kasawule be kɔnɔgberge nɛ adamta.
Mbɔŋwura
Bumo nɛ Mbɔtɔɔ bee tere “Aʋadada / Aʋafia” nɛ Nkraŋ bee tere bumo ‘Tofuhene’
Mbɔŋwura be ashuŋ
1. Mbɔŋwurana e naa junkpar kadeebi a yɔ kenaa to.
2. Baa chɛto a kuŋ kade na nɛ kayurwushi nɛ kenu n sa abar bee wɔ kumo to.
3. Ba kaa yili ewurgboŋ be ayato saŋɛ ko ashi kelijima kpakpaso nko nnɔgberge ko to.
Bewurche
Bewurche ela beche be ayoyulsheŋ be kekuŋ be benimu nɛ adrasheŋ/adaŋkare be 
bekatapo. Baa chɛ bumobe nde to nɛ beche be kebawɔtɔ bee yɔ so nɛnɛ. Ashi Ngbar 
mo nɛ baa ji kewura enio be kabaso na to, ewurche e naa ŋini esa monɛ e beeŋ ji 
kewura mobe baasa kaŋ lara mo. Ba kaa tiŋ a lara bewurche monɛ baa sha nɛ bu baa 
shuŋ a sa bumo fanɛ bebɛsopo.
Bewurche be ashuŋ
1. Bumo e na chɛ bewura to ashi daŋkare be kejunkpar to.
2. Bumo ela beche na kikɛ be demujipo nimuso.
3. Bumo e naa chɛto a leŋ beche be kusɔ monɛ bu daga bu ka kɔ nɛ kade be nkilgi to.
4. Bumo e kata kanaŋ be adaŋkaresheŋ be kenyi ashi bumobe nde to.
5. Bumo e naa wɔrɔ ayoyulsheŋ be kawɔrɔ a sa mbichesobi monɛ baa kil nɛ bu nya 
kakurwe, kayurwushi nɛ adamta.
Kasaawura/Kegberwura
Kegberwura ela ayoyulsheŋ be enimu ashi mobe kade to. Mo e naa chɛ baasa n saa wɔ 
baasa na nɛ bebuni be mfrinto a yulwe kebawɔtɔ.
Kasaawura/Kegberwura be ashuŋ
1. Bumo e naa yili bewura be ayato nɛ ewura maŋ wɔtɔ ashi daŋkare be nde ko.
2. Bumo e naa kuŋ bumobe baasa ashi ayoyulsheŋ be kabaso.
3. Bumo e naa lɔŋɛ nwol so daŋkare be kawɔrɔ to ashi kewura be kebuu nko kegboŋi 
to.

4. Baa buwi edare nɛ kanyɛ be asheŋ to nna n shin naa sa ayoyulsheŋ be tɔrɔ be yulwe.
5. Baa kuŋ bumobe baasa be adrasheŋ, ataada nɛ adaŋkare nna.
6. Baa yulwe baasa ashi baasa lubi nko alɔ lubi be kabaso nna.
Begboŋipo
Egboŋipo la esa nko baasa be katuŋ monɛ bu kɔ kechɛtogboŋ a junkpar nɛ kewurji be 
kebɛso kebɛso be kabaso nna, ama bumo gbagba bre maa ji kewura. Bede bee chala 
nna a migeto a lara esa monɛ e beeŋ naŋ kii ewura nko ewurche monɛ e bɛso.
Begboŋipo be ashuŋ
1. Bumo e naa lara ewura monɛ e bɛso.
2. Bumo e naa wɔrɔ adaŋkaresheŋ ewura baaŋ wu.
3. Bumo e naa gboŋi ewura.
4. Bumo e naa ta ewura pupɔr na a ŋini kade be benimu nɛ kadeebi.
5. Bumo ela ewura be alakal sapoana.
6. Bumo e naa lurito a yulwe nnɔgberge.
7. Bumo e naa shinɛ kenimu be kechɛrga bee nite nɛnɛ kayurwushi so.
8. Bumo e naa migeto a fin baasa monɛ bu bɛso na be emo nɛ e daga kejunkpar.
Ewura be dɔgti
Dɔgti e bɛ ewura so kenyɔsepo a kɔ kechɛto/ashuŋ damta mobe kade. Bumobe ashuŋ 
na kɔr abar to nkpal bumobe ndeto be daŋkare be mbarga so. Bumobe ashuŋ kpakpaso 
na be ako nde:
1. Bumo e na ta ewura be kebɔaya a sa baasa.
2. Bumo e naa junkpar nko a wɔ ewura be anishito ashi daŋkare be kawɔrɔ to.
3. Baa yili ewura be ayato a malga a sa mo.
4. Bumo e naa keta ewura be kekpabi.
5. Bumo e naa ta befɔ be abɔaya a sa ewura n shin naa ta moalɛgba peya a sa befɔ na.

b. Ta fobe atuwebi na n ŋini bebiipo nɛ menye e pumpunto.
Ashi Jukuku be efuli bi ko to Ghana to, kɔnɔgberge tɔr Awɔndre, edɔɔpo nɛ mo da be 
kebia Awaaba so. Awɔndre kaŋɛ fanɛ Awaaba bee luri mobe kenanasawule be kaba 
to nna nɛ e pɔr kowu. Awaaba malɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ mo nananyɛn e daŋ sa mo kumo pɔɛ

be enimu ka wɔrɔ n gben nɛ ewurgboŋ tere kanaŋ na nɛ e yulwe kɔnɔgberge na. 
Bu kaŋɛ kabuna be benimu na fanɛ bu migeto m pin esa monɛ e wɔ kasawule na.

Kushuŋ 7.9 Daŋkare be benimu be ashuŋ
Buko bee ji amɔrɔ fanɛ nde daa tiŋ a nya kashinteŋji nɛ kɔnɔgberge be yulwe 
daŋkare be bejunkparpo kutɔ a chɔ naniere be akɔti be demuji to.
Kunyɔnyɔ to, menye e sibɛ menyebe eyilikpa ashi kebɔaya ere be kabaso nɛ menye 
e ji kumobe emɔrɔ ebiikpa.
Kushuŋ 7.10 Daŋkare be kejunkpar
“Daŋkare be kejunkpar kii kusɔ dra nɛ ku maŋ naa walɛ nna.” Menyebe ntuŋso 
to, menye e sibɛ kamɔrɔji be kasibɛbirabarso a shuliso nko a kini kebɔaya ere. Ta 
fobe atuwebi na n sa fo braana ebiikpa nɛ menye e pumpunto.
Kushuŋ 7.11 Keta kejunkpar be ntuŋ anyɔ na n kesar abar
Ntuŋso to, menye e ji emɔrɔ ta n laŋɛ daŋkare be kejunkpar be kapɔr be tunɔ n 
shin kaŋɛ amaŋ wurbi monɛ menye wu n shin ta n kesar naniere be gomina be 
kejunkpar be asheŋ n keni. Fanɛ kumo nɛ ku wɔ 7.9 to na.

KASOTOFUTI
Kaba ere bee futi fobe kusoe nna ta n laŋɛ daŋkare nɛ naniere be kɔnɔgberge be 
keyulwe (demuji) be ekpaana be asheŋ. Ku bee delgeso amo anyͻ na nԑ amobe ashuŋ 
so nna. Feeŋ ta amo anyɔ na be ashuŋ n karga abar so n wu amobe mbarga fo gbagba 
n shin lara kumo nɛ ku daga. Fo kenyi nɛ kepinto ta n laŋɛ daŋkare be kɔnɔgberge be 
keyulwe nɛ naniere be akɔti be demuji be kabaso beeŋ leŋ fo to ta n laŋɛ kɔŋkɔŋ be 
ketoo be ekpaana be ketiiso n wɔrɔ be kapliɛ. Ku beeŋ naŋ chɛ fo to nɛ kefɛ mfɛra be 
kabaso, asheŋ be kemigeto n lara kumo nɛ ku daga fo ka bee bii, fobe ashuŋ nɛ asɔ 
monɛ adaga fo ka bee wͻrͻ be asheŋ.
N naŋ ta n tiiso, kaba ere beeŋ sa fo kenyi monɛ ku daga n shin leŋ fobe kasha ta n 
laŋɛ echefoso be mbra, kejunkpar nɛ efuli pɔtɛana be kabii be asheŋ to.

Akɔti be demuji be ashuŋ
Akɔti be demuji bee shuŋ fanɛ ade:
1.  A buwi efuli be mbra be afiito a ta amo a shuŋ kananɛ ku daga.
2. Ku bee bra efuli so be kashintenji nɛ ashuŋ be kushuŋ nɛnɛ nna.
3. Ku bee kuŋ baasa be asɔ daga so nɛ kayurwushi fanɛ amo nɛ mbra be kawol na 
bee ŋini na.
4. Ku bee bra kashinteŋji n saa ju nkpiɛto ashi mbra na be keta n shuŋ to. (Kashinteŋji 
be kesa)
5. Ayulwe kɔnɔgberge nɛ kulɔntokɔ kama nɛ ku wɔ baasa, ntuŋ nɛ gomina be mboŋ 
be kefiato.
6. Ku bee bra asɔ fanɛ mmata, kelɔŋɛ abar, kenu n sa abar nɛ demu na maŋ naŋ luri 
kɔti to.
7. Ku bee sa eleŋ be kedara nɛ kekuŋ nna a kuŋ gomina be bejunkparpo nɛ 
mbrawuraana nna nɛ bu maa wɔrɔ a baŋso eleŋ monɛ mbra na sa bumo so.
8. A yili efuliso na be ayato a gberge baasa lubi asoe.
9. A yili demuwuraana be ayato ashi demuji to.
Naniere be akɔti be demuji be kapɔr
Ghana be akɔtisheŋ kɔ le be kebɛso bɛso ere nna:
1. Supirim kɔti ela esoso be kɔti
2. Apil be kɔti e bɛso a la mfrinto be kekule be kɔti
3. Hayi kɔti e ba bɛso a la sososo be demuji be kaboŋ a ji ademu kama.
4. Sɛkiuti nɛ Distiri be akɔti ela kaseto be akɔti monɛ a bee ji kanaŋ be mbra nɛ 
ademu wurbiana.
5. Mbia nko Trabuna be kɔti la kaseto be akɔti na be kumo nɛ ku bee ji ademu monɛ 
a la mbia monɛ bu maŋ naŋ fo mfɛ kudu aburwa(18) peya nna.
Kɔti be ashuŋana
Kɔti na e naa buwito n naa yili mbra fanɛ efulisoebi be mbra, bibilubi be mbra nɛ 
kushuŋto be mbra n naa keni fanɛ mbra be keta n shuŋ bulɔ ekpa nko kumaŋ bulɔ 
ekpa.
Ashi Ghana to, Supirim Kɔti be enumi ela Chief Justice (ajɛji be ewura), nɛ e la efuli 
na be mbra be beshumpo kikɛ be ejunkparpo. Kɔti na be beshumpo nɛ bu naŋ tiiso ela; 
ajɛji, amajistreti nɛ bemigetopo(assesors) nɛ baa chɛto a yulwe demu n saa buwi mbra 
na to n naa keni fanɛ mbra be keta n shuŋ bulɔ ekpa nko kumaŋ bulɔ ekpa.

Naniere be akɔti be demuji be kapɔr/kebirabarso nɛ 
ademuji be kabaso
1. Jɛji koŋwule e naa nu a ji demu ashi Hayi Kɔti, Apil be Kɔti nɛ Supirim Kɔti to.
2. Ashi Supirim Kɔti nɛ Apil Kɔti to, ajɛji asa n ya fo kudu asa be katuŋ (kananɛ ajɛji 
be enimu na bee sha bu ka fo) e naa china n nu n shin ji ademu. Baa nyi fanɛ ashi 
kɔti to, ajɛji be katuŋ na be baasa be kɔnɔ maaŋ tiŋ bargato dede (fanɛ besa, benu, 
beshunu, bekpanu).
3. Ademu ko to, jɛji nɛ bemigetopo (assesors) e naa china a sa kekuŋ nɛ kebuwito.
4. Magistireti e naa nu a ji demu ashi Magistireti Kɔti to.
5. Kayurwushi be jɛji e naa ji ademu wurbiana ashi Distiri Kɔti to.

Kɔnɔgberge be keyulwe be ekpaana ashi naniere be 
akɔti be demuji be kabaso
Kapɔr nɛ ekpaana na beeŋ tiŋ a kɔr nkpal kɔti, demu nɛ asheŋ monɛ a la be nkɔrto so. 
Ade la amo nɛ a bee wɔrɔ saŋɛ damta nna:
1. Demuwuraana na bee bulɔ mbra be eshumpo so nna a ta bumobe mfabal a nase 
kɔti to.
2. Kɔti na bee sa esa nɛ bu yɛr mobe kebɔaya kɔti to na kawol nna a tere mo kɔti na 
to.
3. Kɔti na bee tere nshɛrwurbiana nna a tise ademu na be ako to a lɔŋɛ nɛ a duwɔso 
n ka demu gbagba na.
4. Baaŋ ta adanshiya n nase nɛ adanshiya jipo malɛ e bɔ ntaŋ nɛ bu mige bumo to.

5. Jɛji na nko mbra be katuŋ na beeŋ sa bumobe demuji be kanase nɛ kasoegberge 
kananɛ ku daga.
6. Demuwuraana na beeŋ naŋ tiŋ n yɔ kɔtigboŋ to n ya kule.

Kushuŋ 8.1 Mbra be asheŋ
Menyebe ntuŋana to, menye e pin mboŋ anyɔ monɛ baa yulwe baasa be kɔnɔgberge. 
Chigeto mboŋ nɛ menye pin na n sa ntuŋ pɔtɛana.
Kushuŋ 8.2 Ghana be mbra be asheŋ
Baasa asa nko bena be katuŋ to, menye e lara kaseto be amu ere be kuko n shin fɛ 
mfɛra m fin abɔaya kananɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ n nyɛ amobe kabaso. Ta abɔaya na n nase 
bebiipo kikɛ be anishito n shin wɔrɔ shiriya nɛ fo nu ntuŋ pɔtɛana gba be abɔaya 
ta n laŋɛ amu nɛ a ka na be kabaso n shin sibɛ amo n nase.
1. Delge naniere be akɔti be asheŋ so nɛnɛ.
2. Buwito baasa monɛ baa shuŋ naniere be akɔtisheŋ be demuji na be tunɔ/
ashuŋ.
3. Buwito ekpaana monɛ a wɔ Ghana to be naniere be kɔnɔgberge be keyulwe to.
Kushuŋ 8.3 Kɔnɔgberge be keyulwe be ekpaana
1. Menyebe ntuŋana to, menye e bɛ ekpa asa kama nɛ bu tii ta n laŋɛ kɔnɔgberge 
be keyulwe be ekpaana so n shin pel epel n yulwe kaseto be kɔnɔgberge nɛ ku 
wɔ bebiipo anyɔ ere be kefiato:
Samaakuse nɛ Esaedi wɔ ebiikpabu koŋwule nna nɛ bumo benyɔ na bee ŋmia 
bɔɔl a sa bumobe sukuru. Bumobe lalaluwe be asukuru be abɔɔl be keŋmia to, 
bumobe sukuru nɛ sukuru pɔtɛ ko ŋmia kɔŋkɔŋ be keta be bɔɔl nɛ Esaedi maŋ 
nyi n shin n ji mo gbagba be sukuru nɛ ku shinɛ mobe sukuru tɔr. Agbo ka nu 
Samaakuse nɛ e ponte Esaedi so fanɛ ela bɔɔl be ejunkparpo (Kapitan) monɛ 
e maŋ nyi shɛŋ nna. Esaedi malɛ wu fanɛ e ŋaba mo nna nɛ e kpa Samaakuse 
etaŋ kulunyɔ. Kede bra emurɔ kpakpaso bumobe kefiato. Demu na bee sha 
kelurito n lɔŋɛ nna nɛ ku sa maŋ salga to.
2. Ŋinito kusɔnɛ ku ba nɛ fo bulɔ loŋ be ekpa na so n yulwe kɔnɔgberge na.

Kushuŋ 8.4 Kɔnɔgberge be keyulwe be ekpaana

DAŊKARE NƐ NANIERE BE AKƆTI BE 
DEMUJI BE ASHEŊ
Daŋkare be demuji be asheŋ
Daŋkare be demuji ela ataada nko adaŋkaresheŋ be kɔnɔgberge be keyulwe be ekpa 
monɛ ku wɔ anyebe nde to dra nna pɔɛ nɛ kɔti be demuji nɛ anye kɔ kabre ere. 
Kɔnɔto nɛ baa pɔl daŋkare be demuji be mbra nɛ a dese na a sa kamantoebi. Bewura, 
beyaasepo, kabuna be benimu nɛ bunyaŋwuraana ashi kade na to e naa kaa junkpar 
a ji daŋkare be ademu.
Amfoni 8.2: Amfoni ere bee ŋini daŋkare be demuji be nshɛr nna nɛ ku kɔ ewura nɛ mobe beyaasepo.
Daŋkare be Kɔnɔgberge be Keyulwe
Ade la daŋkare be kɔnɔgberge be yulwe be ekpaana nna nɛ a kɔr achiŋ kade na be 
ataada nɛ adaŋkaresheŋ to. Kade nko efuli kama nɛ kumobe ekpaana nna nɛ a bee 
bra kayurwushi kachinato. Ademu monɛ daŋkare bee tiŋ a yulwe be ako ela laŋto be 
asheŋ, kasawule be asheŋ, ekishi be kewɔrɔ n deso nɛ kefule.

Ekpaana monɛ a wɔ daŋkare be kɔnɔgberge be ke-
yulwe to
Ekpaana monɛ baa bulɔso a yulwe kɔnɔgberge daŋkare be kabaso ela;
1. Mmata/Mfrintowura (Mediation): Kede la kakpa nɛ esa pɔtɛ nɛ demu na maŋ 
liɛ mo ka shuliso nna n luri to nɛ e fin demu na be edesekpa nɛ e maŋ ta mbra 
naseso kama n shuŋ.
2. Demu be kenase (Adjudication): Kɔnɔgberge be keyulwe be ekpa ere la keta 
daŋkare be mbra nɛ kawɔrɔ n shuŋ nna demuji to. Baasa monɛ baa wɔrɔ kumo ela 
bewura, kabuna be benimu, kade be benimu nɛ sheriyajipoana.
3. Abar be kelɔŋɛ (Reconciliation): Ekpa ere ela kanaŋ be benimu nɛ beyaasepo ka 
bee fin kayurwushi, kɔnɔkoŋwule nɛ kejimbɔ ashi kɔnɔgberge wuraana be kefiato.
4. Kekule (Negotiation): Kede la kɔnɔgberge wuraana na ka china nna m bir 
kelijima n shuliso n sa abar fanɛ baaŋ yige kɔnɔgberge na be asheŋ.

paana n kesar abar

ABULƆMBI NƐ AYEREMU
Ebu AnyɔKaba  9
NGBANYATO BE KAMALGANYI
Kamalganyi Pɔlso
KASOTOFUTI
Kaba ere, fobe kenishi beeŋ buwi ta n laŋɛ abulɔmbi nɛ ayeremu nɛ a la kamalganyi 
pɔlso Ngbanyato be kabaso nna. Fobe kenishi tiŋ buwi asɔ fanɛ kachutoo nɛ awɔba 
so ashi ebu koŋwule to. Ashi abulɔmbi nɛ ayeremu be kabii to, feeŋ keni abulɔmbi 
be kapɔr be kemigeto nɛ amobe ntuŋso n shin ta n yɔ ayeremu be kapɔr be kekenito. 
Kaba ere daga nna n sa fo manɛ Ngbanyato nawule be kabaso ama asɔ pɔtɛ nɛ fee bii 
sukuru to na gba be ako be kabaso fanɛ kamalganyi ashi Mbronito. Kaba ere beeŋ naŋ 
sa fo kenyi monɛ kedaga nɛ fobe ngbar be atrɔmbi nɛ kadigal be yulwe be kefin be 
kabaso. Abulɔmbi nɛ ayeremu la ekpa lɛla so nɛ feeŋ tiŋ bulɔ n chɔ fobe mfɛra nna n 
keni n shin bra lakal. Akeniso monɛ a wɔ kaba ere na maŋ luwe.
ALAKAL TENINI
• Kebulɔmbi la mbishi, kamalga nko kamalgaba nɛ ku bee sha kefɛ mfɛra nna n yulwe 
kumo. Abulɔmbi bee kaa milto, a fule nko a kɔ mamachi n saa kɔ ketuwebi nɛ ku 
bee chiŋchiŋ baasa.
• Abulɔmbi nɛ ayeremu beeŋ tiŋ shuŋ kenishi deŋi, kasɔbii nɛ mfɛra be kedaŋ/tiiso 
be ashuŋ.
• Abulɔmbi beeŋ tiŋ leŋ fobe kananɛ fo kɔ ngbar a shuŋ to nɛ lakal.
ABULƆMBI
Abulɔmbi la epel be katuŋ nko mfɛra to be asɔ nna nɛ a bee ta ngbar, mmalgaba nɛ 
kanyiasheŋ farso/milto a ta amobe ketuwebi nko kefiito a ŋana. A bee la mbishi, 
kamalga nko kamalgafolshiŋ nna nɛ adaga fo ta lakal, kebilshi nɛ mfɛra damta n 
yulwe amo. A beeŋ tiŋ a kɔ emushesheŋ.
Abulɔmbi bee kaa:
1. Ta mmalgaba a pel: Mmalgaba nɛ amobe kushu la kekoŋwule ama kefii kɔr, amo 
nɛ akɔ afii anyɔ nɛ adamta.
2. Ta atankargasobi nɛ asɔ monɛ aduli abar a shuŋ.
3. Kɔ efar nɛ kekilgito damta.
4. Daga mfɛra pɔtɛ/buwitoso be kefɛ.
5. Kɔ ketuwebi monɛ fo maa tama.

ABULƆMBI NƐ AYEREMU
Ebu AnyɔKaba  9
Kushuŋ 9.1 Abulɔmbi be kefiito
Kunyɔnyɔ to, menye e ta menye gbagba be mmalgaba n ŋini kusɔ nɛ ku la 
kebulɔmbi n shin chige ketuwebi na to ebiikpa.
Abulɔmbi be ntuŋso
Feeŋ tiŋ bulɔ abulɔmbi be nteŋ so n ta amo n wɔtɔ ntuŋ nyɔ so. Amo ela:
1. Abulɔmbi milto, amo nɛ a wɔnteŋ.
2. Abulɔmbi jewulebi, amo nɛ a maŋ wɔnteŋ
Nkraŋ bee tere abulɔmbi ajenu nna, Mbɔŋ bee tere amo ebisaa, Nwɔŋ bee tere amo 
salinlɔha, nɛ Mbɔtɔɔ bee tere amo adzo.
Abulɔmbi be akeniso ko ela:
1. “Pasi pasi yɛr” (Ketuwebi: Jɔnɔ maa we gbesa moalɛ be anyi fuli)
2. “Keyito chil” (Ketuwebi: Ekpampo be ebin)
3. “Manɛ e naa ba saŋɛkama kumoalɛ maa fo kumobe eyɔkpa” (Ketuwebi: Echefo)
4. “Fiichulo fiichulo” (Ketuwebi: Kabuibi yɛ lɔr bulɔ kanaŋkama mo ere beeŋ choŋ)
5. “Kepaŋ kefui” (Ketuwebi: Kebolpɔ be edesekpa maa paŋ kefuibi)
6. “Bekpampo nɛ anaawuro” (Ketuwebi: Nwɔbabi)
7. “Kul kul maa duwɔ” (Ketuwebi: Fo maaŋ tiŋ maŋ ketirbi so n duwɔ nchu)
8. “Ntuto be kusɔ ko e wɔtɔ, fo shuŋi mo kaplɛkama nɛ e yɔ, e beeŋ bɛta m ba” 
(Ketuwebi: ebɔmfol)

Abulɔmbi be tunɔ/ashuŋ
Abulɔmbi be sososo be kushuŋ ela kenishi deŋi ashi anyebe nde to. Abulɔmbi wɔbel, 
ama amobe keta n shuŋ sukuru to kɔ tunɔ damta n sa bebiipo.
Ade la abulɔmbi be atunɔ ko nna:
1. A bee bra mfɛra be kefɛ n lurito nɛ asheŋ be keyulwe nna.
2. Abulɔmbi bee shinɛ anye bee mushe nɛ emushe malɛ walɛ n sa anyebe mfɛra be 
alemfia.
3. Abulɔmbi beeŋ tiŋ leŋ bebiipo be lakal, kefɛ mfɛra ga be agoni nɛ kadigal be yulwe 
be kefin to.
4. Kebaa wɔrɔ abulɔmbi a bɛ abarso beeŋ tiŋ shinɛ bebiipo be mfɛra e baa wɔ kaboŋ 
koŋwule n saa du manaŋmanaŋ.
5. Abulɔmbi beeŋ tiŋ a la keleŋto n sa bebiipo nɛ bu pre kenishi a shuŋ.
6. Benyipo bee ŋini fanɛ abulɔmbi bee shinɛ mbia be asɔ be kepinto bee daŋɛso nna.
7. Ashi abulɔmbi to, bebiipo beeŋ tiŋ bii mmalgaba pupɔr nɛ amobe kananɛ ba ta amo 
a shuŋ.
8. N naŋ ta n tiiso, bebiipo beeŋ naŋ bii kushunkukweso be asheŋ ashi abulɔmbi to.

Kebulɔmbi be kapɔr
Ghana be ngbar be kekama nɛ kumobe abulɔmbi be kapɔr ama ade la kebulɔmbi be 
kapɔr nna:
1. Kasotofuti: Kusɔ monɛ ku bee gberge nko a bra benupo be lakal.
2. Kedelgeso: Kedelgeso monɛ ku bee ta benupo be mfɛra a foe ketuwebi na so.
3. Mbishi: Mbishi monɛ feeŋ kpal kumobe ketuwebi.
4. (Twist)Kefar/kemiɛabar: Kamalgaba monɛ fo maa tama nɛ kumoalɛ junkpar fo n 
yɔ ketuwebi na so.
5. Ketuwebi: Kebulɔmbi na be kefiito/yulwe.
Kebulɔmbi jewulebi be kapɔr be kekeniso ko nde:
Kasotofuti: Mee ba saŋɛkama malɛ maa fo.

Kushuŋ 9.4 Abulɔmbi be kapɔr
Kunyɔnyɔ to, menye e mige kebulɔmbi ere to m barga kumo to mba mba monɛ 
menye wu esoso na – adaga fo ka kpal kumobe ketuwebi gba. Chige fobe ketuwebi 
na to n ŋini bebiipo kikɛ:
“Ntuto e kurwe mobe mbia ko, bumo kikɛ buu nwuro peper nna. Manɛ ela ma?” 
(ketuwebi: nwͻba be bibi)
Asɔ nɛ adaga fo baa dese fo baa pumpuŋ kebulɔmbi 
be kapɔr to
Kebulɔmbi be kepumpuŋto bee sha fo ka mige ngbar nɛ kapɔr na to nna n wu asɔ nɛ 
a beeŋ lara ketuwebi na n sa fo. Kebɛso bɛso be ekpa chɛtopo nɛ feeŋ ta m pumpuŋ 
abulɔmbi to nde:
1. Wushi eyur n kraŋ: Kraŋ kebulɔmbi na bɔiŋbɔiŋ nɛ keludamta saŋɛ na so feeŋ pin 
mmalgaba nɛ mmalgafolshiŋ na to.
2. Pin Mmalgaba kpra na: Chaŋ mmalgaba kpra, mmalgafolshiŋ nko asɔ monɛ a 
palate na n nase.
3. Keni m fin: Ku bee ka kͻ afii anyͻ nna, keni m fin kumobe afii anyɔ na be afiito.
4. Mige kapɔr na to: Shinɛ fobe lakal e baa wɔ kebulɔmbi na be kananɛ ku du so, n ta 
kumobe kasotofuti, kedelgeso, mbishi nɛ efar/kemilto n daŋɛso.
5. Fin asɔ monɛ a liɛ abar: Fin mmalgaba, alakal nko asheŋ monɛ a liɛ abar kebulɔmbi 
na to.
6. Keni alakal damta: Fɛ mfɛra n shin keni alakal pɔtɛana.
7. Ta atuwebi monɛ a yil parr n lɛ: Abulɔmbi bee kaa kɔ asɔ monɛ a bee fule baasa 
nna. Sa maŋ bɛ atuwebi monɛ a ler efuli ga so.
8. Kpal n keni: Ta fobe kemigeto be kenyi na n kpal n fin ketuwebi na.
9. Keni fobe ketuwebi na: Laŋɛ n kraŋ kebulɔmbi na n keni fanɛ fobe ketuwebi na 
nyalɛ to aa.
10. Palato n shin bii: Kananɛ fo baa wɔrɔ abulɔmbi damta a keni, loŋ nɛ fee pin amobe 
yulwe be kenyi.

Kushuŋ 9.5 Abulɔmbi be epel
Kunyɔnyɔ to, menye e fara nɛ kebulɔmbi gbulimbi be kekuu n sa fo barkasa. Nɛ 
e baaŋ tiŋ yulwe fobe kebulɔmbi na kumo ere moalɛ e naa sa fo mo peya nɛ fo 
yulwe. Emo nɛ e ji kɔŋkɔŋ ela emo nɛ e bishi abulɔmbi damta n shin naŋ yulwe 
adamta gba.
AYEREMU
Ayeremu la kadigal nko asɔ kpakpaso nna nɛ baa ta lakal nɛ mfɛra be kefɛ a yulwe 
amo. Kɔnɔto nɛ baa pɔl amo. Bu kɔ ayeremu nna a nya kenishideŋi, kenishi buwi/
kabii nɛ mfɛra be kebuwito. A bee chɛto a bra lakal buwitoso, kadigal be keyulwe be 
atrɔmbi nɛ kanyiŋi nna.
Ayeremu be ashuŋ/tunͻ
Ayeremu bee shuŋ ashuŋ damta ashi mboŋ pɔtɛana:
1. Lakal be kebuwito: A bee bra kadigal be yulwe be atrɔmbi nɛ kefɛ mfɛra nɛnɛ ashi 
baasa to fɔŋfɔŋ mbia nna.
2. Kenishi deŋi: A bee bra emushesheŋ, ewushi nɛ kamuji ashi baasa kikɛ to nna.
3. Kasɔbii/kenishibuwi: A bee leŋ kasɔbii to, a daŋɛ kanyiŋi so n naa shinɛ baasa bee 
pinto asɔ milto fanɛ kasɔbubu, ademansheŋ nɛ ngbarana to.
4. Kechɛ: A bee chɛto a lara kegben/kulɔ ashi mfɛra nɛ eyur to.
5. Abaranyɔ: A bee bra baasa abarso nkpal kechala a fin ayeremu be yulwe so.
6. Lakal be kabla: A bee leŋ mfɛra be kebaa wɔ kaboŋ koŋwule to, nɛ asɔ be kepin 
manaŋ nɛ ku beeŋ tiŋ n kuŋ lakal be kelaŋɛ kaman.
7. Kewushi eyur m fɛ mfɛra ga: A bee leŋ mfɛra monɛ a bee bra ayulwe pupɔr to nna.
8. Kechɔnkeni nɛ kemigeto: A la asɔ monɛ anyee bulɔso nna a chɔ anyebe kenyi nɛ 
kanyiasheŋ ta n laŋɛ asheŋ ko be kabaso.
9. Ashɛrkpaŋji nɛ Kesheŋkute: A bee bra kechala n wɔrɔ, kebilshi nɛ kamalganyi be 
kesalga nna.

Yulwe be ekpa
Nɛ Ntareka baaŋ ji kashinteŋ nna, kumo ere buku na wɔ Amaabaŋɛ kutɔ. Ama kede 
bee ŋini fanɛ Kusoemaanu nɛ Samaakuse beeŋ ba fule nna na, nɛ ku beeŋ shinɛ 
kashinteŋwura na e baa chɔ esa koŋwule. Loŋso Ntareka bee fule nna.
Nɛ Amaabaŋɛ baa ji kashinteŋ nna, e maŋ nyi kananɛ buku na du gba. Kede beeŋ 
ŋini fanɛ Ntareka, Kusoemaanu nɛ Samaakuse kikɛ bee fule nna na, nɛ ku beeŋ shinɛ 
Ntareka be kamalga na e ba la efɛ, a bal Amaabaŋɛ be kekaŋɛ manɛ mo e ta buku na. 
Amoso, Amaabaŋɛ bee fule nna.
Nɛ Kusoemaanu baa ji kashinteŋ nna, e wu buku na Samaakuse kutɔ. Kede beeŋ ŋini 
fanɛ Ntareka, Amaabaŋɛ nɛ Samaakuse kikɛ bee fule nna. Ama nkpal esa koŋwule ka 
beeŋ ba ji kashinteŋ na so, kede beeŋ tiŋ shuŋ.
Nɛ Samaakuse baa ji kashinteŋ nna, kumo ere Kusoemaanu bee fule, nɛ ku bee ŋini 
fanɛ Kusoemaanu maŋ wu Samaakuse ka ta buku na. Ama kede beeŋ ŋini fanɛ Ntareka 
nɛ Amaabaŋɛ gba bee fule nna, nɛ ku bee bal kashinteŋ be mmalga monɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ 
sɔ na to. Amoso, Samaakuse bee fule nna.
Ku ka la fanɛ esa koŋwule e naa ji kashinteŋ na bre, Kusoemaanu e naaŋ ba la esa 
monɛ e ji kashinteŋ na. Kumoso, Samaakuse e ta buku na.

NGBANYATO BE KAMALGANYI
Kamalganyi Sibɛso
KASOTOFUTI
Kaba ere to, anyeeŋ ta fo n ŋini kamalganyi sibɛso ko ashi Ngbanyato, fɔnfɔŋ atande. 
Anye beeŋ ta fo n ŋini atande be kedelgeso, amobe nnembito nԑ amobe tunͻ kikɛ. 
Feeŋ naŋ bii kananɛ baa tise atande to nɛ loŋ be kenyi na e shinɛ fo nyɛ mmalgaba 
damta nɛ ngbar na be agoni. Atande be kepumpuŋ to beeŋ chɛ fo to nɛ abɔaya be 
mpɔl nɛ amobe ketise to be agoni. Ku beeŋ naŋ shinɛ fo pin fobe kagbeneeka nko 
kewushi be kenyi. Kaba ere la kusɔ nɛ ku ji nna n liɛ kasɔbii fanɛ bedrapo be abɔaya, 
adaŋkaresheŋ, kamalganyi sibɛso nɛ kashɛboŋ. Ku beeŋ naŋ sa fo kachina to be nkilgi 
be kenyi, atande, kanyiŋi nɛ baasa to be kamalga be agoni.
ALAKAL TENINI
• Ketande la kamalganyi sibɛso nko pɔlso be kaba ko nna nɛ ku bee ta kushuŋkukweso 
nɛ ngbar be apɔrsobi a lara kumobe afɛso efuli.
• Esa nɛ e sibɛ atande nɛ baa tere ketandewura nko alangbashupo. Ketandewura bee 
shuŋ nɛ ngbar be apɔrsobi fanɛ mfɛratoyoyul nɛ alɔntorwor be kushu nkukweso nna 
a lara mobe mfɛra efuli.
• Atande be ntgbar maŋ la ngbar monɛ feeŋ tiŋ pin fanɛ ngbar kama.
ATANDE
Atande be keŋinito
Ketande la mpɔl nna nɛ kumobe lakalwura bee pɔl nɛ ku baa kɔ kefii, mfɛra nko 
kagbenechɛrga ashi kinishiso nko ashirito. Ketande la kusɔ nɛ ku bɛ ngbar be keta n 
shuŋ, kumobe kushunkukweso nɛ kamlganyi be agoni to nna fanɛ keta atankargaso nɛ 
kushunkukweso. Atande baaŋ yaa ka la fanɛ kamalganyi, baa sibɛ kumo m ba m ba nɛ 
amobe egbamfol nna, a ta keyilinsa (symbolic) to a ŋini kumobe afii to.

Kushuŋ 10.2 Atande be ntuŋso be kepin

atuwebi na n ŋini fo braana. Fo ka beeŋ tiŋ, fo sa fo gbagba be akeniso.
Atande be apɔrsobi
1. Mfɛrayoyul: Ku bee shinɛ ekrampo na bee wu kusɔ monɛ esibɛpo na bee ji kumobe 
asheŋ na be amfoni nna mobe mfԑra to nɛnɛ.
2. Awor: Kebɛabarso be awor, kushunkukweso be awor, eboltowor nɛ nnɔtorwor be 
kepalto kikɛ e na tiiso nɛ ketande na bee wɔrɔ ebel.
3. Nduli nɛ kapɔr: Ketande be mba mba be kebɛso nɛnɛ nԑ egbamfol be nteŋ bee 
chɛto nna nԑ kumobe kefiito bee lar efuli.
4. Kushunkukweso: Mmalgakul be kegbargeto nɛ kekuuso n tere e na sa ketande 
kushu lɛla.

Atande be tunɔ
1. A bee sa ngbar be kenyi: Atande bee shinɛ bebiipo bee nyɛ mmalgaba damta, 
atankargasobi nɛ ngbar be apɔrsobi nna.
2. Kefɛ n wɔrɔ: Atande bee shinɛ bebiipo bee nyɛ kefɛnwɔrɔ be lakal nna.
3. A bee salga mfɛra be kefԑ to: Atande be kemigeto bee shinɛ bebiipo bee nyɛ mfɛra 
monɛ a bee bra nkilgi, kepɔl nԑ kemigeto be agoni nna.
4. Asheŋ be kepinto/keworwu: Atande bee shinɛ abomin bee pin abar be ngbene be 
afԑso nɛ amobe yulwe nna.
5. A bee bra daŋkare nɛ adrasheŋ be kanyiŋi: Atande bee bra daŋkare, adrasheŋ nԑ 
nsharto be kanyiŋi nna.
6. Kanyiŋi nɛ kakraŋ be agoni: Atande be kepͻl bee bra kanyiŋi, gbunishe/kenyԑn nɛ 
baasa to be kamalga be agoni nna.
7. Kemankura/kekeni asheŋ to nԑnԑ (self-reflection and expression): Atande bee 
shinԑ bebiipo bee tiŋ a lara bumobe afɛsheŋ efuli so nna.
8. A bee shinɛ bebiipo bee nyɛ kanyiti nɛ kanyiasheŋ: Bebiipo bee wu abɔaya monɛ 
a kɔ agbo nɛ amo nɛ a kɔ ngbenwushi ashi kesheŋtirso na to nna a pin ketande 
na to.

mmalgapuchu monɛ a bee chԑto bumobe kamalga be kenyi to nna.

Ketande be kapɔr to
Ade ere ela atande be adabi monɛ a la amobe kapɔr.
1. Egbamfol: Efol kama kɔ kumobe mmalgaba nna.
2. Egbamfol be nteŋ: Kananɛ efolana na wɔnteŋ nko amobe kekama be mmalgakul.
3. Egbaŋ: Egbamfol be ntuŋ e naa bir abarso a kii egbaŋ nko kaba.
4. Kushunkukweso worbi: Alɔntorwor be kepalto be kenase ashi ketande be 
lalaluweto.
5. Kegbargeto: Mmalgakul be kegbergeto nԑ kekuuso n tere.
6.  Egbaŋ be kegbargeto (feet): Kumobe kegbargeto nɛ kumobe mmalgakul be kemata 
abarso.
7. Egbamfol be kechԑ abar so (enjambment): Kananɛ mmalgafol nko afɛlto na 
chuwɔso egbamfol nɛ egbamfol loŋ hali m ba luwe nɛ akurso maŋ wɔtɔ
8. Ewushi(caesura): Keyili egbamfol be mfrinto.
9. Alɔntorwor gboŋ: Kananɛ alɔntorwor gboŋ bee fara egbamfol nko mmalgafol ashi 
ketande to.
Ketande be kapɔrto be kushuŋ kͻ le be asͻfԑso nna;
• Kuu kushunkukweso nɛ kashɛboŋ.
•  A ŋini kefiito nɛ kemataso/kebuwito.
• Kelara ebol nɛ kafole nko afuuto malga.
• Kekuŋ ekrampo na be kakraŋ be enite
• Kedaŋɛ ketande na so anishi be kayɛlga
ATANDE BE KEPUMPUŊTO
Asɔ monɛ adaga fo ka deso atande be kepumpuŋ to
1. Keni kumu na nɛ kananɛ ku liɛ ketande na be apuntosɔ.
2. Pin ketande na be kebɔaya tenini nko kusɔ mo so nɛ esibɛpo na sibɛ kumo.
3. Keni fanɛ kumobe ngbar du putɔputɔ nko chiŋgliŋ n shin keni kusɔnɛ ku ba nɛ bu 
ta loŋ be ngbar na n shuŋ.
4. Malga ketande na be ebol/da nko kumu na be kananɛ ku bee wɔrɔ esibɛpo na nɛ 
kananɛ e nase kumo.
5. Buwito kebawɔtɔ monɛ ketande na kɔ.
6. Ji kumobe kamalganyi be apɔrsobi be asheŋ. Ŋinito apɔrsobi na be tunɔ/edɛnyɔso.
7. Ji ketande na be kapɔr be asheŋ.
8. Keni esa monɛ e bee pɔl ketande na nɛ wanɛ be asheŋ nɛ ketande na bee ji.

1. Ta fo gbagba be mmalgaba n ŋinito atande ashi kamalganyi be ntuŋso to.

4. Mige atande be tunɔ to ashi anyebe karɛchɛkama be kebawɔtɔ to.
5. Ta atande be adabi na n kuu fo gbagba be ketande n shin pumpuŋ kumo to 
gberɛ n nase.
6. Ŋini ketande be apɔrsobi to.
7. Ŋini ekpa monɛ feeŋ bulɔso m pumpuŋ ketande to nɛ manɛso nɛ fo kaŋɛ loŋ.
8. Kuu fo gbagba be ketande n shin sa kumobe kesheŋtirso, kushunkukweso nɛ 
tunɔ/edɛnyɔso.
9. Ŋinito apɔrsobi be tunɔ nɛ a kɔ ta n laŋɛ ketande be kasibɛ be kabaso.

FOREWORD
Ghana’s new Senior High School Curriculum aims to ensure that all learners achieve 
their potential by equipping them with 21st Century skills, knowledge, character 
qualities and shared Ghanaian values. This will prepare learners to live a responsible 
adult life, progress to further studies and enter the world of work. This is the first time 
that Ghana has developed a Senior High School Curriculum which focuses on national 
values, attempting to educate a generation of Ghanaian youth who are proud of our 
country and can contribute effectively to its development.
The Ministry of Education is proud to have overseen the production of these Learner 
Materials which can be used in class and for self-study and revision. These materials 
have been developed through a partnership between the Ghana Education Service, 
teacher unions (Ghana National Association of Teachers- GNAT, National Association 
of Graduate Teacher -NAGRAT and the Pre-Tertiary Teachers Association of Ghana- 
PRETAG) and National Subject Associations. These materials are informative and of 
high quality because they have been written by teachers for teachers with the expert 
backing of each subject association.
I believe that, if used appropriately, these materials will go a long way to transforming 
our Senior High Schools and developing Ghana so that we become a proud, prosperous 
and values-driven nation where our people are our greatest national asset.
Haruna Iddrisu MP
Minister for Education

Tԑ̃ra ti: basԑ ya ti tu tԑ̃ra ti tɔgum buuri fĩi wa n tari sԑla ti ba yi’ira ti ‘tiŋasuka

Tuunԑ 3.1 Pa’alԑ tabelesi n de sԑla (Identifying what affixes are)
Ŋmԑregԑ fu tadaana zi’an gãresԑ pa’alԑ tabelesi n de sԑla. Mɔ gee iŋԑ la gee da 
bisera yelesum la n boi zuon la.
Tabelesi buuri buuri (Types of affixes): Tabelesi buuri buuri bayi la de la vũurԑ 
teere la yelebire naanԑ teere tabelesi.
Vũurԑ teere tabelesi (Derivational affixes): Bana de la tabelesi n naani yelebisãasi la a 
vɔa. Vũurԑ teere tabelesi puan, yelebire tile deo la yelebire la deo ni tee la ta’am dԑna 
bii dagena buyima. Ŋwana pa’alԑ ti vũurԑ teere tabelesi ta’am dԑna deo n ka teeri bii 
deo n teeri. Vũurԑ teere tabelesi la maali la yelebipaala yԑsera yelebire tile la puan. 
Magesԑ wuu: ‘ku’ ta’am lebege ‘kua’, ‘lu’ me ta’am lebege ‘lua’. Yelebԑa ‘ku’ la ‘lu’ de la 
itegɔ yelebԑa gee nyaa lebege yu’urԑ yelebԑa n de ‘kua’ la ‘lua’.
Yelebire naanԑ teere tabelesi (Inflectional affixes): Bana de la tabelesi n teere yelebire 
la naanԑ ma’a gee dagi yelebire deo. Yelebire naanԑ teere tabelesi ka teeri yelebire 
la vũurԑ, gee me ka tԑԑra yelebire la ti di lԑbegera yelebipaalԑ. Tabelesina pa’ali la

Air pollution is primarily caused as a result of excessive and unregulated emissions of 
carbon dioxide into the air. Pollutants mostly emerge from the burning of fossil fuels 
in addition to chemicals, toxic substances, and improper waste disposal. Air pollutants 
are absorbed into the atmosphere, and they can cause smog, a combination of smoke 
and fog, in valleys as well as produce acidic precipitation in areas far away from the 
pollution source.
In many areas, people and local governments do not sustainably use their natural 
resources. Mining for natural gases, deforestation, and even improper use of water 
resources can have tremendous effects on the environment. While these strategies often 
attempt to boost local economies, their effects can lead to oil spills, interrupted animal 
habitats, and droughts.
Ultimately, the effects of the modern world on the environment can lead to many 
problems. Human beings need to consider the repercussions of their actions, trying 
to reduce, reuse, and recycle materials while establishing environmentally sustainable 
habits. If measures are not taken to protect the environment, we can potentially witness 
the extinction of more endangered species, worldwide pollution, and a completely 
uninhabitable planet.

Tuunԑ 7.1 Yizuo tigere n de sԑla (Concept of clan system)
Tĩ’isԑ bisԑ yizuo tigere n de sԑla. Tĩ’isԑ bisԑ di naanԑ, tuunԑ, di ze’ele zi’an. Dikԑ 
fu putĩ’irԑ la sɔ̃sԑ pa’alԑ zamesegɔ deo la gee pa’asԑ fumiŋa putĩ’irԑ yԑsera basԑba 
putĩ’ira la puan.
Tuunԑ 7.2 Yizuto magesegɔ (Comparison of clans)
1. Fumiŋa gulesԑ yizuto tunuu yu’ura la tu kisa dãalesi n boi ya sɔ’ɔlum puan gee 
nyaa pa’alԑ yizuto tutã yԑsera buuri bayi puan.
2. Dikԑ fu lebesego la sɔ̃sԑ pa’alԑ fu tadaana zamesegɔ deo la puan gee pa’alԑ 
yelesi’a zã’a n ŋwɔni taaba gee ti si’a me bɔna yima yima ti zamesegɔ deo la 
lagum sɔ̃sԑ.
Tuunԑ 7.3 Yizuo tuulum yԑla (Significance of Clan)
Tigera puan, gulesԑ ya gee sɔ̃sԑ pa’alԑ yizuo tuuma atã daarԑ woo tuuma puan 
bɔna ya sɔ’ɔlum la puan.
Tuunԑ 7.4 Yizuo tuunԑ (The roles of a clan)
Yayi yayi sɔ̃sԑ pa’alԑ yԑla atã ti yay ire duma kisa la a tari dãaŋɔ bɔ’ɔra ya se’em.
Tuunԑ 7.5
Loe yizuo la di kisa teebule la n boi zuon la puan. Dikԑ yizuo la nԑreba ti ba 
yԑ buuri lɔgerɔ, nԑreba sinii ti ba gãresa pa’ala ba yԑ lɔgeseto la gee tɔgԑ pa’alԑ 
nԑreba la bama n nyԑ yelesi’a.
Tuunԑ 7.6 Yizuo tuuma (Functions of a clan)
Ba loe fu ti fu dԑna la yizuo kiima. Gãresԑ pa’alԑ yԑla atã ti fum wan iŋԑ ti nɔyinԑ 
bɔna nԑreba la tiŋasuka. Sɔ̃sԑ fu putĩ’irԑ la pa’alԑ fu tadaana ti ya lagum sɔ̃sԑ la 
zamesegɔ deo la puan.

BUURI NA’AM YԐLA NAANԐ
(TRADITIONAL GOVERNANCE STRUCTURE)
Buuri na’am yԑla naanԑ kɔ’ɔm dԑna la nԑŋa duma n tigese tagelԑ taaba tara tuuma, 
yiko la putĩ’ira dikerԑ pansi bɔna sɔ’ɔlum duma puan, tuuma yԑla, gɔbemԑnti duma, 
la tigera asi’a puan.
Buuri na’am yԑla naanԑ aŋa 
(Characteristics of Traditional Governance Structure)
Yelesi’a n boi tilum wa de la buuri na’am yԑla naanԑ ansi sisesi n bala:
1. Naanԑ la tari la tagelegɔ n niԑ pansi la yiko (The structure has a clear chain of 
command and authority). Ŋwana vuurε de la tuuma la yԑla maalegɔ pansi tagelegɔ 
la kɔ’ɔm pɔsԑ la zuon sigera tiŋa gee ti tagelega beene woo tar aka tuunԑ tuna.
2. Saazuon na’am naanԑ (Centralised governance structure): Dina de la tigese’ere ti 
yԑla maalegɔ paŋa la kɔ’ɔm bɔna nԑŋa duma sԑba n boi zuon la nu’usi ma’a bii 
putĩ’ira la kɔ’ɔm zԑ’ԑta la bama zi’an.
3. Na’am yiregerԑ naanԑ (Decentralised governance structure): Ŋwana gãreseri pa’ala 
la yԑla maalegɔ pansi la n yiregԑ paԑ sɔ’ɔlum duma la zã’a puan se’em.
4. Yԑa/Deto pua/tɔ̃rega (Departmentalisation): Na’am naanԑ la tari la deto ti tu bɔna 
yima yima. Deo bii yire woo tari la di tuunԑ tuna buuri na’am yԑla la tuuma. Yiko 
la bii paŋa la le maam pu mԑ tara yԑla maalegɔ deto la puan n de wuu yizuto la 
yԑa, ti ba woo tara ba tuuma n de si’a tuna.
5. Nԑŋa duma ti ba yi’ira ‘managers’ la n biseri nԑreba fĩi wa zuo.
6. Naresum sɔ̃sԑga nama (Formal channels of communication): Ŋwana wa de la 
naresum sore n boi ti nԑra woo dɔla bini ta’asera sɔ̃sega/lasebaarԑ ti ka paara 
nԑreba la zã’a n boi sɔ’ɔlum duma la puan la.
7. Ba tari la tuuma mɔpi (Defined roles and responsibilities): Ŋwana wa de la ba 
tuuma la kɔ’ɔm niԑ mԑ ti nԑra woo mina, ba lagum tuna se’em suŋa suŋa, sɔ̃sesuŋa 
la yԑla maalegɔ putĩ’ira la ba eeri sԑla tigere woo zi’an.
8. La tagelԑ mԑ (Hierarchical layers): Nԑŋa duma bԑԑna zo’e zo’e n pɔseri saazuon 
ta paara kĩ’a beene tuntuneba. Naanԑ la ni tara la zuon pansi ti di nyuurɔ dԑna la 
bika ka boi bini, fu wan ta’am pa’alԑ la ani/iti se’em, la atũpa’alԑ suŋa suŋa, gee ti 
pooren lԑbega me dԑna yԑla maalegɔ du’usi la la dagi naana teeseŋo puan.

Tindaana
Tindaana de la mina yaaba n yuum pɔsε sε’ pεsega zi’ire zi’an la puan yia. Tindaana 
de la nԑra ti yaabeduma ni loe e ti a bisera tiŋa la. Tindaankura san tigԑ sagebɔ, ba ni

Nakãtԑ
Nakãreba de la nԑŋa duma buuri so’olum puan. Bama ni dԑna la tiŋa la nԑŋa duma

Tuunԑ 7.8 Buuri nԑŋa tuuma (Functions of traditional leaders)
a. Tigera puan, kãalԑ ya sɔ̃segirega wa gee gulesԑ sԑba n boi tilum wa tuuma yire 
duma zaberԑ yԑla maalegɔ puan.
i. Nakãtԑ ii. Nabibesi iii. Yizuo kima iv. Kiinduma
b. Sɔ̃sԑ ya lebesego la pa’alԑ zamesegɔ deo la zã’a ti ya lagum sɔ̃sԑ.
Anlɔ timbila puan, Ayugbe tiŋa puan, ti nɔkpe’ene sige Kofitse n de kaara la a 
kiima dayua, Agbeko tiŋasuka. Kofitse zũuse Agbeko mԑ ti a kԑ̃ la eŋa yaaba 
samanԑ puan ti a mԑ a yire. Agbeko me yeti eŋa sɔyaaba n yuum dikԑ samanԑ la 
bɔ eŋa. Ba yizuo kima la yi la Kofitse la Agbeko zĩ’ire ti a ta’am bɔkԑ yele la suŋa. 
A walum koŋe mԑ ti nakãtԑ la nyaa kԑ̃ bini yi yire la duma zĩ’ire ti a maalԑ yele 
la. Ba nyaa yele la yizuo kiinduma la ti ba viisԑ baŋԑ mina n sirum sɔi samanԑ la 
ti ba zabera di zuo la. Nabibesi la n zĩ’ire ti ba maalԑ nɔkpe’ene la.
Tuunԑ 7.9 Buuri nԑŋa duma tuuma (Functions of traditional 
leaders)
Basԑba ŋmi’iri nɔkpe’ene ti nԑreba yuum nyԑti ba zaberԑ yԑla maalegɔ buuri nԑŋa 
duma la zi’an gana zina beere kootum tigera wa.
Yayi yayi gulesԑ ya putĩ’ira yԑsera nɔkpe’ene wa n boi zuon wa gee sɔ̃sԑ ya lebesego 
la pa’alԑ zamesegɔ deo la ti ya lagum sɔ̃sԑ.
Tuunԑ 7.10 Buuri na’am yԑla (Traditional governance)
“Buuri na’am yԑla de la nasebo dabesa n tole”. Ya tigera duma puan, gulesԑ ya 
belegere gɔŋɔ ŋmi’ira nɔkpe’ene sakera bɔ’ɔra bii zagesera ba yele se’em la. Sɔ̃sԑ 
ya nɔkpe’ene la pa’alԑ zamesegɔ deo la zã’a ti ya lagum sɔ̃sԑ.

PƆSEGA
Yenkuna pɔsԑ pa’ala ya la daami la zina beere nɔkpe’ene maalegɔ sɔa. La sɔ̃seri pa’ala 
la bayi la zã’a naanԑ la ba tuuma. Ya wan dikԑ tigera ayi la tuuma magesԑ bisԑ a 
ŋwɔsum la a yima yima n ani se’em gee nyaa kilese. Ya daami nɔkpe’ene maalegɔ la 
zina beere sɔ̃sega gakerԑ tigera mi’ilum la bɔkerԑ wan suŋԑ ya ti ya ta’am lagum pa’asԑ

tuuma la.
Le pa’asԑ, yeŋo wa wan kumesԑ ya la bɔkese’ere n nari gee pa’asԑ ya inkpeŋere ti ya 
bɔta ti ya zamesԑ wara yԑla, gɔbena na’am vom yԑla, la tu dikeri tumisi lagena satinsi

• Sɔ̃sega gakerԑ tigera la n leregere gee tara tiŋa la wara duma tuna. Gaana sɔ̃sega

(THE JUDICIARY SYSTEM)
Tĩ’isegɔ Sokere 
(Thinking Question)

Yuuma AyiYEŊO 8
Sɔ̃sega gakerԑ tigere 
(The Judiciary System)
Sɔ̃sega gakerԑ tigere de la kootum tigere n maali nɔkpe’ene yԑla, bii gɔbemԑnti yeŋo 
n leregeri gee tara tiŋa la wara duma tuna.
Sɔ̃sega gakerԑ tigere tuuma 
(Functions of Judiciary)
Sɔ̃sega gakerԑ tigere la tuuma n ŋwana boi tilum wa:
1. Bama n leregeri pa’ala tiŋa la wara duma la vuurε gee dikera a tuna suŋa suŋa.
2. Baseri ti yelemiŋerԑ bɔna tuuma puan gee suŋera ti tuntɔɔ la mama bɔna tiŋa la 
puan.
3. Nԑreba vom naresum gurega (Protection of rights): Nԑreba vom naresum gurega 
la ba tari yɔseto ti warekãra la gulesԑ biŋe la.
4. Tuntɔɔ tuuma bisega (Administration of justice): La baseri ti mama n bɔna gee 
yima yima ka bɔna wara duma la tuuma puan.
5. Nukpԑ’ԑma maalegɔ (Resolution of disputes): La pɔ̃seri la zaberԑ la nukpe’ene 
nԑreba tiŋasuka, tigera, la gɔbena tuntum zĩ’isi.
6. La bɔ’ɔri la yɔ’ɔ ti tiŋasuka daana, yelemaala, la alagensɔ̃sԑ bɔna nukpe’ene 
maalegɔ puan gee dagena kootum tigera puan.
7. Pansi yelesego yɔ’ɔ (Provision of checks and balances): Beŋe la zuo duma 
(executive) la wara biŋere duma (legislative) yeŋo duma, basera ti ba ta’am tuna 
dɔla ba pansi bԑԑna.
8. Bama n ze’ele tiŋa la na’arԑ dɔ̃legera tuume’ero duma tuba.
9. Bama n ze’eti yelemiŋerԑ na’arԑ tuumfĩ’isa yԑla puan.
Zina beere sɔ̃sega gakerԑ tigera naanԑ 
(Structure of the contemporary judiciary systems)
Sɔ̃sega gakerԑ n boi Gaana la tari la tegelegɔ naanԑ wuu sԑla n boi tilum wa:
1. Kootum kãtԑ la ti ba yi’ira ti ‘Supreme Court’ la n gani zã’a.
2. Kootum sԑka n kɔ’ɔm tagelԑ de la kootum sԑka ti nԑra puurԑ ni ka pee ti a duma le 
tari sɔ̃sega la lebe ti ba yi’ira ‘Court of Appeal’ la.
3. Kootum sԑka n nari ti ka iŋԑ nԑra la bisԑ ti zi’an la zã’a nyԑ ti ba yi’ira ti ‘High 
Court’.
4. ‘Circuit Courts’ la ‘District Courts’ de la kootum bibesi n biseri yire puan wara la 
yelepigesi.
5. Kɔmpɔɔlegɔ kootum (Juvenile courts or Tribunals) de la kootum bibesi la basԑba 
n biseri nԑreba n ka paԑ yuum18 yԑla.

Kootum tuuma 
(Roles of the court)
Kootum la leregere gee bisera ti wara duma la tuna n de wuu nԑrezãsi wara (civil 
law), tuumfĩ’isa duma wara (criminal law), la tuntuneba wara (labour laws) gee me 
kelum bisera wara duma la tuuma.
Gaana tiŋa puan, mina n de nԑŋa daana Kootum kãtԑ la puan de la ‘Chief Justice’, eŋa 
n de se’em n gani zã’a sɔ̃sega gakerԑ yeŋo la puan tiŋa la zuo. Gakereba, sԑba n biseri 
kootum sokere duma yԑla (magistrate), la sԑba n suŋeri gakereba (assessors) la boi 
bini mԑ suŋera ti nɔkpe’ene la ta’am maalԑ gee me lԑregera wara duma la gee kelum 
bisera ti Gaana wara duma la tuna dɔla la nari se’em la.
Kootum naanԑ/zina beere sɔ̃sega gakerԑ tigera 
sɔ̃sega gakerԑ puan
(The structure of the court/contemporary judiciary system in adjudicating 
cases)
1. Gakera ayima n ni kԑlesera gee gakera sɔ̃sega ‘High Court’, ‘Court of Appeal’, la 
‘Supreme Court’ puan.
2. Gakereba batã ta paara13 n ni kԑlesa gee gakera sɔ̃sega ‘Court of Appeal’ la ‘Supreme 
Court’ puan (yԑsera la Chief Justice la n boti se’em). Tԑ̃ra ti gakereba sԑba n ni zĩ’ire 
ti ba gakԑ sɔ̃sega la ni dԑna la gingaŋa kootum bana wa puan.
3. Yԑla asi’a gakerԑ puan, gakera la naԑ la nԑreba basԑba n mi bii ka mi yԑla la zĩ’ire 
ti ba suŋera e sɔ̃sega la gakerԑ puan.
4. Gakera se’em ti ba yi’ira ti ‘Magistrate’ la n keleseri gee gakera sɔ̃sega ‘Magistrate 
Court’ la puan.
5. Gakera se’em ti ba yi’ira ti ‘A Justice of the Peace’ la n keleseri gee gakera sɔ̃sepigesi 
‘District Court’ la puan.

Naanԑ la sɔa la ta’am bɔna yima yima yԑsera la kootum la n de kootum sԑka, sɔ̃sega n 
de sɔ̃sesԑka buuri, la sԑla n iŋԑ la. Naanse’ere n boi zi’an woo la n ŋwana gã tilum wa:
1. Nԑreba la ni gulesԑ la ba yele la kootum.
2. Kootum la n ni yi mina ti ba tari a yele wa’am ba zi’an na la ti a tara di ti’ire.
3. Kootum la ni diŋe zĩ’ire mԑ sɔ̃sԑ ti ba kilese yԑla la gee bisԑ a gã’aregɔ zi’an.
4. Ba ni sɔ̃sԑ la yelemiŋerԑ la bɔ gee ti ba me viisԑ sԑԑra duma bisԑ la nɔpɔrԑ.
5. Gakera la nyaa ni gakԑ sɔ̃sega la doose la, la nari se’em la.
6. Nԑreba la ta’am le tari sɔ̃sega la kiŋԑ kootum sԑka n gani zã’a la puan.
Tԑ̃ra ti: Yԑla asi’a puan, nԑreba la ta’am belum ti ba yese sɔ̃sega la lebe yire ta maalԑ 
mina n tari sɔ̃sega la wa’am na la san diŋe gulesԑ ba’asԑ.

BUURI PUAN LA ZINA BEERE SƆ̃SEGA 
GAKERԐ TIGERA
(TRADITIONAL AND CONTEMPORARY JUDICIARY SYSTEMS)
Buuri puan sɔ̃sega tigera 
(Traditional judiciary system)
Buuri sɔ̃sega tigera de la sɔ’ɔlum la puan bii buuri la puan yelemiŋerԑ tigera/wara 
duma n boi sɔ’ɔlum woo puan gee ti naresum duma sɔa tigera la nyaa baŋԑ wa’am. 
Buuri puan sɔ̃sega gakerԑ tigera la a sɔa ta’asԑ basԑ doose tu sɔduma puan yԑsera la 
nuurԑ tɔgum puan. Sԑba n ni bisera tige-ana wa zuto de la tindaanduma, naduma, 
kiinduma, yizuto nԑŋa duma, la gilema duma basԑba n boi kɔrenkɔrum la puan.
Buuri puan nukpԑ’ԑma maalegɔ 
(Traditional Dispute Resolution (TDR))
So-ana wa doli maala la nukpԑ’ԑma bii zaba n boi kɔrenkɔrum, buuri yԑla, la buuri 
malema yel-ira n boi kɔrenkɔrum la puan la. So-ana wa pugum bɔna mԑ gee ti nasaara 
yԑla la nyaa baŋԑ wa’am gee ti a kɔ’ɔm ka dɔla nasaara yԑla la n doli se’em la, gee 
bɔna kɔrenkɔrum duma la puan kɔ’ɔm bisera la a wan iŋԑ se’em ti nɔyinԑ ta’am bɔna 
nԑreba tiŋasuka. Yelesi’a ti buuri puan sɔ̃sega maalegɔ kɔ’ɔm bisera de la yire yԑla, 
tiŋa yԑla, kisa gãleŋo, la pã’asegɔ/pumpɔreŋɔ.

Sosi’a ti ba dɔla maala buuri puan nukpԑ’ԑma
(Methods/procedures in traditional dispute resolution)
Sosi’a ti ba dɔla maala buuri puan nɔkpe’ene yԑla de la:
1. Zaberԑ pɔ̃sega (Mediation): Kalam de la zi’an ti mina nu’o n ka boi zaberԑ la 
puan ni kԑ̃ bini ti a ta’am maalԑ yele la ŋwana suŋa suŋa nԑreba bayi la tiŋasuka 
gee ti wara duma yԑla ka bɔna bini.
2. Zaberԑ gakerԑ (Adjudication): Nɔkpe’ene maalegɔ sodina tari la buuri puan wara 
duma la gakera sɔ̃sega la. Nԑresԑba n ni bɔna kalam de tindaanduma, naduma, 
yizuo kiinduma, sɔ’ɔlum nԑŋa duma la sԑba n me kɔ’ɔm mina gakerԑ yԑla la.
3. Nuurԑ naarԑ (Reconciliation): Sodina kɔ’ɔm bisera la di wan iŋԑ se’em tari 
summa’asum, nɔyinԑ bii nɔnaarԑ wa’am sԑba n zaberi la tiŋasuka na dɔla yire 
duma bii yizuo kiinduma la sɔ’ɔlum la kiinduma nu’usin.
4. Yelemaalegɔ sɔ̃sega (Negotiation): Ŋwana ni dԑna la sɔ̃sega bɔna sԑba n tari 
nɔkpe’ene bii zaberԑ la tiŋasuka ti ba basԑ gee lebese naԑ nuurԑ dɔla ba nԑŋa 
duma, kiinduma bii zabepɔ̃sera puan.

maalegɔ sɔa puan de la sԑla n boi tilum wa:

GLOSSARY
Affix A grammatical form that is attached to a word at either the 
beginning.
Affixation The process of adding affixes to roots or stems to form new words.
Ballad A narrative poem meant to be sung, with simple meter and rhyme, 
often telling folklore or romantic stories.
Borrowing The process of acquiring new words from another language.
Clipping The process of shortening an existing word to form a new one.
Coda The final consonant of a syllable.
Comma A punctuation mark (,) indicating a pause or separating items in a 
list.
Compounding The process of putting two or more existing words together to form 
a new one.
Conjunction A word that joins two or more words, phrases, or clauses in a 
sentence.
Coordination 
conjunctions
Conjunctions that link equal parts of a sentence.
Correlative 
conjunctions
Paired conjunctions generally used at two points in a sentence.
Culture The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular group or 
society.
Customary Traditional practices passed down through generations.
Derivational 
affix
An affix that changes the class of a word it is attached to.
Dramatic Poetry A poem written in verse to be spoken, involving dialogue among 
characters.
Elegy A reflective poem that laments loss, often exploring mourning and 
reflection.
Epic Poetry A lengthy narrative poem recounting heroic deeds or adventures.
135
Free Verse Poetry free from regular meter or rhyme scheme.
Goal A clearly defined objective or desired outcome.
Head word The central element in a phrase.
Human rights Principles concerned with equality and fairness, ensuring freedom 
and protection.
Indigenous Original occupants of a land or region.
Infix An affix placed between two parts of a word.
Inflectional 
affix
An affix that maintains the class of the word it is attached to.
Intonation Pitch changes that occur across a sentence.
Lexicon An inventory of sounds, words, etc. in a language.
Litigant A party involved in a lawsuit, either the accused or defendant.
Lyric Poetry A short poem expressing personal emotions or thoughts, often 
musical.
Meter and 
Rhythm
The pattern of stressed and unstressed syllables in a line.
Monogamy The practice of marrying one person at a time.
Obstacles Challenges or barriers that hinder progress.
Ode A lengthy poem that praises an event, individual, or idea.
Pitch The rate of vibration of vocal cords during speech.
Poem A verbal composition conveying experiences, ideas, or emotions.
Polygamy The practice of having multiple spouses at the same time.
Prefix An affix attached at the beginning of a root/stem.
Puzzle A game or problem requiring logical or strategic thinking to solve.
Relative adverb An adverb that heads an adjective clause.
136
Rhyme Scheme The ordered pattern of rhymes at the ends of lines.
Riddle A puzzle or brain teaser using clever language to conceal an 
answer.
Rules Constraints or guidelines that must be followed.
Slash A diagonal line used to show options, dates, or fractions.
Solution The final answer or outcome.
Solution Path A sequence of steps or decisions leading to the goal.
Sonnet A 14-line poem with a specific rhyme scheme and meter.
Source 
language
The language from which a text is translated.
Starting Point The initial situation or setup.
Subordinating 
conjunction
Conjunctions that link a dependent clause to an independent one.
Suffix An affix attached at the end of a root/stem.
Summary A condensed version of an original text.
Syllabic 
consonant
A consonant that functions as the nucleus of a syllable.
Syllabification The process of dividing a word into syllables.
Target language The language into which a text is translated.
Text A piece of written work.
Transitive verb A verb that uses a direct object to show who or what receives the 
action.

FOREWORD
Ghana’s new Senior High School Curriculum aims to ensure that all learners achieve 
their potential by equipping them with 21st Century skills, knowledge, character 
qualities and shared Ghanaian values. This will prepare learners to live a responsible 
adult life, progress to further studies and enter the world of work. This is the first time 
that Ghana has developed a Senior High School Curriculum which focuses on national 
values, attempting to educate a generation of Ghanaian youth who are proud of our 
country and can contribute effectively to its development.
The Ministry of Education is proud to have overseen the production of these Learner 
Materials which can be used in class and for self-study and revision. These materials 
have been developed through a partnership between the Ghana Education Service, 
teacher unions (Ghana National Association of Teachers- GNAT, National Association 
of Graduate Teacher -NAGRAT and the Pre-Tertiary Teachers Association of Ghana- 
PRETAG) and National Subject Associations. These materials are informative and of 
high quality because they have been written by teachers for teachers with the expert 
backing of each subject association.
I believe that, if used appropriately, these materials will go a long way to transforming 
our Senior High Schools and developing Ghana so that we become a proud, prosperous 
and values-driven nation where our people are our greatest national asset.
Haruna Iddrisu MP
Minister for Education

Kwori
Kwori seina: Taana dedɛ mae kwoar-taŋa mo ya bere wopwolo de wo-chɔgɔ naa 
taane kuri, ye ya ta mae kwoar-taŋa kam ya ke totoŋa yadwonna. Kwori ye n kwoar-
taŋa kam na diini tei naa ka na tu tei selabole naa botarebu beeri maŋa ne ye ko pae 
botarebia kura leiri to mo. Kwoar-taŋa taana ye taana yalo botarebia kura na zege 
kwori baŋa ne to mo. Ghana taana yam maama ye kwoar-taŋa taana mo. Kwoar- taŋa 
nam ta wae ka pae tapuni kuri leira.
Kwori dwoa
Taana dedɛ jege kwori dwi dwi mo. Kwora yanto mo ye kwori dwoa yalo na wo Ghana 
taana yam wone to: baŋa kwori (B), tetare kwori (T), kuri kwori (K) de diinim kwori. 
Ghana taana yam maama jege kwori dwoa na wo muri yalei to, ye yanto mo ye baŋa 
de kuri kwori. Babam nam ta jege tetare kwori ba woli yalei yam wone. Badaara de 
maa jege diinim kwori de tuum kwori ba woli da. Gambwɛ de Ankara tiina jege kwori 
dwoa yalei mo ye yanto mo ye baŋa kwori (B) de kuri kwori (K). Poponem maŋa ne, 
taana yam wae ya mae [`] mo ya bere kuri kwori ye [ ´ ] de mae ko bere baŋa kwori. 
Kasem taane dem nam jege kwori dwoa yana mo. Yanto mo ye: baŋa kwori [´], kuri 
kwori [ ` ], tetare kwori [ ̵ ] de diinim kwori [ ̌ ]. Amaa poponem ne, botarebia fenfee 
nenɛɛne, dé, wó, á, yé, véi, deém, de ná mo poponna bere kwori ba yuu ne Kasem 
ne. Maana mo tento kuri ne na bere kwori na toŋe to tei.
KWORI TOTOŊA
Kwori jege ŋwaane lanyerane de pae taana yalo na mae de ya toŋe to mo ko tɔge 
de de na ke totoŋe na ye de yera to ŋwaane. Kwori ke totoŋa yatɔ mo taane wone. 
Yanto mo ye botarebu poponem, botarebu kuri de botarebu beeri.
1. Botarebu poponem: Kwori yeini de pɔɔre botarebia balo poponem nyenyero na 
nye daane to mo da wone, se ko ná konto, ba yaa ye bedwe mo.

KA-PEENE-KA-KE
A na ye bena yana to, a nu tege mo ye a yeiri a kwo kɔtaa, a nam maŋe a yeiri o

dedam chorro tei ne mo, ye a maŋe a yeiri ba badwonna ko ná dae a na vei se a 
zo de ba to maŋa ne. Dé chorro tem wolo wolo wo ti yiga se te kwei amo se a taa 
ye te bu se te daare te pa se a lɛɛre a taa zoore te wo dedoa tei ne de. A laam jege 
se a taa tole mo. A ná zo dedoa tei ne da yalei, yatɔ, se a daa vu wodwoŋi de tei 
a ke da fee. Ko maŋe de bena fuga yana laŋa ne, a wo fɔge a jeini ba wolo wolo 
tei ne a yi bene naa se a ta we a lage a vu sikuuli dedoa mo ba tei ne a yi bene. 
Ko woli de a na kare a tole to, dé chorro tem tedwonna yaare ne chekke pa se 
de zem maama, ko jege daanem se a ta a yaara yam taane. A nae bochare-zuru 
a dwonna balo a de ba na wo sikuuli ne daane to tei ne mo kolo ŋwaane, sikuuli 
yerane mo ye mɛ a ná wora a na yeini a swei sɔŋɔ yaara yam swia to. A na yi 
bena fuga to, a kwaane mo a toŋe Luu Dedoa de Wɛ Dɛ ne de maŋa kalo ba na pɛ 
sikuuli bia chwoŋa se ba si to se a taa nae ŋweero. A toŋe konto mo se a taa tɔge 
a maa nii a tetere baŋa ne. A ta tɔge a zeŋe kɔnkereke sam dedɛ lɔɔm baŋa ne, a 
maa yeini a diini na-bworru naneero de bwi wone a gɔɔne ywona ye a ta tɔge a 
vei mɛ ba na cheiri kandwa da to a toŋa. A ke totoŋa yanto dwi dem bena fuga 
mo pa se a wane a tiŋi sabu a ma a vu sɛkɔndere sikuuli a ti. De a yaara yanto 
maama, a dεεm ta jege yi-seena de tɔnɔ zamesem ye ko pa se ba kuri ne se a taa 
ye sikuuli bia bam yiga tu sɛkɔndere sikuuli dem ne. A na ti sikuuli to, a twanno 
tem lamma chekke mo.

TAANE DE DE TOTOŊA
Botarebia de Ba Totoŋa Tapuni Wone; de Taane 
Poponem Wadɛ Kasem ne
BOBOOM
Popwara kanto ne, n wó lware taleirina/taleira, botarebia mɔɔnem chwodɛ, de afegesa 
na toŋe tei Kasem taane dem ne to. N ywono afegesa de taleirina totoŋa baŋa ne wó 
woli se n wane n mɔ tapuna na jege kuri to Kasem taane dem ne. N ta wó na berem 
bobwea botarebia mɔɔnem chwodɛ baŋa ne Kasem ne. Botarebia mɔɔnem chwodɛ 
sem sedwonna dé na wó bwɛ ywo to ye botarebia twoŋim(compounding), botarebia 
gwonim/fɔm (clipping), ta-gɛ botarebia jwoŋim/jenem (borrowing) de afegesa 
gwaanem (affixation).
Boboŋ-kura
• Afegese ye poponem woŋo mo na mae wadaa ko toŋe botarebu ne, ko wae ko ye 
o boboa ne, o tetare ne naa o kwola ne. Afegesa dwoa yam chekke to ye yatɔ mo; 
perefegese, sɔfegese de nfegese. Afegese ná woli botarebu wone ko pae o jiri naa o 
leiri o nyenyego/diga mo.
• Taleirina mo mae ya toŋe taane wone se ya taa lei botarebia, tacheiŋa de boboŋa 
daane se ko wane ko ma ko mɔ tapuna na jege kuri to.
• Afegesa totoŋe taane wone ye se ko ma ko mɔ botarebu-doora mo.
• Botarebia mɔɔnem ye chwodea mo na woli pae dé wae dé mɔɔne botarebu-doora ko 
tɔge wadɛ selo na maŋe se wo taane dem wone ye dé mae dé toŋe to.
AFEGESA
Afegesa kuri: Afegesa ye mɔfena mo na sale botarebu-kugu se ko ma ko mɔ botarebu-
dooro naa botarebu-gɛ to. Afegesa ta wae ya ye taane wadaa woŋo na gwaane botarebu 
wone o boboa ne naa o gurim ne ye ko pa botarebu wom kuri leiri to mo.
Afegese zege ko pae sɔfegesa naa perefegesa mo kuni dedɛ. Afegese ná kwei de gwaane 
de botarebu, ko wó wane ko pa o ji naa o taa nye de boratebu-dooro mo. Afegesa 
nam ta wae ya ye taane wone wo-balɛ na wó wane se sale botarebu se ko ma ko leiri 
botarebu kuri de o nyenyego naa o diga to. Afegesa nam na wae ya tui botarebu wone 
tei to mo tento:
Perefegese bere we afegese dem tu botarebu wom boboa ne mo.
Nfegese ye afegese delo na tui botarebu tetare ne to mo.
Sɔfegese ye afegese delo na tui botarebu kweila ne to mo.

Sakumfegese de ye afegese dwi mo. Maŋa kadwoŋi ne, botarebu wae o kwei 
perefegese de sɔfegese maama bedwe baŋa ne se o ji botarebu-dooro.
Note: Berena de zenzamesa de beeri maana yadwonna ba woli yalo na wo baŋa ne to.
Wonnu tento ye afegesa mo bεŋwaane te wae te gwaane de botarebia se te leiri ba 
kura: a-, -m, -l-, n-, -r-, -ta, -ro, -no, -ru, -yere, etc. Botarebia na jege afegesa to maana: 
nlei, kadoa, pullu, chorro, berem, etc. Afegesa wae ya pae botarebu bere kɔgɔ de 
dedoa; tuu + ru= tuuru, choro + r= chorro, sɔɔ + ro= sɔɔro, kunu + n = kunnu, 
bere + no = bereno, etc.
Totoŋe 3.1 Ka-lware afegesa na ye kolo to
Gwaane de n dwoŋi se á maŋe se ko veere jase afegesa na ye kolo to. Kwaane na 
se á yé wuuri á nii kolo na maŋe ko bwɛ ywo to.
Afegesa dwoa: Afegesa na pɔɔre ya ke pwoa yalei yalo wone taane ne to ye jirim de 
gwaanem afegesa mo.
Jirim afegesa: Yanto ye afegesa mo na woli pae dé mɔɔne botarebu-doora ye ba 
kura ye ba teiri to. Jirim afegese keim ne, botarebu-dooro wom wae o leiri o zoore 
botarebia diga kadwoŋi, ye maŋa kakam ne de, o diga ba leira. Jirim afegese pae dé 
nae botarebu-dooro mo ko nuŋi botarebu-kugu kom ne. Maana: Bere (keimbotarebu) 
– berem (yere), afegese -m na woli botarebu-kugu kom ne to mo tei ko leiri to; ve 
(keimbotarebu) – vea (keimbotarebu), afegese -a wo pε se botarebu wonto, ve to leiri 
o diga amaa, de pɛ dé maane keim na ke de daŋe daane to mo.
Gwaanem afegese: Yanto ye afegesa mo na pae botarebu nyenyego/yedaa leiri ye ko 
dae botarebu wom diga mo wó leiri. Gwaanem sɔfegese ba pae botarebu kuri leira, 
konto maa pae se o kuri ba zae se ko mɔ botarebu-doora. Gwaanem afegese bere 
taane totoŋa wadaa ne woŋo dagem, kanɔ, maŋa, de tedwonna mo. Konto ŋwaane, 
n ná kwei gwaanem afegese n ke botarebu na bere dedoa to laam wae o bere kɔgɔ. 
Maana: sɔfegese -ru ná gwaane de luu (dedoa) to wó ji luuru (kɔgɔ), ye nfegese -l- de 
ná gwaane de gulu (dedoa) wó ji gullu (kɔgɔ). Ko woli da, maana yadwonna na bere 
botarebia na nye daane ye ba kura ba tiini ya sere to, ye ba diga de nam wo leiri to mo 
tento: N ma-n ná kwei perefegese ka- (kanɔ) n gwaane de nuga, ko wó taa ye kanuga 
mo. Banto maama nuŋi yere diga kam ne mo.
Totoŋe 3.2 Ka- lware afegesa Kasem ne
1. Jeini na gurupa ne se á bwɛ á daare á maŋe se ko veere jase afegese dwoa yalo 
maama á na wó na to (kwei na baŋa maana yam ywono kom se á ma á zeini á 
tetere) ne á na wó wane tei to- ya leiri botarebu-kuru tem tatε mo?
2. Jeini na gurupa ne se á ma afegesa á mɔ botarebia se ba yé muri banu se á 
daare á ma botarebia bam konto á mɔ tapuna se á de kelase dem ke bobwea 
ya baŋa ne.

TALEIRINA/TALEIRA
Taleirina kuri: Taleirina ye botarebia balo na mae ba lei/ke botarebia, tacheiŋa 
naa takukwi daane to mo. Taleirina ta vɔ naa ya lei tapuna yalo na maŋe to mo 
daane se ya ji tapun-kuni, tapun-zɔgɔ naa tapun-junjuu se ya da chwoŋa ye ya dae 
bubwombwoara yedaa kam ne. Taleirina maana mo: de, naa, konto ŋwaane, ywoo, 
pa se, ye, se, ná, dedaane, de ko de, ko woli da, etc. Taleiru totoŋe chekke ye se de lei 
wonnu mo daane taane wone. Taleirina maana:
Sikuuli dem mo naa yaga kam mo?
Buseseŋa kam laam dɔ mo kolo ŋwaane ka puga sua.
Sia ywoo swoona ywoo, te maama wae te fɔge pɛɛla.
O seene yia mo o toŋe pa se ko ke lanyerane.
Totoŋe 3.5 Ka-maŋe taleirina na ye kolo to se ko veere
Ma bobwea yalo á na ke kelase ne to n ma-n zeini n tetere, se n laam ma n tetere 
botarebia n maŋe taleirina na ye kolo to.
Taleirina Dwoa
Taleirina jege dwoa dwi dwi mo taane wone. Kasem nam jege dwoa yalei mo; 
vɔɔm de leim taleirina. Amaa vɔɔm taleirina yam de ta pɔɔre kuni belei mo - vɔɔm 
taleirina yiga tu de vɔɔm taleirina belei tu. Dé wó bwɛ ya dedoa dedoa kuri ne.
