BOTAREBIA NA MƐ BA TOŊE TƆNƆ WONE TO
Afegesa (Affix) Afegese ye poponem wadaa dwi mo na kwei ko woli 
botarebu ne, ko wae ko ye o boboa ne, o tetare ne naa o 
kwola ne.
Afegesa keim 
(Affixation) Ko ye chwoŋa kalo afegesa na kwei ya gwaane botarebu-
kuru ne pae ko mɔɔne botarebu-doora to mo.
Balo taane ba wora ba 
di to (Litigant) Balo taane na wora de di to, ko wae ko ye wolo na ke saŋa 
kam to naa ba na saŋe wolo to.
Bembea Seina taane 
(Epic Poetry) Seina taane dento ye dedɔrɔ mo, de yeini de tɛ keiru dedɛɛro 
wom totoŋa na ye tei de nɔn-yum tedwonna ŋwea naga naa 
faŋa wonnu de déem na ye tei to taane mo.
Boboom jei (Starting 
Point) Boboom Kolo na dɛ yiga ko ke to.
Botarebu dale/taane 
jirim (Lexicon) Ko ye taane na naane de tetere sɔɔro, botarebia de wonnu 
tedwonna to mo.
Botarebu-yuu (Head 
word) Konto mo ye wo-yuu tacheiŋi wone.
Botarebia gwonim/fɔm 
(Clipping) Ko ye chwodea mo taane na gwoni naa de fɔe de botarebu 
wone de yage se o ji botarebu-dooro.
Botarebia jwoŋim 
(Borrowing) Ko ye chwoŋa mo taane na nae botarebu-doora de nuŋi 
taana yadwonna ne.
137
Botarebia twoŋim 
(Compounding) Ko ye chwodea kalo botarebia na kwei ba twoŋi de babam 
se ba mɔ botarebu-doora to mo.
Chane sɔrem 
(Solution) Leira yalo nɔɔno maama na sɛ to naa wonnu na guri tei to.
Chane sɔrem chwoŋa 
(Solution Path) N na wó tigisi wonnu tei naa n na wó kwei zega kalo se n 
wane n yi n teena yam to.
Choom Wonnu 
(Obstacles) Daanem delo na cho yiga veiŋa to.
Dende (Riddle) Dende ye bwia, taane, naa ta-kenkagela mo na tɔge boŋem 
chekke to se se wane se na se leira to.
Dende-kenkagele 
(Puzzle) Dende-kenkagela ye taana yalo na chamma to mo ye n jege 
se n boŋe ya wone mo chekke se n wane n sɔre ya chana 
yam naa n pa ya leira yam.
Gene wone kwɛɛra 
(Dramatic Poetry) Ba popone de pwei pwei ye ba gare de ne ŋwaŋa mo tei; 
seina taane dento nam ta popone ne kwɛɛra dwoŋi mo tei, 
keira bam pɔɔre boboŋa daane mo de wone.
Gwaanem Afegese 
(Derivational affix) Konto leiri botarebu wolo afegese dem na wo o wone to 
diga mo pa se o jiri diga kadwoŋi botarebu.
Jirim Afegese 
(Inflectional affix) Jirim Afegese ba leiri botarebu wolo de na wo o wone to 
diga.
Ka-doa Swoom 
(Monogamy) Ka-di kaane dedoa yerane ka-zo de-o.
Ka-kɔgɔ swoom 
(Polygamy) Konto ye n na jege kaana na dwoi dedoa ye n zoore de ba to 
mo.
Keimbotarebu kukua 
(Transitive verb) Konto ye keimbotarebu kukua mo ye o jege keinjwoŋinu to 
mo ye o bere kikia yam na dwei wolo naa kolo tapuni dem 
wone to mo dedoa yerane.
Keimseini na seini 
yereseini (Relative 
adverb)
Ko ye keinseini mo na ye botarebu-yuu yereseini wone.
Kɔma (Comma) Ko ye poponem wadaa (,) mo na bere siu fee wonnu na 
popone te twoŋi daane to laŋa ne naa tapuni daa kadwoŋi 
ne.
Kukuanu (Summary) A condensed version of an original text, usually a full article 
or book.
138
Kwori (Intonation) Kwori ye kwor-taŋa kam na leiri tei tapuni dem maama 
garem maŋa ne to mo.
Kwoar-ŋwanno kikia 
(Pitch) Ko ye kwor-ŋanno tem na zuzugi tei ŋwaŋa maŋa ne to mo.
Leim taleirina/
taleira (Coordinating 
conjunctions)
Leim taleirina lei tapuna wo wonnu mo daane.
Leiŋa dwoŋi Seina 
Taane (Lyric Poetry) De tui ne lei tei mo de mae de bere nɔɔno boboŋa de ko na 
ye tei o yera ne to.
Lein-gara dedɔrɔ (Ode) Seina taane dento dwarema mo ye de mae de seini woŋo, 
nɔɔno, naa boboŋe to.
Lua lei (Elegy) Seina taane dem mae de guli wonnu na ke te kɛ to mo ye 
poponno wom mae de o ŋwane mo ko maŋe de o woŋo naa 
o nɔɔno ná tega.
Nabaara chwoŋa 
(Customary) Nabaara kikeeru na nuŋi faŋa ye te toŋe te yi zem to ye te 
ta toŋe te twoŋi te maa kɛ to.
Nabaara kikia 
(Culture) Ko ye boboŋe, chullu de nɔɔna ŋwea na vei tei kateiri wone 
to mo.
Nabɔrɔ woŋo 
(Indigenous) Nɔɔna balo na bobo ba jeini jeiga ne to.
Nabiina ŋwea chega 
chwei (Human rights) Nabiina ŋwea chega chwei ye wadɛ mo na nii se nɔɔna taa 
mae daane ye ko daare se taana taa di ko chwoŋa ne.
Nfegese (Infix) Nfegese ye afegese delo na tui botarebu tetare ne to mo.
Perefegese (Prefix) Perefegese ye afegese delo na tui botarebu boboa ne to mo.
Saa (Free Verse) De popone mo saa, sɔɔ naa sɔɔnem nyenyego ba tɔge daane.
Selabola pɔɔrem 
(Syllabification) Konto ye se n pɔɔre selabola yalo na wo botarebu wone to 
mo n zege.
Selase (Slash) Ko mae ko bere pwola mo wonnu kurim maŋa ne.
Selabole gurim 
kɔnsonante (Coda) Ko ye selabole kwola kɔnsonante mo.
Sensɔla leiŋa dwoŋi 
(Ballad) Seina taane delo ba na tole de ne sensɔla tei to ye de ta ye 
leiŋa dwoŋi to.
139
Seina Taane (Poem) Seina taane ye lara dwi mo na mae sɔɔnem de nonoga taana 
de toŋe se ko pa de labaare.
Sɔ-dwi de Sɔɔro (Meter 
and Rhythm) Sɔɔro tulisim na tɔge sɔ-dwi dedoa ko kwori diini baŋa ne 
naa de tu mo gene kweila/gurim ne to.
Sɔfegese (Suffix) Sɔfegese ye afegese delo na yeini de tui botarebu kweila ne 
to mo.
Sɔɔnem Yedaa (Rhyme 
Scheme) Sɔɔro tulisim na tɔge sɔ-dwi dedoa

FOREWORD
Ghana’s new Senior High School Curriculum aims to ensure that all learners 
achieve their potential by equipping them with 21st Century skills, knowledge, 
character qualities and shared Ghanaian values. This will prepare learners to live a 
responsible adult life, progress to further studies and enter the world of work. This 
is the first time that Ghana has developed a Senior High School Curriculum which 
focuses on national values, attempting to educate a generation of Ghanaian youth 
who are proud of our country and can contribute effectively to its development.
The Ministry of Education is proud to have overseen the production of these 
Learner Materials which can be used in class and for self-study and revision. 
These materials have been developed through a partnership between the Ghana 
Education Service, teacher unions (Ghana National Association of Teachers- GNAT, 
National Association of Graduate Teacher -NAGRAT and the Pre-Tertiary Teachers 
Association of Ghana- PRETAG) and National Subject Associations. These materials 
are informative and of high quality because they have been written by teachers for 
teachers with the expert backing of each subject association.
I believe that, if used appropriately, these materials will go a long way to 
transforming our Senior High Schools and developing Ghana so that we become 
a proud, prosperous and values-driven nation where our people are our greatest 
national asset.
Haruna Iddrisu MP
Minister for Education

SELABOL NHYEHYƐƐ NA TUON
NYIENYIM
Dɛm ɔfa yi kasa fa selabol, selabol nhyehyɛɛ na tuon ho. Adzesua a ɔwɔ ɔfa ha yi 
n’ewiei no, hom botum akyerɛ nsorsoree a ɔwɔ selabol mbuei na selabol ntowmu 
ntamu na hom asan akyerɛ mbrɛ selabol ne nhyehyɛɛ si boa nkasafua ne nyɛe. Hom 
bɛsan esua tuon ahwɛ n’adzeban nye tuon ahorow tse dɛ famu, sor, adantamu, nsianee 
na ne nkekaho. Hom benya nyimdzee na suahu a hom botum egyina tuon do ayɛ 
nkasafua afofor. Ewiei koraa no, ɔfa yi bɛkasa afa tuon no dwumadzi wɔ nkasafua mu, 
kasa mbra mu na kasa nkakraba a wofi kasa bi mu ho.
Adwentsitsir
• Selabol yɛ kasafua ne fa bi a wotum bɔ dzin.
• Nkonsonante a wogyina hɔnho do dɛ selabor no da selabol su edzi. Mfatoho nye 
/m/ na /n/
• Tuon gyina hɔ ma ndze mu nsesa a ɔdze nsesa ba nkasafua ntsease mu.

Tuon/Ndze
Kasa pii dze ndze no sorkɔ na ne famuba (tuon) kyerɛ atsenka na nkyerɛase wɔ asɛm 
bi ho na wɔsan dze dzi dwuma ahorow pii. Ndze (Tuon) nye dɛ hɛn ndze bɔkɔ sor 
anaa ɔbɛba famu wɔ selabol, kasafua anaa asɛntɔw bi ne ka mu. Kasa a Ndze (Tuon) 
dzi dwuma wɔ mu no, yɛka dɛ ɔyɛ kasa a ne nkasafua ntsease gyina ndze (Tuon) do. 
Ghana kasahorow no mu pii wɔ hɔ a ndze (Tuon) dzi dwuma wɔ mu.

Tuon ahorow
Kasahorow pii wɔ ndze (Tuon) ahorow tse dɛ Sor, Adantamu na Famu dze, tuon a 
osian, na dza ɔfow sor. Ghana kasahorow no mu tuon ahorow no bi nye Sor (S), famu 
(F), adantamu ( A), nsianee (Ns) na mfowee (Mf). Dza ɔda edzi mpɛn pii nye Sor 
tuon na Famu tuon. Mbrɛ yesi da no edzi nye iyi; Sor [ ˊ ] Famu [ ˋ ]. Binom san wɔ 
adantamu tuon. Binon san wɔ Nsianee na Mfowee.
Mfatoho:
1. Kasa a tuon ebien wɔ mu (sor na famu): Akan, Nzema, Ga, Kasem, Ewe, na ne 
nkekaho.
2. Kasa a tuon ebiasa wɔ mu (sor, famu na adantamu): Dangme, Dagbani, na ne 
nkekaho.
Mbrɛ yesi da tuon ahorow no edzi nye iyi; Sor [ ˊ ] Famu [ ˋ ], Adantamu [ ¯ ]. Kasafua 
brᾲ (Bra ha.) kitsa famu (F) tuon na kasafua dᾴ (Da enyikom.) so kitsa sor (S) tuon. 
Sɛ sor tuon (S) dzi famu (F) dze ekyir a, yenya tuon a ɔfow sor. Na sɛ famu tuon dzi 
sor tuon ekyir a, yenya tuon a osian.
Tuon no Dwumadzi
Ndze (tuon) no dwumadzi: Tuon ho hia papaapa ɔnam dwuma soronko a wodzi wɔ 
kasa mu ntsi. Dwuma ebiasa na tuon dzi wɔ kasa mu. Iyinom nye dwumadzi a ɔwɔ 
nkasafua mu, dza ɔwɔ nsɛntɔw mu na kasa dodow bi a wofi kasa pɔtsee bi mu.
a. Tuon no dwumadzi wɔ nkasafua mu: Iyi yɛ dza ɔdze nsesa ba nkasafua ahorow 
a hɔn akyerɛw yɛ pɛr mu. Mfatoho bi nye papa (biribi a odzi mu), papa (egya) a sɛ 
nnyɛ tuon a nkyɛ yennkohu nsosoree a ɔwɔ mu. Yɛmfa tuon ntoto do na yɛnhwɛ.

ANO NKITAHODZI
AKENKAN HO NKɔMBɔDZI
NYIENYIM
Ɔfa yi mu no, yɛbͻhwɛ mbrɛ yebesi ehu adwentitsir wͻ akenkansɛm mu. Yɛbͻhwɛ 
mbrɛ yebesi ehu adwentsitsir wͻ akenkansɛm nye ano nkitahodzi mu. Hom bosua 
adze so afa akenkan a no mu dͻ na akenkan a no mu tserɛw ho. Hom bͻhwɛ kwan a 
wͻfa do tse ͻkyerɛwfo anaa ͻkasafo bi n’adwentsir a ͻdze dzi dwuma wͻ n’akyerɛw 
anaa n’ano kasa mu na hom ada no edzi akyerɛ.
Adwentsitsir
Adwentsitsir a ͻwͻ akenkansɛm bi mu no nye akenkansɛm no ne ngyinado. Iyi botum ada 
edzi wͻ asɛntͻw tsitsir no mu na ͻtaa so wͻ nsɛntͻw a wͻma nkyerɛkyerɛmu. Akenkan 
gu mu ahorow ebien; Akenkan a no mu dͻ na akenkan a no mu tserɛw
• Akenkan a no mu dͻ yɛ dza etͻ bo araa kenkan dze hwehwɛ biribi ma yenya ntease 
wͻ ͻkyerɛwfo bi ne tsirmupͻw ho.
• Akenkan a no mu tserɛw yɛ dza yɛkenkan nwoma ahorow dze nya nkasafua afofor 
na ͻboa ma yetum kenkan yie dze nya ntsease.
MBRƐ YESI HU ADWENTSITSIR A ƆWƆ 
ANO NKITAHODZI BI MU
Asɛmbisa a ͻgye adwendwen: Kakaa dza hom suaa no mfeda no na kyerɛ adwentsitsir 
ase. Fa wo nsusui no toto afofor dze ho.
Adwentsitsir: Ɔyɛ asɛm pɔtsee a asɛnsin, akenkan bi anaa nkɔmbɔdzi bi a etsie anaa 
esua dze to gua. Mpɛn pii no, ɔwɔ nkyerɛkyerɛmu ahorow pii a ɔboa no ma ɔda edzi. 
Sɛ ihu nsɛdzi a ɔwɔ nkyerɛkyerɛmu ahorow no mu a, ɔboa ma ihu adwentsitsir a ofi  
mu ba no. Sɛ epɛ dɛ ihu tsirasɛm a, yɛ dza ɔka do yi:
• Kenkan tsirasɛm na nyienyim no (ebɛnadze na tsirasɛm na nyienyim no ka fa dza 
wɔreka ho asɛm no ho?).
• Hwehwɛ asɛntɔw tsitsir. (Ɔtaa dzi asɛnsin no enyim.) Hyɛ no nsew dɛ asɛnt ͻw 
tsitsir no tum ba asɛnt ͻw no finimfin anaaso asɛnt ͻw a odzi ewiei koraa wͻ 
akenkansɛm no mu.
• Hwehwɛ nsɛm ahorow a wɔboa asɛntɔw tsitsir. (Bisa woho nsɛm yi fa adwentsitsir 
no ho: woana, ebɛnadze, ber bɛn, henfa, ebɛnadze ntsi, kwan bɛn do …. ?)

a. Ɔhardo Akenkan a wɔdze hwehwɛ biribi
Tͻfabͻ: Fa woara wo nkasafua bɔ akenkansɛm no tɔfa.
Ntotoho: Fa woara wo nkasafua bɔ akenkansɛm no tɔfa.
Akenkan a no mu dɔ
Dɛm akenkan dwumadzi yi gyina botae ebien do� Iyinom nye dɛ yɛbɔbɔ mbɔdzen ara 
enya akenkan no mu ntsease na kasa no ne nhyehyɛɛ. Dɛm akenkan dwumadzi yi mu 
no, ɔkyerɛwfo no dɔ akenkan no mu esukɔ hwehwɛ nkasafua a wohia nkyerɛkyerɛmu 
a yetum twitwa ase, yɛkyeakyea no, yɛkeka mu, yesisi do na dza ɔkeka ho dze hyɛ 
no nsew. Dɛm ndzɛmba yi boa ma yenya ntsease wɔ akenkan no mu. Esuafo tɔ dɛ 
wɔkyerɛw nsɛmpɔw bi to hɔ, wɔhwehwɛ nkakasafua bi hɔn nkyerɛasee wɔ nkasafua 
nkyerɛase buukuu mu na wɔsan kenkan no yie dze nya ntsease mapa.
Dwumadzi 2.1 Ɔhardo Akenkan na Ɔhardo Akenkan a Wͻdze 
Hwehwɛ Biribi mu Nkyerɛkyerɛmu
Afe a etwa mu no, hom suaa adze faa ͻhardo akenkan na akenkan a yɛdze 
hwehwɛ biribi ho. Hom nkyerɛ kor biara ase na hom ndzi nkͻmbͻ mfa kor biara 
n’akwanhorow ebiasa ho. Hom mfa hom mbuae no ntoto dza ͻwͻ ase ha no ho.
AKENKAN A NO MU DƆ HO NDZƐMBA BI
Akenkan a no mu dɔ ho ndzɛmba dɔɔ so na yɛbɔhwɛ no mu ebien:
Ɔhardo Akenkan
Yɛdze iyi hwehwɛ asɛntsitsir a ɔwɔ akenkan no mu. Ɔtaa yɛ edwuma papaapa wɔ ber 
a yɛrekenkan akyerɛwsɛm a ɔyɛ nokwar mu. Iyi mu no, onnhia dɛ ebɛtse akenkansɛm 
no nyinara ase osiandɛ erennhyɛ da ara ennkenkan akyerɛwsɛm no nyinara.
Ɔhardo Akenkan a wɔdze hwehwɛ biribi
Iyi mu no, yɛdze enyiwa fa akenkansɛm no mu ɔhardo dze hwehwɛ nkasafua na 
nsɛmfua pɔtsee bi. Yɛsan so dze hwehwɛ nsɛmbisa bi ho nyiano.
Dwumadzi 2.2 Adwentsitsir no nhwehwɛe
1. Kenkan akenkansɛm a ͻwͻ ase ha yi.
2.  Hwehwɛ adwentsitsir a ͻwͻ akenkansɛm no mu.
3. Enye w’anyɛnkofo no nkyɛ dza inyae no.

Ber a midzii mfe anan no, mohweer me maame, na m’egya dze nna minnyim 
no ho asɛm mpo na meehu n’ekyir kwan. Dza ͻbae ara nye dɛ, metsenatsenaa 
ebusuafo nkyɛn. Binom mpo nna minnyim hͻn kesi ber a menye hͻn kɛtsenae. 
Hͻn mu biara nnyi hͻ a nna ͻayɛ krado dɛ obosuo mo mu aboa me afebͻͻ. Dɛm 
ntsi menye ebusuafo pii kɛtsenae. Ansaana miribenya mfe duanan (14) no, nna afe 
kor biara ntamu no, mutum tsena mbeambea pii, kͻ skuul fofor aber biara so. Ne 
nyinara mu no, nna ebusuafo a mekɛtsenaa hͻn nkyɛn no mu binom ridzi m’enyi 
dzendzenndzen a seseiara mpo ͻyɛ dzen ma me dɛ mebɛka ho asɛm. M’enyigye 
nyinara nna minya fi m’anyɛnkofo nkyɛn wͻ skuul osiandɛ hͻ nye beebi a nna 
ͻboa ma mo werɛ fir me haw. Midzii mfe enum no, nna Memenda na Kwesida 
biara, nkankaara akwanmaber, meyɛ edwuma dze boa ma wͻdze hwɛ me. Meyɛɛ 
lebora edwuma wͻ adansibea, bea a wͻpaa mbotan. Meyɛɛ far edwuma so kakra. 
Iyi kͻr do araa mfe du a nna medze rohwehwɛ sika akͻ nsͻwdo skuul. Enyigye 
a ͻwͻ mu nye dɛ dza ͻkͻr do no nyinara ekyir no, mimiaa moho suaa adze ma 
woyii me osuanyi panyin wͻ nsͻwdo skuul. Ɔhaw no nyinara ekyir no, muwiee 
m’adzesua wͻ konyimdzi soronko mu.

Setsie ho mfaso
Basiaba: Onua, ana adwen siantsir a setsie ho hia papaapa ho pɛn?

mbra do.
Basiaba: Noara nye no, Nnyɛ setsie ara nye dɛ yeridzi mbra do. Ɔno nye gyedzi, obu 
na nokwardzi. Hwɛ dɛ sɛ edze obu ma w’awofo a, nna erekyerɛ gyedzi a ewͻ wͻ hͻn

Banyimba: Ntsease wͻ mu papaapa. Na sɛ mpanyin no so fom ɛɛ?
Basiaba: Mbo. Obu ntsi ebɛka w’ano ato mu koraa so nnyɛ. Ɔtͻfabi na yɛnntse biribi

ahobambͻ so.
Banyimba: Manndwen ho dɛm koraa.
Basiaba: Tsie iyi so ɛɛ. Setsie yɛ adzetsitsir bi a ohia wͻ nkitahodzi nyinara mu:

awerɛhyɛmu na gyedzi bi wͻ oibara no mu. Iyi boa ma mpontu ba.
Banyimba: Noara na aka no. Mobͻbͻ mbͻdzen dɛ mebɛyɛ setsie wͻ m’abrabͻ mu.

Dwumadzi 2.5. Akenkan a no mu dɔ
Kenkan dza ͻka do yi na bua nsɛmbisa a ͻwͻ ho no.
1. Hom ntsena ekuwekuw na kuw biara ngyina ͻhardo akenkan ho nyimdzee do 
mfa nkyerɛ adwentsitsir ebien a ͻda edzi wͻ mu.
2. Gyina ɔhardo akenkan a wɔdze hwehwɛ biribi do fa kyerɛ dza ͻkyerɛwfo no 
dwen dɛ ͻsɛ dɛ kyerɛkyerɛnyi no hwɛ si no pi anaa ɔbͻ ho ban no.
Kyerɛkyerɛnyi panyin nye nyia tum hyɛ ne nsa wͻ skuul bi mu. Ɔno na ͻhwɛ hyehyɛ ndzɛmba 
na nkitahodzi a ͻkͻ do tse dɛ mbrɛ adzekyerɛ na adzesua besi akͻ do dwoodwoo, mbrɛ 
wobesi ahyɛ akyerɛkyerɛfo na edwumayɛfo nkaa no nkuran, esuafo no hͻn mbͻdzembͻ 
na dza ͻkeka ho. Dɛm ntsi ͻwͻ dɛ kyerɛkyerɛnyi panyin no nya nyimdzee soronko fa 
baanodzi ho na mbrɛ obesi ahwɛ ma obiara edzi mbra do. Iyi ho hia papaapa ma skuul no, 
no mpontu. Obi n’adwenkyerɛ nye dɛ ndzeyɛɛ pa na suban pa ye dze naaso nnyɛ ͻno nko 
na ͻboa adzesua kankͻ. Ɔyɛ kyerɛkyerɛnyi panyin no n’asɛdze dɛ ͻfa akwanhorow a ͻboa 
ma nkorͻfo dzi mbra do no do ma no dͻm no nyina dzi skuul mbra do.

na n’atsenka to mu na ema no enyidzi soronko so.
Sɛ iwura skuuldan a koryɛ kͻ do ͻnam dɛ obiara kyia ne nyɛnko wͻ ͻdͻ mu a, ͻyɛ a

HO MBRA
NYIENYIM
Ɔfa yi mu no, hom bosua adze afa nkabͻmudze, nkasafuayɛ na mbataho dwumadzi 
ho. Nyimdzee a hom benya no bͻboa hom ma hom eetum ayɛ nsɛntͻw a ntsease 
mapa wͻ mu. Hom kyerɛkyerɛnyi bͻboa hom ma hom eehu mbrɛ Mfantsekasa mu 
mbataho dwumadzi tse. Nkasafuayɛ ho dwumadzi bi a hom bɛyɛ no nye; kasafua 
mbͻho, ntwado, ͻfɛm na mbataho.
 Adwentsitsir
• Mbataho yɛ mɔɔfem (Kasafua ne nkyekyɛmu kumaa a ntsease wɔ mu) a yɛdze fam 
kasafua asɛndua ho wͻ enyim, finimfin anaa ekyir dze nya kasafua fofor. Kasafua 
mbataho gu mu ahorow ebiasa; enyim mbataho, kasafua finimfin mbataho na ekyir 
mbataho. Yetum dze mbataho fam anaa dze takyer kasafua anaa kasafua asɛndua 
ho nam do nya nkasafua afofor.
• Yɛdze nkabͻmudze ka nkasafua, nsɛmfua nye adwenhorow bͻ mu dze yɛ nsɛntͻw a 
ntsease wͻ mu.
• Yɛnam mbataho do nya nkasafua afofor.
• Nkasafuayɛ yɛ kwan bi a yɛnam do dze mͻͻfem dwumadzi a ͻwͻ Mfantsekasa mu 
no dzi dwuma dze nya nkasafua afofor.
MBATAHO
Mbataho n’adzeban: Mbataho yɛ mɔɔfem (Kasafua ne nkyekyɛmu kumaa a ntsease 
wɔ mu) a yɛdze fam asɛndua ho dze nya kasafua fofor. Yebotum so akyerɛ mu dɛ 
ɔyɛ kasafua ne nkyekyɛmu kumaa a ntsease wɔ mu a yetum dze si kasafua enyim 
anaa n’ekyir dze sesa ne ntseasee. Mbataho yɛ dzin a yɛdze gyina hɔ ma nsienyim na 
nsiekyir nyinara. Sɛ yɛdze mbataho fam kasafua bi ho a, otum sesa ne ntsease anaa 
kasafuakuw no. Iyi ma yenya Nyamfimu na Ndanmu mɔɔfem. Mbataho a yɛdze si 
asɛndua anaa asɛndwow enyim no wɔfrɛ no nsienyim. Dza ɔba kasafua finimfin so 
wɔfrɛ no nsimu na sɛ ɔba ewiei no so wɔfrɛ no nsiekyir. Sɛ yenya asɛndua bi a ɔwɔ 
nsienyim na nsiekyir wɔ ber kor no ara mu ma ɔma hɛn kasafua fofor a, dɛm mbataho 
ebien no, yɛfrɛ no ntwaho.
Mbataho mfatoho no bi nye: a-, m-, n-, fo-, -nom, re-. Iyinom yɛ mbataho osiandɛ 
yebotum dze afemfam nkasafua afofor ho dze enya ntsease afofor. Mfatoho: egya bɛyɛ 
egyanom. Nsiekyir -nom a yɛdze faam asɛndua egya a ɔyɛ ankonam ho no na ɔmaa 
yenyaa no dodow egyanom.

Dwumadzi 3.1 Mbataho n’adzeban
Enye wo nyɛnko ndzi nkͻmbͻ mfa nkyerɛkyerɛ mbataho adzeban mu. Mma hom 
nnhwɛ dza wͻakyerɛ mu wͻ sor hͻ no do.
Mbataho Ahorow: Mbataho ahorow ebien no nye nyanfimu na ndanmu.
Nyanfimu mbataho: Iy yɛ mbataho a sɛ yɛdze fam kasafua bi ho a, ɔma yenya kasafua 
fofor a ntsease wɔ mu na ɔsesa kasafua no so. Iyi da no edzi dɛ, asɛndua no a yɛdze 
dɛm mbataho no fam ho no ne kasafuakuw no botum asesa. Sɛ yɛdze mbataho yi fam 
asɛndua bi ho a, yenya kasafua fofor. Mfatoho: da (to sleep-asɛndua) botum asesa ayɛ 
nda ber a yɛdze nyamfimu mbataho ‘n’ esi da enyim ma abɛyɛ nda. Sɛ ɔba no dɛm a, 
nna ɔkyerɛ dɛ asɛndua da a ɔyɛ nyɛe no abɛyɛ nda a ɔyɛ dzin.
Ndanmu mbataho: Dɛm mbataho yi boa ma yenya nkasafua afofor mbom kasafua 
kuw no nnsesa. Ɔnnsesa kasafua ne ntseasee no, dɛm ntsi kasafua a yenya no nnyɛ 
kasafua soronko koraa. Otum boa ma yenya nsesa wɔ bɔbea, kabea na dza ɔkeka ho 
mu. Iyi kyerɛ dɛ sɛ yɛdze ndanmu mbataho no mu bi fam dzin bi a ɔyɛ ankonam ho 
a, yenya dɛm kasafua no, no dodow. Mfatoho: Sɛ yɛdze ndanmu mbataho “m” a ɔyɛ 
nsienyim bata asɛndua “banyin” ho a, yebenya “mbanyin”. Iyi ma yehu dɛ nkasafua 
banyin na mbanyin nyinara wɔ kasafuakuw a ɔyɛ dzin mu. Bi so nye nsienyim nn a 
yɛdze bata nyɛe dzi ho ma yenya nndzi. Iyi mu no, dzi na nndzi nyina yɛ nyɛe.
Dwumadzi 3.2 Mbataho no dwumadzi
1. Hom ntsena ekuwekuw na hom ndzi nkasafua mbataho ho nkͻmbͻ ber a hom 
rekyerɛ mbataho dodow biara a hom nyim wͻ Mfantsekasa mu no mu. Afei, 
hom nhwɛ mbrɛ mbataho no si dze nsesa ba kasafua no ndwow no mu.
2. Bio, hom mma nkasafua afofor bi mfatoho bɛyɛ enum a wͻnam mbataho do 
ayɛ. Hom mfa dɛm nkasafua yi nyɛ nsɛntͻw, ma hom anyɛnkofo ntsie.
Mbataho no dwumadzi
Mbataho no dwumadzi dɔɔ so. No mu bi na ɔka do yi:
a.  Wɔboa ma yenya nkasafua afofor fi dza wɔwɔ hɔ dada mu. Mfatoho: n + da = 
nda, skuul + fo = skuulfo, yer + nom = yernom.
b. Ɔsesa nkasafua fi kuw bi mu kɔ kuw fofor mu. Mfatoho n + da (nyɛe) = nda 
(dzin), a + saw (nyɛe) = asaw (dzin).
c. Mbataho ma yenyenya nyɛe kabea fofor. Mfatoho: a + kɔ (daa kabea)= akɔ 
(ayɛesie kabea).
d. Mbataho boa ma yɛsesa ankonam kɔ dodow kabea mu. Mfatoho: a + pon = 
apon, wɔfa + nom = wɔfanom

mu
Kyerɛw nkabͻmudze ahorow no ebiasa na fa yɛ nsɛntͻw. Enye w’anyɛnkofo nkyɛ 
dza enya no mu nyimdzee no.
Mfaso soronko bi a ͻwͻ nkabͻmudze ho
• Ɔkyerɛ siantsir a biribii si.
• Ɔboa ma yetum ka nsɛmpruw ebien ana nsɛmfua ebien bͻ mu.
• Ɔboa dze adwen fofor ka dadaw a ͻwͻ hͻ ho.
• Wͻdze kyerɛ biribi no nsunsuando.
Nkabͻmudze ho nsɛntͻwyɛ
Nkabͻmudze dwumadzi mu no, mbra bi wͻ hͻ a yɛdze dzi dwuma. Sɛ yɛdze dɛm mbra 
yi dzi dwuma yie a, ͻboa ma hɛn akyerɛw dzi mu.
• Nkabͻmudze nye dɛ yɛdze adwenhorow, ndzeyɛɛ na adwempͻw bͻ mu. Dɛm ntsi 
ͻsɛ dɛ edze nkabͻmudze a ͻfata yɛ edwuma ama dwumadzi no eedzi mu.
• Sɛ edze nkabͻmudze ridzi dwuma a, hwɛ dɛ wo nsɛntͻw no afaafa nyinara saa.
NKASAFUAYƐ
Nkasafuayɛ yɛ kwan a yɛfa do nya nkasafua afofor wɔ kasa bi mu.
Yɛwɔ akwanhorow a yɛnam do yɛ nkasafua afofor wɔ kasa bi mu. Iyi mu bi nye 
nkasafua mbɔho, ntwado, ɔfɛm, mbataho, nkakuho, ndanmu na dza ɔkeka ho a 
yɛakyerɛ mu wɔ ase ha

Mbɔho yɛ mɔfɔlɔgyi kwan a yɛnam do ka nkasafua no ndwow ebien bɔ mu ma ɔma 
hɛn ntsease a ɔyɛ soronko fi kor biara ne ntseasee ho. Yebotum so akyerɛ mu dɛ, ɔyɛ 
kasafua a okitsa ndwow kor na no mu kor biara botum egyina noho dɛ kasafua. Dɛm 
nkasafua yi a wɔka bɔ mu yi tum fi nkasafuakuw biara mu. Yebotum enya dzin+dzin 
mbɔho, dzin+nyɛe mbɔho, asɛmpruw+asɛmpruw mbɔho na dza ɔkeka ho.
Mfatoho: enyi+dan= enyidan, enyi + kom = enyikom, nsa +pan = nsapan, sua+ 
pɔn = suapɔn, nsa+ kɔn = nsakɔn, asow+ ehyia = Asowehyia

Hwɛ nkasafua a ͻwͻ ase ha no mu dza wͻmmbͻͻ ho na kyerɛw. Fa dza akyerɛw 
no to gua ma w’anyɛnkofo no nhu. atondan, atser, mpadua, fononoo, nsadzen,

Ntwado: Ntwado ne dzin fofor so nye mbudo anaa nhuando. Ɔyɛ kwan a yɛfa do yɛ 
nkasafua afofor wɔ ber a yɛka nkasafua ahorow ne fa bi bɔ mu ma yenya kasafua 
fofor. Ɔno nye dɛ, yɛyɛ nkasafua afofor wɔ ber a wotwa nkasafua ne fa bi fi ho ma ɔma 
hɛn nkasafua afofor. Yebotum etwa kasafua no n’ahyɛse, ne finimfin anaa n’ewiei.
Mfatoho: Fiifi – Fii, Papa – Paa, Ekɔw – Kɔw,
Afɛm: Ɔyɛ kwan a yɛfa do yɛ nkasafua afofor wɔ ber a yɛfɛm kasafua a ɔwɔ kasa bi 
mu dze kɔ kasa fofor mu. Yɛdze akyerɛwamba kyerɛw kasafua no dɛ mbrɛ ɔgyegye 
wɔ kasa a odzi kan no mu no. Dɛm nkasafua no na wɔfrɛ no afɛm nkasafua. Kasa 
pii wɔ kasa afofor a wɔfɛm hɔn nkasafua fi mu.
Mfatoho: bokitsi-bucket, sɛmɛnte-cement, tomantese-tomatoes, makyese-matches
Dwumadzi 3.9 Nkasafua bi a wͻafɛm
Kyerɛw nkasafua bɛyɛ du a wͻafɛm efi kasa fofor bi mu aba wo kasaa mu. Enye 
w’anyɛnkofo ndzi dza akyerɛw no ho nkͻmbͻ.
Nkasafuayɛ ho mfaso:
1. Ɔboa ma kasa bi nyin ma ne nkasafua so dɔɔ so.
2. Ɔboa ma amanaman do kasahorow pue aman afofor do.
3. Ɔboa ma yenya nkasafua afofor toto ndzɛmba afofor dzin.
4. Ɔboa ma yesua kasa fofor.
5.  Ɔboa ma yehu nkasafua bi abɔse.

Hom mfa mfonyinkwan a ͻwͻ ase ha yi do mfa mbua asɛmbisa yi; Wosi dɛn nya

Dapɛn a abɛsen no ewiei no, menye m’anyɛnkofo kɔr mpoano. Nna wimu ayɛ kama dɛ 
wodzi agor wɔ dɛm da anapa no anna ewia robɔ no. Anapa tutuitu na yɛhyehyɛɛ hɛn 
ndzɛma a nna nsa dɔkɔdɔkɔ ahorow ka ho na yetuu hɛn hɛn dze kodur mpoano hɔ. 
Mframa nwinwin a nna ɔrobɔ fi po no mu no maa akwantu no yɛɛ ahomka.
Yedurii ara na yɛkɔhwehwɛɛ abɛdua bi ase kɛtsenae. Yɛdze hɛn awer sesɛɛw famu 
na yɛtsenantsenaa do. Mbofra a nna woridzi agor wɔ hɔ na dɔm a wɔrogor asorɛkye 
no mu no maa hɛn kɔn dɔɔ dɛ yɛkɛka hɔn ho. Mber kakra ekyir no, yehuruhuruwii 
sisii po nsu wirikukuiku no mu a yɛregye hɛn enyi dɛmara.
Ewiaber no, yɛdze edziban a ɔwɔ hɛn ndzɛmba mu no kaa hɛn ano. Asorɛkye a nna 
orubu hwe mbotan a nna ɔbɛn hɛn no yɛ fɛw yie. Ewiaber no nyinara nna yɛwɔ 
mpoano hɔ a yeridzi agor ahorow wɔ anhwe no mu.

Susukyerɛw Kasa Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Na Kasa

NYIENYIM
Ɔfa yi bue osuanyi no enyi na ɔma no ntsease wͻ susukyerɛw na kasa asekyerɛ ho. 
Susukyerɛw no mu no, hom bͻhwɛ susukyerɛw ahorow na hom esua mbrɛ wosi kyerɛw 
susukyerɛw. Susukyerɛw ahorow a yɛbɔhwɛ no bi nye sukyerɛ susukyerɛw, amandzɛɛbɔ 
susukyerɛw, nkyerɛkyerɛmu susukyerɛw, atekel, anokɔnkɔn na krataakyerɛw. Hom 
benya nyimdzee a ͻbɛma hom ehu susukyerɛw ahorow na hom akyerɛw bi wɔ Mfantse 
mu. Afei, hom bosua kasa nkyerɛase ho nyimdzee wͻ ͻfa yi mu afa dɛ erekyerɛ akyerɛw 
bi ase fi kasa fofor mu akͻ Mfantse mu. Yɛbͻhwɛ kasa nkyerɛase ahorow bi tse dɛ 
‘erekyerɛ kasafua no ase nkorkor, ‘Erohwɛ nsɛm no ne ntseasee dze akyerɛ ase’ na 
adze. Dɛm no bͻboa ma hom eetum akyerɛ kasa ase efi kasa fofor mu aba Mfantse mu 
na hom dze bi efi Mfantse mu akͻ kasa fofor mu.
Adwentsitsir
• Wͻdze Edwumamu krataa kɛma edwuma mu panyin.
• Nyɛnko krataa yɛ krataa a yɛdze kɛma obusuanyi anaa nyɛnkofo.
• Susukyerɛw yɛ mbrɛ ͻkyerɛwfo bi si hyehyɛ ne nsɛm na n’adwempͻw wͻ akyerɛw 
mu.
• Kasakyerɛ susukyerɛw dua akyerɛw do dze adwen bi to gua.
• Kasa nkyerɛase no nye dɛ ebɔtwe ntseasee a ɔwɔ asɛm bi mu akɔ kasa fofor bi mu.
SUSUKYERƐW
Susukyerɛw yɛ kwan a obi fa do hyehyɛ ne nsɛm wɔ akyerɛw mu. Susukyerɛw ahorow 
a osi enyiwa do wɔ mfe mpem ebien dze rokɔ (19th century) yi mu nye sukyerɛ 
susukyerɛw, amandzɛɛbɔ susukyerɛw, nkyerɛkyerɛmu susukyerɛw na anokɔnkɔn 
susukyerɛw. Sɛ akyerɛw dzi mu a nna tserɛ susukyerɛw ho ndzɛmba pa ahorow wɔ 
mu.
Susukyerɛw Ahorow
Susukyerɛw gu mu ahorow dɛ mbrɛ ɔwɔ ha yi; sukyerɛ susukyerɛw, amandzɛɛbɔ 
susukyerɛw, nkyerɛkyerɛmu susukyerɛw na anokɔnkɔn susukyerɛw.

SUSUKYERƐW NA KASA ASEKYERƐ
Year 2ƆFA  5
Sukyerɛ Susukyerɛw
Dɛm susukyerɛw yi ma esuafo kyerɛ mbrɛ biribi, nyimpa, bea, suahu, atsenka, tsebea 
na ne nkekaho bi no su tse. Dɛ bia erekyerɛw afa w’ebusua anaa wo kurom ho no, 
wͻfrɛ no sukyerɛ susukyerɛw. Mfatoho na ͻwͻ ase ha yi.
M’ebusuafo a wͻwͻ fie
Menye m’ebusuafo tse wͻ fie keteaba bi mu. Fie no suar mbom ͻyɛ fɛw ara yie. Ture 
kɛse bi wͻ fie no ekyir. M’enyi gye dɛ mebɛyɛ ture no mu edwuma naaso mo nuabaa 
no dze, n’enyi nngye dɛ ͻbɛyɛ ture mu edwuma. Dza ͻpɛ ara nye akenkan. Otum 
kenkan anapa, ewiaber na mpo anafua.
Sɛ nduadzewa no sow a, medze atododze a ͻwͻ mu no nyinara ma me maame na me 
papa. Wͻtaa noa edziban wͻ gyaadze. Wͻnoa a, midzi naaso mo nuabaa no dze, odzi 
kakraabi pɛr. M’ebusuafo bͻ mu dzi anapa na ewimbir edziban niynara. Ɔyɛ a, yedzi 
nkɔmbɔ na yɛserew. Afei mo nuabaa no twutwuw nkyɛnse ho. Odu anafua a, me papa 
tsie ndwom na me maame so yɛ edwuma wͻ kͻmputa do. Mo so mohwɛ tɛlɛbihyɛn na 
mo nuabaa no kenkan.
1. Amandzɛɛbɔ Susukyerɛw : Kodzisɛm bi a ɔfa ɔkyerɛwfo bi no suahu ho ka 
amandzɛɛbɔ susukyerɛw ho. Okitsa su dɛ kodzi na wͻdze kodzi mu ndzɛmba bi 
forafora a ͻboa osuanyi no. Ndzɛmba a yebotum akyerɛw amandzɛɛ susukyerɛw 
afa ho bi nye; Da a odzi kan a mokͻr mo skuul anaa asɛm bi a osii. Dɛm susukyerɛw 
yi mu no, obi da no suahu wͻ no skuul ho na dza ͻwͻ no wͻ asɛm a osii no ho edzi.
2. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu Susukyerɛw:  Iyi ma esuafo hwehwɛ adwenkyerɛ bi mu, ne 
ngyinado ahorow na sɛ ɔfata dɛ wɔdze adwen fofor ka ho a, wɔdze ka ho dze to gua 
ma no mu da hɔ wɔ akyerɛw no mu. Ɔda nsɛm edzi fa susukyerɛw no ne tsirasɛm 
no ho. Sɛ erekyerɛw afa Ghana fahodzi ho a, ͻkyerɛwfo no bɛma abakͻsɛm bi a 
ͻfa fahodzi da no ho. Tse dɛ da a fohodzi no sii, nyimpa a wodzi akotsen wͻ mu 
na dza ͻkeka ho.
3. Anokɔnkɔn Susukyerɛw: Dɛm susukyerɛw yi hwehwɛ dɛ esuafo bɛyɛ biribi ho 
nhwehwɛmu a no mu dɔ na osisi nsɛm do yie dze epia egyinasi bi. Mfatoho; “Mbaa 
a wͻyɛ edwumamu mpanyin no wͻ abotar sen mbanyin a wonya dɛm dzibew no”. 
Ha no obehia dɛ osuanyi no bɛkyerɛ n’adwen a ogyina nokwasɛm do. Ber a wͻreyɛ 
dɛm no nna wͻreyɛ anokͻnkͻn.
Dza ͻka do yi yɛ anokͻnkͻn tsirasɛm mfatoho no bi
a. “Kyerɛkyerɛnyi na datser, woana na no ho hia kɛse?”
b. “Okuafo na obi a ɔyɛ mfir ho edwuma, woana na no ho hia kɛse wͻ ͻman mu?”
c. “Skuul a esuafo da hɔ na dza esuafo nnda hɔ mu dza ɔwɔ hen na w’enyi gye ho 
papaapa? Ma nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɔwɔ ngyinado”.
d. “Iyinom mu hendze na epɛ? Skuul a mbaa anaa mbanyin nko kɔ na skuul a mbaa 
na mbanyin nyina bɔ mu kɔ”.
Susukyerɛw ne Nhyehyɛɛ
Susukyerɛw wͻ nkyekyɛmu ebiasa. Ɔno nye Nyienyim, Asɛm no ankasa na Ewiei.

Nyienyim
Iyi yɛ biribi a ɔtwe adwen ba asɛm no do. Fa asɛmbisa, nkontaabudze a ɔtaa nsɛm bi 
ekyir anaa asɛm biara a ɔbɔtwe nkorɔfo hɔn adwen akͻ dza erekyerɛw ho asɛm no do 
hyɛ ase. Ka tsirasɛm no ho nsɛm bi a akenkanfo rohwehwɛ. Afei, fa kwan bi do na fa 
dza erebɛka ho asɛm no to gua.
Asɛm no ankasa
Ha na edze asɛntɔw a okitsa asɛntsitsir no bͻto gua na edze mfatoho, dasedzi na 
ngyinado biara a ewɔ ataa wo nkyerɛkyerɛmu no ekyir. Dza ͻwͻ ase ha yi boa ano a, 
otum yɛ anokͻnkͻn susukyerɛw mu nsɛmpͻw ankasa.
Eyi asɛm no enyim ewie no, fa asɛmpɔw a odzi hɔ no to gua.
Fa asɛntɔw a ɔdze akenkanfo bowura asɛnsin a ɔtoa do no mu bra.
Fa asɛntsitsir asɛntɔw a obi botum aka dze etsia wodze no bra.
Fa ngyinado kyerɛkyerɛ dɛm nsɛm no mu kakra na kyerɛ dɛ nokwar kakra bi wɔ mu.
Bɔ dɛm nsɛm no gu na wura tɔfabɔ no mu.
Ewiei
Ewiei nye ber a ͻkyerɛwfo no dze ne nsɛm a ͻrekyerɛw fa ho no ba ewiei . Dza ͻwͻ 
ase ha yi bͻboa wo, ber a edze w’akyerɛw reba ewiei no.
1. Bɔ wo nsɛmpɔw no tɔfa
2. San si w’egyinae no do.
3. Fa asɛntɔw a ɔkyerɛ ewiei wie w’akyerɛw no.

Kasakyerɛ susukyerɛw
Kasakyerɛ susukyerɛw yɛ kwan a yɛfa do dze adwen anaa asɛm bi to akenkanfo

susukyerɛw no ankasa.

Mfaso a ɔwɔ hɛnankasa hɛn kasaa ho wɔ adzesua mu.
Hom yɛ nsɔwdo skuulfo yi, hom ehu dɛ hom dze kasa forafora wɔ hom daadaa 
abrabɔ mu? Mekyerɛ, ber a hom nye anyɛnkofo na ebusuafo ridzi nkitaho na ber 
a hom wɔ skuuldan mu rusua adze. Ana atsena ase da kor bi adwen mfaso a ɔwɔ 
warankasa wo kasaa ho wɔ w’adzesua mu ho?
 Nhwehwɛmu taa kyerɛ dɛ esuafo a hɔn ano atsew wɔ hɔnara hɔn kasaa mu no bɔ 
mbɔdzen papaapa, tsitsir wɔ akenkan na akyerɛw mu. Iyi ne siantsir nye dɛ, wo 
kasaa yɛ fapem papa a wogyina do sua adze. Iyi ma kasa fofor no sua nnyɛ dzen 
na ndzɛmba bi a nkyɛ no sua bɛyɛ wo dzen no mpo yɛ mberɛw ma wo.
 Bio, wo kasaa boa ma etse kusum na nyimpasu ase yie. Kasa nye kusum nam ntsi 
sɛ obi tum ka ne kasaa yie a, ɔma ohu hɔn ase ma onya enyigye wɔ no kusum 
abakɔsɛm ho.
Kor so nye dɛ, nhwehwɛmu san da no edzi dɛ, esuafo a wotum ka hɔnara hɔn 
kasaa yie no hɔn adwen mu ebue, hɔn werɛ mmfir asɛm, wotum sɔw ɔhaw ano na 
wɔdwen kɔ ekyir so. Iyi ne siantsir nye dɛ, hɔnara hɔn kasaa no na mpɛn pii no 
ɔyɛ edwuma tsitsir wɔ hɔn (esuafo no) adwen mu na ɔma wotum dzi nkɔmbɔ yie 
na ɔdandan nsɛm wɔ adwen no mu so.
Medze m’asɛm reba ewiei no, hɛnara hɛn kasaa ho hia papaapa wɔ nwomasua 
na no mu konyimdzi mu, kusum na nyimpasu nye adwen no mu ndɔe mu. Yɛyɛ 
nsɔwdo skuulfo yi, oye papaapa dɛ yɛgye hɛn kasaa to mu.

Hom nkyɛ hom mu ekuwekuw na kuw biara mfa nsɛnsin ebiasa nkyerɛw atekel 
anaa kasakyerɛ susukyerɛw wͻ tsirasɛm “Mo skuul mu mpontu” ho. Hom nhwɛ 
dɛ hom dze nhyehyɛɛ a yɛaka ho asɛm no nyinara bedzi dwuma wͻ hom akyerɛw 
no mu.
KRATAAKYERƐW
Krataakyerɛw gu mu ahorow ebien. Yɛwɔ nyɛnko krataa na edwumamu krataa.
EDWUMAMU KRATAA NA NE NHYEHYƐƐ
Nsͻhwɛ- Ma Yɛnsͻ W’adwen Nhwɛ
Ansaana yɛbͻhwɛ krataakyerɛw ahorow no, bͻ w’adwen mu fa kyerɛ susukyerɛw 
ahorow anan no nye hͻn nhyehyɛɛ no ho.
Edwumamu krataa
Edwuma mu krataa: Iyi yɛ krataa a wɔkyerɛw kɔ ndwuma mu anaa wɔdze ma nyimpa 
etsitsir bi. Odzi nhyehyɛɛ pɔtsee bi do. Yɛwɔ no ho kasa nhyehyɛɛ soronko. Ber biara 
a yɛpɛ dɛ yɛnye onyimdzeenyi anaa nyimpa tsitsir bi bedzi nkitsaho no, yɛkyerɛw no 
edwuma mu krataa.
Yetum dze edwuma mu krataa dzi dwuma wͻ yɛnye mpanyimfo etsitsir bi ntamu 
nkitahodzi ahorow mu. Mpanyimfo a yɛreka hͻn ho asɛm no bi nye Kyerɛkyerɛnyi 
panyin, Akyerɛw mu nsamufo, Asͻfo mpanyimfo, Abanmu mpanyimfo, Ahemfo, Aban 
ananmusifo na nkekaho pii, .
Edwumamu Krataa Ne Nhyehyɛɛ
1. Ɔkyerɛwfo no n’adrɛɛse: Iyi nye krataakyerɛw ahyɛse koraa. Bɔ ɔwo a erekyerɛw 
krataa no w’adrɛɛse wɔ nyimfa sor duodoo no mu. Yɛnhyɛ no nsew dɛ krataakyerɛw 
no bi so wͻ hͻ a yetum bͻ adrɛɛse no bankum afamu dodoomu sor hͻ.
2. Da; Kyerɛw da pɔtsee a edze rekyerɛw krataa no hyɛ w’adrɛɛse no ase.
3. Ɔkenkanfo no n’adrɛɛse: Kyerɛw nyia edze krataa no rekɛma no no n’adrɛɛse wɔ 
da no ase, bankum afa mu.
4. Nkyia; Iyi yɛ enyidzi mu nkyia. Ɔsan so twe ɔkenkanfo no n’adwen ba dza erebɛka 
no do.
Bi nye, “Kyerɛkyerɛnyi panyin pa, Ɔkwankyerɛfo pa, Onyimnyamfo pa,”
5. Tsirasɛm: Ɔwɔ dɛ ɔyɛ asɛm a erebɛka no ho tsirasɛm a wɔdze akyerɛwamba akɛse 
akyerɛw. Wonya iyi fi asɛmbisa no mu. Ɔtaa yɛ asɛmfua.

Dwumadzi 5.12 Nyɛnko krataa
Enye wo kuwmba mfa nsɛnsin ebiasa nkyerɛw nyɛnko krataa nkɛma hom nyɛnko 
na hom nka akwanma bi mu nsɛm nkyerɛ no ber a hom dze hom enyi ritsim 
nhyehyɛɛ a wͻdze kyerɛw krataa no do.
KASA NKYERƐASE
Kasa nkyerɛase nye dɛ ebɔtwe ntsease a ɔwɔ asɛm bi mu no akɔ kasa fofor bi mu. Kasa 
a yɛkyerɛ no mu asɛm ase no nye kasa a asɛm no fi mu. Yɛwɔ kasa a yɛkyerɛ asɛm no 
ase kɔ mu so.
Ndzɛmba bi a yegyina do dze kyerɛ kasa ase
Kasa nkyerɛase mu no, ohia ahoboa soronko bi a ͻyɛ adwenmudͻ na ntsease a wͻdze 
kyerɛ asɛm mu fi kasa kor mu dze kͻ fofor mu.
Akwankyerɛ bi nye yi;
1. Buebue nsɛm bi enyi do; Dzi kan ma esuafo nhu soronko a ɔwɔ kasa nkyerɛase 
na kasa nkyerɛkyerɛmu ntamu nye hia a kusum ho hia wɔ kasa nkyerɛase mu.
2. Akenkan ho Nyimdzeenya: Hwɛ dɛ esuafo no botum akenkan kasa a asɛm a 
wɔrebɛkyerɛ ase no wɔ mu no na wɔaatse ase.
3. Asɛm mu nhwehwɛmu: Kyerɛ esuafo ma wonya nyimdzee a ɔbɛma woeetum ehu 
akyerɛw mu nsɛm ahorow, ndze, botae na etsiefo no hɔn nyimpa ban.
4. Fa adwen tsim kasa nkyerɛase akwanhorow no do: Kyerɛ kasa nkyerɛase 
akwanhorow tse dɛ dza ɔwɔ ase ha yi.
a. Nkasafua nkyerɛase na nkyerɛase a itum dze bi ka ho anaa iyi nsɛm bi fi mu.
b. Nsɛmfua anaa nsɛm bi a ntsease ntsi ɔwɔ dɛ yenya n’ahyɛnanmu (Kusum 
nsɛdzi).
c. Kasambirenyi
d. Nkasafua ebien ebien a wɔbɔ mu ma ntsease
5. Suasua kasa ase kyerɛ:  Hyɛ ase dɛ ibedzi kan akyerɛ nsɛm bi a ne nkyerɛasee 
nnyɛ dzen na nkakrankakra fa kɔ dza no mu yɛ dzen do.
6. Ma nokwardzi nhia wo: Hwɛ dɛ esuafo nnkɛsesa ntsease a ɔwɔ hɔ dada no.
7. Abaɛfor tɛkonɔlɔgyi ndzɛmba: Fa Abaɛfor tɛkonɔlɔgyi ho ndzɛmba bi tse dɛ 
sɔfotowɛɛ, nkasafua nkyerɛase na ndzɛmba nkaa a ɔwɔ abaɛfor ntentan do dzi 
dwuma. Hyɛ no nsew dɛ ɔwɔ dɛ idzi kan kyerɛ esuafo no mbrɛ wosi dze dɛm 
ndzɛmba no dzi dwuma.
8. Nyimpa fofor nhwɛ mu: Hyɛ esuafo nkuran dɛ sɛ wɔkyerɛ nsɛm bi ase wie a, 
wɔmfa mma afofor ma wɔnhwɛ mu nkyerɛ nsiesie a ɔfata dɛ wɔyɛ.
9. Kasa nkyerɛase a no mu yɛ dzen: Afei, ma esuafo nkyerɛ nsɛm bi a no mu yɛ 
dzen sen nkan dze no. Otum yɛ nsɛm a ɔfa ndzɛmba soronko bi ho. ( mbra, ayarsa, 
adzekyerɛ, abɔdze ho nyansapɛ, kuayɛ, mfonyintwa).

10. Daadaa adzesua mu kankͻ: Ma esuafo ntse ase dɛ ɔwɔ dɛ wɔkɔ do kyerɛkyerɛ 
nsɛm bi tse dɛ kͻͻto nsɛm, apͻwmudzen ho nsɛm na adze ase dze tu mpon wɔ kasa 
nkyerɛase mu. Wɔmma iyi nyɛ hɔn daadaa abrabɔ.
Kasa Nkyerɛase ahorow
Kasa nkyerɛase gu mu ahorow pii mbom adzesua yi mu no, yɛbͻhwɛ dza ͻka do yi.
1.  Nkasafua nkyerɛase; iyi kyerɛkyerɛ nkasafua ase ara kɛkɛ.
2. Nkyerɛase a ɔnnhyɛ wo ketsee : Nkyerɛase a oyi kasambirenyi mu ntseasee na 
ndze a ɔwɔ mu no pue prekopɛr
3. Dza ɔdze kusum yɛ edwuma: Erekyerɛ asɛm bi ase na agye kusum ndzɛmba bi 
ato mu.
4. Dza ɔnnsesa enyidzi kasa a ɔwɔ mu no: Iyi yɛ asekyerɛ bi a ɔhwɛ dɛ enyidze 
kasa na obu a ɔwɔ mu no obegyina hɔ dɛmara wɔ kasa fofor no mu.
5. Kasa nkyerɛkyerɛmu; Iyi yɛ anokasa mu nkyerɛkyerɛmu a yɛtaa hu wɔ nhyiamudzi 
ahorow ase anaa asɛndzii ase.
6. Dza itum sesa mu: Iyi so yɛ dza mbra ketsee biara nnyi ho ntsi ibotum ase nsɛm 
no bi dɛ edze bi bɛka ho anaa ibeyi bi efi mu. Na tserɛ, itum so manman.
7. Kasa nkyerɛase mapa: Iyi mu no, adzehiadze kɛse papaapa nye asɛm bo ne 
ntsease dɛ mbrɛ ibohu no dɛ ɔtse wɔ kasa a odzi kan no mu no. Iyi hwɛ mbrɛ asɛm 
no tse ankasa, adwen a ɔtaa ekyir, akenkanfo anaa etsiefo na ne nkekaho.
Kasa Nkyerɛase ho Dwumadzi
Kasa nkyerɛase ho dwumadzi bi nye iyi
1. Nsɛntɔw a hɔn nkyerɛase nnyɛ dzen; Hom nkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm a hɔn nkyerɛase 
nnyɛ dzen ase.

The Environment
In our modern world, there are many factors that place the wellbeing of the planet 
in jeopardy. While some people have the opinion that environmental problems are 
just a natural occurrence, others believe that human beings have a huge impact 
on the environment. Regardless of your viewpoint, take into consideration the 
following factors that place our environment as well as the planet Earth in danger.
Global warming or climate change is a major contributing factor to environmental 
damage. Because of global warming, we have seen an increase in melting ice caps, 
a rise in sea levels, and the formation of new weather patterns. These weather 
patterns have caused stronger storms, droughts, and flooding in places that they 
formerly did not occur.
Air pollution is primarily caused as a result of excessive and unregulated emissions 
of carbon dioxide into the air. Pollutants mostly emerge from the burning of fossil 
fuels in addition to chemicals, toxic substances, and improper waste disposal. 
Air pollutants are absorbed into the atmosphere, and they can cause smog, a 
combination of smoke and fog, in valleys as well as produce acidic precipitation 
in areas far away from the pollution source.

In many areas, people and local governments do not sustainably use their natural 
resources. Mining for natural gases, deforestation, and even improper use of 
water resources can have tremendous effects on the environment. While these 
strategies often attempt to boost local economies, their effects can lead to oil 
spills, interrupted animal habitats, and droughts.
Ultimately, the effects of the modern world on the environment can lead to many 
problems. Human beings need to consider the repercussions of their actions, 
trying to reduce, reuse, and recycle materials while establishing environmentally 
sustainable habits. If measures are not taken to protect the environment, we 
can potentially witness the extinction of more endangered species, worldwide 
pollution, and a completely uninhabitable planet.

Ghana Kasakuw ahorow mu hɔn kusum awargye
Iyi yɛ kusum ndzɛmba a wɔyɛ dze ka basia na banyin bɔ mu ma wɔtsena dɛ awarfo. 
Ghanaman yi mu no, awar nnyɛ basia na banyin no nko hɔn asɛm na mbom basia no 
n’ebusuafo, banyin no n’ebusuafo na hɔn beenu no nyina hɔn anyɛnkofo so ka ho ma 
wɔgye awar no. Awargye ho ntͻyɛɛ taa sesa kakra wͻ kasakuw ahorow mu. Mber pii 
no, ebusua ebien no mu mba tum dɛ wͻserasera hͻn ho, kyekyɛ hͻnho ndzɛmba.
Awar mu ntͻyɛɛ [awargye]
Ndzeyɛɛ ahorow a wͻyɛ wͻ awar mu no yɛ kusum ntͻyɛɛ anaa atͻrmuadze bi a wͻyɛ 
fa nyimpa beenu bi a wͻrowar ho. Dɛm ndzeyɛɛ yi sesa wͻ nyimpakuw, nsͻrnsͻr, nye 
nkuronkurow do. Iyi taa gyina nyimpakuw ahorow no hɔn gyedzi , hɔn amambra nye 
hͻn kusum ntͻyɛɛ do.
Awar mu amambra ahorow wɔ Ghanaman mu. Kasakuw biara so wͻ kwan a wͻfa do 
gye hͻn awar na ndzeyɛɛ ahorow a wͻyɛ wͻ awargye ase. Mfatoho a ͻfa no awargye 
mu ndzeyɛɛ a kasakuw ahorow bi yɛ na ͻka do yi.

wɔnwar a, wͻhyɛ da dze yɛ amambra biara a ͻfata ma hͻn dze ka hͻn bͻ mu. Nkranfo 
hɔn kusum gye ndɛ mber yi mu nsesa a aba awar mu tse dɛ Kristosom mu awar na 
Nkromofo awar to mu. Nkranfo hͻn kusum awar mu no, banyin a ɔrohwehwɛ basia 
awar no anaa egya bi a ɔrohwehwɛ basia ama ne ba awar no dzi kan per dɛ obenya 
basia a n’enyi gye no ho. Nkranfo hɔn awar ahorow no mu bi na ɔwɔ ase ha yi.

Banyin no n’ebusuafo dze basia no n’ayefor ndzɛmba kɛma no ayeforhyia da no.

Ndzɛmba bi a ͻda edzi wͻ ebusuabͻ mu nye:   
1.  Wofi nanankansowa kor ase: Dͻm a wͻwͻ ebusua bi mu no hͻn ase fi nanankansowa

yi bi nye:

Mbrɛ kusum amambu ho nhyehyɛɛ tse
Dza ͻka do yi kyerɛ ndzɛmba bi a yehu wͻ kusum amambu nhyehyɛɛ mu.
1. Tumdzi hyɛ ase fi sor dze kesi ase, na tumdzi kor biara wͻ dwuma pͻtsee a wodzi 
wͻ hͻ.
2. Tumdzi nhyehyɛɛ na adwenfa no wͻ baanodzifo mpanyin nsamu. Kyerɛ dɛ ahemfo 
mpanyimfo no na wͻfa adwen ma dͻm no.
3. Wͻdze tumdzi na adwenfa no bi hyɛ baanodzifo bi a wͻwͻ tumdzi dua no ase nsa 
ma hͻn so wodzi dwuma no bi.
4. Nkyekyɛmu ahorow bi: Wͻakyekyɛ tumdzi mu ekuwekuw na kuw biara wͻ dwuma 
a wodzi. Tumdzi no so wͻkyekyɛ mu bio ma ebusua na dzibewdzifo nkakraba 
nyinara so kyerɛ hͻn adwen.
5. Mbrɛ nkitahodzi nhyehyɛɛ tse: Nkitahodzi wͻ kusum amambu mu no wͻ nhyehyɛɛ 
pͻtsee a ͻfa do. Dɛm nhyehyɛɛ kwan yi do na ͻsɛ dɛ oibara fa do dze dzi nkitaho 
wͻ ͻman no mu.
6. Mbrɛ woesi akyekyɛ dwumadzi no: Dwuma a ͻwͻ dɛ kuw biara dzi no, wͻakyekyɛ 
no pɛpɛɛpɛr a kuw biara nyim n’asɛdze na wͻyɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛr.

Mfonyin 7.4: Kusum amambu mu dzibewdzi atwer
Sɛ yɛhwɛ dzibewdzi atwer a ͻwͻ sor hͻ no a, ͻda edzi pefee dɛ kusum edzibewdzifo 
hͻn dzibewdzi atwer no, nyia a odzi kan nye ͻhempͻn. Mfantsefo mu dze, ɔmanhen 
na odzi kan ana ahemfo nkaa bi na ahemfo nkakraba so atoa do. Mbaahembaa na 
akͻmfo dze, hɔn gyinabew yɛ kor wͻ atwer no do. Ahemfo nkakraba no na wͻhwɛ 
akyeame na ebusua-mpanyimfo no do.
Ahemfo a wͻdeda mbeambea ahorow wͻ dzibewdzi nhyehyɛɛ atwer no do no mu 
biara wͻ dwuma a odzi. Hͻn dwumazi a wodzi no bi nye:

Ɔhempɔn: Ɔhempɔn yɛ odzibewdzifo kɛse a ͻwͻ tum kɛse dze hwɛ ͻmanpͻn do. 
Kasakuw bi mu no, ͻhempͻn yi wͻ tum soronko a ɔdze hwɛ ͻmanfo nyina do.
Ɔhempͻn no dwumadzi:
1. Ɔhen hwɛ ͻmampͻn do.
2. Ɔhyɛ mbra na ͻhwɛ ma ͻmamfo dzi do.
3. Ɔno nye nyia odzi baano wͻ ͻko mu.
4. Odzi asɛm anaa osiesie asɛm.
Ɔmanhen
Ɔmanhen yɛ obi a ͻda nyimpakuw a wͻka kasa kor anaa wɔtse bea pɔtsee bi ano. Ɔno 
nye ͻman no baanodzinyi panyin. Ɔmanfo no na wͻpaw no. Wodzi adze yi fi na afamu 
anaa egya afamu adzedzi mu. Iyi gyina mbrɛ adzedzi nhyehyɛɛ tse wͻ ͻman bi mu do. 
Wotum frɛ ͻmanhen ebusuahen osiandɛ wͻpaw no fi ebusua dehye mu. Sɛ adzedzi wͻ 
nyimpakuw bi mu yɛ na afamu adzedzi a, woyi ͻmanhen no fi na afamu.
Ɔmanhen n’asɛdze
Ɔmanhen dzi dwumason bi tse dɛ dza ͻka do yi:
1. Ɔno nye obi a ͻda nyimpakuw a wͻka kasa kor anaa wɔtse bea pɔtsee bi ano.
2. Ɔhyɛ mbra ma ne mamfo dzi do.
3. Ɔhwɛ yɛ atͻrmuadze ahorow.
4. Osiesie nsɛmansɛma hwɛ dɛ asomdwee bɛba ne man mu.
5. Ɔno nye amambra wura.
6. Ɔbͻ kusum amambra na ntͻyɛɛ ho ban.
7. Ɔhwɛ ma mpontu ba ne man mu.
8. Odzi ahemfo hɔn ntamu asɛm.
9. Ɔhwɛ yɛ egua no ho amandze biara.
10. Wɔyɛ egyina-ntamu ma nyimpa na nananom ewuakͻr.
Ahemfo nkakraba:
Ahemfo yinom yɛ ahemfo nkakraba a wͻhyɛ ahemfo nkaa bi ase. Wͻtaa yɛ ɔdzekrow 
a wͻdeda nkurokurow nye nkuraase bi ano. Dɛm dzibew so wodzi fi na adzedzi mu 
anaa egya adzedzi mu tse dɛ ͻmanhen dze no pɛpɛɛpɛr. Hͻn so wͻdze hͻn fa amandze 
ahorow mu ana woesi hͻn ͻhen.
Ahemfo nkakraba hͻn asɛdze:
1. Sɛ ͻmanhen nnyi hͻ a, hͻn na wͻhwɛ ekyir.

Wͻakyekyɛ ahemfo nkakraba mu dɛ mbrɛ ͻwͻ ase ha no:
Bankumhen
Anwonafo frɛ ahemfo yinom Miafi na Akanfo so frɛ hͻn ‘Bankumhen’. Hͻn na wͻda 
dͻm a wogu ͻmanhen no ne bankum do no ano ber a ͻwͻ guabͻ ase, ͻwͻ kusum 
asɛndzibea ridzi asɛm na ber a ͻkͻ ͻko.
Nyimfahen
Anwonafo frɛ dɛm ahemfo yi Đusifia na Mfantsefo frɛ no nyimfahen. Wodzi dͻm a 
wͻwͻ ͻmanhen no ne nyimfa do wͻ baguamu no enyim.
Ahemfo beenu no dzi dwuma soronko wͻ ͻman amambu mu na hͻn dwumadzi so yɛ 
pɛr. Hͻn dwumadzi no bi na ͻwͻ ase ha yi:
1. Wɔboa ͻmanhen no ma ͻfa adwem na wͻboa wͻ dwumadzi fofor bi so ho.
2. Hͻn na wͻda ͻmanhen ne nyimfa na ne bankum do ahemfo nkakraba nyinara ano.
3. Wͻma ͻmanhen no afotu na akwankyerɛ.
4. Wosiesie nsɛmansɛma a osisi mpͻtamu, hwɛ dɛ asomdwee na koryɛ wͻ hͻ.
5. Wodzi akotsen wͻ ahensi na ahentu mu.
6. Wͻhwɛ nsaase do, dzi asaase ho nsɛmansɛma nyinara.

2. Wͻhwɛ ma ͻmanfo dzi mbra do ma asomdwee ba. Wͻbͻ ͻman no ho ban fi atamfo

Mbaahembaa tse dɛ sunsum mu akandzifo ma mbaa a wͻwͻ hͻn nkurow mu na hͻn so

Ɔman kͻmfo
Ɔkͻmfo nye sunsum afamu baanodzinyi ankasa wͻ nkan tsetse ͻman bi amambu mu. 
Ɔno nye ͻmanfo no hͻn ͻyarsafo na ntamugyinafo wͻ sunsum mu na honam afamu.

NYIENYIM
Dɛm ɔfa yi kasa fa kwan a wɔfa do dzi asɛm wɔ kusum na ndɛ mber yi mu ho. Ɔkyerɛ 
ebien no nyinara hɔn nhyehyɛɛ na hɔn dwumadzi. Iyinom ho ntsease bɔboa wo ma 
eetum ada woho edzi wɔ wo dwumadzi mu dɛ kabi-ma-menka-bi ɔmamba pa. Ɔbɛsan 
aboa wo ma eetum adwen akɔ ekyir wɔ egyinasi bi ho na ehu dza ewɔ ho kwan dɛ 
itum yɛ nye w’asɛdze so.
Bio, ebɛsan enya nyimdzee na nhunmu a ɔbɛma wo kɔn adɔ dɛ ibosua adze akɔ kan wɔ 
mbranyim mu, amanyɛsɛm mu nye amanaman nkitahodzi a ɔfa amanyɛ na abakɔsɛm 
ho mu.
Adwentsitsir
• Asɛndzi anaa atsɛmbu edwuma no kyerɛkyerɛ ͻman ne mbra mu na ogyina do dze 
dzi asɛm. Ghana asɛndzi edwuma wͻ nhyehyɛɛ bi a wͻhwɛ ho dzi hͻn dwuma. 
Nhyehyɛɛ mu no, kͻͻto kunyin (supreme court) nye dza odzi kan na ɔkrɔn sen nkaa 
no nyinara.
• Kusum asɛndzi mu no, wɔdze kusum mbra hwɛ ma pɛrpɛr yɛ edwuma.
• Ndɛ mber yi mu adzedzi mu abaguafo no nye atsɛmbuafo a aban eyi hɔn ma wodzi 
asɛm na wɔtsentsen ndzɛmba.
• Abaguafo a wɔwɔ kusum asɛndzi mu no nye; ahemfo na ɔhen n’apamfo. Hɔn na 
wodzi asɛm na wɔtsentsen ndzɛmba.

asɛm. Enye esuafo nkaa no ndzi wo mbuae no ho nkɔmbɔ.

Iyi gyina hɔ ma trabuna kɔɔto anaa hɔn a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ ɔman no ne mbra mu na

Ghana asɛndzi anaa atsɛmbu mu dzibew nhyehyɛɛ
Ghana asɛndzi anaa atsɛmbu mu dzibew nhyehyɛɛ na odzi do yi.
1. Kɔɔto kunyin nye kɔɔto a odzi kan na ɔkrɔn sen nkaa no nyinara.
2. Dza odzi hͻ bio nye kͻͻto a wodzi asɛm a woedzi no dada. Iyi yɛ kɔɔto a wɔda 
ntamu a nkorɔfo a atsɛmbu bi ammee hɔn no su dan hɔn.
3. Haekͻͻto yɛ kɔɔto a wotum dze asɛm biara kɔ hɔ.
4. Kͻͻto nkakraba bi tse dɛ Mansin mu kͻͻto na wɔhwɛ ebusua mbra mu na ndzinoa 
a no mu nnyɛ dur ho nsɛm mu.
5. Mbofraba asoͻdzenfo kͻͻto na trabuna kɔɔto yɛ kɔɔto nkumaa a wɔhwɛ dzi mbofra 
a wonndzii mfe duawɔtwe hɔn asɛm.
Dwuma a kɔɔto dzi
Kɔɔto kyerɛkyerɛ ɔman ne mbra (nyimpa nye ne nyɛnko nyimpa ntamu asɛm ho mbra, 
ewudzi ho mbra (nyimpa nye aban) na edwumayɛ ho mbra) mu na ɔhwɛ ma mbra no 
yɛ edwuma. Wɔsan hwɛ dɛ mbra a wɔdze reyɛ edwuma no nyinara fa kwan mu.
Ghanaman mu ha no, onyia odzi baano wͻ kͻͻto kunyin mu nye Mbranyimfo panyin 
(Chief Justice) a ͻno nye asɛndzi edwuma no mu panyin ankasa. Yɛwͻ atsɛmbuafo na 
nhwehwɛmuyɛfo a wɔboa no wɔ asɛndzi mu. Binom kyerɛkyerɛ kasa na mbra mu na 
wɔhwɛ so dɛ mbra a wɔdze reyɛ edwuma no dzi mu.

• Ebisaa yɛ ano na ano agodzi bi a odua kasa do sɔ adwen hwɛ. Ɔyɛ asɛmbisa a ne 
nyiano no nngyina nkasafua anaa nsɛmfua a ɔwɔ mu no do. Ɔyɛ asɛmbisa anaa

ndwenho a no mu dɔ ana ne ntseasee ada edzi ma nyiano no so aba.

EBISAA
Ebisaa yɛ agodzi a odua nkasafua na kasa do sɔ adwen hwɛ ber a wofura asɛmbisa no 
tam ma dɛm ntsi ne ntseasee na ne nyiano nnda famu. Mpɛn pii no, yehu asɛmbisa, 
asɛnka anaa asɛmfua bi a ohia ndwendwenho, ebooboodzi na ndwendwenho a no mu 
dɔ wɔ ebisaa mu. Otum so yɛ aserewsɛm.
Yɛtaa hu su bi tse dɛ dza ɔwɔ ase ha yi wɔ ebisaa mu:
1. Nkasafua a wɔdze dzi agor: nsɛngor, ntsease nta, nkasafua a wokitsa akyerɛw kor 
na ntsease no yɛ soronko.
2. Ngyinahɔma wɔ mu
3. Ɔfa nsɛm a woekyim no
4. Ohia ndwenho a no mu dɔ
5. Mbuae a ɔyɛ ahomka

Dwumadzi 9.4 Ebisaa ne Nhyehyɛɛ
Beenu biara mpɛnsapɛnsa ebisaa a ɔwɔ ase ha yi ne nhyehyɛɛ no mu dɛ mbrɛ ɔwɔ 
sor hɔ no. Hom nsusu mbuae no so ho na afei hom mfa hom dwumadzi no ho 
mbuae no nyina nto gua.
 “Egya rokɔ no, ogyaa me mbofra beenu bi. Dɛm mbofra beenu yi tse fie kor mu 
naaso hɔn mu biara nnhun ne nyɛnko n’enyim da. Ebɛn enuanom a?
Ndzɛmba a ɔwɔ dɛ yɛhyɛ no nsew ber a yɛreyɛ 
ebisaa mu mpɛnsampɛnsamu
Ebisaa ne mpɛnsampɛnsamu nye dɛ ibesiansian kasa no mu, ne nhyehyɛɛ no mu na 
nkyinkyimii anaa mbirenyi biara a ɔwɔ mu no bɛtsentsen ma nyiano anaa mbuae no 
ada edzi prɛkopɛr. Mbrɛ ibesi ayɛ iyi na odzidzi do yi.
1. Tsie anaa kenkan ebisaa no yie: Fa ntoboase kenkan no mpɛn dodow bi hu dɛ atse 
nkasafua na nsɛmfua a ɔwɔ mu no ase yie.
2. Hyɛ nkasafua bi nsew: Dɛm nkasafua yi yɛ nkasafua na nsɛmfua etsitsir nye nsɛm 
a wosi do anaa woetsi mu.
3. Hwehwɛ ntsease nta: Ebisaa taa dze nkasafua a wɔdze dzi agor anaa nsɛm a ntsease 
a ɔwɔ mu no yɛ ebien dzi dwuma. Hwehwɛ ntsease ebien no nyinara ama eetum 
eyi mu kor.
4. Hwehwɛ ne nhyehyɛɛ no mu: Fa w’adwen kɔ ebisaa ne nhyehyɛɛ no do. Mekyerɛ, 
nyienyim, nkyerɛkyerɛmu, asɛmbisa na akwankyerɛ a n’enyim nnda hɔ.
5. Twetwe nsɛm sisi nsɛm do: Hwehwɛ nkitahodzi a ɔwɔ nkasafua, nsɛmfua anaa 
adwenmu mu.
6. Hwɛ adwenkyerɛ ahorow: Dwendwen adwenkyerɛ ahorow a obotum ada edzi ho yie.
7.Yi mbuae a ɔyɛ traa anaa ɔda edzi prɛko pɛr akwa: Ebisaa ho mbuae nnda edzi 
prɛko pɛr; ɔtaa suma. Hwehwɛ mbuae a esuma no.
1. Si egyinae pa: Gyina wo nhwehwɛmu ho nyimdzee no do si egyinae pa wɔ wo 
mbuae no ho.

Dwumadzi 9.5 Ebisaa ne ndzii ho akansi

ano. Sɛ otum yi ano a, ɔno so bebisa wo bi ma eeyi ano. Nyia obedzi konyim no 
nye nyia ɔbɛma ebisaa dodow na oeeyi ebisaa dodow so ano no.
NYANSAPƆW
Nyansapɔw yɛ asɛmbisa bi a no mu yɛ dzen ma dɛm ntsi ne nyiano nnda famu. Ɔgye 
ndwenho a no mu dɔ nye adwen a ɔkyer adze ntsɛm. Mpɛn pii no, ɔtaa yɛ ano agodzi.
Yɛtaa dze nyansapɔw gye hɛn enyi, yɛdze sua adze na yɛdze tu adwen mpon so. Ɔma 
nyimpa dwen kɔ ekyir, ohu kwan pa a wɔfa do yi nsɛmbisa ano na ɔma nyimpa kaa 
adze ntsɛm so. Ɔboa adwen mu mfonyintwa nye dza ɔkeka ho pii.
Nyansapɔw ho Mfaso anaa no Dumadzi
1. Ɔma adwen nyin: Nyansapɔw ma nyimdzee a yɛdze siw ɔhaw ano kɔ kan na ɔma 
mbofra hɔn adwen mu so da hɔ.
2.  Enyigye: Nyansapɔw ma nkorɔfo dzi ehurusi, wɔdwedwe hɔnho na wɔnye nkorɔfo 
a wɔnnyɛ etsipɛnfo dzi ehyia enyigye kwan do.
3. Adzesua wɔ mu: Ɔboa ma adzesua tu mpon na oyi awerɛfir fi hɔ. Afei, ɔboa 
ntsease wɔ ndzɛmba bi a ne ntseasee yɛ dzen tse dɛ Nkontaabu na Abɔdze ho 
nyansapɛ nye kasasua mu.
4. Oyi adwendwen fi nyimpa do: Osiesie nyimpa n’adwen mu, ɔma akomatɔyamu 
wɔ akwanhorow mu.
5. Ɔboa Koryɛ: Ɔma nkabɔmu, bataboa na nkitahodzi ankasa ber a yɛrohwehwɛ 
nyansapɔw bi no mbuae.
6. Otu adwen mpon: Ɔma hɛn adwen mu da hɔ ma dɛm ntsi ndzɛmba nnka ekyir 
wɔ abrabɔ mu.
7. Adwen a ɔdze adze fofor to gua: Ɔboa ma yɛyɛ nsusui pa a ɔboa ma yetum yɛ 
biribi fofor a ɔboa kankɔ.
8. Oker adwen: Ɔboa ma yɛyɛ egyinasi bi ho adwenkerii na yɛda nyimdzee a no mu 
dɔ edzi wɔ akwanhorow do.

Nyansapɔw ne nhyehyɛɛ

2. Mbra: Ma mbra anaa nhyehyɛɛ biara a ɔwɔ dɛ wodzi do no nda edzi.
3. Anamɔntu a odzi kan: Iyi yɛ anamɔntu a odzi ɔhaw no, no nsɔwano no enyim.
4. Akwansidze ahorow: Iyi yɛ ndzɛmba dodow biara a osiw anamɔntu no kwan. Nna

5. Anamɔntu a ɔdze wo bodu wo botae no ho: Iyi yɛ mbrɛ yɛbɛyɛ ma botae no aba mu.
6. Mbuae/ ɔhaw no, no nsɔwano: Iyi yɛ wo mbuae ankasa a edze rema.
Nyansapɔw mfatoho
Nyansapɔw: Buukuu a ayew no ho anwanwasɛm
Nyansapɔw no ankasa:
Buukuu bi a no ho yɛ na ayew wɔ ekuraase buukuu korabea bi. Ɔhwɛdofo no bisaa 
nyimpa baanan bi a osusu dɛ wonyim ho bi: Kukua, Nana, Kakra, na Duku. Hɔn mu 
biara kasae.
1. Kukua: "Mammfa buukuu no. Muhun dɛ okitsa Nana ne nsamu ndeda."
2. Nana "Mammfa buukuu no. Minnyim mbrɛ buukuu no tse mpo."
3. Kakra: " Muhun Duku dɛ oriyi buukuu no wɔ mbrɛ nna ɔhyɛ no."
4. Duku: “Kakra ridzi ator. Ber a buukuu no yewee no nna mowɔ fie.”
Buukuu hwɛdofo no nyim dɛ hɔn mu kor pɛr na ɔreka nokwar. Woana na ɔfaa buukuu no?

NYIENYIM
Dɛm ɔfa yi mu no, hom bɔhwɛ akyerɛw kasadwin ne fa bi a ɔyɛ awensɛm. Dza hom 
bosua no bi nye awensɛm n’adzeban, awensɛm ahorow, awensɛm ho ndzɛmba na 
awensɛm ho mfaso. Hom bɛsan ahwɛ mbrɛ wosi pɛnsapɛnsa awensɛm mu. Awensɛm 
na no mu mpɛnsampɛnsamu ho nyimdzee bɛma ehyia nkasafua a ɔbɛma wo kasaa 
eedzi mu na aayɛ frenkyemm so. Ɔfa yi san kyerɛ mbrɛ ibesi dze w’adwen esusu biribi 
ho, mbrɛ ibesi adwen akɔ ekyir na eetum akasa ma akyerɛ dɛ awea wɔ kasa no mu. 
Awensɛm mu mpɛnsampɛnsamu no bɛma w’adwen mu eepiw yie, aakyerɛ kasa ase yie 
na eehu mbrɛ wosi yɛ kasa mu mpɛnsampɛnsamu ankasa. Ɔbɛsan ama aatse nkorɔfo 
hɔn atsenka ase na hom eehu kwan a hom bɛfa do nye afofor atsena asomdwee mu. 
Awensɛm ho nyimdzee yi bɔboa wɔ adzesua fofor tse dɛ Abakɔsɛm mu, Borɔfo kasa 
mu kasadwin mu na Ndwom no sua mu. Adzesua yi boa ma yenya tsema, abakɔsɛm 
na kusum nye amandze mu nhunmu. Sɛ edze awensɛm gu wo tsirmu na eka no dɛ 
mbrɛ ɔsɛ a, ɔboa mbrɛ isi kaakaa nsɛm, inya akokodur na eda nsew wɔ bagua mu kasa 
mu.
Adwentsitsir
• Awensɛm yɛ kasa mu edwindze bi a ɔdze ndze no mfowee, ne nsianee na ne pɛryɛ 
nye kasasu ahorow na odua atsenka do dze ntseasee pii to gua.
• Nyia ɔwen awensɛm no wɔfrɛ no ɔwemfo anaa kasadwimfo. Kasasu a ɔdze dzi 
dwuma no bi nye ndze, mita, nsɛnkyerɛdze a ɔkasa, mfonyintwa na adze a ɔma odua 
nkasafua kumaa bi do dze nsɛm a no mu dɔ na ɔgye adwen to gua.
• Mbrɛ yesi tse awensɛm mu kasa ase no nntse dɛ mbrɛ yesi tse nsɛm a ɔnnyɛ awensɛm 
ase no.
AWENSƐM
Awensɛm ne nkyerɛmu
Awensɛm yɛ kasadwin bi a wɔka anaa wɔkyerɛw no nsensanee, nsensanee na 
nkyekyɛmu, nkyekyɛmu a okita adwen mu mfonyintwa na ɔdze adwen, suahu, atsenka 
na adze to gua. Awensɛm kitsa su bi dɛ no mu nkasafua na nsɛm no wɔto hɔn bo ase 
yiyi dze wen ma etisefo anaa akenkanfo hu tum bi wɔ mu. Ndzɛmba a ɔma tum ba 
nkasafua no mu no bi nye mita, ngyinahɔma na ndze ngyegyee pɛr.

Awensɛm ho Ndzɛmba
1. Adwenmu mfonyintwa: Iyi boa ma akenkanfo no tum twa dza wɔrekenkan no 
ho mfonyin wɔ hɔn adwen mu osian nkasafua a wɔdze edzi dwuma no ntsi.
2. Ngyegyee: Dɛm ngyegyee ahorow yi mu bi boa ma awensɛm no yɛ dɛw wɔ etsiefo 
no hɔn asomu.
3. Mbrɛ woesi ahyehyɛ awensɛm no: Ɔyɛ kwan a awensɛm da no ho edzi wɔ enyi 
do a no mu bi nye nkyekyɛmu na nsensanee ne tsentsen. Iyi boa ma awensɛm ne

4. Mita na Ngyegyee nsisido: Iyi kyerɛ nselabor a wotsi mu anaa wonntsi mu wɔ

Awensɛm ho mfaso
Kasasua ho nyimdzee : Awensɛm ma etsiefo sua nkasafua afofor, ngyinahɔma na 
kasasu ahorow a ɔboa kasa mapa.
Yɛdze biribi fofor to gua: Awensɛm ma yetum gyina hɛnara hɛn nyimdzee na adwen 
mu mfonyintwa do dze kasa mu biribi fofor to gua.
Obue adwen mu: Awensɛm ma nyimpa n’adwen mu dɔ, ohu mbrɛ obesi apɛnsapɛnsa 
asɛm bi mu na oesi egyinae pa.
Yenya tsema:  Awensɛm da nyimpa ne tsebea, atsenka, suahu na no nsusui edzi. 
Ɔnam iyi do ma yenya tsema na ayamuhyehye ma hɛnho nkorkor.

Mpɛnsampɛnsamu a ɔyɛ ndzidzido ndzidzido
Kwan a odzi kan: Kenkan awensɛm no kɛse ma obiara ntse
“Da no edu” n’akenkan yɛ ahomka papaapa; no mu nsɛm no bi ano yɛ dzen mapa.
Onnyi ngyegyee ntsimu soronko biara. Nkyekyɛmu biara yɛ soronko fi fofor ho, na 
ɔno ma innhu dza odzi do no.
Ntsɛmara ibohu dɛ ngyegyee “oo” na “i” dzi mu akotsen mapa.
Iyi ma awensɛm no gyegye tse dɛ ndwom.
Kwan a ɔtɔ do 2: Kyerɛkyerɛ Awensɛm no mu
Yɛdze dɛm ɔfa yi bɛkyerɛkyerɛ awensɛm no mu. Iyi yɛ nkyekyɛmu ebien a odzi kan 
no. Mbom, ɔwɔ dɛ aber biara etse awensɛm no nyinara ase ama eetum akyerɛkyerɛ 
awensɛm no mu yie na eetum ada ndzɛmba a ɔma awensɛm no dzi mu nyinara edzi.
Dza ɔda edzi wɔ nhwehwɛmu no mu
Awensɛm no nnhyɛ da nnyi ngyegyee ntsimu ahorow biara na mbom ngyegyee “oo” 
na yehu no wɔ nsensanee ebien bi n’ewiei.
Nkyekyɛmu 1: AABBB Ngyegyee Ntsimu
Yebohu dɛ nsensanee 1&2 n’ewiei no ma hɛn ngyegyee kor a ɔyɛ “u”. Dɛm ntsi na 
yenya AA no. Yɛhwɛ nsensanee 3,4 &5 so a, n’ewiei no ma hɛn ngyegyee kor a ɔyɛ “i” 
na ɔno ma yenya BBB.

Yebohu dɛ ngyegyee “oo” da noho edzi wɔ nsensanee 1&5 mu ma dɛm ntsi yenya 
AA. Nsensanee 2 &3 so n’ewiei no ma hɛn ngyegyee kor a ɔyɛ “i” na ɔno ma yenya 
BB. Yɛhwɛ nsensanee 4, ngyegyee a a ɔwɔ n’ewiei no nnye nsensanee a aka no dze 
nngyegyee pɛr ntsi na ɔno yɛ C no.
Kwan a ɔtɔ do 3: Hwehwɛ no Nsunsuando
Ber a yehu awensɛm yi ne ngyegyee ntsimu kwan yi, yɛnhwɛ no nsunsuando wɔ ber 
a yeriyiyi nsɛmbisa a odzidzi do yi ano:
1. Ana ngyegyee ntsimu a ɔwɔ awensɛm no mu no sesa? Ebɛnadze ntsi a?
Nkyekyɛmu biara a ɔwɔ awensɛm no mu no kita ngyegyee ntsimu soronko; ngyegyee 
no nnsisi do wɔ awensɛm no mu.
Nkyekyɛmu no bi wɔ ngyegyee ntsimu wɔ nsensanee n’ewiei na bi so nnyi bi. 
Ngyegyee ntsimu ka awensɛm no bɔ mu, dɛm ntsi nkyekyɛmu a onnyi ngyegyee 
ntsimu no, ma awensɛm no mu kyekyɛ na ɔmma kwan mma yennhu dza ɔtoa do. 
Iyi ma awensɛm ne dɛw no nnwie pɛ yɛ.
 2. Ɔkyerɛ nhyɛ anaa ɔnoara ne kwan? Ebɛnadze ntsi?
Nkasafua a hɔn ngyegyee sesɛ na ngyegyee ntsimu tse dɛ biribi a ɔyɛ nhyɛ wɔ 
mu. Kwan a ɔkyerɛwfo no faa do dze ngyegyee bi tse dɛ “oo” na “i” dzii dwuma 
no maa ɔdaa edzi dɛ nsɛmbɔn bi esi wɔ awensɛm no mu a ɔkyerɛ owu, awerɛhow 
anaa yaw.
 3. Ebɛn atsenka na ɔdze to gua?
Nsɛm a ɔwɔ awensɛm no mu no ma atsenka a ɔyɛ awerɛhow na ɔtse dɛ osu. Ɔyɛ 
awensɛm a ɔnnyɛ enyigye.
 4. Ana ɔboa ma ngyegyee ntsimu ba?
Ngyegyee “oo” na “i” a ɔwɔ nsensanee n’ewiei no boa ma yenya ngyegyee ntsimu, 
mbom ɔmmfa ho dɛ onndzidzi do wɔ awensɛm no mu, ɔnam dɛ dɛm ngyegyee no 
nndzi akotsen wɔ awensɛm no mu nyinara. Ngyegyee no da nsew; odzi dwuma dɛ 
ɔhwɛ mbrɛ awensɛm ne har anaa no nwin bɛyɛ.
Kwan a ɔtɔ do 4: N’asekyerɛ nye dɛn?
Ber yi a yehu ngyegyee nstimu no nsunsunado no, ber aso dɛ yɛhwehwɛ n’asekyerɛ!
1. Ana osi biribi pɔtsee bi do dua?
Dwendwen awensɛm no mu nsɛntsitsir ho.
“Da no edu” yɛ awensɛm a ɔkasafo bi rekyerɛ yaw na awerɛhow a ɔwɔ mu osian 
ɔbaatan bi a oewu egya ne mba hɔ ntsi.
Nsɛntsitsir a ɔwɔ awensɛm no mu bi nye:
Owu, awerɛhow, yaw, egyankayɛ
Afei, hom mma yɛnkaakaa hɛnho wɔ nhwehwɛmu a yɛyɛɛ a ɔfa ngyegyee ho wɔ 
ɔfa a etwa mu no ho no.

Afei, ber aso dɛ yɛbɔbɔ nhwehwɛmu no nyinara tɔfa wɔ asɛnsin kor mu.
Awensɛm yi twe adwen si yaw na awerɛhow do. Nsɛm a ɔwɔ mu no mu bi yɛ dzen dze, 
naaso ɔkyerɛwfo no ahyehye awensɛm no tse dɛ ndwom ara pɛr ma akyerɛ yaw na 
awerɛhow a ɔkasafo no wɔ mu. Ɔkasafo no da ɔhaw a ɔbɛba owufo no ne mba do wɔ 
ber a hɔn na ewu egya hɔn hɔ no. Yebotum ehu wɔ awensɛm no mu dɛ, nkyekyɛmu no 
biara kitsa nsensanee enum na no mu nsensanee ebien anaa ebiasa biara wɔ ngyegyee 
kor bi a ɔba nsensanee no n’ewiei. Bi so wɔ hɔ a, yehu dɛ nsensanee bi wɔ ngyegyee 
kor bi wɔ n’ewiei a dɛm ngyegyee no mmpue wɔ nsensanee biara mu. Iyi ma ɔkyerɛwfo 
no da ne nsɛm edzi kyerɛ akenkamfo ma ɔyɛ dɛ adwontow ara pɛr.

FOREWORD
Ghana’s new Senior High School Curriculum aims to ensure that all learners achieve 
their potential by equipping them with 21st Century skills, knowledge, character 
qualities and shared Ghanaian values. This will prepare learners to live a responsible 
adult life, progress to further studies and enter the world of work. This is the first time 
that Ghana has developed a Senior High School Curriculum which focuses on national 
values, attempting to educate a generation of Ghanaian youth who are proud of our 
country and can contribute effectively to its development.
The Ministry of Education is proud to have overseen the production of these Learner 
Materials which can be used in class and for self-study and revision. These materials 
have been developed through a partnership between the Ghana Education Service, 
teacher unions (Ghana National Association of Teachers- GNAT, National Association 
of Graduate Teacher -NAGRAT and the Pre-Tertiary Teachers Association of Ghana- 
PRETAG) and National Subject Associations. These materials are informative and of 
high quality because they have been written by teachers for teachers with the expert 
backing of each subject association.
I believe that, if used appropriately, these materials will go a long way to transforming 
our Senior High Schools and developing Ghana so that we become a proud, prosperous 
and values-driven nation where our people are our greatest national asset.
Haruna Iddrisu MP
Minister for Education

Ngyɛnu ɛhye buke ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ, ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ ngyehyɛleɛ nee ɛnelɛ ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ne anye. 
Ɛsukoa ngyɛnu ɛhye ɛwie a, ɛbahola wɔahile ɛweɛne mɔɔ la ɛnelɛmgbɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔbuke 
nee mɔɔ ɔmbuke la avinli na wɔawowɔ adwenle wɔ kɛ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne si 
boa wɔ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ fofolɛ ɛnyianlɛ nu la. Eza ɛbazukoa ɛnelɛ nwo debie na ɔlua zo 
wɔagua ɛnelɛ wɔ ekpunli ngakyile mɔɔ le kɛ aze nee anwuma ɛnelɛ la anu. Ɛbanyia 
adwenle nee sukoanyia mɔɔ baboa amaa wɔagyinla ɛnelɛ zo wɔanyia edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ 
fofolɛ a. Awieleɛ, ngyɛnu ne bawowɔ adwenle wɔ gyima mɔɔ ɛnelɛ di wɔ aneɛ ne anu 
la mɔɔ le kɛ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ɛbobɔlɛ, aneɛmɛla gyima nee aneɛ ko ne ala ngakyile 
ɛhilelɛ nwo.
 ADWENLE TITILI
• Ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ a le edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ foa ne mɔɔ yɛbɔ a ɔyɛ boɛ la.
• Kɔnsɔnante ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ a le kɔnsɔnante mɔɔ ɔda ye subane ali kɛ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ la.
• Ɛnelɛ kile ngakyile mɔɔ finde edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ ɛbɔlɛ nu mɔɔ kola maa edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ 
nyia ngilenu ngakyile la.
ƐNELƐKPƆKƐ, YE NGAKYILE NEE NGYEHYƐLEƐ
Ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ Subanehilelɛ
Ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ a le ɛdendɛlɛ foa ne bie mɔɔ lɛ vawolo la. Ɔkola ɔyɛ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ foa ne 
bie anzɛɛ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ mumua ne. Ɔkile ngyehyɛnu (ɛgyinlanlɛ) ne mɔɔ finde anzɛɛ 
yɛnwu ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛlɛbɔ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ la. Ndonwo, saa ɛbɔ duma Kofi a, ɛbagyinla 
fane nwiɔ (Ko: fi). Yemɔti, duma Kofi lɛ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ nwiɔ. Saa ɛbɔ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ tu (tu) 
a, ɛbagyinla ko kye ala. Ɛhye kile kɛ ɔlɛ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ ko. Ɔti ɛnea a ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ nyɛ a wɔ 
edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ bɛtɛbɛtɛ anu a? [bɛ:tɛ:bɛ:tɛ]
Saa ɛye vawolo ɛsie ahanle a, kɔnsɔnante mɔɔ lɛ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ le kɛ /m,n/ noko 
kola gyinla yɛ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ. Ɛhye ta si wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ vawolo ɛndoa kɔnsɔnante ɛhye mɔ 
ndinli zo la. Ndonwo, kundum [ku:n:du:m]. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ nyia vawolo alɛra ko 
mɔɔ kola nyia anzɛɛ ɛngola ɛnnyia kɔnsɔnante wɔ ɔ nyunlu, ɔ nzi anzɛɛ ɔ nyunlu nee 
ɔ nzi a. Edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ kola nyia ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ ko, nwiɔ anzɛɛ dɔɔnwo. Ndonwo bie mɔ a

ƐNELƐKPƆKƐ NGYEHYƐLEƐ NEE ƐNELƐ
Bango NwiɔNGYƐNU  1
1. Mɔɔ lɛ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ ko la: Sa [sa], tu [tu]
2. Mɔɔ lɛ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ nwiɔ la: sele [se:le], sulo [su:lo]
3. Mɔɔ lɛ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ dɔɔnwo la: bulalɛ [bu:la:lɛ], Takolade [ta:ko:la:de]
Adwenle mɔɔ wɔ aneɛ bie anu ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ nwo la anwo hyia ɔluakɛ;
• Ɔboa ɔmaa sukoavoma nyia edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ fofolɛ mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la.
• Ɔboa ɔmaa sukoavoma ne nwu aneɛ ne anu edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔ.
• Eza ɔboa ɔmaa sukoavoma dwenle na bɛmaa ngilenu fɔɔnwo mɔɔ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ 
lɛ la.
Ndonwo bie mɔ mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛzi bɛhyehyɛ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ nu bɛhile ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ la a 
le ɛhye mɔ:
bu, bo:lɛ, su:hɔ:lɛ, a:bɔ:lɔ:ba, gbu:lu:m.
Wɔ ndonwo ne mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la anu, edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔ ɛbobɔlɛ ngyehyɛnu 
ne mɔ ko biala le ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ. Bɛhyehyɛ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ ko biala anu bɛhile ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ 
dodo mɔɔ ɔlɛ la.
Ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ ngakyile
Gana aneɛ ko biala lɛ ɛnelɛmgbɔkɛ ngakyile. Emomu mɔɔ finde Gana aneɛ ne mɔ 
dɔɔnwo anu la a le mɔɔ ɔmbuke nee mɔɔ ɔbuke la.
Ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔbuke
Ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔbuke la a le mɔɔ vawolo dwula ye la. Ndonwo ɛhye mɔ kile ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ 
mɔɔ buke la wɔ aneɛ ne anu:
a:bɛ:lɛ, tɔ, tɔ:ne, a:zu:le
Ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔmbuke la
Ɛhye a le ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ kɔnsɔnante a dwula ye la. Ɔhyia kɛ ɛkɛnwu ye kɛ Gana aneɛ 
aneɛ ne mɔ dɔɔnwo ɛnlɛ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔmbuke la noko bɛlɛ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ mɔɔ 
kɔnsɔnante dwula bɛ a. Gana aneɛ mɔɔ lɛ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔmbuke la bie a le Dagbani, 
Gurune, Likpankpaani, Dagare, nee mɔɔ ɛha la. Ndonwo bie mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Nzema nu la 
a le:
ku:n:du:m, gbu:lu:m
Kakye ɛhye: Ndonwo ne mɔɔ yɛbanyia bɛ wɔ aneɛ ne anu la dɔɔnwo le nyɛvolɛ aneɛ 
mɔɔ yɛva yɛboka Nzema aneɛ ne edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ nwo la anzɛɛ alɛrahilelɛ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ 
bie mɔ mɔɔ wɔ aneɛ ne anu mɔɔ m anzɛɛ n dwula ye la.

ƐNELƐKPƆKƐ NGYEHYƐLEƐ NEE ƐNELƐ
Bango NwiɔNGYƐNU  1
Gyima 1�1 Kɛ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ si de la
1. Fa ɛ ti anwo edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ kilehile edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ anu. Fa wɔ 
nyelebɛnloa ne to gua maa sukoavoma mɔɔ ɛha la.
2. Kilehile ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ ngakyile mɔɔ Nzema lɛ la anu.
3. Kilehile nvasoɛ mɔɔ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne lɛ ye wɔ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ fofolɛ 
ɛnyianlɛ nu la azo. Fa wɔ nyelebɛnloa ne to gua kile ɛ gɔnwo mɔ.
Ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ ngyehyɛleɛ
Ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne noko kola kakyi wɔ aneɛ ko biala anu. Saa yɛkile kɛ 
ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ ngyehyɛleɛ si de a, yɛfa (K) yɛgyinla ɛkɛ yɛmaa kɔnsɔnante yɛɛ (V) gyinla 
ɛkɛ maa vawolo. Vawolo ne a le ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ ne ngyɛnu ne mɔɔ anwo hyia kpalɛ a. Wɔ 
Gana aneɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti anu, ɛnelɛ le debie mɔɔ anwo hyia wɔ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ ngyehyɛleɛ 
nu a. Kɔnsɔnante nee vawolo dodo mɔɔ wɔ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ ne anu la a kile kɛ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ 
ngyehyɛleɛ ne bazi ayɛ a. Kɔnsɔnante ne mɔɔ angome gyi kɛ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ la a lɛ ɛnelɛ 
ne a. Ndonwo bie mɔ mɔɔ wɔ aneɛ ne anu la a le ɛhye:
a(V), aa(V:), ɛnɛ (VKV), akyɛkɛ(VKVKV), gbulum(KVKVN)
Gyima 1�2 Nzema ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne
Wowɔ adwenle wɔ Nzema ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne anwo na fa wɔ nyelebɛnloa 
ne to gua kile sukoavoma mɔɔ ɛha la.
Gyima 1�3 Edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ fofolɛ ɛnyianlɛ mɔɔ gyi ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ zo la�
Wɔ bɛ ekpunli ne mɔ anu, bɛye edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ nsia bɛvi ɛgengadeɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ aze 
ɛke la anu na bɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ:
1. Ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo mɔ ɛwowɔ adwenle na bɛhile ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ dodo mɔɔ wɔ 
edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛnyia ye la ko biala anu.
2.  Ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo mɔ ɛwowɔ adwenle wɔ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne mɔɔ 
edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔ ko biala lɛ la anwo.
Ɔwɔ kɛ ekpunli ne fa ye nyelebɛnloa ne to gua na bɛwowɔ nwolɛ adwenle bɛkilehile 
nu.
Ɛnee abɛbɛ nee ngyigyilira le agɔnwolɛ kpalɛ. Emomu, bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ɛnee le ngakyile. 
Wɔ ewia mekɛ ne anu, ngyigyilira yɛle gyima ɛsesebɛ kpondɛle aleɛ ziele. Abɛbɛ

maanle ɔ nwo dɔle ye na ɔlile aleɛ ne mɔɔ ɔkpondɛle ɔziele wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɛhɔne 
ɛlɛku abɛbɛ na ɛbɔlɛ ɛhye ye wɔ ye sua ne anu la.

 Aneɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala fa ɛnelɛ ɛhakyihakyilɛ kile nganeɛdelɛ anzɛɛ maa ngilenu na bɛfa 
bɛdi gyima ngakyile dɔɔnwo. Saa awie ɛlɛtendɛ a, kɛ ɔ ne ne si kɔ anwuma anzɛɛ ba 
aze wɔ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ, edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ anzɛɛ ɛdendɛmunli nu la a yɛfɛlɛ ye ɛnelɛ a. Ɛnelɛ 
aneɛ a le aneɛ mɔɔ ɛnelɛ a fa edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ngakyile ne mɔ ngilenu ne ba la. Gana 
aneɛ ngakyile dɔɔnwo ne ala le ɛnelɛ aneɛ.
Ɛnelɛ ngakyile
Aneɛ ngakyile ne mɔ biala lɛ ɛnelɛ ngakyile. Ndonwo bie mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Gana aneɛ aneɛ 
ne mɔ anu la a le ɛhye: anwuma ɛnelɛ, aze ɛnelɛ, avinli ɛnelɛ nee mɔɔ ɛha la. Saa 
yeanyɛ boɛ a, Gana aneɛ ko biala lɛ ɛnelɛ ngakyile nwiɔ, bɛmɛ a le anwuma nee aze 
ɛnelɛ. Bie mɔ noko lɛ avinli ɛnelɛ ne boka nwiɔ ne anwo. Eza bie mɔ lɛ mɔɔ bo zɔ a. 
Ɛnelɛ ngakyile mɔɔ wɔ Gana aneɛ bie mɔ anu la a le ɛhye:
1. Aneɛ aneɛ mɔɔ lɛ ɛnelɛ ngakyile nwiɔ la (anwuma nee aze): Akane, Nzema, Ga, 
Kasem, Ewe nee mɔɔ ɛha la.
2. Aneɛ aneɛ mɔɔ lɛ ɛnelɛ ngakyile nsa la (anwuma, avinli nee aze): Dangme, Dagbani 
nee mɔɔ ɛha la.
Yɛfa sɛkɛlɛneɛ [`] yɛkile aze ɛnelɛ yɛɛ yɛfa [´] yɛkile anwuma ɛnelɛ. Ndonwo, 
edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ le kɛ [bɛlà], ɛnelɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔɔ la /a/ ne azo la kile kɛ ɔle aze ɛnelɛ 
yɛɛ wɔ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ [dá] anu sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔɔ la /a/ ne azo la kile kɛ ɔle anwuma 
ɛnelɛ.

Ɛnelɛ gyimalilɛ
Ɛnelɛ le debie mɔɔ anwo hyia kpalɛ wɔ ɛnelɛ aneɛ nu a, ɔlua ye gyima titili mɔɔ ɔdi la 
ati. Ɛnelɛ di gyima titili ngakyile nsa wɔ ɛnelɛ aneɛ nu. Ɛhye mɔ a le edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ 
ngakyile ɛbobɔlɛ, aneɛmɛla yɛɛ aneɛ ko ne ala ngakyile mɔ ɔlɛ la.
1. Ɛnelɛ di gyima wɔ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ɛbobɔlɛ nu: Yɛfa ɛnelɛ yɛkile ngilenu anzɛɛ 
ndelebɛbo ngakyile mɔɔ wɔ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ mɔɔ bɛ ɛhɛlɛlɛ le ko na bɛ ɛbobɔlɛ ɛnle 
ko wɔ aneɛ ne anu la. Nea ndonwo ne mɔɔ wɔ aze ɛke la na nea kɛ ɛnelɛ ne mɔɔ 
gugua zo la si fa ngakyile ne ba la.
a. áwúlé (aleɛ) yɛɛ áwùlè(mɔɔ wua la),
b. kùmà(abɛlɛ aleɛ) yɛɛ kúmá(mɔɔ bɛtu ye aze la)
c. Fòlɛ`(kenle) yɛɛ fólɛ`(nane)
2. Ɛnelɛ di aneɛmɛla gyima: Yɛfa ɛnelɛ mɔɔ wɔ aneɛ nu la yɛkile aneɛmɛla ekpunli 
duma ngakyile. Ndonwo a le:
a. Yɛkpɔkɛ: Y´ɛ gyima ne yɛɛ dumagya: Y`ɛ gyima ne.
b. Duma: Sùà ɛhendeɛ ne yɛɛ yɛkpɔkɛ: Súá ɛhendeɛ ne.
c. Kɛkalahilelɛ: Aya s`iè ezukoa yɛɛ ɛmianlɛ: Aya si´é ezukoa.
3. Aneɛ ko ne ala ngakyilehilelɛƐnelɛ eza kola kile ngakyile wɔ aneɛ ko ne ala anu. 
Ɛhye finde wɔ menli ekpunli ngakyile mɔɔ ka aneɛ ko ne ala la ɛdendɛlɛ nu. 
Ɛhye kile kɛ aneɛ ne bie kola nyia ye ngane ngane mɔɔ biala lɛ kɛ ɔsi ɔbobɔ ye 
edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔɔ le ngakyile ekyii fi ɔ gɔnwo ɛdeɛ nwo la. Ɛba Nzema a a 
menli ne bie ka kɛ yɛlɛ Dwɔmɔlɔ Nzema, Ɛlɛmgbɛlɛ Nzema, Ɛvaloɛ Nzema nee 
mɔɔ ɛha la ɔlua aneɛ ko ne ala anu edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ bie mɔ mɔɔ ekpunli ɛhye mɔ 
bobɔ bɛ ngakyile la ati.
Gyima 1�5 Ɛnelɛ subane ɛhilelɛ
1. Fa ɛ ti anwo edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ kile ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ anu. To wɔ nyelebɛnloa ne gua 
kile sukoavoma ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti.
2. Dua ndonwo mɔɔ fɛta la azo na kilehile ɛnelɛ ngakyile ne mɔ anu.
3. Wɔ bɛ ekpunli ne mɔ anu, bɛwowɔ adwenle bɛhile gyima mɔɔ ɛnelɛ di la. Bɛva 
bɛ nzuzulɛ ne bɛdo gua.
Gyima 1�6 Ɛnelɛhilelɛ gyima
Ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo ɛdie edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔ na bɛgyinla zo bɛyɛ mɔɔ wɔ aze ɛke la.
1. Bɛhile ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ holɛ mɔɔ wɔ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔ anu la. ɛsɛlɛ (desert)/ 
ɛsɛlɛ(to plead), ɛzɛne(funeral)/ɛzɛne(a pan or a saucepan).
2. Bɛhile ɛnelɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔɔ lɛ ɛnelɛ ne wɔ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔ anu la. Bɛdo 
bɛ nyelebɛnloa ne gua bɛhile sukoavoma ne kɔsɔɔti.

Ɛgengalɛ
MUKENYE
Ngyɛnu ɛhye wowɔ adwenle wɔ adwenle titili mɔɔ wɔ ɛgengadeɛ anzɛɛ adwelielilɛ 
nu la anwo. Ɛbazukoa debie wɔava ɛgengalɛ mɔɔ anu-mia nee ɛgengalɛ ndɛlɛnu 
anwo. Ɛbawowɔ adwenle wɔ ndenle mɔɔ anwo hyia na ɔbaboa amaa wɔade adwenle 
titili mɔɔ kɛlɛvo anzɛɛ tendɛvo bie lɛ la abo na wɔazukoa ndenle fɔɔnwo ne mɔ mɔɔ 
ɛbalua zo wɔala ye ali wɔahile tievoma la. Ngyɛnu ɛhye nee ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ngakyile 
mɔɔ le kɛ Nrelenza nee mɔɔ fale menli tɛnlabelɛ nwo nee aneɛ bie mɔ anwo noko la 
lɛ ngitanwolilɛ.
ADWENLE TITILI
Adwenle titili mɔɔ wɔ ɛgengadeɛ nu la a le bodane kpɔkyee ne mɔɔ ɛdendɛkpunli bie gyi 
zo la. Ɛhye bahola avea tidwɛkɛ ɛdendɛmunli ne anu na yeanyia ye boavolɛ mɔɔ maa 
nwolɛ ngilenu a. Ɛgengalɛ kola yɛ mɔɔ anu-mia anzɛɛ ndɛlɛnu.
• Ɛgengalɛ mɔɔ anu-mia la le ɛgengalɛ mɔɔ ɛto ɛ rɛle aze wɔava ɛgengadeɛ bie anu

Ɛgengalɛ ndɛlɛnu kile kɛ ɛkenga ɛgengadeɛ ngakyile dɔɔnwo amaa wɔanyia anyelielɛ,

kpalɛ, debie ɛgengalɛ yɛ wɔ subane, ɛ nye die ɛgengalɛ nwo na ɔmaa wɔ aneɛ ɛhanlɛ/
ɛdendɛlɛ di munli ɔluakɛ ɛkenga ɛgengadeɛ dɔɔnwo.

nyɛleɛ fɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ kengavo da ye ali wɔ ɛgengalɛ ne anu la.
Ɛgengadeɛ Ngyehyɛleɛ : Ɛhye kile kɛ kɛlɛvoma si siezie anzɛɛ nwo adwenle wɔ 
ɛgengadeɛ nu la. Ɛgengadeɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne ɛnwunlɛ kola boa maa bɛfa bɛ adwenle 
bɛsie kpɔkɛ titili bie azo na bɛkile mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔsi la. Ɛhye eza boa maa ɛfa ɛ nye ɛdi

Deɛnzinleanlɛ: Ɔkile adenle mɔɔ yɛdua zo yɛnea kɛ yɛ ɛgengalɛ ne si de la amaa yɛanyia

nzuzulɛ ɔlua ɛgengadeɛ ne anu ngyinlazo bie ati. Ɛhye kile kɛ ɛto ɛ rɛle aze wɔagenga

MUKENYE
Wɔ ngyɛnu ɛhye anu, ɛbazukoa mɔnukpɔkɛ anwo debie, ndenle bie mɔ mɔɔ yɛdua zo 
yɛnyia edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ fofolɛ, yɛɛ kɛ yɛsi yɛfa mgbɔkye mɔfeme yɛdi gyima wɔ Nzema 
aneɛ ne anu la. Adwenle mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye wɔ mgbɔkye mɔfeme nee mɔnukpɔkɛ gyimalilɛ 
nwo la baboa amaa wɔahɛlɛhɛlɛ ɛdendɛmunli mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la. Edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ fofolɛ 
ɛnyianlɛ ndenle bie mɔ mɔɔ yɛbawowɔ adwenle wɔ nwolɛ la a le ɛhye mɔ: mɔnwoyɛlɛ, 
bokanwoyɛlɛ, nyɛvolɛ-aneɛyɛlɛ nee ɛnelɛnveanuyɛlɛ.
ADWENLE TITILI
• Mgbɔkye mɔfeme a le edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ ne foa ne bie mɔɔ yɛfa yɛsua edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ 
la. Yɛlɛ mgbɔkye mɔfeme titili ngakyile nsa. Bɛmɛ a le: nzizo, nzɔzo nee nveanu 
mgbɔkye mɔfeme. Yɛfa mgbɔkye mɔfeme yɛsua edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ yɛmaa ɔnyia ngilenu 
anzɛɛ aneɛmɛla ekpunli duma fofolɛ.
• Yɛfa mɔnukpɔkɛ yɛkeha edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ, ɛdendɛsinli, yɛɛ adwenle ngakyile yɛbobɔ 
nu na yɛkola yɛkɛlɛhɛlɛ ɛdendɛmunli mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la.
• Mgbɔkye mɔfeme mɔɔ yɛfa yɛdi gyima wɔ aneɛ nu la le adenle ko mɔɔ yɛdua zo 
yɛnyia ɛdwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ fofolɛ a.
• Edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ɛnyianlɛ le debie mɔɔ maa adenle maa yɛfa aneɛmɛla ngyehyɛleɛ ne 
mɔɔ wɔ aneɛ ne anu la azo yɛnyia edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ fofolɛ a.
MGBƆKYE MƆFEME
Mgbɔkye mɔfeme abohilelɛ: Mgbɔkye mɔfeme a le mɔfeme mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsua ndinli 
mɔfeme na ɔlua zo yɛnyia edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ fofolɛ anzɛɛ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ mɔɔ wɔ aneɛmɛla 
ekpunli fofolɛ nu la. Yɛkola yɛkile mgbɔkye mɔfeme anu bieko kɛ, ɔle mɔfeme mɔɔ 
yɛfa yɛsɔ anzɛɛ yɛsi edwɛkɛpɔkɛ ndinli zo yɛnyia ndelebɛbo fofolɛ la.
Mgbɔkye mɔfeme mɔɔ yɛta yɛnwu bɛ la a le nzizo nee nzɔzo mɔfeme. Saa yɛfa mɔfeme 
yɛsua edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ bie ndinli a, ɔkakyi edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ ne na ɔkola ɔmaa ɔnyia ngilenu 
fofolɛ. Ɔkola ɔmaa yɛnyia edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ mɔɔ wɔ aneɛmɛla ekpunli gyɛne nu la.
Nzizo mɔfeme a le mgbɔkye mɔfeme mɔɔ yɛfa yɛsi ndinli/ninli mɔfeme zo la.
Nveanu mɔfeme a le mgbɔkye mɔfeme mɔɔ yɛfa yɛfea edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ (ndinli/ninli 
mɔfeme) nu la.

Nzɔzo mɔfeme a le mgbɔkye mɔfeme mɔɔ yɛfa yɛsɔ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ (ndinli/ninli) zo la.
Nzizo-nzɔzo mɔfeme a le mgbɔkye mɔfeme mɔɔ lɛ nzizo nee nzɔzo la. Yɛfa nzizo ne 
yɛsi ndinli/ninli ne azo na yɛava nzɔzo ne yeazɔ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ ne azo wɔ mekɛ ko ne 
ala anu, na ɔlua zo yɛanyia edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ fofolɛ. Ɛhye kile kɛ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ (ndinli/
ninli) ne fea avinli.
Mgbɔkye mɔfeme anwo ndonwo bie mɔ ɛne: a- . ɛlɛ-, m-, -le, -nle, -n-, -d-, n-lɛ, ɛ-lɛ.
Yɛfɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ mgbɔkye mɔfeme ɔluakɛ saa yɛfa yɛsuozua edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ngakyile 
a ɔmaa yɛnyia edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ mɔɔ lɛ ngilenu fofolɛ a. Ndonwo; edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ -baka 
kakyi yɛ mbaka wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛkɛva mgbɔkye mɔfeme m yɛkɛzi ndinli (baka) ne azo 
la. Ɛhye maa edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ ne kakyi fi baholɛ kɔyɛ dɔɔnwo.
Gyima 3�1 Kilehile deɛ holɛ mɔɔ mgbɔkye mɔfeme le la�
Kakyi ɛ nwo kɔ ahenle mɔɔ ɛ nee ye de bikye la anwo na kilehile mgbɔkye mɔfeme 
anu kile ye. Bɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɛbahilehile nu mɔɔ ɛnrɛnlea mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la azo a.
Mgbɔkye mɔfeme ngakyile: Mgbɔkye mɔfeme ngakyile titili nwiɔ ne mɔɔ Nzema lɛ 
la a le: agualeɛ mɔfeme nee adwulaleɛ mɔfeme.
Agualeɛ mɔfeme: Ɛhye mɔ a le mgbɔkye mɔfeme mɔɔ saa yɛfa yɛsuozua edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ 
a ɔmaa yɛnyia edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ fofolɛ mɔɔ bɛ ndelebɛbo ne le ngakyile la. Wɔ agualeɛ 
mgbɔkye mɔfeme gyimalilɛ nu, yɛkola yɛnyia edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ fofolɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee ndinli 
ne aneɛmɛla ekpunli duma ne yɛ ko anzɛɛ kola kakyi. Ɛhye kile kɛ, agualeɛ mɔfeme 
kola yɛ ekpunli-nu-walɛ anzɛɛ ɛkpunlihakyilɛ agualeɛ mɔfeme. Agualeɛ mgbɔkye 
mɔfeme maa yɛnyia edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ fofolɛ yɛfi ndinli mɔfeme ne anu. Ndonwo; 
edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ bɔ(ykp) kakyi kɔyɛ bɔvolɛ(duma)wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛva nzɔzo  –volɛ yɛzɔ 
bɔ- azo la. Wɔ ɛhye anu, yɛkola yɛka kɛ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ ‘bɔ’ aneɛmɛla ekpunli duma ne 
ɛhakyi ɛvi yɛkpɔkɛ ɛhɔyɛ duma.
Adwulaleɛ mgbɔkye mɔfeme:  Ɛhye a le mgbɔkye mɔfeme mɔɔ saa yɛfa yɛsua 
edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ a ɔkakyi edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ ne kɛ ɔsi ɔde la na emomu ɔngakyi edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ 
ne aneɛmɛla ekpunli duma ne mɔɔ ɔvi nu la. Saa adwulaleɛ nzɔzo mɔfeme zɔ 
edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ zo a ɔngakyi edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ ne ndelebɛbo ne ɔmmaa ɔmminli kolaa a, 
ɔti ɔmmaa yɛnnyia edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ fofolɛ anzɛɛ ngakyile. Saa adwulaleɛ mgbɔkye 
mɔfeme zua edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ a ɔkola ɔkile edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ ne dodo (dɔɔnwoyɛlɛ), nyinli 
anzɛɛ belɛ, yɛkpɔkɛ ndɛlɛnu nee mɔɔ ɛha la. Ɛhye kile kɛ, saa yɛfa adwulaleɛ nzɔzo 
anzɛɛ nzizo mɔfeme yɛsua edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ bie baholɛ a ɔkola ɔmaa ɔkakyi na ɔkile ye 
dɔɔnwoyɛlɛ. Ndonwo; saa yɛfa nzizo m- yɛsi edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ boane azo a ɔmaa yɛnyia 
edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ mboane mɔɔ kile ye dɔɔnwoyɛlɛ a. Ɛke, edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ boane nee mboane 
ɛnle edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ mɔɔ lɛ ngakile kpaziwɔkɛ biala mɔɔ kile kɛ biala vi aneɛmɛla 
ekpunli duma fofolɛ nu a anzɛɛ bɛ ngilenu ne le ngakyile kolaa a.

Kɛlɛhɛlɛ mɔnukpɔkɛ ngakyile ne mɔ ko biala anwo ndonwo nsa na fa bɛ wulowula 
ɛdendɛmunli nu. Boɔboa ɛ nwo kɛ ɛbava wɔ ɛdendɛmunli ne mɔ wɔado ɛ gɔnwo

Nvasoɛ mɔɔ wɔ mɔnukpɔkɛ gyimalilɛ zo la
Mɔnukpɔkɛ gyima mɔɔ ɔdi la le ngakyile wɔ aneɛ ko biala anu, bie mɔ a le:
• Ɔkilehile deɛmɔti anzɛɛ bɛda bodane ali.
• Ɔkeha ɛdendɛfoa anzɛɛ ɛdendɛsinli mɔɔ bɔ atipɛne la ɔbobɔ nu.
• Ɔka adwenle mɔɔ kile kyɛkyɛhanlɛ la ɔbɔ nu.
• Yɛfa yɛkile adwenle mɔɔ ko tia bɛ nwo la.
• Yɛfa yɛkile nzidwɛkɛ bie guabelɛ.
Mɔnukpɔkɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkɛlɛhɛlɛ ɛdendɛmunli la
Mɛla ngyikyi beta kɛ yɛsi yɛfa mɔnukpɔkɛ yɛdi gyima la anwo. Saa yɛfa mɛla ɛhye mɔ 
yɛdi gyima a ɔbaboa amaa yɛ ngɛlɛhɛlɛlɛ ali munli.
• Yɛdua mɔnukpɔkɛ zo yɛkeha yɛ nyɛleɛ nee adwenle mɔɔ yɛlɛ bɛ la yɛbobɔ nu. 
Ɛhye ati ɔwɔ kɛ yɛfa mɔnukpɔkɛ fɔɔnwo yɛdi gyima amaa yeaboa wɔ adenle ɛhye 
azo.
• Mɔnukpɔkɛ boa wɔ ninyɛne ɛbobɔlɛ nu.
• Saa ɛlɛfa mɔnukpɔkɛ wɔali gyima a, nea kɛ ngitanwolilɛ fɔɔnwo la wɔ ɛdendɛmunli 
ne mɔ ngyehyɛnu ne avinli.

MUKENYE
Wɔ ngyɛnu ɛhye anu, ɛbazukoa aneɛmɛla mɔɔ le kɛ ɛdendɛsinli, ɛdendɛfoa yɛɛ ɛhɛlɛlɛ 
sɛkɛlɛneɛ anwo debie. Ɛbazukoa ɛdendɛsinli nee ɛdendɛfoa ngakyile ne mɔ yɛɛ 
ngyehyɛleɛ mɔɔ wɔ ko biala anwo la. Adwenle mɔɔ wɔ aneɛmɛla nvɛyebanvɛyeba 
ɛhye mɔ anwo la baboa amaa wɔahɛlɛ ɛdendɛmunli nee ngɛlɛhɛlɛ kpomgbondee mɔɔ 
le fɔɔnwo la. Ɛhye eza bamaa wɔade ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ngakyile mɔɔ le kɛ Nrelenza la abo.
ADWENLE TITILI
• Ɛdendɛsinli a le edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ anzɛɛ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ekpunli mɔɔ bɔ nu di ɔ ti 
anwo gyima wɔ aneɛ ne anu la. Ɛdendɛsinli kola nyia ye ngakyile mɔɔ le kɛ: duma 
ɛdendɛsinli, yɛkpɔkɛ ɛdendɛsinli, dumangilenu ɛdendɛsinli, ɛlekakpɔkɛ ɛdendɛsinli 
yɛɛ yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ɛdendɛsinli.
• Ɛdendɛfoa a le edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ekpunli mɔɔ ndelebɛbo wɔ nu na ɔkola ɔyɛ gyima kɛ 
ɛdendɛmunli la. Ɔlɛ yɛvo nee ngilenukpɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔfa ɔyɛ ɛdendɛmunli ne anzɛɛ ɔle 
ɛdendɛmunli ne ngyɛnu ne bie a.
• Wɔ aneɛ ɛhɛlɛlɛ nu, sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ boa maa ndelebɛbo/ngilenu bie anye da ɛkɛ 
ne wienyi la a bɛfɛlɛ ye ɛhɛlɛlɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ a. Ɛhye mɔ bie a le: gyinla sɛkɛlɛneɛ, 
ngilenukyi sɛkɛlɛneɛ, ɛzinzelɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ, ngilenu sɛkɛlɛneɛ yɛɛ ndeanu sɛkɛlɛneɛ.
ƐDENDƐSINLI
Ndwenlenwo kpuyia: Da wɔ adwenle mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye wɔ ɛdendɛsinli anwo la ali kile ɛ 
gɔnwo sukoavo ne wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ wɔnlea vidio ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛdendɛsinli nwo wɔwie la 
https://youtu.be/P5_OB5oKwxM. Fa mɔɔ ɛnwunle ye la toto ekpunli ne mɔɔ ɛwɔ nu 
la ɛdeɛ ne anwo.
Ɛdendɛsinli a le edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ anzɛɛ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ekpunli mɔɔ lɛ ndelebɛbo wɔ 
ɛdendɛmunli nu la.  Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛdendɛsinli biala nyia edwɛkpɔkɛ titili na eza ɔyɛ mɔɔ 
ndelebɛbo wɔ nu a. Edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ titili ne a anwo hyia kpalɛ wɔ ɛdendɛsinli ne anu a 
yɛɛ yemɔ a ɛdendɛsinli ne dua zo nyia ye duma a. Saa edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ titili ne le duma 
a, ɔmaa yɛnyia duma ɛdendɛsinli, saa yɛkpɔkɛ a, yɛnyia yɛkpɔkɛ ɛdendɛsinli. Ndonwo 
bie mɔ a le ɛhye; tɛladeɛ, bɛlɛra ne, ahunyele, kakula ne.
Ɛdendɛsinli ngakyile
Ɛdendɛsinli ngakyile nnu ne mɔ a le: duma ɛdendɛsinli, yɛkpɔkɛ ɛdendɛsinli, 
dumangilenu ɛdendɛsinli, yɛkpɔkɛngilenu ɛdendɛsinli, yɛɛ ɛlekakpɔkɛ ɛdendɛsinli.

Ɛhye le ɛdendɛsinli mɔɔ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ titili ne mɔɔ wɔ nu la le duma anzɛɛ dumagya 
la. Ngyehyɛleɛ mɔɔ duma ɛdendɛsinli (Dm ɛds) lɛ la kakyihakyi.
Duma ɛdendɛsinli kola yɛ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ ko kye mɔɔ le duma anzɛɛ dumagya la. 
Ɛdendɛsinli ɛhye da duma ko anzɛɛ dumagya ko ala ali. Ndonwo; Edobo, bɛ.

Duma ɛdendɛsinli ngilenu: Duma ɛdendɛsinli kola nyia edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ bie mɔ

ngilenu. Ngilenu ne mɔɔ a le edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ, ɛdendɛsinli anzɛɛ ɛdendɛfoa mɔɔ bɛka 
edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo bɛfa edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ titili ne anwo la. Ngilenu mɔɔ di moa ba kolaa na 
edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ titili ne ara la le nzizo ngilenu. Mɔɔ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ titili ne ba kolaa na 
yeadoa ye la le nzɔzo ngilenu.

Kenle mɔɔ yɛhɔle ɛnweazo lɔ la
Ɛkenle dapɛne ne awieleɛ, me nee me gɔnwo mɔ bɔle kpɔkɛ kɛ yɛkali kenle ne wɔ 
ɛnweazo lɔ. Ɛnee ɔle nwonlomɔ mɔɔ ɛnee ewia ne ɛlɛbɔ na maanlenu le kɛlɛma 
maa fealeranu nwɔhoa bie mɔ a. Nwonlomɔ mangyee ne ala, yɛvale yɛ aleɛ mɔɔ 
anu ɛnyɛ ɛnlomboɛ nee ɛnlondeɛ yɛguale yɛ baage ne anu yɛmaanle ɔyile na 
yɛhɔle ɛnweazo lɔ. Anwoma kɛlɛma ne mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛbɔ fi nyevile ne anu la maanle 
adendulɛ ne yɛle anyelielɛ.
Mekɛ mɔɔ yɛdwule la, yɛkpondɛle anwodɔlɛ ɛleka wɔ arɛlɛ baka bie abo. Yɛzɛle 
yɛ tohulu ne mɔ wɔ anwea wuluwulu ne anu na yɛdɛnlanle aze. Mbɛda ne mɔ 
ɛnee ɛlɛdi nwɔhoa wɔ nzule ne anwo yɛɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛweɛ azɛlɛkye ne anu la 
maanle ɔhwenle yɛ kɛ yɛkɛva yɛ nwo yɛkɛwula nwɔhoa ne anu. Mekɛ hɔle bie la, 
yɛwuluwulule yɛguale nzule weɛlɛkɔkɔ ne anu yɛbolole bie anyelielɛ nu.
Ɔdwule ewiazo la, yɛbɔle kpɔkɛ kɛ yɛdie yɛ ɛnwomenle na yɛali aleɛ nee mbakamra 
mɔɔ wɔ yɛ baage ne anu la bie. Sɛlɛkye ne mɔɔ bu gua awolɛ ne mɔɔ bikye yɛ azo 
la alɛra bɛtɛɛ ne mɔɔ ɔyɛ la ɛnee yɛ fɛ. Yɛvale mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɛha wɔ ewia ne la
