ƐDENDƐSINLI/ƐDENDƐFOA NGYEHYƐLEƐ NEE ƐHƐLƐLƐ SƐKƐLƐNEƐ
Bango NwiɔNGYƐNU  5
ANEƐ NEE YE GYIMALILƐ
Nwobiehanlɛ, Aneɛbohilelɛ nee Aneɛhakyilɛ
MUKENYE
Ngyɛnu ɛhye fa sukoavoma ne wolo nwobiehanlɛ nee aneɛhakyilɛ ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ne 
anu. Wɔ nwobiehanlɛ ngyɛnu ɛdeɛ ne anu, ɛbanleɛnlea nwobiehanlɛ ngakyile ne mɔ 
nee kɛ bɛsi bɛkɛlɛ bɛ la. Nwobie nwiɔ ne mɔɔ ngyɛnu ɛhye baha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la a 
le, nwobie mɔɔ lɛ ngyehyɛleɛ titili fɔɔnwo nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ngyehyɛleɛ titili fɔɔnwo la. 
Ɛbanyia adwenle nee sukoanyia mɔɔ bamaa wɔahile na wɔahɛlɛ nwobie ngakyile ne 
mɔ la. Ngyɛnu ne eza bawowɔ adwenle wɔ kɛ bɛsi bɛkakyi adawu bɛfi aneɛ ko anu 
bɛkɔ aneɛ gyɛne nu la anwo. Aneɛhakyilɛ ndenle ngakyile ne mɔ mɔɔ le kɛ, mɔɔ gyi 
edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ zo la, mɔɔ gyi ngilenu mumua ne azo la, mɔɔ ɛnva mɛla kyengye zo 
la nee mɔɔ bokɛboka nwo la anwo adwenle ɛwowɔlɛ noko bahɔ zolɛ wɔ ɛke. Ɛbanyia 
adwenle nee sukoanyia mɔɔ bamaa wɔanwu aneɛhakyilɛ ndenle ngakyile ne mɔ na 
wɔahola wɔahakyi ɛgengadeɛ wɔavi aneɛ ko anu wɔahɔ gyɛne nu.
ADWENLE TITILI
• Bɛkɛlɛ gyimanu kɛlata (kɛlata kpalɛ) bɛkɔ gyima nu.
• Bɛkɛlɛ agɔnwolɛ kɛlata bɛmaa busuanli, agɔnwolɛ anzɛɛ awie mɔɔ bɛze ye ala la.
• Nwobiehanlɛ kile kɛ kɛlɛvo si nwo ye adwenle wɔ ɛhɛlɛlɛ nu la.
• Baguanu ɛdendɛlɛ kile adwenle anzɛɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ awie dua ɛhɛlɛlɛ adenle zo yeala 
ye ali la.
• Aneɛhakyilɛ kile ngilenu mɔɔ wɔ aneɛ ko anu mɔɔ bɛkakyi ye bahɔ aneɛ gyɛne nu la.
NWOBIEHANLƐ
Nwobiehanlɛ kile adenle mɔɔ kɛlɛvo bie dua zo nwo adwenle wɔ ɛhɛlɛlɛ nu la. 
Nwobiehanlɛ ngakyile nna ne mɔɔ bɛliele bɛdole nu wɔ ɛvolɛ apenle ko ɛya-ngɔnla 
ne anu la a le kɛside, kolakoladulɛ, debienuhilelɛ/Adwenlebɔlɛ yɛɛ kpolerazulɛ. 
Nwobiehanlɛ mɔɔ di munli biala la kola fa ngyehyɛleɛ mɔɔ wɔ ngɛlɛhɛlɛ ɛhye mɔ 
kɔsɔɔti anwo la di gyima.
Nwobie ngakyile
Yɛlɛ nwobie titili ngakyile nna. Ɛhye mɔ a le, kɛside, kolakoladulɛ, debienuhilelɛ/
adwenlebɔlɛ, yɛɛ kpolerazulɛ nwobie.
49
ƐDENDƐSINLI/ƐDENDƐFOA NGYEHYƐLEƐ NEE ƐHƐLƐLƐ SƐKƐLƐNEƐ
Bango NwiɔNGYƐNU  5
Kɛside nwobie
Ɛhye maa sukoavoma kile kɛ deɛ bie si de la – debie, sonla, ɛleka, sukoanwu, 
nganeɛdelɛ, gyinlabelɛ, nzidwɛkɛ, nee mɔɔ ɛha la. Ndonwo; ɛkɛlɛ nwobie wɔava wɔ 
abusua ne anzɛɛ wɔ suazo anwo la le kɛside nwobie. Ndonwo a wɔ aze ɛke la.
Me abusua ne mɔɔ wɔ suanu la
Me abusua ne wɔ sua ekyi bie anu. Ɔle sikalɛ na eza ɔle kɛlɛma. Ɔlɛ suanzi ɛya (tola) 
koatee bie. Mekulo suanzi ɛya ne anu gyima ɛyɛlɛ na me diema raalɛ ne ɛngulo. Ɔkulo 
ɛgengalɛ. Ɔkenga nwonlomɔ, ewiazo, nee nɔɔzo.
Mefa aleɛmra ne kɔsɔɔti memaa me nli nee me ze. Bɛkulo aleɛ ɛdonlɛ wɔ yɛ egyade ekyi ne 
anu. Medi aleɛmra biala, noko me diema raalɛ ne di ekyii bie.
Me abusua ne bɔ nu di nwonlomɔ nee nɔsolɛ nu aleɛ. Yɛtendɛ, yɛsele yɛɛ me diema raalɛ 
ne kpuda ngyɛnze ne mɔ.
Nɔɔzo/nɔsolɛ nu, me ze kulo kɛ ɔkɛdie edwɛne. Me nli di gyima wɔ kɔmputa ne azo. Menea 
yekile ne (tiivi) yɛɛ me diema raalɛ ne kenga.
Ɔngyɛ na yɛala. Me awovolɛ ne mɔ ɛnla ndɛ na me nee me diema raalɛ ne mɔɔ yɛda ndɛ. 
Menyia nwo kɛ mekala na me diema raalɛ ne kpondɛ kɛ ɔkɔ zo ɔkenga.
Kolakoladulɛ nwobie
Nwobie ɛhye le adawu mɔɔ fale awie sukoanwu mɔɔ ɔlɛ na yehɛlɛ yeva nwo la. Ɔdua 
adawubɔlɛ adenle zo a ɔ nee sukoavoma ne di ngitanwo a. Ndonwo, nwobiehanlɛ mɔɔ 
fale wɔ kenle mɔɔ li moa wɔ wɔ sukulu ne mɔɔ ɛkɔ ye kɛkala anu anzɛɛ nzidwɛkɛ bie anwo 
la le kolakoladulɛ nwobie. Wɔ ɛhye anu, ɛda sukoanwu mɔɔ wɔnyia ye sukulu ne anu 
anzɛɛ nzidwɛkɛ ne anwo la ali.
Debienuhilelɛ/Adwenlebɔlɛ nwobie
Nwobie ɛhye hyia nvefenuyɛlɛ mɔɔ anu mia, ɔle fɔɔnwo yɛɛ ɔkile edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɔ zo 
mɔɔ ɛvinde wɔ adwenlekpɔkɛ ne anwo la, na ɔneɛnlea daselɛ anzɛɛ adwenlehilelɛ 
ngakyile mɔɔ zua ye la. Nwobie ɛhye maa kɛlɛvo ne neɛnlea adwenle ngakyile mɔɔ 
wɔ tidwɛkɛ bie anwo na ɔka ye kɛ mɔɔ ɔde la. Ɔda adwenle kpɔkɛ mɔɔ nwobie ne lɛ 
la anwo edwɛkɛ ali. Ndonwo; nwobie mɔɔ fale Gana fanwodi ɛlielɛ ne anwo la; kɛlɛvo ne 
bahile tetedwɛkɛ mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ wɔ kenle ne mɔɔ bɛliele fanwodi ne la, menli titili mɔɔ 
gyinlanle liele fanwodi ne, maanle ne ɛbulɛ wɔ fanwodi ɛlielɛ ne anzi nee mɔɔ ɛha la.
Kpolerazulɛ nwobie
Nwobie ɛhye maa sukoavoma ne yɛ nvefenu wɔ adwenle bie anwo, neɛnlea daselɛ 
mɔɔ zua ye na bɛdua mɔɔ bɛnwu ye la azo bɛsi gyinla mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la. Ndonwo; 
mraalɛ mɔɔ bɛ dibelɛ/gyinlabelɛ wɔ anwuma wɔ maanle ye gyimayɛlɛ nleka ne mɔ la lɛ 
abotane tɛla mrenyia ne mɔ mɔɔ lɛ dibelɛ/gyinlabelɛ ko ne ala la. Wɔ ɛhye anwo, ɔbahyia 
kɛ sukoavo ne bala ye adwenle nee nzuzulɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛ la ali na yeagyinla mɔɔ bɛdie bɛto 
nu la azo yeahilehile nu. Mɔɔ bɛyɛ ɛhye la, bɛka bɛfua zo anzɛɛ bɛka bɛtia tidwɛkɛ ne.

ƐDENDƐSINLI/ƐDENDƐFOA NGYEHYƐLEƐ NEE ƐHƐLƐLƐ SƐKƐLƐNEƐ
Bango NwiɔNGYƐNU  5
Kpolerazulɛ nwobie anwo tidwɛkɛ ndonwo bieko a le ɛhye mɔ:
1. Kile maa yɛnwu mɔɔ anwo hyia kpole kpalɛ la. Kilehilevolɛ anzɛɛ Dɔketa.
2. Ɛyasovo nee engyinia boni a anwo hyia kpalɛ wɔ maanle ne anu a?
3. Sukulu mɔɔ bɛda ɛkɛ yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛnla ɛkɛ ne la anu boni a ɛkulo a.? Kilehile deɛmɔti.
4. Ɛhye mɔ boni a ɛkulo a? Sukulu mɔɔ mraalɛ anzɛɛ mrenyia ngome kɔ anzɛɛ mɔɔ 
mrenyia nee mraalɛ fonla nu kɔ la?
Ngyehyɛleɛ mɔɔ nwobie lɛ la
Nwobie lɛ ngyehyɛleɛ (ngyɛnu) nsa. Bɛmɛ a le, mukenye, edwɛkɛ mumua ne, yɛɛ 
adwulaleɛ.
Mukenye
Ɛhye le mɔlebɛbo mɔɔ twe adwenle. Ngyɛnu ɛhye da wɔ tidwɛkɛ ne nee adwenlekpɔkɛ 
ne ali. Fa edwɛkɛmiza, daselɛ, anzɛɛ edwɛkɛhanlɛ mɔɔ twe menli adwenle la bɔ ɔ bo. 
Wɔ ɛke, ɔwɔ kɛ ɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo nee mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ kengavoma nwu ye la.
Edwɛkɛ mumua ne ɛdendɛkpunli ne mɔ
Ngyɛnu ɛhye da nvedenvedenu mɔɔ anu pi, kolakoladulɛ, adwenlehilehilelɛ nee mɔɔ 
bokɛboka ye la ali. Wɔ ɛke, ɛda wɔ tidwɛkɛ ɛdendɛmunli ne, kpolerazulɛ tidwɛkɛ ne 
mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la ali, na ɛfa ngilenu mɔɔ le daselɛ la ɛsua wɔ adwenlekpɔkɛ ne mɔɔ 
ɛlɛkile la nee mɔɔ bokɛboka ye la. Ɛhye mɔ bahola ayɛ edwɛkɛ mumua ne ngyɛnu ne 
mɔɔ kpolerazulɛ nwobie lɛ la.
1. Kile ɛdendɛmunli mɔɔ maa ɛdendɛkpunli ngakyile ne mɔ nyia ngitanwo la.
2. Kile tidwɛkɛ bieko mɔɔ fale adwenlekpɔkɛ mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ la na fa ngilenu mɔɔ le 
daselɛ la sua ɔ nzi.
3. Fa ɛdendɛmunli bieko mɔɔ bamaa ɔ nee ɛdendɛkpunli ne mɔɔ ɔdoa ye la anyia 
ngitanwo la.
4. Kile tidwɛkɛ ɛdendɛmunli mɔɔ ko tia adwenlekpɔkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛsu nwolɛ kpolera 
ne la.
5. Kilehile nu, fa nwolɛ daselɛ sua ɔ nzi na die to nu kɛ ɔle nɔhalɛ kofee.
6. Mmadie mɔɔ ko tia wɔ adwenlekpɔkɛ ne la ɛto nu na akee dwula wɔ nwobie ne
Adwulaleɛ
Adwulaleɛ ne a le ngyɛnu ne mɔɔ kɛlɛvo ne bobɔ ye adwenlekpɔkɛ ne mɔ agbɔkɛ la. 
Ɛhye mɔ le ndenle mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛkɛlɛ adwulaleɛ a.
1. Pɛ wɔ adwenle titili ne mɔ sikalɛ.
2. Sia kile wɔ gyinlabelɛ ne.
3. Maa adwulaleɛ ɛdendɛmunli.

ƐDENDƐSINLI/ƐDENDƐFOA NGYEHYƐLEƐ NEE ƐHƐLƐLƐ SƐKƐLƐNEƐ
Bango NwiɔNGYƐNU  5
Gyima 5�1 Kpolerazulɛ nwobie
1. Fa ɛ ti anwo edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ kile kpolerazulɛ nwobie anu na kilehile subane 
mɔɔ ɔlɛ la anu.
2. Dwenle adwenle bie mɔɔ wɔwowɔ anzɛɛ kpolera bie mɔɔ wɔzu wɔ wɔ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ 
nu la anwo. Duzu a ɛnee ɔfa nwolɛ a? Duzu agbɔkɛ a ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ ɛfa ɛ nye ɛto 
a? Bɛzɔle ɔ nloa bɔkɔɔ ɔ?
Gyima 5�2 Yɛkile
Ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo ɛyɛ kpolerazulɛ yɛkile mɔɔ bɛ nuhua ko gyi tidwɛkɛ ne anzi yɛɛ ko 
ne ko tia ye wɔ tidwɛkɛ ɛhye “Mekɛ mɔɔ yɛ nee yɛ gɔnwo mɔ nee yɛ abusua ne di 
la anwo hyia kpalɛ tɛla ɛzukoalɛ” anwo.
Gyima 5�3 Nwobie ɛhɛlɛlɛ
1. Sukoavoma mɔɔ da nwomazukoalɛ ɛleka ne la bɔ mɔdenle wɔ nwomazukoalɛ nu 
tɛla mɔɔ bɛda bɛ azua nu la. Fa edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ 350 kɛlɛ kpolerazulɛ nwobie wɔ 
tidwɛkɛ ɛhye anwo. Da wɔ gyinlabelɛ ne ali kile sukoavoma ne kɔsɔɔti.
2. Wɔ bɛ ekpunli nu, bɛwowɔ adwenle bɛhile, saa ɔwɔ kɛ bɛtua agudeɛ ɛdulɛ 
mɔɔ bɛtu kuma la a. Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛnea ngyegyelɛ mɔɔ gyinlazilɛ ɛhye bava arɛlɛ 
yɛ wɔ ezukoa, ezuavolɛ ne ɛdɛnlalɛ nu nee nyambɔyia ne la. Akee bɛgyinla bɛ 
nzuzulɛ ne azo bɛhɛlɛ nwobie mɔɔ lɛ ɛdendɛkpunli nsa la. Bɛva bɛ nwobie ne 
bɛdo gua bɛmaa bɛdo ye tone nu na bɛbizebiza nwolɛ kpuyia.
Gyima 5�4 Mualɛ
Saa ɛlɛtie adwenle mɔɔ ekpunli gyɛne ne mɔ ɛlɛda ye ali la a anrɛɛ nea edwɛkɛmiza 
ɛhye mɔ:
1. Kɛ tidwɛkɛ ne si boa daselɛ ne gyimalilɛ nee adwenle mɔɔ wɔ nwobie ne anu 
la ɛ?
2. Neɛnlea kɛ tendɛvo/kɛlɛvo ne si sɔ adwenle mɔɔ kola ko tia ye adwenle wɔ 
kpolerazulɛ ne anu anloa la. Ɔdi munli ɔ? Duzu ati a ɔdi munli anzɛɛ ɔnli munli 
a?
3. Sinlidɔlɛ anzɛɛ nzisi (nyeyenu) bie mɔ boni a wɔ tendɛvo/kɛlɛvo ne adwenlekpɔkɛ 
ne anu a?
4. Kɛ ɛhye mɔ si ko tia nwobie ne munlililɛ mumua ne ɛ?
5. Kɛ tendɛvo/kɛlɛvo ne ane ne si boa wɔ adwenlelilɛ nu ɛ?

BAGUANU ƐDENDƐLƐ NEE ADWELIE 
KƐLATA ƐHƐLƐLƐ
Baguanu ɛdendɛlɛ ɛhɛlɛlɛ nee adwelie kɛlata abo-
hilelɛ
Baguanu ɛdendɛlɛ ɛhɛlɛlɛ
Baguanu ɛdendɛlɛ ɛhɛlɛlɛ le adenle mɔɔ yɛdua aneɛ nee ɛhɛlɛlɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ fɔɔnwo 
zo yɛto nrɛlaleɛ yɛmaa kengavolɛ la. Baguanu ɛdendɛlɛ ɛhɛlɛlɛ ɛnle debie mɔɔ nee 
kolakoladulɛ nwobie lɛ ngakyile titili bie a.
Adwelie kɛlata
Ɛhye le ngɛlɛhɛlɛ ne mɔ ko mɔɔ bɛdua adwelie ngɛlata ne azo bɛto nrɛlaleɛ bɛmaa 
menli dɔɔnwo la. Wɔ adwelie kɛlata nu, nolobɔlɛ ne da ali wɔ adwelielilɛ nee nolobɔlɛ 
ngɛlata ne mɔ anu.
Adenle mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛkɛlɛ baguanu ɛdendɛlɛ la
Saa ɛnwu menli mɔɔ ɛto nrɛlaleɛ ne wɔamaa bɛ, tidwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ ɛto nwolɛ nrɛlaleɛ 
ne, ninyɛne mɔɔ baboa amaa wɔado nrɛlaleɛ ne la na ɛbobɔ bɛ agbɔkɛ agbɔkɛ ɛwie a, 
ɛnee yedwu mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛlɛ wɔ baguanu ɛdendɛlɛ ne a.
Baguanu ɛdendɛlɛ ngyehyɛnu (ngyehyɛleɛ) ne
Ɔwɔ kɛ baguanu ɛdendɛlɛ ne nyia ngyɛnu nna ɛhye;
1. Ɛvɛlɛlɛ/Ahyebizalɛ: Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛdi moa ɛbiza menli mɔɔ ɛto nrɛlaleɛ ne wɔamaa bɛ 
la ahye na ɛda ɛ nwo ali ɛkile bɛ. Die bɛ wɔ anyelielɛ adenle zo. Ndonwo bie a le; 
Me gɔnwo mɔ, Mediema Ganama, Yɛmenle mɔ, Nana mɔ nee mɔɔ ɛha la.
2. Mukenye: Wɔ mukenye ne anu, ɛda tidwɛkɛ anzɛɛ deɛ ne mɔɔ ɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ 
la ali ɛkile menli mɔɔ ɛto nrɛlaleɛ ne wɔamaa bɛ la. Ndonwo, Mera bɛ azokoɛleɛ ɛke 
ewia ye kɛ mebaha mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zo wɔ yɛ konle ne mɔɔ yɛlɛko yɛatia ninyɛndane mɔɔ kɔ 
zo wɔ yɛ azua ne mɔ azo la anwo edwɛkɛ meahile bɛ.
3. Baguanu ɛdendɛlɛ mumua ne: Wɔ ɛke, ɔwɔ kɛ ɛnwu mɔɔ ɛbaha wɔava tidwɛkɛ 
ne anwo la kɔsɔɔti. Ɛke a le ɛleka mɔɔ ɛka debie biala mɔɔ fale adwenlekpɔkɛ ne 
anwo a.
4. Adwulaleɛ: Wɔ adwulaleɛ ne anu, bɔ mɔdenle kɛ dahuu ɛkɛmaa wɔ tievoma 
ne kɛha ɛzinzelɛ nu. Ɔwɔ kɛ mekɛ biala bɛnyia debie bɛdwenledwenle nwolɛ. 
Ndonwo, Meha mɔdenle mɔɔ wɔbɔ nee wɔ maanle gyima mɔɔ ɛlɛdi wɔaboa amaa yɛazɔ 
ebunlu ewule ne mɔɔ ɛlɛkponde ndɛndɛ zo wɔ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo la anloa la. Ɔle 
yɛ anyelazo kɛ maanlema kɔsɔɔti kɛva bɛ nwo kɛwula konle ne mɔɔ yɛlɛko kɛ yɛkɛdu 
ebunlu ewule ne abo wɔ yɛ azua ne mɔ azo la anu.

Ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo ɛnleɛnlea ngyehyɛleɛ mɔɔ baguanu ɛdendɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ aze ɛke lɛ

na bɛwowɔ nwolɛ adwenle.
Mediema kilehilevolɛma nee Agɔnwolɛma, Aranenu Mgbanyinli nee Nana mɔ.

na ɛhye yɛ ɛzulolɛ maa yɛ kpɔkɛdelɛ.Yɛ nwonane nu ɛkpundikpundilɛ ɛnle kɛ ɔyɛ 
mɔɔ anu yɛ se kolaa na yeaboa yɛ kpɔkɛdelɛ a. Yɛkola yɛyɛ ɛhye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛyɛ 
ngyehyɛleɛ mɔɔ bamaa yɛakpundikpundi yɛ agbɔkɛ nu dahuu biala a. Menli ta ka kɛ 
mɔlebɛbo ne a yɛ se a. Zɔhane ati, agɔnwolɛma, bɛbɔ ɔ bo ɛnɛ na bɛmmakpo aze.

ƐDENDƐSINLI/ƐDENDƐFOA NGYEHYƐLEƐ NEE ƐHƐLƐLƐ SƐKƐLƐNEƐ
Bango NwiɔNGYƐNU  5
la maa ɔnyia adiabo wɔ aneɛzukoalɛ nu na ɔboa ɔmaa ɔsukoa aneɛ fofolɛ ɔboka nwolɛ 
na ɔte ninyɛne kpomgbondee bie mɔ abo mɔɔ ɔnvɛ fee a.
Bieko, awie aneɛ mɔɔ ɔka la maa ɔte ye maandeɛ agyadeɛ ne abo kpalɛ na ɔyɛ ɔdaye 
mumua ne nzonlɛ. Aneɛ nee maandeɛ a tu a, zɔhane ati, saa sukoavoma kola fa bɛ 
aneɛ ne di ngitanwo a ɔmaa bɛnwu bɛ nzi adenle na bɛkile anyenzɔlɛ wɔ bɛ maandeɛ 
ne anwo.
Mɔɔ boka ye la a le, debiezukoalɛ da ye ali kɛ, sukoavoma mɔɔ anloa ɛde wɔ bɛ aneɛ ne 
ɛhanlɛ nu la adwenle nu buke na ɔmaa bɛnyia fasie, ngyegyelɛ nloa sɔbelɛ na bɛdwenle 
bɛkɔ moa. Ɔboalekɛ, aneɛ ne mɔɔ ahenle ka la anu a ɔkola ɔbɔ adwenle, ɔdi adwelie 
mɔɔ ɔle fɔɔnwo na ɔbɔ kpɔkɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia la a.
Adwulaleɛ, ɔhyia kɛ ɛkɛva wɔ aneɛ mɔɔ ɛka la ɛkɛli gyima amaa wɔali konim wɔ 
nwomazukoalɛ nu, wɔahola wɔahile wɔ maandeɛ ne na wɔanyi wɔ adwenlenu. Kɛmɔ 
bɛle sukunwiɔ nu sukoavoma la, ɔhyia kɛ bɛkɛlie bɛ aneɛ ne mɔɔ bɛka la bɛkɛdo nu, 
bɔbɔ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛsukoa aneɛ ngakyile na eza bɛlɛbɔ adenle wɔ gyinlabelɛ mɔɔ 
bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛnyia ye wɔ nwomazukoalɛ nu la.
Gyima 5�8 Adwelie kɛlata/Baguanu ɛdendɛlɛ nwobie
Wɔ bɛ ekpunli ne mɔ anu, bɛhɛlɛ adwelie kɛlata anzɛɛ baguanu ɛdendɛlɛ wɔ 
tidwɛkɛ ɛhye anwo: Anyuhɔlɛ mɔɔ wɔ me sukulu ɛkɛ ne la. Bɛnwu ye kɛ, bɛbava 
subane nee ngyehyɛleɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia mɔɔ yɛhile ye wɔ anwuma ɛkɛ ne la kɔsɔɔti 
bɛali gyima. Bɛziezie bɛ nwo kɛ bɛbava bɛ nwobie ne bɛado gua amaa bɛawowɔ 
nwolɛ adwenle.
GYIMANU KƐLATA NEE YE NGYEHYƐLEƐ
Bɛ-nwo sɔneayɛlɛ – Maa yɛnlea ɛleka mɔɔ ɛwɔ la
Kolaa na yɛahɔ kɛlata ngakyile ne mɔ ɛzukoalɛ zo la, dua ɛhakyelɛ zo kɛlɛ 
nwobie ngakyile nna ne yɛɛ bɛ subane/ngyehyɛleɛ ne mɔ.
Gyimanu kɛlata
Gyimanu kɛlata a le kɛlata mɔɔ yɛkɛlɛ yɛkɔmaa gyima ngakyile mɔɔ di ngyehyɛleɛ nee 
adengile fɔɔnwo bie mɔ azo la. Ɔdua ngyehyɛleɛ mɔɔ di munli la azo na ɔfa aneɛ mɔɔ 
ekpunli ne die to nu kɛ ɔle fɔɔnwo la ɔdi gyima wɔ kɛlata ne ɛhɛlɛlɛ nu la. Gyimanu 
kɛlata kola yɛ adenle ngakyile mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛ nee gyimanu mgbanyinli di ngitanwo 
a. Mgbanyinli zɛhae mɔ bie mɔ a le, Kilehilevolɛ Kpanyinli, Kpanuvolɛma, Gyimanu 
Adengilevoma, Sɛlɛvolɛma, Maanle Mgbanyinli (Aranenu mgbanyinli), Arelemgbunli, 
Maangyeba Abolɔba Kpanyinli nee mɔɔ ɛha la.

ƐDENDƐSINLI/ƐDENDƐFOA NGYEHYƐLEƐ NEE ƐHƐLƐLƐ SƐKƐLƐNEƐ
Bango NwiɔNGYƐNU  5
Subane mɔɔ gyimanu kɛlata lɛ la
Subane mɔɔ gyimanu kɛlata lɛ la a le ɛhye mɔ:
1. Kɛlɛvolɛ ne adolɛse:  Ɛhye a le kɛlata ne ngyɛnu ne mɔɔ li moa a. Ɛdawɔ mɔɔ 
ɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ne la, wɔ adolɛse ne ba ɛ sa fema zo anwuma. Maa yɛyɛ ye nzonlɛ kɛ, 
kɛlata ɛhye subane ne bie kola maa yɛkɛlɛ kɛlɛvolɛ ne adolɛse ne wɔ ɛ sa bɛne zo 
anwuma.
2. Kenle: Ɛhye a le kenle ne mɔɔ ɛlɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ne la.
3. Dievolɛ ne adolɛse: Dievolɛ ne duma/gyima nu adolɛse ne ba ɛ sa bɛne zo wɔ 
kenle ne abo.
4. Ahyebizalɛ: Ahyebizalɛ mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la (Yɛmenle, Yɛmenle Ɛbambe, Yɛmenle 
Kpanuvolɛ)
5. Tidwɛkɛ: Tidwɛkɛ mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo mɔɔ kile deɛmɔti ɛlɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ne na bɛva 
ngɛlɛlera ngokoatee bɛhɛlɛ la. Ɛhye le kpuyia ne sikalɛpɛlɛ.
6. Mukenye: Fa ɛdendɛmunli ezinra mɔɔ anye la ɛkɛ na ɔkile deɛmɔti ɛlɛkɛlɛ kɛlata 
ne la buke ɔ nye.
7. Ɛdendɛkpunli ne mɔ: Adwenlekpɔkɛ ko biala hyia ɔ ti anwo ɛdendɛkpunli. Saa 
ɛfa ɛdendɛkpunli ngyehyɛleɛ ne ɛdi gyima a ɔboa ɔmaa dievolɛ ne te agbɔkɛ mɔɔ 
ɛlɛkile ye wɔ kɛlata ne anu la abo.
8. Adwulaleɛ/ Awieleɛ edwɛkɛ:  Wɔ kɛlata ne awieleɛ, ɔwɔ kɛ kɛlɛvo ne sia kile 
agbɔkɛ titili ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ kɛlata ne anu la bieko.
Kakye ɛhye: Wɔ gyimanu kɛlata ɛhɛlɛlɛ nu, ɔhyia kɛ ɛmaa ɔ nye da ɛkɛ, ɔyɛ sikalɛ mɔɔ 
gyi kpɔkɛ zo na ɔdua ngyehyɛleɛ fɔɔnwo zo. Bɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɛbava ɛnelɛ nee aneɛ mɔɔ 
le fɔɔnwo la wɔali gyima na wɔava ngyehyɛleɛ fɔɔnwo ne azo amaa bɛalie bɛado nu 
ɛsesebɛ.
Gyima 5�9 Subane mɔɔ kɛlata lɛ la
Nwo adwenle mɔɔ ɛbala ye ali wɔ subane mɔɔ gyimanu kɛlata lɛ la anwo na fa to 
sukoavoma mɔɔ ɛ nee bɛ gyi bango ko la anyunlu.
Gyima 5�10 Gyimanu Kɛlata Ɛhɛlɛlɛ
Wɔ bɛ ekpunli ne mɔ anu, bɛhɛlɛ gyimanu kɛlata mɔɔ lɛ ɛdendɛkpunli nsa la 
bɛhɔmaa bɛ suazo belemgbunli ne wɔ anyuhɔlɛ gyima nsa mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛwie ye 
yɛ wɔ sua ne azo la anwo. Bɛgyinla subane mɔɔ kɛlata ne lɛ la azo na bɛla ye ali 
bɛhile sukoavoma mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ wɔ la kɔsɔɔti.

ƐDENDƐSINLI/ƐDENDƐFOA NGYEHYƐLEƐ NEE ƐHƐLƐLƐ SƐKƐLƐNEƐ
Bango NwiɔNGYƐNU  5
AGƆNWOLƐ KƐLATA
Agɔnwolɛ kɛlata a le kɛlata mɔɔ yɛkɛlɛ yɛmaa yɛ gɔnwo mɔ anzɛɛ yɛ abusua ne amaa 
bɛanwu mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zo wɔ yɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu anzɛɛ yɛfa yɛbiza bɛ akpɔkɛ nu la. Mekɛ 
dɔɔnwo ne ala yɛkɛlɛ agɔnwolɛ kɛlata yɛmaa yɛ nwo sonla, awie mɔɔ bikye yɛ, anzɛɛ 
yɛ gɔnwo.
Subane mɔɔ agɔnwolɛ kɛlata lɛ la
Ɛhye mɔ a le subane mɔɔ agɔnwolɛ kɛlata lɛ a:
1. Kɛlɛvolɛ ne adolɛse:  Wɔ adolɛse ne a le debie mɔɔ li moa mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛkɛlɛ a. 
Ɔhyia kɛ ɛkɛhɛlɛ ɛhye wɔ kɛlata ne anwuma wɔ ɛ sa fema zo. Ɔkile kɛlata ɛhɛlɛlɛ 
ne mɔlebɛbo. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛkɛlɛ debie biala mɔɔ kile ɛ nzi adenle la.
2. Kenle: Ɔwɔ kɛ kenle ne mɔɔ ɛlɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ne la ba adolɛse ne abo.
3. Ahyebizalɛ: Ahyebizalɛ mɔɔ le kɛ; Me nli, Me gɔnwo Alan, Me gɔnwo kpalɛ, nee mɔɔ 
ɛha la.
4. Mukenye: Deɛmɔti ɛlɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ne la da ali wɔ alimoa ɛdendɛkpunli ne anu. 
Ɛbahola wɔabiza dievolɛ ne akpɔkɛ nu wɔabɔ ɔ bo. Eza ɛbahola wɔahile kɛ, ɛlɛ 
anyelazo kɛ ɔte kpɔkɛ na ɔ sa baha wɔ kɛlata ne. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛhonlone ne mɔɔ li moa 
wɔ agɔnwolɛ kɛlata ɛhɛlɛlɛ ne anu la yɛ mɔɔ le mɔɔ bɛdie bɛto nu a ɔyɛ boɛ a.
5. Kɛlata mumua ne: Ɔwɔ kɛ aneɛ ne mɔɔ ɛfa wɔahɛlɛ kɛlata ne la yɛ mɔɔ la aze. Noko 
akee, ahenle mɔɔ ɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ne wɔamaa ye la gyinlabelɛ kola kile edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ, 
ɛdendɛsinli nee ɛdendɛmunli holɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛfa ɛdi gyima la. Saa ɛlɛkɛlɛ wɔamaa 
ɛ gɔnwo a, ɛbahola wɔava aneɛ mɔɔ ɛ nee ye bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛte ɔ bo na bɛdie bɛto 
nu la wɔali gyima. Saa ɛkɛlɛ wɔamaa kpanyinli a ɔwɔ kɛ wɔ aneɛ ne anwo te.
6. Adwulaleɛ: Bɔ deɛmɔti ɛlɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ne la kpɔkɛ wɔ adwulaleɛ ɛdendɛkpunli ne 
anu. Yemɔ a pɛ kɛlata ne sikalɛ a. Ɛ nee kengavo ne ɛli nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ le ahundwolɛ 
na ɔtɔ ɛnzonlɛ nu la. Eza mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi kɛ kengavo ne ɛhɛlɛ ɛbua wɔ edwɛkɛ ne 
anwo bie. Ɔkile ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ye kɛ bɛkɛdoa bɛ ngitanwolilɛ ne azo a.
7. Awieleɛ nrɛlaleɛ: Yɛnlɛ awieleɛ nrɛlaleɛ kpɔkyee ko mɔɔ gyi ɛkɛ ne maa agɔnwolɛ 
kɛlata ɛhɛlɛlɛ a, emomu ɛhye gyi ahenle ne mɔɔ ɛkɛlɛ wɔamaa ye la anwo zo. Ɛhye 
mɔ a le awieleɛ nrɛlaleɛ bie mɔ;
a. Ɛhulolɛ ngome
b. Agɔnwolɛ kpalɛ
c. Ɛ ti ngoane
d.  Mebiza wɔ
Akee ɛwie a, fa wɔ duma wula ɔ bo. Ndonwo, Medame Kodwo ɔ . Ɛhye kɔ ɛ sa fema 
zo aze.
Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛkakye kɛ, wɔ agɔnwolɛ kɛlata ɛhɛlɛlɛ nu, aneɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛdi gyima la gyi ahenle 
ne mɔɔ bɛkɛlɛ kɛlata ne bɛamaa ye la anwo zo. Bɛle ngɛlata mɔɔ yɛkɛlɛ yɛmaa yɛ gɔnwo 
mɔ nee yɛ nwo amra la. Bɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɛbava ɛnelɛ nee aneɛ mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la wɔali gyima 
na wɔava ngyehyɛleɛ fɔɔnwo ne mɔɔ wɔ agɔnwolɛ kɛlata nwo la wɔali gyima.

Gyima 5�12 Agɔnwolɛ kɛlata ɛhɛlɛlɛ
Wɔ ekpunli nu, bɛhɛlɛ agɔnwolɛ kɛlata mɔɔ lɛ ɛdendɛkpunli nsa la wɔ bɛ 
ɛnwomenlelielɛ kenle ne anwo bɛmaa bɛ gɔnwo mɔ. Bɛgyinla subane mɔɔ kɛlata 
ne lɛ la azo bɛla bɛ gyima ne ali bɛhile sukoavoma mɔɔ ɛha la.
ANEƐHAKYILƐ
Aneɛhakyilɛ a le adenle mɔɔ yɛdua zo yɛfa ndelebɛbo mɔɔ wɔ aneɛ ko anu la yɛkɔ 
aneɛ fofolɛ (gyɛne) nu la. Alimoa aneɛ ne a le mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ɛgengadeɛ ne wɔ nu la yɛɛ 
mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ ne la a le aneɛ ne mɔɔ ɛkakyi ɛgengadeɛ ne wɔahɔ nu la.
Adengile mɔɔ bɛfa zo bɛkakyi aneɛ la
Aneɛhakyilɛ hyia ndenle mɔɔ lɛ ngyehyɛleɛ fɔɔnwo na ɔbaboa sukoavoma amaa bɛanyia 
sukoanyia mɔɔ bamaa bɛnleɛnlea aneɛ nu, bɛanyia ɛgengadeɛ bie anu ndelebɛbo wɔ 
aneɛ ko anu na bɛahakyi bɛahɔ aneɛ gyɛne nu la. Moalɛ adengile mɔɔ baboa wɔ la a 
wɔ ze ɛke la:
1. Mɔlebɛbo: Te ɛweɛne mɔɔ la aneɛhakyilɛ nee aneɛbohilelɛ avinli la abo na kile 
maandeɛ mɔɔ aneɛ ne vi nu la anwo nvasoɛ ne noko abo.
2. Ɛgengalɛ sukoanyia ɛnyianlɛ: Nwu ye kɛ ɛkola ɛkenga alimoa aneɛ ne na ɛte ɔ 
bo.
3. Ɛgengadeɛ nu ɛnleɛnleanlɛ: Kpondɛ ɛgengadeɛ ngakyile ne mɔ, aneɛ (ɛnelɛ) ne, 
bodane nee menli mɔɔ ɛgengadeɛ ne kɔ amaa bɛ la.
Dua aneɛhakyilɛ ngyehyɛleɛ adenle zo. Nea ndenle mɔɔ le kɛ ɛhye mɔ:
a. Kɛ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔ ndelebɛbo si kile la yɛɛ ndelebɛbo mɔɔ ɛgengadeɛ 
mumua ne lɛ la.
b. Mɔɔ le ko wɔ aneɛ ne mɔ maandeɛ ne anu la.
c. Aneɛ mɔɔ bɛvea ɔ nye la.
d. Edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ mɔɔ tu bɔ nu la.
4. Sukoa aneɛhakyilɛ: Fa ɛgengadeɛ mɔɔ le sikalɛ na nuhua ɛnyɛ se la bɔ ɔ bo na 
akee wɔahɔ mɔɔ le kpomgbondee la azo.
5. Gyinla fɔɔnwohilelɛ nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ zo: Dwenle ngilenu nee gyinlabelɛ mɔɔ 
ɛgengadeɛ ne lɛ la azo tɛla kɛ ɛkɛli edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔ ndelebɛbo nzi dɔɔnwo 
dɔɔnwo.
6. Dua tɛkenɔlɔgyi nee adwuleso moalɛ ndenle zo: Dua adwuleso aneɛhakyilɛ 
ndenle zo, edwɛbohilelɛ mbuluku, yɛɛ adwuleso moalɛ ndenda ne azo maa ɔboa 
wɔ wɔ ɛzukoalɛ nu
7. Mobɔnuyɛlɛ nee nwolɛ adwenlehilelɛ:  Bɛnleɛnlea bɛ gɔnwo mɔ aneɛ mɔɔ 
bɛkɛhakyi la anu na bɛha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔfɛta la.

8. Kpondɛ ɛgengadeɛ mɔɔ gyi bodane kpɔkyee bie azo la: Neɛnlea ɛgengadeɛ 
ngakyile mɔɔ gyi bodane kpɔkyee bie mɔ azo la (ndonwo; mɔɔ gyi mɛla, ayileyɛlɛ, 
anzɛɛ bɛ sa anloa gyima bie azo la) amaa wɔabe.
9. Kɔ zo sukoa: Kpondɛ adenyia na kɔ zo sukoa amaa wɔanyia aneɛhakyilɛ nwo

Aneɛhakyilɛ ngakyilɛ
Yɛlɛ aneɛhakyilɛ ngakyile dɔɔnwo. Emomu, ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ɛhye bagyinla ngakyile ɛhye 
mɔ azo:
1. Aneɛhakyilɛ mɔɔ gyi edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔ ndelebɛbo zo la: Ɛhye kile aneɛhakyilɛ 
adenle mɔɔ bɛdua edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔ ndelebɛbo zo bɛfa edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ fofolɛ 
bɛsie bɛ gyakɛ anu mɔɔ ɔnea fɔɔnwohilelɛ ɔtɛla aneɛ ne ɛhanlɛ la.
2. Aneɛhakyilɛ mɔɔ gyi ndelebɛbo mɔɔ ɛgengadeɛ mumua ne lɛ azo la: Aneɛhakyilɛ 
adenle ɛhye le mɔɔ ɛngakyi ɛnvi ndelebɛbo mɔɔ ɛgengadeɛ ne lɛ la anwo la. Ɔfea 
aneɛ ne anye na ɔmaa ngilenu mumua ne nee kɛ bɛzi bɛha ye la.
3. Aneɛhakyilɛ mɔɔ gyi maandeɛ zo la: Wɔ aneɛhakyilɛ ɛhye anu, yɛnea ngakyile 
mɔɔ wɔ maandeɛ ne anu nee mɔɔ bɛdie bɛto nu la azo a yɛkakyi ɛgengadeɛ ne a.
4. Aneɛhakyilɛ mɔɔ gyi ngyehyɛleɛ fɔɔnwo bie azo la: Ɛhye le aneɛhakyilɛ adenle 
mɔɔ bɛnea ninyɛne mɔɔ alimoa aneɛ ne lɛ la azo fɔɔnwo a bɛkakyi bɛkɔ aneɛ fofolɛ 
ne anu la.
5. Aneɛbohilelɛ: Ɛhye le bɛ nloa anu aneɛhakyilɛ mɔɔ ta finde ayiamgbole, guabɔlɛ 
anzɛɛ edwɛkɛlilɛ bo la.
6. Aneɛhakyilɛ mɔɔ gyi kakyivolɛ ne ndelebɛbo zo la: Ɛhye le aneɛhakyilɛ mɔɔ 
gyi ahenle mɔɔ kakyi aneɛ ne la ndelebɛbo mɔɔ ɔkɛnyia ye wɔ ɛgengadeɛ ne anu 
azo la. Aneɛ kakyivo ne kola ye ninyɛne ne bie fi nu na ɔfa bie ɔboka ye na ɔmaa 
ɛgengadeɛ ne kakyi.
7. Aneɛhakyilɛ mɔɔ gyi ndelebɛbo zo la: Ɛhye le aneɛhakyilɛ adenle mɔɔ bɛdua 
ngilenu nee bodane fɔɔnwo mɔɔ alimoa ɛgengadeɛ ne lɛ la azo a bɛkakyi bɛkɔ aneɛ 
fofolɛ nu kɛ mɔɔ ɔde la tɛla kɛ yɛkɛgyinla edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔ ngilenu angome 
azo la. Adenle ɛhye gyinla gyinlabelɛ, bodane, menli, ɛweɛne nee koyɛlɛ mɔɔ la 
aneɛ nwiɔ ne avinli la azo.
Aneɛhakyilɛ ɛzukoalɛ
Ɛhye mɔ a le aneɛhakyilɛ nwo gyima bie mɔ:
1. Ɛdendɛmunli sikalɛ (mɔɔ anu ɛnyɛ se la): Dua aneɛ ne fɔɔnwo ɛhɛlɛlɛ, ye 
aneɛmɛla zo kakyi ɛdendɛmunli fi Nrelenza nu kɔ Nzema nu.
2. Aneɛ mɔɔ anye fea la: Sukoa kɛ ɛbazi wɔahakyi aneɛ mɔɔ bɛvea ɔ nye, mɔmoane 
aneɛ yɛɛ ɛdendɛdenle.
3. Ɛdendɛkpunli nzinranzinra: Kakyi ndelebɛbo mɔɔ wɔ ɛdendɛkpunli nzinranzinra 
nu la kɔ aneɛ fofolɛ nu fa sukoa aneɛhakyilɛ.

4. Ɛgengadeɛ mɔɔ gyi ɛzukoalɛdeɛ kpɔkyee zo la: Kakyi ɛgengadeɛ mɔɔ gyi 
ɛzukoalɛdeɛ kpɔkyee bie azo la ( ndonwo; mɔɔ gyi mɛla, ayileyɛlɛ, anzɛɛ bɛ sa

6. Adwelie-ngɛlata nu adawu: Kakyi adwelie ngɛlata nu adawu na dua zo sukoa kɛ

7. Menli nwiɔ adwelielilɛ: Kakyi adwelie mɔɔ menli nwiɔ ɛlɛdi la na dua zo kakyi 
bodane nee ɛnelɛ mɔɔ adweliedivoma ne ɛlɛfa ali ngitanwo ne la kɔ Nzema nu.
8. Aneɛhakyilɛ ndotonwoyɛlɛ: Fa wɔ aneɛ ne mɔɔ wɔhakyi la toto ɛ gɔnwo mɔ 
ɛdeɛ nwo (Ndonwo, mɔɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnyia nwolɛ amodinlibɔlɛ ɛyɛ la, aneɛ mɔɔ 
melahyinli ɛhakyi la) na dua zo kakyihakyi sukoanyia mɔɔ ɛlɛ la anu.
9. Bɛ-nwo aneɛhakyilɛ: Kɛlɛ ɛgengadeɛ wɔ Nrelenza nu na kakyi kɔ Nzema nu amaa 
ɛ sa ahola ye.
10. Mobɔnu nee nwolɛ adwenlehilelɛ: Fa wɔ aneɛ ne mɔɔ wɔhakyi la maa ɛ gɔnwo 
na die ye deɛ ne na ko biala ɛnleɛnlea ɔ gɔnwo ɛdeɛ nu na ɔmaa mualɛ mɔɔ ɔfɛta 
la amaa bɛanyia anyuhɔlɛ nee sukoanyia.

The Environment
In our modern world, there are many factors that place the wellbeing of the planet 
in jeopardy. While some people have the opinion that environmental problems are 
just a natural occurrence, others believe that human beings have a huge impact

on the environment. Regardless of your viewpoint, take into consideration the 
following factors that place our environment as well as the planet Earth in danger.
Global warming or climate change is a major contributing factor to environmental 
damage. Because of global warming, we have seen an increase in melting ice caps, 
a rise in sea levels, and the formation of new weather patterns. These weather 
patterns have caused stronger storms, droughts, and flooding in places that they 
formerly did not occur.
Air pollution is primarily caused as a result of excessive and unregulated emissions 
of carbon dioxide into the air. Pollutants mostly emerge from the burning of fossil 
fuels in addition to chemicals, toxic substances, and improper waste disposal. 
Air pollutants are absorbed into the atmosphere, and they can cause smog, a 
combination of smoke and fog, in valleys as well as produce acidic precipitation 
in areas far away from the pollution source.
In many areas, people and local governments do not sustainably use their natural 
resources. Mining for natural gases, deforestation, and even improper use of 
water resources can have tremendous effects on the environment. While these 
strategies often attempt to boost local economies, their effects can lead to oil 
spills, interrupted animal habitats, and droughts.
Ultimately, the effects of the modern world on the environment can lead to many 
problems. Human beings need to consider the repercussions of their actions, 
trying to reduce, reuse, and recycle materials while establishing environmentally 
sustainable habits. If measures are not taken to protect the environment, we 
can potentially witness the extinction of more endangered species, worldwide 
pollution, and a completely uninhabitable planet.

MUKENYE
Ngyɛnu ɛhye wowɔ adwenle wɔ agyalɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne nee agyalɛ maandeɛ ne anwo. 
Ɔka edwɛkɛ ɔfa tete agyalɛ maamulɛ ne, agyalɛ ngakyile yɛɛ nvasoɛ mɔɔ wɔ agyalɛ 
maamulɛ ne azo la anwo. Ɔbabuke ndenle mɔɔ yɛdua zo yɛbu maandeɛ agyalɛ ne 
anwo maamulɛ wɔ yɛ azua ne mɔ azo la anye. Adwenle mɔɔ ɛbanyia ye wɔ ngyɛnu 
ɛhye anu la baboa amaa wɔade wɔ maandeɛ ne anu agyalɛ ne nee maandeɛ gyɛne bie 
mɔ ɛdeɛ ne abo. Ɛbawowɔ adwenle wɔ kɛ bɛsi bɛbu aneɛ ekpunli gyɛne bie mɔ agyalɛ 
nwo maamulɛ la yɛɛ adwuleso ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛva nzenzaleɛ ɛra tete agyalɛ maamulɛ ne 
anu la anwo. Agyalɛ adiabo ne nee ye gyima mɔɔ ɔdi wɔ aneɛ gyɛne bie mɔ maandeɛ 
nu la baboa amaa wɔade ko biala ɛdeɛ ne abo kpalɛ. Ɛbade nvasoɛ mɔɔ wɔ maandeɛ 
nwo banebɔlɛ, maandeɛ mɔɔ bɛkakyi bɛmaa nee subane kpalɛ alilalɛ abo.
ADWENLE TITILI
• Agyalɛ le nrenyia nee raalɛ ngamɔnulilɛ.
• Agyalɛ maamulɛ le adenle mɔɔ bɛdua diedi, ngyehyɛleɛ nee mɔɔ menli ekpunli bie 
die to nu la azo a bɛyɛ nyɛleɛ ne la.
• Agyalɛ gua ye ngakyile nsa, bɛmɛ a le maandeɛ agyalɛ, aranenu agyalɛ yɛɛ ngɛnlamo 
agyalɛ.
• Sonla nee dasanli ɛzuzulɛ, nwomazukoalɛ, ɛzonlenlɛ, adendulɛ nee mɔɔ bokɛboka 
nwo la ɛva nzenzaleɛ ɛra tete agyalɛ maamulɛ ne anu wɔ adwuleso mekɛ ye anu.
• Yɛbahola yɛalua maandeɛ nu ɛmiemianlɛ, awolɛ-ndoazo ekpunli ngakyile adwelielilɛ 
nee sonla tɛnlabelɛ nu ninyɛne mɔɔ fa abodelɛ ba la adenzilɛ zo yɛazi adwuleso 
nyɛleɛ mɔ ɛmaa yɛ agyalɛ maamulɛ ne mɔ bie ɛlɛminli la adenle.

Nvoninli ne kile mbusuama mɔɔ ɛlɛdi bɛlɛra bie ɛgyalɛ nwo daselɛ la. Wɔ nvoninli 
ne anu, raalɛgyavo ne ɛbu ndwɛlɛ wɔ ɔ ye ne mɔɔ ɔgya ye la anyunlu. Yelɛ ne ɛziezie 
ɔ nwo wɔ maamulɛ adenle zo. Kunli ne wula tɛladeɛ yɛɛ avikpa la ɔ kɔme nee ɔ sa. 
Mgbanyinli ne mɔ noko ɛziezie bɛ nwo wɔ maamulɛ adenle zo.
Nvasoɛ mɔɔ wɔ agyalɛ nee agyalɛ maamulɛ ne azo la
Agyalɛ maamulɛ ne le nvasoɛ wɔ Gana azua azua ne mɔ azo . Nvasoɛ bie mɔ mɔɔ wɔ 
agyalɛ nee agyalɛ maamulɛ ne azo la a le kɛ: ɔbɔ yɛ maandeɛ ne anwo bane, ɔboa ɔmaa 
yɛkakyi maandeɛ ne yɛmaa awolɛ-ndoazo, ɔmmaa menli ɛmbɔ ɛbɛla mgbane mgbane, 
ɔmaa bɛdie mbɛda mɔɔ bɛkɛwo bɛ la bɛto nu wɔ abusua ne anu, ɔkile agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ, 
koyɛlɛ, anwobanebɔlɛ, moalɛ nee mɔɔ ɛha la.
1. Ɔbɔ yɛ maandeɛ ne anwo bane: Bɛdua menli ne maandeɛ adenle zo a bɛbu agyalɛ 
maamulɛ ne a. Ɔwɔ nu kɛ maandeɛ ne anwo nyɛleɛ ne mɔ bie ɛhakyi ɛdeɛ noko 
akee ɔgyi tete ɛdeɛ ne azo. Ɛhye kile kɛ yɛsi yɛbɔ yɛ maandeɛ ne anwo bane la.
2. Ɔboa ɔmaa yɛkakyi maandeɛ ne yɛmaa awolɛ-ndoazo
3. Wɔ agyalɛ mekɛ ne anu, yɛyɛ nyɛleɛ bie mɔ mɔɔ le kɛ kɔkɔbɔlɛ/abusua ne ɛnwunlɛ, 
asoazulɛ yɛɛ raalɛgyavo ne mɔɔ bɛlɛra ne abusua ne die ye bɛ sa amu nwiɔ la. 
Yɛkakyi nyɛleɛ ɛhye mɔ yɛmaa awolɛ-ndoazo ne mekɛ biala.
4. Ɔkile anyunlunyia nee ɛbulɛ: Agyalɛ maamulɛ ne kile enililɛ nee ɛbulɛ na ɔwula 
agyalɛma ne nee bɛ mbusua ne anyunlunyia. Menli nwu agyalɛma ne kɛ bɛziezie 
bɛ nwo bɛmaa agyalɛ ɛlobɔ ne. Bɛbɔ bɛ adwenle kpɔkɛ kɛ bɛbadɛnla bɛabɔ ɛdane 
na bɛanlea mbɛda mɔɔ kɛvinde agyalɛ ne anu la. Ɛhye maa bɛnyia enililɛ nee ɛbulɛ 
bɛfi maanzinli mɔɔ bɛwɔ nu la anu.
5. Ɔmaa menli bɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ ɔfɛta la: Ɔmaa ɛkpa zo nwɔhoalilɛ nwo adenle. Ɔmaa 
agyalɛma ne amu nwiɔ adenle maa bɛfa bɛ nwo na tɛ awie gyɛne ɔ. Ye titili ne gyi 
yelɛ ne anwo zo. Ɛhye le maamulɛ adenle mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛsi adwɔmane mɔɔ kɛra 
nrenyia ne nee raalɛ ne afoa nu la adenle na bɛfa bɛ nye bɛdi bɛ nzi a.
6. Ɔkile koyɛlɛ: Agyalɛ le abusua ahualilɛ. Agyalɛ maamulɛ ne ka nrenyia ne nee 
raalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛgya bɛ nwo la mbusua ne bɔ nu. Maandeɛ ne ka mbusua nee 
agɔnwolɛma mɔɔ agyalɛma ne lɛ bɛ la bɔ nu. Bɛdi pelasili bɛbɔ nu na bɛyɛ bɛ nwo 
nzonlɛ. Saa aneɛ bie anu sonla kɔgya aneɛ gyɛne anu dehelɛ a, ɔka aneɛ ekpunli 
nwiɔ zɔhane ɔbɔ nu na ɔmaa anzondwolɛ nee koyɛlɛ ba aneɛ ngakyile nwiɔ zɔhane 
avinli na ɔka maanle kpule ne.
7. Ɔmaa bɛdie ngakula mɔɔ bɛkɛwo bɛ la bɛto nu wɔ abusua ne anu: Bɛdua agyalɛ 
zo bɛdie mralɛ mɔɔ kɛvinde agyalɛ ɛlobɔ ne abo la bɛto nu wɔ abusua nu. Agyalɛ 
ne maa mralɛ ɛhye mɔ nwu kɛ bɛboka abusua ne na bɛlɛ tumi kɛ bɛdi agya bɛfa 
debie. Bieko a le kɛ, ɔmaa bɛnyia adenle bɛkpondɛ bɛ bo wɔ abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne 
anu.
8. Ɔkile Agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ: Menli kɔ agyalɛ amaa bɛanyia agɔnwolɛvalɛ na bɛayɛ bɛ nwo 
moalɛ. Agyalɛ le sonla ko ɛlualɛ nwo sɔbelɛ. Ɔmaa agyalɛma ne boa bɛ nwo ngoko, 
kyɛ adwenle na bɛdie bɛ nye bɛbɔ nu. Eza agyalɛ si adwenlendwenle nee sonla ko 
ɛdɛnlanlɛ nu anwongyelelɛ dɔɔnwo dɔɔnwo adenle.

Gyima 6�2 Agyalɛ ngakyile
Wɔ bɛ ekpunli ne mɔ anu, bɛwowɔ adwenle wɔ agyalɛ ngakyile mɔɔ bɛze bɛ la 
anwo na bɛ nee ekpunli fofolɛ ɛwowɔ bɛ nyelebɛnloa ne anwo adwenle.
Agyalɛ ngakyile
Agyalɛ ngakyile dɔɔnwo wɔ aleɛabo mɔɔ ɛye Gana ɛfi nu a ɔnyɛ boɛ a. Wɔ Gana, 
agyalɛ ngakyile ne mɔ a le maandeɛ agyalɛ, aranenu agyalɛ yɛɛ ngɛnlamo agyalɛ.
Ngɛnlamo Agyalɛ: Ɔle nwanzanwanza ngamɔnulilɛ mɔɔ kɛnlamo nrenyia nee raalɛ 
ka bɛ nwo bɔ nu mɔɔ ye ngyinlazo a le ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu anzondwolɛ, bɛ nwo moalɛ nee 
agɔnwolɛyɛlɛ la. Eza bɛfɛlɛ ye Nee-ka.
Aranenu agyalɛ: Ɛhye le kɔɔto agyalɛ mɔɔ bɛdua mɛla nee ngyehyɛleɛ fɔɔnwo bie azo 
a bɛdie bɛto nu la. Ɔle nrenyia ko, raalɛ ko agyalɛ. Agyalɛ ɛhye ɛmmaa adenle ɛmmaa 
agyalɛma ne ɛngya bieko bɛmboka nwo.
Maandeɛ Agyalɛ: Eza bɛfɛlɛ ye tete anzɛɛ maamulɛ agyalɛ mɔɔ bɛdua aneɛ ekpunli 
bie maandeɛ, bɛ tetedwɛkɛ nee bɛ mɛla zo bɛka nrenyia nee raalɛ bɛbɔ nu kɛ kunli 
nee yelɛ la. Wɔ Gana, aneɛ ekpunli biala lɛ kɛ ɔsi ɔbu ye agyalɛ nwo maamulɛ a. 
Maandeɛ agyalɛ maa adenle maa bɛyɛ nvedenvedenu wɔ agyalɛma mbusua ne anu na 
bɛneɛnlea ninyɛne mɔɔ bahola azi agyalɛ ne adenle la kɔsɔɔti.
Wɔ ngyɛnu ɛhye anu, yɛbawowɔ adwenle wɔ maandeɛ agyalɛ ne anwo.
Aneɛ ekpunli ne mɔ biala lɛ agyalɛ ngakyile. Gana aneɛ ekpunli ngakyile bie mɔ nee 
bɛ agyalɛ ngakyile bie mɔ a wɔ aze ɛke la.

Kolaa na agyalɛ ne ahɔ zo la
Selɛ a biza raalɛ agyalɛ maa ɔ ra nrenyia a. Edwɛkɛmiza nee nvedenvedenu dɔɔnwo 
ɛyɛlɛ kɔ zo wɔ mbusua nwiɔ ne avinli kolaa na agyalɛ mekɛ ne adwu. Bɛyɛ ɛhye amaa 
bɛanwu kɛ bɛ mra ne mɔ ɛlɛkɔ aako kpalɛ mɔɔ anzondwolɛ wɔ nu la anu. Ɔwɔ kɛ ɔyɛ 
aako mɔɔ nuhua menli kulo sonla, ze nyele, lɛ ndelebɛbo, lɛ ɛbulɛ na bɛkɛlie raalɛ 
ne anzɛɛ nrenyia ne bɛkɛdo nu kɛ bɛgya ye la. Bɛnea bɛnwu ye kɛ, agyalɛma ne ɛnle 
menli mɔɔ le mogya ko a. Eza bɛyɛ ɛhye amaa bɛanwu ye kɛ abusua ne mɔɔ bɛ mra 
ne mɔ ɛlɛkɔ nu la anu amra ne bie ɛnlɛ ewule mɔɔ le nzane a. Bɛnea ewule ewule le 
kɛ avinli ewule, kokobɛ, mgbutike nee mɔɔ ɛha mɔɔ bɛnwu bɛ kɛ bɛle ewule ɛtane 
ɛtane la. Bɛnea bɛnwu ye kɛ abusua ne anu menli ne mɔ le menli mɔɔ lɛ subane kpalɛ 
a. Bɛkyi subane bie mɔ mɔɔ le kɛ nzabolɛ, awulekadeɛ, akyɛbɛ, mgbovonle na bɛkulo 
nyele, gyima ɛsesebɛyɛlɛ nee anwofamaa.
Agyalɛ mekɛ ne/Agyalɛ mumua ne
Saa nrenyia ne nee raalɛ ne die to nu kɛ bɛkɛgya a, bɛkile kenle. Folɛ a bɛta bɛdi 
gyima ɛhye a ɔluakɛ bɛdie bɛdi kɛ kenle ne le anzondwolɛ kenle. Nrenyia ne siezie ɔ 
nwo na ɔkendɛ wɔ abotane nu kɛ mekɛ ne kɛdwu na yeahɔgya bɛlɛra ne. Ninyɛne mɔɔ 
bɛta bɛfa bɛgya la dɔɔnwo ne ala le ezukoa nee nza. Ninyɛne ne bie mɔ a le ɛhye:
Kɔkɔbɔlɛ nza: Ɛhye le nza mɔɔ raalɛgyavo ne abusua ne fa kɔnwu selɛ ne mɔɔ bɛgya 
ɔ ra ne la na ɔgyinla zolɛ ɔkile kenle mɔɔ agyalɛ mumua ne kɛra zo la. Mekɛ dɔɔnwo 
ne ala ɔle nza kpalɛ akpandu ko yɛɛ nwolɛ ezukoa ekyi mɔɔ ɔfɛta la. Nyɛleɛ ɛhye buke 
adenle maa nrenyia ne maa ɔkola ɔkɔkpɔla bɛlɛra ne wɔ ɔ ze aako nu mɔɔ edwɛkɛmiza 
biala ɛnle nu a. Mekɛ ɛhye a nrenyia ne kola da ɔ nwo ali na ɔkile kɛ ɔkɛgya bɛlɛra 
ne a.
Ɔ ti nza: Ɔle bɛlɛra ne ati nza. Mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala ezukoa ekyi zua ye. Ɛhye noko di 
daselɛ kɛ kpavolɛ ne ɛgya bɛlɛra ne.
Asoa/ Ɔ ti ezukoa: ɛhye le bɛlɛra ne ati ezukoa mɔɔ raalɛgyavo ne tua maa bɛlɛra ne 
ɔ ze la. Bɛlɛra ne ɔ ze a kile ezukoa mɔɔ ɔbalie a. Ezukoa ɛhye anu yɛ ɛnlomboɛ.

Mesia ezukoa: Ɔle ezukoa mɔɔ raalɛgyavo ne tua maa bɛlɛra ne amediema mrenyia 
ne mɔ kɛ bɛbɔ bɛ diema raalɛ ne anwo bane dedee yedwu agyalɛ mekɛ la yɛɛ agyalɛ 
ne anzi anwobanebɔlɛ. Mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala, bɛlɛra ne mɔɔ bɛgya ye la amediema 
mrenyia ne mɔ a bɔ ezukoa mɔɔ bɛkɛlie la bolɛ a.
Selɛ nza: Ɛhye le ezukoa mɔɔ bɛtua bɛkpɔda bɛlɛra ne ɔ ze ɔlua ɛvɛlɛ mɔɔ yeva ɔ ra ne 
anwo sumunli ye mbɛda nu la. Raalɛgyavo ne a tua zɛhae ezukoa ne a. Mekɛ dɔɔnwo 
ne ala bɛlɛra ne ɔ ze a kile ezukoa mɔɔ ɔkɛlie a.
Bɛ nli akunlu falɛ: Ɛhye le ɛdanlɛ mɔɔ ezukoa ekyi mɔɔ ɔfɛta la zua ye mɔɔ raalɛgyavo 
ne fa maa ninli ne mɔɔ tetele bɛlɛra ne la.
Kakye: Saa ɛye mɔɔ yɛdiedia bɛ wɔ anwuma la ɛfi ɛkɛ ne a, ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ; abɔfo

Adwuleso nyɛleɛ bie mɔ ɛva ngakyile anzɛɛ nzenzaleɛ ɛrawolo tete agyalɛ maamulɛ ne 
anu wɔ Gana maandeɛ ngakyile ne mɔ anu. Nzenzaleɛ ne mɔ le nvasoɛ anzɛɛ ngyegyelɛ. 
Adwuleso nyɛleɛ mɔɔ ɛva ngakyile anzɛɛ nzenzaleɛ ɛrawolo maandeɛ agyalɛ ne anu la

ɛbɛla ɛbɔlɛ nu la anwo. Adwuleso mekɛ ye, agyalɛma ne a ta kile mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ

nwo nee kɛ mrenyia nee mraalɛ suzu bɛ nwo la ɛva nzenzaleɛ ɛra tete agyalɛ 
maamulɛ ne anu. Ɛhye mɔ bie a le, ndenle mɔɔ kile mraalɛ kyɛfoa wɔ agyadeɛ 
ɛhyɛlɛ nee agyalilɛ nu wɔ maandeɛ bie mɔ anu la.
3. Ɛzonlenlɛ: Ɛzonlenlɛ le kɛ keleseɛne, ngɛnlamo nee ɛzonlenlɛ ngakyile mɔɔ ɛdɛlɛ 
aleɛabo la ɛva nyɛleɛ nee mɛla ngakyile ɛrawula agyalɛ maamulɛ ne anu, mɔɔ 
ɔdwu mekɛ ne bie a, nyɛleɛ zɔhane bafea yɛ maandeɛ ne anu a.

6. Adwuleso ngitanwolilɛ nleka nee tɛkenɔlɔgyi: Ndenle mɔɔ yɛdua zo yɛdi

la ɛha yɛ maandeɛ ne.

Ɛbanyia ngilenu mɔɔ le kɛ ɛhye mɔ la: Abusua le edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ yɛfa 
yɛkile menli ekpunli mɔɔ bɛ nla le ko vi tete, bɛlɛ tetedwɛkɛ ko, duma ko, yɛɛ 
agyadeɛ ko la. Ɔkola ɔyɛ mɔɔ bɛdi agya bɛfi bɛ ze akunlu anzɛɛ mɔɔ bɛdi agya 
bɛfi bɛ nli akunlu la. Abusua a le menli ekpunli koatee ne mɔɔ ɛha bɛ nwo ɛbɔ 
nu wɔ aneɛ ko biala anu a. Menli ekpunli ne mɔɔ vi aneɛ ko ne ala ngakyile 
ɛhanlɛ nleka ne mɔ la a yɛ abusua ngambɔnu a, yɛɛ mbusua ngyikyi ne mɔ 
veɛvea abusua koatee ne anu.
Yɛnwu mbusua wɔ Abibile maanle bie mɔ mɔɔ le kɛ Gana la anu. Tetedwɛkɛ da ye ali 
kɛ, mbusua wɔ aleɛabo maanle ngakyile ne mɔ bie anu.
Subane mɔɔ abusua lɛ la
Subane titili mɔɔ mbusua lɛ la bahola ayɛ ɛhye mɔ:
1. Bɛ nla ko vi tete: Ɛhye kile kɛ, abusua ne anu amra die to nu kɛ, bɛ bo vi ɛleka ko.
2. Bɛle mogya ko na bɛdi bɛ nwo agya: Ɛhye kile kɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ abusua ne anu la 
die to nu kɛ, bɛle mogya ko na bɛdi bɛ nwo agya.
3. Bɛ subane nee sɛkɛlɛneɛ le ko: Menli mɔɔ wɔ abusua ne anu la lɛ ekpunli duma, 
sɛkɛlɛneɛ, subane nee maandeɛ ko.
4. Bɛle menli ko: Mekɛ ko biala abusua ne lɛ mɔɔ ka bɛ bɔ nu na bɛte nganeɛ kɛ bɛle 
menli ekpunli ko ɔti a bɛkye bɛ nwo file a.
5. Bɛlɛ dibelɛlilɛ nidizo ngyehyɛleɛ: Mbusua lɛ menli mɔɔ la bɛ nloa a; nuhua 
mgbanyima, arelemgbunli mɔɔ nea toto mbusua ne anu ndotolɛ a.
6. Bɛlɛ maandeɛ mɔɔ maa bɛda nzonlɛ: Abusua ko biala lɛ maandeɛ mɔɔ da menli 
ekpunli ne nzonlɛ a na bɛbɔ nwolɛ bane a. Bɛlɛ bɛ amodinli mɔɔ bɛbɔ a.
7. Gyima nee ezukoa nwo ngamɔnulilɛ: Mbusua lɛ ninyɛne le kɛ azɛlɛ nee agyandeɛ 
ngakyile mɔɔ bɛfa bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo a.
8. Maamulɛ nee nyɛleɛ: Mbusua ne mɔ ko biala lɛ kɛ ɔsi ɔbu ye maamulɛ na ɔyɛ ye 
nyɛleɛ mɔɔ le kɛ azezielɛ, agyalɛ, ɛzɛneyɛlɛ yɛɛ tete maandeɛ ne anwo nyɛleɛ a.
Nvasoɛ mɔɔ wɔ abusua zo la
Abusua ɛli gyima mɔɔ sonle bolɛ wɔ aneɛ ekpunli ngakyile ne mɔ maandeɛ nu. Bie a 
bɛwowɔ nwolɛ adwenle wɔ aze ɛke la.
1. Menli ekpunli-nu ɛgualɛ: Abusua maa yɛkola yɛgyinla menli bie mɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ 
bɛkulo nee subane bie mɔɔ bɛda ye ali la azo na yɛgua bɛ ekpunli nu.
2. Abusua maa menli nwu ye kɛ bɛle mogya ko na ɔmiemia ngamɔnulilɛ mɔɔ la 
alehelɛ ne mɔ avinli la anu.
3. Bɛdi bɛ nwo agya: Ɔmaa bɛnwu ye kɛ bɛle menli ekpunli ko, bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛmaa 
na bɛyɛ bɛ nwo moalɛ.

4. Subane nee sɛkɛlɛneɛ ko: Mbusua boa maa menli ka bɛ nwo bɔ nu bɛbayɛ ekpunli 
koatee ko mɔɔ bɛlɛ tetedwɛkɛ, subane nee sɛkɛlɛneɛ ko a.
5. Ngamɔnulilɛ nee moalɛ: Mbusua boa maa menli ka bɛ nwo bɔ nu na bɛboɔboa 
bɛ nwo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bie kɛhɔ ngyianlɛ nu mɔɔ le kɛ esiane, anwobanebɔlɛ anzɛɛ 
ɔkɛnyia edwɛkɛ la.
6. Edwɛkɛ ɛlilɛ: Mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala, mbusua lɛ bɛ ngyehyɛleɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛsi bɛdi 
edwɛkɛ na bɛsiezie menli ne avinli a.
7. Maandeɛ nwo banebɔlɛ: Abusua kola boa maa yɛbɔ yɛ maandeɛ ne, nwolɛ maamɛla 
nee ninyɛne mɔɔ yɛdie yɛto nu kɛ ɔsonle bolɛ la anwo bane na yɛkakyi yɛmaa 
awolɛ-ndoazo ngakyile ne.
8. Maanyɛlɛ faneyɛlɛ: Wɔ menli ekpunli ne mɔ bie anu, mbusua a le maanyɛlɛ 
faneyɛlɛ ne mɔlebɛbo a. Mbusua mgbanyinli ne mɔ dedɛ tumi (dibelɛ).
9. Gyima nee ezukoa nwo ngamɔnuyɛlɛ: Abusua boa wɔ gyima nee ezukoa nwo 
ngamɔnulilɛ mɔɔ le kɛ, azɛlɛ, ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛhyia bɛyɛ gyima, gualilɛ yɛɛ menli 
ekpunli mɔɔ ka bɛ nwo bɛabɔ nu bɛali bɛ gyima la.
10. Ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu anyuhɔlɛ: Abusua kola boa maa sonla nyia ye ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu anyuhɔlɛ, 
kɛmɔ nuhua menli ne kola fi dibelɛ ko anu ko dibelɛ fofolɛ mɔɔ kpogya tɛla mɔɔ 
ɛnee bɛwɔ nu la anzɛɛ nyia anyunlunyia ɔlua mɔdenlebɔlɛ bie ati.
11. Ekpunli-nu ɛwalɛ: Abusua boa maa menli nwu ye kɛ bɛwɔ ekpunli anzɛɛ bɛwɔ eku 
bie anu tɛla kɛ bɛle baholɛ la. Bɛnyia moalɛ na bɛte nganeɛ kɛ, bɛboka ekpunli ne.
Kɛ abusua ngyehyɛleɛ ne ɛnee si de la ɛhakyi mekɛ tendenle, yɛɛ nvasoɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛ ye wɔ 
maandeɛ ekpunli ngakyile ne mɔ tetedwɛkɛ nwo la ɛhakyi. Emomu, bolɛ mɔɔ ɔsonle 
wɔ menli ekpunli nu ɛgualɛ, bɛ nzonlɛyɛlɛ yɛɛ bɛ ngamɔnulilɛ la ɛtɛkakyile.
Mbusua ngakyile nee bɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ
Aneɛ ekpunli ngakyile ne mɔɔ wɔ Gana la lɛ mbusua ngakyile mɔɔ ko biala lɛ ye 
sɛkɛlɛneɛ (debie anzɛɛ abɔdeɛ mɔɔ gyi bɛ gyakɛ anu) le kɛ mɔɔ bɛhile ye wɔ ɛkponle 
ne mɔɔ wɔ aze ɛke anu la.

Gyima 7�1 Abusua ngyehyɛleɛ ne
Fa abusua nwo ngyehyɛleɛ ne kɔ adwenle nu. Dwenledwenle ngyehyɛleɛ ne mɔɔ 
ɔlɛ la, ye gyima, ɛleka mɔɔ ɔ bo vi, nee mɔɔ ɛha la anwo. Fa wɔ adwenle ne to gua 
maa sukoavoma mɔɔ ɛha la na fa bɛ deɛ ne bie boka wɔ deɛ ne anwo.
Gyima 7�2 Mbusua ngakyile ne mɔ anwo ndotonwoyɛlɛ
1. Kɛlɛ mbusua nnu mɔɔ wɔ wɔ aneɛ ne anu la nee bɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ na kile mbusua 
nsa nsa mɔɔ wɔ aneɛ ngakyile nwiɔ anu la nee bɛ kɛlɛneɛ.
2. Da wɔ nyelebɛnloa ne ali kile ɛ gɔnwo mɔ sukoavoma, kilehile koyɛlɛ nee 
ɛweɛne mɔɔ la bɛ nyelebɛnloa ne mɔ avinli la na bɛwowɔ nwolɛ adwenle.
Gyima 7�3 Nvasoɛ mɔɔ wɔ abusua zo la
Wɔ bɛ ekpunli ne mɔ anu, bɛhile gyima nsa mɔɔ abusua di wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo 
la na bɛwowɔ nwolɛ adwenle.
Gyima 7�4 Gyima mɔɔ abusua di la
Ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo ɛwowɔ adwenle wɔ ninyɛne nsa mɔɔ le bɛ abusua ne kyibadeɛ la 
anwo na bɛhile kɛ ɔsi ɔka bɛ la.
Gyima 7�5
Neɛnlea mbusua nee bɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ ɛkponle ne mɔɔ bɛhile ye wɔ anwuma ɛkɛ ne 
la anu ye abusua ko. Kpondɛ nvoninli mɔɔ kile abusua ne anu amra mɔɔ ɛziezie 
bɛ nwo la, vidio mɔɔ kile kɛ menli ne ɛlɛkilehile bɛ maandeɛ ne anu na bɛlɛka bɛ 
sukoanwu mɔɔ bɛlɛ la.
Gyima 7�6 Nvasoɛ mɔɔ wɔ abusua zo la
Bɛzie wɔ Abusuakpanyinli. Kilehile ninyɛne nsa mɔɔ ɛbayɛ wɔamaa koyɛlɛ adɛnla 
wɔ mbusuama ne avinli la. Da wɔ adwenle ne ali kile sukoavoma mɔɔ ɛ nee bɛ gyi 
bango ko la na bɛwowɔ adwenle wɔ nwolɛ.

TETE MAANLE ƐBULƐ NGYEHYƐLEƐ NE
Tete maanle ɛbulɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne: Ɛhye titili kile kɛ menli mɔɔ bu maanle ne la 
dibelɛ ne mɔ ngyehyɛleɛ ne si didi zo la. Yɛta yɛnwu ye wɔ gyimanu, aranenu yɛɛ eku 
bie mɔ anu. Ɔlɛ subane anzɛɛ ngyehyɛleɛ.
Subane mɔɔ tete maanle ɛbulɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne lɛ la
Subane mɔɔ tete maanle ɛbulɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne lɛ la bie a le ɛhye mɔ.
1. Dibelɛ ne mɔ tumililɛ ne didi zo: Tumililɛ ne vi anwuma badwu aze mɔɔ gyinlabelɛ 
ko biala lɛ ye gyima titili mɔɔ ɔdi a.
2. Gyinlazilɛ ne gyi mɔɔ lɛ tumi kpalɛ la anwo zo: Mgbanyima mɔɔ bɛ dibelɛ wɔ 
anwuma kpalɛ la a bɔ kpɔkɛ a.
3. Gyinlazilɛ mɔɔ gyi menli mɔɔ bɛ tumi wɔ aze la anwo zo la: Ɛhye kile kɛ kpɔkɛbɔlɛ 
tumi ne si de wɔ maanzinli, maangyeba nee azua azua ne mɔ azo la.
4. Bɛlɛ bɛ ngyehyɛnu: Wɔ ekpunli ne anu bɛhyehyɛ bɛ nu na ekpunli ko biala lɛ ɔ ti 
anwo gyima kpɔkyee mɔɔ ɔyɛ anzɛɛ kpɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔ a.
5. Bɛnea menli ekpunli ngyikyi bie azo.
6. Bɛlɛ ngitanwolilɛ adenle mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo a: Ngitanwolilɛ mɔɔ kɔ zo wɔ bɛ avinli la 
dua ngyehyɛleɛ fɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛdo ɛkɛ ne la azo.
7. Awie biala nee ye gyima: Ɛhye kile kɛ, dibelɛ biala lɛ ye gyima, ngamɔnu gyimayɛlɛ, 
ngitanwolilɛ mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo, yɛɛ kpɔkɛbɔlɛ nee mɔɔ bɛhyia bɛfi ko biala ɛkɛ ne la.
8. Dibelɛ ngakyile: Bɛlɛ dibelɛ ngakyile mɔɔ menli veɛvea bɛ bo sonle bɛ a. Ɛhye 
vi anwuma dibelɛ ne badwu aze ɛdeɛ ne azo. Mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala ngyehyɛleɛ 
ɛhye lɛ ndenle fɔɔnwo bie mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛyɛ debie a, na ɔlɛ nvasoɛ mɔɔ le kɛ 
maanle ɛgyinlanlɛ, nzuzulɛyɛlɛ nee mgbondabulɛ mɔɔ di munli a . Emomu, eza 
bɛlɛ sinlidɔlɛ mɔɔ le kɛ, kpɔkɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ ɛnyɛ ndɛ nee ninyɛne mɔɔ ye ɛhakyilɛ ɛnla 
aze la.
Tete maanle ɛbulɛ ne dibelɛ nidizo ne
Abobɔlɛ gyima
Wɔ bɛ ekpunli ne mɔ anu, bɛziezie tete maanle ɛbulɛ dibelɛ nidizo ngyehyɛleɛ ɛhye mɔ 
bɛmaa ɔhile kɛ tumililɛ ne si fi anwuma badwu aze wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo la.
azua zo arelemgbunli - maanle mgbanyinli - maanle arelemgbunli 
 - bia-sievoma
1. Ngyehyɛleɛ ne bahola azɔho ɛhye;
Maanle arelemgbunli→ azua zo arelemgbunli → bia-sievoma→ maanle mgbanyinli
2. Yɛkola yɛfɛlɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne mɔɔ wɔyɛ la dibelɛ nidizo.

Dibelɛ nidizo ne kile tumi mɔɔ menli mɔɔ bu maanle ne nee gyinlabelɛ mɔɔ menli 
mɔɔ veɛvea bɛ bo lɛ la. Ɔkile ngitanwolilɛ mɔɔ la dibelɛ ne mɔ avinli nee ɛleka mɔɔ 
ko biala tumililɛ ne kɔdwu yɛɛ menli mɔɔ bu mgbonda maa bɛ la.
Akee maa yɛnlea tete maanle ɛbulɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne anwo dibelɛ nidizo ne
Nvoninli 7.4: Tete maanle ɛbulɛ ngyehyɛlɛ ne
Saa ɛnea dibelɛ nidizo ne mɔɔ bɛhile ye wɔ anwuma ɛkɛ ne la a, ɔda ali wienyi kɛ tete 
maanle ɛbulɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne bɔ ɔ bo wɔ maanle belemgbunli ne anwo zo, ye ɛhyema 
ne yɛɛ bia-sievoma ne mɔ vea ɔ bo, akee suazo arelemgbunli, safohyenle nee maanle 
kɔmenle ne mɔ vea ɔ bo wɔ ɛhonlone ko azo, odikulo ne vea suazo arelemgbunli ne 
mɔ abo yɛɛ abusua kpanyinli ne doa bɛ.
Menli mɔɔ deda dibelɛ ne mɔ azo wɔ dibelɛ nidizo ne azo la ko biala lɛ ye gyima titili 
mɔɔ ɔdi a. Dibelɛ ɛhye mɔ bie nee bɛ gyima a bɛhile ye wɔ aze ɛke la.
Maanle arelemgbunli ne mɔ
Maanle arelemgbunli ne mɔ a deda maanle kpule ne mɔ anloa a. Bɛmɛ a bɛ tumi wɔ 
anwuma kpalɛ wɔ Nzema maanle ne anu a. Bɛdi bia ne anwo agya ne bɛfi mrɛladane 
nu wɔ bia ne anwo abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne anu. Yɛkola yɛfɛlɛ bɛ mbusua ngamɔnu 
arelemgbunli, ɔluakɛ yɛye bɛ yɛfi abusua ne mɔɔ lɛ sua ne azo senvia ne la anu. Bɛfa 
maandeɛ nyɛleɛ biala mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ bɛmaa bɛ la anu kolaa na bali bia ne. Kɛmɔ 
yɛdi bia ne wɔ mrɛladane nu la, saa bia bie tɔ mgbane na bɛnnyia nrenyia a, raalɛ kola 
di bia ne. Nzema fɛlɛ maanle belemgbunli ne awulae.
Gyima mɔɔ maanle belemgbunli ne di la
 Maanle belemgbunli ne di gyima ɛhye mɔ;
 1. Bɛle maanle kpule ne mgbanyinli.

 2. Bɛsi gyinla mɔɔ boa maanle kpule ne mɔɔ bɛnea zo la.
 3. Bɛmɛ a bɛla sumsum nu gyima nloa wɔ ezuavolɛ ne nee mɔwuamra avinli a.
 4. Bɛdi edwɛkɛ bɛsiezie menli avinli na bɛnea kɛ anzondwolɛ kɛra maanle ne anu.
 5. Bɛle azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛdi zolɛ belemgbunli la nee nwolɛ agyandeɛ ne mɔ amenle.
6. Bɛbɔ maandeɛ ne anwo bane na bɛkpogya ye.
 7. Bɛfa anyuhɔlɛ bɛbɛlɛ ezuavolɛ ne.
 8. Bɛdi edwɛkɛ na bɛbɔ kpɔkɛ wɔ edwɛkɛmiza mɔɔ fale maanyɛlɛ nee bɛ tɛnlabelɛ nu 
la anwo.
9. Bɛmɛ a bɛnea maanle ɛbulɛ ne anwo ndotolɛ a.
10. Bɛdi mɛla (maamɛla) na bɛnea bɛnwu kɛ pɛlepɛlelilɛ kɔ zo wɔ maanle ne anu.
Azua zo arelemgbunli
Ɛhye mɔ le arelemgbunli mɔɔ veɛvea maanle arelemgbunli ne mɔ abo a. Bɛmɛ a bɛnea 
azua ne mɔ mɔɔ veɛvea bɛ bo la azo a na bɛdi zolɛ tumi a. Bɛdi dibelɛ ne anwo agya 
wɔ abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne anu kɛ mɔɔ maanle arelemgbunli ne mɔ ɛdeɛ ne de la. Bɛdabɛ 
noko bɛfa biazielɛ ne anwo maamulɛ ne anu kɛ mɔɔ ɔfɛta la kolaa na bɛazie bɛ bia zo.
Gyima mɔɔ azua zo arelemgbunli ne mɔ di la
1. Saa maanle belemgbunli ɛnle ɛkɛ a, ɔgyinla ɔ gyakɛ anu ɔdi gyima mɔɔ ɔfɛta la.
2. Bɛnea bɛmaa anwobanebɔlɛ nee mɛla zo ɛlilɛ kɔ zo wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo.
3. Bɛdi edwɛkɛ wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo.
4. Bɛnea bɛmaa anzondwolɛ ba bɛ azua ne mɔ azo.
5. Saa nwolɛ ngyianlɛ ne ba a, bɛnea bɛbia bia ne bɛmaa ye aleɛ na bɛyɛ nwolɛ nyɛleɛ 
mɔɔ ɔfɛta la.
6. Bɛnea bɛsi ɛtanelilɛ nwo adenle wɔ bɛ maanle ne anu.
7. Bɛlɛ tumi kɛ bɛbɔ azɛlɛ mɔɔ vea bɛ bo la anwo bane.
8. Bɛnea menli ekpunli kpɔkyee bie anwo zo.
9. Bɛnea bɛmaa maanle ɛbulɛ ne kɔ zo na bɛfa ye guabelɛ ne bɛto maanle belemgbunli 
ne anyunlu.
Safohyenle ne
Bɛfɛlɛ ye ‘‘safohene’’ wɔ Akanema anu yɛɛ Anwɔnlama fɛlɛ ye “Aʋadada/ Aʋafia”.

Gyima mɔɔ safohyenle di la
1. Azavohyenle ne mɔ a di ezuavolɛ ne anyunlu kɔ konle a.
2. Bɛnea bɛmaa bɛdi mɛla zo na bɛbɔ ezuavolɛ ne anwo bane bɛfi maanle gyɛne 
ɛnwulonwunlanlɛ nwo.
3. Bɛkola bɛgyinla maanle belemgbunli anzɛɛ belemgbunli ekyi ne agyakɛ anu wɔ 
maanle ne anwo nzuzulɛ bie mɔɔ anwo hyia la anzɛɛ maanzonle bie anu.
Ɛhyema ne
Ɛhyema ne mɔ a la mraalɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ azua ne mɔ azo la anloa wɔ sunsum nu a yɛɛ 
bɛmɛ a bɛze abusua biazielɛ ne anwo tetedwɛkɛ a. Bɛdi gyima titili bɛmaa mraalɛ nee 
ngakula mraalɛ wɔ bɛ azua ne mɔ azo. Wɔ nleka nleka mɔɔ bɛdi bia wɔ mrɛladane nu 
la, ɛhyema ne mɔ a kile awie fɔɔnwo mɔɔ kola di bia wɔ suakunlu abusua ne anu a. 
Bɛkola bɛye ɛhyema ngyikyi mɔɔ veɛvea bɛ bo na bɛsonle bɛ a.
Gyima mɔɔ ɛhyema ne mɔ di la
1. Bɛboa arelemgbunli ne mɔ wɔ tete maanle ɛbulɛ ne anu.
2. Bɛnea bɛdi mraalɛ nee ngakula mraalɛ mɔɔ wɔ azua ne mɔ azo la avinli edwɛkɛ.
3. Bɛdi gyima bɛkpogya mraalɛ fanwodi nee azua anyuhɔlɛ zo.
4. Suakunlu abusua ɛlɔnwɔne ne nee ye bialilɛ ne anwo tetedwɛkɛ vea bɛ sa nu.
5. Bɛdi maandeɛ nwo sunsum nu gyima bɛmaa ngakula mraalɛ ne mɔ na bɛnea bɛnwu 
kɛ, bɛbabɔ ɛdane, bɛlɛ anzondwolɛ nee boɛlilɛ yɛɛ ninyɛne bie mɔ.
Maanle kɔmenle ne
Kɔmenle ne a la maanle ne anloa wɔ sunsum nu wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ menli ekpunli ne fa 
maandeɛ di gyima la a. Ɔle ayileyɛvo yɛɛ ɔgyi ɛnyelɛzo nee susum nu ewiade ne avinli.
Gyima mɔɔ maanle kɔmenle ne di la
1. Saa belemgbunli ɛnle ɛkɛ a bɛkola bɛgyinla ɔ gyakɛ anu bɛdi gyima kɛ mɔɔ ɔfɛta la.
2. Bɛbɔ ezuavolɛ ne anwo bane wɔ sunsum nu.
3. Bɛye ɛdɛne na bɛbu sunsum nu maamulɛ wɔ azubɔlɛ, belemgbunli ɛzielɛ nee ye 
ɛdulɛ nu.
4. Bɛkilehile ɛlalɛ nee yekile bo na bɛkile munzule nwo sɔbelɛ wɔ sunsum nu.
5. Bɛbɔ ezuavolɛ ne mgbanyidwɛkɛ, maamɛla nee bɛ maandeɛ ne anwo bane.
6. Bɛyɛ menli mɔɔ kɛnyia sunsum nu ngyegyelɛ la ayile.

Bia-sievo/Bia-sievoma
Ɔle sonla anzɛɛ menli mɔɔ nea ye belemgbunli fofolɛ maa bɛsie ye bia zo na bɛboa 
bɛmaa maanle ɛbulɛ ne kɔ zo la. Saa bia bie tɔ mgbane a, ekpunli ɛhye yia bɔ kpɔkɛ 
ye awie mɔɔ kola di bia ne la.
Gyima mɔɔ Bia-sievoma di la
1. Bɛnea bɛye awie mɔɔ kola di bia ne la na bɛsie ye bia zo.
2. Saa belemgbunli kɔ mrɛlatɛlɛ nu a, bɛnea bɛbu ɔ nwo maamulɛ.
3. Bɛkola bɛtu belemgbunli wɔ bia zo.
4. Bɛye belemgbunli fofolɛ ne bɛkile maanle mgbanyinli nee ezuavolɛ ne.
5. Bɛtu belemgbunli ne folɛ.
6. Bɛdi edwɛkɛ na bɛsiezie menli avinli.
7. Bɛnea bɛnwu ye kɛ dibelɛ mɔɔ awie ko lɛ na ɔlɛfi ɔ sa yeahɔ awie fofolɛ asa nu la 
anwo maamulɛ kɔ zo kɛ mɔɔ ɔfɛta la.
8. Bɛmɛ a bɛkile mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ awie yɛ kolaa na yeahola yeali bia la a.
Maanle kpɔmavolɛ ne
Maanle kpɔmavolɛ ne noko di gyima dɔɔnwo wɔ maanle ne anu. Maanle kpɔmavolɛ 
ne gyima mɔɔ ɔdi la kola kakyihakyi, ɔluakɛ ɛhye gyi kɛ menli ekpunli ne si bu bɛ 
maandeɛ nwo maamulɛ nee ngyehyɛleɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ la azo. Maanle kpɔmavolɛ ne gyima 
mɔɔ anwo hyia la bie a le ɛhye mɔ;
1. Bɛmɛ a bɛtendɛ belemgbunli ne anloa zo a. Bɛfa belemgbunli ne anloa edwɛkɛ 
bɛmaa ezuavolɛ ne.
2. Bɛmɛ a bɛdi belemgbunli ne anyunlu wɔ ɛlɔne nu a.
3. Saa bɛbiza belemgbunli amaneɛ a bɛmɛ a bɛbɔ a. Bɛtendɛ bɛmaa belemgbunli ne.
4. Bɛdɛ belemgbunli ne kpɔma ne.
5. Bɛfa ezuavolɛ anzɛɛ nyɛvolɛ edwɛkɛ bɛto belemgbunli ne anyunlu na bɛava 
belemgbunli ne ɛdeɛ bɛado ezuavolɛ ne anyunlu.
Gyima 7�7 Tete maanle ɛbulɛ dibelɛ nidizo ngyehyɛleɛ ne
Da dibelɛ nidizo ne mɔɔ kile wɔ suazo maanle ɛbulɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne la ali . Fa 
ngyehyɛleɛ ne mɔɔ wɔhile la toto sukoavoma mɔɔ ɛ nee bɛ gyi bango ko na bɛvi 
azua gyɛne zo la ɛdeɛ ne mɔ anwo.

Gyima 7�8 Gyima mɔɔ maanle mgbanyima ne mɔ di la
1. Ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo ɛkenga adawu ezinra ne mɔɔ wɔ aze ɛke la na bɛhile gyima mɔɔ 
menli ɛhye mɔ ko biala di wɔ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛdi bɛsiezie mbusuama ne avinli 
la anu.
a. Maanle belemgbunli ne b. Suazo belemgbunli ne c. Abusuakpanyinli ne      
d. Maanle mgbanyima ne mɔ.
2. Fa wɔ nyelebɛnloa ne to gua maa sukoavoma ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti ɛwowɔ adwenle 
wɔ nwolɛ.
Wɔ maanle ekyi bie mɔɔ wɔ Aŋlᴐ, mɔɔ wɔ anwɔnla maanzinli ne mɔɔ wɔ Gana la 
anu, edwɛkɛ zile ɛyazonlɛnli Kofitse nee ɔ diema nrenyia kpanyinli ne ara Agbeko 
avinli. Kofitse bɔle Agbeko somolɛ kɛ, ɔlɛfa ye abusua azɛlɛ kyɛfoa ɛdeɛ ne yeazi 
ye sua. Agbeko ɔdaye ɔkile a, ɔ nlenyia mɔɔ ɛhɔ ye ɛkɛla nzi la a vale azɛlɛ ne 
maanle ye a. Bɛ abusua kpanyinli ne yiale bɛ kɛ ɔkɛde bɛ edwɛkɛ ne abo. Nzinlii, 
mɔɔ ndelebɛbo anyɛ gyima la, maanle belemgbunli ne vɛlɛle abusua ayia kɛ ɔsiezie 
edwɛkɛ ne. Bɛzele mgbanyinli mɔɔ wɔ abusua ne anu la kɛ , bɛyɛ nvedenvedenu 
bɛkpondɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ anwo ɛra edwɛkɛ ne la amenle. Belemgbunli ekyi (suazo 
belmgbunli) ne nee bɛ dɛnlanle aze kɛ ɔdi edwɛkɛ ne.
Gyima 7�9 Gyima mɔɔ maanle mgbanyinli ne mɔ di la
Menli bie kile a, tete ne mɔɔ ɛnee maanle mgbanyinli a di edwɛkɛ la, ɛnee bɛnyia 
adenyia sikalɛ wɔ pɛlepɛlelilɛ nee edwɛkɛlilɛ nwo tɛla ɛnɛ mɔɔ adwuleso edwɛkɛlilɛ 
ngyehyɛleɛ ne ɛra la. Ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo ɛhɛlɛ bɛ adwenle nzuzulɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ wɔ edwɛkɛ 
ɛhye anwo la na bɛdo ye gua bɛmaa sukoavoma ne ɛzu nwolɛ kpolera.
Gyima 7�10 Tete maanle ɛbulɛ
“Tete maanle ɛbulɛ adenle ne le maamulɛ mɔɔ ɛkpanwo a”. Wɔ bɛ ekpunli ngakyile ne 
mɔ anu, bɛhɛlɛ kpolerazulɛ nwobie wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anwo bɛhile kɛ bɛzua ɔ nzi anzɛɛ 
bɛnzua ɔ nzi. Bɛdo bɛ adwenle nzuzulɛ ne gua bɛmaa sukoavoma ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti 
ɛwowɔ adwenle wɔ nwolɛ.
Gyima 7�11 Maanle ɛbulɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ngakyile nwiɔ ne anwo 
ndotonwoyɛlɛ
Wɔ bɛ ekpunli ne mɔ anu, bɛva nvasoɛ mɔɔ wɔ tete maanle ɛbulɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne 
anwo la bɛtoto adwuleso ɛdeɛ ne anwo na bɛhile sinlidɔlɛ mɔɔ wɔ ko biala anwo 
la. Ndonwo, pɛlepɛlelilɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne mɔɔ bɛwowɔ nwolɛ adwenle wɔ gyima 7.9 
ne anu la, anwobanebɔlɛ, ɛyazonlɛ nee mɔɔ ɛha la.

Tete Maanle Ɛbulɛ
MUKENYE
Ngyɛnu ɛhye buke tete nee adwuleso edwɛkɛlilɛ ndenle ne mɔ anye. Ɔwowɔ adwenle 
wɔ tete (maamulɛ) nee adwuleso (kɔɔto) ngyehyɛleɛ ne nee bɛ gyima mɔɔ bɛdi la 
anwo. Ɛbava bɛ gyima mɔɔ bɛdi la wɔatoto nwo na wɔahile ɛweɛne mɔɔ la bɛ avinli 
la na wɔagyinla zo wɔazi ɛ ti anwo agyinla. Adwenle nee ndelebɛbo mɔɔ ɛbanyia ye 
wɔ tete edwɛkɛlilɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne nee adwuleso edwɛkɛlilɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne anwo la 
baboa amaa wɔava ɛ nwo wɔawula kabiemaamengabie maanle ɛbulɛ ne anu na wɔayɛ 
wɔ dasanli fanwodi ne anwo gyima. Eza ɔbaboa ɛdawɔ mumua ne amaa wɔanyia 
adwenle mɔɔ dwenle fɔɔnwo nee sukoanyia fɔɔnwo mɔɔ baboa amaa wɔabɔ kpɔkɛ na 
wɔayɛ maanle sonla mɔɔ ze ye fanwodi nee gyima mɔɔ beta nwolɛ la.
Mɔɔ boka ye bieko a le kɛ, ɔbaboa amaa wɔanyia adiabo adwenle na wɔanyia anyelielɛ 
wɔ ndoazo nwomazukoalɛ le kɛ mɛla, maanyɛlɛ nee maanle maanle ngitanwolilɛ 
ɛzukoalɛdeɛ nu ɔboalekɛ ɔ nee ɛzukoalɛdeɛ bie le kɛ Maanle Ɛbulɛ nee Tetedwɛkɛ lua 
adenle ko azo.
ADWENLE TITILI
• Adwuleso (kɔɔto) edwɛkɛlilɛ azokoɛleɛ ne kilehile maanle ne mɛla mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ la anu 
na ɔfa ɔdi gyima. Gana maanle ne edwɛkɛlilɛ azokoɛleɛ ne lɛ ngyehyɛleɛ mɔɔ kile 
kɛ bɛ tumililɛ ne si didi zo mɔɔ Kɔɔto Ɛrɛladane ne a ye tumi ne wɔ anwuma kpalɛ a.
• Tete edwɛkɛlilɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne gyinla maamɛla zo a di edwɛkɛ a.
• Wɔ adwuleso edwɛkɛlilɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne anu, arane menli (gyɛɛgyema) mɔɔ yeye bɛ 
yezie ɛkɛ ne la a nea di edwɛkɛ na bɛtoto ninyɛne a.
• Wɔ tete edwɛkɛlilɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne anu, arelemgbunli anzɛɛ maanle mgbanyinli a nea 
di edwɛkɛ na bɛfa boɛ bɛto boɛ a.

Ndwenlenwo Kpuyia
Kɛlɛ mɛla nsa mɔɔ wɔ awovolɛma ɛhyehyɛ na bɛfa bɛdi gyima wɔ suanu la. Eza kɛlɛ 
ndenle nsa mɔɔ wɔ awovolɛma dua zo siezie ɛ nee ɛ mediema ne mɔ avinli edwɛkɛ la. 
Fa wɔ nyelebɛnloa ne to sukoavoma mɔɔ ɛha la kɔsɔɔti anyunlu.

Edwɛkɛlilɛ Ngyehyɛleɛ Ne
Edwɛkɛlilɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne a le adenle mɔɔ kɔɔto ne anzɛɛ edwɛkɛlilɛ ɛleka ne dua zo 
kilehile mɛla nu na bɛfa mɛla ne mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la bɛdi gyima la.
Gyima mɔɔ Edwɛkɛlilɛ Azokoɛleɛ ne Di la
Gyima mɔɔ edwɛkɛlilɛ azokoɛleɛ ne di la a le ɛhye:
1. Bɛkilehile mɛla nu na bɛfa bɛdi gyima kɛ mɔɔ ɔfɛta la.
2. Bɛnea bɛnwu kɛ mgbondabulɛ mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ kɔ zo wɔ maanle ne 
anu.
3. Bɛbɔ dasanli fanwodi nwo bane, mɔɔ le kɛ mɔɔ mɛla ɛrɛladane ne anzɛɛ mɛla mɔɔ 
wɔ dasanli fanwodi nwo kile la.
4. Bɛnea bɛfa mɛla ne bɛdi gyima wɔ ye adenle zo mɔɔ bɛnyɛ nyeyenu a.
5. Bɛdi na bɛsiezie menli, eku eku, nee aranenu gyima ngakyile avinli edwɛkɛ.
6. Bɛdua ɛdoanlɛ, menli mumua ne avinli ɛziezielɛ nee agyinlanulilɛ adenle zo 
bɛsiezie edwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔnva kɔɔto ngyehyɛleɛ ne ɔnli gyima a.
7. Bɛfa bɛ nye bɛdi arane ngane ne mɔɔ bu maanle ne nee mɛlalilɛ ayiaku ne gyima 
mɔɔ bɛdi la anzi amaa bɛayɛ mɔɔ mɛla ɛrɛladane ne kile kɛ bɛyɛ la.
8. Bɛgyinla maanle ne agyakɛ anu bɛbua amumuyɛma ndɛne.
9. Bɛko bɛmaa menli mɔɔ bɛkɛsɛmaa bɛ wɔ amumuyɛ edwɛkɛ nwo la.
Adwuleso Edwɛkɛlilɛ Ngyehyɛleɛ Ne
Gana maanle ne edwɛkɛlilɛ azokoɛleɛ ne lɛ ngyehyɛleɛ mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛ tumililɛ ne si 
didi zo la. Ɛhye mɔ a le:
1. Kɔɔto Ɛrɛladane ne a le kɔɔto mɔɔ ye tumi ne wɔ anwuma kpalɛ a.
2. Mɔɔ doa ye la a le Edwɛkɛlilɛ-Nzi Edwɛkɛlilɛ Kɔɔto/Ndoazo Kɔɔto.
3. Maanzinli Kɔɔto ne a le kɔɔto mɔɔ di maanzinli ne anu edwɛkɛ a.
4. Maanzikyi Kɔɔto nee Maangyeba Kɔɔto a le kɔɔto ngyikyi mɔɔ di abusua nu nee 
edwɛkɛ ngyikyi la.
5. Mbɛda kɔɔto ne noko boka kɔɔto ngyikyi ne mɔ mɔɔ di mbɛda mɔɔ ɛtɛnyianle 
ɛvolɛ bulu nee mɔtwɛ (18) la edwɛkɛ la.
Gyima mɔɔ kɔɔto ne di la
Kɔɔto ne kilehile na ɔmaa bɛfa mɛla mɔɔ le kɛ awulilɛ mɛla anzɛɛ mɔɔ ɛnle awulilɛ 
mɛla yɛɛ gyimayɛlɛ mɛla bɛdi gyima eza ɔkile adenle fɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfa mɛla 
bie bɛdi gyima la.
Wɔ Gana maanle ye anu, Ndɛnebuavolɛ Kpanyinli mɔɔ le ndɛnebuavoma kɔsɔɔti 
tumivolɛ ne la a di edwɛkɛ wɔ kɔɔto ɛrɛladane ne anu a. Yɛlɛ gyɛɛgyema, magyeseletima,

Kɔɔto nee Kɔɔto Ɛrɛladane ne anu. Ɔwɔ kɛ gyɛɛgyema mɔɔ di edwɛkɛ ne la dodo 
ne yɛ mɔɔ ɛkyɛ bɛ nu a ɔgua mgbata la.
3. Ɔdwu mekɛ ne bie a, gyɛɛgye ko nee kpanuvolɛ (awie mɔɔ ɛnle gyɛɛgye) mɔɔ lɛ 
edwɛkɛ ne anwo adwenle la tɛnla na ɔkilehile ye ninyɛne bie mɔ anye zo nee mɔɔ 
ɔfɛta kɛ ɔnwu ye la.
4. Magyeseleti ko di edwɛkɛ wɔ Maangyeba/Magyeseleti Kɔɔto nu.
5. Anzondwolɛ Pɛlepɛledivo di edwɛkɛ ngyikyingyikyi wɔ Maangyeba Kɔɔto nu.
Nvoninli 8.1: Nvoninli ne kile adwuleso edwɛkɛlilɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne nee nuhua menli bie mɔ
Ndenle mɔɔ Adwuleso Edwɛkɛkɛlilɛ Ngyehyɛleɛ ne 
Dua zo Di Edwɛkɛ la
Ngyehyɛleɛ ne nee ndenle mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛdi edwɛkɛ la ɛngyi ɛleka ko, ɛhye gyi kɔɔto 
holɛ mɔɔ di edwɛkɛ ne la, edwɛkɛ holɛ ne yɛɛ ngyinlazo ne mɔɔ ɔlua zo a edwɛkɛ ne 
zile la azo. Ndenle titili ne mɔ a le ɛhye:
1. Menli mɔɔ manzonle ne ɛdɔ bɛ avinli la fa edwɛkɛ ne kɔ kɔɔto kɛ sɛmaavolɛ.
2. Kɔɔto ne fa ɛsɛmaalɛ kɛlata kɔmaa mɔɔ bɛsɛmaa ye la na ɔtwe ye ɔba kɔɔto ɛkɛ.

la.
4. Bɛkile edwɛkɛ ne anwo daselɛlilɛ na bɛbizebiza dasevoma ne kpuyia bɛtie mɔɔ

Kakye kɛ: Mekɛ ne bie dwu a menli mɔɔ lɛ edwɛkɛ ne la kola sɛlɛ kɔɔto ne na bɛye

Gyima 8�1 Edwɛkɛlilɛ Ngyehyɛleɛ Ne
Wɔ bɛ ekpunli ngakyile ne mɔ anu, bɛhile nleka nwiɔ mɔɔ bɛsiezie edwɛkɛ mɔɔ 
maanzonle wɔ nwolɛ la. Bɛmaa ekpunli ngakyile mɔɔ ɛha la ɛnwu nleka zɔhane 
mɔ.
Gyima 8�2 Gana Edwɛkɛlilɛ Ngyehyɛleɛ Ne
Bɛgua bɛ nwo ekpunli nu, mɔɔ ekpunli ko biala anu menli kɛyɛ nsa anzɛɛ nna la, 
na bɛye tidwɛkɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ aze ɛke la anu ngoko na bɛhile bɛ adwenle bɛha 
nwolɛ edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛhola la. Bɛva bɛ edwɛkɛ ne bɛdo sukoavoma mɔɔ ɛha 
la anyunlu na bɛziezie bɛ nwo kɛ bɛkɛdie ekpunli gyɛne ngilehilenu ɛdeɛ ne. Akee 
bɛhɛlɛlɛ debie bɛva bɛ tidwɛkɛ ɛdeɛ ne noko anwo.
1. Kilehile kɛ adwuleso edwɛkɛlilɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne si de la anu.
2. Kilehile menli mɔɔ nea toto adwuleso edwɛkɛlilɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne anwo ndotolɛ 
la ko biala anwo nvasoɛ.
3. Wowɔ adwenle wɔ ndenle mɔɔ Gana adwuleso edwɛkɛlilɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne dua 
zo di edwɛkɛ la anwo.

Kodwo nee Koasi le sukoavoma mɔɔ gyi bango ko a. Eza bɛ mu nwiɔ bɛle

Tete edwɛkɛlilɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne kile maandeɛ adenle ne anzɛɛ pɛlepɛlelilɛ maamɛla 
ne mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛdi edwɛkɛ wɔ azua ne mɔ azo la, mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ ɛkɛ kolaa na 
adwuleso ɛdeɛ ne ara la. Bɛdua anloanudwɛkɛ adenle zo a bɛkakyi tete edwɛkɛlilɛ 
ngyehyɛleɛ ne nee nwolɛ ndenle ne mɔ bɛmaa awolɛ-ndoazo fofolɛ a. Menli mɔɔ nea 
maa bɛfa ngyehyɛleɛ ɛhye bɛdi gyima wɔ edwɛkɛlilɛ nu la a le arelemgbunli, maanle 
mgbanyinli, mbusua mgbanyinli yɛɛ menli mɔɔ lɛ ɛbulɛ wɔ azua ne mɔ azo la.

Ɛhye kile ndenle mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛsiezie edwɛkɛ anzɛɛ manzonle mɔɔ ye adiabo ne gyi 
maandeɛ, maamɛla nee nyɛleɛ mɔɔ aneɛ ekpunli bie lɛ la azo la. Sua ko biala azo lɛ ye 
deɛ mɔɔ ɔdua zo ɔnea kɛ koyɛlɛ nee anzondwolɛ bara sua ne azo a. Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛdua 
maamulɛ adenle zo bɛsiezie la bie mɔ a le abusua nu edwɛkɛ, azɛlɛ, edwɛkɛ mɔɔ fale 
kyibadeɛmuluzo, ndanedonlɛ yɛɛ mɛlɛbɛla nwo la.
Kɛ bɛsi bɛsiezie edwɛkɛ wɔ maamulɛ adenle zo la
Ndenle mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛdi edwɛkɛ wɔ maamulɛ adenle zo la a le;
1. Agyinlanulilɛ: Ɛhye le edwɛkɛ ɛziezielɛ adenle mɔɔ awie mɔɔ anwo ɛnle edwɛkɛ 
ne anu la tu ɔ nwo sie ɛkɛ siezie menli ne avinli la. Wɔ adenle ɛhye azo, ahenle ne 
mɔɔ siezie edwɛkɛ ne la ɛngyinla mɛla zo a ɔsiezie edwɛkɛ ne a.
2. Ɛsɛmaanlɛ: Ɛhye le edwɛkɛ ɛziezielɛ mɔɔ bɛgyinla maamɛla nee nyɛleɛ bie mɔ 
azo a bɛbua la. Menli mɔɔ di edwɛkɛ ne la a le arelemgbunli, mbusua mgbanyinli, 
maanle mgbanyinli nee menli titili bie mɔ.
3. Ɛdoanlɛ: Ɛhye le adenle mɔɔ bɛdua mbusua mgbanyinli anzɛɛ mgbanyinli bie mɔ 
anwo zo bɛmaa anzondwolɛ nee koyɛlɛ ba menli ne avinli la.
4. Mɔɔ menli mumua ne siezie bɛ avinli la: Ɛhye le adwenlenwowɔ mɔɔ kɔ zo wɔ 
menli ne mɔɔ ɛnyia edwɛkɛ ne la avinli na bɛdi bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ bɛmaa anzondwolɛ

Kɛ tete adenle mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛdi edwɛkɛ la si di gyima wɔ yɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu la ɛ?
Ɔlua wɔ kilehilevolɛ ne anzɛɛ wɔ suazo moalɛ zo, ɔwɔ kɛ ɛmaa sua ne azo kpanyinli 
bie mɔɔ ze adenle mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛdi edwɛkɛ wɔ maamulɛ adenle zo kpalɛ la wowɔ 
adwenle wɔ nwolɛ kile bɛ.

kɛ ɛkɛbiza la
2. Bɛ nee maanle kpanyinli ne ɛwowɔ adwenle – bɔ mɔdenle kɛlɛhɛlɛ adwenle 
titili bie mɔ fa yɛ ngakyelɛ.
3. Bɛwie a, ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo mɔ ɛwowɔ adwenle wɔ menli mɔɔ di edwɛkɛ ne la nee 
bɛ gyima mɔɔ bɛdi la anwo.
4. Fa tete nee adwuleso ndenle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛdua zo bɛdi edwɛkɛ la toto nwolɛ 
kile sukoavoma mɔɔ ɛha la.

MUKENYE
Wɔ ngyɛnu ɛhye anu, bɛbala adwenle mɔɔ wɔ agyebɛ nee agyiba ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ 
vea Nzema anloanudwɛkɛ ngane ne abo la ali bɛahile wɔ. Bɛli moa bɛbuke ɛzukoalɛdeɛ 
mɔɔ le kɛ ɛdɛneyelɛ nee mraalɛ ɛzunlɛ azo bɛhile wɔ wɔ alimoa ɛvolɛ ne anu. Wɔ 
agyebɛ nee agyiba ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ye abo, ɛbanleɛnlea agyebɛ nee agyiba ngakyile ne 
mɔ nee subane mɔɔ bɛlɛ la. Ngyɛnu ɛhye anwo ɛngyia wɔ Nzema aneɛ ne angome kye 
ɛzukoalɛ nu, na eza nwolɛ hyia wɔ ɛzukoalɛdeɛ mɔɔ zuozua aneɛ ne mɔɔ le kɛ Nrelenza 
edwɛkɛ ɛzukoalɛdeɛ ne la. Eza ngyɛnu ɛhye baboa amaa wɔanyia sukoanyia mɔɔ anwo 
hyia la amaa wɔ aneɛ ne ɛzukoalɛ ahɔ ɔ nyunlu na yeawula wɔ ngyegyelɛ nloa sɔbelɛ 
anwosesebɛ ne anu. Agyebɛ nee agyiba le anyelielɛ adenle mɔɔ yɛfa yɛsiezie adwenle 
ne a, ɔboa wɔ debie fofolɛyɛlɛ nu, na ɔmaa yɛkola yɛdwenle ɛdwenlenlɛ mɔɔ anu yɛ se 
a. Tɛ ndonwo ne mɔ amuala a bɛmaa la. Ɛhye kile kɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ.

• Agyebɛ le kpuyia, edwɛkɛhanlɛ anzɛɛ agyibadolɛ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ hyia ndwenlenwo 
kpalɛ na wɔanyia ye sɔbelɛ la. Mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala, agyebɛ to agyiba, ɔngile deɛ 
fɔɔnwo ne anzɛɛ ɔbɛlɛbɛla na ye nyelebɛnloa le azibɛnwo anzɛɛ anyelielɛ a.
• Bɛkola bɛfa agyebɛ nee agyiba bɛdielie bɛ nye, bɛfa bɛsiezie adwenle ne, anzɛɛ bɛdi 
nwomazukoalɛ gyima bie mɔ.
• Agyebɛ kola boa wɔ wɔ adenle mɔɔ ɛdua zo ɛfa aneɛ ɛdi gyima la azo, mɛla adenle 
zo, yɛɛ adwenlebɔlɛ mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo nee kɛ ɛsi ɛdwenle la anwo.
AGYEBƐ
Agyebɛ a le nwɔhoa mɔɔ bɛdua aneɛ, edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ nee agyiba ɛdolɛ adenle zo bɛsɔ

Gyima 9�4 Subane mɔɔ agyebɛ lɛ la
Ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo ɛnleɛnlea agyebɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ aze ɛke la anu na bɛlua agyebɛ subane 
ne mɔɔ bɛhile ye wɔ anwuma ɛkɛ ne la azo bɛhyehyɛ agyebɛ ne anu. Ɔwɔ kɛ 
bɛsuzu nyelebɛnloa ne noko anwo. Bɛla nyelebɛnloa ne ali bɛhile sukoavoma ne 
mɔ kɔsɔɔti.
“Debie bie wɔ ɛkɛ o, ɔndo aleɛ noko aleɛkye a ɔdi aleɛ dedee aleɛdwo. Duzu debie

Ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛnea wɔ agyebɛ nvefenuyɛlɛ nu 
la
Saa ɛyɛ agyebɛ nvefenu a, ɔwɔ kɛ ɛneɛnlea aneɛ ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛhɛlɛ la, ye subane nee 
ninyɛne mɔɔ baboa wɔ amaa wɔanyia nyelebɛnloa ne la. Moalɛ ndenle mɔɔ baboa 
amaa wɔayɛ nvefenu ne la bie a wɔ aze ɛke la:
1. To ɛ rɛle aze kenga ye boɛ: Nyia abotane kenga agyebɛ ne fane dɔɔnwo na nwu ye 
kɛ wɔde edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ nee ɛdendɛsinli ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ nu la abo.
2. Kpondɛ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ titili ne mɔ: Yɛ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ, ɛdendɛsinli nee nzizodwɛkɛ 
mɔɔ wɔ agyebɛ ne anu la nzonlɛ.
3. Kpondɛ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ mɔɔ lɛ ngilenu mɔɔ bo ko la: Agyebɛ ta fa edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ 
mɔɔ bɛ ngilenu bo ko la di gyima. Kpondɛ zɛhae edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔ na neɛnlea 
ngilenu ngakyile ne mɔɔ ko biala lɛ la.
4. Neɛnlea ye subane ne: Maa wɔ adwenle ɛhɔ kɛ bɛzi bɛhɛlɛ agyebɛ ne la azo. Nea 
mɔlebɛbo ne, ye subane ɛhilelɛ ne, edwɛkɛmiza ne, yɛɛ kɛ ɔsi ɔtwe adwenle la.
5. Kpondɛ ngyehyɛleɛ nee ngitanwolilɛ: Kpondɛ ngitanwolilɛ mɔɔ la edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ, 
adwenle anzɛɛ ndelebɛbo ne mɔ avinli la.
6. Dwenle ninyɛne dɔɔnwo anwo: Dua adwenlebɔlɛ zo na neɛnlea adwenle ngakyile 
anzɛɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛfinde la.
7. Yeye nyelebɛnloa mɔɔ anye la ɛkɛ ne la fi nuhua: Mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala, agyebɛ ɛnga 
deɛ ne mɔɔ ɔkile la anwo edwɛkɛ fɔɔnwo ne. Ɔfa ɔdua debie gyɛne zo. Yeye mɔɔ 
ɔkɛha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ fɔɔnwo la fi nuhua.
8. Yɛ nzuzulɛ mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo la: Dua sukoanwu mɔɔ ɛlɛ la azo na suzu kɛ nyelebɛnloa 
ne bazi ayɛ la.

wɔnyia ye la le fɔɔnwo a.
10. Sukoa: Mekɛ dodo ne ala mɔɔ ɛlɛneɛnlea agyebɛ nu, na ɛlɛsukoa nwolɛ debie la,

4. Kile adwenle mɔɔ di munli la na gyakyi kɛ ɛkɛha kɛ, ‘medwenle kɛ’.
Gyima 9�5 Agyebɛ nwɔhoa ne
Bɔ ɔ bo kɛ ɛnwo agyebɛ ezinra ko wɔamaa ɛ gɔnwo mɔɔ ɛ nee ye de nwolɛ la. Saa 
ɛkola ɛye ye deɛ ne anloa a, fa wɔ agyebɛ ɛdeɛ ne biza ye maa ɔye ɔ nloa. Ahenle 
mɔɔ kɛbiza agyebɛ dɔɔnwo na ɔkɛye dɔɔnwo anloa fɔɔnwo la a ɛli konim a.
AGYIBA
Agyiba a le nwɔhoa anzɛɛ ngyegyelɛ mɔɔ hyia adwenle, ɛdwenlenlɛ mɔɔ anu mia nee 
adwenlebɔlɛ kolaa na bɛazɔ anzɛɛ bɛaye ɔ nloa la. Bɛkola bɛka ye bɛ nloa anu. Bɛta 
bɛfa agyiba bɛdielie bɛ nye, bɛfa bɛsukoa debie, yɛɛ ɔsiezie adwenle ne ɔmaa nuhua 
buke. Bɛboa bɛmaa yɛdwenle yɛkɔ moa, yɛnyia sukoanyia mɔɔ yɛfa yɛsɔ ngyegyelɛ 
nloa, yɛkakye debie na yɛdwenledwenle ninyɛne mɔ wɔ anwomanyunlu la anwo.
Gyima ngakyile mɔɔ agyiba di la
Agyiba di gyima ngakyile dɔɔnwo wɔ nleka mɔɔ bɛkɛvinde la.
1. Ɔbuke adwenle nu: Ɔboa ɔmaa yɛnwu kɛ yɛbazi yɛazɔ ngyegyelɛ bie anloa la, 
ɔmaa yɛdwenle yɛkɔ moa na eza yɛdwenle fɔɔnwo, bɔbɔ ngakula.
2. Ɔmaa anyelielɛ: Agyiba maa mgbanyinli nee ngakula muala anye die. Eza ɔmaa 
bɛdie bɛ ɛnwomenle.
3. Nwomazukoalɛ: Ɔboa ɔmaa menli sukoa debie, bɛnyia fasie na ɔmaa bɛte 
ɛzukoalɛdeɛ mɔɔ le kpomgbondee le kɛ Mgbonda, Abɔdeɛnwo Nrɛlɛbɛ yɛɛ Aneɛ 
abo.
4. Ɔle ayile: Ɔboa ɔmaa bɛsiezie adwenle ne, ɔye ɛvɛlɛ ɔfi yɛ nu na ɔboa adwenlenu 
kpɔkɛdelɛ.
5. Ɔka menli ɔbɔ nu: Ɔkile ngitanwolilɛ mɔɔ la menli avinli, koyɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ 
gyima yɛɛ adwelielɛ.

6. Ɔsiezie adwenle ne: Ɔboa ɔmaa yɛtwe yɛ adwenle yɛsie debie zo, yɛdwenle debie 
nwo, na yɛkile nwolɛ nyelebɛnloa ne ndɛndɛ zo. Ɔmmaa adwenle ne ɛnla.
7. Ɔboa ɔmaa yɛbɔ adwenle: Ɔboa ɔmaa yɛbɔ adwenle mɔɔ fa ninyɛne fofolɛyɛlɛ ba 
na yɛdua zo yɛnyia ninyɛne/adwenle fofolɛ.
8. Ɔboa ɔmaa yɛsɔ adwenle ne gyinlabelɛ yɛnea na yɛbu nwolɛ mgbonda:

9. Ɔle adawubɔlɛ nee kolakoladulɛ: Ɔboa edwɛkɛ nu ngitanwolilɛ, ɛzinzelɛ nee ye 
ngyehyɛleɛyɛlɛ.
10. Ɔboa wɔ nvedenvedenuyɛlɛ nee abɔdeɛnwo nrɛlɛbɛ ɛzukoalɛ nu: Ɔboa ɔmaa 
bɛsukoa kɛ sonla adwenle si di ye gyima la, subane, yɛɛ kpɔkɛbɔlɛ ndenle.
11. Ɔboa sonla ɛnyilɛ nu: Ɔdua nyelebɛnloa nwo abazobɔlɛ zo ɔmaa awie nyia

12. Ɔboa wɔ adenyia nee ngamɔnulilɛ nu: Ɔboa ɔmaa menli mɔɔ abo vi nleka

Agyiba di gyima dɔɔnwo na eza ɔlɛ nvasoɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ maa ɔsonle bolɛ wɔ sonla 
ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nu a.

Agyiba ne
Wɔ namule ekyi bie mbuluku ɛgengalɛ nee ɛzielɛ ɛleka ne, buluku bie mɔɔ ye ɛnyianlɛ 
ɛnla aze la ɛminli. Mbuluku ɛzielɛ ɛleka ne neazovo ne bizale menli nna mɔɔ bɛvale 
bɛ nye bɛzule bɛ la nwolɛ edwɛkɛ. Bɛmɛ a le: Bɛneɛ, Agyako, Ebambe nee Ɛlea. Nuhua 
ko biala hanle ye tendile:
1. Bɛneɛ: ‘‘Meanva buluku ne. Anoma menwunle ye kɛ Agyako lɛ’’.
2. Agyako: ‘‘Meanva buluku ne. Menze debie bɔbɔ mɔɔ ɔzɔho ye a’’.
3. Ebambe: ‘‘Menwule kɛ Ɛlea ɛva buluku ne wɔ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛziezie bɛ la’’.
4. Ɛlea: ‘‘Ebambe ɛlɛbɔ adalɛ. Mewɔ suanu la yɛɛ buluku ne minlinle a’’.
Buluku ɛzielɛ ɛleka neazovo ne ze ye kɛ sonla ko kye ala a ɛlɛka nɔhalɛ a. Nwane a 
vale buluku ne a?
Nyelebɛnloa adenle ne
Saa Bɛneɛ a ɛlɛka nɔhalɛ a, ɛnee buluku ne wɔ Agyako ɛkɛ. Na ɛhye kile kɛ, Ebambe 
nee Ɛlea ɛlɛbɔ adalɛ mɔɔ bamaa yeahile kɛ menli mɔɔ bo ko la a ɛlɛka nɔhalɛ a, yemɔti 
Agyako ɛlɛbɔ adalɛ. Zɔhane ati Bɛneɛ noko ɛlɛbɔ adalɛ.
Saa Agyako a ɛlɛka nɔhalɛ a, ɔnze debie mɔɔ buluku ne zɔho ye a. Ɛhye bahile kɛ, 
Bɛneɛ, Ebambe nee Ɛlea mɔ ɛlɛbɔ adalɛ, mɔɔ bamaa Ebambe edwɛkɛ ne ayɛ adalɛ, mɔɔ 
ɔ nee Agyako ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ kile kɛ ɔnze nwolɛ ɛhwee la ɛnle ko a. Zɔhane ati Agyako 
ɛlɛbɔ adalɛ.
Saa Ebambe a ɛlɛka nɔhalɛ a, ɔnwunle kɛ Ɛlea a vale buluku ne a. Ɛhye bahile kɛ 
Bɛneɛ, Agyako yɛɛ Ɛlea mɔ ɛlɛbɔ adalɛ. Kɛmɔ sonla ko kye a bahola aha nɔhalɛ la, 
nzuzulɛ ɛhye yɛ gyima.
Saa Ɛlea a ɛlɛka nɔhalɛ a, ɛnee Ebambe ɛlɛbɔ adalɛ, kile kɛ, Ebambe annwu kɛ Ɛlea 
vale buluku ne. Na ɛhye bahile kɛ, Bɛneɛ nee Agyako noko ɛlɛbɔ adalɛ, mɔɔ maa 
edwɛkɛ ne nee nɔhalɛ dodo mɔɔ bɛmaa nwolɛ adenle la bɔ nzianwo a. Zɔhane ati Ɛlea 
ɛlɛbɔ adalɛ.
Kɛmɔ sonla ko kye a ɛlɛka nɔhalɛ la, Ebambe a le awie mɔɔ ɛlɛka nɔhalɛ ne a. Zɔhane 
ati, Ɛlea a vale buluku ne a.

MUKENYE
Wɔ ngyɛnu ɛhye anu, ɛbanleɛnlea ngɛlɛhɛlɛdwɛkɛ asa ngane ne mɔ bie wɔ Nzema 
aneɛ ne anu. Ngyɛnu ne wowɔ adwenle titili wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nwo. Ɛbanwu 
kɛ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ si de la, edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ngakyile ne mɔ, nu-ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ 
edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nu yɛɛ nvasoɛ mɔɔ wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ zo la. Eza noko ɛbazukoa 
kɛ bɛsi bɛyɛ nvedevedenu wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nu la. Wɔ adwenle mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye wɔ 
edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nee edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nvedevedenuyɛlɛ nwo la bamaa wɔanwu 
edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ nee aneɛ ne anu sukoanyia mɔɔ anwo hyia kpalɛ la. Ngyɛnu ɛhye 
baboa amaa wɔahola wɔadwenledwenle ninyɛne nwo, wɔabɔ adwenle na wɔala wɔ 
adwenle ali. Edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nvedevedenuyɛlɛ ne baboa amaa wɔadwenle wɔahɔ 
moa, wɔahile aneɛ bo, na wɔanyia sukoanyia mɔɔ boa maa bɛneɛnlea ninyɛne nu boɛ 
la. Eza ɔbaboa amaa wɔanlea kɛ wɔ nganeɛdelɛ si de la na wɔanwu nwolɛ nrɛlɛbɛ. 
Ngyɛnu ne nee ɛzukoalɛdeɛ mɔɔ le kɛ tetedwɛkɛ, edwɛkɛ mɔɔ wɔ Nrelenza nu nee 
edwɛne la lɛ ngitanwolilɛ. Ngyɛnu ne bamaa wɔade kɛ menli si dwenle anzɛɛ bɛ 
nganeɛdelɛ de la; mɔɔ wɔ tete nzidwɛkɛ nu, mɔɔ wɔ maandeɛ nyɛleɛ nu yɛɛ kɛ menli 
ekpunli agyakɛdulɛ si de la. Edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ɛhakyelɛ nee ye ɛhanlɛ boa maa yɛnyia 
fasie, akɛnrazilɛ nee sukoanyia mɔɔ bɛfa bɛdi adwelie bagua nu la.
ADWENLE TITILI
• Edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ le edwɛkɛ mɔɔ fa edwɛndo-subane nee aneɛ mɔɔ bɛvea ɔ nye la ɔto 
nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ ndelebɛbo nee nganeɛdelɛ wɔ nu la.
• Bɛfɛlɛ awie mɔɔ kɛlɛ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ la “edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ kɛlɛvo”. Edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ 
kɛlɛvo fa aneɛnu ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ alɛrakoyɛlɛ, mita, sɛkɛlɛneɛdwɛkɛ, nee adwenlenu 
nvoninli nwo adwenle mɔɔ anu mia nee bodane wɔ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ nu.
• Aneɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkɛlɛ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ la ɛnle aneɛ mɔɔ ye ndelebɛbo ne anye la ɛkɛ 
ne kɛ aneɛ gyɛne la.

Nuninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nu la�
1. Adwenlenu nvoninli: Ɔdua aneɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkile kɛ debie si de la azo ɔnwo 
ɛnyelɛzo debie nvoninli wɔ kengavo ne adwenle nu.
2. Alɛra: Ɔkile alɛrakoyɛlɛ, edwɛndo-subane, vawolo alɛranzizo, kɔnsɔnante 
alɛranzizo, alɛradwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɔ nu maa edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne da nzolɛ la.
3. Subane nee ngyehyɛleɛ: Ɛhye kile kɛ bɛzi bɛziezie edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne nee kɛ ɔsi 
ɔde la. Ɔkile kɛ ye ekpunli ekpunli ne nee ɛhonlone ne mɔ si de la yɛɛ mɔɔ boa ye 
ngilenu ne nee nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ ɔto la.
4. Mita nee Edwɛndo-subane: Ɔkile ɛnelɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛhonlone ne mɔ anu la 
anwumahɔlɛ nee bɛ azeralɛ mɔɔ maa edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne nyia subane kɛ asɛɛ ɔle 
edwɛne la.
5. Alɛrakoyɛlɛ ngyehyɛleɛ: Ɔkile kɛ bɛzi bɛziezie alɛra ne mɔ wɔ ɛhonlone ne mɔ 
awieleɛ mɔɔ maa bɛnyia koyɛlɛ anzɛɛ ngakyile mɔɔ kile edwɛne subane na ɔboa 
fasieyɛlɛ nu la.
6. Ɛhonlone nee Ekpunli: Ɛhonlone ne mɔ a le ndinli mɔɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne gyi 
zo a yɛɛ bɛka bɛbɔ nu a bɛmaa yɛ ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛzi bɛnwo 
bodane ne la.
7. Aneɛ mɔɔ anye fea/Adwenlenu nvoninlihyelɛ: Ɔfa aneɛnu ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ 
ɛrɛlɛdendɛ, edwkɛnzɔho, sonlayɛlɛ nee nwudumolozo mɔ ɔnwo edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne 
ɔmaa ɔnyia ngilenu mɔɔ tɛla mɔɔ edwɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛnwo edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ 
ne lɛ la. Ɔboa aneɛbohilelɛ.
8. Bodane: Ɔkile adwenle anzɛɛ nrɛlaleɛ kpɔkyee ne mɔɔ kɛlɛvo ne ɛlɛdua 
edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne azo ava anwa mɔɔ fale sonla sukoanwu nee nganeɛdelɛ nwo

ɔte ye wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne anu la le gyinlabelɛ ne.

boa maa yɛyɛ fasie, yɛnyia akɛnrazilɛ yɛɛ baguanu ɛdendɛlɛ nwo sukoanyia.

aneɛnu ninyɛne le kɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛdwɛkɛ, adwenlenu nvoninli yɛɛ aneɛ mɔɔ anye-fea 
la. Aneɛnu ninyɛne ɛhye boa maa yɛ nloa te na yɛ ɛdendɛlɛ nu pi.
Gyima 10�4 Nvasoɛ mɔɔ wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ zo la
Ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo mɔ ɛgua bɛ nwo ekpunli ekpunli na bɛwowɔ adwenle wɔ nvasoɛ 
mɔɔ edwɛkɛdwendolɛ lɛ la anwo.
Subane mɔɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ lɛ la
Edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ lɛ subane ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ kile kɛ ye ngyehyɛleɛ ne si de la
1. Ɛhonlone: Edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ mɔɔ doɔdoa zo wɔ ɛdendɛlɛ ko anu la.
2. Ɛhonlone ne tendenle: Ɔkile kɛ ɛhonlone si wale la anzɛɛ ɛnelɛmgbɔkɛ dodo mɔɔ 
wɔ ɛhonlone ko biala anu la.
3. Ekpunli: Ɛhonlone ngakyile mɔɔ bobɔ nu yɛ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ngyɛnu ko la.
4. Alɛrakoyɛlɛ ngyehyɛleɛ: Ɔkile alɛra bie nzizoyɛlɛ mɔɔ finde ɛhonlone ne mɔ awieleɛ 
wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nu la.
5. Mita: Ɔkile ɛnelɛmgbɔkɛ anwumahɔlɛ nee azeralɛ ngyehyɛleɛ.
6. Ɛnelɛmgbɔkɛ-ndoazo: Mita ko, mɔɔ kile ɛnelɛmgbɔkɛ ngakyile mɔɔ bɛheha bɛbɔ 
nu la.
7. Anvahɛlɛlɛsɛkɛlɛneɛ: Ɛhye kile ɛdendɛmunli anzɛɛ ɛdendɛsinli mɔɔ toa zo kɔwolo 
ɛhonlone fofolɛ nu mɔɔ bɛnva ɛhɛlɛlɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ bɛnli gyima la.
8. Ɛzinzelɛ: Ɔkile ɛzinzelɛ anzɛɛ ɛgyinlanlɛ mɔɔ wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ɛhonlone nu la.
 9.  Ngɛlɛlera-koateeyɛlɛ: Ɛhye kile ngɛlɛlera ngokoatee mɔɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ ɛhonlone anzɛɛ 
ɛdendɛmunli bo la.
Bɛgyinla bodane ɛhye mɔ azo a bɛfa edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ngyehyɛleɛ bɛdi gyima a;
• Kile edwɛndo-subane nee edwɛneyɛlɛ adenle.
• Maa ngilenu na kile nzizoyɛlɛ.
• Kile kɛlɛvo ne subane yɛɛ gyinlabelɛ mɔɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne wɔ nu la.
• Kile kɛ kengavo ne si kenga la nee ye ndoɔdoazo ne.
• Fa debie mɔɔ maa edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne yɛ kɛlɛma wɔ ɛnyelɛzo la boka ye.

EDWƐKƐDWƐNDOLƐ NVEFENUYƐLƐ
Ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ ɛnea wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ 
nvefenuyɛlɛ nu la
1. Nea ngitanwo mɔɔ la tidwɛkɛ ne nee mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne anu avinli 
la.
2. Kpondɛ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne anu bodane ne anzɛɛ deɛmɔti kɛlɛvo ne hɛlɛle 
edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne la.
3. Nea saa aneɛ ne anu pi anzɛɛ ɔmpi a na kile deɛmɔti bɛvale zɔhane aneɛ ne bɛlile 
gyima la.
4. Ka kɛlɛvo ne subane ne anwo edwɛkɛ na kile kɛ ɔsi ɔda ye ali wɔ bodane ne anwo 
la.
5. Wowɔ adwenle wɔ gyinlabelɛ ne mɔɔ bɛla ye ali la anwo.
6. Ka aneɛnu ninyɛne ne mɔɔ bɛva bɛli gyima la anwo bie na kilehile gyima mɔɔ bɛdi 
la anu.
7. Ka subane anzɛɛ ngyehyɛleɛ mɔɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne lɛ la anwo bie.
8. Nea ahenle mɔɔ ɛlɛda edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne ali yɛɛ ahenle mɔɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne 
fale ɔ nwo la.
Gyima 10�5 Nuninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nu yɛɛ subane mɔɔ 
edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ lɛ la anwo mobɔnuyɛlɛ
Saa ɛbayɛ nvefenu wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nu a, nwolɛ hyia kɛ ɛkɛde nuninyɛne mɔɔ 
wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nu nee subane mɔɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne lɛ la abo.
1. Ɛ nee ɛ gɔnwo ɛnleɛnlea nuninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nu la anu. Bɛmaa 
ndonwo bɛvi edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhanle ye wɔ gyima 10.3 ne la anu.
2. Bɛwowɔ adwenle wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ gyima 10.3 ne anwo. Duzu 
alɛrakoyɛlɛ ngyehyɛleɛ a bɛkola bɛnwu ye a? Ɛhonlone nyɛ a wɔ ekpunli ko 
biala anu a? Ɛhonlone ne adendenle kakyihakyi anzɛɛ bɛsɛ ɔ?
Gyima 10�6 Edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nvefenuyɛlɛ
Kenga edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne yɛɛ nvefenu ndonwo ne mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye wɔ aze ɛke 
la. Fa ɛ ti anwo edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ kɛlɛ debie mɔɔ baboa amaa wɔayɛ nvefenu wɔ 
edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nu la.
Nvefenu ndonwo mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ, “Egya” mɔɔ Sylvia Plath 
hɛlɛle anu la.

Ngyɛnu 1: Kenga edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne kɔsɔɔti maa ɔvinde�
Ɛkenga edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ “Egya” wɔamaa yeavinde la le debie mɔɔ da nzonlɛ a. Ɔ nloa 
yɛ se yɛɛ ɔyɛ ɛvɛlɛ.
Ɔnlɛ alɛrakoyɛlɛ titili ko. Ekpunli ko biala nee alimoa ɛdeɛ ne le ngakyile, na ɔmaa 
nwolɛ nzuzulɛyɛlɛ yɛ se.
Eza ɛkola ɛnwu ye ndɛndɛ zo kɛ, edwɛkɛdwendolɛ kɛlɛvo ne vale alɛrakoyɛlɛ molozo 
lile gyima.
Ɛhye maa ye edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne anu yɛ anyebolo nee ezulolɛ.
Ngyɛnu 2: Fefe ewdɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne anu�
Wɔ ndonwo ɛhye anu, yɛbafefe ekpunli nwiɔ ne mɔɔ li moa wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ 
“Egya” anu. Emomu, ɔwɔ kɛ dahuu ɛfefe edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne kɔsɔɔti anu amaa 
wɔanwu nuninyɛne mɔɔ bɛva bɛli gyima la kɔsɔɔti.
Ye guabelɛ:
Alɛra “ɛ” ne le debie mɔɔ finde ekpunli nwiɔ ne ɛleka biala a; ɛhonlone ne mɔ mɔlebɛbo, 
bɛ avinli nee awieleɛ.

Bango NwiɔNGYƐNU  10
Saa ɛnea a ɛnwu ye kɛ, alɛrakoyɛlɛ “A” ne mɔɔ yɛnwu ye wɔ ɛhonlone ko ne nee mɔɔ 
tɔ zo nsa ne anu wɔ alimoa ekpunli ne anu la lɛ ye nzizo wɔ ɛhonlone ne mɔɔ tɔ zo 
nwiɔ wɔ ekpunli nwiɔ ne anu la. Zɔhane ala yɛɛ alɛrakoyɛlɛ “D” ne mɔɔ yɛnwu ye wɔ 
ɛhonlone ne mɔɔ tɔ zo nna ne wɔ ekpunli ko ne anu la lɛ ye nzizo wɔ ɛhonlone ne mɔɔ 
tɔ zo nsa nee nna ne mɔɔ bɛwɔ ekpunli nwiɔ ne anu la a.
Ngyɛnu 3: Nea gyima mɔɔ ɔdi la�
Kɛkala mɔɔ yɛnwu kɛlɛvo ne alɛrakoyɛlɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne la, maa yɛnlea gyima mɔɔ ɔdi 
la wɔ kpuyia ɛhye mɔ anloa ɛyeyelɛ nu.
1. Asoo alɛrakoyɛlɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne kakyi kolaa wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne anu 
bɔkɔɔ ɔ? Duzu ati ɔ?
Ekpunli ko biala lɛ ye alɛrakoyɛlɛ ngyehyɛleɛ. Ɛhonlone ngoko bie ala a lɛ 
alɛrakoyɛlɛ a.
Saa edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ bie lɛ alɛrakoyɛlɛ a, ɔfa koyɛlɛ nee ngitanwolilɛ ɔba 
edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne ekpunli ne mɔ anu. Mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la fa mgbakyemgbakye ba 
ekpunli ne mɔ anu na ɔmaa nwolɛ nzuzulɛ yɛ se.
2. Asoo ɔmaa ye ɛgengalɛ yɛ se anzɛɛ ɔla aze ɔ? Duzu ati ɔ?
Alɛrakoyɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔ anu nee alɛrakoyɛlɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne 
kile kɛ ɔle mgbata, na ɛhye maa ye ɛgengalɛ ne yɛ se.
Edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ kɛlɛvo ne vale alɛrakoyɛlɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ɛhye (mgbata ne) lile gyima 
kpalɛ na ɛhye maa ye ɛgengalɛ yɛ se na ɔku kengavo ɛvɛlɛ. Alɛrakoyɛlɛ ngyehyɛleɛ 
ndalɛ ne le ko kye. Ɔvale ɛhye ɔhilele bodane ne mɔɔ kile, abodelɛhilelɛ, ɛyavalɛ, 
nee ewule la.
3. Duzu gyinlabelɛ ɔda ye ali a?
Edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne ɛnlɛ edwɛndo-subane kpaziwɔkɛ biala mɔɔ maa yɛte ɔ bo 
ndɛndɛ na eza yɛfa yɛsie yɛ adwenle nu a. Eza anrɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔfa nwɔhoalilɛ adenle 
zo noko akee ɔle mɔɔ kile dwɔwɔlɛ a. Kɛlɛvo ne gyinlabelɛ kile ɛyavalɛ.
4. Ɔboa ɔmaa yɛnyia alɛrakoyɛlɛ ɔ?
Saa ɛnea edwɛkɛdɛndolɛ ne alɛrakoyɛlɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne a, edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ dɔɔnwo 
ne ala ɛngile alɛrakoyɛlɛ.
Ngyɛnu 4: Duzu nvasoɛ a ɔlɛ a?
Kɛkala mɔɔ yɛnwu gyima mɔɔ alɛrakoyɛlɛ ne di la, yedwu mekɛ mɔɔ yɛkpondɛ ngilenu a.
1. Asoo ɔgyi adwenle ko kye azo ɔ?
Dwenle bodane ne mɔɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne lɛ la anwo.
Egya le edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ mɔɔ ye adwelie ne anye kile ɛleka ko a. Plath ɛlɛkile ye 
nganeɛdelɛ nee ye adwenle mɔɔ ɔlɛ ye wɔ ɛdɛnlanlɛ ɛtane mɔɔ ɔ ze nee ye dɛnlanle 
la anwo.
Bodane mɔɔ bɛla ye ali wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne anu la bie mɔ a le: Abodelɛhilelɛ, 
ɛya, ewule yɛɛ tumililɛ.

2. Boni a le kɛlɛvo ne bodane ne a?
Saa ɛnea kɛlɛvo ne edwɛkpomgba ne nee edwɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔ a, ɔkile ye nganeɛdelɛ 
nee ye adwenle mɔɔ ɔlɛda ye ali yeahile kengavoma ne a. Ɛhye boa bodane ne 
mɔɔ le abodelɛhilelɛ mɔɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne da ye ali na ɔmaa yɛte nganeɛ mɔɔ 
kɛlɛvo ne wɔ nu la.
Ngyɛnu 5: Pɛ ye guabelɛ ne sikalɛ wɔ ɛdendɛkpunli ko anu�
Yedwu mekɛ mɔɔ ɛpɛ guabelɛ ne sikalɛ ɛdendɛkpunli ko a.
Kɛlɛvo ne nleɛnleanle abodelɛhilelɛ tumi wɔ Egya anu. Alɛrakoyɛlɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ne 
mɔɔ le mgbata la maa ye ɛgengalɛ yɛ se mɔɔ ɔkile kɛ abodelɛ bo ɛvealɛ ɛnla aze na 
ɔluale zo ɔhilele ye subane ne mɔɔ le ɛyavalɛ la ɔhilele kengavoma. Mgbɔlaboa bile, 
ɛnlomboɛ-awolɛ, bedevinli kɛ Feleseko …..” mɔ le sɛkɛlɛndeɛdwɛkɛ mɔɔ ɔvale ɔhilele 
subane mɔɔ selɛ ne wɔ nu la. Alimoa ekpunli ne ɛhonlone ne mɔɔ tɔ zo nsa kɔdwu 
nnu ne azo kile ye ɛvɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɔvɛle abodelɛhilelɛ ne abo la, yɛɛ alimoa ɛhonlone 
ne mɔɔ wɔ ekpunli ne mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ ne anu la, Egya, ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ meku wɔ da ye 
ɛyavalɛ mɔɔ kile ye gyinlabelɛ ne la. Ɔvale aneɛnu ninyɛne mɔɔ le kɛ nzizodwɛkɛ: 
Ɛnyɛ, ɛnyɛ, sɛkɛlɛneɛdwɛkɛ: … mgbɔlaboa bile, edwɛkɛnzoho: … mɔɔ mendɛnlanle nu 
kɛ egyakɛ nee dɔɔnwo ne ala ɔlile gyima ɔhilele bodane ne yɛɛ gyinlabelɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ 
edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne anu la.

6. Kilehile nuninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nu la.
7. Kilehile ndenle mɔɔ ɛbalua zo wɔayɛ nvefenu wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nu la na kile 
deɛmɔti ɛbava yemɔ la.
8. Nwo ɛ ti anwo edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ na kile ye bodane, alɛrakoyɛlɛ nee mɔɔ ɔ nee 
ye lua la.
9. Kilehile nuninyɛne ne mɔ anwo nvasoɛ mɔɔ wɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ɛnwolɛ nu la.

Kɔsɔnante
Ɔkile kɔnsɔnante mɔɔ finde ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ awieleɛ la.
Adwulaleɛ mgbɔkye 
mɔfeme
Ɔle mgbɔkye mɔfeme mɔɔ saa ɛfa ɛsua edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ a ɔngakyi 
ye aneɛmɛla ekpunli abusua mɔɔ ɔwɔ nu la.
Adenzideɛ/
Ngyegyelɛ
Dwɔwɔlɛ anzɛɛ ngyegyelɛ mɔɔ si debie anyuhɔlɛ adenle la.
Agyebɛ Agyebɛ le adwenle nwɔhoalilɛ mɔɔ dua aneɛ, edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ 
nee agyibadolɛ adenle zo ɔfea nyelebɛnloa anzɛɛ ndelebɛbo ne 
anye la.
Agyiba Agyiba le nwɔhoa anzɛɛ ngyegyelɛ mɔɔ hyia adwenle anzɛɛ 
ɛdwenlenlɛ fɔɔnwo na bɛaye ɔ nloa la.
Agualeɛ mgbɔkye 
mɔfeme
Saa ɛfa ɛsua edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ a ɔkola ɔkakyi ye aneɛmɛla ekpunli 
abusua mɔɔ ɔwɔ nu la.
Alɛrakoyɛlɛ 
ngyehyɛleɛ
Ɔkile alɛra bie nzizoyɛlɛ mɔɔ finde ɛhonlone ne mɔ awieleɛ wɔ 
edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ nu la na ɔmaa ɔnyia edwɛne subane la.
Alimoa aneɛ Aneɛ ne mɔɔ bɛkakyi bɛahɔ aneɛ gyɛne ne anu la.
Aneɛ mɔɔ tɔ zo 
nwiɔ/Amozi aneɛ
Aneɛ ne mɔɔ bɛkakyi alimoa aneɛ ne bɛahɔ nu la.
Ayɛlɛyelɛ 
edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ
Edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ tendenle mɔɔ bɛfa bɛyeyɛ anzɛɛ bɛwula awie, 
nzidwɛkɛ anzɛɛ adwenle bie anyunlunyia la.
Balade Ɔle adawu edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ mɔɔ bɛto a. Balade lɛ alɛrakoyɛlɛ 
ngyehyɛleɛ nee mita sikalɛ bie.
Bodane Ɔkile mɔɔ gyi bɛ nye zo, mɔɔ le kɛ ngyegyelɛ bie sɔbelɛ anzɛɛ 
guabelɛ kpɔkyee bie anwo ɛnyianlɛ.

Dasanli fanwodi Dasanli fanwodi le ngyehyɛleɛ mɔɔ kile tone ko anu ɛdolɛ nee 
pɛlepɛlelilɛ.
Edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ Edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ le bɛ-nloanu anzɛɛ ngɛlɛhɛlɛ edwɛnwo mɔɔ 
bɛdua zo bɛda sukoanwu, adwenle anzɛɛ nganeɛdelɛ wɔ 
ɛnyelɛzo nee adwenlenu ali la.
Edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ titili Ɛdendɛsinli nu edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia kpalɛ la.
Edwɛkɛmbɛzoyɛlɛ Ɔle adenle mɔɔ yɛdua zo yɛpɛ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ bie azo yɛnyia 
edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ fofolɛ yɛfi nu a.
Edwɛkɛmgbɔkɛ Ɔle alɛra, edwɛmgbɔkɛ nee mɔɔ bokɛboka nwo mɔɔ aneɛ lɛ la.
Ɛgengadeɛ Adawu anzɛɛ ngɛlɛhɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛkenga la.
Ɛnelɛ ɛwozolɛ Ɔkile kɛ ɛdendɛlɛ nvɛyeba ne mɔ si wozo wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ 
yɛlɛtendɛ la.
Ɛnelɛhakyihakyilɛ Ɔkile ɛnelɛ mɔɔ kakyihakyi wɔ ɛdendɛmunli nu la.
Ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ 
kɔnsɔnante
Ɔkile kɔsɔnante mɔɔ di gyima kɛ ɛnelɛkpɔkɛ la wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ 
vawolo ɛnle ɛkɛ la.
Ɛnelɛkpɔkɛyɛlɛ Ɔle adenle mɔɔ yɛdua zo yɛkyehyɛ edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ nu yɛnyia 
ɛnelɛmgbɔkɛ ngakyile ne mɔ la.
Ɛnledwɛndo-subane Edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ mɔɔ te ɔ nwo fi mita mɔɔ le fɔɔnwo nee 
edwɛndo-subane nwo na ɔnva alɛrakoyɛlɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ko ɔnli 
gyima la.
Ɛpeke 
edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ
Ɔle kolakoladulɛ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ mɔɔ wale na ɔka edwɛkɛ ɔfa 
mgbanyidwɛkɛ nee tetedwɛkɛ nwo a.
Ɛzinzelɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ Ɔle ɛhɛlɛlɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ (,) mɔɔ yɛfa yɛkile ɛnwomenlelielɛ wɔ 
ɛdendɛmunli nu anzɛɛ yɛfa yɛtete ninyɛne mɔɔ yɛbobɔ bɛ la 
avinli.
Funli-ngavolɛ Ɔle ngakyelɛ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛsu awie mɔɔ ɛwu la.
Laleke 
Edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ
Edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ mɔɔ da sonla nganeɛdelɛ anzɛɛ ye adwenle ali 
yɛɛ mekɛ dɔɔnwo ne ala ɔle kɛ edwɛndolɛ la.
Maandeɛ Ɔle menli ekpunli bie adwenle, maamulɛ nee bɛ tɛnlabelɛ nu 
subane mɔɔ bɛda ye ali la.
Maamulɛ Ɔle tete nyɛleɛ mɔɔ bɛkakyi bɛmaa awolɛ-ndoazo la.

Maanlema (sua/
azɛlɛ menle mɔ)
Menli mɔɔ limoale dɛnlanle ɛleka anzɛɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛde zo azo 
la.
Manzotwevo Awie mɔɔ anwo wɔ edwɛkɛ nu la; sɛmaavolɛ anzɛɛ mɔɔ 
bɛsɛmaa ye la.
Mɛla Ɔkile adengile bie mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi zo la.
Mita nee Edwɛndo-
subane
Ɔkile ɛnelɛmgbɔkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛhonlone ne mɔ anu la 
anwumahɔlɛ nee bɛ azeralɛ mɔɔ maa edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ ne nyia 
subane kɛ asɛɛ ɔle edwɛne la.
Mgbɔkye mɔfeme Ɔle aneɛmɛla nvɛyeba mɔɔ yɛfa yɛsi, yɛsɔ anɛɛ yɛfea 
edwɛkɛkpɔkɛ zo la.

This book is intended to be used for the Y ear Two Nzema Senior High School

to support learners’ self-study and revision. Learners can use the review
